x: Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It hears every control, including the ones that are not a knob or a fader, such as the mod wheel and the pedals, which knobMoved() never reports. The latest value of every controller number is also in OAVp5.cc, so a sketch that only wants to look can read OAVp5.cc[1] in draw(). For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('controlChange', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. cc The controller number, 0 to 127 (1 is the mod wheel, 64 the sustain pedal, 74 the first knob on a MiniLab 3). value Where the control is now, 0 to 1 (MIDI's 0 to 127 divided by 127). channel The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.

用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 每個控制它都聽得到，包括不是旋鈕也不是推桿的那些，像調變輪和踏板，knobMoved() 永遠不會回報它們。每個控制器號碼的最新值也放在 OAVp5.cc，所以只想看一眼的草圖可以在 draw() 裡讀 OAVp5.cc[1]。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('controlChange', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 cc 控制器號碼，0 到 127（1 是調變輪，64 是延音踏板，MiniLab 3 的第一顆旋鈕是 74）。 value 這個控制現在的位置，0 到 1（MIDI 的 0 到 127 除以 127）。 channel MIDI 通道，1 到 16。
The function form of fader1, for when the fader's number is a variable. n Which fader, counting from 1. The fader's position, 0..1; 0 until it has moved.
fader1 的函式版本，推桿的編號是變數的時候用。 n 第幾支推桿，從 1 開始算。 推桿的位置，0..1。還沒推過之前是 0。

Works exactly like knob1, for the controller's faders, numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them (as printed on the device). A controller with only four faders, like the MiniLab 3, has fader1 to fader4. Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load, exactly as for a knob (knob1); reading a fader also makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card. Changes when the fader moves; 0 until it has moved.
用法跟 knob1 完全一樣，只是對應控制器上的推桿，編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序（也就是機器上印的順序）。只有四支推桿的控制器（像 MiniLab 3）就只有 fader1 到 fader4。 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要，跟旋鈕一樣（見 knob1）。讀推桿還會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成一張卡片。 推桿移動的時候才會改變。還沒推過之前是 0。
The fader twin of knobMoved(): function faderMoved(n, value) { … }. n Which fader (1 is the first). value Where it is now, 0..1.
knobMoved() 的推桿版本：function faderMoved(n, value) { … }。 n 哪一支推桿（1 是第一支）。 value 現在的位置，0..1。

Use it when the number of the knob is a variable: for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));. It also works in a sketch that has its own knob1, which oav-p5 then leaves alone. n Which knob, counting from 1 (as printed on the controller). The knob's position, 0..1; 0 until it has been turned.
旋鈕的編號是變數的時候用它：for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));。草圖自己已經有 knob1 的話也可以用，oav-p5 不會去動那個名稱。 n 第幾顆旋鈕，從 1 開始算（照控制器上印的）。 旋鈕的位置，0..1。還沒轉過之前是 0。

Read it in draw() the way you read mouseX: background(knob1 255). Knobs are numbered the way they are printed on the controller, so knob 1 is knob 1 on any controller OAV has a profile for: the MiniLab 3's first knob is CC 74, the LPD8's is CC 70. The sketch never needs to know a CC number. On a controller OAV has no profile for, the first knob you turn becomes knob1, the next one knob2, and so on, in the order you turn them. Past eight, use knob(n). Nothing to call. With the default hardware=auto, oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI as soon as it loads, whatever the sketch reads (Chrome, Edge and Firefox have it; Safari and iPad do not: use 🎹 or a phone there). Reading a knob also tells oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI, so when Web MIDI is missing or refused a card beside the 🎹 says so; a sketch that uses none of this never sees that card. ?oav_hardware=click waits for the 🎹 panel instead. A sketch that already has its own knob1 (a let, a function) keeps it, and a card beside the 🎹 says what to read instead (knob(1)). With OP Configurator, knobs also drive the OPC sliders in the order they are declared. A knob the sketch reads itself stays the sketch's: that slider no longer follows it. Changes when the knob moves, not once per frame; the sketch just reads the latest value. 0 until the knob has been turned.

像讀 mouseX 一樣在 draw() 裡讀：background(knob1 255)。旋鈕的編號照控制器上印的順序，所以在 OAV 有設定檔的任何控制器上，旋鈕 1 就是旋鈕 1：MiniLab 3 的第一顆是 CC 74，LPD8 的是 CC 70。草圖完全不用知道 CC 號碼。 遇到 OAV 沒有設定檔的控制器，你轉的第一顆旋鈕就變成 knob1，下一顆是 knob2，依你轉的順序往下排。超過八顆就用 knob(n)。 不用呼叫任何東西。預設的 hardware=auto 下，oav-p5 一載入就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI，不管草圖有沒有讀東西（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 有。Safari 和 iPad 沒有，那裡改用 🎹 或手機）。讀旋鈕還會讓 oav-p5 知道這份草圖要用 MIDI 玩，所以 Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕的時候，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明。完全沒用到這些的草圖不會看到那張卡片。?oav_hardware=click 則是等你按 🎹 面板裡的按鈕才去要。 草圖如果本來就有自己的 knob1（let、函式都算），就由草圖保留，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明改讀什麼（knob(1)）。 搭配 OP Configurator 時，旋鈕也會依宣告順序推動 OPC 的滑桿。草圖自己有讀的那顆旋鈕就歸草圖：對應的滑桿不再跟著動。 旋鈕轉動的時候才會改變，不是每個畫面一次。草圖只要讀最新的值。旋鈕還沒轉過之前是 0。

Like mouseMoved() for knobs: It is called for every step the knob sends, so many times per second while it turns. To read a knob once a frame, use knob1 instead. n Which knob (1 is the first, as printed on the controller). value Where it is now, 0..1.
就像旋鈕版的 mouseMoved()： 旋鈕每送出一格就呼叫一次，轉動的時候每秒會呼叫很多次。想要每個畫面讀一次，就改用 knob1。 n 哪一顆旋鈕（1 是第一顆，照控制器上印的）。 value 現在的位置，0..1。
The frame-counting twin of lastNoteTs: 0 in the first frame after the key, then 1, 2, 3 … A frame number, on the same count as frameCount, set with note; -Infinity before any key. Since oav-p5 0.8.3.
lastNoteTs 的「數格子」版本：按下之後的第一格是 0，接下來 1、2、3…… 畫面的編號，跟 frameCount 同一套數法，跟 note 一起更新。還沒按過任何鍵之前是 -Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.3 起。

Any key counts: a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen, a phone. Releasing a key does not change it. Milliseconds on the same clock as millis(), set with note and velocity; -Infinity before any key. Since oav-p5 0.8.2.
任何鍵都算：MIDI 鍵盤、畫面上的 🎹、手機。放開鍵不會改變它。 毫秒，跟 millis() 同一個時鐘，跟 note、velocity 一起更新。還沒按過任何鍵之前是 -Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.2 起。

Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It is the widest net: it is called first for every note, control change and pitch bend, and it is the only function that hears the messages oav-p5 has no friendlier name for, such as channel pressure (0xD0), polyphonic aftertouch (0xA0) and program change (0xC0). The OAVp5.last object keeps the latest note, control change or pitch bend, but not those. It does not hear system messages: the MIDI clock, start, stop and song position go to OAVp5.clock, and system-exclusive messages are dropped. A note-on with velocity 0 arrives here as it was sent (a note-on with 0), while noteOff() is the one that treats it as a release. For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('midiMessage', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. bytes The message as three numbers [status, data1, data2]. 用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 它是網子最大的一個：每個音符、控制變化、音高輪訊息都會先呼叫它，而且 oav-p5 沒有比較親切的名字可以叫的訊息，只有它聽得到，像是通道壓力（0xD0）、各鍵觸後（0xA0）、音色切換（0xC0）。OAVp5.last 只留最新的音符、控制變化或音高輪，不留這些。 系統訊息它聽不到：MIDI 時鐘、start、stop、song position 都交給 OAVp5.clock，系統專用（sysex）訊息直接丟掉。力道是 0 的 note-on 在這裡照送出的樣子到達（note-on，力道 0），把它當成放開的是 noteOff()。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('midiMessage', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 bytes 這則訊息，三個數字 [status, data1, data2]。status 位元組的上半是種類，下半是通道（0x90 是通道 1 的 note-on，0x93 是通道 4 的）。資料位元組是 0 到 127，訊息沒有的那個位元組是 0。 source 它從哪裡來：'hardware'（真的控制器）、'screen'（🎹）、'phone'、'virtual-out'（某個程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI）、'link'（同一個房間的另一頁），或你在 OAVp5.input() 給的標籤。

Middle C is 60, A4 is 69. noteName(note) writes the number as a name (60 → 'C4') and noteFreq(note) as a frequency in Hz. velocity says how hard it was pressed. For every key, not just the last, define notePressed(). Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load (see knob1). Unlike a knob, merely reading note does not tell oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI: defining notePressed() or reading a knob or pad does, which is what makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card. 🎹 and a phone always work. A sketch with its own note (a let note, a function) keeps it; read midi.last.note instead. oav-p5 says so in a card the first time. Set when a key goes down and kept after it is released; 0 before any key has been pressed.

中央 C 是 60，A4 是 69。noteName(note) 把號碼寫成音名（60 → 'C4'），noteFreq(note) 換成赫茲。velocity 告訴你按得多用力。想要每個鍵都知道、不只最後一個，就定義 notePressed()。 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要（見 knob1）。跟旋鈕不一樣，單單讀 note 並不會讓 oav-p5 知道草圖要用 MIDI 玩：定義 notePressed()，或讀旋鈕、墊子才會，也才會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成卡片。🎹 和手機隨時都能用。 草圖如果自己有 note（let note、函式都算），就由草圖保留。改讀 midi.last.note。oav-p5 第一次會用卡片告訴你。 鍵按下的時候設定，放開之後也保留。還沒有按過任何鍵之前是 0。

The MIDI version of keyIsDown(). noteIsDown('C4') is the same as noteIsDown(60): C4 is middle C. A name that is not a note ('H4', 'C-2') stops the sketch with a one-line card saying how to write it. n The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name ('C4', 'c#4', 'Db3'). True if that key is down right now.
就是 MIDI 版的 keyIsDown()。noteIsDown('C4') 跟 noteIsDown(60) 一樣：C4 是中央 C。不是音符的名稱（'H4'、'C-2'）會讓草圖停下來，並用一張卡片告訴你怎麼寫。 n 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼（60）或音名（'C4'、'c#4'、'Db3'）。 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。
To ask about one particular key, use noteIsDown(). midi.held lists every key held right now, lowest first. Like keyIsPressed, for MIDI keys. False when nothing is held.
想問某一個特定的鍵，用 noteIsDown()。midi.held 列出現在按著的所有鍵，由低到高。 像 keyIsPressed，但是對 MIDI 琴鍵。沒有任何鍵按著就是 false。

The partner of noteOn(): It is called for a note-off message and also for a note-on with velocity 0, which many keyboards send instead. There is no velocity: oav-p5 does not pass the release velocity. For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('noteOff', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. note The MIDI number of the key that came up, 0 to 127. channel The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.

noteOn() 的另一半： note-off 訊息會呼叫它，力道是 0 的 note-on 也會（很多鍵盤用那個來代替 note-off）。沒有力道這個參數：oav-p5 不傳放開時的力道。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('noteOff', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 note 放開的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127。 channel MIDI 通道，1 到 16。

Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It is called once per note-on message, as it came in. It is the level below notePressed(): the same moment, but with the channel, and for pads too, even when the sketch defines padPressed(). A note-on with velocity 0, which some keyboards send instead of a note-off, is not a note-on here: it calls noteOff(). For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('noteOn', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. note The MIDI number of the key, 0 to 127 (60 is middle C). noteName(note) turns it into a name. velocity How hard, above 0 and up to 1 (MIDI's 1 to 127 divided by 127). channel The MIDI channel, 1 to 16. Pads on the MiniLab 3 and the LPD8 send on channel 10.

用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 每則 note-on 訊息進來就呼叫一次，照它進來的樣子。它比 notePressed() 低一層：同一個時刻，但多了通道，而且打擊墊也會呼叫，就算草圖有定義 padPressed() 也一樣。力道是 0 的 note-on（有些鍵盤用它來代替 note-off）在這裡不算 note-on，會去呼叫 noteOff()。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('noteOn', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 note 這個鍵的 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127（60 是中央 C）。noteName(note) 可以把它轉成音名。 velocity 多用力，大於 0、最大 1（MIDI 的 1 到 127 除以 127）。 channel MIDI 通道，1 到 16。MiniLab 3 和 LPD8 的打擊墊都是從通道 10 送出。

Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It is called once per key, with the key and how hard. A pad also calls it, unless the sketch defines padPressed(). Defining it is enough: oav-p5 calls it from every source, and if Web MIDI is missing or refused it says so in a card beside the 🎹 (Web MIDI itself is asked for at load, see knob1). Keys from 🎹 and from a phone call it too. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next key still plays, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. note The MIDI number of the key (60 is middle C). noteName(note) turns it into a name. velocity How hard, 0..1.

用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 每個鍵呼叫一次，帶著是哪個鍵、多用力。打擊墊也會呼叫它，除非草圖有定義 padPressed()。 只要定義了它就夠了：不管是哪一種來源，oav-p5 都會呼叫它。Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕的時候，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明（Web MIDI 本身在載入時就會去要，見 knob1）。🎹 和手機上彈的鍵也會呼叫它。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一個鍵還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 note 這個鍵的 MIDI 號碼（60 是中央 C）。noteName(note) 可以把它轉成音名。 velocity 多用力，0..1。
The partner of notePressed(), like keyReleased() to keyPressed(): note The MIDI number of the key that was released.
notePressed() 的另一半，就像 keyReleased() 之於 keyPressed()： note 被放開的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼。
The function form of pad1. n Which pad, counting from 1. The velocity while the pad is held (0..1), 0 when it is released.
pad1 的函式版本。 n 第幾個墊子，從 1 開始算。 墊子按著的時候是力道（0..1），放開是 0。

Read it like a held mouse button that also knows how hard: if (pad1 > 0) fill(255, 90, 31). Pads are numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them. To react once per hit rather than ask every frame, define padPressed(). Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load, exactly as for a knob (knob1); reading a pad also makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card. The velocity of the hit while the pad is held (1 is as hard as the controller sends), and 0 as soon as it is released.

像一個知道力道的滑鼠按鍵那樣讀：if (pad1 > 0) fill(255, 90, 31)。墊子編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序。想「每打一下反應一次」而不是每個畫面都問，就定義 padPressed()。 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要，跟旋鈕一樣（見 knob1）。讀墊子還會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成一張卡片。 墊子按著的時候是這一下的力道（1 是控制器能送出的最大力道），一放開就變成 0。
When the sketch defines padPressed(), a pad calls it and not notePressed(); without it, a pad calls notePressed() like any key. n Which pad (1 is the first). velocity How hard, 0..1.
草圖有定義 padPressed() 的話，打擊墊會呼叫它，而不會呼叫 notePressed()。沒有定義的話，打擊墊會像任何一個鍵一樣呼叫 notePressed()。 n 哪個墊子（1 是第一個）。 velocity 多用力，0..1。
The partner of padPressed(): function padReleased(n) { … }. Without it, a pad calls noteReleased(). n Which pad (1 is the first).
padPressed() 的另一半：function padReleased(n) { … }。沒有定義的話，打擊墊會呼叫 noteReleased()。 n 哪個墊子（1 是第一個）。

Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): A pitch wheel usually springs back to the middle when you let go, so you will hear a stream of values ending at 0. MIDI sends the position as 14 bits (0 to 16383, with 8192 in the middle). oav-p5 hands it to you as −1 to 1. The latest position is also in OAVp5.bend. For one incoming message the order is: midiMessage(), then the specific one (noteOn(), controlChange(), pitchBend()), then the friendly one (padPressed(), knobMoved(), notePressed() and their partners). Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, ?oav_hardware=auto), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, OAVp5.input() and other programs reach it too. OAVp5.on('pitchBend', fn) does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it. Pitch bend is not mapped to anything else: there is no bend variable, only this function and OAVp5.bend. An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line. value The wheel's position: −1 all the way down, 0 in the middle, 1 all the way up. channel The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.

用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 音高輪放開之後通常會自己彈回中間，所以你會收到一串值，最後停在 0。MIDI 用 14 位元送出位置（0 到 16383，中間是 8192），oav-p5 轉成 −1 到 1 給你。最新的位置也放在 OAVp5.bend。 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 midiMessage()，再來是對應的那一個（noteOn()、controlChange()、pitchBend()），最後才是比較親切的那一個（padPressed()、knobMoved()、notePressed() 和它們的另一半）。 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，?oav_hardware=auto），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、OAVp5.input() 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。OAVp5.on('pitchBend', fn) 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。 音高輪沒有對應到別的東西：沒有叫 bend 的變數，只有這個函式和 OAVp5.bend。 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。 value 輪子的位置：−1 是推到底往下，0 是中間，1 是推到底往上。 channel MIDI 通道，1 到 16。

MIDI sends velocity as 0 to 127; oav-p5 hands you it divided by 127, so 1 is the hardest hit the controller can send. A sketch with its own velocity keeps it; read midi.last.value. Set together with note when a key goes down; kept after release; 0 before any key.
MIDI 的力道是 0 到 127。oav-p5 給你的是除以 127 之後的值，所以 1 就是控制器能送出的最大力道。 草圖自己有 velocity 的話就由草圖保留。改讀 midi.last.value。 跟 note 一起在鍵按下的時候設定。放開之後保留。還沒按過任何鍵之前是 0。

Read it in draw() like a knob that goes both ways: x = width / 2 + OAVp5.bend 150. MIDI sends the position as 14 bits (0 to 16383, with 8192 in the middle). oav-p5 maps the two halves to −1..0 and 0..1, so full travel reaches exactly −1 and 1. To be told on every movement, define pitchBend(). midi.bend is the same number. There is no plain bend variable. Changes when the wheel moves. 0 before it has moved, and again when a spring-loaded wheel returns to the middle.

像一顆可以往兩邊轉的旋鈕那樣在 draw() 裡讀：x = width / 2 + OAVp5.bend 150。MIDI 用 14 位元送出位置（0 到 16383，中間是 8192）。oav-p5 把兩半分別對應成 −1 到 0 和 0 到 1，所以推到底剛好是 −1 和 1。想每次移動都被通知，就定義 pitchBend()。 midi.bend 是同一個數字。沒有叫 bend 的變數。 輪子動的時候才會變。還沒動過之前是 0，有彈簧的輪子彈回中間時也是 0。

The array version of controlChange(): read any controller in draw() without defining a function. It holds every CC, including the ones that are not a knob or a fader, such as the mod wheel (1), the volume (7) and the sustain pedal (64, which counts as down at 0.5 and above). The MIDI channel is ignored: the latest value of that controller number wins, whichever channel it came on. midi.cc is the same array. The friendly names knob1 and fader1 are looked up through the controller's profile and read the same data. The index is the controller (CC) number, 0 to 127; the value is the last one received divided by 127. Changes when a message arrives. 0 before a control has moved, which is not the same as "at 0".

controlChange() 的陣列版：不用定義函式，在 draw() 裡讀任何控制器。每個 CC 它都記著，包括不是旋鈕也不是推桿的那些，像調變輪（1）、音量（7）和延音踏板（64，0.5 以上算踩下去）。MIDI 通道被忽略：那個控制器號碼的最新值勝出，不管它是從哪個通道來的。 midi.cc 是同一個陣列。比較親切的 knob1 和 fader1 是透過控制器的設定檔對應過去的，讀的是同樣的資料。 索引是控制器（CC）號碼，0 到 127，值是最後收到的那個除以 127。訊息進來的時候才會變。控制還沒動過之前是 0，這跟「剛好在 0」不是同一件事。

It does what ?oav_hardware=auto does at load, at a moment you pick: from a button, after an intro, or when hardware is click or off. It works whatever the option says. After a refusal you can call it again to retry, but browsers usually remember a refusal and answer at once, so the way out is the lock icon left of the address. A browser with Web MIDI (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), on https or localhost. Some browsers want a click first: call it from mousePressed() or a button handler if setup() is too early. Safari and iPad have none: the promise resolves false and OAVp5.hardware is 'unavailable'. Resolves to true once the browser has allowed Web MIDI (with or without a device plugged in), and to false if it refused or there is no Web MIDI in this browser. Calling it again while it is asking, or after it said yes, gives the same answer.

它做的就是 ?oav_hardware=auto 在載入時做的事，只是時間由你挑：從一個按鈕、片頭結束之後，或是 hardware 設成 click 或 off 的時候。不管選項怎麼設它都能用。被拒絕之後可以再呼叫一次重試，但瀏覽器通常會記住拒絕、立刻回答，所以要解決得靠網址列左邊的鎖頭。 要有 Web MIDI 的瀏覽器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox），網頁在 https 或 localhost 底下。有些瀏覽器要先有一次點擊：如果在 setup() 裡太早，就放在 mousePressed() 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。Safari 和 iPad 沒有：promise 會 resolve 成 false，OAVp5.hardware 是 'unavailable'。 瀏覽器允許 Web MIDI 之後 resolve 成 true（不管有沒有插設備），被拒絕或這個瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI 就 resolve 成 false。還在詢問的時候、或是已經答應之後再呼叫，會得到同樣的答案。

Use it for a line like "playing: Arturia MiniLab3", or to tell whether a real controller is there. The names are whatever the operating system calls the port, so match them loosely (name.toLowerCase().includes('minilab')). The 🎹 panel uses them to follow the controller that is plugged in. midi.devices is the same array, replaced as a whole, not changed in place: read it again after a change. One entry per connected input port. Replaced whenever a device is plugged in or out. Empty until Web MIDI has been allowed (OAVp5.hardware), and it never lists the on-screen controller or the phone.

用來顯示像「正在彈：Arturia MiniLab3」這樣的一行，或判斷有沒有真的控制器。名稱是作業系統給連接埠取的名字，所以比對時要寬鬆一點（name.toLowerCase().includes('minilab')）。🎹 面板就是用它們來跟著插上去的那一台控制器。 midi.devices 是同一個陣列，是整個換掉，不是就地修改：變動之後要重新讀一次。 每個連上的輸入埠一項。每次有設備插上或拔掉都會換成新的。在 Web MIDI 被允許之前是空的（OAVp5.hardware），而且永遠不會列出螢幕上的控制器或手機。

'off': Web MIDI has not been asked for yet (see hardware). 'asking': waiting for the browser's permission answer. 'connected': allowed, and at least one device is plugged in (OAVp5.devices lists them). 'waiting': allowed, but no device yet: plug one in and it becomes 'connected' by itself. 'denied': the permission was refused. 'unavailable': the browser has no Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) or could not open it. It is only about real hardware. The on-screen controller and a phone work in every state. In the 🩺 check-up, waiting is written as "no device found". Changes when the browser answers and whenever a MIDI device is plugged in or out.

'off'：還沒有去要過 Web MIDI（見 hardware）。'asking'：等瀏覽器的權限回答。'connected'：允許了，而且至少插著一台設備（OAVp5.devices 列出它們）。'waiting'：允許了，但還沒有設備：插上一台就會自己變成 'connected'。'denied'：權限被拒絕。'unavailable'：這個瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad），或是打不開它。 它只管真的硬體。螢幕上的控制器和手機在每一種狀態下都能用。 在 🩺 體檢裡，waiting 寫成「沒偵測到裝置」。 瀏覽器回答的時候，以及每次有 MIDI 設備插上或拔掉的時候會變。

The short version of OAVp5.note: only the keys that are down, so OAVp5.held.length is how many, OAVp5.held[0] is the lowest and OAVp5.held.map((n) => noteName(n)) spells the chord. noteIsPressed is OAVp5.held.length > 0. midi.held is the same array. Read it, do not change it. It is the same array object every time, so copy it ([...OAVp5.held]) if you want to keep a moment of it. Empty when nothing is held. A key is added when its note-on arrives and removed at its note-off, and the list is kept sorted from low to high.

OAVp5.note 的精簡版：只列按著的鍵，所以 OAVp5.held.length 是幾個鍵，OAVp5.held[0] 是最低的那個，OAVp5.held.map((n) => noteName(n)) 把和弦寫出來。noteIsPressed 就是 OAVp5.held.length > 0。 midi.held 是同一個陣列。只讀，不要改它。它每次都是同一個陣列物件，想把某一刻存下來的話要複製一份（[...OAVp5.held]）。 沒有按著任何鍵的時候是空的。note-on 進來時加入，note-off 時移除，清單一直照由低到高排好。

It is the door every input goes through, and you can knock on it yourself: a sketch can test itself without a controller, drive itself from a timer, or take messages from a WebSocket or another library. The sketch cannot tell the difference: knob1, notePressed(), OAVp5.note, the sound if startSound() is on and the drum cues all react. OAVp5.play() is the friendlier way to send a note. midi.input(…) is the same function. It returns nothing. A message with a source other than 'screen' also lights the keys of the on-screen controller if it is open. bytes One message, [status, data1, data2]: [0x90, 60, 100] is a note-on for key 60 with velocity 100 on channel 1, [0xB0, 74, 127] a control change, [0xE0, 0, 64] a pitch bend in the middle. The status byte sets the kind (top half) and the channel (bottom half). Only the first three numbers are read, and the data bytes are held to 0 to 127. System messages are not for this: the clock bytes (0xF8, 0xFA, 0xFB, 0xFC, 0xF2) go to OAVp5.clock, and anything else from 0xF0 up is ignored. source A label for where it came from, which shows up as OAVp5.last.source and as the second argument of midiMessage(). Any text. 'hardware' and 'virtual-out' are taken as those real sources and are not repeated to a sketch's own Web MIDI code. device A profile id such as 'akai-lpd8': the numbering of knob1, pad1 … follows that controller for this message. Left out, it is the controller on the on-screen panel.

每一種輸入都從這扇門進來，你也可以自己來敲：草圖可以在沒有控制器的時候測試自己、用計時器自己推動自己，或接收來自 WebSocket 或其他函式庫的訊息。草圖分不出差別：knob1、notePressed()、OAVp5.note、開著 startSound() 時的聲音，還有鼓機的 cue 都會有反應。要送音符的話，OAVp5.play() 是比較親切的方式。 midi.input(…) 是同一個函式。它沒有回傳值。來源不是 'screen' 的訊息，會在螢幕控制器打開的時候也讓它的琴鍵亮起來。 bytes 一則訊息，[status, data1, data2]：[0x90, 60, 100] 是通道 1 上鍵 60、力道 100 的 note-on，[0xB0, 74, 127] 是控制變化，[0xE0, 0, 64] 是在中間的音高輪。status 位元組決定種類（上半）和通道（下半）。只讀前三個數字，資料位元組會被限制在 0 到 127。系統訊息不是給它用的：時鐘位元組（0xF8、0xFA、0xFB、0xFC、0xF2）會交給 OAVp5.clock，從 0xF0 起的其他東西都忽略。 source 一個說明來源的標籤，會出現在 OAVp5.last.source，也是 midiMessage() 的第二個參數。任何文字都行。'hardware' 和 'virtual-out' 會被當作真的那兩種來源，不會再轉給草圖自己的 Web MIDI 程式。 device 設定檔 id，像 'akai-lpd8'：這則訊息裡 knob1、pad1 … 的編號照那一台控制器來對應。不寫的話，就是螢幕面板上的那一台控制器。

It is noteIsDown() under the OAVp5 name, for a sketch that cannot use the plain one: OAVp5.isDown('C4'). A name that is not a note stops the sketch with a card that says how to write one. midi.isDown(…) is the same function. n The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name ('C4', 'c#4', 'Db3'). True if that key is down right now.
它是用 OAVp5 這個名字呼叫的 noteIsDown()，給不能用一般名稱的草圖：OAVp5.isDown('C4')。不是音符的名稱會讓草圖停下來，並用卡片說明怎麼寫。 midi.isDown(…) 是同一個函式。 n 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼（60）或音名（'C4'、'c#4'、'Db3'）。 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。

A single object that is replaced on every message, so read it, do not keep it. It is how a sketch finds out where a message came from (OAVp5.last.source) or which knob moved (OAVp5.last.control), and what to read when the sketch has its own note or velocity that keeps the plain names: OAVp5.last.note and OAVp5.last.value. It keeps only notes, control changes and pitch bends. Aftertouch and program change reach midiMessage() but are not stored here. midi.last is the same object. Clock messages (tick, start, stop) are not here: see OAVp5.clock. { type, note | cc, value, channel, source, control }. type is 'noteOn', 'noteOff', 'controlChange' or 'pitchBend' (a note-on with velocity 0 is a 'noteOff'). note is there for notes, cc for control changes. value is the velocity 0..1 (0 for a note-off), the control's position 0..1, or the wheel −1..1. channel is 1 to 16. source is 'hardware', 'screen', 'phone', 'virtual-out', 'link' or the label you gave OAVp5.input(). control is 'knob1', 'fader2', 'pad3' … when the controller's profile knows it, otherwise null.

它是每收到一則訊息就整個換掉的單一物件，所以只讀，不要留著。草圖用它知道訊息從哪裡來（OAVp5.last.source）或哪顆旋鈕動了（OAVp5.last.control），草圖自己有 note 或 velocity 而保留了一般名稱的時候，也是改讀它：OAVp5.last.note 和 OAVp5.last.value。 它只留音符、控制變化和音高輪。觸後和音色切換只會到 midiMessage()，這裡不存。 midi.last 是同一個物件。時鐘訊息（tick、start、stop）不在這裡，請看 OAVp5.clock。 { type, note | cc, value, channel, source, control }。type 是 'noteOn'、'noteOff'、'controlChange' 或 'pitchBend'（力道 0 的 note-on 算 'noteOff'）。音符有 note，控制變化有 cc。value 是力道 0 到 1（note-off 是 0）、控制的位置 0 到 1，或輪子的 −1 到 1。channel 是 1 到 16。source 是 'hardware'、'screen'、'phone'、'virtual-out'、'link'，或你在 OAVp5.input() 給的標籤。control 在控制器的設定檔認得它的時候是 'knob1'、'fader2'、'pad3' …，否則是 null。

Read every key at once, in draw(): OAVp5.note[60] for one key, or a loop over a range to draw a piano roll. It is the array version of noteIsDown(), with the velocity in it. It is not the variable note, which is just the number of the last key pressed. OAVp5.held is the same information as a short list of the keys that are down. midi.note is the same array. A note-on with velocity 0 sets the key to 0, like a note-off. The index is the MIDI note number, 0 to 127. A key that is down holds the velocity of its note-on divided by 127, a key that is up (or never pressed) holds 0. Changes when a message arrives, not once per frame.

在 draw() 裡一次讀每個鍵：OAVp5.note[60] 讀一個鍵，或用迴圈跑過一個範圍來畫鋼琴捲簾。它是 noteIsDown() 的陣列版，而且裡面有力道。它不是變數 note，那個只是最後按下的鍵的號碼。OAVp5.held 是同樣的資訊，做成只列出按著的鍵的短清單。 midi.note 是同一個陣列。力道是 0 的 note-on 會讓那個鍵變成 0，就像 note-off。 索引是 MIDI 音符號碼，0 到 127。按著的鍵放的是它 note-on 的力道除以 127，放開（或從沒按過）的鍵是 0。訊息進來的時候才會變，不是每個畫面一次。

The event functions (notePressed(), knobMoved(), noteOn() …) are defined once, by name. OAVp5.on('notePressed', fn) is the other way: any number of listeners, added and removed while the sketch runs, with no global names taken. It is how a library, a class or a Hydra sketch listens, and the way to listen for a while and stop. A listener counts as a defined function for the pad rule: once anything listens to 'padPressed', a pad stops calling notePressed(). An error inside fn shows in the console and on a card, and the other listeners still run. For the microphone's events use OAVp5.mic.on(). midi.on(…) is the same function. name The event: 'notePressed', 'noteReleased', 'knobMoved', 'faderMoved', 'padPressed', 'padReleased', 'noteOn', 'noteOff', 'controlChange', 'pitchBend' or 'midiMessage'. 'noteon' and 'noteoff' work in any case. Anything else throws an error that lists the names. fn Called with the same arguments the function of that name would get (notePressed(note, velocity), knobMoved(n, value) …). A function that takes fn off again: const off = OAVp5.on(…); off();.

事件函式（notePressed()、knobMoved()、noteOn() …）是用名字定義一次的。OAVp5.on('notePressed', fn) 是另一種方式：想要幾個監聽者都行，草圖在跑的時候可以加也可以拿掉，也不占用任何全域名稱。函式庫、類別或 Hydra 草圖就是這樣監聽的，要聽一陣子再停下來也用它。 對打擊墊的規則來說，監聽者就跟定義過的函式一樣：只要有東西在聽 'padPressed'，打擊墊就不再呼叫 notePressed()。fn 裡面出錯會顯示在 console 和卡片上，其他的監聽者照樣執行。麥克風的事件要用 OAVp5.mic.on()。 midi.on(…) 是同一個函式。 name 事件名稱：'notePressed'、'noteReleased'、'knobMoved'、'faderMoved'、'padPressed'、'padReleased'、'noteOn'、'noteOff'、'controlChange'、'pitchBend' 或 'midiMessage'。'noteon' 和 'noteoff' 大小寫隨便。其他的名稱會丟出一個錯誤，並列出可用的名稱。 fn 呼叫它的時候帶的參數跟同名函式會拿到的一樣（notePressed(note, velocity)、knobMoved(n, value) …）。 一個把 fn 取消的函式：const off = OAVp5.on(…); off();。

The panel behind the 🎹 button holds the on-screen controller and the buttons for 🎤, 🔊, 🥁, ⏺, 📷, 📱 and 🩺. OAVp5.panel.open(), close() and toggle() do what pressing 🎹 does, from your code: open it on a key, or open it at the start for a workshop (?oav_panel=open does the same at load). With ?oav_panel=off there is no 🎹 and these do nothing.
🎹 按鈕後面的面板裝著螢幕上的控制器，和 🎤、🔊、🥁、⏺、📷、📱、🩺 的按鈕。OAVp5.panel.open()、close()、toggle() 做的是按 🎹 做的事，只是從你的程式裡：按一個鍵就打開它，或是工作坊一開始就打開（?oav_panel=open 在載入時做同樣的事）。 設了 ?oav_panel=off 就沒有 🎹，這幾個也什麼都不做。

Same as pressing the 🎹 button. The first time the panel opens, oav-p5 loads the on-screen controller (a few seconds on a slow connection, which the panel says while it loads), and if hardware is click it asks for Web MIDI then. OAVp5.panel.open() when it is already open does nothing new. The three are listed together here: OAVp5.panel.close and OAVp5.panel.toggle take no arguments either. midi.panel.open() is the same function. A promise. open() (and toggle() when it opens) resolves to the panel's element once the on-screen controller inside it has loaded, and the panel is on screen at once, before that. close() (and toggle() when it closes) resolves to null, and so does everything when the panel option is off.

就跟按 🎹 按鈕一樣。面板第一次打開的時候，oav-p5 才載入螢幕控制器（連線慢的話要幾秒，載入的時候面板會這麼說），而且 hardware 是 click 的話，就在這時去要 Web MIDI。已經打開的時候再呼叫 OAVp5.panel.open() 不會有新的動作。 這三個放在一起說明：OAVp5.panel.close 和 OAVp5.panel.toggle 也都不帶參數。midi.panel.open() 是同一個函式。 一個 promise。open()（以及 toggle() 打開時）在面板裡的螢幕控制器載好之後 resolve 成面板的元素，面板本身一開始就會顯示，不用等。close()（以及 toggle() 關起來時）resolve 成 null，面板選項是 off 的時候全部都是 null。

The same as the 📱 button in the panel. The card shows a QR code, the room and the link underneath; opening the link on a phone gives that phone an on-screen controller whose MIDI tab plays your sketch over the relay, as one more input (OAVp5.last.source is 'phone'). Calling it again hides the card. The first call connects to the relay and loads a small QR-code library from jsDelivr. A network connection, to the relay (wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay unless you set another) and, for the picture of the QR code, to jsDelivr. Without the library the card shows the link as text. The name of the room the phone joins: the room option, or the link room, or a name made up for this browser (p5-…) and kept in it.

跟面板裡的 📱 按鈕一樣。卡片上有 QR code、房間，和下面的連結。在手機上打開連結，那支手機就有一個螢幕控制器，它的 MIDI 分頁透過中繼來彈你的草圖，當作多一個輸入（OAVp5.last.source 是 'phone'）。再呼叫一次就把卡片收起來。第一次呼叫會連到 relay，並從 jsDelivr 載入一個很小的 QR code 函式庫。 要有網路，連到中繼（沒另外設的話是 wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay），顯示 QR code 的圖還要連到 jsDelivr。沒有那個函式庫的話，卡片就把連結用文字顯示。 手機要加入的房間名稱：room 選項、link 的房間，或是為這個瀏覽器隨機取、並存在裡面的名字（p5-…）。

It sends the same MIDI bytes a keyboard would, with midi.last.source set to 'screen', so everything reacts: notePressed(), noteIsDown(), note, the sound if startSound() is on. midi and OAVp5 are the same object, so OAVp5.play and midi.play are one function. The key stays down until you play it again with velocity 0. note The key: a MIDI number or a name ('C#4'). velocity How hard, 0..1; 0 releases the key. Leave it out for full force.

它送出的 MIDI 位元組跟鍵盤送出的一樣，midi.last.source 會是 'screen'，所以所有東西都會有反應：notePressed()、noteIsDown()、note，還有開著 startSound() 時的聲音。midi 和 OAVp5 是同一個物件，所以 OAVp5.play 和 midi.play 是同一個函式。 鍵會一直按著，直到你再用力道 0 彈一次。 note 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼或音名（'C#4'）。 velocity 多用力，0..1。0 表示放開。不給就是最大力道。

With OP Configurator, OPC.slider('radius', 10) declares a variable and oav-p5 wires the controller to the OPC variables in order: knob 1 to the first slider, knob 2 to the second, the faders after the knobs, pad 1 to the first toggle or button. This is the list of who drives what, the same one the panel prints under the controller and the console says once. Use it when a knob moves the wrong thing. midi.wiring(…) is the same function. dev Whose numbering to use: 'screen' (the controller shown in the panel) or a profile id such as 'akai-lpd8'. It matters for the faders, which are numbered after the knobs. One { control, name } per wired variable: control is 'knob1', 'fader2', 'pad1' …, name is the OPC variable. A control the sketch reads itself also has sketch: true, and its slider no longer follows it. An empty array when there is no OPC on the page or opc is off.

搭配 OP Configurator 時，OPC.slider('radius', 10) 宣告一個變數，oav-p5 會依序把控制器接到 OPC 的變數：旋鈕 1 接第一個滑桿，旋鈕 2 接第二個，推桿接在旋鈕後面，打擊墊 1 接第一個開關或按鈕。這份清單就是誰推動什麼，面板在控制器下面印的、console 說一次的也是同一份。旋鈕推動錯東西的時候就看它。 midi.wiring(…) 是同一個函式。 dev 用誰的編號：'screen'（面板上顯示的那台控制器）或設定檔 id，像 'akai-lpd8'。它會影響推桿，因為推桿的編號接在旋鈕後面。 每個接上線的變數一筆 { control, name }：control 是 'knob1'、'fader2'、'pad1' …，name 是 OPC 的變數。草圖自己有讀的控制還會多一個 sketch: true，對應的滑桿就不再跟著它。頁面上沒有 OPC，或 opc 是 off 的時候是空陣列。

For a sketch that makes its own sound (p5.sound, Web Audio): osc.freq(noteFreq(note)). If you just want the sound, startSound() plays every key for you. v A note name or a MIDI number. A number may be fractional (69.5 is a quarter tone above A4) and is not held to 0..127. Hz, equal temperament with A4 = 69 = 440 Hz.
給自己發聲的草圖用（p5.sound、Web Audio）：osc.freq(noteFreq(note))。如果只是想要有聲音，startSound() 會幫你把每個鍵都彈出來。 v 音名或 MIDI 號碼。數字可以有小數（69.5 是比 A4 高四分之一音），而且不會被限制在 0..127。 赫茲，十二平均律，A4 = 69 = 440 Hz。

notePressed(note, velocity) hands you the number; noteName(note) writes it back as a name for the screen or a lookup table. The same C4-is-60 convention as noteNumber(). v A MIDI number (or a name, which is normalised). o Options: { flats: true } writes 'Db4' instead of 'C#4'; { octave: false } drops the octave number ('C#'). The name, sharps by default: noteName(60) is 'C4'.

notePressed(note, velocity) 給你的是號碼。noteName(note) 把它寫回音名，拿去顯示在畫面上或查表。跟 noteNumber() 一樣，C4 就是 60。 v MIDI 號碼（給音名的話會被整理成標準寫法）。 o 選項：{ flats: true } 寫成 'Db4' 而不是 'C#4'。{ octave: false } 不寫八度數字（'C#'）。 音名，預設用升記號：noteName(60) 是 'C4'。

A name is a letter A to G (either case), an optional # or b (♯ and ♭ too), and the octave: C4, c#4, Db3, C-1 (0) up to G9 (127). C4 is 60. Anything else, such as 'H4' or 'C-2', throws an error, and a card beside the 🎹 says how to write a note. You rarely call it yourself: every place that takes a note number also takes a name, such as noteIsDown() and midi.play(). v A note name ('C4', 'c#4', 'Db3', 'F♯2') or a number. A number comes back rounded and held to 0..127. The MIDI number: noteNumber('C4') is 60, noteNumber('A4') is 69.

音名由一個 A 到 G 的字母（大小寫都可以）、可有可無的 # 或 b（♯、♭ 也行），加上八度數字組成：C4、c#4、Db3，從 C-1（0）到 G9（127）。C4 是 60。 其他寫法（像 'H4'、'C-2'）會丟出錯誤，🎹 旁邊也會有一張卡片告訴你音名怎麼寫。 通常不用自己呼叫：凡是收音符號碼的地方也都收音名，像 noteIsDown() 和 midi.play()。 v 音名（'C4'、'c#4'、'Db3'、'F♯2'）或數字。數字會四捨五入並限制在 0..127。 MIDI 號碼：noteNumber('C4') 是 60，noteNumber('A4') 是 69。

Use them like micLevel, one number per band: fill(200 + bass 160, 70, 100) pushes the colour with the low end. The three share one entry because they behave the same; only the frequency range differs. Unlike micLevel they are not measured in decibels: each is the average strength of the frequencies in its band, scaled by micSensitivity() and held to 1. A band that is faint in your room can stay close to 0; raise the sensitivity rather than multiplying by a large number. Reading any of them asks for the microphone the first time, exactly like micLevel; until you allow it they are 0. A sketch that already has its own variable, function or library called bass, mid or treble keeps it: oav-p5 leaves that name alone and never starts the microphone for it. Assigning one later turns the name back into a plain variable. The energy in 20–250 Hz (bass), 250–2000 Hz (mid) and 2000–8000 Hz (treble). Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.

用法跟 micLevel 一樣，每個頻段一個數字：fill(200 + bass 160, 70, 100) 讓顏色跟著低音走。三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。 跟 micLevel 不一樣，它們不是用分貝量的：每一個是該頻段所有頻率的平均強度，乘上 micSensitivity() 之後最多算到 1。如果某個頻段在你的房間裡很微弱，數字會一直貼近 0。這時調高靈敏度，比自己乘一個很大的數字好。 第一次讀其中任何一個，就會跟 micLevel 一樣去要麥克風。在你允許之前都是 0。 如果草圖本來就有自己的 bass、mid 或 treble（變數、函式、函式庫都算），oav-p5 就不動那個名稱，也不會為它去開麥克風。之後自己指定值的話，那個名稱就變回一般變數。 bass 是 20–250 Hz 的能量，mid 是 250–2000 Hz，treble 是 2000–8000 Hz。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

It behaves like mouseIsPressed while a button is down, except the "press" lasts one frame: if (beat) flash = 1; is all it takes to react to the music. A beat is a jump in loudness over what the room has been doing, with at least 100 ms between two beats; two beats between two frames count as one. When the drum machine is playing, beat is also true for a frame on every kick and snare, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over to the machine unchanged. Reading beat asks for the microphone the first time, like micLevel. If you would rather be called, define beatDetected(). True in the first draw() after a beat, and false until the next one. Reading it twice in the same frame gives the same answer.

它的用法像按著滑鼠鍵時的 mouseIsPressed，只是「按下」只持續一個畫面：if (beat) flash = 1; 就能對音樂做出反應。一個拍子是音量比房間一直以來的聲音突然跳高，兩個拍子之間至少隔 100 毫秒。兩個畫面之間發生的兩個拍子只算一次。 鼓機在播的時候，每一下大鼓和小鼓也會讓 beat 在那個畫面是 true，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。 第一次讀 beat 就會跟 micLevel 一樣去要麥克風。如果你比較想被呼叫，就定義 beatDetected()。 拍子之後的第一個 draw() 是 true，到下一個拍子之前都是 false。同一個畫面裡讀兩次，答案一樣。

Declare it the way you declare keyPressed(): It is called once per beat, right when the beat lands, not once per frame. Use beat instead if you would rather ask each frame. A sketch that defines beatDetected() and reads no microphone value starts the microphone on the first click or key. When the drum machine is on, the same function is called for its kicks and snares and the microphone is not opened for it. OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn) hears the same beats without defining a global and returns a function that stops listening, but a listener alone never starts the microphone: read micLevel or call startMic() as well. If your function throws, the sketch keeps running: the error appears in the console and as a card beside the 🎹 with the file and line. level How loud it was at that moment, 0..1 (the value of micLevel).

用宣告 keyPressed() 的方式宣告它： 每個拍子呼叫一次，在拍子落下的當下，不是每個畫面一次。如果你比較想每個畫面自己問，改用 beat。 草圖只要定義了 beatDetected() 而沒有讀任何麥克風的值，第一次點擊或按鍵時就會啟動麥克風。鼓機開著的時候，鼓機的大鼓和小鼓也會呼叫同一個函式，而且不會為它去開麥克風。OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn) 聽到的是同樣的拍子，不用定義全域函式，也會回傳一個停止監聽的函式，但只有監聽並不會啟動麥克風：還要讀 micLevel 或呼叫 startMic()。 你的函式如果出錯，草圖會繼續跑：錯誤會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案和行號。 level 那一刻有多大聲，0..1（就是 micLevel 的值）。

The microphone splits what it hears into three drum-like bands and calls the matching function when each band jumps: 20–120 Hz for the kick, 150–800 Hz for the snare, 6–14 kHz for the hat. There is no machine learning in it, just a transient in a frequency band, so a bass voice can trigger a kick. When the drum machine plays, each of its hits calls the same functions: kick for the kick, snare for a snare, clap or rim, hat for a closed, open or pedal hat. A sketch written for the microphone therefore works with startDrums() unchanged. While the drum machine plays, only its hits call these functions (from oav-p5 0.8.1). A microphone that is on at the same time mostly hears the drums coming out of the speakers, so its hits would call the same function twice and hear a kick as a snare. micLevel, bass, mid and treble still follow the microphone; the microphone's hits come back when the drums stop. Defining one of them is not enough to open the microphone once the drum machine has started; reading micLevel (or calling startMic()) is. Without the drum machine, a sketch that defines any of them and reads nothing starts the microphone on the first click or key. level How strong the hit was, 0..1 (for the drum machine, its velocity).

麥克風把聽到的聲音分成三個像鼓的頻段，哪個頻段突然跳高，就呼叫對應的函式：大鼓是 20–120 Hz，小鼓是 150–800 Hz，鈸是 6–14 kHz。裡面沒有機器學習，只是某個頻段出現瞬間的衝擊，所以低沉的人聲也可能觸發大鼓。 鼓機在播的時候，它的每一下也會呼叫同樣的函式：大鼓呼叫 kick，小鼓、拍手或 rim 呼叫 snare，閉合、開放或腳踏的鈸呼叫 hat。所以為麥克風寫的草圖，不用改就能搭配 startDrums()。 鼓機在打的時候，只有鼓機的每一下會呼叫這幾個函式（oav-p5 0.8.1 起）。這時候如果麥克風也開著，它聽到的多半是喇叭放出來的鼓聲，同一下會被叫兩次，大鼓也可能被聽成小鼓。micLevel、bass、mid、treble 照樣跟著麥克風。鼓機停下來，麥克風的打擊就會回來。 鼓機啟動之後，只定義其中一個函式並不會去開麥克風。要讀 micLevel（或呼叫 startMic()）才會。沒有鼓機的時候，草圖只要定義了其中任何一個、又沒有讀任何值，第一次點擊或按鍵時會啟動麥克風。 level 這一下有多強，0..1（鼓機的話就是力道）。

The same hits that call kickDetected(), snareDetected() and hatDetected(), as a value you read in draw() instead of a function you write. Hand it to lag() and it becomes a number that jumps to 1 on the hit and fades: lag(kickIsDetected, 0, 0.3) is 1 on a kick and back near 0 about 0.3 s later, ready for an alpha or a size. lag() takes true as 1. While the drum machine plays, only its hits count. Reading these does not ask for the microphone by itself: with no drums, it counts as wanting the microphone's hits, the way defining kickDetected() does, so the first click on the page opens it. True for exactly one p5 frame per hit, however often that frame reads it; false otherwise. Since oav-p5 0.8.2.

跟呼叫 kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected() 的是同一批打擊，只是改成在 draw() 裡讀的值，不用寫函式。交給 lag() 就變成一個數字：打到時跳到 1，然後慢慢退回去。lag(kickIsDetected, 0, 0.3) 在大鼓那一下是 1，大約 0.3 秒後回到 0 附近，可以直接拿來控制透明度或大小。lag() 把 true 當成 1。 鼓機在打的時候只算鼓機的。讀這幾個名字本身不會去要麥克風。沒有鼓機的時候，它就跟定義 kickDetected() 一樣，算是想要麥克風的打擊，所以第一次點畫面會開麥克風。 每一下只在一個 p5 畫面裡是 true，那一格讀幾次都一樣。其他時候是 false。oav-p5 0.8.2 起。

The frame-counting twin of lastKickTs. frameCount - lastKickFrameCount is 0 in the frame where kickIsDetected is true, then 1, 2, 3 …, so a shape can last a fixed number of frames after each hit. Use the Ts version when it should last a fixed time whatever the frame rate. A frame number, on the same count as frameCount; -Infinity before the first hit. Since oav-p5 0.8.3.

lastKickTs 的「數格子」版本。在 kickIsDetected 是 true 的那一格，frameCount - lastKickFrameCount 是 0，接下來是 1、2、3……，所以可以讓一個形狀在每一下之後固定留幾格。想要不管幀率都留固定秒數，就用 Ts 那一組。 畫面的編號，跟 frameCount 同一套數法。第一下之前是 -Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.3 起。

Set by every hit that calls kickDetected(), snareDetected(), hatDetected() or beatDetected(): the drum machine's, or the microphone's when no drums play. Use it for anything that depends on how long ago: exp(-(millis() - lastKickTs) / 200) is 1 on the kick and fades with a 0.2 s time constant. Milliseconds on the same clock as millis(); -Infinity before the first hit, so millis() - lastKickTs is then Infinity. Since oav-p5 0.8.2.

每一下會呼叫 kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected() 或 beatDetected() 的打擊都會更新它：鼓機的，或沒有鼓機時麥克風的。要算「多久以前」就用它，例如 exp(-(millis() - lastKickTs) / 200) 在大鼓那一下是 1，然後以 0.2 秒的時間常數淡掉。 毫秒，跟 millis() 同一個時鐘。第一下之前是 -Infinity，所以那時 millis() - lastKickTs 是 Infinity。oav-p5 0.8.2 起。

Use it to show a hint until sound arrives: if (!micIsOn) text("Allow the microphone", 20, 30);. Reading it never starts the microphone (unlike micLevel), so it is safe to check anywhere. The reason behind a false is in OAVp5.mic.state (off, asking, on, denied or unavailable) and, when something failed, OAVp5.mic.error. True once the browser has said yes and sound is coming in; false while the microphone is off, still asking, blocked or missing.

可以用它在聲音進來之前顯示提示：if (!micIsOn) text("請允許麥克風", 20, 30);。讀它不會啟動麥克風（跟 micLevel 不一樣），所以在哪裡檢查都安全。false 的原因看 OAVp5.mic.state（off、asking、on、denied 或 unavailable），失敗的時候還有 OAVp5.mic.error。 瀏覽器答應了、聲音進來之後是 true。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或不存在的時候是 false。

Read it in draw() the way you read mouseX: circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel 300) grows when someone talks. It is a loudness in decibels, which is how an ear hears it, measured from the room itself: the bottom of the scale follows the room's own noise (it settles within a second or two and rises at most 1.5 dB a second, so a voice never becomes the new silence), and −10 dBFS, shouting into a laptop, is 1. In practice a quiet room reads 0, a quiet voice about 0.4 to 0.6, shouting close to 1. If the microphone is quiet or far away, raise it with micSensitivity(). It follows the browser's animation frames rather than draw(), so a sketch running at frameRate(10) still reads the latest value, and the number stops changing while the tab is hidden (browsers pause animation frames there). Nothing to call. The first time a sketch reads micLevel (or bass, mid, treble, beat), oav-p5 asks the browser for the microphone, and every value stays 0 until you allow it. The page needs https or localhost. If the browser kept audio quiet until a click, the first click or key starts it. ?oav_mic=click makes only the 🎤 button and startMic() turn it on; ?oav_mic=off means nothing can. In the 🎹 panel the 🎤 button turns the microphone on and off by hand and shows the level. When the browser blocked it, a card beside the 🎹 says why and what to press: click the lock left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then click the canvas. On openprocessing.org the sketch frame allows the…

像讀 mouseX 一樣在 draw() 裡直接讀：circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel 300)，有人說話圓就變大。它是以分貝量的音量，跟耳朵聽起來的感覺一致，而且是從房間本身量起：量表的底部跟著房間的底噪走（一兩秒內安頓下來，每秒最多往上爬 1.5 dB，所以人聲不會變成新的安靜），−10 dBFS（對著筆電大喊）就是 1。 實際上，安靜的房間是 0，小聲說話約 0.4 到 0.6，大喊接近 1。麥克風很小聲或離得很遠的話，用 micSensitivity() 把它調大。 它跟著瀏覽器的動畫畫面更新，不是跟著 draw()，所以用 frameRate(10) 跑的草圖讀到的還是最新的值。分頁被藏起來時數字會停住（瀏覽器在那時會暫停動畫畫面）。 不用呼叫任何東西。草圖第一次讀 micLevel（或 bass、mid、treble、beat）的時候，oav-p5 就會向瀏覽器要麥克風，在你按下允許之前所有的值都是 0。網頁要在 https 或 localhost 底下。如果瀏覽器在你點一下之前不讓聲音出來，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把它啟動。?oav_mic=click 表示只有 🎤 按鈕和 startMic() 能開。?oav_mic=off 表示什麼都開不了。 🎹 面板裡的 🎤 按鈕可以手動開關麥克風，並顯示音量。瀏覽器擋下麥克風的時候，🎹 旁邊會跳出一張卡片說明原因和怎麼處理：點網址列左邊的鎖頭，把麥克風設成允許，再點一下畫布。 在 openprocessing.org 上，草圖的框允許麥克風和 MIDI（2026-10-19 實際檢查過：它的 allow 清單有 microphone 和 midi），而且在那裡第一次讀 micLevel 就會去要麥克風。從 OpenProcessing 複製出來的嵌入碼沒有這個設定：要在那個 加上 allow="microphone"。 它背後的原始數字是 OAVp5.mic.rms（0..1）、OAVp5.mic.db 和 OAVp5.mic.floor（房間本身的底噪，單位 dBFS）。 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或根本沒有的時候，一直是 0。

The number multiplies what the microphone hears. On micLevel, 2 adds 6 dB; on bass, mid and treble it multiplies by 2 (they stay held to 1). Use it for a quiet microphone or a far-away voice: micSensitivity(3) in setup() adds about 9.5 dB. OAVp5.mic.gain is the same knob under the name oav-p5 0.3.0 used. v The new sensitivity, greater than 0 (kept between 0.05 and 20). Leave it out, or pass something that is not greater than 0, to change nothing. The sensitivity now in effect (1 until you change it).

這個數字乘在麥克風聽到的東西上。對 micLevel 來說，2 等於加 6 dB。對 bass、mid、treble 是乘以 2（最多還是 1）。麥克風很小聲或人離得很遠的時候用它：在 setup() 寫 micSensitivity(3) 大約加 9.5 dB。 OAVp5.mic.gain 是同一個旋鈕，用的是 oav-p5 0.3.0 的舊名字。 v 新的靈敏度，要大於 0（會被限制在 0.05 到 20 之間）。不傳，或傳不大於 0 的值，就什麼都不改。 現在生效的靈敏度（沒改過就是 1）。

You rarely need it: reading micLevel and its friends already starts the microphone. Call it when you want to choose the moment (a button, the end of an intro) or know the answer: startMic().then((ok) => { … }). Calling it again while it is on, or while the browser is still asking, returns the same result. Browsers want a click before audio plays: call it from mousePressed() or a button handler if setup() is too early. It works whatever the mic option is, except ?oav_mic=off, where nothing can start the microphone. After stopMic(), only startMic() (or 🎤) turns it back on; reading micLevel does not. Resolves to true once the microphone is on, false if it was blocked, is missing, or the mic option is off.

通常用不到：只要讀 micLevel 之類的名稱，麥克風就會自己啟動。想自己決定時機（一個按鈕、片頭結束的時候）或想知道結果時才呼叫：startMic().then((ok) => { … })。已經開著、或瀏覽器還在詢問的時候再呼叫，會回傳同一個結果。 瀏覽器要先有一次點擊才讓聲音出來：如果在 setup() 裡太早，就放在 mousePressed() 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。不管載入選項 mic 是什麼都能用，只有 ?oav_mic=off 例外，那時什麼都開不了麥克風。 呼叫過 stopMic() 之後，只有 startMic()（或 🎤）能再把它打開。讀 micLevel 不會。 麥克風開起來之後 resolve 成 true。被擋下、不存在、或載入選項 mic 是 off 的時候 resolve 成 false。

It stops the microphone's tracks and closes its audio context, so the browser's "recording" indicator goes away. micLevel, bass, mid, treble and the rest read 0 again, and micIsOn is false. After stopMic(), reading micLevel does not turn the microphone back on: that needs startMic() or the 🎤 button. Resolves to false, the new state of the microphone.
它會停掉麥克風的音軌並關掉它的音訊環境，所以瀏覽器上「正在錄音」的指示會消失。micLevel、bass、mid、treble 等等都回到 0，micIsOn 變成 false。 stopMic() 之後，讀 micLevel 不會再把麥克風打開：要用 startMic() 或 🎤 按鈕。 resolve 成 false，也就是麥克風的新狀態。

Everything the microphone names (micLevel, bass, micIsOn, startMic() …) read from here. The difference is that reading OAVp5.mic.level never asks for the microphone: the plain micLevel does, the first time. So OAVp5.mic is for code that must look without waking anything: a status line, a library, a sketch with ?oav_mic=click. The members: state, error, sensitivity (also gain), level, bass (also mid, treble), rms, db, floor, analyzer, start(), stop() and on(). This is advanced. For most sketches the plain names are all you need.

所有麥克風的名稱（micLevel、bass、micIsOn、startMic() …）讀的都是這裡。差別是讀 OAVp5.mic.level 永遠不會去要麥克風，而一般的 micLevel 第一次讀就會。所以 OAVp5.mic 是給「只想看、不想吵醒任何東西」的程式用的：狀態列、函式庫、設了 ?oav_mic=click 的草圖。 成員有：state、error、sensitivity（也叫 gain）、level、bass（還有 mid、treble）、rms、db、floor、analyzer、start()、stop() 和 on()。 這是進階用法。大多數草圖只要用一般的名稱就夠了。

A way into the audio itself when the 0 to 1 numbers are not enough: read the spectrum of the microphone with the browser's own OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(array), or connect your own Web Audio nodes to it. oav-p5 updates the analyzer once per frame, so do not call its update() yourself. This is advanced. Check it is not null first, and read it again after stopMic() and startMic(): it is a new object each time. Made when the microphone starts and dropped when it stops. It has its own AudioContext (OAVp5.mic.analyzer.ctx) and the Web Audio AnalyserNode it reads from (OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser).

0 到 1 的數字不夠用的時候，直接進到聲音本身的路：用瀏覽器自己的 OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(array) 讀麥克風的頻譜，或把你自己的 Web Audio 節點接上去。oav-p5 每個畫面會更新一次這個分析器，所以不要自己去呼叫它的 update()。 這是進階用法。先確認它不是 null，而且 stopMic() 再 startMic() 之後要重新讀：每次都是新的物件。 麥克風啟動時產生，停止時丟掉。它有自己的 AudioContext（OAVp5.mic.analyzer.ctx），也有它讀取的 Web Audio AnalyserNode（OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser）。

The plain bass, mid and treble ask for the microphone when first read, and a sketch that already has a variable of that name keeps it. OAVp5.mic.bass, .mid and .treble are the numbers themselves: always there, never starting anything. They are also the answer when the plain names are taken: on strudel.cc, where Strudel owns bass, this is what the card tells you to read. The three share this entry because they behave the same: only the frequency range differs. bass is 20–250 Hz, mid 250–2000 Hz and treble 2000–8000 Hz, scaled by the sensitivity and held to 1. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.

一般的 bass、mid、treble 第一次被讀的時候會去要麥克風，而且草圖本來就有同名變數的話就由草圖保留。OAVp5.mic.bass、.mid、.treble 就是數字本身：一直都在，也不會啟動任何東西。一般名稱被占用的時候也要讀它們：在 strudel.cc 上 bass 是 Strudel 的，卡片會告訴你改讀這個。 三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。 bass 是 20–250 Hz，mid 是 250–2000 Hz，treble 是 2000–8000 Hz，乘上靈敏度、最多算到 1。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

Decibels are what an ear hears: each 6 dB is twice the amplitude, so a number in dB moves the way loudness feels. micLevel maps it onto 0 to 1 between the room's noise floor (+6 dB) and −10 dBFS. Use db directly when you want your own scale, for example map(OAVp5.mic.db, -60, -10, 0, 1). 20 log10(rms), measured from OAVp5.mic.rms. −100 when the level is below about −100 dB and while the microphone is off. Updated once per display frame.

分貝就是耳朵聽到的樣子：每增加 6 dB 就是振幅兩倍，所以用 dB 的數字，變化的方式就跟聽起來的大小聲一致。micLevel 把它對應到 0 到 1，範圍從房間底噪（再加 6 dB）到 −10 dBFS。想用自己的刻度的話，直接用 db，例如 map(OAVp5.mic.db, -60, -10, 0, 1)。 20 log10(rms)，由 OAVp5.mic.rms 算出來。低於約 −100 dB 和麥克風關著的時候是 −100。每個畫面更新一次。

For a sketch that wants to say more than a card does: if (OAVp5.mic.error === 'NotAllowedError') …. The card beside the 🎹 already tells the user what to press for each of these, in their language; this is the same fact for your code. null at the start and again once the microphone is on. After a failure: the browser's error name ('NotAllowedError' or 'SecurityError' for a refusal, 'NotFoundError' when there is no microphone, 'NotReadableError' when another program holds it) or 'no getUserMedia' on a page that cannot ask.

給想比卡片說得更多的草圖用：if (OAVp5.mic.error === 'NotAllowedError') …。🎹 旁邊的卡片已經用使用者的語言，針對每一種告訴他要按什麼了，這是同一件事給你的程式用。 一開始是 null，麥克風開起來之後又回到 null。失敗之後是瀏覽器的錯誤名稱（被拒絕是 'NotAllowedError' 或 'SecurityError'，沒有麥克風是 'NotFoundError'，被別的程式占住是 'NotReadableError'），或是在不能詢問的頁面上的 'no getUserMedia'。

A humming classroom should not read as loud, so micLevel is measured from the room itself: this floor follows the quietest recent readings. It drops within a second when the room gets quieter and rises at most 1.5 dB a second when it gets noisier, so a voice never becomes the new silence. 6 dB above the floor reads 0 on micLevel. Stopping the microphone does not reset it: the next start continues from the last floor. Starts at −60 and is always held between −70 and −45. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on.

嗡嗡響的教室不該被讀成很大聲，所以 micLevel 是從房間本身量起的：這個底噪跟著最近最安靜的讀數走。房間變安靜時，一秒內就會降下去，變吵時每秒最多往上爬 1.5 dB，所以人聲不會變成新的安靜。比底噪高 6 dB 的音量，在 micLevel 上讀成 0。 停掉麥克風不會重設它：下次開始會從上一次的底噪接著走。 一開始是 −60，永遠限制在 −70 到 −45 之間。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次。

micLevel is a getter that returns this number and, the first time it is read, asks for the microphone. OAVp5.mic.level is the number itself, so reading it is safe anywhere: before the user has chosen, with ?oav_mic=click, or in a library. Start the microphone with startMic() or 🎤, then it moves. How it is measured (decibels, the room as zero, −10 dBFS as 1) is described under micLevel. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 while it is off, asking, blocked or missing.

micLevel 是一個 getter，回傳這個數字，而且第一次被讀的時候會去要麥克風。OAVp5.mic.level 就是數字本身，所以在哪裡讀都安全：使用者還沒決定之前、設了 ?oav_mic=click，或是在函式庫裡。用 startMic() 或 🎤 啟動麥克風，它才會動。它怎麼量（分貝、以房間為 0、−10 dBFS 為 1）寫在 micLevel 底下。 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次。關著、詢問中、被擋下或不存在的時候是 0。

The listener version of beatDetected(), kickDetected(), snareDetected() and hatDetected(): any number of them, added and removed while the sketch runs, with no global names taken. An error inside fn shows in the console and on a card. Listening does not turn the microphone on: call startMic(), press 🎤, or read micLevel too, or nothing will ever fire. (Defining the global beatDetected() is different: oav-p5 sees that function and starts the microphone at the first click.) These events come from the microphone only, not from the drum machine. When the drum machine plays, the global beatDetected(), kickDetected() and the others are also called for its hits. A listener added with OAVp5.mic.on() hears the microphone only. name 'beat', 'kick', 'snare' or 'hat'. Anything else throws an error that lists them. fn Called as fn(level) with how strong the hit was, 0 to 1: the same number beatDetected(level) and kickDetected(level) get. A function that takes fn off again: const off = OAVp5.mic.on(…); off();.

beatDetected()、kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected() 的監聽者版本：想要幾個都行，草圖在跑的時候可以加也可以拿掉，也不占用任何全域名稱。fn 裡面出錯會顯示在 console 和卡片上。 監聽並不會把麥克風打開：要呼叫 startMic()、按 🎤，或是也讀一下 micLevel，不然什麼事件都不會發生。（定義全域的 beatDetected() 就不一樣：oav-p5 看到那個函式，會在第一次點擊時啟動麥克風。）這些事件只來自麥克風，不來自鼓機。 鼓機在播的時候，全域的 beatDetected()、kickDetected() 這些也會為鼓機的每一下被呼叫。用 OAVp5.mic.on() 加的監聽者只聽得到麥克風。 name 'beat'、'kick'、'snare' 或 'hat'。其他的名稱會丟出一個錯誤，並列出這幾個。 fn 用 fn(level) 的方式呼叫，帶著這一下有多強，0 到 1：跟 beatDetected(level) 和 kickDetected(level) 拿到的數字一樣。 一個把 fn 取消的函式：const off = OAVp5.mic.on(…); off();。

The root mean square of the samples in the latest frame, smoothed a little. It is linear, the way a waveform is drawn, so it suits a quick check or your own scale. micLevel is built from it: OAVp5.mic.db is the same number in dBFS, and OAVp5.mic.floor is the room's own noise, in dBFS too. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 when it is off. A speaking voice into a laptop is a small number, in the range 0.01 to 0.05 according to the comment in the code, which is why micLevel works in decibels.

最新一個畫面裡所有取樣的均方根，稍微平滑過。它是線性的，就像波形畫出來的樣子，所以適合快速檢查，或是用在你自己的刻度上。micLevel 就是用它算出來的：OAVp5.mic.db 是同一個數字換成 dBFS，OAVp5.mic.floor 是房間本身的底噪，單位也是 dBFS。 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次，關著是 0。對著筆電說話是個很小的數字，程式碼裡的註解說大約在 0.01 到 0.05，所以 micLevel 才改用分貝來算。

The number multiplies what the microphone hears: on micLevel 2 adds 6 dB, on bass, mid and treble it multiplies by 2. Read it to show the current setting, and set it with micSensitivity(), which checks the number. OAVp5.mic.gain is the same value under the name oav-p5 0.3.0 used. Assigning to either works (OAVp5.mic.gain = 2) but is not held between 0.05 and 20, and gain falls back to 1 for a number that is not above 0. Starts at 1. micSensitivity(v) keeps what you give it between 0.05 and 20.

這個數字乘在麥克風聽到的東西上：對 micLevel 來說 2 等於加 6 dB，對 bass、mid、treble 是乘以 2。讀它來顯示目前的設定，要設定的話用 micSensitivity()，它會檢查數字。 OAVp5.mic.gain 是同一個值，用的是 oav-p5 0.3.0 的名字。直接指定給任何一個都行（OAVp5.mic.gain = 2），但不會被限制在 0.05 到 20 之間，而且 gain 遇到不大於 0 的數字會退回 1。 一開始是 1。micSensitivity(v) 會把你給的值限制在 0.05 到 20 之間。

startMic() is this function: see it for what must happen first (a click, https or localhost). OAVp5.mic.start() also lifts the "stopped by you" mark that stopMic() leaves, which is what lets a later read of micLevel switch the microphone on again. Resolves to true once the microphone is on, false if it was blocked, is missing, or the mic option is off.
startMic() 就是這個函式：要先發生什麼（一次點擊、https 或 localhost）請看那一條。OAVp5.mic.start() 也會解除 stopMic() 留下的「你停掉的」記號，這樣之後再讀 micLevel 就又能把麥克風打開。 麥克風開起來之後 resolve 成 true，被擋下、不存在、或 mic 選項是 off 的時候 resolve 成 false。

'off': not started, or stopped. 'asking': the browser is waiting for the user's answer. 'on': sound is coming in, and micIsOn is true. 'denied': the permission was refused (by the user, by the computer's settings, or by an iframe without allow="microphone"). 'unavailable': there is no microphone, none the browser can open, or the page is not on https or localhost. When it is not 'on', OAVp5.mic.error has the browser's reason and a card beside the 🎹 says what to press. Changes when you start or stop the microphone and when the browser answers. 'off' until something starts it. Reading it never starts it.

'off'：還沒啟動，或已經停了。'asking'：瀏覽器在等使用者回答。'on'：聲音進來了，micIsOn 是 true。'denied'：權限被拒絕（被使用者、被電腦的設定，或被沒有 allow="microphone" 的 iframe）。'unavailable'：沒有麥克風、瀏覽器打不開，或網頁不在 https 或 localhost 底下。不是 'on' 的時候，OAVp5.mic.error 有瀏覽器給的原因，🎹 旁邊也會有卡片說明要按什麼。 你開始或停止麥克風、瀏覽器回答的時候會變。在有東西啟動它之前是 'off'。讀它不會啟動它。

stopMic() is this function. It stops the microphone's tracks and closes its audio context, so the browser's "recording" indicator goes away, and OAVp5.mic.level, bass, mid, treble, rms read 0 and db reads −100. After it, only OAVp5.mic.start() or 🎤 turns the microphone back on: reading micLevel does not. Resolves to false, the new state of the microphone.
stopMic() 就是這個函式。它停掉麥克風的音軌並關掉它的音訊環境，所以瀏覽器上「正在錄音」的指示會消失，OAVp5.mic.level、bass、mid、treble、rms 都讀到 0，db 讀到 −100。之後只有 OAVp5.mic.start() 或 🎤 能再把麥克風打開：讀 micLevel 不行。 resolve 成 false，也就是麥克風的新狀態。

An AudioAnalyzer wraps one Web Audio AnalyserNode. You give it a sound (enableMic(), enableElement(el), or connect your own node into input()), call update() once per frame, and it returns a plain object of numbers, which it also publishes as audio/ signals if you gave it a signals bus. This is the analysis under the microphone of a p5 sketch: micLevel is its rms turned into decibels, bass, mid and treble are its low, mid and high, and beat and kickDetected() come from its onset and kick. update() returns null until a source is enabled. After that it returns { rms, peak, low, mid, high, centroid, onset, kick, snare, hat }. rms is the smoothed loudness and peak the loudest sample of the moment, both 0..1 of full scale (from float samples where the browser has them, so a quiet room is measured, not rounded to one 8-bit step). A voice is a small rms: scale it, or map it through a window. low, mid and high are the average strength of the spectrum in 20–250 Hz, 250–2000 Hz and 2000–8000 Hz, 0..1, taken from the analyser's byte spectrum, so they are not decibels and a faint band stays near 0. centroid is the spectrum's centre of mass, 0..1 of the way from 0 Hz to half the sample rate (the brightness). onset is true for the one update() in which the loudness jumped over its adaptive floor, with at least 100 ms between two onsets. kick, snare and hat are { hit, level, env }, found by looking for a sudden rise in one band of the spectrum, with no machine learning: kick 20–120 Hz,…

AudioAnalyzer 包著一個 Web Audio 的 AnalyserNode。你給它一個聲音來源（enableMic()、enableElement(el)，或把自己的節點接到 input()），每個畫面呼叫一次 update()，它就回傳一個只有數字的物件，如果你給了 signals 匯流排，也會同時發布成 audio/ 訊號。這就是 p5 草圖的麥克風底下的分析：micLevel 是它的 rms 換成分貝，bass、mid、treble 是它的 low、mid、high，beat 和 kickDetected() 來自它的 onset 和 kick。 來源開起來之前，update() 回傳 null。開起來之後，它回傳 { rms, peak, low, mid, high, centroid, onset, kick, snare, hat }。rms 是平滑後的音量，peak 是這一刻最大的取樣，兩個都是滿刻度的 0..1（瀏覽器有浮點取樣的話就用浮點，所以安靜的房間也量得到，不會被四捨五入到 8 位元的一格）。人聲的 rms 很小，要乘上倍數，或用範圍視窗對應。low、mid、high 是頻譜在 20–250 Hz、250–2000 Hz、2000–8000 Hz 的平均強度，0..1，取自分析器的位元組頻譜，所以不是分貝，微弱的頻段會貼近 0。centroid 是頻譜的重心，從 0 Hz 到取樣率的一半，0..1（亮度）。onset 只在音量跳過它自己適應的底線的那一次 update() 是 true，兩個起音之間至少隔 100 毫秒。 kick、snare、hat 是 { hit, level, env }，做法是在頻譜的某一段找突然的上升，沒有用機器學習：大鼓 20–120 Hz、小鼓 150–800 Hz、鈸 6000–14000 Hz。hit 在找到一下的那次 update() 是 true（互相至少隔 90、90、60 毫秒），level 是那一段現在的強度，env 是 0..1：打到的時候跳到 min(1, level × 2)，之後每次 update() 縮小 12%，每秒 60 個畫面的話大約 120 毫秒。因為它是每次 update() 衰減，所以你呼叫 update() 的頻率越低，它掉得越快。 有 signals 匯流排的話，會發布這些：audio/rms、audio/peak、audio/band/low、audio/band/mid、audio/band/high、audio/centroid、audio/kick/env、audio/snare/env、audio/hat/env（連續值，0..1），以及脈衝 audio/onset { rms }、audio/kick { level }、audio/snare { level }、audio/hat { level }。脈衝只在找到東西的時候才觸發。 瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作之後才讓聲音開始。enableMic() 會去要麥克風，而分析器的 AudioContext 在頁面被點一下或按過鍵之前都是暫停的：update() 每個畫面都會呼叫 resume()，所以第一次點擊之後數字會自己開始動。在那之前全部都是 0。麥克風要求網頁在 https 或 localhost 底下。 它自己建一個 AudioContext，所以 p5.sound 或 Tone.js 可以在旁邊照常跑。要分析在別的 context 裡的聲音，就把 audio.ctx…

Read it in draw() like mouseIsPressed: if (!soundIsOn) text('click to hear', 20, 30);. It changes only when the state of the sound changes, not every frame. Reading it never starts anything (unlike micLevel), so it is safe to check anywhere. false does not mean startSound() was never called. To tell "loading" from "waiting for the click" from "failed", read OAVp5.sound.state, and OAVp5.sound.error for the reason of a failure. It becomes true only after startSound() (or 🔊 in the 🎹 panel, or ?oav_sound=piano), and after the click the browser wants. A sketch that already declares its own variable called soundIsOn keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.sound.state === 'on' instead. True only while OAVp5.sound.state is 'on'. It is false at the start, while sound waits for a click, while it loads, after stopSound() and after an error.

像 mouseIsPressed 一樣在 draw() 裡讀：if (!soundIsOn) text('click to hear', 20, 30);。它只有在聲音的狀態改變的時候才會變，不是每個畫面都更新。讀它不會啟動任何東西（跟 micLevel 不一樣），所以在哪裡檢查都安全。 false 不代表沒呼叫過 startSound()。要分辨「載入中」、「等點擊」和「失敗」，請讀 OAVp5.sound.state，失敗的原因在 OAVp5.sound.error。 要先呼叫 startSound()（或按 🎹 面板的 🔊、或網址加 ?oav_sound=piano），而且過了瀏覽器要求的那次點擊，它才會變成 true。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 soundIsOn 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.sound.state === 'on'。 只有 OAVp5.sound.state 是 'on' 的時候才是 true。一開始、等待點擊、載入中、呼叫 stopSound() 之後、以及出錯的時候都是 false。

Call it once in setup(): startSound('organ'). From then on every note you play is heard: a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen, a phone, midi.play(60, 0.8). Your own notePressed() still gets the note, and the sound is made before the sketch is told, so a slow callback never delays it. Pads on MIDI channel 10 (the General MIDI drum channel) play the drum kit instead of the instrument, and the sustain pedal holds notes. The instrument ids are piano, epiano, organ, strings, choir, harp, marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, music-box and the synth presets synth/pad, synth/saw-lead, synth/square-lead, synth/pluck, synth/supersaw, synth/bass, synth/acid, synth/brass, synth/bell, synth/sub and synth/chip. Calling startSound(id) while sound plays switches the instrument. An id that does not exist is listed in the console together with the real ones: an instrument that is already playing stays, and at the first call the warm pad synth/pad plays. Nothing is loaded before the first call (or before 🔊 in the 🎹 panel): @openav/sound comes from next to oav-p5.js and Tone.js 15 from jsDelivr (the tone option points it somewhere else). Only the piano plays recorded samples, about 2 MB the first time; the electric piano sounds meanwhile (or, when you switch from another instrument, that one keeps sounding), and OAVp5.sound.instrument changes to piano when the samples are in. Every other instrument is made by Tone.js and has no files to load. A browser lets a page make sound only after…

在 setup() 裡呼叫一次：startSound('organ')。從這時候起，你彈的每個音都聽得到：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的 🎹、手機、midi.play(60, 0.8) 都算。你自己寫的 notePressed() 一樣會收到音符，而且是先發聲、再通知草圖，所以 callback 寫得慢也不會拖慢聲音。MIDI 第 10 軌（General MIDI 的鼓軌）的打擊墊打的是鼓組，不是樂器，延音踏板則會讓音延續。 樂器代號有 piano、epiano、organ、strings、choir、harp、marimba、vibraphone、xylophone、glockenspiel、music-box，以及合成器音色 synth/pad、synth/saw-lead、synth/square-lead、synth/pluck、synth/supersaw、synth/bass、synth/acid、synth/brass、synth/bell、synth/sub、synth/chip。聲音在播的時候再呼叫 startSound(id)，就是換樂器。給了不存在的代號，主控台會連同真正的代號清單一起列出來：已經在播的樂器不變，第一次呼叫就給錯的話，會是溫暖的 synth/pad。 在第一次呼叫之前（或按 🎹 面板裡的 🔊 之前）什麼都不會載入：@openav/sound 從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入，Tone.js 15 從 jsDelivr 載入（載入選項 tone 可以改成別的地方）。只有 piano 播的是錄好的取樣，第一次大約 2 MB，載好之前由電鋼琴先頂著（如果是從別的樂器切過來，就由原本那個繼續響），取樣到齊的時候 OAVp5.sound.instrument 會變成 piano。其他樂器都是 Tone.js 即時合成的，沒有檔案要載。 瀏覽器要頁面上先有一次點擊或按鍵才讓頁面出聲，MIDI 鍵盤上的鍵不算。在 setup() 裡呼叫 startSound() 沒有問題：OAVp5.sound.state 會是 'waiting'，🎹 旁邊有一張卡片說「聲音準備好了，還沒響」，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把聲音打開。soundIsOn 會告訴你什麼時候開了。 完全不寫程式也行：在網址後面加 ?oav_sound=piano（任何樂器代號都可以，在 OpenProcessing 上是 ?sketch_oav_sound=piano），任何草圖從第一次點擊起就聽得到，?oav_sound=off 則讓它保持安靜，這時 startSound() 什麼都不做，並 resolve 成 false。🎹 面板裡的 🔊 可以開關聲音，並列出所有樂器讓你挑。 聲音和鼓機是分開的：startDrums() 有自己的鼓組，不用 startSound()，第一次點擊之後就聽得到。 id 樂器的代號，例如 'organ' 或 'synth/pluck'（完整清單在說明裡）。不傳就沿用之前選的樂器，第一次呼叫時就是鋼琴。不是非空字串的值，視同沒傳。 聲音開起來之後 resolve 成 true。瀏覽器要先有一次點擊的話，就是在頁面上第一次點擊或按鍵之後。載入選項 sound 是 off、stopSound() 先被呼叫、或 Tone.js 載入失敗的時候，resolve 成 false。

It releases every note that is ringing, sets soundIsOn to false and OAVp5.sound.state to 'off'. Notes you play afterwards are not heard (the sketch's notePressed() is still called). Tone.js and the instrument stay loaded: startSound() afterwards is on again at once, without a new download and without waiting for another click. It also works while sound is still loading or waiting for the first click: the pending startSound() then resolves to false. It does not touch the drum machine (use stopDrums()) or the microphone (stopMic()). A promise that is already resolved to false, the new state of the sound.

它會放開所有正在響的音，把 soundIsOn 設成 false，OAVp5.sound.state 設成 'off'。之後彈的音聽不到（草圖的 notePressed() 照樣會被呼叫）。Tone.js 和樂器都還載著，所以之後再呼叫 startSound() 會馬上開，不用重新下載，也不用再等一次點擊。 聲音還在載入、或還在等第一次點擊的時候呼叫也可以：還沒結束的 startSound() 會 resolve 成 false。 它不會動到鼓機（要用 stopDrums()），也不會動到麥克風（stopMic()）。 一個已經 resolve 成 false 的 promise，false 就是聲音的新狀態。

OAVp5.sound (also reachable as midi.sound) is what startSound(), stopSound() and soundIsOn are built on. Read state to know where sound is, instrument for what you hear, status for the loading progress and error for a failure. start(id) and stop() are the same as the two global functions. shell, engine and module hand you the loaded @openav/sound parts for the rare case that you need them. For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, the console and debugging: OAVp5.sound.state is the first thing to look at when nothing is heard.

OAVp5.sound（也可以用 midi.sound 取得）是 startSound()、stopSound() 和 soundIsOn 的底層。讀 state 知道聲音在哪個階段，instrument 是你聽到的樂器，status 是載入進度，error 是失敗的原因。start(id) 和 stop() 跟那兩個全域函式一模一樣。shell、engine、module 把載入進來的 @openav/sound 各部分交給你，給少數真的需要的情況。 一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、主控台和除錯用的：聽不到聲音的時候，先看 OAVp5.sound.state。

It is the error the browser reported when @openav/sound or Tone.js could not be loaded. A card beside the 🎹 already tells the person at the keyboard what to do (try another network, or point the tone option at another copy of Tone.js); read this value to log it or to show your own message. To know whether sound is failing right now, use OAVp5.sound.state, not this. Set when the state becomes 'error'. It stays until the page is reloaded: a later try that works does not clear it.

這是 @openav/sound 或 Tone.js 載入失敗的時候，瀏覽器回報的錯誤。🎹 旁邊的卡片已經告訴現場的人該怎麼辦（換一個網路，或把 tone 選項指到另一份 Tone.js）。讀這個值是為了記錄下來，或顯示你自己的訊息。要知道聲音現在是不是在出錯，看 OAVp5.sound.state，不要看這個。 狀態變成 'error' 的時候設定。它會一直留到頁面重新載入：之後重試成功也不會清掉。

After a first startSound('piano') the piano's samples (about 2 MB) download first, and the electric piano plays meanwhile, so the first key is never silent: instrument says 'epiano' until the piano is ready and 'piano' after. When you switch to the piano from another instrument, that one keeps sounding and instrument names it until the samples are in. How far the loading is, and which instrument it is on, is in OAVp5.sound.status. Changes when the instrument changes, which for a sampled instrument is when its samples are in.

第一次呼叫 startSound('piano') 的時候，鋼琴的取樣（約 2 MB）要先下載，這段時間由電鋼琴頂著，所以第一個鍵不會沒聲音：鋼琴準備好之前 instrument 是 'epiano'，之後才是 'piano'。如果是從別的樂器切到鋼琴，取樣到齊之前原本那個樂器繼續響，instrument 也還是它的名字。載到哪裡、載的是哪個樂器，看 OAVp5.sound.status。 樂器換了才會變，取樣型的樂器則是等取樣到齊的時候才換。

'off' is where it starts and where stopSound() leaves it. startSound() moves it to 'loading' while @openav/sound and Tone.js arrive, to 'waiting' when everything is ready but the browser has not yet had its click, and to 'on' when notes are heard. 'error' means the sound parts could not be loaded (a network, a school firewall or an ad blocker); the message is in OAVp5.sound.error, and calling startSound() again tries once more. soundIsOn is the same thing reduced to state === 'on'. Starts as 'off' and changes whenever the sound moves to another stage.

'off' 是起點，也是 stopSound() 之後的狀態。呼叫 startSound() 之後，@openav/sound 和 Tone.js 還在下載的時候是 'loading'，東西都到齊但瀏覽器還沒等到那次點擊的時候是 'waiting'，聽得到音符的時候是 'on'。'error' 表示聲音的部分載入失敗（網路、學校的防火牆或廣告攔截器）。訊息在 OAVp5.sound.error，再呼叫一次 startSound() 會重試。 soundIsOn 就是把它縮成 state === 'on' 的版本。 一開始是 'off'，聲音換到另一個階段的時候就跟著變。

It is about the instrument, not about the whole sound: OAVp5.sound.state is the whole sound. Only the piano has files to load, so for every other instrument progress is 1 almost at once. While a sampler loads, OAVp5.sound.instrument is still the one you hear and status.id is the one on its way (at the very first call it may name the electric piano that stands in, and then the piano). A new object on every read. id is the instrument the loader is working on, state is 'idle' before anything loads, 'loading', 'ready' or 'error', and progress is the fraction of the files loaded.

它講的是樂器，不是整個聲音：整個聲音的狀態是 OAVp5.sound.state。只有 piano 有檔案要載，所以其他樂器的 progress 幾乎馬上就是 1。取樣型樂器載入的時候，OAVp5.sound.instrument 仍是你現在聽到的那個，status.id 才是正在路上的那個（第一次呼叫的時候，一開始可能先是頂替用的電鋼琴，之後才是鋼琴）。 每次讀都是一個新的物件。id 是載入器現在處理的樂器，state 在還沒載任何東西時是 'idle'，之後是 'loading'、'ready' 或 'error'，progress 是檔案載入的比例。

Loading the package registers all of them, except those whose id you registered first. Each one is a small file in the package's instruments/ folder. The piano loads its samples only when it is picked, and falls back to the electric piano if they cannot be fetched. The organ, the strings, the choir, the electric piano and the vibraphone bring params of their own. An array of 22 instrument definitions, in the order of the table.
載入套件就會登記全部，除非你先登記了同樣 id 的樂器。每一個都是套件的 instruments/ 資料夾裡的一個小檔案。鋼琴只有在被選到的時候才載入取樣，取樣抓不到就退回電鋼琴。風琴、弦樂、合唱、電鋼琴和顫音琴有自己的參數。 一個有 22 個樂器定義的陣列，順序跟下面的表一樣。

The category of an instrument definition picks its group in the picker. A category that is not in this list is allowed: it sorts after these, and its label is its id. Every category also has a Chinese name, which the picker uses on a Chinese page. Nine items { id, name: { en, zh } }, such as { id: 'mallets', name: { en: 'Mallets', zh: … } }.
樂器定義的 category 決定它在選單裡的組別。不在這份清單裡的類別也可以，它排在這些後面，標籤就是它的 id。中文名稱是 鍵盤、敲擊琴、弦樂、撥弦、風琴、人聲、合成器、鼓、其他。 九個項目 { id, name: { en, zh } }，例如 { id: 'mallets', name: { en: 'Mallets', zh: '敲擊琴' } }。
toneEngine() starts on it, and falls back to it when you name an instrument that is not registered. Its sound has not changed since the first version. 'synth/pad'.
toneEngine() 一開始用它，你指定了沒登記的樂器時也退回它。它的聲音從第一版以來沒有變過。 字串 'synth/pad'。

Use it to check that an id exists before you pass it to toneEngine() or setInstrument(), or to read an instrument's credit, defaults or params. id The id, for example 'piano' or 'synth/pluck'. The definition you registered ({ id, name, category, create, … }), or null.
在把 id 交給 toneEngine() 或 setInstrument() 之前，用它確認 id 存在，或讀一個樂器的 credit、defaults、params。 id id，例如 'piano' 或 'synth/pluck'。 你登記的那個定義（{ id, name, category, create, … }），或 null。

It is the data behind the picker, so you can build your own menu, a list or a grid of buttons. A category that is not in CATEGORIES is allowed; it sorts after the known ones and its label is its id. lang The language of the group labels. list The instruments to group. Left out, all the registered ones. [{ id, label, items: [definition…] }]: the groups in the order of CATEGORIES, then any categories of your own, sorted by name.
這就是選單背後的資料，所以你可以自己做選單、清單或一排按鈕。不在 CATEGORIES 裡的類別也可以，它排在已知的類別後面，label 就是它的 id。 lang 組別標籤的語言。 list 要分組的樂器。沒給的話，就是所有登記過的。 [{ id, label, items: [定義…] }]：各組依 CATEGORIES 的順序，接著是你自己的類別，依名稱排序。

Instruments carry name as a string or as { en, zh }. This hides which, so your own menu can just call instrumentName(def, lang). def An instrument definition. null or undefined gives ''. lang 'en', 'zh'… A longer tag such as 'zh-TW' is tried by its first two letters. The name in that language, else the English one. A definition whose name is a plain string gives that string.
樂器的 name 可以是字串，也可以是 { en, zh }。這個函式把差別藏起來，所以你自己的選單只要呼叫 instrumentName(def, lang)。 def 樂器的定義。null 或 undefined 會得到 ''。 lang 'en'、'zh'…。比較長的標記，像 'zh-TW'，會用它前兩個字母去找。 該語言的名稱，沒有就是英文的。name 只是一個字串的定義就回傳那個字串。

The 22 built-in instruments are registered when @openav/sound loads, so a fresh page lists those. For a list shaped for a menu, with the groups in order, use instrumentGroups(). category In the options { category }: only the instruments of this category ('mallets'). A new array of instrument definitions.
22 個內建樂器在 @openav/sound 載入的時候就登記了，所以剛打開的頁面列出的就是這些。要一份適合做選單的清單，各組已排好序，用 instrumentGroups()。 category 在選項 { category } 裡：只列這個類別的樂器（'mallets'）。 一個新的樂器定義陣列。

A xylophone bar, a glockenspiel bar and a music-box tine are the same physics with different numbers: a strike excites a few modes, each rings at its own multiple of the pitch and dies at its own rate. So a mallet instrument here is data, not code. The built-in xylophone is this short: Harder strikes brighten: the upper partials grow faster with velocity, as a real mallet does. The voices are raw Web Audio nodes built for each strike and left to the garbage collector. id The instrument id (see registerInstrument()). name The name: a string, or { en, zh }. category The picker group. credit A credit line, a string or { text, url }. params Params of its own: [{ key, label, min, max, def }]. Handled by the set function. defaults Starting values for the shared params. The default opens the filter, because bars are bright. partials The modes of the bar: [{ ratio, gain, decay }]. ratio is the frequency as a multiple of the note (1 is the note itself, 3 a twelfth above it), gain the level relative to the others and decay the seconds to near silence at middle C. High notes die faster than low ones. A partial above 45% of the sample rate is skipped. Required: without it this throws. strike The mallet, a few milliseconds of band-passed noise: { ratio, q, gain, decay }, where ratio sets its pitch as a multiple of the note, q its width, gain its level and decay its length in seconds. damp Seconds in which letting go of a key mutes the bar. 0 lets the bars ring free (xylophone,…
