木琴的音條、鐵琴的音條和音樂盒的音叉是同樣的物理，只是數字不同：敲一下激發出幾個振動模式，每個模式以自己的音高倍數響，用自己的速度消失。所以這裡的敲擊類樂器是資料，不是程式。內建的木琴就這麼短： 打得越用力越亮：高的泛音會隨力度長得比較快，真的槌子就是這樣。每個聲部都是每敲一下就建一組的原生 Web Audio 節點，用完交給垃圾回收。 id 樂器的 id（見 registerInstrument()）。 name 名稱：字串，或 { en, zh }。 category 選單的組別。 credit 出處說明，字串或 { text, url }。 params 它自己的參數：[{ key, label, min, max, def }]。由 set 函式處理。 defaults 共用參數的起始值。預設把濾波器打開，因為敲擊的音條聲音是亮的。 partials 音條的各個振動模式：[{ ratio, gain, decay }]。ratio 是頻率相對於音符的倍數（1 是音符本身，3 是高一個十二度），gain 是相對於其他泛音的音量，decay 是在中央 C 衰減到幾乎無聲要幾秒。高音比低音消失得快。高於取樣率 45% 的泛音會被略過。必須給：沒給的話會丟出錯誤。 strike 槌子，幾毫秒的帶通雜訊：{ ratio, q, gain, decay }，ratio 是它的音高相對於音符的倍數，q 是寬度，gain 是音量，decay 是長度，單位是秒。 damp 放開鍵之後幾秒內把音條止音。0 是讓音條自由響完（木琴、鐵琴）。顫音琴有止音器。 pitchDecay 高音比低音消失得快多少。衰減時間會乘上 (261.63 / 頻率) ^ pitchDecay，限制在 0.2 到 3 之間。0 讓每個音一樣長。 transpose 把演奏的音移幾個半音（木琴高一個八度：12）。 gain 樂器的音量，單位是 dB。 attack 泛音達到全音量要幾秒。 tremolo 所有聲部一起的音量起伏，也就是顫音琴的馬達：{ frequency, depth, spread }。 maxVoices 最多能同時響幾個音。超過的時候，最舊的會在 30 毫秒內淡出。 set set({ key, value, tremolo, Tone })，樂器自己的參數改變時呼叫，好讓它改顫音或別的東西。 一個還沒登記的樂器定義：交給 registerInstrument()。tail 設成 min(8, 最長的衰減 × 1.5 + 0.2) 秒。

A native with one per category (CATEGORIES), so it works with a keyboard and on a phone and needs no styling to be usable. It lists whatever is registered, and it refreshes itself when an instrument is registered or removed (onInstrumentsChange()). Choosing one calls sound.setInstrument(id, { remember: true }). While a sampler loads it shows a bar and a percentage; if the load fails it says so, and says which instrument plays instead. A credit line appears under the menu for an instrument that has one: the Salamander piano is CC-BY, and its credit is always shown. container The element to put the picker in. sound The Sound to control. The menu follows its instrument and its loading. lang The language of the labels and instrument names. The default is 'zh' when the page's starts with zh, else 'en'. className The class of the picker. The parts get -row, -label, -status, -meter and -credit added to it, for your own styling. The picker brings no CSS. label The label in front of the menu. Left out, it is the word "instrument" (in Chinese when lang is 'zh'). enableOnPick Choosing an instrument also calls sound.enable() if the sound is off. A choice is a click, which is the gesture a browser wants before it plays audio. { el, select, refresh(), dispose() }: the element it made, its , a function that rebuilds the list, and a function that takes it away.

這是原生的 ，每個類別（CATEGORIES）一個 ，所以用鍵盤、在手機上都能用，不用做任何樣式就能用。它列出所有已登記的樂器，而且在有樂器被登記或移除時自動更新（onInstrumentsChange()）。選了一個就呼叫 sound.setInstrument(id, { remember: true })。取樣樂器載入的時候顯示進度條和百分比。載入失敗會說出來，並說明改播哪個樂器。有出處說明的樂器，選單底下會出現一行：Salamander 鋼琴是 CC-BY，它的出處說明一定會顯示。 container 要放選單的元素。 sound 要控制的 Sound。選單會跟著它的樂器和載入狀態走。 lang 標籤和樂器名稱的語言。預設是頁面的 以 zh 開頭就用 'zh'，否則用 'en'。 className 選單的 class。各個部分會在它後面加上 -row、-label、-status、-meter、-credit，讓你自己寫樣式。選單本身不帶 CSS。 label 選單前面的標籤。沒給的話，依語言是 "instrument" 或「樂器」。 enableOnPick 選了樂器之後，如果聲音還沒開，就順便呼叫 sound.enable()。選擇本身就是一次點擊，正是瀏覽器要的那個動作。 { el, select, refresh(), dispose() }：它做出來的元素、裡面的 、重建清單的函式，和把它拆掉的函式。

mountSoundPicker() listens this way, which is why an instrument registered after the picker was built still shows up. A replacement with { replace: true } also reports register. A call to unregisterInstrument() for an id that is not there reports nothing. cb cb({ type, id }) with type 'register' or 'unregister'. An error inside it is logged and does not stop the others. Call it to stop listening.

mountSoundPicker() 就是這樣在聽，所以選單蓋好之後才登記的樂器也會出現。用 { replace: true } 取代也會通報 register。對不存在的 id 呼叫 unregisterInstrument() 不會通報。 cb cb({ type, id })，type 是 'register' 或 'unregister'。裡面出錯只會被記在 console，不會影響其他監聽者。 呼叫它就停止監聽。

A sound you can pick is plain data plus one factory. Registering it is all it takes: import the file before you start, and every mountSoundPicker() on the page lists it under its category, with no change to the package. The registry lives on globalThis, so two copies of this module on one page share one list. Built-in instruments only fill empty slots: register your own 'piano' first and you keep it. The definition: create(Tone, ctx) runs on enable and on every switch to the instrument, with Tone.js already loaded. ctx is { output, rawOutput, rawContext, baseUrl, options, onProgress }: connect Tone nodes to output (raw Web Audio nodes to rawOutput), baseUrl is where sample folders live, options is what was passed in toneEngine({ instruments: { : … } }), and onProgress(0..1) shows a loading bar. If ready is a promise, the picker shows progress and the old sound keeps playing until it resolves. An instrument that makes mallet sounds from data can use modalInstrument(), and one that is a Tone synth with settings, registerSynthPreset(). def The instrument definition, see the table below. replace In the options { replace }: allow replacing an instrument that has the same id. Without it a duplicate id throws. The definition you gave. It throws a TypeError listing everything wrong if the definition is not valid (see validateInstrument()), and an Error for a duplicate id.

能選的聲音就是一份資料加一個工廠函式。登記它就夠了：在開始之前匯入那個檔案，頁面上每個 mountSoundPicker() 就會把它列在它的類別底下，不用改套件。登記表放在 globalThis 上，所以同一個頁面上有兩份這個模組也共用同一份清單。內建的樂器只會填空位：先登記你自己的 'piano'，就會保留你的。定義如下： create(Tone, ctx) 在啟用的時候、以及每次切換到這個樂器的時候執行，那時 Tone.js 已經載入。ctx 是 { output, rawOutput, rawContext, baseUrl, options, onProgress }：把 Tone 的節點接到 output（原生 Web Audio 節點接到 rawOutput），baseUrl 是取樣資料夾的位置，options 是 toneEngine({ instruments: { : … } }) 傳進來的東西，onProgress(0..1) 用來顯示載入進度。如果 ready 是 promise，選單會顯示進度，而且在它 resolve 之前舊的聲音繼續播。從資料做敲擊聲的樂器可以用 modalInstrument()，是有設定的 Tone 合成器就用 registerSynthPreset()。 def 樂器的定義，見下面的表。 replace 在選項 { replace } 裡：允許取代同樣 id 的樂器。沒有它的話，重複的 id 會丟出錯誤。 你給的那個定義。定義不合格的話會丟出 TypeError，列出所有的問題（見 validateInstrument())，id 重複則丟出 Error。

A preset names a voice, its settings in Tone.js's vocabulary, and an optional effects chain, and nothing else. id is lowercase letters, digits and - (it becomes synth/), name is a string or { en, zh }. voice is 'synth' (oscillator and envelope), 'mono' (adds a resonant filter with its own envelope), 'fm' or 'am'. The Tone settings are oscillator, envelope, filter, filterEnvelope, harmonicity, modulationIndex, modulation, modulationEnvelope, detune and portamento. The rest: octave (a whole number of octaves, -1 for a bass), gain (dB, to level it against the others), polyphony, defaults (starting cutoff, space, volume), params, category and credit, as in registerInstrument(). effects is a list of { type, …settings } that the sound passes through in order. The types are chorus, delay, pingpong, distortion, vibrato, tremolo, phaser, autofilter, filter, eq, compressor, chebyshev and widener; the other keys are the effect's own Tone settings, including wet. A preset that is wrong throws a TypeError with the reasons. preset The preset: { id, name, voice, … }, see below. opts The options of registerInstrument(): { replace: true } swaps an existing one. The instrument definition that was registered (synthInstrument() of the preset).

一個預設只有這些：一個 voice、用 Tone.js 的詞彙寫的設定，和選用的效果鏈。id 是小寫字母、數字和 -（會變成 synth/），name 是字串或 { en, zh }。voice 是 'synth'（振盪器加包絡）、'mono'（多一個有自己包絡的共振濾波器）、'fm' 或 'am'。Tone 的設定有 oscillator、envelope、filter、filterEnvelope、harmonicity、modulationIndex、modulation、modulationEnvelope、detune、portamento。其他的：octave（整數個八度，貝斯用 -1）、gain（dB，用來跟別的樂器配音量）、polyphony、defaults（起始的 cutoff、space、volume）、params、category、credit，跟 registerInstrument() 一樣。 effects 是一串 { type, …設定 }，聲音依序通過它們。種類有 chorus、delay、pingpong、distortion、vibrato、tremolo、phaser、autofilter、filter、eq、compressor、chebyshev、widener。其他的鍵是那個效果自己的 Tone 設定，包括 wet。不合格的預設會丟出 TypeError 並說明原因。 preset 預設：{ id, name, voice, … }，見下面。 opts registerInstrument() 的選項：{ replace: true } 會換掉現有的。 被登記的那個樂器定義（這個預設的 synthInstrument()）。

The sampler shifts the pitch of the notes in between by at most a semitone and a half, which is inaudible on a piano. There is only one velocity layer, so loud against soft is a gain curve, not a different hammer. [21, 24, 27, …, 108]: 30 MIDI note numbers, three semitones apart (the A, C, D♯ and F♯ of every octave).
取樣器把中間的音升降最多一個半音半，在鋼琴上聽不出來。只有一個力度層，所以大聲和小聲是音量曲線，不是不同的琴槌。 [21, 24, 27, …, 108]：30 個 MIDI 音符號碼，彼此相隔三個半音（每個八度的 A、C、D♯、F♯）。

The piano instrument uses it to fetch its files from baseUrl + 'salamander/'. Use it if you want to load the same files into a sampler of your own. notes Which MIDI notes to include. The default is SALAMANDER_NOTES, all 30. An object from Tone note names to file names. The files spell a sharp as "s": D#1 is Ds1.mp3.
鋼琴樂器用它從 baseUrl + 'salamander/' 抓檔案。想把同樣的檔案載入你自己的取樣器時可以用它。 notes 要包含哪些 MIDI 音符。預設是 SALAMANDER_NOTES，全部 30 個。 一個物件，從 Tone 的音名對應到檔名。檔名把升記號寫成 "s"：D#1 是 Ds1.mp3。

It is the default baseUrl of toneEngine(). The piano reads its 30 mp3 files from the salamander/ folder under it. The server sends CORS headers, so any page can load them. createShow() points the engine at the copy next to the page instead. To use your own copy, give baseUrl, or instruments: { piano: { baseUrl } } for the piano alone. 'https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/sound/samples/', ending in a slash.

它是 toneEngine() 的 baseUrl 預設值。鋼琴從它底下的 salamander/ 資料夾讀 30 個 mp3 檔。伺服器有送 CORS 標頭，所以任何頁面都能載入。createShow() 會改指向頁面旁邊的那一份。要用自己的備份，就給 baseUrl，只想換鋼琴的話給 instruments: { piano: { baseUrl } }。 'https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/sound/samples/'，以斜線結尾。

Sound is the shell that wires an engine into an app. Once await sound.enable() has run, every midi/note/on and midi/note/off on the bus is played, whatever sent it: a MIDI keyboard, the on-screen piano (mountKeys()), a SimPlayer, a TakePlayer or a phone. Notes on a channel in the engine's skipChannels are left out (the Tone engine skips channel 10, which belongs to the drum machine). The engine's params become sound/ params, so a knob, the timeline or a hand can play the filter the same way it plays the visuals: sound is performable state, not a side effect. Every frame, call sound.update(state) with the resolved param values, and the sound/ ones that changed are handed to the engine. The instrument is a discrete choice (setInstrument() or the picker); what you perform continuously stays a param. To set an engine value by hand, use sound.set('volume', -20): it is an override on sound/volume held by 'sound.set', the engine hears it at once, and the timeline, a route or a re-sent reading leave it there until sound.release('volume') or ✕ on the console. A value written straight into the engine (sound.engine.set(…)) is no longer overwritten on the next frame; it stays until its param changes. sound.enable() from a click: browsers start audio only after a user gesture. With toneEngine() it also loads Tone.js from the network (jsDelivr) the first time. Before enable() nothing is heard, and the bus is not listened to. From a p5 sketch you do not build this: startSound() does it,…

Sound 是把引擎接進應用程式的外殼。await sound.enable() 之後，匯流排上每個 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off 都會被播出來，不管是誰送的：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕鋼琴（mountKeys()）、SimPlayer、TakePlayer 或手機。在引擎的 skipChannels 裡的頻道的音符不會播（Tone 引擎略過頻道 10，那是鼓機的）。 引擎的參數會變成 sound/ 參數，所以旋鈕、時間軸或一隻手可以像操作畫面那樣操作濾波器：聲音是可以演奏的狀態，不是附帶的效果。每個畫面用解析好的參數值呼叫 sound.update(state)，其中變了的 sound/ 值就會交給引擎。樂器是離散的選擇（setInstrument() 或選單），要連續演奏的東西則維持是參數。 要用手設定引擎的值，用 sound.set('volume', -20)：它是 sound/volume 上由 'sound.set' 握著的覆寫值，引擎立刻聽到，時間軸、路由或重送的讀數都不會動它，直到 sound.release('volume') 或按主控台上的 ✕。直接寫進引擎的值（sound.engine.set(…)）不會再在下一個影格被蓋掉，會留到它的參數改變為止。 要在點擊裡呼叫 sound.enable()：瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作才讓聲音開始。用 toneEngine() 的話，第一次還會從網路（jsDelivr）載入 Tone.js。enable() 之前什麼都聽不到，匯流排也沒有被聽。 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己建這個：startSound() 會做，而且只在被呼叫的時候才載入這個套件。 signals Signals 匯流排。Sound 聽 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch }、midi/note/off { note, ch } 和 midi/cc/64（延音踏板，0.5 以上算踩下），並在樂器改變時發出 sound/instrument { id, name } 脈衝。 params 要把引擎的參數加進去的 Params，名稱是 sound/（sound/cutoff、sound/space、sound/volume，和樂器自己的）。沒給的話，不註冊任何參數。 engine 發聲引擎，例如 toneEngine() 或 drumEngine()。約定是 { params, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01), noteOff(note), set(key, value), dispose() }，選用的有 setInstrument、instrument、status、subscribe、sustain(down)、skipChannels。 instrument 一開始用哪個樂器，給有樂器的引擎用（'piano'、'synth/pluck'）。不認識的 id 會在 console 警告，並被忽略。 remember 把選單最後選的樂器依頁面記在 localStorage，下一次它會贏過 instrument。給字串就是你自己的儲存鍵。預設的鍵是 openav:sound:。false 是關掉。用程式做的選擇不會被記住，除非你要求（setInstrument(id, { remember: true })）。 picker 控台要不要顯示樂器選單。它被存成 sound.picker，給建介面的人讀。Sound 自己不畫任何東西。 writes…

cutoff is the low-pass filter's frequency in Hz, space is how much reverb is mixed in (the wet amount, 0..1), volume is the level in dB. They sit after the instrument on the output chain, so the timeline, a knob or a hand keep performing them across instrument switches. In a show they are the params sound/cutoff, sound/space and sound/volume. An instrument may suggest other starting values through its defaults, and automation and overrides always win over a suggestion. An instrument's own params cannot use these keys. [{ key: 'cutoff', min: 100, max: 8000, def: 2500 }, { key: 'space', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.3 }, { key: 'volume', min: -36, max: 0, def: -8 }], each also with a label.

cutoff 是低通濾波器的頻率，單位是 Hz，space 是混進去多少殘響（濕度，0..1），volume 是音量，單位是 dB。它們在輸出鏈上排在樂器之後，所以換樂器的時候，時間軸、旋鈕或一隻手可以繼續演奏它們。在演出裡它們是參數 sound/cutoff、sound/space、sound/volume。樂器可以用它的 defaults 建議不同的起始值，自動化和覆寫永遠贏過建議。樂器自己的 params 不能用這幾個鍵。 [{ key: 'cutoff', min: 100, max: 8000, def: 2500 }, { key: 'space', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.3 }, { key: 'volume', min: -36, max: 0, def: -8 }]，每個還有一個 label。

It is how createShow({ modules: { sound: … } }) understands its option, so sound: true, sound: 'piano' and sound: { instrument: 'organ', remember: false, picker: false } all work. You only need it if you write something that takes the same option. value true for the defaults, an instrument id ('piano'), or { instrument, remember, picker, engine, …toneEngine options }. Anything falsy gives null. { engine, instrument, remember, picker, engineOptions } (engine and instrument are null when not given, remember and picker are true), or null for a falsy value. engineOptions holds the rest of an object: baseUrl, cdn, instruments…. An instrument that is not a string, or a value of another kind, throws a TypeError.

createShow({ modules: { sound: … } }) 就是靠它理解選項，所以 sound: true、sound: 'piano' 和 sound: { instrument: 'organ', remember: false, picker: false } 都行。只有你要寫收同樣選項的東西時才需要它。 value true 是預設，樂器 id（'piano'），或 { instrument, remember, picker, engine, …toneEngine 的選項 }。任何假值會得到 null。 { engine, instrument, remember, picker, engineOptions }（沒給的 engine 和 instrument 是 null，remember 和 picker 是 true），假值則是 null。engineOptions 放物件裡其餘的東西：baseUrl、cdn、instruments…。instrument 不是字串，或給了別種值，會丟出 TypeError。

Each preset is what synthInstrument() turns into an instrument synth/. They are data in Tone.js's own vocabulary (oscillator, envelope, filter, filterEnvelope, harmonicity…), a good place to look when you write a preset of your own for registerSynthPreset(). The pad is the framework's original voice: three detuned sawtooth waves with a quick attack and a long release. An array of 11 presets { id, name: { en, zh }, voice, … }: pad, saw-lead, square-lead, pluck, supersaw, bass, acid, brass, bell, sub, chip.

每個預設都會被 synthInstrument() 變成一個樂器 synth/。它們是用 Tone.js 自己的詞彙寫的資料（oscillator、envelope、filter、filterEnvelope、harmonicity…），要為 registerSynthPreset() 寫自己的預設時，是個好的參考。pad 是框架最早的聲音：三個失諧的鋸齒波，起音快、釋放長。 一個有 11 個預設的陣列 { id, name: { en, zh }, voice, … }：pad、saw-lead、square-lead、pluck、supersaw、bass、acid、brass、bell、sub、chip。

The definition's create() builds one Tone.PolySynth of the preset's voice (synth, mono, fm or am), with the Tone settings the preset carries, a chain of its effects, and its polyphony (16 voices if left out). Use it when you want the definition for yourself (to adjust it before registering); otherwise registerSynthPreset() does both steps. preset The preset, see registerSynthPreset(). A preset that validateSynthPreset() refuses throws a TypeError. An instrument definition: id is 'synth/' + preset.id, name the preset's (or its id), category the preset's or 'synth', transpose is octave × 12, gain, defaults, params and credit come from the preset, tail is min(8, release × 1.5 + 0.5) seconds and preset is the preset itself.

這個定義的 create() 會建一個 Tone.PolySynth，聲部是預設的 voice（synth、mono、fm 或 am），帶著預設的 Tone 設定、一串 effects 效果，以及它的 polyphony（沒給就是 16 個聲部）。想自己拿到這個定義（登記前先調整）時才用它。否則 registerSynthPreset() 兩步一起做完。 preset 預設，見 registerSynthPreset()。validateSynthPreset() 不接受的預設會丟出 TypeError。 一個樂器定義：id 是 'synth/' + preset.id，name 用預設的（沒有就用它的 id），category 用預設的或 'synth'，transpose 是 octave × 12，gain、defaults、params、credit 來自預設，tail 是 min(8, release × 1.5 + 0.5) 秒，preset 是預設本身。
A module URL that toneEngine() imports on enable(). To host Tone.js yourself, pass your own as the cdn option of toneEngine(). 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm'.
toneEngine() 在 enable() 時匯入的模組網址。想自己放 Tone.js 的話，把你的網址當作 toneEngine() 的 cdn 選項。 字串 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm'。

Tone.js stays a neighbour, not a dependency: it is loaded from the network the first time enable() runs, so an app that never turns the sound on pays nothing. After enable() the instrument's output goes through a low-pass filter (cutoff, starting at 2500 Hz), a reverb (space, the wet amount, starting at 0.3), a volume (volume, in dB, starting at -8) and a limiter at -1 dB, so a loud organ never clips the room. These three are the SOUND_PARAMS shared by every instrument. Their starting values can follow the instrument (a piano wants the filter open), and the instrument may add params of its own. setInstrument(id) switches live and returns a promise of whether it worked. Before enable() it only remembers the choice. Held notes are released on the old instrument and its tail is left to ring for a few seconds. A sampler (the piano) keeps the old sound until its files are in; if they cannot load, the engine plays the instrument's fallback (the piano falls back to the electric piano), so a performance never goes silent because of one failed download. subscribe(cb) tells you about instrument, loading, ready and error events. sustain(down) is the pedal: note-offs wait until it comes up. releaseAll() is a panic button. You usually pass the engine to a Sound, which is what listens to the bus. Used on its own, noteOn(60, 0.8) plays a note. await engine.enable() from a click: it loads Tone.js from the network, then starts its audio. Before that, noteOn() does nothing and…

Tone.js 只是鄰居，不是相依套件：第一次 enable() 的時候才從網路載入，所以從不開聲音的應用程式什麼代價都不用付。enable() 之後，樂器的輸出會經過低通濾波器（cutoff，起始 2500 Hz）、殘響（space，濕度，起始 0.3）、音量（volume，單位 dB，起始 -8）和 -1 dB 的限幅器，所以很大聲的風琴也不會把房間削波。這三個就是每個樂器共用的 SOUND_PARAMS。它們的起始值可以跟著樂器走（鋼琴想要濾波器全開），樂器也可以再加自己的參數。 setInstrument(id) 現場換樂器，回傳換成功與否的 promise。在 enable() 之前它只是記住這個選擇。舊樂器按著的音會被放開，它的尾巴讓它再響幾秒。取樣樂器（鋼琴）在檔案進來之前會繼續用舊的聲音。如果載入失敗，引擎會播這個樂器的 fallback（鋼琴退回電鋼琴），所以演出不會因為一次下載失敗就沒聲音。subscribe(cb) 會告訴你 instrument、loading、ready、error 事件。sustain(down) 是踏板：放開音的動作要等到踏板抬起來才做。releaseAll() 是緊急停止鈕。 通常你會把引擎交給 Sound，由它去聽匯流排。單獨使用的話，noteOn(60, 0.8) 就是彈一個音。 要在點擊裡 await engine.enable()：它從網路載入 Tone.js，然後啟動音訊。在那之前 noteOn() 什麼都不做，setInstrument() 只是記住選擇。 cdn 引擎啟用時從哪裡匯入 Tone.js。預設是 TONE_CDN。是一個模組網址，所以你可以放自己的備份。 instrument 一開始用的樂器。不認識的 id 會警告，改用 synth/pad。 baseUrl 放內建取樣組（salamander/…）的資料夾。預設是 SAMPLES_URL。 instruments 給單一樂器的選項，會當作 ctx.options 交給它的 create()：{ piano: { baseUrl: '/my/salamander/' } }。 drumChannel 這個 MIDI 頻道的音符屬於鼓的引擎（鼓機送的是 General MIDI 的頻道 10），這裡不播。null 是全部都播。 一個引擎：{ params, sharedParams, instrument, status, skipChannels, hasInstrument(id), subscribe(cb), setInstrument(id), enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), noteOff(note, time), sustain(down), releaseAll(), set(key, value), dispose() }。

A picker refreshes itself. It does not stop an engine that is playing the instrument: switch away first. id The id of the instrument. True if it existed. The listeners of onInstrumentsChange() hear { type: 'unregister', id } only then.
選單會自己更新。它不會停掉正在播這個樂器的引擎：要先換掉。 id 樂器的 id。 原本有就是 true。只有這時候，onInstrumentsChange() 的監聽者才會收到 { type: 'unregister', id }。

It checks: id (lowercase letters, digits and -, at most one /), name (a string, or { en, zh } with at least en), category (a string), create (a function), params (each with a word as key, numbers min < max, a def within them, and a key that is not one of the shared three), defaults (only cutoff, space or volume, each within its range), credit (a string, or { text, url }), gain, transpose and tail (numbers) and fallback (another instrument's id). registerInstrument() runs it and throws with these sentences. def The definition to check. Sentences, one per problem. [] when valid. It never throws.

它檢查：id（小寫字母、數字和 -，最多一個 /）、name（字串，或至少有 en 的 { en, zh }）、category（字串）、create（函式）、params（每個的 key 是一個單字，min < max 是數字，def 在兩者之間，而且 key 不是共用的那三個之一）、defaults（只能是 cutoff、space、volume，且各自在範圍內）、credit（字串，或 { text, url }）、gain、transpose、tail（數字），以及 fallback（另一個樂器的 id）。registerInstrument() 會執行它，並用這些句子丟出錯誤。 def 要檢查的定義。 句子，每個問題一句。沒問題就是 []。它不會丟出錯誤。

It checks the id (lowercase letters, digits and -), the voice (synth, mono, fm or am), that every effect has a type the package knows, and that octave is a whole number. It does not check the Tone settings, which are Tone.js's to judge. p The preset to check. Sentences, one per problem. [] when valid.
它檢查 id（小寫字母、數字和 -）、voice（synth、mono、fm 或 am）、每個效果的 type 是不是套件認得的，以及 octave 是不是整數。Tone 的設定它不檢查，那是 Tone.js 的事。 p 要檢查的預設。 句子，每個問題一句。沒問題就是 []。

A beat is a quarter note (four steps). 1 - beatPhase is biggest right on the beat and shrinks until the next one, so circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + (1 - beatPhase) 80) pulses with the tempo, with no callback needed. drumPhase is the same thing across a whole bar. Start the machine with startDrums(); until it plays, beatPhase is 0. Read fresh each time you look at it. 0 on the beat, close to 1 just before the next one, then 0 again. It is 0 before the machine has played and holds still while it is stopped.

一拍是一個四分音符（四格）。1 - beatPhase 在正拍上最大，然後縮小到下一拍，所以 circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + (1 - beatPhase) 80) 會跟著速度脈動，不用任何 callback。drumPhase 是同樣的東西，範圍是整個小節。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機，在它開始播之前，beatPhase 是 0。 每次讀都是當下的值。正拍上是 0，下一拍之前接近 1，然後回到 0。鼓機還沒播之前是 0，停下來的時候停在原地。

Call it in draw() after background(): drawRhythm(20, 100, 360, 100). Each row is one drum that plays in the pattern, a hit lights up the moment it is heard (the clock drumPhase reads), and a hit between two steps, such as a triplet, sits where it falls. The grid card is part of the page and a recording never shows it, but the canvas is what a recording takes, so this is how the rhythm gets into the video. With no box it draws a strip along the bottom for 'grid' and a square in the middle for the other two. It draws with p5's own shapes between push() and pop(), so it leaves your styles alone and works in 2D and in WEBGL, in p5 1.x and 2.x. In WEBGL the origin is the middle of the canvas: drawRhythm(-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height, 'circle') fills it. Start the machine with startDrums() first. Before it plays you get an empty four-lane grid. OAVp5.drums.draw(x, y, w, h, style, o) is the same function as a method. x Left edge of the box to draw in. In WEBGL the middle of the canvas is (0, 0). If any of x, y, w, h is left out, the default box is used. y Top edge of the box. w Width of the box. h Height of the box. style 'grid' (the 16 steps with a playhead), 'circle' (a ring of 16 per drum with a hand turned by drumPhase) or 'spiral' (the last few bars wound outwards, now at the tip). An object here is taken as o, with style inside it. o Options: colors ({ kick: '#f66', … }, any p5 colour per drum), color (one colour for all), off (the empty steps), playhead (a colour,…

在 draw() 裡、background() 之後呼叫：drawRhythm(20, 100, 360, 100)。每一列是節奏裡有用到的一種鼓，打擊在你聽到的那一刻亮起來（用的就是 drumPhase 讀的那個時鐘），兩格之間的打擊（例如三連音）會畫在它實際落下的位置。鼓機的卡片是頁面的一部分，錄影錄不到，但錄影錄的是畫布，所以要讓節奏進影片，就用這個。 不給方框的話，'grid' 畫在畫布下方的一條帶子，另外兩種畫在中間的正方形。它用 p5 自己的圖形，包在 push() 和 pop() 之間，所以不會弄亂你設定的樣式，2D 和 WEBGL、p5 1.x 和 2.x 都能用。在 WEBGL 裡原點是畫布中心：drawRhythm(-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height, 'circle') 會鋪滿整個畫布。 要先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機。在它開始播之前，畫出來的是一個空的四軌格子。 OAVp5.drums.draw(x, y, w, h, style, o) 是同一個函式，寫成方法的樣子。 x 要畫的方框的左邊。在 WEBGL 裡，畫布中心是 (0, 0)。x、y、w、h 只要有一個沒傳，就用預設的方框。 y 方框的上邊。 w 方框的寬。 h 方框的高。 style 'grid'（16 格加一條播放頭）、'circle'（每種鼓一圈 16 格，指針照 drumPhase 轉）或 'spiral'（最近幾小節往外繞，現在在最外面的尖端）。這裡如果給的是物件，就當成 o，style 寫在物件裡面。 o 選項：colors（{ kick: '#f66', … }，每種鼓一個 p5 看得懂的顏色）、color（全部同一個顏色）、off（空格子的顏色）、playhead（顏色，或 false 表示不畫）、bg（方框的底色）、bars（只用在螺旋，1 到 16，沒寫就是 4）。 有畫東西就是 true，方框是空的（w 或 h 不大於 0），或沒有 p5 全域模式可以畫的時候是 false。

A beat is a quarter note, four steps, so one step lasts 60 / drumBpm / 4 seconds and one bar 240 / drumBpm: at 120 a bar takes 2 seconds. To change the tempo call startDrums(bpm): startDrums(drumBpm + 5) speeds up by five. Writing to drumBpm yourself changes nothing. startDrums() keeps the tempo between 30 and 300; the slider on the grid goes from 60 to 180. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumBpm keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.bpm instead. 112 until you set another one. It follows startDrums() and the tempo slider on the grid.

一拍是一個四分音符，也就是四格，所以一格長 60 / drumBpm / 4 秒，一小節長 240 / drumBpm 秒：速度 120 的時候一小節是 2 秒。要改速度就呼叫 startDrums(bpm)：startDrums(drumBpm + 5) 就是加快 5。自己對 drumBpm 賦值不會有任何作用。 startDrums() 會把速度限制在 30 到 300 之間，格子上的滑桿則是從 60 到 180。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumBpm 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.bpm。 在你設定別的之前是 112。它會跟著 startDrums() 和格子上的速度滑桿走。

Define function drumHit(lane, velocity) { … } and oav-p5 calls it for every hit of every drum, the way it calls notePressed() for a key. It is called in the frame in which the hit is heard, right before draw(). The same hit also calls the microphone's functions, so you can pick the grain you want: kickDetected() for the kick, snareDetected() for snare, clap and rim, hatDetected() for the three hats, and beatDetected() (with beat true for a frame) for kick, snare, clap and rim, once per step. Toms, crash, ride and cowbell reach only drumHit(). On one step the order is: cueFired(), barStarted(), stepStarted(), then the hits. While the tab is hidden nobody sees a frame: the clock keeps counting, but no hit is told, and nothing is told twice when the tab comes back. An error thrown inside drumHit() is printed, with its file and line, and the next hit still comes. lane The drum that sounded: 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' or 'clap' for the grid, and also 'openhat', 'pedalhat', 'rim', 'lowtom', 'tom', 'hightom', 'crash', 'ride' or 'cowbell' for a line of rhythm. velocity How hard, from 0.15 to 1. It varies a little from hit to hit, because the machine plays slightly softer or louder on purpose.

定義 function drumHit(lane, velocity) { … }，鼓機每打一下、不論哪一種鼓，oav-p5 都會呼叫它，就像按一個鍵會呼叫 notePressed() 一樣。它是在你聽到那一下的那個畫面、draw() 之前被呼叫的。 同一下打擊也會呼叫麥克風用的那些函式，你可以挑想要的粒度：kickDetected() 是大鼓，snareDetected() 是小鼓、拍手和鼓邊，hatDetected() 是三種鈸，beatDetected()（同時 beat 在那個畫面是 true）是大鼓、小鼓、拍手和鼓邊，每一格最多一次。中鼓、碎音鈸、疊音鈸和牛鈴只會呼叫 drumHit()。同一格裡的順序是：cueFired()、barStarted()、stepStarted()，最後才是各個打擊。 分頁被藏起來的時候沒有人看得到畫面：時鐘照樣在數，但不會通知任何一下打擊，分頁回來時也不會把漏掉的補通知一次。drumHit() 裡丟出的錯誤會連同檔案和行號印出來，下一下打擊照樣會來。 lane 發聲的鼓：格子上是 'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'clap'，一行字寫的節奏還會有 'openhat'、'pedalhat'、'rim'、'lowtom'、'tom'、'hightom'、'crash'、'ride'、'cowbell'。 velocity 打得多用力，從 0.15 到 1。每一下會有一點點不同，因為鼓機故意打得時輕時重。

Use it for anything that should move continuously with the music: rotate(drumPhase TWO_PI) turns once per bar. drumStep says the same thing in 16 jumps; drumPhase is the smooth version. The value is what the listener hears, which is the machine's position corrected for the latency of the speakers, so a drawing driven by it lands on the beat you hear. A bar has four beats; beatPhase is the same idea for one beat. Start the machine with startDrums(); until it plays, drumPhase is 0. A sketch that declares its own drumPhase keeps it, and oav-p5 does not write that name. OAVp5.drums.phase is the same number under a name nothing else can take. Read fresh each time you look at it, so it is never a frame old. 0 at the start of a bar, close to 1 at its end, then 0 again. It is 0 before the machine has played and holds still while it is stopped.

任何要跟著音樂連續移動的東西都用它：rotate(drumPhase TWO_PI) 一小節轉一圈。drumStep 講的是同一件事，只是分成 16 次跳動，drumPhase 是平滑的版本。它的值是聽的人聽到的位置，也就是鼓機的位置再扣掉喇叭的延遲，所以用它驅動的畫面會落在你聽到的拍子上。 一小節有四拍，beatPhase 是同樣的概念，單位是一拍。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機，在它開始播之前，drumPhase 是 0。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumPhase，就用你的，oav-p5 不會去寫這個名稱。OAVp5.drums.phase 是同一個數字，用一個不會跟別人衝突的名字。 每次讀都是當下的值，不會慢一個畫面。小節開頭是 0，結尾接近 1，然後回到 0。鼓機還沒播之前是 0，停下來的時候停在原地。

Use it to tell "the drums are not running" from "the drums are at step 0": drumStep is 0 in both cases. if (drumsAreOn) { … } is also the right guard before you read drumPhase. It changes only when the machine starts or stops, and reading it never starts anything. For the reason behind a false read OAVp5.drums.state: 'loading' while the module arrives, 'stopped' when the grid is up but not playing, 'error' when it could not load. It becomes true after startDrums() (or 🥁 in the 🎹 panel) has loaded the machine, usually within a fraction of a second. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumsAreOn keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.state === 'on' instead. True while the machine plays, false at the start, after stopDrums(), after an error and while the grid's own checkbox is unticked.

用它來分辨「鼓機沒在跑」和「鼓機剛好在第 0 格」：這兩種情況下 drumStep 都是 0。在讀 drumPhase 之前用 if (drumsAreOn) { … } 把關也很合適。它只有在鼓機開始或停止的時候才會變，讀它不會啟動任何東西。 false 的原因看 OAVp5.drums.state：模組還在下載是 'loading'，格子在但沒在播是 'stopped'，載入失敗是 'error'。 要先呼叫 startDrums()（或按 🎹 面板的 🥁），等鼓機載入完才會變成 true，通常不到一秒。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumsAreOn 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.state === 'on'。 鼓機在播的時候是 true，一開始、呼叫 stopDrums() 之後、出錯的時候、以及格子上自己的勾選框取消勾選的時候是 false。

The line over the grid and the cells edit each other, so the rhythm can change without your code: a click on a cell, a line typed into the card, ↶. rhythmChanged(src, how) tells the sketch, so it can show the line on the canvas (where a recording has it) or store it. It is also called once after startDrums(), a moment after the rhythm module has loaded, with how equal to 'code'. src The line of rhythm that plays now, for example 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'. A preset or a grid you drew comes as the line it is written as. how What changed it: 'code' (startDrums()), 'cell' (a click on a cell of the grid), 'type' (typed into the line on the card, or OAVp5.drums.edit()), 'undo' (↶ or OAVp5.drums.undo()) or 'menu' (a preset picked on the card).

格子上方的那一行字和格子本身會互相改寫，所以節奏可以在你的程式碼之外改變：點格子、在卡片上打字、按 ↶。rhythmChanged(src, how) 把這件事告訴草圖，讓它可以把那一行字畫在畫布上（錄影就錄得到），或是存起來。startDrums() 之後，節奏模組載入完的那一刻也會呼叫一次，這時 how 是 'code'。 src 現在播的那一行節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'。預設節奏或你自己畫的格子，會以它對應的那一行字給你。 how 是什麼改變了它：'code'（startDrums()）、'cell'（點了格子上的一格）、'type'（在卡片的那行字上打字，或用 OAVp5.drums.edit()）、'undo'（↶ 或 OAVp5.drums.undo()）、'menu'（在卡片上挑了一個預設節奏）。

Call it once in setup(): startDrums('breakbeat', 120). A grid of 16 steps by 4 lanes (kick, snare, hat, clap) appears at the top of the page, with the tempo and the bar it is in, and plays a synthesized drum kit (no sample files). The grid is part of the page, not of the canvas: a recording never shows it, so use drawRhythm() to draw the rhythm on the canvas. A click on a cell changes the beat, and 🥁 in the 🎹 panel starts and stops the machine with no code at all. The machine is also a clock and a source of events. Every hit calls drumHit() and the microphone's own functions (kickDetected(), snareDetected(), hatDetected(), beatDetected()), so a sketch written for the microphone moves over unchanged. drumStep, drumBar, drumPhase and beatPhase say where the machine is, and cue() lets you plan what happens at which bar. Calling it again while it plays changes the pattern or the tempo without restarting: startDrums(90) only changes the tempo, startDrums('latin') only the pattern. A line of rhythm is any text that is not a preset name. A word is a drum (bd kick, sd snare, hh hat, oh open hat, cp clap, rim, lt mt ht toms, cr crash, rd ride, cb cowbell), ~ is a rest, words separated by spaces share the bar evenly, [ ] groups, 4 repeats, , puts another line on top, takes one per bar and bd(3,8) spreads 3 hits over 8 steps. A mistake shows a card that points at the character and says how to fix it, and 'four on floor' plays meanwhile. A line copied from strudel.cc works too:…

在 setup() 裡呼叫一次：startDrums('breakbeat', 120)。頁面上方會出現 16 格 × 4 軌（大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手）的鼓機，旁邊有速度和目前的小節，用合成的鼓組發聲（沒有取樣檔）。這個鼓機是頁面的一部分，不在畫布上，所以錄影錄不到它，要把節奏畫進畫布請用 drawRhythm()。點格子可以改節奏，🎹 面板裡的 🥁 不用寫程式就能開關鼓機。 鼓機同時也是時鐘和事件的來源。每一下打擊都會呼叫 drumHit() 和麥克風用的那幾個函式（kickDetected()、snareDetected()、hatDetected()、beatDetected()），所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。drumStep、drumBar、drumPhase、beatPhase 告訴你鼓機走到哪，cue() 讓你事先安排哪一小節發生什麼。 機器播的時候再呼叫，是換節奏或換速度，不會重新開始：startDrums(90) 只改速度，startDrums('latin') 只換節奏。不是預設節奏名字的文字，都當成一行節奏來讀。一個字就是一種鼓（bd 大鼓、sd 小鼓、hh 鈸、oh 開鈸、cp 拍手、rim 鼓邊、lt mt ht 三種中鼓、cr 碎音鈸、rd 疊音鈸、cb 牛鈴），~ 是休息，用空白隔開的字平分一小節，[ ] 是一組，4 是重複四次，, 是疊上另一行， 是每小節輪流一個，bd(3,8) 是把 3 下打擊平均分在 8 格裡。寫錯的話會跳出一張卡片，指出是哪個字、怎麼改，這時先播 'four on floor'。 從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式也可以：startDrums('s("bd4, [~ sd]2").fast(2)')。s("…") 和 sound("…") 加上 .fast(n)、.slow(n) 會被讀進來，沒給速度的話 setcpm(110/4) 會設定速度，.bank(…) 會略過（oav-p5 用自己的鼓組），鏈裡其他的呼叫會跳一張卡片說目前還不支援，其餘照播。 呼叫之前不用準備什麼。計數、drumHit() 和其他 callback 馬上就開始，但瀏覽器要頁面上先有一次點擊或按鍵才讓頁面出聲，所以在那之前鼓是沒聲音的，過一會兒上方會出現卡片提醒你。 鼓的聲音不需要 startSound()：鼓機有自己的鼓組。MIDI 第 10 軌的打擊墊，在 startSound() 開著的時候打的就是同一組鼓。 卡片上的 – 可以把格子收起來，× 會停掉鼓機。分頁在背景的時候，鼓機照樣數、照樣播。載入選項 drums（lookahead 或 frame）和 drumlatency 可以調整時鐘。 pattern 要播什麼。預設節奏的名字（'four on floor'、'breakbeat'、'half time'、'latin'、'sparse'）。一行字寫的節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'，或從 strudel.cc 複製來的。你自己畫的格子 { kick: 'x...x...x...x...', snare, hat, clap }（x 或 1 是打擊，沒寫的軌道是靜音，{} 是只走時間、不出聲的時鐘）。只給一個數字，那個數字就是速度。不傳就維持現在播的（一開始是 'four on floor'）。 bpm 速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍（一拍是四格）。會被限制在 30 到 300 之間。不傳就維持現在的速度：一開始是 112，或是複製來的 Strudel 程式用…

The machine stops playing, the grid disappears and drumsAreOn becomes false. The numbers keep the last value they had: drumStep, drumBar and cueName stay where they were, and drumPhase and beatPhase hold still. startDrums() afterwards begins again from bar 1. It also works while the machine is still loading: the pending startDrums() then resolves to false. The × on the card does the same thing. A promise that is already resolved to false, the new state of the machine.

鼓機停止播放，格子消失，drumsAreOn 變成 false。各個數字停在最後的值：drumStep、drumBar 和 cueName 留在原來的地方，drumPhase 和 beatPhase 也停住不動。之後再呼叫 startDrums() 會從第 1 小節重新開始。 機器還在載入的時候呼叫也可以：還沒結束的 startDrums() 會 resolve 成 false。卡片上的 × 做的是同一件事。 一個已經 resolve 成 false 的 promise，false 就是鼓機的新狀態。

OAVp5.drums (also reachable as midi.drums) is what startDrums(), drumStep and the rest are built on. It holds the numbers (state, step, bar, count, bpm, phase, beatPhase), the rhythm (pattern, src, copyText, strudelUrl, history, edit(), undo()), the cues (cue(), cues, lastCue), a way to listen (on()), what the machine hears right now (now) and handles for the curious (machine, clock). start, stop and draw are the same as startDrums(), stopDrums() and drawRhythm(). For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, libraries (Hydra, for one), the console and debugging.

OAVp5.drums（也可以用 midi.drums 取得）是 startDrums()、drumStep 這些名稱的底層。它裡面有數字（state、step、bar、count、bpm、phase、beatPhase）、節奏（pattern、src、copyText、strudelUrl、history、edit()、undo()）、cue（cue()、cues、lastCue）、監聽的方法（on()）、鼓機此刻聽到的樣子（now），以及給好奇的人用的把手（machine、clock）。 start、stop、draw 跟 startDrums()、stopDrums()、drawRhythm() 是同一回事。一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、函式庫（例如 Hydra）、主控台和除錯用的。

Click cells, type a line, find a rhythm you like, and paste this into setup() to keep it. The tempo is the current one, rounded to two decimals. For example startDrums("bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8", 110). Read fresh each time; '' before the machine has loaded.
點格子、打字，找到喜歡的節奏之後，把這一行貼進 setup() 就能留住它。速度是現在的速度，四捨五入到小數點後兩位。 例如 startDrums("bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8", 110)。每次讀都是當下的值，鼓機載入之前是 ''。

Unlike startDrums(text), which plays 'four on floor' when the line has a mistake, edit() keeps the line that was playing and tells you why the new one failed, so a live-coding sketch can show the message. The line goes into OAVp5.drums.history and rhythmChanged() is called with how equal to 'type'. A mistake also shows the card that points at the character. The machine and the rhythm module must have loaded: call startDrums() first and give it a moment. text The line of rhythm, for example 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8', or a line copied from strudel.cc. { ok: true, error: null, text } when the line plays. { ok: false, error, text } when it has a mistake: error has code, index and length (where the bad word is in text), a message and a hint, and the last line that worked keeps playing. Before the machine has loaded: { ok: false, error: null }.

跟 startDrums(text) 不同：那一行有錯的時候，startDrums 會改播 'four on floor'，而 edit() 會讓原本那一行繼續播，並告訴你新的為什麼失敗，所以即時編碼的草圖可以把訊息顯示出來。這一行會進到 OAVp5.drums.history，rhythmChanged() 也會被呼叫，how 是 'type'。有錯的時候也會跳出卡片，指出是哪個字。 鼓機和節奏模組必須已經載入完成：先呼叫 startDrums()，再等一下。 text 一行節奏，例如 'bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8'，或是從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式。 這行節奏播起來了就回傳 { ok: true, error: null, text }。有錯的話回傳 { ok: false, error, text }：error 裡有 code、index 和 length（錯的那個字在 text 的位置）、message 和 hint，這時上一行能播的節奏繼續播。鼓機還沒載入的時候回傳 { ok: false, error: null }。

OAVp5.drums.undo() takes the last line off this list and plays it. Changes made by startDrums() are not recorded here, only the ones made on the card or with OAVp5.drums.edit(). The array is the machine's own, so treat it as read-only. Empty at the start, and at most 50 lines long. The line that plays now is not in it: that is OAVp5.drums.src.
OAVp5.drums.undo() 會把這份清單最後一行拿出來播。用 startDrums() 做的改變不會記在這裡，只有在卡片上做的，或用 OAVp5.drums.edit() 做的才會。這個陣列是鼓機自己的，請當成唯讀。 一開始是空的，最多保留 50 行。現在在播的那一行不在裡面，那一行是 OAVp5.drums.src。

It is what the card uses to light the word that sounds. Read it when you want the line and its lit words in one go, for example to draw the line on the canvas with the sounding word marked. Before the machine has loaded it answers with zeros and an empty text. A new object on every read. phase and beatPhase are drumPhase and beatPhase. tokens is a list of { start, end }: the places in text of the words that sound now. mode is 'string' for a line of rhythm and 'grid' for a preset or a grid you drew. text is the line.

卡片就是用它讓正在響的字亮起來。想一次拿到那一行字和亮著的字的時候讀它，例如把那一行字畫在畫布上，並標出正在響的字。鼓機載入之前，它給的是零和空的 text。 每次讀都是一個新的物件。phase 和 beatPhase 就是 drumPhase 和 beatPhase。tokens 是 { start, end } 的清單，標出 text 裡現在正在響的那幾個字的位置。mode 在播一行節奏時是 'string'，預設節奏或你自己畫的格子是 'grid'。text 是那一行字。

The functions you define (drumHit, barStarted …) are one listener each. on() is for the cases where that does not fit: several listeners for one event, a library or a Hydra sketch that has no drumHit() of its own, a listener you want to remove again. It is the same idea as midi.on(). An error thrown inside fn is printed and the other listeners still run. name What to listen to: 'hit' (like drumHit()), 'step' (like stepStarted()), 'bar' (like barStarted()), 'cue' (like cueFired()) or 'rhythm' (like rhythmChanged()). Any other name throws an error that lists them. fn Called with the same arguments as the function it matches: (lane, velocity), (step, bar), (bar), (name, bar) or (src, how). A function: call it to stop listening.

你定義的函式（drumHit、barStarted ……）每種事件只能有一個。on() 是給不適用的情況：同一個事件要有好幾個監聽者、函式庫或 Hydra 草圖沒有自己的 drumHit()、或是想把監聽者再拿掉。概念跟 midi.on() 一樣。fn 裡丟出的錯誤會被印出來，其他監聽者照樣執行。 name 要監聽什麼：'hit'（像 drumHit()）、'step'（像 stepStarted()）、'bar'（像 barStarted()）、'cue'（像 cueFired()）、'rhythm'（像 rhythmChanged()）。其他的名字會丟出錯誤，並列出這幾個。 fn 被呼叫的時候帶的參數跟對應的函式一樣：(lane, velocity)、(step, bar)、(bar)、(name, bar) 或 (src, how)。 一個函式，呼叫它就停止監聽。

After startDrums('breakbeat') it is 'breakbeat', after startDrums({ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }) it is 'custom', and after startDrums('bd4, hh8') it is that line. A click on a cell of a preset makes it 'custom'. To get the line of rhythm in every case, read OAVp5.drums.src: a preset also has one. 'four on floor' until you choose another. It follows what plays, including clicks on the grid.

startDrums('breakbeat') 之後是 'breakbeat'，startDrums({ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }) 之後是 'custom'，startDrums('bd4, hh8') 之後就是那一行字。在預設節奏的格子上點一下，它就變成 'custom'。想在每一種情況下都拿到那一行節奏，請讀 OAVp5.drums.src：預設節奏也有對應的那一行。 在你選別的之前是 'four on floor'。它跟著正在播的東西走，包括在格子上點的修改。

Show it on the canvas so a recording has it (text(OAVp5.drums.src, 20, 30)), or keep it to come back to the rhythm later with startDrums(src). rhythmChanged() tells you when it changes, and OAVp5.drums.copyText is the same line wrapped in a startDrums("…") call. It is '' until startDrums() has loaded the machine and the rhythm module, a fraction of a second. Read fresh each time. A preset or a grid you drew shows as the line it is written as, and it changes with every click on a cell and every typed edit.

把它畫在畫布上，錄影就錄得到（text(OAVp5.drums.src, 20, 30)），或是存起來，之後用 startDrums(src) 回到這個節奏。它改變的時候 rhythmChanged() 會通知你，OAVp5.drums.copyText 則是同一行字外面包上 startDrums("…")。 在 startDrums() 載入鼓機和節奏模組之前都是 ''，大約不到一秒。 每次讀都是當下的值。預設節奏或你自己畫的格子，會顯示成它對應的那一行字，每點一次格子、每改一次文字，它就跟著變。

'loading' is the moment after startDrums() while the module arrives, 'on' is playing, 'stopped' is a grid that is up but not playing (its checkbox is unticked), 'off' is where it starts and where stopDrums() leaves it, and 'error' means @openav/drums could not be loaded. drumsAreOn is state === 'on'. Starts as 'off' and changes when the machine loads, plays, is stopped or fails.

'loading' 是呼叫 startDrums() 之後，模組還在下載的那段時間，'on' 是正在播，'stopped' 是格子還在但沒在播（它的勾選框取消勾選了），'off' 是起點，也是 stopDrums() 之後的狀態，'error' 表示 @openav/drums 載入失敗。drumsAreOn 就是 state === 'on'。 一開始是 'off'，鼓機載入、播放、停止或失敗的時候就跟著變。

It holds the line as s("…") with setcpm(bpm/4) (one bar here is one Strudel cycle of four beats), the same thing the "Open in Strudel" link on the card opens. Open it in a new tab: window.open(OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl) from a click handler. A https://strudel.cc/#… address, read fresh each time. '' before the machine has loaded.
裡面是那一行節奏，寫成 s("…")，再加上 setcpm(bpm/4)（這裡的一小節就是 Strudel 的一個週期，四拍），跟卡片上「在 Strudel 打開」連結開啟的是同一個東西。用新分頁打開它：在點擊的處理函式裡寫 window.open(OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl)。 一個 https://strudel.cc/#… 的網址，每次讀都是當下的。鼓機載入之前是 ''。

The line before the current one is played again and removed from the history. rhythmChanged() is called with how equal to 'undo'. On the card the same thing is ⌘Z or Ctrl+Z after touching it. true if it went back one line, false if OAVp5.drums.history was empty or the machine is not loaded.
上一行會再播一次，並從歷史清單裡拿掉。rhythmChanged() 會被呼叫，how 是 'undo'。在卡片上，點一下卡片之後按 ⌘Z 或 Ctrl+Z 也是同樣的事。 回到上一行就是 true，OAVp5.drums.history 是空的、或鼓機還沒載入就是 false。

It follows the small engine contract of @openav/sound, so the same shell and the same signals drive it: enable() makes the AudioContext, noteOn(note, vel01, time) plays a drum, set(key, value) sets a param. The kit has thirteen voices (see GM): kick, rim, snare, clap, low tom, hat, pedal hat, tom, open hat, high tom, crash, ride and cowbell. A note the kit does not know (any melodic note) plays nothing and returns null. noteOn(note, vel01, time) returns { time, cancel() }, or null before enable() or for a note it does not play. time is on the kit's own clock (engine.context.currentTime); left out, or already past, the hit sounds now. cancel() silences a hit that has not started, which is how DrumTransport takes back what it scheduled when the tempo changes. hit('crash', 0.9) plays a voice by name (or a note number) for code that is not a MIDI pad. There is one param, kitVolume, from −30 to 0 dB (default −6). Once enabled, engine.context is its AudioContext and engine.output is the node that goes to the speakers, which a recorder can tap. Before that both are null. noteOff() does nothing (drums ring out) and dispose() closes the context. await kit.enable() from a click: browsers start audio only after a user gesture. mountDrums() and DrumTransport with autoEnable do that for you on the first hit. samples Play audio files instead of the synthesis: { 36: 'kick.wav', 38: 'snare.wav' }, MIDI note number to URL. They are fetched and decoded by enable(); a file that fails to load…

它遵守 @openav/sound 的小小引擎約定，所以同一個外殼、同樣的訊號都能驅動它：enable() 建立 AudioContext，noteOn(note, vel01, time) 打一下鼓，set(key, value) 設定參數。鼓組有十三種鼓聲（見 GM）：大鼓、鼓邊、小鼓、拍手、落地鼓、鈸、踩鈸、中鼓、開鈸、高音中鼓、碎音鈸、疊音鈸、牛鈴。鼓組不認得的音符（任何旋律音符）不會發聲，並回傳 null。 noteOn(note, vel01, time) 回傳 { time, cancel() }，在 enable() 之前，或遇到它不打的音符時回傳 null。time 是鼓組自己的時鐘（engine.context.currentTime）上的時間。沒給，或已經過了，這一下就馬上響。cancel() 能讓還沒開始的鼓靜音，DrumTransport 在速度改變時就是用它把排好的收回來。hit('crash', 0.9) 用名字（或音符號碼）打一種鼓，給不是 MIDI 墊子的程式用。它有一個參數 kitVolume，從 −30 到 0 dB（預設 −6）。 啟用之後，engine.context 是它的 AudioContext，engine.output 是接到喇叭的節點，錄音器可以從這裡接。在那之前兩個都是 null。noteOff() 什麼都不做（鼓聲自己響完），dispose() 會關掉 context。 要在點擊裡 await kit.enable()：瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作才讓聲音開始。mountDrums() 和 autoEnable 的 DrumTransport 會在第一下鼓的時候替你做。 samples 用音檔取代合成：{ 36: 'kick.wav', 38: 'snare.wav' }，MIDI 音符號碼對應網址。enable() 會去下載並解碼。載入失敗的檔案會被略過、不報錯，屬於鼓組的音符就改用合成的聲音打。 一個引擎：{ params, context, output, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), hit(what, vel01, time), noteOff(), set(key, value), dispose() }。

The drum names inside code stay English everywhere ('kick', 'snare'), and this is for the screen: the row labels of the drum machine card use it, and with 'zh' they are written in Chinese. voice The drum: kick, snare, hat, clap, openhat, pedalhat, rim, lowtom, tom, hightom, crash, ride or cowbell. lang 'zh' for Chinese; anything else is English. The name, or voice itself if it is not a drum of the kit.

程式裡的鼓的名字到處都保持英文（'kick'、'snare'），這個函式是給畫面顯示用的：鼓機卡的列標籤就是用它，中文的瀏覽器裡是 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍手。 voice 哪種鼓：kick、snare、hat、clap、openhat、pedalhat、rim、lowtom、tom、hightom、crash、ride、cowbell。 lang 'zh' 是中文。其他都是英文。 名字。如果 voice 不是鼓組的鼓，就原樣回傳 voice。

A DrumScheduler knows what plays in which bar, and when a bar happens, but it owns no clock: every time you give it is in seconds on one clock of your choosing, so it runs the same under a fake clock in a test as under the audio clock in a page. DrumTransport is the runtime that feeds it the real one. Use the scheduler on its own when you want drum events as data, for your own sound engine or a test. The loop is: start(at) puts the downbeat of bar 1 at time at. Then, again and again, advance(now) schedules everything up to now + lookahead and returns the new events, in order. due(t) hands out the events whose time has come (they stay in queue until then). Two kinds of event come out: a step { kind: 'step', i, n, bar, pos, time } for every 16th, and a hit { kind: 'hit', voice, vel, pos, n, bar, token, word, layer, dur, time }. pos counts bars from the start (0 is the downbeat of bar 1, 1.5 is half way through bar 2), time is in your seconds, i is the step 0..15 and n counts steps since the start. For a grid, the step comes before its hits. token, word, layer and dur come from a line of rhythm and are null or undefined for a grid. Positions turn into seconds by multiplication from the last tempo anchor, never by adding up frame times, so a thousand bars later nothing has drifted (the test measures under a microsecond). A tempo change adds an anchor, so the past keeps the tempo it had. bpm The tempo, in beats per minute. A value that is not above 0 becomes 112. swing 0 to 0.5:…

DrumScheduler 知道哪個小節要打什麼，也知道一個小節在什麼時候發生，但它沒有自己的時鐘：你給它的每個時間，都是你選的某一個時鐘上的秒數，所以它在測試裡用假時鐘跑、在頁面裡用音訊時鐘跑，結果一樣。DrumTransport 是把真的時鐘餵給它的執行環境。想把鼓的事件當資料用，例如給自己的發聲引擎或測試，就單獨用排程器。 流程是這樣：start(at) 讓第 1 小節的強拍落在時間 at。然後一再地呼叫 advance(now)，它排好直到 now + lookahead 的全部，並依序回傳新的事件。due(t) 把時間到了的事件交出來（在那之前它們留在 queue 裡）。事件有兩種：每個十六分音符一個步 { kind: 'step', i, n, bar, pos, time }，和一下鼓 { kind: 'hit', voice, vel, pos, n, bar, token, word, layer, dur, time }。pos 從開始算起以小節為單位（0 是第 1 小節的強拍，1.5 是第 2 小節的一半），time 是你的時鐘的秒數，i 是步 0..15，n 是從開始算起的步數。格子圖的話，步在它的鼓之前。token、word、layer、dur 來自一行節奏，格子圖的話是 null 或 undefined。 位置是從最近一個速度錨點用乘法換成秒的，不是把畫面時間加起來，所以一千個小節之後也沒有漂移（測試量到的誤差不到一微秒）。速度改變會多加一個錨點，所以過去保持它當時的速度。 bpm 速度，每分鐘幾拍。不大於 0 的值會變成 112。 swing 0 到 0.5：每個奇數的十六分音符晚那麼多個十六分音符。0 是直的。 humanize 0..1：晚幾毫秒、力道有一點大小變化，讓它有律動而不是機械的滴答。要精準、可重複的時間就用 0。 lookahead advance() 在 now 之後多排幾秒。 pattern PATTERNS 裡的預設名稱、你自己的格子圖，或編譯過的一行節奏（見 setPattern()）。 seed 當作 eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) 交給那一行節奏，讓每個 ? 每次都做同樣的決定。 random humanize 的隨機從哪裡來：回傳 0 到 1 之間數字的函式。傳自己的就能得到可重複的結果。

It is the simplest clock: no audio, no timers, no DOM. Make it with an onHit that does something, call toggle(true), then call update(dt) once per frame with the seconds since the last frame. It walks through the 16 steps of a bar (a 16th lasts 60 / bpm / 4 seconds) and calls onHit(lane, velocity) for each hit in the four lanes kick, snare, hat and clap. A hit is told in the frame in which it is due, so it can be late by up to a frame, and nothing happens in a hidden tab. For a steady beat under a heavy frame, use DrumTransport. The grid is seq.grid: { kick: [0|1 × 16], snare, hat, clap }. seq.pattern is the preset name, or 'custom' once you changed a cell or gave your own grid. seq.playing, seq.bpm, seq.swing and seq.humanize are plain properties you can read and set. onHit onHit(lane, velocity) for every hit: lane is 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' or 'clap', velocity is 0.15 to 1. You decide what a hit does: play a sound, draw, publish a signal. onStep onStep(i, n) for every 16th step: i is 0..15, n counts steps since the start. It comes before that step's hits. A timeline counts bars on it. bpm The tempo, in beats per minute. It can be changed later: seq.bpm = 90. swing 0 to 0.5: every odd 16th is that share of a 16th late. 0 is straight. humanize 0..1: some hits a few milliseconds late and a little softer or louder. Use 0 for exact, repeatable velocities (0.9 on the beat, 0.6 between). pattern A preset name from PATTERNS or your own grid.

這是最簡單的時鐘：沒有聲音、沒有計時器、沒有 DOM。做一個會做事的 onHit，呼叫 toggle(true)，然後每個畫面用距離上一個畫面過了幾秒呼叫 update(dt)。它會走過一個小節的 16 步（一個十六分音符是 60 / bpm / 4 秒），每一下 kick、snare、hat、clap 四條軌道上的鼓就呼叫 onHit(lane, velocity)。鼓是在到時間的那個畫面才被告知，所以最多會晚一個畫面，分頁被藏起來的時候什麼都不會發生。要在畫面很重的時候也有穩的節拍，用 DrumTransport。 格子圖是 seq.grid：{ kick: [0|1 × 16], snare, hat, clap }。seq.pattern 是預設的名稱，改過格子或給了自己的格子圖之後就是 'custom'。seq.playing、seq.bpm、seq.swing、seq.humanize 都是可以直接讀和設的普通屬性。 onHit 每一下鼓呼叫 onHit(lane, velocity)：lane 是 'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'clap'，velocity 是 0.15 到 1。一下鼓要做什麼由你決定：發聲、畫圖、發布訊號。 onStep 每個十六分音符步呼叫 onStep(i, n)：i 是 0..15，n 是從開始算起的步數。它在那一步的鼓之前。時間軸靠它數小節。 bpm 速度，每分鐘幾拍。之後可以改：seq.bpm = 90。 swing 0 到 0.5：每個奇數的十六分音符晚那麼多個十六分音符。0 是直的。 humanize 0..1：有些鼓晚幾毫秒、力道有一點大小。要精準、可重複的力道就用 0（拍點上 0.9，其他 0.6）。 pattern PATTERNS 裡的預設名稱，或你自己的格子圖。

A page that plays a hit in the frame it is due is late by up to a frame, and silent when its tab is hidden. DrumTransport fixes both. A timer (the heartbeat, from a Web Worker, 25 ms by default) looks 0.1 seconds ahead on the kit's own audio clock and hands the kit every hit with its exact start time. The page is told separately, in the frame in which each step and hit is heard: its time plus the output latency the browser reports. So the beat stays steady under a heavy draw() and in a hidden tab, and the callbacks still arrive in order: a step before its hits, hits in time order. Call start(), then frame() once per animation frame. The heartbeat calls pump() for you. Tempo and pattern changes (setBpm(), setPattern(), toggleCell()) take back what was already handed over after now and make it again, so no hit is doubled or lost. Before the kit's AudioContext runs (no click yet) the clock runs on now() and the callbacks run but nothing sounds; once it runs, the hits from then on sound, and none from before. A hidden page, or a frame loop that catches up more than stale seconds late, tells its steps quietly: ev.quiet is true, the clock moves and cues fire, but onHit is not called, and of several bar starts at once only the last has ev.announce. Nothing floods the page when the tab comes back. If a draw() ever holds the thread longer than the lookahead, the lookahead grows to 0.3 seconds (info().extended). It has the getters playing, pattern, grid, mode, text, bpm, swing,…

在到時間的那個畫面才打的鼓，最多會晚一個畫面，分頁被藏起來的時候還會停。DrumTransport 兩個都解決。一個計時器（心跳，預設用 Web Worker，每 25 毫秒一次）在鼓組自己的音訊時鐘上往前看 0.1 秒，把每一下鼓連同確切的開始時間交給鼓組。頁面則是另外被通知，在每一步、每一下被聽到的那個畫面：它的時間加上瀏覽器回報的輸出延遲。所以畫面很重或分頁被藏起來，節拍還是穩的，回呼也依然按順序到：一步在它的鼓之前，鼓依時間排序。 呼叫 start()，然後每個動畫畫面呼叫一次 frame()。心跳會替你呼叫 pump()。速度和節奏的改變（setBpm()、setPattern()、toggleCell()）會把現在之後已經交出去的收回來重做，所以不會有鼓重複或漏掉。鼓組的 AudioContext 還沒跑（還沒點擊）的時候，時鐘用 now() 跑，回呼照常執行但沒有聲音。開始跑之後，從那之後的鼓才會響，之前的不補。 頁面被藏起來，或畫面迴圈追趕時已經晚了超過 stale 秒的時候，步會被安靜地告知：ev.quiet 是 true，時鐘照走、cue 照發，但 onHit 不會被呼叫，而且同時到的好幾個小節開頭，只有最後一個有 ev.announce。分頁回來的時候不會一下子湧進一大堆。如果某個 draw() 佔住執行緒的時間比預讀還長，預讀會增加到 0.3 秒（info().extended）。 它有它的排程器的 getter：playing、pattern、grid、mode、text、bpm、swing、humanize、lookahead。bpm、swing、humanize 也可以設定。通常是透過 clock: 'lookahead' 的 mountDrums() 拿到一個。想要時鐘而不要卡片的時候再自己建。 scheduler 決定什麼時候打什麼的 DrumScheduler。 engine 發聲的引擎，通常是 drumEngine()。它有 context 這個屬性（一個 AudioContext，啟用之前是 null）的話，鼓點就用那個時鐘提前排程。沒有的話，每一下鼓就在聽到的那一刻呼叫 engine.noteOn(note, vel) 來打。 onStep onStep(i, n, ev)，每個十六分音符步在聽到的時候呼叫。ev.quiet 和 ev.announce 說明它是不是被安靜地告知（見下面）。 onHit onHit(voice, vel, ev)，每一下鼓在聽到的時候呼叫。 onLate onLate(margin, transport)：因為頁面佔住主執行緒的時間比預讀還長，有一下鼓交給鼓組的時候已經過了它的時間。margin 是它早了幾秒（負的或很小）。 autoEnable 引擎還沒有 AudioContext 的話，在 start() 時呼叫 engine.enable()。 now 回傳目前時間（秒）的函式。測試時傳自己的，就能用假的時鐘帶動傳輸控制。 hidden 沒有人看得到頁面時回傳 true 的函式。 heartbeat 誰來呼叫 pump()：'auto' 是 Web Worker 的計時器（被藏起來的分頁不會讓 worker 變慢），不行就退回 setInterval。'interval' 一律用 setInterval。false（或 'none'）是沒人叫，你自己呼叫 pump() 或 frame()。 tick 兩次心跳之間隔幾秒。 latency…

Drum pads and drum machines send these notes on MIDI channel 10. The drum machine sends them as midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 } for every hit, so anything that listens to MIDI hears the drums. The reverse, from a note to a drum, is voiceForNote(), which also knows the neighbouring General MIDI notes (35 is also a kick, 40 is also a snare). { kick: 36, rim: 37, snare: 38, clap: 39, lowtom: 41, hat: 42, pedalhat: 44, tom: 45, openhat: 46, hightom: 48, crash: 49, ride: 51, cowbell: 56 }: drum name to MIDI note number.

打擊墊和鼓機在 MIDI 頻道 10 送這些音符。鼓機每打一下就送一個 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 }，所以任何聽 MIDI 的東西都聽得到鼓。從音符反查是哪種鼓用 voiceForNote()，它也認得 General MIDI 相鄰的音符（35 也是大鼓，40 也是小鼓）。 { kick: 36, rim: 37, snare: 38, clap: 39, lowtom: 41, hat: 42, pedalhat: 44, tom: 45, openhat: 46, hightom: 48, crash: 49, ride: 51, cowbell: 56 }：鼓的名字對應 MIDI 音符號碼。

It is how every grid you write is read: { kick: 'x...x...x...x...' } in DrumSequencer, DrumScheduler and startDrums(). 'x... x... x... x...' and '1000100010001000' are the same lane. Note that the dot is a rest here, and only here: in a line of rhythm (see compile()) a rest is ~. v The lane. In text, x, X and 1 are hits and everything else is a rest; spaces and | are ignored, so they can help the eye. In a list, 1 and true are hits. An array of 16 numbers, 1 for a hit and 0 for a rest. A short lane is padded with rests, a long one is cut at 16.

你寫的每一張格子圖都是這樣被讀的：DrumSequencer、DrumScheduler 和 startDrums() 裡的 { kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }。'x... x... x... x...' 和 '1000100010001000' 是同一條軌道。注意點在這裡是休止，只有在這裡：一行節奏（見 compile()）裡的休止是 ~。 v 軌道。文字的話，x、X、1 是鼓點，其他都是休止。空白和 | 會被忽略，可以用來幫助眼睛。陣列的話，1 和 true 是鼓點。 一個 16 個數字的陣列，1 是鼓點、0 是休止。太短的軌道用休止補滿，太長的在第 16 格截掉。

mountDrums(el, { signals }) builds a drum machine card inside el: a play checkbox, a preset menu, a tempo slider, the bar it is in, and a grid with a lane per drum (kick, snare, hat, clap, and a row of their own for the crash, ride, toms and open hat that a line of rhythm uses). A click on a cell toggles it. The returned object lets you do from code what the card does with the mouse: play(true), setPattern('breakbeat'), setBpm(96). You must call drums.update(dt) every frame, with the seconds since the last one. It moves the machine (with the frame clock), tells your onStep and onHit what is heard, paints the grid and lets the drum//env signals decay. A machine that is never updated does not move. Hits travel the same road as a drummer heard through the microphone, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over unchanged: drum/kick, drum/snare, drum/hat, drum/clap as pulses with { level }, drum//env as continuous 0..1 values, and midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 } with the General MIDI drum note (see GM). A voice a line of rhythm adds, like drum/crash, is defined the first time it is hit. Give it the pattern module (rhythm) and the line of rhythm is always shown over the grid: a preset shows the line its grid is ('four on floor' is bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8), and the word that sounds lights up. Then the two edit each other. A click on a cell rewrites the line (with fromGrid()). Typing in the line changes the cells: Enter, or 400 ms without a key, plays what was typed. A mistake…

mountDrums(el, { signals }) 在 el 裡蓋一張鼓機卡：播放勾選框、預設選單、速度滑桿、現在在第幾小節，和一個每種鼓一條軌道的格子（大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手，一行節奏用到的碎音鈸、疊音鈸、中鼓、開鈸各有自己的一列）。點一個格子就切換它。回傳的物件讓你用程式做卡片上用滑鼠做的事：play(true)、setPattern('breakbeat')、setBpm(96)。 每個畫面都要呼叫 drums.update(dt)，參數是距離上一個畫面過了幾秒。它讓鼓機前進（用 frame 時鐘的時候）、把聽到的事告訴你的 onStep 和 onHit、畫格子，並讓 drum//env 訊號衰減。從來不更新的鼓機不會動。 鼓點走的路跟麥克風聽到的鼓手一樣，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成它：drum/kick、drum/snare、drum/hat、drum/clap 是帶 { level } 的脈衝，drum//env 是 0..1 的連續值，還有 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 }，音符是 General MIDI 的鼓音符（見 GM）。一行節奏多出來的鼓，像 drum/crash，會在第一次被打到的時候才定義。 把鼓的模組（rhythm）交給它，格子上面就一直有那一行節奏：預設會顯示它的格子圖是哪一行（'four on floor' 就是 bd4, [~ sd]2, hh8），正在響的字會亮起來。接著兩邊互相修改。點一個格子會改寫那一行（用 fromGrid()）。在那一行打字會改變格子：按 Enter，或停手 400 毫秒，就播放打進去的內容。有錯的地方標紅、通知 onEditError，上一行能用的繼續打。按 Escape 丟掉還沒播的。每次改動都存在 history。卡上的 ↶，或碰過卡片之後按 Cmd/Ctrl+Z，退一步。Copy 把那一行放進剪貼簿，Open in Strudel 在新分頁的 strudel.cc 打開它（strudelUrl()）。 回傳的物件提供這些： 需要有 DOM 的頁面，而且每個畫面都要呼叫 update(dt)。聲音要等瀏覽器：鼓組的 AudioContext 在第一下鼓（用 lookahead 時鐘的話是 play()）的時候才建立，頁面被點一下之前它都是暫停的。回呼和訊號從一開始就會跑。聲音在第一次點擊之後才進來，點擊之前的鼓不會補打。 用 clock: 'frame' 的時候，編譯過的一行只有第一小節會在四條軌道、十六格的格子上打：落在格子之間的鼓點會移到最近的一格，沒有軌道的鼓（碎音鈸、疊音鈸、中鼓、開鈸）會被略過，console 會說一聲。clock: 'lookahead' 則照寫的樣子打。 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己呼叫：startDrums() 會替你蓋這張卡，用 lookahead 時鐘，並且每個畫面幫你呼叫 update()。 container 要放鼓機卡的元素。dispose() 會把它拆掉。 signals 一個 Signals 匯流排。每一下鼓都會發布成 drum/（脈衝 { level }）、drum//env（0..1，會衰減）和 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 10 }。沒給的話鼓機照樣會打、會呼叫你的函式，但什麼都不發布。 engine 發聲的引擎。沒給的話，鼓機自己做一個 drumEngine()。任何有 enable() 和 noteOn(note, vel01, time)…

The preset names are what startDrums(), DrumSequencer and mountDrums() accept as a pattern. A preset is just data, so you can start from one: { ...PATTERNS.latin, clap: 'x...x...x...x...' } is latin with a clap on every beat. The five presets as text, one lane per column: Five presets, each { kick, snare, hat, clap } as 16-character strings of 1 and 0.

預設的名稱就是 startDrums()、DrumSequencer、mountDrums() 的 pattern 收的值。預設就只是資料，所以你可以從其中一個開始改：{ ...PATTERNS.latin, clap: 'x...x...x...x...' } 就是在 latin 上每一拍加一下拍手。 五個預設的內容，一欄一條軌道： 五個預設，每個都是 { kick, snare, hat, clap }，各是 16 個字的 1 和 0。

Pads and drum machines send notes on channel 10, and several notes map to the same drum: 35 and 36 are kicks, 38 and 40 snares, 41 and 43 low toms, 45 and 47 toms, 48 and 50 high toms, 49, 52, 55 and 57 crashes, 51, 53 and 59 rides. A note that is not in the table, such as a melodic 60, gives null: the kit stays silent instead of guessing, because a wrong cymbal on a kick pad is worse than nothing. note A MIDI note number. The drum name ('kick', 'crash'…), or null.

打擊墊和鼓機在頻道 10 送音符，好幾個音符會對到同一種鼓：35 和 36 是大鼓，38 和 40 是小鼓，41 和 43 是落地鼓，45 和 47 是中鼓，48 和 50 是高音中鼓，49、52、55、57 是碎音鈸，51、53、59 是疊音鈸。不在表裡的音符，像旋律用的 60，會回傳 null：鼓組寧可不出聲也不亂猜，因為大鼓的打擊墊打出錯的鈸，比沒聲音還糟。 note MIDI 音符號碼。 鼓的名字（'kick'、'crash'…），或 null。

compile() is the one function you need to turn a line of rhythm into hits. compile('bd sd hh').eventsInBar(1) answers "what happens in bar 1?" with a list of hits, sorted by pos. Bars count from 1, and one bar is one cycle of the line: the words share the bar equally, so bd sd hh puts a kick at 0, a snare at 1/3 and a hat at 2/3. Each hit from eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) is { word, voice, n, pos, dur, vel, layer, token }. word is what was written, voice the drum it plays ('kick'), pos where in the bar, 0 up to (not including) 1. dur is how long it lasts, in bars, and may run past the bar (bd/2 lasts two). vel is always 1. layer is the index of the comma part it came from. token is { start, end }, the character range of the word in src, so you can light the word while it sounds. n is the sample number from bd:2, or null. n is kept for you but does not change the sound. It never throws. A line it cannot read comes back as { ok: false, error }, and eventsInBar() returns [] for every bar, so check ok before you trust the hits. error.index and error.length mark the characters that are wrong, error.message and error.hint are English sentences, and error.code is one of empty, unclosed, unexpected, bad-number, bad-euclid, unknown-word or unsupported. An unknown-word error also carries suggestion, the closest word or null. The words and the symbols you can write are listed below. Modifiers chain in the order written (bd(3,8)2, hh8?). Word case does not matter (BD is bd). ? is decided…

要把一行節奏變成鼓點，用 compile() 就夠了。compile('bd sd hh').eventsInBar(1) 回答「第 1 小節發生什麼事」，給你一串按 pos 排好的鼓點。小節從 1 開始數，一個小節就是這一行的一個循環：字平分這個小節，所以 bd sd hh 是大鼓在 0、小鼓在 1/3、鈸在 2/3。 eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) 給的每個鼓點是 { word, voice, n, pos, dur, vel, layer, token }。word 是寫的字，voice 是它打的鼓（'kick'），pos 是在小節的哪裡，從 0 到（不含）1。dur 是持續多久，單位是小節，可以超過這個小節（bd/2 長兩個小節）。vel 永遠是 1。layer 是它來自第幾個逗號層。token 是 { start, end }，這個字在 src 裡的字元範圍，字在響的時候可以拿來點亮它。n 是 bd:2 的取樣編號，沒寫就是 null。n 會保留給你，但不會改變聲音。 它不會丟出錯誤。讀不懂的一行會回傳 { ok: false, error }，而且每個小節的 eventsInBar() 都回傳 []，所以相信鼓點之前先檢查 ok。error.index 和 error.length 標出錯的字元，error.message 和 error.hint 是英文句子，error.code 是 empty、unclosed、unexpected、bad-number、bad-euclid、unknown-word、unsupported 其中之一。unknown-word 錯誤還會帶 suggestion，也就是最接近的字，沒有就是 null。可以寫的字和符號列在下面。 修飾符號照寫的順序一個接一個（bd(3,8)2、hh8?）。字的大小寫不影響（BD 就是 bd）。? 由 seed 和鼓點的時間決定，所以同一個 seed、同一個小節永遠打出一樣的鼓點，換一個小節或換一個 seed 就不同。不支援，並會用 unsupported 錯誤和提示拒絕的有：.（Strudel 的分組）、|、{ }、%、..、^。其中最重要的是點：像 'x...x...' 這種軌道字串不是一行節奏，休止要寫 ~。 內部的時間用精確的分數，每個小節各自計算。[bd sd sn]3 的第 1 000 000 小節跟第 1 小節落在一模一樣的九分之幾，問第 500 小節跟問第 2 小節一樣便宜。 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己呼叫：startDrums() 收下這一行，會替你編譯。想把鼓點當資料用，例如畫譜、畫圖或寫測試的時候，才自己呼叫 compile()。 這種寫法來自 TidalCycles 和 Strudel，這個套件是依他們的公開文件獨立實作的。刻意跟 strudel.cc 不同的地方（旋轉 n 格以上會繞回來、0 和 (9,8) 是錯誤、不認識的字是錯誤），套件的 README 都有寫。 src 一行節奏，例如 'bd sd hh'。不是字串的東西會被轉成字串（null 和 undefined 變成空的一行，那是錯誤）。 words 哪個字代表哪一種鼓：{ 字: 鼓聲 }。預設是 WORDS。要多加一個字，就把預設展開：{ ...WORDS, boom: 'kick' }。鼓聲要是鼓組會打的，見 GM。 { ok, error, src, voices, layers, period, eventsInBar(bar, { seed })…

It is the function behind bd(3,8) in a line of rhythm: compile() calls it for every (k,n). Use it on its own when you want the pattern as data, for a drawing or your own sequencer. euclid(3, 8) is x..x..x., and euclid(5, 8) is x.xx.xx.. It follows Bjorklund's procedure as Toussaint (2005) describes it. rotate moves the pattern later, the direction strudel.cc plays: euclid(3, 8, 2) is x.x..x.., the hits of euclid(3, 8) moved two steps to the right. pulses How many hits. A negative number plays the gaps instead: euclid(-3, 8) is the five steps euclid(3, 8) leaves out. More hits than steps fills every step. The number is cut to a whole number. steps How many steps. Fewer than 1 gives an empty array. rotate Start the pattern this many steps later. Negative starts earlier, and a number of steps or more wraps around. An array of steps booleans, true where there is a hit.

一行節奏裡的 bd(3,8) 就是靠它：compile() 每遇到一個 (k,n) 就會呼叫它。想把這個節奏當資料用，例如畫圖或接到自己的音序器，就單獨呼叫它。euclid(3, 8) 是 x..x..x.，euclid(5, 8) 是 x.xx.xx.。 它照 Toussaint（2005）說明的 Bjorklund 方法做。rotate 把節奏往後移，方向跟 strudel.cc 一樣：euclid(3, 8, 2) 是 x.x..x..，也就是 euclid(3, 8) 的鼓點往右移兩格。 pulses 有幾下。負數會打空隙：euclid(-3, 8) 是 euclid(3, 8) 沒打的那五格。比格數多的話，每一格都會打。小數會被去掉。 steps 有幾格。小於 1 會得到空陣列。 rotate 讓節奏晚這麼多格開始。負數是提早，steps 以上的數字會繞回來。 一個長度 steps 的布林陣列，有鼓點的地方是 true。

It is what happens when you click a cell of the drum machine card: the grid has to come back as text. Each lane becomes one layer, joined with , , and it picks the shortest honest spelling. Steady hits become bd4 or hh8, one hit per group [~ sd]2, a Euclidean rhythm bd(3,8), and anything else is written beat by beat, like bd [~ ~ ~ bd] bd2 ~. It never throws. The line is exact: compile() of the result lands on the same steps, in every bar. The rules are in the package README, and the tests check a thousand random grids. grid The steps: { lane: 'x...x...' } or { lane: [1, 0, 0, 0, …] }. A lane is named by its drum (kick) or its word (bd). x, X, 1 and true are hits, | and spaces are ignored. A lane with no name the kit knows is left out. steps How many steps each lane has. words Keep your own spelling: { kick: 'kick' } writes kick4 instead of bd4. order Drums to put first, in this order, for example ['kick', 'snare']. The rest follow in the order of the grid's keys. One line of rhythm that plays exactly the grid. A grid with no hit anywhere gives '~'.

按下鼓機卡上的一個格子，就是在做這件事：格子圖要變回文字。每條軌道變成一層，用 , 接起來，並選最短又準確的寫法。平穩的鼓點寫成 bd4 或 hh8，每組一下寫成 [~ sd]2，歐幾里得節奏寫成 bd(3,8)，其他的一拍一拍寫，像 bd [~ ~ ~ bd] bd2 ~。它不會丟出錯誤。 這一行是精確的：把結果交給 compile()，每個小節都會落在同樣的格子上。規則寫在套件的 README，測試用一千張隨機的格子圖驗證過。 grid 格子：{ 軌道: 'x...x...' } 或 { 軌道: [1, 0, 0, 0, …] }。軌道可以用鼓的名字（kick）或字（bd）命名。x、X、1、true 是鼓點，| 和空白會被忽略。名字不是鼓組認得的軌道會被丟掉。 steps 每條軌道有幾格。 words 保留你自己的寫法：{ kick: 'kick' } 會寫成 kick4 而不是 bd4。 order 要放在最前面的鼓，照這個順序，例如 ['kick', 'snare']。其他的接在後面，照格子圖的鍵的順序。 一行剛好打出這張格子圖的節奏。完全沒有鼓點的格子圖會得到 '~'。

It lets someone paste what they made in Strudel. It reads s("…") and sound("…") with ", ' or backtick quotes. Several of them (also with a label like $: or name: in front) become layers. A .fast(n) or .slow(n) is folded into the line as […]n or […]/n. setcpm(x) gives bpm as x times 4, setcps(x) as x times 240. .bank(…) goes to ignored, because OAV plays its own kit. Any other call or statement goes to unsupported, and the rest still plays. It never throws. It only reshapes text: it does not check the words. fromStrudel('s("bd kik")') gives ok: true with src: 'bd kik', so pass src to compile() and look at its ok. startDrums() accepts Strudel code directly and does all of this for you. code The Strudel code, as copied from the strudel.cc editor. { strudel, ok, src, bpm, ignored, unsupported }. strudel is false when the text has no s(…) or sound(…) in it. ok is true when there is a line of rhythm in src. bpm is the tempo from setcpm() or setcps(), else null. ignored lists what was left out on purpose (.bank(…)), unsupported what OAV does not do (.jux(rev), .gain(…)).

它讓人可以貼上自己在 Strudel 做的東西。它讀 s("…") 和 sound("…")，引號可以是 "、' 或反引號。好幾個（前面也可以有 $: 或 name: 這種標籤）會變成好幾層。.fast(n) 或 .slow(n) 會折進那一行，變成 […]n 或 […]/n。setcpm(x) 的 bpm 是 x 乘 4，setcps(x) 是 x 乘 240。.bank(…) 進 ignored，因為 OAV 打的是自己的鼓組。其他的呼叫或敘述都進 unsupported，剩下的照樣會打。它不會丟出錯誤。 它只是把文字重新整理，不會檢查字。fromStrudel('s("bd kik")') 會回 ok: true 和 src: 'bd kik'，所以要把 src 交給 compile()，看它的 ok。startDrums() 可以直接收 Strudel 程式碼，這些事都替你做了。 code 從 strudel.cc 編輯器複製來的 Strudel 程式碼。 { strudel, ok, src, bpm, ignored, unsupported }。文字裡沒有 s(…) 或 sound(…) 的話，strudel 是 false。src 裡有一行節奏的話，ok 是 true。bpm 是 setcpm() 或 setcps() 給的速度，沒有就是 null。ignored 列出刻意略過的（.bank(…)），unsupported 列出 OAV 不做的（.jux(rev)、.gain(…)）。

parse() is the first half of compile(): it checks the grammar and builds the tree, and stops there. Use it when you want to look at the structure of a line, for example to colour its words or find a mistake. For the hits, call compile(). The root is always a layer whose layers are the top-level comma parts, and each of those is a seq. The node types are step { word, n }, rest, seq { steps: [{ node, weight }] }, layer { layers }, alt { steps } (one per bar), fast and slow { factor, node }, euclid { pulses, slots, rotate, node } and maybe { chance, id, node }. Every node has start and end, its character range in src. Weights and factors are fractions [numerator, denominator], so bd1.5 has the factor [3, 2]. Because parse() never looks at the drum kit, parse('kik') succeeds while compile('kik') fails with unknown-word. Everything else (an unclosed bracket, 0, (9,8)) fails in both. src The line of rhythm, for example 'bd [sd sd]'. { ok: true, tree, error: null }, or { ok: false, tree: null, error } with the same { code, index, length, message, hint } error as compile().

parse() 是 compile() 的前半段：只檢查文法、建出樹，到此為止。想看一行的結構，例如幫字上色或找錯誤的時候用它。要鼓點的話，呼叫 compile()。 樹根永遠是 layer，它的 layers 是最上層用逗號分開的幾部分，每一部分是一個 seq。節點的種類有 step { word, n }、rest、seq { steps: [{ node, weight }] }、layer { layers }、alt { steps }（每小節一個）、fast 和 slow { factor, node }、euclid { pulses, slots, rotate, node }、maybe { chance, id, node }。每個節點都有 start 和 end，也就是它在 src 裡的字元範圍。權重和倍數是分數 [分子, 分母]，所以 bd1.5 的倍數是 [3, 2]。 因為 parse() 不看鼓組，parse('kik') 會成功，compile('kik') 卻會失敗，錯誤是 unknown-word。其他的錯（括號沒關、0、(9,8)）兩個都會失敗。 src 一行節奏，例如 'bd [sd sd]'。 { ok: true, tree, error: null }，或 { ok: false, tree: null, error }，error 跟 compile() 的一樣，是 { code, index, length, message, hint }。

fromGrid() writes with these words when you do not give it your own spelling, and toStrudel() uses them (with hh for pedalhat) to speak Strudel. A frozen object of 13 { voice: word } pairs, one per drum of the kit. pedalhat has no short word, so it maps to 'pedalhat', OAV's own.
fromGrid() 沒給你自己的寫法時，就是用這些字寫。toStrudel() 也用它們（pedalhat 用 hh）來說 Strudel 的話。 一個凍結的物件，有 13 組 { 鼓聲: 字 }，鼓組每種鼓一組。pedalhat 沒有短字，所以對到 OAV 自己的 'pedalhat'。

The format is the one strudel.cc shows in its own address bar. It is what the drum machine card's Open in Strudel link uses. Open it in a new tab: a strudel.cc tab that is already open does not read a changed #. OAV only builds the link. No Strudel code runs in, or ships with, OAV. src The line of rhythm. opts The options of toStrudel(): { bpm, comment, words }. A URL: 'https://strudel.cc/#' and the code from toStrudel(), as UTF-8 base64, URL-encoded.

格式就是 strudel.cc 自己的網址列顯示的那種，鼓機卡上的 在 Strudel 打開 連結用的就是它。要在新分頁打開：已經開著的 strudel.cc 分頁不會重讀改變過的 #。 OAV 只是做出連結，沒有任何 Strudel 的程式碼在 OAV 裡執行，也沒有隨 OAV 一起發佈。 src 一行節奏。 opts toStrudel() 的選項：{ bpm, comment, words }。 一個網址：'https://strudel.cc/#' 加上 toStrudel() 的程式碼，轉成 UTF-8 的 base64，再做網址編碼。

It is the way back from fromGrid(), and what the drum machine card uses to draw the cells of a line. Each hit goes to the step it is nearest to. The lost fields say what that cost: offGrid is the number of hits that sit between steps (triplets) and were moved to the nearest one. stacked counts two hits of one drum on one step. varies is true when other bars differ (, /2). random is true when the line has a ?. samples is true when it has a sample number like bd:2. exact is true only when none of these happened. A line that fails to compile does not throw: you get ok: false. p A line of rhythm, or the result of compile(). bar Which bar to show, counting from 1. steps How many steps the grid has. seed Decides each ?, the same way as in eventsInBar(). bars How many bars to look through to find out whether the other bars differ (lost.varies). At most the line's period, and never more than 64. words Which words mean which drum, the same as in compile(). { ok, grid, words, voices, exact, lost }. grid is { voice: [0 or 1 × steps] }. words is the word the line used for each drum. voices lists the drums. exact is true when the grid holds the bar completely. lost counts what it cannot: { offGrid, stacked, varies, random, samples }. If the line cannot be read, ok is false and the rest is empty.

它是 fromGrid() 的反方向，鼓機卡就是用它畫出一行節奏的格子。每個鼓點會放到離它最近的那一格。lost 的欄位告訴你這樣損失了什麼：offGrid 是落在格子之間（三連音）而被移到最近一格的鼓點數量。stacked 是同一種鼓在同一格有兩下。varies 為 true 表示其他小節不一樣（、/2）。random 為 true 表示這一行有 ?。samples 為 true 表示有像 bd:2 的取樣編號。只有這些都沒發生，exact 才是 true。 編譯失敗的一行不會丟出錯誤，你會得到 ok: false。 p 一行節奏，或 compile() 的結果。 bar 要看哪個小節，從 1 開始數。 steps 格子有幾格。 seed 決定每一個 ?，跟 eventsInBar() 裡的用法一樣。 bars 要看幾個小節，用來判斷其他小節有沒有不同（lost.varies）。最多看到這一行的 period，而且不會超過 64。 words 哪個字代表哪一種鼓，跟 compile() 一樣。 { ok, grid, words, voices, exact, lost }。grid 是 { 鼓聲: [0 或 1，共 steps 個] }。words 是這一行為每種鼓用的字。voices 列出鼓。exact 是 true 表示格子完整放得下這個小節。lost 數出放不下的東西：{ offGrid, stacked, varies, random, samples }。這一行讀不懂的話，ok 是 false，其他都是空的。

The words become the names Strudel's drum sounds use: kick becomes bd, pedalhat becomes hh. A rotation of n steps or more in a Euclidean part, like bd(3,8,10), is written as the rotation OAV plays (bd(3,8,2)), because strudel.cc would play it unrotated. A line that does not read is passed through unchanged, so the result may not play in Strudel: check it with compile() first. It never throws. To open the result in the Strudel editor, use strudelUrl(). src The line of rhythm. bpm The tempo. When it is above 0 a setcpm(bpm/4) line is written, because one OAV bar is one Strudel cycle of four beats. comment A line to put first as a // comment. words Which words mean which drum, the same as in compile(). The Strudel code, one to three lines, ending in s("…").

字會換成 Strudel 的鼓的名字：kick 變 bd，pedalhat 變 hh。歐幾里得的旋轉在 n 格以上的，像 bd(3,8,10)，會寫成 OAV 實際打的旋轉（bd(3,8,2)），因為 strudel.cc 會把它當作沒旋轉。讀不懂的一行會原樣放過去，所以結果在 Strudel 裡可能打不出來，先用 compile() 檢查。它不會丟出錯誤。 要在 Strudel 編輯器裡打開結果，用 strudelUrl()。 src 一行節奏。 bpm 速度。大於 0 的話會寫一行 setcpm(bpm/4)，因為 OAV 的一個小節就是 Strudel 的一個四拍的循環。 comment 要放在最前面的一行 // 註解。 words 哪個字代表哪一種鼓，跟 compile() 一樣。 Strudel 程式碼，一到三行，最後一行是 s("…")。

The short words are the ones TidalCycles and Strudel use: bd kick, sd and sn snare, hh hat, oh open hat, cp clap, rim and rs rim, lt low tom, mt tom, ht high tom, cr crash, rd ride, cb cowbell. Each drum's own name works too: kick, snare, hat, openhat, pedalhat, clap, lowtom, tom, hightom, crash, ride, cowbell. The values are the drum names of GM. It is the default of the words option of compile(), toGrid() and toStrudel(). To teach a line a new word, pass a copy with your word added. A frozen object of 26 { word: voice } pairs. Keys are lowercase, and compile() ignores the case of what you write.

短的字是 TidalCycles 和 Strudel 用的：bd 大鼓、sd 和 sn 小鼓、hh 鈸、oh 開鈸、cp 拍手、rim 和 rs 鼓邊、lt 落地鼓、mt 中鼓、ht 高音中鼓、cr 碎音鈸、rd 疊音鈸、cb 牛鈴。每種鼓自己的名字也能用：kick、snare、hat、openhat、pedalhat、clap、lowtom、tom、hightom、crash、ride、cowbell。值就是 GM 裡的鼓的名字。 它是 compile()、toGrid()、toStrudel() 的 words 選項的預設值。要讓一行節奏認得新的字，就傳一份加了你的字的複本。 一個凍結的物件，有 26 組 { 字: 鼓聲 }。鍵是小寫，compile() 不管你寫的大小寫。

Define function barStarted(bar) { … } to do something once per bar: function barStarted(bar) { drift += 9; }. It is called in the frame where the first step of the bar is heard, right before draw(), and the first call is barStarted(1) when the machine starts. Within a step, cueFired() comes before it and stepStarted() after. While the tab is hidden it is still called once per bar, but nothing is told twice when the tab comes back. stepStarted() and the hits are not told in that time. bar The bar that starts, counted from 1.

定義 function barStarted(bar) { … }，就可以每小節做一次事：function barStarted(bar) { drift += 9; }。它是在你聽到那一小節第一格的那個畫面、draw() 之前被呼叫的，鼓機啟動時的第一次呼叫是 barStarted(1)。在同一格裡，cueFired() 在它之前，stepStarted() 在它之後。 分頁被藏起來的時候，每一小節仍然會呼叫一次，分頁回來的時候也不會補呼叫漏掉的。這段時間不會呼叫 stepStarted()，也不會通知打擊。 bar 剛開始的小節，從 1 算起。

The drum machine counts the bars, so it can run a plan: cue(1, 'calm', 12); cue(5, 'bloom', 12); cue(9, 'storm', 12); in setup() makes three scenes that come round every 12 bars. When a cue is due, cueFired(name, bar) is called and cueName holds the name; read it in draw() if you prefer that to a callback. Several cues on one step fire in the order you declared them, before barStarted(), stepStarted() and the hits of that step. Calling cue() twice with the same values adds nothing, so it is safe in draw() too. Counting starts with startDrums(), and a cue only fires when the machine passes its place: declare the cues right after startDrums() in setup() so that a cue at bar 1 is not missed. After the machine is stopped and started again, the cues fire again from bar 1. A cue declared after its bar has passed fires at its next repeat if it has an every, otherwise never until the machine is started again. Without a running machine no cue fires at all. bar The bar, counted from 1 (the first bar). A fraction is a place inside a bar: 4.5 is halfway through bar 4 (the nearest of the 16 steps is used). A value below 1, or one that is not a number, prints a warning in the console and adds nothing. name What to call it, usually a string. It is passed to cueFired() and becomes cueName. every Repeat every this many bars after the first time (fractions work, at least one step). 0 or left out: only once. Nothing. OAVp5.drums.cue() is the same function and returns the cue it made.

鼓機會數小節，所以可以照著計畫走：在 setup() 裡寫 cue(1, 'calm', 12); cue(5, 'bloom', 12); cue(9, 'storm', 12);，就是三個場景，每 12 小節輪一圈。cue 到的時候會呼叫 cueFired(name, bar)，cueName 裡也會是它的名字，不想用 callback 的話，在 draw() 裡讀它就好。同一格有好幾個 cue 的時候，會依你宣告的順序發動，並且在 barStarted()、stepStarted() 和那一格的打擊之前。 用同樣的值呼叫兩次 cue() 不會重複加，所以放在 draw() 裡也安全。計數從 startDrums() 開始，cue 只在鼓機走過它的位置時才發動：請在 setup() 裡緊接著 startDrums() 宣告，第 1 小節的 cue 才不會漏掉。鼓機停止再啟動之後，cue 會從第 1 小節重新發動。 如果 cue 是在它的那一小節已經過了之後才宣告的，有 every 就會在下一次重複時發動，沒有的話，要等到鼓機重新啟動才會發動。鼓機沒在跑的時候，任何 cue 都不會發動。 bar 第幾小節，第一小節是 1。小數表示小節裡的位置：4.5 是第 4 小節的一半（會取最接近的那一格，共 16 格）。小於 1 或不是數字的值，會在主控台印一個警告，什麼都不會加。 name 給它取的名字，通常是字串。會傳給 cueFired()，並成為 cueName。 every 第一次之後，每隔這麼多小節再來一次（小數可以，至少一格）。0 或不傳：只發動一次。 沒有回傳值。OAVp5.drums.cue() 是同一個函式，它會回傳建立出來的 cue。

Define function cueFired(name, bar) { … } and it is called at the step where a cue is due, before barStarted(), stepStarted() and the hits of that step. A good place to change a scene: function cueFired(name) { look = SCENES[name]; }. If you only need the latest name, read cueName in draw() instead. Cues keep firing while the tab is hidden, so the scene is right when you come back. Several cues on one step call it once each, in the order they were declared. name The name you gave to cue(). bar The bar the cue fired in, counted from 1. For a cue in the middle of a bar (4.5) it is the whole bar it falls in (4).

定義 function cueFired(name, bar) { … }，cue 該發動的那一格就會呼叫它，順序在 barStarted()、stepStarted() 和那一格的打擊之前。很適合用來換場景：function cueFired(name) { look = SCENES[name]; }。如果你只需要最近的名字，在 draw() 裡讀 cueName 就好。 分頁被藏起來的時候，cue 照樣會發動，所以回來的時候場景是對的。同一格有好幾個 cue，會依宣告的順序各呼叫一次。 name 你給 cue() 的名字。 bar cue 發動時所在的小節，從 1 算起。小節中間的 cue（4.5）給的是它落在的那一整小節（4）。

Read it in draw() instead of waiting for cueFired(): look = SCENES[cueName];. It is the name of the last cue only, so it is the right thing for "which scene am I in", and cueFired() is the right thing for "something just began". Cues are declared with cue(). A sketch that declares its own variable called cueName keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.lastCue instead. Changes when a cue fires, and keeps the name until the next one. It is '' at the start.

可以在 draw() 裡直接讀，不用等 cueFired()：look = SCENES[cueName];。它只是最近一個 cue 的名字，所以回答「我現在在哪個場景」用它最適合，「某件事剛剛開始」則適合用 cueFired()。cue 用 cue() 宣告。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 cueName 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.lastCue。 cue 發動的時候改變，之後一直是那個名字，直到下一個。一開始是 ''。

A bar is 16 steps, four beats. Use it to give a piece a shape: floor((drumBar - 1) / 4) % 3 is the section number when you change every four bars. To make something happen at an exact bar, cue() is neater than testing drumBar in draw(). barStarted() is the function that is called at the start of each bar. Start the machine with startDrums(). Stopping and starting again counts from bar 1 again. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumBar keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.bar instead. 0 before the machine has played its first step, then 1, 2, 3 … with no upper limit. It keeps its last value when the machine stops.

一小節是 16 格、四拍。用它替作品安排結構：每四小節換一段的話，floor((drumBar - 1) / 4) % 3 就是現在是第幾段。要讓某件事剛好發生在某一小節，cue() 比在 draw() 裡判斷 drumBar 更簡潔。barStarted() 則是每小節開頭會被呼叫的函式。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機。停止之後再啟動，會從第 1 小節重新算起。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumBar 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.bar。 鼓機播第一格之前是 0，之後是 1、2、3 ……，沒有上限。鼓機停止之後停在最後的值。

A bar has 16 steps (sixteenth notes) and a beat has 4, so drumStep % 4 === 0 is a beat and drumStep === 0 the start of a bar. At 120 bpm a step lasts 125 ms.
