Use it to light a cell or pick a frame: fill(i === drumStep ? 255 : 80). If you would rather be called on each step, define stepStarted(). For something that moves smoothly instead of in 16 jumps, use drumPhase. Start the machine with startDrums(). Before that, and when the machine is stopped, the value is 0 or the last one, so check drumsAreOn if the difference matters. A sketch that declares its own variable called drumStep keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.drums.step instead. While the tab is hidden the clock keeps counting but nothing else is told. Changes in the frame in which a step is heard, right before draw(). 0 at the start, and it keeps its last value when the machine stops.

一小節有 16 格（十六分音符），一拍有 4 格，所以 drumStep % 4 === 0 就是正拍，drumStep === 0 是小節的開頭。速度 120 的時候一格是 125 毫秒。可以用它讓某一格亮起來或挑選畫面：fill(i === drumStep ? 255 : 80)。如果你比較想在每一格被呼叫，就定義 stepStarted()。想要平滑移動，不要 16 次跳動的話，用 drumPhase。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機。在那之前、以及鼓機停止之後，值是 0 或最後的值，這個差別重要的話，要檢查 drumsAreOn。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 drumStep 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.drums.step。分頁被藏起來的時候，時鐘照樣在數，但不會通知任何事件。 在你聽到那一格的那個畫面、draw() 之前改變。一開始是 0，鼓機停止之後停在最後的值。

Define function stepStarted(step, bar) { … } for something on every step: if (step % 4 === 0) ping = 1; is a pulse on the beat. It is called in the frame where the step is heard, right before draw(), after barStarted() and before the hits of that step. drumStep holds the same number if you would rather read than be called. It is not called while the tab is hidden, so a sketch that adds a particle per step does not burst when you come back. step The step that starts, 0 to 15. Every 4 steps is a beat. bar The bar it is in, counted from 1.

定義 function stepStarted(step, bar) { … }，每一格都能做事：if (step % 4 === 0) ping = 1; 就是每一拍脈動一下。它是在你聽到那一格的那個畫面、draw() 之前被呼叫的，在 barStarted() 之後、那一格的打擊之前。如果你比較想讀值而不是被呼叫，drumStep 裡是同一個數字。 分頁被藏起來的時候不會呼叫它，所以每一格就加一個粒子的草圖，在你回來的時候不會一口氣冒出一大堆。 step 剛開始的那一格，0 到 15。每 4 格是一拍。 bar 它所在的小節，從 1 算起。

It is the single clock the others are cut from: drumBar is floor(count / 16) + 1, drumStep is count % 16, and cue() fires when count reaches the step of its bar. It is handy when you want one number that only grows: a position on a very long timeline, or an index into a list. Start the machine with startDrums(); it is -1 until the first step has played. Goes up by one at every step and never goes back to 0 at a new bar. It starts again from 0 when the machine is started again.

其他的數字都是從它切出來的：drumBar 是 floor(count / 16) + 1，drumStep 是 count % 16，cue() 是在 count 走到它那一小節的位置時發動。想要一個只會一直變大的數字的時候很好用，例如很長的時間軸上的位置，或是清單的索引。 先用 startDrums() 啟動鼓機，第一格播出來之前都是 -1。 每一格加一，到了新的小節也不會歸零。機器重新啟動的時候，才會從 0 重新算。

Use it when you want to hold on to the cue, for example to find out which step it fires at. For a plain plan, cue() is shorter. The list of every cue is OAVp5.drums.cues. bar The bar, counted from 1; 4.5 is halfway through bar 4. See cue(). name What to call the cue. every Repeat every this many bars; 0 or left out: once. The cue: { bar, name, every, at, period, key } with at and period counted in steps. null if bar is below 1 or not a number. A repeat of an earlier call gives back the cue that exists.

想拿著這個 cue 的時候用它，例如想知道它在第幾格發動。只是安排計畫的話，cue() 比較短。所有 cue 的清單在 OAVp5.drums.cues。 bar 第幾小節，從 1 算起，4.5 是第 4 小節的一半。見 cue()。 name 這個 cue 的名字。 every 每隔幾小節再來一次，0 或不傳：只一次。 這個 cue：{ bar, name, every, at, period, key }，其中 at 和 period 以格為單位。bar 小於 1 或不是數字就是 null。重複前面呼叫過的，會回傳已經存在的那個 cue。

Read it to show a plan on screen or to check what is declared. It is the machine's own list, so treat it as read-only; declare cues with cue(). Each item is { bar, name, every, at, period, key }: the values you passed, and at and period counted in steps. An empty list at the start.
想把計畫顯示在畫面上，或檢查宣告了哪些 cue 的時候讀它。它是鼓機自己的清單，請當成唯讀，要宣告 cue 請用 cue()。 每一項是 { bar, name, every, at, period, key }：你傳進去的值，以及以格為單位的 at 和 period。一開始是空的。

A segment module is the code that performs one segment (the dawn, the storm, the finale). The director calls its hooks as the show moves through the score: Every hook gets a ctx: p (progress through the segment, 0 to 1; above 1 during linger; exactly 1 while holding), t (seconds into the segment), dt, dur, T (show time), segment, cue(name) and cueT(name) (where a cue sits, as a progress and in show seconds), phase ('active', 'linger', or 'failed' inside exit() after a crash), holding, held (seconds waited at a hold: a clock for ambient motion while T is frozen), playing and api. A module is entered once and exited once, however the show got there: a seek into the middle of a segment calls enter with the right p, so a module must be able to start from the middle. A module that throws is switched off alone: the director calls its exit() once with phase: 'failed', logs one console.error, and never calls it again; the other modules and the show carry on. Reset brings it back. In a show, createShow() builds the director from its score option and calls update() every frame after the timeline has advanced; the director's param() plugs into timeline.layer. Without createShow() you do that wiring yourself: director.update(timeline.t, dt, { holding: timeline.holding, playing: timeline.playing }). The last segment is never exited by time: while the show sits at its end (or past it), the last module stays entered. It exits on a seek that leaves it, or on reset(). A new segment's module…

段落模組就是負責表演一個段落（黎明、暴風雨、終曲）的程式碼。演出走過總譜的時候，導演會呼叫它的掛鉤： 每個掛鉤都會收到一個 ctx：p（這一段走了多少，0 到 1，餘韻期間大於 1，hold 的時候剛好是 1）、t（段內第幾秒）、dt、dur、T（演出時間）、segment、cue(name) 和 cueT(name)（cue 的位置，一個是進度、一個是演出秒數）、phase（'active'、'linger'，崩潰後的 exit() 裡是 'failed'）、holding、held（在 hold 上等了幾秒，演出時間 T 凍結時可以拿它當環境動態的時鐘）、playing 和 api。 一個模組只進場一次、只退場一次，不管演出是怎麼走到那裡的：seek 到段落中間，會用正確的 p 呼叫 enter，所以模組必須能從中間開始。丟出錯誤的模組只有它自己會被關掉：導演用 phase: 'failed' 呼叫一次它的 exit()，印出一行 console.error，之後不再呼叫它，其他模組和演出照常進行。reset 可以把它請回來。 在演出裡，createShow() 依 score 選項建好導演，每個畫面在時間軸前進之後呼叫 update()，導演的 param() 接到 timeline.layer 上。不用 createShow() 的話，這些接線要自己做：director.update(timeline.t, dt, { holding: timeline.holding, playing: timeline.playing })。 最後一個段落不會因為時間而退場：演出停在尾端（或超過尾端）時，最後一個模組仍維持進場狀態。它只在 seek 離開或 reset() 時退場。 新段落的模組會先進場、舊的才退場，在 linger 期間兩個會同時在跑。 module 或 id 對不到任何段落的模組，或段落指定了沒人登記的模組（會列在 status().missing），都只是不被表演，演出照常進行。 score 要表演的 Score。必填，沒有的話建構函式會丟出 "Director needs a score"。 modules 段落模組：一個陣列（依每個模組的 id 對應到段落），或以段落 id 為 key 的物件。沒有模組的段落就單純不被表演。 api 每個模組的掛鉤收到的第一個參數（也是 ctx.api）。如果是函式，會在第一次需要時呼叫一次，然後使用它回傳的結果。 onStatus 當段落、hold 的狀態或被關掉的模組清單改變的時候，以 status() 呼叫，不是每個畫面都呼叫。 onCue 播放頭每經過一個 cue 就呼叫一次：{ name, cue, T, n, segment }。 maxStep 兩次 update() 之間跳超過這麼多秒，就算是 seek，中間的 cue 不會觸發。如果你用很高的 timeline.rate 排練，把它調大。

A timeline written as a table of absolute seconds cannot grow: make one scene longer and every later cue, curve and if (t > 466) is wrong. In a score you write only how long each segment is, and Score computes every start, end, cue time, countdown and scene from those lengths. Change one dur and everything after it moves; a second version of the show is a few lines of data. A cut is one version of the show; a segment is one stretch of it: dur is the only time a segment has. cues are named moments (a ratio 0 in the page address picks the cut. Plain fields: cut (the id being performed), title, segments (each with start, end, dur, index, cues, meta …), total (the length of the show), startT (where reset goes), scale and base. A segment may carry meta: whatever else the work hangs on it (a layer, a palette, an event window). The score does not read it and hands it back as segment.meta, always an object ({} when there is none), also in scenes() and in the director's ctx.segment. A top-level field of a segment that the score does not know is kept in meta too, and an explicit meta entry of the same name wins. A meta that is not an object is a ScoreError. Segment and cue ids must not contain a dot: the dot is how cueTime('dusk.glow') separates a segment from its cue. A cue cannot be called end. If two cuts differ in structure and not only in length, do not share automation between them. Drive the params from the segment modules instead, where ctx.p already scales for free. cuts The…

把時間軸寫成一張絕對秒數的表，它就長不大：某個場景拉長一點，後面每個 cue、曲線和 if (t > 466) 全都錯了。在總譜裡你只寫每一段「多長」，Score 從這些長度算出每個起點、終點、cue 的時間、倒數和場景。改一個 dur，它後面的一切都跟著挪。第二個版本只是幾行資料。 一個 cut 是演出的一個版本，一個 segment（段落）是其中的一段： dur 是一個段落唯一擁有的時間。cues 是有名字的時刻（比例 0 可以選 cut。 普通欄位：cut（正在表演的 id）、title、segments（每一段都有 start、end、dur、index、cues、meta ……）、total（演出總長）、startT（reset 回到哪裡）、scale 和 base。 段落可以帶 meta：作品想掛在段落上的其他東西（圖層、色盤、事件的時間窗）。總譜不讀它，原樣用 segment.meta 交還，而且一定是物件（沒有就是 {}），在 scenes() 和導演的 ctx.segment 裡也拿得到。段落最上層有總譜不認得的欄位，也會被收進 meta，明寫在 meta 裡的同名項目優先。meta 不是物件的話，會是一個 ScoreError。 段落和 cue 的 id 不能含有句點：cueTime('dusk.glow') 就是靠句點把段落和它的 cue 分開。cue 也不能叫 end。 如果兩個 cut 不只是長度不同、連結構都不同，就不要讓它們共用自動化曲線，改由段落模組來驅動參數，那裡的 ctx.p 本來就會跟著縮放。 cuts 這場演出可以表演成哪些 cut：一個 cut 的陣列，或以 cut id 為 key 的物件。一個 cut 是 { id, title?, start?, segments: [...] }，或衍生的 { id, title?, from, scale }。必填，沒有 cut 就會丟出錯誤。 cut 要表演的 cut 的 id。預設是第一個，不在 cuts 裡的 id 是錯誤。

You rarely build one yourself: new Score() throws it. error.problems is an array of strings and error.message is the same list as one text, headed "Score is invalid (3 problems)". error.name is 'ScoreError', and it is a normal Error, so instanceof ScoreError and instanceof Error both work. It lists every problem it found, not only the first, so one run of the show shows you everything to fix. Nothing half-valid can reach the stage. problems The reasons, one string each. Each one names the cut, the segment and what is wrong.

通常不用自己建：new Score() 會丟出它。error.problems 是字串陣列，error.message 是同一份清單串成的文字，開頭是「Score is invalid (3 problems)」。error.name 是 'ScoreError'，它是一般的 Error，所以 instanceof ScoreError 和 instanceof Error 都成立。 它會列出找到的所有問題，不是只列第一個，所以跑一次就能看到所有要修的地方。有問題的總譜上不了台。 problems 所有原因，每個一個字串。每一個都會指出是哪個 cut、哪個段落、哪裡不對。

timeline.exportAutomation() returns { format, version: 1, cut, as, automation } with this constant as format. importAutomation() reads the field: a document whose format is another string is refused with an error, and so is a version above 1. A document without a format string is read as a bare { key: keyframes | lane } map. Use it to recognise such a file before you hand it over, for example in a file picker that also accepts map files.

timeline.exportAutomation() 回傳 { format, version: 1, cut, as, automation }，其中的 format 就是這個常數。importAutomation() 會讀這個欄位：format 是別的字串的檔案會被拒絕並丟出錯誤，version 大於 1 的也是。沒有 format 字串的檔案，會被當成一張單純的 { key: 關鍵影格 | lane } 表來讀。 可以拿它在交給時間軸之前先認出這種檔案，例如一個同時也收映射檔的檔案選擇器。

A point [p, value, curve] is the keyframe [segment start + p × segment length, value, curve], and there is no other rule. Between segments the value interpolates like any two keyframes; two points on the same second (the p: 1 of one segment and the p: 0 of the next) are a jump. A Timeline calls this for every lane in its automation when it is built, and again in importAutomation(); call it yourself in a tool that reads lanes without a timeline. It throws an Error that names the param, the segment and the point when something is wrong: a segment id that is not in the plan (and not in known), a value that is not a finite number, a p outside 0 to 1 or out of order, an empty list of points, or a point that is not [p, value, curve?]. plan The segments the lane is written against: [{ id, start, end }] or [{ id, start, dur }], in seconds. lane { segmentId: points }. points is an array of [p, value, curve?] with p from 0 to 1 in ascending order, or a bare number (that value for the whole segment), or null / undefined (this segment is not written). key In the options object: the param's name, used only in error messages. known In the options object: the segment ids that any cut has (score.allSegmentIds()). A lane entry for an id that is in known but not in plan is skipped; without known, every id missing from plan throws. Keyframes [[t, value], [t, value, curve], …] in the plan's seconds, sorted by time. On the same second, the p: 1 of the earlier segment comes before the p: 0 of…

一個點 [p, 值, 曲線] 就是關鍵影格 [段首 + p × 段長, 值, 曲線]，沒有別的規則。段與段之間照一般兩個關鍵影格那樣內插。兩個點落在同一秒（前一段的 p: 1 和後一段的 p: 0）就是一次跳變。Timeline 建立的時候，會替 automation 裡的每條 lane 呼叫它，importAutomation() 裡也會再呼叫。不透過時間軸讀 lane 的工具，可以自己呼叫。 有問題的時候它會丟出 Error，訊息裡指出是哪個參數、哪個段落、第幾個點：段落 id 不在段落表裡（也不在 known 裡）、值不是有限數字、p 超出 0 到 1 或順序不對、點的清單是空的，或某個點不是 [p, 值, 曲線?]。 plan lane 對照的段落表：[{ id, start, end }] 或 [{ id, start, dur }]，單位是秒。 lane { 段落 id: 點 }。「點」是 [p, 值, 曲線?] 的陣列，p 在 0 到 1 之間、由小到大。也可以只寫一個數字（整段維持這個值），或 null、undefined（這一段不寫）。 key 放在選項物件裡：參數的名字，只用在錯誤訊息裡。 known 放在選項物件裡：任何一個 cut 有過的段落 id（score.allSegmentIds()）。lane 寫到的 id 在 known 裡、但不在 plan 裡，那一筆會被略過。沒給 known 的話，plan 裡沒有的 id 一律丟出錯誤。 以段落表秒數表示的關鍵影格 [[t, 值], [t, 值, 曲線], …]，依時間排好。落在同一秒的時候，前一段的 p: 1 排在後一段的 p: 0 前面。

In a Timeline, the third item of a keyframe names the curve of the segment that ends at that keyframe: [30, 320, 'ease'] means "arrive at 320 at second 30 the ease way". linear is the default, and an unknown name or a typo also falls back to linear, so a mistake never stops a show. You can pass your own function instead of a name. linear goes straight. ease is a smoothstep: slow, fast, slow. in starts slowly (f²). out starts fast and lands softly (1 − (1 − f)²). step is special: the segment holds the old value until the keyframe, then jumps. The step function stored here returns 0 and is never called to interpolate; it is listed so that the object is the whole vocabulary. A param declared with step in its Params schema holds each keyframe whatever curve you name.

在 Timeline 裡，關鍵影格的第三項是「抵達這個影格的那一段」的曲線名稱：[30, 320, 'ease'] 的意思是「用 ease 的方式，在第 30 秒抵達 320」。預設是 linear，名稱不認得或打錯也會退回 linear，所以打錯字不會讓演出停下來。你也可以傳自己的函式，不用名稱。 linear 走直線。ease 是 smoothstep：慢、快、慢。in 起頭慢（f²）。out 起頭快、輕輕落地（1 − (1 − f)²）。step 比較特別：這一段會一直守著舊值，到了關鍵影格才跳過去。放在這裡的 step 函式永遠回傳 0，內插的時候不會用它來算，列在這裡只是為了讓這個物件涵蓋整套名稱。 在 Params 的 schema 裡宣告了 step 的參數，不管你寫哪種曲線，都會停在每個關鍵影格。

A keyframe exactly on a boundary: alone, it becomes p: 0 of the segment that starts there. Two or more on the same second are a jump, so all but the last become p: 1 of the segment before and the last becomes p: 0 of the next. That is why a lane made by compileLane() comes back exactly as it was. Keyframes on the last second of the show are p: 1 of the last segment. A keyframe outside the show has no (segment, p), so it throws a RangeError; export in seconds instead. An empty plan, or one where two segments share an id, throws an Error. On a Timeline, timeline.lanes() and exportAutomation({ as: 'segments' }) call this for you. plan The segments: [{ id, start, end }] or [{ id, start, dur }], in seconds. It must not be empty, and every id must be different. keyframes Keyframes [[t, value, curve?], …] in the plan's seconds. They need not be sorted. key In the options object: the param's name, used only in error messages. precision In the options object: how many decimals p is rounded to. null does not round. The lane. A segment that no keyframe falls in has no entry.

剛好落在段界上的關鍵影格：只有一個的話，它是從那裡開始的那一段的 p: 0。同一秒有兩個以上就是跳變，前面的歸前一段的 p: 1，最後一個歸後一段的 p: 0。所以 compileLane() 編出來的 lane，拆回去會一模一樣。落在演出最後一秒的關鍵影格，是最後一段的 p: 1。 演出範圍之外的關鍵影格寫不成（段落, p），所以會丟出 RangeError，這種情況請改用秒數匯出。段落表是空的，或有兩個段落共用一個 id，會丟出 Error。在 Timeline 上，timeline.lanes() 和 exportAutomation({ as: 'segments' }) 會替你呼叫它。 plan 段落表：[{ id, start, end }] 或 [{ id, start, dur }]，單位是秒。不能是空的，而且每個 id 都要不一樣。 keyframes 以段落表秒數表示的關鍵影格 [[t, 值, 曲線?], …]。不用先排好。 key 放在選項物件裡：參數的名字，只用在錯誤訊息裡。 precision 放在選項物件裡：p 要四捨五入到小數第幾位。null 表示不捨入。 一條 lane。沒有任何關鍵影格落在裡面的段落，就不會出現在結果裡。

A scene with hold: true stops playback at its end. The Timeline parks HOLD_EPS (0.000001 seconds) before the boundary rather than on it, so sceneIndexAt(t) and the director still say "the held scene", timeline.t reads 5.999999 for a hold at 6, and the next scene has not started. release() then moves the playhead onto the boundary itself. You only need it when you compare the playhead with a boundary yourself: while holding, timeline.t is boundary - HOLD_EPS, not exactly boundary.

hold: true 的場景會在尾端讓播放停住。Timeline 把播放頭停在邊界前面 HOLD_EPS（0.000001 秒）的地方，而不是正好停在邊界上，所以 sceneIndexAt(t) 和導演仍然說「現在是被 hold 的那個場景」，在 6 秒的 hold 上 timeline.t 讀到的是 5.999999，下一個場景還沒開始。之後 release() 才把播放頭移到邊界本身。 只有在你自己拿播放頭跟邊界做比較的時候才會用到：hold 的時候，timeline.t 是 邊界 - HOLD_EPS，不是剛好等於邊界。

In a Timeline, each param's automation is either an array of [seconds, value, curve?] keyframes or a lane, { segmentId: [[p, value, curve?], …] }. isLane() is the test the timeline itself uses to decide which one it was given. It looks only at the shape: it does not check that the segment ids exist or that the points are valid (compileLane() does that). x One value of an automation object. true when x is an object that is neither null nor an array.

在 Timeline 裡，每個參數的自動化曲線不是 [秒數, 值, 曲線?] 關鍵影格的陣列，就是一條 lane：{ 段落 id: [[p, 值, 曲線?], …] }。isLane() 就是時間軸自己用來判斷拿到的是哪一種的那個測試。它只看形狀：不檢查段落 id 存不存在，也不檢查點合不合格（那是 compileLane() 的事）。 x automation 物件裡的一個值。 x 是物件，而且不是 null、也不是陣列的時候是 true。

A boundary belongs to the segment that starts there, so the second where noon begins answers { id: 'noon', p: 0 }, not the end of the segment before. The one exception is the last second of the show, which is p: 1 of the last segment. A segment of zero length answers p: 0. laneTime() goes the other way. These functions do not know a Timeline, so a tool can use them alone. On a timeline, timeline.lanePos(t) and timeline.laneTime(id, p) call them with the timeline's own plan. The seconds are automation seconds (the root cut's): for a derived cut's show time use score.locate(T) and score.timeAt(id, p). plan The segments in order: [{ id, start, end }] or [{ id, start, dur }], in seconds. This is the shape of score.rootSegments and of timeline.lanePlan(). t A time in the plan's seconds. { id, index, p }. null when the plan is empty, t is not a finite number, or t is before the first segment or after the last.

段界屬於從那裡開始的那一段，所以 noon 開始的那一秒回答的是 { id: 'noon', p: 0 }，不是前一段的結尾。唯一的例外是演出的最後一秒，它是最後一段的 p: 1。長度是 0 的段落回答 p: 0。反方向的換算是 laneTime()。 這幾個函式不認得 Timeline，所以工具可以單獨拿來用。在時間軸上，timeline.lanePos(t) 和 timeline.laneTime(id, p) 會帶著時間軸自己的段落表去呼叫它們。這裡的秒是自動化的秒（root cut 的秒）：衍生 cut 的演出時間要用 score.locate(T) 和 score.timeAt(id, p)。 plan 依序排好的段落：[{ id, start, end }] 或 [{ id, start, dur }]，單位是秒。score.rootSegments 和 timeline.lanePlan() 就是這個樣子。 t 段落表所用秒數的一個時間。 { id, index, p }。段落表是空的、t 不是有限數字，或 t 在第一段之前、最後一段之後，都回傳 null。

Use it to say "halfway through noon" without knowing how long noon is: laneTime(plan, 'noon', 0.5). With lanePos() it converts between seconds and (segment, p) in both directions. On a Timeline, timeline.laneTime(id, p) does the same with the timeline's own plan. plan The segments: [{ id, start, end }] or [{ id, start, dur }], in seconds. id The id of a segment. With two segments of the same id, the first one is used. p Progress through the segment: 0 is its start, 1 its end. It is not clamped, so 1.5 answers a second past the end. start + p × (end − start) in the plan's seconds; exactly start for p 0 and exactly end for p 1. NaN when there is no segment with that id or p is not a finite number.

用它可以說「noon 的一半」而不必知道 noon 有多長：laneTime(plan, 'noon', 0.5)。它和 lanePos() 一起，讓秒數和（段落, p）可以雙向換算。在 Timeline 上，timeline.laneTime(id, p) 用時間軸自己的段落表做同一件事。 plan 段落表：[{ id, start, end }] 或 [{ id, start, dur }]，單位是秒。 id 段落的 id。有兩個段落 id 相同的話，用的是第一個。 p 在這個段落裡的進度：0 是段首，1 是段尾。它不會被限制範圍，所以 1.5 會回答超過段尾的秒數。 段落表所用秒數的 start + p × (end − start)。p 是 0 的時候剛好等於 start，是 1 的時候剛好等於 end。沒有這個 id 的段落，或 p 不是有限數字，就是 NaN。

timeline.state(t) returns { key: value } for every param at time t, interpolated from automation. That is the whole job: the timeline owns time, and a world never reads the clock. In a show, createShow() builds the timeline from its timeline option, Loop calls advance(dt) every frame, and what state() returns goes into params.resolve(), where a hand or a knob that has overridden a param still wins. Between two keyframes the value moves in a straight line. The optional third item of a keyframe says how the segment that ends at that keyframe gets there: 'linear', 'ease', 'in', 'out', 'step', or your own function of 0..1 (see CURVES). Before the first keyframe the value is the first one, after the last it is the last one, and a param with no keyframes stays at its def. A param declared with step holds each keyframe instead of interpolating. Scenes give the show its shape: { id: 'storm', t: 90, title: 'Storm', note: 'clusters welcome' }. onSceneChange is the hook to fire sound, lights or prompts, and the console shows the title and note to the performer. A scene with hold: true stops playback at its end until someone calls release(). Scene cues are { name, t } with t in show seconds (not seconds into the scene), and they fire only when playback passes them: a seek, a jump or a reset never does. A lane writes a param per segment instead of in seconds. The segments are those of the score's root cut, or the scenes when there is no score (a scene lasts until the next one starts). A…

timeline.state(t) 回傳時間 t 的時候每個參數的 { key: value }，由 automation 內插得來。它的工作就這一件：時間歸時間軸管，世界從來不讀時鐘。在演出裡，createShow() 依 timeline 選項建好時間軸，Loop 每個畫面呼叫 advance(dt)，state() 的結果再交給 params.resolve()，被手或旋鈕覆寫的參數仍然以覆寫為準。 兩個關鍵影格之間，值走直線。關鍵影格選填的第三項，說的是「抵達這個影格的那一段」怎麼走：'linear'、'ease'、'in'、'out'、'step'，或你自己寫的 0..1 函式（見 CURVES）。第一個影格之前，值就是第一個影格的值。最後一個影格之後，就是最後一個的值。沒有任何關鍵影格的參數維持在 def。宣告了 step 的參數會停在每個關鍵影格，不做內插。 場景給了演出一個結構：{ id: 'storm', t: 90, title: 'Storm', note: 'clusters welcome' }。onSceneChange 是用來觸發聲音、燈光或提詞的掛鉤，主控台會把標題和備註顯示給表演者。hold: true 的場景，播放到它的尾端就停住，直到有人呼叫 release()。場景的 cues 是 { name, t }，t 是演出秒數（不是場景內的第幾秒），而且只有播放經過它們的時候才會觸發：seek、跳轉或 reset 都不會。 lane 是按段落寫參數，不是按秒數。段落指的是總譜 root cut 的段落，沒有總譜的話就是場景（一個場景持續到下一個場景開始為止）。一個點 [p, 值, 曲線?] 就是位在「段首 + p × 段長」的關鍵影格。只寫一個數字，表示整段維持這個值。null 表示這一段不寫。lane 用段落的名字來寫，所以長度不同的 cut 讀起來是同一個意思。lane 寫到「這個 cut 沒有、別的 cut 有」的段落，那一段會被略過。寫到所有 cut 都沒有的段落就丟出錯誤（多半是打錯字）。exportAutomation() 和 importAutomation() 把自動化曲線以 JSON 匯出、匯入，可以用秒數，也可以按段落。 還有兩個選用的時鐘，不呼叫就什麼都不會變。anchor() 會去讀牆鐘：Loop 把每個 dt 夾在 0.1 秒以內，所以演出一長，播放頭就會慢於真實時間，drift() 會算出慢了多少。'warn' 模式只計數和警告，'catch-up' 模式會把欠的時間追回來。follow() 讓時間軸去追另一條時間軸的時鐘，給好幾個頁面演同一場用：差得少就微調 rate，差得多就 seek，主控端暫停或停在 hold 它也跟著，主控端沒聲音了就自己往前走。頁面之間的傳輸是 createSync()。 時間只在你呼叫 play()、並且每個畫面呼叫 advance(dt) 的時候才會往前走（演出會替你做）。state(t) 和 valueAt(key, t) 隨時都能用，不論有沒有在播放。起始場景的回呼，要等到第一次 advance() 或 seek() 才會觸發。 這些是可以直接讀、也可以直接設定的普通欄位：t、playing、holding、rate（1 是真實速度，4 是四倍速排練）、total、start、scenes、automation、score、loop、loops（上次 reset 以來繞了幾圈）和 layer。 layer 是 (key, value, t) =>…

A counter you do not have to keep yourself: count(mouseIsPressed) is the number of clicks so far, count(beat, 4) walks 0 1 2 3 0 1 … on the beat, and count('kick') counts the kicks of the drum machine. A switch has to go off and on again to be counted twice. Event counts start when count('kick') is first called, so earlier kicks are not counted. An event of your own fired with trigger() is counted from its first firing, whenever count() is first called. The event names work like env(): 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' and 'beat' come from the microphone, or from the drum machine once startDrums() has been called, and the first count('kick') asks for the microphone if the drum machine is not on. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. A sketch with its own variable or function called count keeps it. OAVp5.chop.count(…) is this function under another name. on A switch: a boolean, or a number above 0.5, and each time it goes from off to on counts one. Or an event name ('kick', 'beat', 'note', or one of your own fired with trigger()): how many of…

不用自己維護的計數器：count(mouseIsPressed) 是到現在的點擊次數，count(beat, 4) 跟著拍子數 0 1 2 3 0 1 …，count('kick') 數鼓機的大鼓。開關要關掉再打開，才會算第二次。 事件的計數從第一次呼叫 count('kick') 才開始，之前的大鼓不算。你自己用 trigger() 發出的事件，從它第一次發出就開始算，不管 count() 什麼時候第一次被呼叫。 事件名字的規則跟 env() 一樣：'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'beat' 來自麥克風，或是呼叫過 startDrums() 之後來自鼓機，而鼓機沒開的時候，第一次 count('kick') 會去要麥克風。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 草圖如果自己有叫 count 的變數或函式，就由草圖保留。OAVp5.chop.count(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 on 可以是開關：布林值，或大於 0.5 的數字，每次從關變成開就算一次。也可以是事件名字（'kick'、'beat'、'note'，或你自己用 trigger() 發出的）：那種事件到現在發生了幾次。 limit 數到這個數字就繞回去：4 會得到 0 1 2 3 0 1 …。不寫、或是 0 以下，就一直往上數。 name 只用在開關的寫法（count(beat, 4, 'a')）：給它的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。事件名字的寫法不需要。 計數，從 0 開始的整數。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的開關，都回傳 0。

The picture scope() shows in the corner, but drawn on the canvas: stroke(255); drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 0, height - 100, width, 100). The line is one shape in the sketch's own stroke() colour and weight (white while noStroke() is in effect), with no fill, and the style you had before is put back afterwards. The oldest value is at the left edge x, the newest at x + w. A number instead of an array is the shortcut: drawTrail(micLevel, 0, 0, width, 100) draws the last 2 seconds without a separate trail() call. Call it in draw() after createCanvas(). With a number, the first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames, and nothing is drawn until then. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.drawTrail(…) is this function under another name. values An array such as the one trail() returns. Or a single number: then drawTrail keeps its own trail of the last 2 seconds. x Left edge of the box. y Top edge of the box. w Width of the box. Left out, it is the canvas width. h Height of the box. Left out, it is the canvas height. lo The value drawn at the bottom of the box. hi The value…

就是 scope() 顯示在角落的那張圖，只是畫在畫布上：stroke(255); drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 0, height - 100, width, 100)。這條線是草圖自己的 stroke() 顏色和粗細畫出的一個形狀（noStroke() 生效時是白色），不填色，畫完之後會把你原本的樣式還原。 最舊的值在左邊的 x，最新的在 x + w。傳數字而不傳陣列是捷徑：drawTrail(micLevel, 0, 0, width, 100) 不用另外呼叫 trail() 就能畫出最近 2 秒。 在 createCanvas() 之後的 draw() 裡呼叫。傳數字的話，第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面，那之前不會畫任何東西。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.drawTrail(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 values 像 trail() 回傳的那種陣列。或是單一個數字：這時 drawTrail 會自己保留最近 2 秒的軌跡。 x 方框左邊的位置。 y 方框上緣的位置。 w 方框的寬度。不寫就是畫布的寬度。 h 方框的高度。不寫就是畫布的高度。 lo 畫在方框底部的那個值。 hi 畫在方框頂部的那個值。超出 lo 到 hi 的值會貼在方框的邊上。hi 等於 lo 的話，線會從中間穿過。 name 只有 values 是單一個數字的時候才用：給它自己的軌跡取的名字，寫在第 8 個參數（hi 後面）。 畫出來的那個陣列：你傳進來的，或是那個數字自己的軌跡。少於 2 個值的時候不會畫。

Call it every frame and use the number like a size or a brightness: circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + env('kick', 0.01, 0.3) 200) swells on every kick. The number rises to 1 in attack seconds after an event and falls back to 0 in decay seconds, quick at first and landing softly, the way a bass drum's swell looks right. An event that arrives while the last pulse is still sounding restarts from where the pulse is, never from zero, so fast hits pile up into a plateau instead of flickering. The attack is measured from 0: a retrigger from halfway up takes half the attack. The events: 'kick', 'snare' and 'hat' are the hits kickDetected() hears (from the microphone, or from the drum machine when it plays), 'beat' is beat, 'note' is any key going down, 'bar' and 'step' come from the drum machine, a cue's name fires when cue() does, and any other name is yours to fire with trigger(). The switch form, env(mouseIsPressed, 0.02, 0.5), fires on every press. 'kick', 'snare', 'hat' and 'beat' need something that makes them. If the sketch has not started the drum machine (startDrums()), the first env('kick') asks for the microphone, like reading micLevel, and ?oav_mic=off means nothing ever fires. Once the drum machine is started, the microphone is not opened for it. 'note' needs a key: play one, press 🎹, or call OAVp5.play(). A name of your own needs trigger(): if nothing fires it within 4 seconds, a card says so. A named event needs no place in draw(): env('kick') works in setup() or…

每個畫面都呼叫它，把這個數字當成大小或亮度來用：circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + env('kick', 0.01, 0.3) 200) 讓圓在每一下大鼓都脹大。事件之後，數字在 attack 秒內升到 1，再用 decay 秒落回 0，一開始退得快，最後輕輕落地，就像大鼓的那一下看起來該有的樣子。 上一個脈衝還沒退完時又來一個事件，會從脈衝現在的位置重新開始，不會回到 0，所以很快的連打會堆成一個平台，不會閃爍。attack 是從 0 算起的：從一半的地方再觸發，只花一半的 attack。 事件有這些：'kick'、'snare'、'hat' 就是 kickDetected() 聽到的那些打擊（來自麥克風，或鼓機在播的時候來自鼓機），'beat' 是 beat，'note' 是任何一個琴鍵按下，'bar' 和 'step' 來自鼓機，cue 的名字在 cue() 觸發時發出，其他的名字由你用 trigger() 發出。開關的寫法 env(mouseIsPressed, 0.02, 0.5) 在每次按下時發出事件。 'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'beat' 要有東西去產生它們。草圖還沒啟動鼓機（startDrums()）的話，第一次 env('kick') 就會像讀 micLevel 一樣去要麥克風，而 ?oav_mic=off 表示永遠不會有事件。鼓機一啟動，就不會為它去開麥克風。'note' 要有琴鍵：彈一個、按 🎹，或呼叫 OAVp5.play()。你自己取的名字要靠 trigger()：4 秒內沒有任何東西觸發它，會跳出一張卡片告訴你。 有名字的事件不需要待在 draw() 裡：env('kick') 在 setup() 或 mousePressed() 裡也能用。只有開關的寫法會在畫面之間記東西，沒有名字的開關在 draw() 外面回傳 0。在 draw() 裡的呼叫跟 lag() 一樣，靠順序來對應。 OAVp5.chop.env(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 event 要對什麼起反應。可以是名字：'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'beat'（來自麥克風或鼓機）、'note'（任何琴鍵）、'bar'、'step'（鼓機）、某個 cue 的名字，或你自己用 trigger() 發出的事件。也可以是開關：布林值，或大於 0.5 的數字，每次從關變成開就算一次事件。不寫就是 'beat'。 attack 從 0 升到 1 要花的秒數。 decay 從 1 落回 0 要花的秒數。 name 只用在開關的寫法（env(mouseIsPressed, …, 'a')）：給它的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。像 'kick' 這種有名字的事件不需要。 0 到 1：什麼都沒發生是 0，脈衝的頂點是 1。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面）回傳 0。

Wrap any number that jumps: circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) 300) is a VU meter. It opens within 0.03 seconds when someone speaks and takes 0.4 seconds to close. up is the time to follow a rise, down the time to follow a fall. Leave down out and both are up. Leave both out and they are 0.1. The seconds are TouchDesigner's: lag(x, 0.1) moves like a Lag CHOP set to 0.1, so the numbers you learn here carry over. That is about the time the output takes to cover 90% of a jump (underneath, a one-pole lag whose time constant is the seconds divided by 2.3). The curve is the same at 30 and at 144 frames per second. The first value it sees is taken as it is, so nothing glides in from 0. A boolean counts as 0 or 1: lag(mouseIsPressed, 0.2) is a soft switch. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop from next to oav-p5.js, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. A sketch with its own variable or function called lag keeps it. OAVp5.chop.lag(…) is this function under another name. value The number to follow. A…

包住任何會跳的數字：circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) 300) 就是一個音量表。有人說話時 0.03 秒內張開，要 0.4 秒才收回去。up 是跟上升的時間，down 是跟下降的時間。不寫 down，兩個都是 up。兩個都不寫，就都是 0.1。 這裡的秒數跟 TouchDesigner 一樣：lag(x, 0.1) 的動法就像把 Lag CHOP 設成 0.1，所以在這裡學的數字可以直接帶到 TouchDesigner。意思大約是輸出走完一次跳動的 90% 所花的時間（底層是一階的 lag，時間常數是秒數除以 2.3）。每秒 30 格和每秒 144 格畫出來的曲線一樣。 它看到的第一個值照單全收，所以不會從 0 慢慢滑進來。布林值算成 0 或 1：lag(mouseIsPressed, 0.2) 就是一個柔軟的開關。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫時會從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 草圖如果自己有叫 lag 的變數或函式，就由草圖保留。OAVp5.chop.lag(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 value 要跟隨的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西（字串、NaN）會直接穿過去，lag 保留原來的狀態。 up 跟上升的秒數：輸出大約花這麼久走完往上跳的 90%。負數算 0。 down 跟下降的秒數。不寫的話跟 up 一樣。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 平順過的數值。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，原樣回傳 value。

It is a CHOP's viewer: each label is one line in a small plot across the page from the 🎹, with the last 4 seconds of the value and its number now. Call it twice in a frame with two labels and you get two lines to compare, raw against smoothed. The scale is at least 0 to 1 and grows to hold whatever the values reach. It lives on the page, not on the canvas: never in a recording or in 📷, and it never takes a click from the sketch. To draw the same line inside the work, use drawTrail(). Only inside draw(): anywhere else it just returns value. ?oav_scope=off hides it, and so does ?oav_hints=off, which is the one thing to know if it does not appear. See scope. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.scope(…) is this function under another name. The lines keep coming from the last second: stop calling it for a second and its line leaves the plot. value The number to watch. A boolean is drawn as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number is returned as it is and not drawn. label The name of this line in the legend. Each label…

它就是 CHOP 的檢視器：每個標籤是一條線，畫在跟 🎹 對角的網頁角落一個小圖上，顯示這個值最近 4 秒的樣子和現在的數字。在一個畫面裡用兩個標籤呼叫兩次，就有兩條線可以比較，例如原始的和平滑過的。刻度至少是 0 到 1，值跑出去就跟著放大。 它在網頁上，不在畫布上：不會錄進影片，也不會進 📷，而且不會搶走草圖的點擊。要把同樣的線畫進作品裡，用 drawTrail()。 只在 draw() 裡有作用：其他地方它只會原樣回傳 value。?oav_scope=off 會把它藏起來，?oav_hints=off 也會，這是它沒出現時唯一要知道的事。見 scope。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.scope(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。線條只保留最近一秒內還有呼叫的：停止呼叫一秒之後，那條線就會從圖上消失。 value 要觀察的數字。布林值畫成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西原樣回傳，也不會畫。 label 這條線在圖例上的名字。每個標籤是一條線，超過 9 個字元的標籤在圖例上會被截短。不寫的話，這條線用編號。 原封不動的 value，所以 circle(x, y, scope(lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4), 'lag') 300) 這樣寫就行。

Ask how hard something is moving rather than where it is: abs(slope(mouseX)) is the mouse speed in pixels per second, and slope(micLevel) jumps up at the start of a word. It is as noisy as its input, so smooth it when it flickers: lag(abs(slope(x)), 0.05, 0.3). Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.slope(…) is this function under another name. value The number to watch. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number keeps the last slope. name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in draw(); with one, the call is the same wherever it is made. The change per second, in the units of value (pixels per second for a pixel position). 0 on the first call, and 0 until @openav/chop has loaded or for an unnamed call outside draw().

問的是東西動得多用力，而不是在哪裡：abs(slope(mouseX)) 是滑鼠每秒移動幾像素，slope(micLevel) 在一個字開頭的時候會往上衝。它的雜訊跟輸入一樣多，閃爍的時候先平滑一下：lag(abs(slope(x)), 0.05, 0.3)。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.slope(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 value 要觀察的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西，就保留上一個斜率。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 每秒的變化量，單位跟 value 一樣（像素位置就是每秒幾像素）。第一次呼叫是 0。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前，以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，也是 0。

Use the total to turn or move something: rotate(speed(TWO_PI)) is one turn a second, x = speed(60) % width slides 60 pixels a second and wraps around. You pass the rate, not the position, so the rate can follow a knob or the microphone (speed(micLevel TWO_PI) spins faster the louder it gets) and the angle never jumps, which frameCount rate would do. Time is in seconds, the same at any frame rate. One frame counts for at most a quarter of a second, so coming back to a hidden tab does not make the shape leap. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. Plenty of sketches have a variable called speed. If yours does, it keeps the name, and OAVp5.chop.speed(…) is this function under another name (third example). rate How much to add per second, in the unit you use the result in (radians for rotate(), pixels for a position). It may change every frame. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by…

用累計值來轉或移動東西：rotate(speed(TWO_PI)) 是每秒轉一圈，x = speed(60) % width 是每秒滑 60 像素，到邊界再繞回來。你傳的是速率，不是位置，所以速率可以跟著旋鈕或麥克風走（speed(micLevel TWO_PI) 越大聲轉越快），角度也不會跳，換成 frameCount rate 就會跳。 時間是以秒計，任何畫面更新率都一樣。一個畫面最多只算四分之一秒，所以從被藏起來的分頁回來時，圖形不會一下子衝出去。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 很多草圖都有一個叫 speed 的變數。你的草圖有的話，名稱就歸你的草圖，而 OAVp5.chop.speed(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字（第三個範例）。 rate 每秒要加多少，單位看你怎麼用結果（給 rotate() 就是弧度，給位置就是像素）。每個畫面都可以不一樣。布林值算成 0 或 1。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 累計值，一開始是 0。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，都回傳 0。

Wrap a target that jumps: circle(width / 2, height / 2, spring(mouseIsPressed ? 300 : 100, 100, 6)). The size does not just glide to the new target (that is lag()): it swings past it, comes back and settles. Stiffness and damping are the two knobs. A stiff, lightly damped spring rings like a ruler on a table. A soft, heavily damped one just eases. A big jump or a low frame rate does not break it: the motion is the same at any frame rate. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.spring(…) is this function under another name. value The target the spring is pulled toward. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. stiffness How fast it swings: 100 swings about 1.6 times a second. Higher is snappier. Negative numbers count as 0. damping How soon it settles: 6 gives two or three bounces, 20 and up none. The edge where it stops bouncing is 2 sqrt(stiffness). name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in draw();…

包住一個會跳的目標：circle(width / 2, height / 2, spring(mouseIsPressed ? 300 : 100, 100, 6))。大小會衝過頭、回來、再穩住，跟單純滑向新目標的 lag() 不一樣。 剛性（stiffness）和阻尼（damping）是兩個旋鈕。很硬、阻尼很小的彈簧像桌邊的尺一樣一直顫。很軟、阻尼很大的就只是緩緩靠近。目標跳很大，或畫面更新率很低，都不會弄壞它：任何更新率的動作都一樣。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.spring(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 value 彈簧被拉向的目標。布林值算成 0 或 1。 stiffness 擺動得多快：100 大約每秒擺 1.6 次。越大越俐落。負數算 0。 damping 多快穩下來：6 會彈兩三下，20 以上就不彈了。剛好不再彈的界線是 2 sqrt(stiffness)。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 彈簧現在的位置。看到的第一個值照單全收。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，原樣回傳 value。

A history to draw or measure: drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 20, 20, width - 40, 100) plots the last three seconds of the microphone level, and Math.max(...trail(x, 2)) is a two-second peak. The values are sampled 60 times a second whatever the frame rate, and the gaps between two frames are interpolated, so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same shape. Change seconds between frames and the history is resized, keeping the newest values. The array you got last frame is never changed afterwards. Nothing to call or declare: write it in draw(). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames. Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in draw(): the first lag() is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an if, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside draw() an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so. OAVp5.chop.trail(…) is this function under another name. To see the line on the canvas use drawTrail(), to see it in the corner of the page use scope(). value The number to record. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number is skipped. seconds How many seconds of history to keep, from 0.05 to 600. name A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in draw(); with one,…

要畫出來或量一量的歷史：drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 20, 20, width - 40, 100) 畫出麥克風音量最近三秒的樣子，Math.max(...trail(x, 2)) 是兩秒內的最高值。不管畫面更新率是多少，都是每秒取 60 個值，兩個畫面之間的空隙用內插補起來，所以每秒 30 格和 144 格得到同樣的形狀。 在畫面之間改 seconds，歷史會跟著調整大小，保留最新的值。上一個畫面拿到的陣列之後不會再被改動。 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 draw() 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 draw() 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 lag() 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 if，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 draw() 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。 OAVp5.chop.trail(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。要在畫布上看這條線用 drawTrail()，要在網頁角落看就用 scope()。 value 要記錄的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西會被略過。 seconds 要保留幾秒的歷史，範圍是 0.05 到 600。 name 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 draw() 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。 大約 seconds 60 + 1 個數字（2 秒是 121 個），每次呼叫都是一個新的陣列。長度從第一次呼叫就固定，並且用第一個值填滿，所以從第一個畫面就能畫。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前，以及在 draw() 外面沒有名字的呼叫，是空陣列。

Call it where the thing happens: function mousePressed() { trigger('boom'); }. Then read it anywhere in draw() with env('boom', 0.01, 0.6) (a pulse that fades) or count('boom') (how many times so far). It returns nothing. It works anywhere, not only in draw(), and each call is one event, remembered with the time it happened. You can fire the built-in names by hand as well: trigger('kick') pulses env('kick') as a real kick would. OAVp5.chop.trigger(…) is this function under another name. name The name of the event. Anything is fine except the built-in meanings: 'kick', 'snare', 'hat', 'beat', 'note', 'bar' and 'step' are also fired by the microphone, the keys and the drum machine. Left out: 'trigger'.

在事情發生的地方呼叫它：function mousePressed() { trigger('boom'); }。然後在 draw() 的任何地方，用 env('boom', 0.01, 0.6)（會退下去的脈衝）或 count('boom')（到現在發生幾次）去讀它。它沒有回傳值。 它在哪裡都能用，不只是 draw()，每呼叫一次就是一個事件，連同發生的時間一起被記下來。內建的名字也可以用手發出：trigger('kick') 會讓 env('kick') 跳一下，就像真的大鼓一樣。 OAVp5.chop.trigger(…) 是同一個函式的另一個名字。 name 事件的名字。隨便取，只是要留意內建的意思：'kick'、'snare'、'hat'、'beat'、'note'、'bar'、'step' 也會被麥克風、琴鍵和鼓機發出。不寫就是 'trigger'。

Every function of this group is also here: OAVp5.chop.lag, .env, .trigger, .speed, .spring, .trail, .slope, .count, .scope and .drawTrail are the same functions as the plain names, for a sketch whose own speed or count keeps the plain name. The rest is for looking inside: state says whether the module is loaded, module is the module itself, slots() lists every memory in use and reset() forgets them. This is advanced: a sketch that only calls lag() and friends never needs it.

這一組的每個函式這裡都有：OAVp5.chop.lag、.env、.trigger、.speed、.spring、.trail、.slope、.count、.scope、.drawTrail 跟一般的名稱是同一批函式，給那些自己的 speed 或 count 保留了一般名稱的草圖用。 其餘的是用來看裡面的：state 說模組載好了沒，module 就是模組本身，slots() 列出正在用的每一個記憶，reset() 把它們忘掉。 這是進階用法：只呼叫 lag() 這些函式的草圖用不到它。

For reaching below the p5-style calls: OAVp5.chop.module.DEFAULTS lists the defaults the functions use, and new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 0.1 }) makes a lag you keep yourself. Check it is not null first. This is advanced. The module is also published as @openav/chop for sketches and shows that do not go through oav-p5. null until the first CHOP function has been called and the module has arrived, then the module (Lag, Spring, Trail, envelope(), DEFAULTS and the rest).

要用到比 p5 風格呼叫更底層的東西時才需要：OAVp5.chop.module.DEFAULTS 列出這些函式用的預設值，new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 0.1 }) 做出一個你自己保管的 lag。先確認它不是 null。 這是進階用法。這個模組也以 @openav/chop 發布，給不經過 oav-p5 的草圖和演出使用。 第一次呼叫 CHOP 函式、而且模組載好之前是 null，之後就是那個模組（Lag、Spring、Trail、envelope()、DEFAULTS 等等）。

The call that follows starts from nothing, as if it were the first one: a speed() total is 0 again, a lag() takes its input as it is, a count() is back at 0. Use it to restart a named effect, for example on a key press. Calling it with no name also drops the unnamed memories. They are made again by order on the next frame, so nothing breaks, but every unnamed value starts over too. Event counts from trigger() are not memories of a call and are not touched. name The name you gave a call as its last argument ('spin' in speed(1, 'spin')). The memory of that name is forgotten in every function that has one. Left out, every memory is forgotten, named or not.

接下來的那次呼叫會從零開始，就像是第一次：speed() 的累計值回到 0，lag() 照單全收輸入，count() 回到 0。想讓某個有名字的效果重新開始時用，例如按一個鍵的時候。 不給名字的時候，沒有名字的記憶也一起丟掉。下一個畫面會重新照順序建立，所以不會壞掉，但每一個沒有名字的值也都重新開始。trigger() 的事件次數不是某個呼叫的記憶，不受影響。 name 你在呼叫的最後一個參數給的名字（speed(1, 'spin') 裡的 'spin'）。每個函式裡那個名字的記憶都會被忘掉。不寫的話，不管有沒有名字，全部忘掉。

For finding out why two calls seem to share a memory, or whether a loop made hundreds: OAVp5.chop.slots().length is how many there are. It reads the state and changes nothing. This is advanced. 🩺 and tests use it; a sketch rarely needs to. One { kind, key, mode, value } per memory. kind is the function ('lag', 'spring', …). key is '#1', '#2' for calls found by order, a name for named ones, or the line of code for calls matched by line. mode says which: 'order', 'name' or 'site'. value is its latest output (missing for a trail).

用來查為什麼兩個呼叫好像共用同一個記憶，或迴圈是不是做出了好幾百個：OAVp5.chop.slots().length 就是現在有幾個。它只讀取狀態，不會改任何東西。 這是進階用法。🩺 和測試會用到，草圖很少需要。 每一個記憶一筆 { kind, key, mode, value }。kind 是哪個函式（'lag'、'spring' …）。key 是靠順序找到的呼叫的 '#1'、'#2'，有名字的就是名字，靠行號對應的就是那一行程式。mode 說明是哪一種：'order'、'name' 或 'site'。value 是它最近一次的輸出（trail 沒有）。

off until one of these functions is first called, loading while @openav/chop arrives (a few frames), on once it is in, error if it could not be loaded: a card says so and every function then passes its input through. trigger() on its own never loads it, because it only records that something happened. Changes the first time a CHOP function is called and once more when the module has arrived. off before any call.
在任何一個函式第一次被呼叫之前是 off，@openav/chop 在載入的時候（幾個畫面）是 loading，載好之後是 on，載不到是 error：這時會跳出卡片，所有函式也都改成把輸入直接穿過去。單獨呼叫 trigger() 不會載入它，因為它只記錄「發生了一件事」。 第一次呼叫 CHOP 函式的時候會變，模組載好時再變一次。在任何呼叫之前是 off。

The smallest piece of smoothing. Call it once per frame, value = approach(value, target, 0.2, dt), and value chases target: 63% of the way after seconds, 90% after 2.3 × seconds, 99% after 4.6 × seconds. It is exact for any dt, so a sketch at 30 fps and one at 144 fps draw the same curve. seconds here is a time constant, which is shorter than the "seconds" of TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP. Lag takes the TouchDesigner kind and divides it by TD_LAG_RATIO before calling this function. @openav/mapping's smooth steps with approach and means the time constant too. Nothing. It is pure arithmetic with no memory: you keep current yourself and pass in the seconds since the last call. For a value with its own memory use Lag. current Where the value is now. target Where it is heading. seconds The time constant: after this many seconds the gap to target has closed by 63% (1 − 1/e). 0, a negative number or NaN jumps straight to target, whatever dt is. dt Seconds since the last step. 0, a negative number or NaN leaves current where it is. The new value, between current and target.

平滑裡最小的一塊。每個畫面呼叫一次，value = approach(value, target, 0.2, dt)，value 就會追著 target 跑：經過 seconds 走完 63%，2.3 × seconds 走完 90%，4.6 × seconds 走完 99%。不管 dt 多大都是精確解，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 畫出同一條曲線。 這裡的 seconds 是時間常數，比 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 的「秒數」短。Lag 收的是 TouchDesigner 那種秒數，會先除以 TD_LAG_RATIO 再呼叫這個函式。@openav/mapping 的 smooth 也是用 approach 一步一步走，意思同樣是時間常數。 不需要先做什麼。它只是算術，沒有記憶：current 由你自己保管，並把距離上次呼叫的秒數傳進來。想要自帶記憶的版本，用 Lag。 current 數值現在的位置。 target 它要去的地方。 seconds 時間常數：經過這麼多秒，與 target 的差距縮小 63%（1 − 1/e）。0、負數或 NaN 會直接跳到 target，不管 dt 是多少。 dt 距離上一步過了幾秒。0、負數或 NaN 時 current 原地不動。 新的數值，落在 current 與 target 之間。

count.step(input, limit) counts a rising edge, the moment the input goes from off to on, not the time it stays on. Hold a button for ten seconds and that is one. With limit 4 the result walks 0 1 2 3 0 1 …, which is how a beat becomes "beat 1 of 4". The counter keeps counting underneath even when you pass a limit, so you can change the limit later without losing your place. A value that is not a number counts as off. In a p5 sketch use count(): count(beat, 4), or count('kick') to count the drum machine's kicks. Nothing to load. Call step every frame, even while the input is off: it has to see the "off" to notice the next "on". It has no dt, because a count does not depend on time. Public fields: threshold, on (is the input on right now) and total (the count before looping). threshold A number counts as "on" when it is above this. A boolean true is 1, false is 0.

count.step(input, limit) 數的是上升的那一下，也就是輸入從關變成開的瞬間，不是開著的時間。按住按鈕十秒也只算一次。給 limit 4，結果會是 0 1 2 3 0 1 …，一個拍子就這樣變成「四拍裡的第幾拍」。 就算給了上限，底下的計數器還是一直累加，所以之後改上限也不會失去進度。不是數字的值算成關。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 count()：count(beat, 4)，或用 count('kick') 數鼓機的大鼓。 不用載入任何東西。每個畫面都呼叫 step，連輸入關著的時候也要：它得看到「關」，才認得出下一次的「開」。它沒有 dt，因為計數跟時間無關。 公開的欄位有 threshold、on（輸入現在是不是開著）和 total（循環之前的計數）。 threshold 數字超過這個值才算「打開」。布林值 true 是 1，false 是 0。

For documentation and for interfaces that show the defaults, such as the placeholder text of a field. The classes and envelope() have these same numbers written in their own signatures; changing this object changes nothing about how they behave. { lag: { up: 0.1, down: 0.1 }, envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.3 }, spring: { stiffness: 100, damping: 6 }, trail: { seconds: 2, rate: 60 }, count: { threshold: 0.5 } }. Frozen: assigning to it does nothing.

給文件和要顯示預設值的介面用，例如輸入欄的提示文字。這些類別和 envelope() 在自己的簽名裡已經寫了同樣的數字。改這個物件不會改變它們的行為。 { lag: { up: 0.1, down: 0.1 }, envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.3 }, spring: { stiffness: 100, damping: 6 }, trail: { seconds: 2, rate: 60 }, count: { threshold: 0.5 } }。已凍結：指定新值不會有作用。

Keep a list of the times something happened (a kick, a key press, a cue) and ask for the level at the time you are drawing: scale(1 + envelope(kicks, now, 0.01, 0.3)). It rises in a straight line to 1 in attack seconds, then falls to 0 in decay seconds, quick at first and landing softly. It is a pure function of the times and of t: ask twice, or at 30 fps and at 144 fps, and the same moment gives the same level; attack and decay may change every frame (a knob on the decay). A new event while the last one still sounds restarts from where the envelope is, never from 0, so fast hits pile up into a plateau instead of flickering. The attack counts from 0 to the peak, so a retrigger from halfway up takes half the attack. In a p5 sketch you do not import it: env() and trigger() keep the event list for you and read the drum machine and the microphone. Nothing to load. You record the event times yourself (for example kicks.push(performance.now() / 1000) when a kick arrives) and pass the same clock as t. times When the events happened, in seconds on any clock you like, oldest first. An empty array (or none) gives 0. Events later than t have not happened yet and are ignored. Only the last few matter, so you can trim the list. t The moment to read, on the same clock as times. attack Seconds to rise from 0 to the peak. 0 starts at the peak at once. decay Seconds to fall back to 0 after the peak: it is exactly 0 from attack + decay seconds after an event. peak The top of the envelope. 0…

把某件事發生的時間（大鼓、按鍵、cue）存成一個清單，畫的時候問它「現在多高」：scale(1 + envelope(kicks, now, 0.01, 0.3))。它在 attack 秒內直線升到 1，再用 decay 秒落回 0，一開始快、收尾柔。 它是 times 和 t 的純函式：問兩次、或在 30 fps 與 144 fps 問同一個時間點，答案一樣。attack 和 decay 每個畫面都可以改（例如用旋鈕調 decay）。上一個事件還沒消散時又來一個，包絡從目前的高度重新出發，不會先掉到 0，所以快速的連擊會堆成一個高原，不會閃爍。起音以 0 到峰值計算，所以從一半高度重新觸發只要一半的起音時間。 在 p5 草圖裡不用 import：env() 和 trigger() 會替你保管事件清單，也會讀鼓機和麥克風。 不用載入任何東西。事件的時間由你自己記（例如大鼓來的時候 kicks.push(performance.now() / 1000)），t 要用同一個時鐘。 times 事件發生的時間，單位是秒，用哪個時鐘都行，最舊的排前面。空陣列（或沒給）回傳 0。比 t 晚的事件還沒發生，會被忽略。只有最後幾筆有影響，所以可以把舊的剪掉。 t 要讀取的時間點，跟 times 用同一個時鐘。 attack 從 0 升到峰值要幾秒。0 就一開始直接在峰值。 decay 到達峰值後落回 0 要幾秒：事件之後 attack + decay 秒起正好是 0。 peak 包絡的最高點。 0 到 peak：事件剛發生時是 peak，消散之後是 0。

The building block of envelope(), which strings several of these together for a list of events. On its own it answers: "how high is a kick that happened elapsed seconds ago?" With the defaults of envelope() (attack 0.01, decay 0.3) it is 0.5 at 5 ms, 1 at 10 ms, 0.49 at 100 ms and 0 from 310 ms on. The fall is quick at first and lands softly: that is the shape a kick drum swell looks right with. It reaches 0 in exactly decay seconds, not asymptotically. Advanced. Most sketches never call it: use envelope(), or env() in p5. elapsed Seconds since the trigger. Below 0 (or NaN) gives from. attack Seconds to rise from 0 to peak. 0 or less starts at the peak at once. decay Seconds to fall from peak to 0, along (1 − u)² where u runs 0 to 1. 0 or less drops to 0 right after the attack. from The level at the moment of the trigger. The attack still counts from 0 to the peak, so starting from halfway up takes half the attack. peak The top of the envelope. The level, from 0 to peak.

envelope() 的基本零件，它把好幾個這樣的片段串起來處理一串事件。單獨使用時，它回答的是：「elapsed 秒前發生的一次大鼓，現在有多高？」用 envelope() 的預設值（attack 0.01、decay 0.3），5 毫秒時是 0.5，10 毫秒是 1，100 毫秒是 0.49，310 毫秒起是 0。 下降一開始很快、收尾很柔：大鼓的律動配這個形狀看起來最對。它剛好在 decay 秒落到 0，不是無限接近。 進階用法。大部分草圖不會直接呼叫它：請用 envelope()，p5 裡用 env()。 elapsed 觸發之後過了幾秒。小於 0（或 NaN）時回傳 from。 attack 從 0 升到 peak 要幾秒。0 或更小就一開始直接在峰值。 decay 從 peak 落到 0 要幾秒，走 (1 − u)² 的曲線（u 從 0 跑到 1）。0 或更小就在起音結束後立刻變 0。 from 觸發當下的高度。起音仍然以 0 到峰值計算，所以從一半高度開始只要一半的起音時間。 peak 包絡的最高點。 高度，從 0 到 peak。

Make one Lag per value you want to smooth, then call step(input, dt) once per frame. new Lag({ up: 0.03, down: 0.4 }) is a VU meter: it opens almost at once and closes slowly. up and down are in TouchDesigner's seconds: with up: 1, a jump from 0 to 1 is at 0.9 one second later, at 30, 60 or 144 fps alike. Each step is the exact answer for an input held at its new value over dt seconds, so the frame rate does not change the curve. A boolean counts as 0 or 1 (lag.step(mouseIsPressed, dt) is a soft switch). A value that is not a number, such as NaN, comes back untouched and leaves the memory as it was. In a p5 sketch you do not import this: lag() keeps one Lag per call for you. Nothing to load or start. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt (in a browser: the difference of two performance.now() / 1000). The first step only stores the input, so the output equals the input on frame one. Public fields: up, down and value, the last output (null until the first step). You can change up and down any time. The time constant underneath is seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO (see TD_LAG_RATIO), not seconds. If you want the plain 63% kind, call approach(). up Seconds to follow a rise, while the input is above the output. TouchDesigner's seconds: about the time to cover 90% of a jump. 0 follows at once. down Seconds to follow a fall, while the input is below the output. Leave it out and it is the same as up. value A starting value. Leave it out and the first input is taken as it is, so…

每一個要平滑的數值做一個 Lag，每個畫面呼叫一次 step(input, dt)。new Lag({ up: 0.03, down: 0.4 }) 就是音量表：幾乎立刻張開，慢慢收回。up 和 down 用 TouchDesigner 的秒數：up: 1 的話，從 0 跳到 1 之後一秒是 0.9，30、60 或 144 fps 都一樣。 每一步都是「輸入在這 dt 秒內維持新值」的精確解，所以影格率不會改變曲線。布林值算成 0 或 1（lag.step(mouseIsPressed, dt) 是柔和的開關）。不是數字的值（像 NaN）原樣傳回，記憶不受影響。 在 p5 草圖裡不用 import 它：lag() 會替每一個呼叫保管一個 Lag。 不用載入或啟動任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來（瀏覽器裡：兩次 performance.now() / 1000 的差）。第一次 step 只是把輸入記下來，所以第一個畫面輸出等於輸入。 公開的欄位有 up、down 和 value（最後一次的輸出，第一次 step 之前是 null）。up、down 隨時可以改。 底層的時間常數是 seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO（見 TD_LAG_RATIO），不是 seconds。想要單純 63% 那一種，直接呼叫 approach()。 up 追上升高的輸入要幾秒（輸入比輸出高的時候）。用 TouchDesigner 的秒數：大約是走完 90% 跳躍的時間。0 表示立刻跟上。 down 追上降低的輸入要幾秒（輸入比輸出低的時候）。不給就跟 up 一樣。 value 起始值。不給的話，第一個輸入原樣當作輸出，所以不會從 0 慢慢滑進來。

slope.step(value, dt) returns (value − previous value) / dt. A value rising by 3 every second gives 3 at any frame rate; a value that stands still gives 0; a falling one gives a negative number. Use it for "how hard did the knob just move": scale(1 + abs(slope.step(knob, dt))). It has no smoothing: a single jump of the input is one big spike for one step. Put the result through a Lag if you want it to fade. A dt of 0 or less changes nothing and returns the last slope, and a value that is not a number returns the last slope too. In a p5 sketch use slope(). Nothing to load. The first step only stores the value and returns 0, because there is no earlier value to compare with. The last slope is the public field value.

slope.step(value, dt) 回傳 (value − 上一個值) / dt。每秒升 3 的數值，在任何影格率下都回傳 3，沒動的數值是 0，往下掉的是負數。用來表達「旋鈕剛剛轉得多用力」：scale(1 + abs(slope.step(knob, dt)))。 它不做任何平滑：輸入跳一下，就是一步裡的一根大尖峰。想讓它淡出，把結果交給 Lag。dt 是 0 或更小，什麼都不改，回傳上一次的斜率。值不是數字時也回傳上一次的斜率。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 slope()。 不用載入任何東西。第一次 step 只是把值記下來並回傳 0，因為沒有更早的值可以比。 最近一次的斜率是公開欄位 value。

speed.step(rate, dt) adds rate dt to the total and returns it. With rate 1 the total grows by 1 every second; rotate(speed.step(TWO_PI, dt)) is one turn a second. Feed it a rate that changes (a knob, micLevel) and the motion speeds up and slows down smoothly, without the jump you get from multiplying frameCount by it. It is the integral of the rate, so it is the same at any frame rate. A boolean rate counts as 1 per second while true. A rate that is not a number, or a dt of 0 or less, adds nothing. In a p5 sketch use speed(), which keeps one for each call. Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt. The total is the public field value. value The starting total. Anything that is not a finite number starts at 0.

speed.step(rate, dt) 把 rate dt 加到累計值裡並回傳。rate 是 1 的話，累計值每秒增加 1。rotate(speed.step(TWO_PI, dt)) 就是每秒轉一圈。餵給它會變動的速率（旋鈕、micLevel），動作會平順地變快變慢，不會像把 frameCount 乘上速率那樣一跳一跳。 它是速率的積分，所以不論影格率都一樣。布林值的速率在 true 的時候算每秒 1。速率不是數字、或 dt 是 0 或更小，就什麼都不加。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 speed()，它會替每個呼叫保管一個。 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來。 累計值就是公開欄位 value。 value 累計值的起點。不是有限數字的話就從 0 開始。

Make one Spring per value, call step(target, dt) once per frame and draw what it returns. With the defaults (stiffness 100, damping 6), a jump of the input from 0 to 1 sends the output to 1.37 after a third of a second, and it is within 1% of 1 from about 1.4 s on. Raise the damping to 20 and it glides to the target without overshooting. Each step is the exact answer from springStep(), so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same motion and a long frame cannot blow it up. The input is the position it is pulled toward; a boolean counts as 0 or 1; a value that is not a number is returned as it is and changes nothing. In a p5 sketch use spring(). Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt. The first step only stores the input (the spring starts at rest on it). Public fields: stiffness, damping, value (the position; null before the first step) and velocity. stiffness How hard the spring pulls, so how fast it swings. With nothing damping it, it swings about √stiffness / 2π times a second (100 is about 1.6). damping How soon it settles. 6 with a stiffness of 100 bounces a few times; 2 √stiffness (20 for 100) and above never bounces. value A starting position. Leave it out and the first input is taken as it is, so it does not swing in from 0.

每個數值做一個 Spring，每個畫面呼叫一次 step(target, dt)，畫它回傳的值。用預設值（stiffness 100、damping 6）的話，輸入從 0 跳到 1，輸出在約三分之一秒時衝到 1.37，大約 1.4 秒之後就落在 1 的 1% 以內。把 damping 調到 20，它就會滑到目標上，不衝過頭。 每一步都是 springStep() 的精確解，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 動得一樣，一個很長的畫面也不會讓它發散。輸入是它被拉向的位置，布林值算成 0 或 1，不是數字的值原樣傳回，什麼都不改。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 spring()。 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來。第一次 step 只是把輸入記下來（彈簧就靜止在那裡開始）。 公開的欄位有 stiffness、damping、value（位置，第一次 step 之前是 null）和 velocity。 stiffness 彈簧拉得多用力，也就是擺動多快。沒有阻尼的時候，每秒大約擺 √stiffness / 2π 次（100 大約是 1.6 次）。 damping 多快安定下來。stiffness 100 配 damping 6 會彈幾下。2 √stiffness（100 的話是 20）以上就完全不彈。 value 起始位置。不給的話，第一個輸入原樣當作位置，所以不會從 0 擺進來。

Solves x'' = −stiffness·(x − target) − damping·x' exactly over dt for a target that stays still during the step. It handles all three cases (under-damped: it bounces; critically damped; over-damped: it creeps) and a huge dt never blows up, which is why a sketch can fall behind for a whole second and the spring just lands on the target. damping = 2 Math.sqrt(stiffness) is the edge where it stops bouncing: with stiffness 100 that is a damping of 20. With no spring (stiffness 0) only the damping acts and the velocity just fades. Advanced. The Spring class holds the position and the velocity for you and calls this. x The position now. v The velocity now, in units per second. target Where the other end of the spring is held. stiffness How hard it pulls. Negative counts as 0. damping How much friction slows it. Negative counts as 0. dt Seconds to advance. 0 or less (or NaN) returns [x, v] unchanged. The new position and velocity.

對 dt 這段時間內 target 不動的情況，精確解 x'' = −stiffness·(x − target) − damping·x'。欠阻尼（會彈）、臨界阻尼、過阻尼（慢慢爬）三種情況都處理，而且 dt 再大也不會發散，所以草圖卡了一整秒，彈簧也只是落在目標上。 damping = 2 Math.sqrt(stiffness) 是剛好不再彈的臨界點：stiffness 是 100 的話，就是 damping 20。沒有彈簧（stiffness 為 0）的時候只剩阻尼作用，速度慢慢消失。 進階用法。Spring 類別會替你保管位置與速度，並呼叫這個函式。 x 現在的位置。 v 現在的速度，單位是每秒多少單位。 target 彈簧另一端固定的位置。 stiffness 拉得多用力。負數當作 0。 damping 摩擦力多大。負數當作 0。 dt 要前進幾秒。0 或更小（或 NaN）原樣回傳 [x, v]。 新的位置與速度。

TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP quotes its seconds as roughly the time the output takes to follow 90% of a change. A one-pole lag reaches 90% after ln 10 time constants, so seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO is the time constant to hand to approach(). Lag does exactly that, which is why lag(x, 0.1) in a p5 sketch moves like a Lag CHOP set to 0.1. You only need it when you mix the two kinds of seconds: a time constant tau is tdSeconds / TD_LAG_RATIO, and tdSeconds is tau TD_LAG_RATIO. Attack and decay of an envelope() are plain lengths and are not converted. Exactly Math.LN10, 2.302585092994046. A fixed number: it never changes.

TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 把秒數定義成大約是輸出追上 90% 變化所花的時間。一階低通要走 ln 10 個時間常數才到 90%，所以 seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO 就是該交給 approach() 的時間常數。Lag 做的正是這件事，所以 p5 草圖裡的 lag(x, 0.1) 動起來就像把 Lag CHOP 設成 0.1。 只有在兩種秒數混著用的時候才會用到它：時間常數 tau 等於 tdSeconds / TD_LAG_RATIO，tdSeconds 等於 tau TD_LAG_RATIO。envelope() 的 attack 和 decay 是單純的長度，不用換算。 就是 Math.LN10，2.302585092994046。固定的數字，不會變。

trail.step(value, dt) returns an array of seconds rate past values followed by this step's input at the end, so the array is seconds rate + 1 long (121 for the defaults). Draw it across the canvas as a line: that is a scope of the value. The length is fixed from the first step, filled with the first value, so a sketch can draw the whole line from frame one. The values are interpolated between steps, so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same line. A gap longer than the whole window (a tab that was hidden) restarts it filled with the new value. In a p5 sketch use trail() and drawTrail(). Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as dt. A value that is not a number leaves the history as it is and returns the current list. seconds How many seconds of history to keep. 0 or less falls back to 2. rate Values per second in the list. 0 or less falls back to 60.

trail.step(value, dt) 回傳一個陣列：seconds rate 個過去的值，最後接上這一步的輸入，所以長度是 seconds rate + 1（預設是 121）。把它橫跨畫布畫成一條線，就是這個數值的示波器。 長度從第一步就固定，用第一個值填滿，所以草圖從第一個畫面就能畫出整條線。步與步之間會內插，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 得到同一條線。如果有一段空檔比整個視窗還長（例如分頁被藏起來），就用新的值填滿重新開始。 在 p5 草圖裡請用 trail() 和 drawTrail()。 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 dt 傳進來。不是數字的值不會改動歷史，只是回傳目前的清單。 seconds 要保留幾秒的歷史。0 或更小的話改用 2。 rate 清單裡每秒幾個值。0 或更小的話改用 60。

The modulo that Count uses, made safe for negative numbers: wrapCount(-1, 4) is 3, where -1 % 4 is -1. It is useful on its own for anything that loops, such as a step number: wrapCount(frameCount, 16). total The count so far. limit How many values to loop through. A fraction is rounded down. 0, a negative number, or no value at all returns total unchanged. total looped into 0 … limit − 1 (never negative, even for a negative total).

Count 使用的取餘數，並且對負數也安全：wrapCount(-1, 4) 是 3，而 -1 % 4 是 -1。拿來處理任何要循環的東西也很方便，例如步序編號：wrapCount(frameCount, 16)。 total 目前累計的次數。 limit 要循環幾個值。小數會無條件捨去。0、負數或沒給，就原樣回傳 total。 循環到 0 … limit − 1 的 total（就算 total 是負的，結果也不會是負的）。

Use it to keep things out of the video: if (!recordingIsOn) text('press r to record', 20, 30);, because everything on the canvas is recorded. Use it for a key that toggles: recordingIsOn ? stopRecording() : startRecording(). It changes when a take starts and when it ends, and reading it never starts anything. For the other stages (starting, saving) read OAVp5.record.state. A sketch that declares its own variable called recordingIsOn keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read OAVp5.record.state === 'on' instead. True while a take runs. It is false at the start, while the recorder is still loading, from the moment stopRecording() is called (the file is then being made) and after the take.

用它把東西留在影片之外：if (!recordingIsOn) text('press r to record', 20, 30);，因為畫布上的所有東西都會被錄進去。也可以用在開關鍵上：recordingIsOn ? stopRecording() : startRecording()。它只在錄影開始和結束的時候改變，讀它不會啟動任何東西。想知道其他階段（starting、saving），請讀 OAVp5.record.state。 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 recordingIsOn 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 OAVp5.record.state === 'on'。 錄影進行中是 true。一開始、錄影程式還在載入、從呼叫 stopRecording() 的那一刻起（檔案這時還在製作）、以及錄完之後，都是 false。

Define function recordingSaved(info) { … } to know when the file is done: stopRecording() or the end of seconds leads to it. By then the file has already been handed to the browser to download. The same info is given to the promise of stopRecording() and to OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn), and stays in OAVp5.record.last. info.url works as a link to the file (createA(info.url, 'play') or a ) until a minute after the next take is saved. warnings is what the card after the take says in words; an empty list means nothing looked wrong. info name (the file name), format ('mp4' or 'webm'), type (the exact MIME type), seconds (length, to a tenth), bytes, width and height (even numbers for MP4), fps, audio (the video has a sound track), heard (something sounded), sources (which sounds were in it: 'sound', 'drums', 'mic', 'p5sound'), warnings (what looked wrong: 'recEmpty', 'recWebm', 'recNoAudio', 'recSilent', 'recBlack', usually an empty list), blob (the file) and url (an address for the blob).

定義 function recordingSaved(info) { … }，就知道檔案什麼時候好了：stopRecording() 或 seconds 時間到之後會走到這裡。那時檔案已經交給瀏覽器下載了。同一份 info 也會交給 stopRecording() 回傳的 promise 和 OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn)，並且留在 OAVp5.record.last。 info.url 可以當成檔案的連結用（createA(info.url, 'play') 或 ），直到下一支錄好之後一分鐘為止。warnings 是錄完之後卡片用文字說的那些事，空的清單表示沒有哪裡不對。 info name（檔名）、format（'mp4' 或 'webm'）、type（精確的 MIME 類型）、seconds（長度，精確到 0.1 秒）、bytes、width 和 height（MP4 會是偶數）、fps、audio（影片有沒有音軌）、heard（有沒有真的出過聲）、sources（錄進去的聲音來源：'sound'、'drums'、'mic'、'p5sound'）、warnings（看起來哪裡不對：'recEmpty'、'recWebm'、'recNoAudio'、'recSilent'、'recBlack'，通常是空的）、blob（檔案本身）、url（blob 的位址）。

Start it from a key or a click: if (key === 'r') startRecording();. What goes into the video is the canvas alone, at its own pixel size (a retina screen doubles it), and everything your sketch sounds like: the instrument of startSound(), the drum machine, the pads, the microphone while it is on, and p5.sound 1.x, mixed into one track while the speakers play as before. The 🎹, the drum grid and the cards are part of the page, not of the canvas, so they are never in the video. A sound that comes on during the take joins it. The file is MP4 (H.264 + AAC, which Instagram, YouTube and every editor take) where the browser can write it, and WebM where not; a card says Instagram will not take a WebM. It is named oav-20261015-183005.mp4, with name in the middle when you give one. When the take is done it is downloaded, and on a phone that can share files a Share button appears on the card. After stopRecording(), or when seconds has run out, recordingSaved(info) is called with the details. Without seconds a take stops by itself at the longest length (300 seconds unless the reclimit option says otherwise). Without bitrate the quality follows the canvas: 0.16 bits per pixel per frame, kept between 4 and 16 megabits a second (24 above 30 frames a second). Calling startRecording() while a take is running starts nothing new. After every take a card says what was recorded and, when something looks wrong, what and why: nothing reached the sound track although a sound was on, WebM, a file…

從按鍵或點擊啟動：if (key === 'r') startRecording();。進影片的只有畫布本身（用畫布自己的像素大小，視網膜螢幕會是兩倍），加上你的草圖發出的所有聲音：startSound() 的樂器、鼓機、打擊墊、開著的麥克風、p5.sound 1.x，混成一條音軌，喇叭照常播放。🎹、鼓機格子和提示卡片是頁面的一部分，不在畫布上，所以不會出現在影片裡。錄到一半才開起來的聲音也會加入。 瀏覽器寫得出 MP4 的話，檔案就是 MP4（H.264 + AAC，Instagram、YouTube 和所有剪輯軟體都吃），不然就是 WebM，這時會有卡片說 Instagram 不收 WebM。檔名像 oav-20261015-183005.mp4，有給 name 的話會放在中間。錄完會自動下載，在能分享檔案的手機上，卡片會出現「分享」按鈕。呼叫 stopRecording() 之後，或 seconds 時間到了，會呼叫 recordingSaved(info) 並把細節交給它。沒給 seconds 的話，錄到最長長度就會自己停（預設 300 秒，載入選項 reclimit 可以改）。 沒給 bitrate 的話，畫質跟著畫布大小走：每個像素、每一格 0.16 位元，限制在每秒 4 到 16 百萬位元之間（每秒超過 30 格時是 24）。已經在錄的時候再呼叫 startRecording()，不會開新的一支。每支錄完之後，卡片會說錄了什麼，有地方不對的話還會說是什麼、為什麼：有聲音開著、卻沒有任何東西進到音軌、WebM、幾乎是空的檔案、畫布明明不是黑的、影片卻是黑的。 瀏覽器要有 MediaRecorder，沒有的話會跳出卡片說明，promise 也會 resolve 成 false。畫面馬上就錄，但頁面要有一次點擊或按鍵之後才能發聲，所以在第一次點擊之前開始的錄影，一開始是沒有聲音可錄的。畫布上如果有別的網站來的圖片（沒有 CORS），就錄不了，卡片會告訴你。 在 🎹 面板裡，⏺ 不用寫程式就能開始和停止錄影，📷 把畫布存成 PNG（見 OAVp5.record.shot()）。錄影的時候，🎹 按鈕上會有紅點和時間。載入選項 record（on、nomic 或 off）、recfps、reclimit、title 可以設定預設值。 麥克風開著的時候會錄進影片：請戴耳機，不然喇叭的聲音會被錄兩次。p5 2.x 用的 p5.sound 把每個聲音直接接到喇叭，沒辦法錄（卡片會說明），請改用 p5 1.11，或用 startSound() 和 startDrums()。草圖自己用 Tone.js 或 Web Audio 程式發出的聲音，同樣不會被錄進去。 畫在畫布上的東西都會進影片，所以提示文字只在 recordingIsOn 是 false 的時候畫。 o 給數字就是秒數：startRecording(10) 錄十秒後自己停。給物件的話，可以放 seconds（同樣是秒數，不會超過一支影片的長度上限，預設 300）、fps（每秒幾格，最多 60，預設 30）、mic（false 就不把麥克風錄進影片）、name（檔名裡的一個詞）、canvas（要錄的畫布：、p5 畫布或 createGraphics() 的緩衝區，預設是頁面上最大的那張 p5 畫布）和 bitrate（每秒幾位元）。不傳就一直錄到呼叫 stopRecording()。 錄影開始之後 resolve 成 true（已經在錄的話也是 true）。載入選項 record 是…

It ends a take that has no seconds, or ends one early. recordingIsOn turns false at once, while the file is made (OAVp5.record.state is 'saving' until then), so the promise or recordingSaved() is how you know the file is ready. Both come after a fraction of a second, a little more for a long take. Resolves, once the file is saved and checked, to the same info that recordingSaved(info) gets. Resolves to null at once when nothing is recording, or when the recording was still starting (nothing was recorded then).

用來結束沒有給 seconds 的錄影，或是提早結束。recordingIsOn 馬上變成 false，檔案這時還在製作（OAVp5.record.state 在那之前是 'saving'），所以要用 promise 或 recordingSaved() 才知道檔案好了。兩者都在不到一秒之後，很長的一支會再久一點。 檔案存好、檢查完之後，resolve 成跟 recordingSaved(info) 拿到的同一份 info。沒有在錄、或錄影還在啟動中（那時還沒錄到東西）的時候，馬上 resolve 成 null。

OAVp5.record (also reachable as midi.record) is what startRecording(), stopRecording() and recordingIsOn are built on. It holds the state of the recording, how many seconds it has run, the last file's info, the sources in the take, and the fps and limit in force. formats() says what the browser can write, shot() saves a PNG of the canvas and on() listens to 'start' and 'saved'. start and stop are the same as the two global functions. For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, the console and debugging.

OAVp5.record（也可以用 midi.record 取得）是 startRecording()、stopRecording() 和 recordingIsOn 的底層。裡面有錄影的 state、已經錄了多少 seconds、last 最後一支檔案的 info、這一支裡有哪些聲音來源 sources，以及生效的 fps 和 limit。formats() 說明瀏覽器能寫什麼格式，shot() 把畫布存成 PNG，on() 監聽 'start' 和 'saved'。start 和 stop 跟那兩個全域函式一模一樣。 一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、主控台和除錯用的。

Use it before you offer a recording button, or to tell the person which file they will get: MP4 goes to Instagram and every editor, WebM does not. It asks the browser each time you call it. recorder is true when the browser has MediaRecorder at all, mp4 and webm are true when it can write that format, and mime is the MIME type a recording asks for first (MP4 where possible), or '' when none works.
在你要提供錄影按鈕之前用它，或是告訴使用的人會拿到哪種檔案：MP4 可以直接上傳 Instagram，也能放進所有剪輯軟體，WebM 不行。每次呼叫都會重新問一次瀏覽器。 recorder 表示瀏覽器到底有沒有 MediaRecorder，mp4 和 webm 表示能不能寫那種格式，mime 是錄影最先要求的 MIME 類型（可以的話是 MP4），都不行的話是 ''。

They are there to read: OAVp5.record.limit tells a sketch how long a take can be. Writing to them changes nothing, because a take reads the options, not these two. To record at another frame rate once, pass startRecording({ fps: 60 }); to change the limit, set the reclimit option before oav-p5 loads (window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: 600 }). fps is 30 and limit is 300 unless the options say otherwise (fps is kept between 1 and 60).

它們是拿來讀的：OAVp5.record.limit 讓草圖知道一支影片最長能錄多久。對它們賦值沒有作用，因為錄影讀的是載入選項，不是這兩個值。想用別的格率錄一次，就傳 startRecording({ fps: 60 })，要改長度上限，在 oav-p5 載入之前設定 reclimit 選項（window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: 600 }）。 fps 預設是 30，limit 預設是 300，除非載入選項另外設定（fps 會被限制在 1 到 60 之間）。

Handy when you did not keep info in recordingSaved(): show the last file name, or put OAVp5.record.last.url in a link. The address stays valid until a minute after the next take is saved. Replaced each time a take is saved. See recordingSaved() for its fields.
當你沒有在 recordingSaved() 裡把 info 存下來的時候很方便：顯示最後一支的檔名，或把 OAVp5.record.last.url 放進連結。這個位址會一直有效，直到下一支存好之後一分鐘。 每存好一支就換成新的。欄位見 recordingSaved()。

recordingSaved() is a single function that you define. on() is for the cases where that does not fit: several listeners, a library, a listener you want to remove again. It is the same idea as OAVp5.drums.on() and midi.on(). An error thrown inside fn is printed and the other listeners still run. name 'start' (a take began) or 'saved' (a file is saved, like recordingSaved()). Any other name throws an error that lists the two. fn For 'start' it gets { width, height, fps, type, seconds } (seconds is 0 when no length was asked for). For 'saved' it gets the same info as recordingSaved(). A function: call it to stop listening.

recordingSaved() 是你定義的單一函式。on() 是給不適用的情況：好幾個監聽者、函式庫、或是想把監聽者再拿掉。概念跟 OAVp5.drums.on() 和 midi.on() 一樣。fn 裡丟出的錯誤會被印出來，其他監聽者照樣執行。 name 'start'（一支錄影開始了）或 'saved'（檔案存好了，跟 recordingSaved() 一樣）。其他的名字會丟出錯誤，並列出這兩個。 fn 'start' 拿到的是 { width, height, fps, type, seconds }（沒指定長度的話 seconds 是 0）。'saved' 拿到的是跟 recordingSaved() 一樣的 info。 一個函式，呼叫它就停止監聽。

Use it as a clock that starts with the take: const t = recordingIsOn ? OAVp5.record.seconds : 0; makes an animation that always begins at 0 in the video. It is the time since the recording began, not the time of the sketch, so it does not count the moment before startRecording(). 0 at the start, then refreshed four times a second while recording. When the take is saved it is that take's length, and the next take sets it back to 0.
當成跟著這一支錄影一起開始的時鐘：const t = recordingIsOn ? OAVp5.record.seconds : 0; 做出來的動畫，在影片裡一定從 0 開始。它是錄影開始之後的時間，不是草圖的時間，所以不包含 startRecording() 之前的那段。 一開始是 0，錄影中每秒更新四次。檔案存好之後是那一支的長度，下一支開始的時候又歸零。

It is the button 📷 in the 🎹 panel as a function. The file is named oav-20261015-183005.png (with name in the middle when you give one) and is downloaded at once; on a phone that can share files a Share button appears on a card instead. The picture has the size of the canvas in pixels, so a retina screen gives twice the width and height. p5's own saveCanvas('name', 'png') does the same thing without the card. With the loading option record=off the 📷 button is gone and startRecording() does nothing, but this function still saves the PNG (tried). o Options: canvas (the canvas to save: a , a p5 canvas or a createGraphics() buffer; the biggest p5 canvas on the page by default) and name (a word for the file name). Resolves to { name, blob, url, width, height, bytes }, or to null when there is no canvas or it cannot be read (an image from another site on it, no CORS).

就是 🎹 面板裡 📷 按鈕的函式版。檔名像 oav-20261015-183005.png（有給 name 的話會放在中間），馬上下載，在能分享檔案的手機上，會改成在卡片上出現「分享」按鈕。圖片的大小就是畫布的像素大小，所以視網膜螢幕的寬和高會是兩倍。p5 自己的 saveCanvas('name', 'png') 做的是同一件事，只是沒有卡片。 載入選項 record=off 的時候，📷 按鈕會消失，startRecording() 也什麼都不做，但這個函式仍然可以存 PNG（實際試過）。 o 選項：canvas（要存的畫布：、p5 畫布或 createGraphics() 的緩衝區，預設是頁面上最大的 p5 畫布）和 name（檔名裡的一個詞）。 resolve 成 { name, blob, url, width, height, bytes }，找不到畫布、或畫布讀不出來（上面有別的網站來的圖片，沒有 CORS）的時候是 null。

It is what the take has connected, not whether something is audible at this moment. A source that is switched on halfway joins the list within a quarter of a second. After the take, recordingSaved() gives the final list in info.sources. A new list on every read. 'sound' is the instrument of startSound(), 'drums' the drum machine and the pads, 'mic' the microphone, 'p5sound' p5.sound 1.x.
它是這一支已經接上的來源，不是此刻有沒有聲音聽得到。錄到一半才打開的來源，會在四分之一秒內加進清單。錄完之後，最終的清單在 recordingSaved() 的 info.sources 裡。 每次讀都是一份新的清單。'sound' 是 startSound() 的樂器，'drums' 是鼓機和打擊墊，'mic' 是麥克風，'p5sound' 是 p5.sound 1.x。

recordingIsOn is state === 'on'. Read the state when the other stages matter: a button can show "starting…" and "saving…" and refuse a new take while one is being saved. Starts as 'off'. A take goes 'starting' (the recorder is loading, the first time), 'on' (recording), 'saving' (the file is being made) and back to 'off'.
recordingIsOn 就是 state === 'on'。其他階段有影響的時候才需要讀它：按鈕可以顯示「啟動中……」和「儲存中……」，在檔案還在存的時候不接受新的一支。 一開始是 'off'。一支錄影會依序是 'starting'（錄影程式載入中，第一次才會有）、'on'（錄影中）、'saving'（檔案製作中），然後回到 'off'。

AAC in an .m4a file comes first because it imports into every DAW and editor. This is the list a Recorder with audioOnly: true uses, through pickMime(). A frozen list of 5 strings: audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2, audio/webm;codecs=opus, audio/ogg;codecs=opus, audio/mp4, audio/webm.
AAC 的 .m4a 檔排第一，因為它每個 DAW 和剪輯軟體都能匯入。audioOnly: true 的 Recorder 用的就是這份清單，透過 pickMime()。 一份凍結的清單，有 5 個字串：audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2、audio/webm;codecs=opus、audio/ogg;codecs=opus、audio/mp4、audio/webm。

Recording the speakers with a microphone gives you the room. Tapping the Web Audio graph gives you the instrument exactly as it was synthesized, on the same clock as the canvas. An AudioTap has two buses and two outputs.
