The work bus is the sound of the piece; the extra bus is for things that belong in the video but not in the sound file, such as a microphone. tap.stream and tap.tracks are work and extras together (give them to the video Recorder); tap.workStream and tap.workTracks are the work alone (for the separate audio file). Both are a single track, on purpose: Chrome records only the first audio track of a stream. The tap never routes anything to the speakers, so adding a microphone cannot feed back. To record a sketch you did not write (p5.sound, Tone.js, Sound), call captureDestination() before the work starts its sound: from then on every node that connects to a speaker destination is tapped too. An AudioContext that is running. Browsers start audio only after a click, so call tap.resume() from a click handler. Without the click the tracks exist but carry silence. context The AudioContext to mix in, usually the work's own. One is made if you leave it out; it needs Web Audio to exist. sources Things to add to the work bus at once: AudioNodes, MediaStreams or MediaStreamTracks (see add()). captureDestination Also call captureDestination() right away.

用麥克風錄喇叭，錄到的是房間。接上 Web Audio 的節點圖，錄到的是樂器合成出來的原樣，而且跟畫布用同一個時鐘。AudioTap 有兩條匯流排和兩個輸出。work 匯流排是作品的聲音，extra 匯流排放的是該在影片裡、卻不該在聲音檔裡的東西，例如麥克風。tap.stream 和 tap.tracks 是 work 加 extra（交給影片的 Recorder），tap.workStream 和 tap.workTracks 只有 work（給另外存的聲音檔）。兩個都只有一條音軌，這是故意的：Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。 這個 tap 絕不會把東西送到喇叭，所以加麥克風不會產生回授。要錄不是你寫的草圖（p5.sound、Tone.js、Sound），就在作品開始出聲之前呼叫 captureDestination()：從那時起，每個接到喇叭的節點也會被接進來。 要有正在跑的 AudioContext。瀏覽器要點擊過才讓聲音開始，所以在點擊的處理函式裡呼叫 tap.resume()。沒有點擊的話，音軌雖然存在，裡面是靜音。 context 要在哪個 AudioContext 裡混音，通常是作品自己的。沒給的話會新建一個，需要瀏覽器有 Web Audio。 sources 要馬上加進作品匯流排的東西：AudioNode、MediaStream 或 MediaStreamTrack（見 add()）。 captureDestination 同時馬上呼叫 captureDestination()。

Size and rate are ideal, never exact: a camera that cannot do 1920 by 1080 should open at what it can, not throw in front of an audience. It is pure, so you can look at what openCamera() will ask for. The stream has no audio: a microphone is added through AudioTap. deviceId A specific camera, from listCameras(). It is asked for as exact: if it is gone, opening fails. width The width to ask for, as ideal. height The height to ask for, as ideal. fps The frame rate to ask for, as ideal. facingMode 'user' or 'environment' on a phone. Ignored when a deviceId is given. A MediaStreamConstraints: { video: { width: { ideal }, height: { ideal }, frameRate: { ideal }, deviceId?, facingMode? }, audio: false }.

尺寸和畫格率是 ideal，不是 exact：做不到 1920 乘 1080 的鏡頭應該用它做得到的規格開起來，而不是在觀眾面前丟出錯誤。它是純函式，所以你可以看 openCamera() 會要求什麼。串流裡沒有聲音：麥克風要透過 AudioTap 加。 deviceId 指定哪一個鏡頭，來自 listCameras()。用 exact 要求：如果它不見了，就會開啟失敗。 width 想要的寬，用 ideal 要求。 height 想要的高，用 ideal 要求。 fps 想要的畫格率，用 ideal 要求。 facingMode 手機上的 'user'（前鏡頭）或 'environment'（後鏡頭）。有給 deviceId 時會被忽略。 一個 MediaStreamConstraints：{ video: { width: { ideal }, height: { ideal }, frameRate: { ideal }, deviceId?, facingMode? }, audio: false }。

The rules: numbers are rounded to 6 decimals, and NaN and infinities become null. Typed arrays become plain arrays. A bigint becomes a number. Objects and arrays are copied down to depth 4 and anything deeper becomes null. A function, symbol or undefined becomes null in an array and the key is dropped from an object. EventLog runs every value through it. v The value to clean. depth How deep we already are. Leave it out; it is used by the function calling itself. The cleaned copy.
規則：數字捨入到小數第 6 位，NaN 和無限大變成 null。型別陣列變成普通陣列。bigint 變成數字。物件和陣列往下複製到第 4 層，再深的變成 null。函式、symbol 和 undefined 在陣列裡變成 null，在物件裡這個鍵會被丟掉。EventLog 把每個值都經過它。 v 要整理的值。 depth 目前已經到第幾層。不用給，是函式呼叫自己的時候用的。 整理過的複本。

A performance video is two things in one picture: your work and the performer. The Compositor makes that picture. It owns a canvas (comp.canvas) of exactly the size of the file you want, whatever your window is, so a vertical 4K video from a laptop really is 4K. It is the canvas you hand to a Recorder. To show it on the page as a preview, put comp.canvas in the DOM and shrink it with CSS. comp.start() redraws every animation frame (and, because a hidden tab freezes animation frames, from a Web Worker timer too, so a recording does not freeze with the tab). comp.draw() draws one frame now: call it yourself right after your work renders if you have your own loop. comp.rects is the last layout, { work, cam } in output pixels, and comp.fps is the rate it has been drawing at. The camera is optional and never owned: setCamera(stream) shows it and setCamera(null) lets go, and you stop the tracks yourself. The camera's area can show a panel instead, anything with draw(ctx, rect, now), for example a drawing of the controller being played. The area for the camera is reserved before the camera arrives, so the picture does not jump. A WebGL work: the compositor copies its canvas in the same animation frame it was drawn in, which works in Chrome. If you see black, create the WebGL context with preserveDrawingBuffer: true, or call comp.draw() right after your render and do not call start(). Webcams usually stop at 1080p30, so a 4K stack layout enlarges the camera about 1.6 times. The…

表演影片是同一個畫面裡的兩件事：你的作品和表演者。Compositor 就是做這個畫面的。它擁有一張畫布（comp.canvas），大小就是你要的檔案大小，跟你的視窗多大無關，所以在筆電上錄的直式 4K 影片真的是 4K。把這張畫布交給 Recorder。要在頁面上預覽，就把 comp.canvas 放進 DOM，再用 CSS 縮小。 comp.start() 每個動畫畫面重畫一次（而且因為被藏起來的分頁會凍結動畫畫面，所以也用 Web Worker 的計時器畫，這樣錄影不會跟著分頁一起凍住）。comp.draw() 馬上畫一個畫面：如果你有自己的迴圈，就在作品畫完之後自己呼叫它。comp.rects 是最近一次的版面，{ work, cam }，單位是輸出的像素，comp.fps 是它實際畫的頻率。 鏡頭是選用的，而且合成器不擁有它：setCamera(stream) 顯示它，setCamera(null) 放手，音軌由你自己停。鏡頭的區域也可以改放一個面板，也就是任何有 draw(ctx, rect, now) 的東西，例如一張正在彈的控制器的圖。鏡頭的區域會在鏡頭來之前就先留好，所以畫面不會跳動。 WebGL 的作品：合成器會在作品畫完的同一個動畫畫面裡複製它的畫布，在 Chrome 上這樣就行。如果看到黑的，就用 preserveDrawingBuffer: true 建立 WebGL context，或在你渲染完之後馬上呼叫 comp.draw()，並且不要呼叫 start()。 網路攝影機通常只到 1080p30，所以 4K 的 stack 版面會把鏡頭放大約 1.6 倍。上面的作品是照輸出尺寸畫的，只要作品自己的畫布至少跟它的區域一樣大，就會保持清楚。 在 p5 草圖裡用不到這個：startRecording() 會替你錄畫布和它的聲音。Compositor 是給要把作品和鏡頭一起錄的頁面用的。 size 輸出的尺寸，也就是檔案的尺寸。可以是 PRESETS 的 id（'vertical-4k'）、'1080x1920'、[w, h] 或 { w, h }。每一邊都會進位成偶數。見 resolveSize()。 layout 作品和鏡頭放在哪裡：stack、pip、side、work（見 LAYOUTS）。 layoutOptions 原封不動交給 layoutRects()：fit、camFit、camAnchor、minCam、split、pip。 getWorkCanvas 回傳你的作品的畫布，或 null。每個畫面都會問一次，因為 p5 草圖可能換掉畫布，WebGL 作品可能改變大小。合成器從來不擁有作品。 background 所有東西後面的顏色，任何畫布能用的顏色字串。 mirrorCam 把鏡頭顯示成鏡子，這是表演者習慣的樣子。要跟畫在上面的手部追蹤的 mirror 保持一樣。 maxFps 跑起來的時候最多這麼頻繁地畫。120 Hz 的螢幕不需要每秒合成 120 次。 onDraw onDraw(ctx, rects, comp)，作品和鏡頭畫好之後呼叫，用來在最上面再蓋一層。呼叫前後會保存和還原繪圖狀態。裡面出錯只會警告一次，不會中斷錄影。 canvas 畫進這張畫布，不另外做新的。它的寬高會被設成輸出的尺寸。

A video keeps the picture and the sound. The log keeps the score of the take: every note, pad hit and (throttled) hand position, in milliseconds from the moment recording started. With it a take can be re-rendered at another size, re-synced to a better audio take, or turned into MIDI later. Start it with the recorder's start time so event times line up with the video's first frame: log.start(recorder.t0). log.attach(signals) logs every signal a Signals bus publishes; pulses are always kept and continuous signals obey throttleMs. Or add events yourself with log.add(name, value). Values are cleaned into plain JSON data by cleanValue(). toJSON() gives { format: 'openav-eventlog', version: 1, startedAt, durationMs, count, events }, and EventLog.fromJSON(json) reads it back. toTake() turns the log into a MIDI take; TakeRecorder is a log that does exactly that on midi/. Properties: events is the list [{ t, name, value }] (t in ms, to a tenth), t0 the clock time of t = 0, startedAt the wall-clock time (ISO text) and durationMs is null until stop(). now The clock, in milliseconds. The default is the same clock as Recorder.t0. Pass your own in a test. filter filter(name, value, meta), returns whether to keep an event. It applies to add() too. throttleMs For continuous signals: keep at most one event per name in this many milliseconds. Pulses (note on, note off…) are never throttled.

影片留下的是畫面和聲音。事件記錄留下的是這次錄影的樂譜：每個音符、每一下墊子、以及（有節流的）手的位置，從開始錄的那一刻算起的毫秒數。有了它，一段錄影之後可以用別的尺寸重新渲染、跟更好的聲音檔重新對齊，或轉成 MIDI。用錄影器的開始時間來開始它，事件時間才會跟影片的第一個畫面對齊：log.start(recorder.t0)。 log.attach(signals) 會記下 Signals 匯流排發布的每個訊號。脈衝一定會留，連續的訊號則受 throttleMs 限制。也可以自己用 log.add(name, value) 加事件。值會被 cleanValue() 整理成單純的 JSON 資料。toJSON() 給 { format: 'openav-eventlog', version: 1, startedAt, durationMs, count, events }，EventLog.fromJSON(json) 能讀回來。toTake() 把記錄轉成 MIDI 的 take，TakeRecorder 就是在 midi/ 上剛好做這件事的記錄。 屬性：events 是 [{ t, name, value }] 的清單（t 是毫秒，精確到十分之一），t0 是 t = 0 的時鐘時間，startedAt 是真實時間（ISO 文字），durationMs 在 stop() 之前是 null。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒。預設跟 Recorder.t0 是同一個時鐘。測試時傳自己的。 filter filter(name, value, meta)，回傳要不要留下這個事件。add() 也適用。 throttleMs 對連續的訊號：每個名字在這麼多毫秒內最多留一個事件。脈衝（音符開、音符關…）永遠不會被節流。

A Recorder puts this in the ext of its result. Use it for a download name: 'take.' + extFor(blob.type). mime A MIME type, with or without codecs, in any letter case. Anything that is not text counts as empty. mp4, m4a (audio/mp4), webm, ogg, mkv (video/x-matroska) or bin.
Recorder 把它放進結果的 ext。拿來取下載檔名：'take.' + extFor(blob.type)。 mime MIME 型別，有沒有 codecs 都行，大小寫不拘。不是文字的東西當作空字串。 mp4、m4a（audio/mp4）、webm、ogg、mkv（video/x-matroska）或 bin。

Landmarks from a hand or pose tracker come as fractions of the camera picture. To draw something on the output at the place a landmark is, you need pixels of the output, where the camera may be enlarged and cropped. framePoint() does that. It gives the same point whether or not part of the camera is cropped away, because it uses frame, the whole camera picture placed in the output. Use the same mirror in the tracker and in the compositor. camRect The cam of layoutRects(), or of compositor.rects. u Across the camera picture, 0 left to 1 right, in the displayed (mirrored if mirrorCam) orientation. v Down the camera picture, 0 top to 1 bottom. { x, y } in output pixels, or null when there is no camera (or its size is not known yet).

手部或姿態追蹤給的關節點是鏡頭畫面的比例。要在輸出上、關節點所在的位置畫東西，需要的是輸出畫面的像素，而鏡頭可能被放大和裁切。framePoint() 就是做這件事。不管鏡頭有沒有被裁掉一部分，它給的點都是對的，因為它用的是 frame，也就是整個鏡頭畫面放進輸出之後的位置。追蹤器和合成器要用同樣的 mirror。 camRect layoutRects() 的 cam，或 compositor.rects 的 cam。 u 橫跨鏡頭畫面，0 是左、1 是右，用顯示出來的方向（有 mirrorCam 就是鏡像後的）。 v 沿著鏡頭畫面往下，0 是上、1 是下。 輸出像素的 { x, y }，沒有鏡頭（或還不知道它的尺寸）就是 null。

It reads type 0 and type 1 files (the tracks are merged), running status, tempo changes and SMPTE time division; system exclusive messages are skipped. A file that is not a MIDI file throws a TypeError (fromMidiFile: not a MIDI file (no MThd)), and one that ends early a RangeError. Play the result into a show with TakePlayer: it drives a work like someone playing the file on a keyboard. bytes The bytes of the .mid file, for example await file.arrayBuffer(). name The name of the take. Left out, it is the track name in the file, then 'take'. families Which signal spellings to produce, as in signalsOfMidi(). The default is both, like hardware. A take. meta.bpm is the first tempo in the file (not set for SMPTE time).

它讀 type 0 和 type 1 的檔案（音軌會合併）、running status、速度變化，和 SMPTE 時間單位。系統專用訊息會被略過。不是 MIDI 的檔案會丟出 TypeError（fromMidiFile: not a MIDI file (no MThd)），中途結束的檔案會丟出 RangeError。用 TakePlayer 把結果播進演出：它驅動作品的方式，就像有人在鍵盤上彈這個檔案。 bytes .mid 檔的位元組，例如 await file.arrayBuffer()。 name take 的名字。沒給的話用檔案裡的音軌名稱，再沒有就是 'take'。 families 要產生哪幾種訊號寫法，跟 signalsOfMidi() 一樣。預設兩種都有，就像硬體。 一個 take。meta.bpm 是檔案裡第一個速度（SMPTE 時間的檔案不設）。

It is pure arithmetic: no DOM, no clock. The Compositor calls it whenever a size changes. A 1080 by 1920 frame with a square work and stack splits into exactly 1080 by 1080 and 1080 by 840, with no seam row. The crop of a camera is in the displayed orientation, so with the mirror on, an anchor of x: 0.2 still means "keep the left of what you see". stack puts the work across the full width at the top and the camera below. If that would leave the camera under minCam of the height (a square or landscape frame), the work gets split of the height and is letterboxed in it. side is the same turned sideways. pip fills the frame with the work and puts the camera in a corner as a rounded inset. work is the work alone. layout One of LAYOUTS. Any other name throws a TypeError. out The output size { w, h } in pixels. It must be positive, or this throws. src The sizes of the sources: { workW, workH, camW, camH }. A missing or zero value means unknown. An unknown work counts as square. With an unknown camera the camera's area is still reserved, with crop: null and frame: null, so the frame does not jump when the camera arrives. opts Options: fit ('contain' default, or 'cover', for the work), camFit ('cover' default, or 'contain'), camAnchor ({ x, y }, 0..1, default the middle: which part a cover-crop keeps, in what you see), minCam (0.2: the share of the height in stack, or of the width in side, that the camera must keep), split (0.6: the work's share when it would leave the camera less…

這是純算術：沒有 DOM、沒有時鐘。Compositor 在尺寸改變時就呼叫它。1080 乘 1920 的畫面放一個正方形的作品、用 stack，會剛好切成 1080 乘 1080 和 1080 乘 840，中間沒有縫。鏡頭的裁切是用顯示出來的方向表示的，所以開了鏡像之後，x: 0.2 的錨點仍然是「保留你看到的畫面的左邊」。 stack 把作品橫跨整個寬度放在上面，鏡頭在下面。如果這樣留給鏡頭的高度不到 minCam（正方形或橫式畫面），作品就只佔高度的 split，並且在裡面留黑邊。side 是同樣的做法轉九十度。pip 讓作品鋪滿畫面，把鏡頭放在角落當圓角小視窗。work 只有作品。 layout LAYOUTS 其中之一。其他名字會丟出 TypeError。 out 輸出尺寸 { w, h }，單位是像素。必須是正數，否則會丟出錯誤。 src 來源的尺寸：{ workW, workH, camW, camH }。沒給或是 0 就表示不知道。不知道尺寸的作品當作正方形。鏡頭尺寸不知道時，鏡頭的區域還是會先留好，crop: null、frame: null，所以鏡頭來的時候畫面不會跳動。 opts 選項：fit（作品，預設 'contain'，或 'cover'）、camFit（預設 'cover'，或 'contain'）、camAnchor（{ x, y }，0..1，預設在中間：滿版裁切時保留哪一部分，是你看到的畫面裡的位置）、minCam（0.2：stack 裡鏡頭至少要留的高度比例，side 裡是寬度比例）、split（0.6：留給鏡頭的比 minCam 還少時，作品佔的比例）、pip（{ corner: 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl', size: 0.3, margin: 0.03, radius: 0.08, aspect: 0 }：小視窗寬度佔畫面的比例、離角落的距離佔短邊的比例、圓角半徑佔小視窗短邊的比例，以及形狀，0 表示用鏡頭自己的比例）。 { layout, out, work, cam }。work 和 cam 是輸出像素的 { x, y, w, h, crop, frame, box }（全是整數），cam 還多一個 radius。crop 是來源被畫出來的那一塊（來源像素，可以有小數），整張都畫就是 null。frame 是整個來源畫面會落在哪裡，被裁掉的部分在矩形外面，疊圖需要它。box 是它被放進的區域。work 版面的 cam 是 null。

stack: the work across the full width at the top, the camera fills the rest below (for vertical video: Reels, Shorts, TikTok). pip: the work fills the frame and the camera is a rounded inset in a corner (for square frames, or a work that needs all of the frame). side: the work at full height on the left, the camera fills the right (landscape). work: the work alone. layoutRects() says exactly where everything lands, and the layout option of the Compositor takes one of these names; any other name throws. ['stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work'], a frozen-by-convention list (do not change it).

stack：作品橫跨整個寬度放在上面，鏡頭填滿下面剩下的（給直式影片：Reels、Shorts、TikTok）。pip：作品鋪滿畫面，鏡頭是角落的圓角小視窗（給正方形畫面，或需要整個畫面的作品）。side：作品佔滿左邊的整個高度，鏡頭填滿右邊（橫式）。work：只有作品。確切的位置由 layoutRects() 算出，Compositor 的 layout 選項收的就是這幾個名字，其他名字會丟出錯誤。 ['stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work']，一份約定不要修改的清單。

Browsers hide the labels (and sometimes the ids) until the page has had camera permission once, so call it again after openCamera() to get the real names. Needs https or localhost: elsewhere there is no navigator.mediaDevices and the promise rejects. A promise of a list of { deviceId, groupId, label }. A device without a label is called Camera 1, Camera 2… by its position.

瀏覽器在頁面拿到過一次鏡頭權限之前，會隱藏名字（有時連 id 也是），所以在 openCamera() 之後再呼叫一次，才會拿到真正的名字。需要 https 或 localhost：其他地方沒有 navigator.mediaDevices，promise 會被 reject。 一個 promise，內容是 { deviceId, groupId, label } 的清單。沒有名字的裝置會依位置叫作 Camera 1、Camera 2…。

The same as listCameras() for audio, with the same rule about labels: they are generic until the page has had microphone permission once. Pass a deviceId to AudioTap.addMicrophone() to use one. A promise of a list of { deviceId, groupId, label }. A device without a label is called Microphone 1, Microphone 2… by its position.
跟 listCameras() 一樣，只是列的是音訊，名字的規則也一樣：頁面拿到過一次麥克風權限之前，名字都是通用的。把 deviceId 交給 AudioTap.addMicrophone() 就能使用其中一個。 一個 promise，內容是 { deviceId, groupId, label } 的清單。沒有名字的裝置會依位置叫作 Microphone 1、Microphone 2…。

A take made on hardware holds the same note several times, under several names. This picks one family for the notes: midi/note/ if present, else midi/ch/, else one device's midi//note/, else raw midi/virtual bytes. Controllers and pitch bend come from midi/ch/ if present, else the classic names (as channel 1), else one device's. toMidiFile() and takeStats() are built on it. take The take. A list in the shape of @openav/midi: { t, type: 'noteon', ch, note, vel }, noteoff, { t, type: 'cc', ch, cc, value }, { t, type: 'pitchbend', ch, value } (0..16383), chanat and polyat. vel and value are 0..127.

在硬體上錄的 take，同一個音會用好幾個名字記好幾次。這裡替音符選一種寫法：有 midi/note/ 就用它，沒有就用 midi/ch/，再沒有就用某一個裝置的 midi//note/，最後是 midi/virtual 的原始位元組。控制器和彎音：有 midi/ch/ 就用，沒有就用傳統名稱（當作頻道 1），再沒有就用某一個裝置的。toMidiFile() 和 takeStats() 都是建立在它上面。 take 這個 take。 @openav/midi 的格式：{ t, type: 'noteon', ch, note, vel }、noteoff、{ t, type: 'cc', ch, cc, value }、{ t, type: 'pitchbend', ch, value }（0..16383）、chanat、polyat。vel 和 value 是 0..127。

A Recorder calls this itself when you give it more than one live audio track, and closes the mix on stop(). Call it yourself when you want the one track for something else. It makes an AudioContext, so the page needs to have had a click. For several sounds that come from Web Audio nodes, AudioTap is the better tool: it mixes them without a detour through streams. tracks The audio tracks to mix. { track, close() }: the one mixed MediaStreamTrack, and a function that closes the AudioContext that mixes it.

你給 Recorder 超過一條活著的音軌時，它會自己呼叫這個，並在 stop() 時關掉混音。想把那一條音軌拿去做別的事時，才自己呼叫。它會建一個 AudioContext，所以頁面需要先被點過一次。如果聲音是來自 Web Audio 節點，用 AudioTap 比較好：它直接混，不用繞一圈串流。 tracks 要混的音軌。 { track, close() }：混好的那一條 MediaStreamTrack，以及關掉混音用的 AudioContext 的函式。

A take is what an EventLog filtered to midi/ records, as plain data: t is milliseconds from the start, name is a signal name such as midi/note/on, value is its payload, and meta holds free fields like { bpm, device, notes }. normalizeTake() makes any input safe: events that are not objects, have no name or have a t that is not a number are dropped; t is rounded to a tenth of a millisecond and held at 0 or more; the events are sorted by t (events with equal times keep their order); name defaults to 'take'; durationMs is at least the time of the last event. A new object is returned. Every function in this package that takes a take runs it through here first, so you can pass raw data. input A take, or its JSON text. A string is parsed with JSON.parse. Anything that is not an object throws a TypeError. A new take: { v: 1, name, createdAt, durationMs, events: [{ t, name, value }], meta }.

take 就是過濾成 midi/ 的 EventLog 記下的東西，是單純的資料：t 是從開始算起的毫秒數，name 是訊號名稱，像 midi/note/on，value 是它的內容，meta 放自由欄位，像 { bpm, device, notes }。normalizeTake() 讓任何輸入都變安全：不是物件、沒有名字、t 不是數字的事件會被丟掉，t 捨入到十分之一毫秒並限制在 0 以上，事件依 t 排序（時間一樣的保持原來的順序），name 預設是 'take'，durationMs 至少是最後一個事件的時間。回傳的是新物件。 這個套件裡每個收 take 的函式，都會先把它送進這裡處理，所以你可以直接傳原始資料。 input 一個 take，或它的 JSON 文字。字串會用 JSON.parse 解析。不是物件的東西會丟出 TypeError。 一個新的 take：{ v: 1, name, createdAt, durationMs, events: [{ t, name, value }], meta }。

A hardware keyboard publishes the same note under several names, and this function knows them all: midi/note/on and midi/note/off (family legacy, with value: { note, vel, ch }), midi/ch//note/ (family channel, a number, 0 for off), midi//note/on|off (family slug:) and raw bytes on midi/virtual (family virtual, { data: [status, note, vel] }). A key-down with velocity 0 in raw bytes counts as off. A channel of 0, as the on-screen piano says, counts as channel 1. ev An event { name, value } of a take. { key, on, note, ch, family, vel }, or null if it is not a note event. key is ':', on is true for a key-down, family says which spelling it came in, vel is 0..127.

硬體鍵盤會把同一個音符用好幾種名字發布，這個函式全部認得：midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off（寫法 legacy，內容是 { note, vel, ch }）、midi/ch//note/（寫法 channel，是數字，0 表示放開）、midi//note/on|off（寫法 slug:），以及 midi/virtual 上的原始位元組（寫法 virtual，{ data: [status, note, vel] }）。原始位元組裡力度是 0 的按下算放開。頻道是 0 的（螢幕鋼琴會這樣）當作頻道 1。 ev take 的一個事件 { name, value }。 { key, on, note, ch, family, vel }，不是音符事件就是 null。key 是 ':'，on 是 true 表示按下，family 說明它用哪一種寫法，vel 是 0..127。

This is how a TakePlayer and a TakeRecorder make sure no note is left sounding: for legacy it is midi/note/off, for channel it is midi/ch//note/ with 0, for virtual it is a raw note-off byte triple, for a device family midi//note/off. n The result of noteOf(): { note, ch, family }. A list of { name, value } events (one, or none for an unknown family).

TakePlayer 和 TakeRecorder 就是這樣確保沒有音一直響著：legacy 是 midi/note/off，channel 是值為 0 的 midi/ch//note/，virtual 是原始的放開位元組，裝置寫法則是 midi//note/off。 n noteOf() 的結果：{ note, ch, family }。 { name, value } 事件的清單（一個，不認得的寫法則是空的）。

Give the stream to Compositor.setCamera(). The caller owns the stream: stop its tracks when you are done, the compositor never does. Webcams usually top out at 1080p30, so a 4K frame enlarges the camera; the work above it stays sharp. It needs https or localhost, and the user's permission. opts The options of cameraConstraints(): { deviceId, width, height, fps, facingMode }. A promise of the stream, with one video track and no audio. It rejects with the browser's error when permission is refused or the camera is missing.

把串流交給 Compositor.setCamera()。串流由呼叫的人擁有：用完要自己把音軌停掉，合成器不會做。網路攝影機通常最多到 1080p30，所以 4K 的畫面會把鏡頭放大，上面的作品仍然清楚。需要 https 或 localhost，以及使用者許可。 opts cameraConstraints() 的選項：{ deviceId, width, height, fps, facingMode }。 串流的 promise，有一條影像軌，沒有聲音。權限被拒或沒有鏡頭時會用瀏覽器的錯誤 reject。

A Recorder calls this for you. It takes the browser's check as an argument so that it is pure and can be tried with a fake one, like the examples below. isTypeSupported The browser's check, for example (m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m). Not a function gives ''. A check that throws counts as "no" for that type. audioOnly Use AUDIO_MIMES instead of VIDEO_MIMES. prefer Move this container to the front, keeping the order inside each group. candidates Your own list instead of the built-in one. The first supported type, or '' when none matches (then let MediaRecorder choose its default).

Recorder 會替你呼叫它。它把瀏覽器的檢查當成參數傳進來，所以是純函式，可以像下面的範例那樣用假的檢查來試。 isTypeSupported 瀏覽器的檢查函式，例如 (m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m)。給的不是函式就回傳 ''。丟出錯誤的檢查，對那個型別算「不行」。 audioOnly 用 AUDIO_MIMES 而不是 VIDEO_MIMES。 prefer 把這種容器移到最前面，兩組各自的內部順序不變。 candidates 用你自己的清單，取代內建的。 第一個支援的型別，都不符合就回傳 ''（這時就讓 MediaRecorder 用它的預設）。

Use it to fill a size picker with PRESETS, or to read the suggested frame rate and layout of a size before you build a Compositor. id The preset id, for example 'square-1080'. The preset { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }, or null if there is no such id.
拿來為尺寸選單填上 PRESETS 的內容，或在建 Compositor 之前讀一個尺寸建議的畫格率和版面。 id 預設的 id，例如 'square-1080'。 那個預設 { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }，沒有這個 id 就是 null。

Every side is even, because H.264 and VP9 encode 4:2:0 colour, which needs even sizes. Use an id as the size of a Compositor; presetById() looks one up. A frozen list of 11 presets. Each is { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }: group is 'vertical', 'landscape' or 'square', label and labelZh are names for a picker, layout is the layout suggested for the shape and fps is recommendedFps().

每一邊都是偶數，因為 H.264 和 VP9 用 4:2:0 的色彩編碼，需要偶數的尺寸。可以把 id 當作 Compositor 的 size。用 presetById() 查某一個。 一份凍結的清單，有 11 個預設。每個是 { id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }：group 是 'vertical'、'landscape' 或 'square'，label 和 labelZh 是給選單用的名字，layout 是這種形狀建議的版面，fps 是 recommendedFps()。

Each key-down moves to the nearest grid line (60000 / bpm / grid milliseconds apart). The key-up of a note moves with it, so the length of every note is kept. Everything that is not a note (controllers, pitch bend) stays where it was. A note written in two spellings at the same time (midi/note/on and midi/ch/1/note/60) moves by the same amount in both. take The take. bpm The tempo. Left out, it is take.meta.bpm, and then 120. grid Grid steps per beat: 4 is sixteenths, 2 is eighths, 1 is quarters. strength How far to move, 0..1. 1 is all the way, 0.5 is half way to the grid, 0 changes nothing. offsetMs Shift the grid later by this many milliseconds, for a take that does not start on a beat. A new take.

每次按下的鍵會移到最近的格線上（格線之間隔 60000 / bpm / grid 毫秒）。音符放開的時間跟著一起移，所以每個音的長度不變。不是音符的東西（控制器、彎音）留在原處。同一個音符用兩種寫法同時記錄的（midi/note/on 和 midi/ch/1/note/60），兩邊移動的量一樣。 take 這個 take。 bpm 速度。沒給的話用 take.meta.bpm，再沒有就是 120。 grid 每一拍幾格：4 是十六分音符，2 是八分音符，1 是四分音符。 strength 移動多少，0..1。1 是移到定位，0.5 是移一半，0 是什麼都不變。 offsetMs 把格子往後移這麼多毫秒，給不是從拍點開始的 take 用。 一個新的 take。

Particles and thin lines are the first things a low bitrate smears, so this is higher than a streaming bitrate on purpose: the file is a master that will be edited and encoded again. It is the default videoBitsPerSecond of a Recorder that records a canvas. w Width in pixels. h Height in pixels. fps The frame rate. Left out, it is recommendedFps() for the size. Bits per second, rounded to 100 000. 1080 by 1920 at 60 fps is 14 900 000, 4K at 30 fps is 29 900 000.

粒子和細線是位元率太低時最先被糊掉的東西，所以這個數字刻意比串流的位元率高：這個檔案是要再剪輯、再編碼的母帶。它是錄畫布的 Recorder 的 videoBitsPerSecond 預設值。 w 寬，單位是像素。 h 高，單位是像素。 fps 畫格率。沒給的話，用這個尺寸的 recommendedFps()。 每秒位元數，四捨五入到 100 000。1080 乘 1920、60 fps 是 14 900 000，4K、30 fps 是 29 900 000。

60 fps holds up to about 1080 by 1920 (and 1440 by 1800, 1920 by 1200). A 4K canvas at 60 means 500 million pixels a second through the compositor and the encoder, which drops frames on a laptop in the middle of a performance, and 30 is what cameras shoot 4K at anyway. Pass the result as fps to a Recorder. w Width in pixels. h Height in pixels. 60 when w × h is at most 2 600 000 pixels, otherwise 30.
60 fps 可以撐到約 1080 乘 1920（以及 1440 乘 1800、1920 乘 1200）。4K 的畫布用 60 的話，合成器和編碼器每秒要處理 5 億個像素，在筆電上表演到一半會掉格，而且相機拍 4K 本來也是 30。把結果當作 fps 交給 Recorder。 w 寬，單位是像素。 h 高，單位是像素。 w × h 不超過 2 600 000 像素是 60，否則是 30。

new Recorder({ canvas, audioTracks }) then start() and, later, await stop(). The canvas track and the audio track go into the same MediaRecorder, which stamps both from one clock: nothing has to be lined up afterwards. stop() resolves, after the last chunk, with { mimeType, ext, bytes, chunks, durationMs, width, height, fps, audio, blob, error }: the blob is the file, ext the extension to give it (mp4, webm, m4a…), audio whether it has sound. Give the blob to URL.createObjectURL() for a download link. Which file you get depends on the browser: it records MP4 (H.264 and AAC) when it can, WebM otherwise. A WebM from Chrome has no duration in its header; players cope, editors may want ffmpeg -i in.webm -c copy out.webm. The file is a master to edit, so the default bitrate is high. To keep a long take out of the tab's memory, pass ondata(blob, seq) to start(): each chunk (every timeslice ms) is handed over in order, and a promise you return is awaited before the next chunk and before stop() resolves, so uploads stay ordered. With ondata the chunks are not kept and blob is null, unless you pass keep: true. To line a take up with an EventLog, start the log with recorder.t0, the performance.now() of the moment recording started. A browser with MediaRecorder (Recorder.supported tells), and a canvas or a stream, or audioOnly: true: otherwise the constructor throws a TypeError. Mixing several audio tracks makes an AudioContext, which needs the page to have had a click. A camera or…

new Recorder({ canvas, audioTracks })，然後 start()，之後 await stop()。畫布的影像軌和聲音軌進的是同一個 MediaRecorder，它用同一個時鐘替兩者打時間戳記，所以事後不用對齊。stop() 在最後一塊資料到了之後 resolve，內容是 { mimeType, ext, bytes, chunks, durationMs, width, height, fps, audio, blob, error }：blob 就是檔案，ext 是該用的副檔名（mp4、webm、m4a…），audio 是有沒有聲音。把 blob 交給 URL.createObjectURL() 就能做下載連結。 拿到什麼檔案看瀏覽器：能錄 MP4（H.264 和 AAC）就錄 MP4，不行就錄 WebM。Chrome 錄出來的 WebM 檔頭沒有長度，播放器沒問題，剪輯軟體可能需要 ffmpeg -i in.webm -c copy out.webm。這個檔案是拿來剪輯的母帶，所以預設的位元率偏高。 要讓很長的一段錄影不佔著分頁的記憶體，就在 start() 傳 ondata(blob, seq)：每一塊資料（每隔 timeslice 毫秒）會依序交給你，你回傳的 promise 會在下一塊、以及 stop() resolve 之前被等待，所以上傳的順序不會亂。有給 ondata 的話資料塊不會保留，blob 是 null，除非你傳 keep: true。要讓一段錄影跟 EventLog 對齊，就用 recorder.t0 來開始事件記錄，它是開始錄影那一刻的 performance.now()。 需要有 MediaRecorder 的瀏覽器（Recorder.supported 會告訴你），也要有畫布或串流，或 audioOnly: true：否則建構時會丟出 TypeError。混好幾條音軌會建一個 AudioContext，頁面需要先被點過一次。串流裡有鏡頭或麥克風的話，一樣需要使用者許可。 canvas 要錄什麼，通常是 compositor.canvas。 stream 要錄的現成影像串流，用來取代畫布。 fps 畫布的擷取頻率。用 recommendedFps(w, h)：2.7K 和 4K 是 30。 audioTracks 聲音，例如 AudioTap 的 tap.tracks。給好幾條會混成一條，因為 Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。 audioOnly 只錄音軌：把聲音另外存成一個檔。這時不需要 canvas 和 stream。 videoBitsPerSecond 影像位元率。預設是依畫布尺寸和 fps 算出的 recommendedBitrate()（沒有畫布的話是 12 Mb/s）。 audioBitsPerSecond 聲音位元率。 mimeType 強制用某一個 MIME 型別。預設是瀏覽器支援的第一個 VIDEO_MIMES 或 AUDIO_MIMES，見 pickMime()。 prefer 挑 MIME 型別的時候先試這種容器。

It is what the Compositor uses for its size and setSize(). A size that cannot be read ('wat', a negative number, a missing side) throws a TypeError: record: unknown size "wat". Even sizes matter because H.264 and VP9 encode 4:2:0 colour. size A preset id from PRESETS, 'WxH' (also with × or ), [w, h] or { w, h }. { w, h }, whole numbers, each rounded up to the next even number.

Compositor 的 size 和 setSize() 用的就是它。讀不懂的尺寸（'wat'、負數、少一邊）會丟出 TypeError：record: unknown size "wat"。尺寸要偶數，是因為 H.264 和 VP9 用 4:2:0 的色彩編碼。 size PRESETS 的 id、'WxH'（也可以用 × 或 ）、[w, h] 或 { w, h }。 { w, h }，整數，各自進位到下一個偶數。

It is what fromMidiFile() uses to build a take from a .mid file: each event of the file becomes the signals a keyboard would have published, so TakePlayer can play it into a show. Call it yourself when you have MIDI events from somewhere else and want them on a Signals bus. ev A MIDI event { type, ch, note?, vel?, cc?, value? }. type is noteon, noteoff, cc, pitchbend (value 0..16383), chanat or polyat; velocities and values are 0..127. families Which spellings to make: the classic names (midi/note/on, midi/cc/64, midi/bend), the per-channel ones (midi/ch/1/note/60, midi/ch/1/cc/64…), or both, as hardware does. device A device name to put in the classic note events. A list of { name, value }. Note velocity becomes 0..1 (vel and velocity for the classic spelling), controllers 0..1, pitch bend -1..1. chanat and polyat exist only in the per-channel spelling.

fromMidiFile() 用它把 .mid 檔做成 take：檔案裡每個事件都變成鍵盤本來會發布的訊號，這樣 TakePlayer 就能把它播進演出裡。如果你有別處來的 MIDI 事件，想放到 Signals 匯流排上，就自己呼叫它。 ev MIDI 事件 { type, ch, note?, vel?, cc?, value? }。type 是 noteon、noteoff、cc、pitchbend（value 是 0..16383）、chanat 或 polyat，力度和數值是 0..127。 families 要做哪幾種寫法：傳統名稱（midi/note/on、midi/cc/64、midi/bend）、每頻道的（midi/ch/1/note/60、midi/ch/1/cc/64…），或兩種都做，就像硬體一樣。 device 要放進傳統音符事件的裝置名稱。 { name, value } 的清單。音符力度變成 0..1（傳統寫法有 vel 和 velocity），控制器是 0..1，彎音是 -1..1。chanat 和 polyat 只有每頻道的寫法。
A take is a plain object { v, name, createdAt, durationMs, events, meta }, see normalizeTake(). validateTake() complains when v is not this number, and normalizeTake() writes it. 1.
take 是一個普通物件 { v, name, createdAt, durationMs, events, meta }，見 normalizeTake()。v 不是這個數字時，validateTake() 會抱怨，normalizeTake() 會把它寫進去。 版本號就是 1。

Give it a bus and a take, call play(), and it publishes the take's events into the bus at their times: the same signals a keyboard would have, so a work's visuals, its sound (Sound) and its chord detector respond exactly as to your hands. That is what lets a work's preview play itself. Pass clock: 'manual' and call player.update(dt) from your loop for full control. No stuck notes, ever: the player remembers every key it pressed, in the spelling it pressed it, and the sustain pedal, and lets go of them on pause, stop, seek and every loop wrap. With yieldToLive, playing a key yourself makes the take fall silent; with resumeAfter: 8 it comes back 8 seconds after you stop. Its state is 'playing', 'paused', 'yielded' or 'stopped', and position (milliseconds), loops, playing and yielded are plain properties. signals The Signals bus to publish into. It also defines take/playing (0 or 1) and take/position (0..1). take A take or its JSON. You can load() another one later. loop Start again at the end. Off, it stops there. speed Playback speed: 0.5 is half speed. yieldToLive Fall silent when someone plays live: a key-down that the player did not send (hardware, the on-screen piano, a phone) pauses the take and releases its notes. resumeAfter Seconds without live playing before a take that gave way resumes. 0 means it stays paused. isLive isLive(name, value), what counts as live playing. The default is any key-down that did not come from the player; knobs do not count. chase When you…

給它一個匯流排和一個 take，呼叫 play()，它就會在對的時間把 take 的事件發布到匯流排上：跟鍵盤會發的訊號一樣，所以作品的畫面、它的聲音（Sound）和和弦偵測器的反應，跟面對你的雙手時完全一樣。這就是作品的預覽可以自己演奏的原因。傳 clock: 'manual' 並在你的迴圈裡呼叫 player.update(dt)，就能完全自己掌控。 絕不會卡音：播放器記得它按下的每個鍵（用它按下時的寫法）和延音踏板，並在暫停、停止、跳轉和每次循環回到開頭的時候放開它們。有 yieldToLive 的話，你自己彈一個鍵，take 就會安靜下來。有 resumeAfter: 8 的話，你停手 8 秒後它會回來。它的狀態是 'playing'、'paused'、'yielded' 或 'stopped'，position（毫秒）、loops、playing、yielded 是普通屬性。 signals 要發布訊號的 Signals 匯流排。它也會定義 take/playing（0 或 1）和 take/position（0..1）。 take 一個 take 或它的 JSON。之後可以用 load() 換別的。 loop 到結尾就從頭再來。關掉的話，就停在結尾。 speed 播放速度：0.5 是一半的速度。 yieldToLive 有人現場彈的時候就安靜下來：播放器沒送出的按鍵（硬體、螢幕鋼琴、手機）會暫停 take 並放開它的音。 resumeAfter 被讓位的 take 要等多少秒沒有現場演奏才恢復。0 表示維持暫停。 isLive isLive(name, value)，什麼算現場演奏。預設是任何不是播放器送出的按鍵。旋鈕不算。 chase seek() 的時候，把那個時間點之前每個控制器的最後一個值再送一次（延音踏板、旋鈕），讓 take 處在原本該有的狀態。 clock 誰來帶動時間：'raf'（requestAnimationFrame，頁面裡的預設）、'timer'（10 毫秒的計時器：對聲音比較準，背景分頁也會繼續只是比較慢），或 'manual'（你呼叫 update(dt) 或 tick()，沒有 requestAnimationFrame 的環境預設是這個）。 maxStepMs 一步最多往前走多久。遇到空檔（分頁凍結）的時候，take 會變慢，而不是一口氣打出一堆音。 onEvent onEvent({ t, name, value }, player)，每個事件播出時都呼叫。 onState onState(state, reason)，狀態改變時呼叫：'playing'、'paused'、'yielded' 或 'stopped'。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒。

A TakeRecorder is an EventLog that listens to midi/ on a bus. Press record: rec.start(). Play. Press stop: const take = rec.stop(). The take is plain data, so it can be saved as JSON, turned into a .mid (toMidiFile()) or played back (TakePlayer). It has every member of EventLog (mark(), between(), toJSON()…). No stuck notes: a recorder stopped in the middle of a chord closes the keys that are still held (and a sustain pedal that is still down) in the take itself, at the stop time. The events are the signals as they were published, so a take from hardware holds both naming families (midi/note/on and midi/ch/1/note/60) and the device names, and playback publishes all of them. Pass recorder.t0 of a video Recorder to start() to line the take up with the video. signals The Signals bus to listen to. filter Which signals are the take: a pattern for the name, or filter(name, value, meta). name The name of the take. meta Free fields copied into the take: { bpm, device, notes }. The device is found from the events if you leave it out. overdub Also record what a TakePlayer is playing back right now. Off, a recorder ignores playback. throttleMs For continuous signals (knobs, aftertouch): at most one event per name in this many milliseconds. now The clock, in milliseconds.

TakeRecorder 是一個聽匯流排上 midi/ 的 EventLog。按下錄音：rec.start()。彈。按下停止：const take = rec.stop()。take 是單純的資料，所以可以存成 JSON、轉成 .mid（toMidiFile()），或播回去（TakePlayer）。EventLog 的所有成員它都有（mark()、between()、toJSON()…）。 不會有卡住的音：在彈和弦的中間停止錄影，還按著的鍵（和還踩著的延音踏板）會在停止的時間，於 take 本身裡被放開。事件就是訊號被發布時的原樣，所以從硬體錄的 take 兩種名稱寫法（midi/note/on 和 midi/ch/1/note/60）和裝置名稱都在，播放時全部發布出去。把影片 Recorder 的 recorder.t0 傳給 start()，就能讓 take 跟影片對齊。 signals 要聽的 Signals 匯流排。 filter 哪些訊號算進 take：名稱的正規表達式，或 filter(name, value, meta)。 name take 的名字。 meta 複製進 take 的自由欄位：{ bpm, device, notes }。沒給裝置的話，會從事件裡找。 overdub 連 TakePlayer 正在播放的也錄下來。關著的時候，錄影器會忽略播放的內容。 throttleMs 對連續訊號（旋鈕、觸後）：每個名字在這麼多毫秒內最多一個事件。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒。

Good for showing what a take is before it is played or saved. Notes are counted through midiEventsOf(), which picks one naming family, so the count is the number of keys pressed. take The take. { notes, events, durationMs, channels, low, high }. notes counts key-downs, once each even when the take holds two spellings of them. channels is a sorted list of MIDI channels. low and high are MIDI note numbers, or null for a take without notes.

適合在播放或儲存一個 take 之前，顯示它是什麼。音符是透過 midiEventsOf() 數的，它只選一種名稱寫法，所以數字就是按過幾個鍵。 take 這個 take。 { notes, events, durationMs, channels, low, high }。notes 數的是按下的鍵，每個音只算一次，即使 take 裡有兩種寫法。channels 是排好序的 MIDI 頻道清單。low 和 high 是 MIDI 音符號碼，沒有音符的 take 是 null。

One track holds note on and off with velocity, controllers (the sustain pedal is CC 64), pitch bend, and channel and poly aftertouch, each on its own channel; channel 10 stays the drums. The take's name becomes the track name, and a 4/4 time signature is written only so a DAW's grid looks sane. Times are kept to the millisecond whatever the tempo, so the file plays like the take. Only one naming family of the take is used, so nothing doubles (midiEventsOf()). To save it, wrap it in a Blob of type audio/midi. take The take. ppq Ticks per quarter note. bpm The tempo written in the file. Left out, it is take.meta.bpm, and then 120. The bytes of the .mid file.

一條音軌裡有音符開關（含力度）、控制器（延音踏板是 CC 64）、彎音，以及頻道和單音的觸後，各自在自己的頻道。頻道 10 還是鼓。take 的名字會變成音軌名稱，另外寫了 4/4 拍的拍號，只是讓 DAW 的格線看起來正常。不管速度是多少，時間都精確到毫秒，所以檔案播出來跟 take 一樣。只會用 take 裡的一種名稱寫法，所以不會重複（midiEventsOf()）。要存檔的話，把它包成型別是 audio/midi 的 Blob。 take 這個 take。 ppq 每四分音符幾個 tick。 bpm 寫進檔案的速度。沒給的話用 take.meta.bpm，再沒有就是 120。 .mid 檔的位元組。

Everything before the first key-down is cut away, but not lost: a controller value set during the silence, such as the sustain pedal or a knob, is kept and moved to the start (to t = 0 if it was before the cut), so the take still starts in the same state. If the take has no key-down at all, it is moved so its first event is at keep. take The take. keep Milliseconds of lead-in to keep before the first key-down. A new take. Everything moved earlier by the same amount, and durationMs is shorter by that amount. A take that starts at once comes back as it is.

第一次按鍵之前的東西會被剪掉，但不會遺失：靜默裡設定的控制器數值，例如延音踏板或旋鈕，會保留，並移到開頭（剪掉的範圍內的會變成 t = 0），所以 take 開始時的狀態不變。如果 take 裡完全沒有按鍵，就整體移動，讓它的第一個事件落在 keep。 take 這個 take。 keep 第一次按鍵之前要保留幾毫秒的空白。 一個新的 take。所有事件都提早同樣的量，durationMs 也縮短那麼多。一開始就有音的 take 會原樣回傳。

It checks: v is TAKE_VERSION, name is a string, durationMs is a number from 0 up, events is an array, each event is an object with a signal name and a t of 0 or more, the events are in time order and none is after durationMs, and meta, if present, is an object. Use it on a take you read from a file; to repair one, use normalizeTake(). take The take to check. Sentences such as v must be 1 (got 2) or events[3] is out of order (t 100 < 200). [] when valid. It never throws.

它檢查：v 是 TAKE_VERSION，name 是字串，durationMs 是 0 以上的數字，events 是陣列，每個事件都是有訊號 name 和 0 以上的 t 的物件，事件依時間排序而且沒有任何一個超過 durationMs，meta 如果有的話是物件。用在從檔案讀來的 take 上。要修復的話，用 normalizeTake()。 take 要檢查的 take。 像 v must be 1 (got 2) 或 events[3] is out of order (t 100 < 200) 這樣的句子。沒問題就是 []。它不會丟出錯誤。

MP4 comes first because it opens everywhere a performance video goes next (an editor, Instagram, a phone's gallery) without a remux, and Chrome encodes H.264 in hardware. The first string asks for a profile (avc1.640033, High profile level 5.1, enough for 4K at 30 and 1080 by 1920 at 60) because Chrome says no to the generic avc1,mp4a but yes to the qualified one, so both are in the list for other browsers. Plain video/mp4 is for Safari. pickMime() walks this list. A frozen list of 6 strings: video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2, video/mp4;codecs=avc1,mp4a, video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus, video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus, video/webm, video/mp4.

MP4 排第一，因為表演影片接下來要去的地方（剪輯軟體、Instagram、手機相簿）都能直接開，不用重新封裝，而且 Chrome 用硬體編 H.264。第一個字串指定了 profile（avc1.640033，High profile level 5.1，夠 4K 30 和 1080 乘 1920 60 用），因為 Chrome 對籠統的 avc1,mp4a 回答不行、對指定 profile 的卻回答可以，所以兩個都放進清單給別的瀏覽器用。單純的 video/mp4 是給 Safari 的。pickMime() 就是走過這份清單。 一份凍結的清單，有 6 個字串：video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2、video/mp4;codecs=avc1,mp4a、video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus、video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus、video/webm、video/mp4。

With follow, an external MIDI clock (24 ticks a beat, plus start, stop and song position) is followed: drumPhase, beatPhase, drumBar, drumStep and drumBpm read it, and a drum machine that is up takes its tempo and its downbeat from it, starting and stopping with it. OAVp5.clock tells you what it hears. With nothing sending a clock, nothing changes. off ignores every clock message: OAVp5.clock.info.state stays 'none'. Use it when something on the page or the machine sends a clock you do not want the sketch to follow. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { clock: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_clock=… on the page address, then ?clock=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_clock=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except off means follow.

設成 follow 的時候，外部的 MIDI 時鐘（每拍 24 個 tick，加上 start、stop 和 song position）會被跟隨：drumPhase、beatPhase、drumBar、drumStep、drumBpm 讀的就是它，已經在跑的鼓機也會從它取得速度和第一拍，跟著它開始和停止。OAVp5.clock 會告訴你它聽到什麼。沒有東西送時鐘過來的時候，什麼都不會改變。 off 會忽略所有時鐘訊息：OAVp5.clock.info.state 一直是 'none'。頁面上或機器上有東西在送時鐘、而你不想讓草圖跟著它走的時候用。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { clock: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_clock=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?clock=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_clock=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 off 以外的任何值都當作 follow。

Normally the panel opened by 🎹 is a bar across the whole window, up to half its height. With compact it is a box at most 560 pixels wide and a third of the window high, in the corner the 🎹 sits in, so the page beside it stays in view. It is the default on strudel.cc, where the code editor needs the room. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { compact: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_compact=… on the page address, then ?compact=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_compact=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only on turns it on. OAVp5.options.compact reads back as true or false.

一般來說，按 🎹 打開的面板是橫跨整個視窗的一條，最高到視窗的一半。設成 compact 就變成一個最寬 560 像素、高度是視窗三分之一的方塊，放在 🎹 所在的那個角落，旁邊的頁面還看得到。在 strudel.cc 上它是預設，因為程式編輯器需要那塊空間。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { compact: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_compact=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?compact=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_compact=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 on 會打開它。OAVp5.options.compact 讀回來是 true 或 false。

Moves the 🎹 to the left or right edge, with the cards that appear beside it. scope() draws on the opposite side, so the two never meet. On openprocessing.org the default is left, because OpenProcessing's own icon sits at the top right. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { corner: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_corner=… on the page address, then ?corner=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_corner=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except left means right.

把 🎹 移到左邊或右邊，它旁邊出現的卡片也跟著移動。scope() 畫在對面那一側，所以兩個不會碰在一起。在 openprocessing.org 上預設是 left，因為 OpenProcessing 自己的圖示在右上角。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { corner: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_corner=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?corner=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_corner=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 left 以外的任何值都當作 right。

Two seconds after the 🎹 is placed, a line says whether the 🎹 in the page is oav-p5's own copy and where oav-p5 loads the rest of OAV from. Every click then adds a line with the pointer position, what was clicked, and what is on top at that spot, which is how you find a page element sitting over the 🎹. It also says when the panel opens, when the page replaced the 🎹 and which name asked for the microphone. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { debug: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_debug=… on the page address, then ?debug=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_debug=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Any value except an empty one and 0 turns it on.

🎹 放上頁面兩秒之後，會印出一行說頁面上的 🎹 是不是 oav-p5 自己的那一個，以及 oav-p5 從哪裡載入 OAV 的其他部分。之後每次點擊都多一行，記下指標的位置、點到了什麼、那個位置最上面是什麼，這就是找出是哪個頁面元素蓋在 🎹 上面的方法。面板打開、頁面把 🎹 換掉、是哪個名稱去要了麥克風，它也會說。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { debug: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_debug=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?debug=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_debug=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 除了空的和 0，任何值都會打開它。

Moves the 🎹, its cards and the panel to the top or bottom edge. On openprocessing.org the default is top, because OpenProcessing's console floats over the bottom of the sketch. The drum machine's card sits below a panel docked at the top. The panel itself has two buttons for whoever is looking at it: Dock cycles bottom → top → floating (drag a floating panel by its bar), and Size cycles small → medium → large. This browser remembers the choice, and it wins over the option. When the sketch sets no dock, the panel starts at the bottom, also on openprocessing.org (from 2026-10-20: at the top it covered the sketch). The 🎹 moves out of the panel's way only when the two share an edge. Reloading the same page (Cmd+Enter on OpenProcessing) opens the panel again if it was open, and restarts drums started from its 🥁 on the same line and tempo. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { dock: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_dock=… on the page address, then ?dock=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_dock=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except top means bottom.

把 🎹、它的卡片和面板移到上緣或下緣。在 openprocessing.org 上預設是 top，因為 OpenProcessing 的 console 會浮在草圖的下方。鼓機的卡片會放在固定在上緣的面板下面。 面板上有兩個按鈕給正在看的人用：「位置」依序切換下方、上方、浮動（浮動時拖曳面板上面那一列就能移動），「大小」依序切換小、中、大。這個瀏覽器會記住你的選擇，而且優先於這個選項。草圖沒有設定 dock 時，面板一開始在下方，openprocessing.org 上也一樣（2026-10-20 起，之前放在上方會蓋住草圖）。只有面板和 🎹 在同一個邊時，🎹 才會讓開。同一個頁面重新整理（OpenProcessing 按 Cmd+Enter）時，面板原本開著就會自動打開，從面板 🥁 開的鼓機也會用同一行節奏和速度再打起來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { dock: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_dock=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?dock=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_dock=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 top 以外的任何值都當作 bottom。

The drum machine hands each hit to the audio clock slightly ahead of time, and tells the sketch (drumHit(), kickDetected(), env('kick')) when you will hear it, which is the scheduled moment plus the output latency. auto uses the latency the browser reports. If the browser's figure is smaller than what your output really takes, the picture runs ahead of the sound, and giving the number yourself fixes that. The project's README names a Bluetooth speaker as the case and suggests trying 200. Only the default drum machine (drums=lookahead) uses it: the frame-driven one has nothing scheduled ahead. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { drumlatency: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_drumlatency=… on the page address, then ?drumlatency=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_drumlatency=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). A number is held between 0 and 500. Anything that is not a number means auto. OAVp5.options.drumlatency reads back in seconds (0.2 for 200).

鼓機把每一下鼓點稍微提前交給音訊時鐘，並在你會聽到的那一刻通知草圖（drumHit()、kickDetected()、env('kick')），那一刻就是排定的時間加上輸出的延遲。auto 用瀏覽器回報的延遲。瀏覽器回報的數字如果比你的輸出實際花的時間小，畫面就會跑在聲音前面，自己給一個數字就能解決。專案的 README 舉的例子是藍牙喇叭，並建議試試 200。 只有預設的鼓機（drums=lookahead）會用到它：逐幀推進的那一種沒有提前排程的東西。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { drumlatency: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_drumlatency=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?drumlatency=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_drumlatency=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 數字會被限制在 0 到 500 之間。不是數字的值都當作 auto。OAVp5.options.drumlatency 讀回來的單位是秒（200 讀回 0.2）。

With lookahead, a heartbeat in a Web Worker hands the hits to the audio clock a little ahead of time, so the beat stays steady when frames stutter or the tab is busy, and the sketch is told when each hit is heard. With frame, the machine is moved by the animation frames instead, as it was in oav-p5 0.5. It is the safety net: where the lookahead machine misbehaves, frame brings the old behaviour back, and the timing is then only as steady as the frame rate. OAVp5.drums.clock and the 🩺 check-up say which clock is running. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { drums: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_drums=… on the page address, then ?drums=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_drums=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything except frame means lookahead.

設成 lookahead 的時候，Web Worker 裡有一個心跳，會把鼓點提前一點交給音訊時鐘，所以畫面卡頓或分頁很忙的時候，拍子還是穩的，草圖也會在每一下鼓點被聽到的時候收到通知。設成 frame 則是回到 oav-p5 0.5 的做法，由動畫畫面推著鼓機走。這是保險：提前排程的鼓機在某個地方出狀況的時候，frame 把舊的做法找回來，這時拍子只會跟畫面更新率一樣穩。 OAVp5.drums.clock 和 🩺 體檢會告訴你現在是哪一種時鐘在跑。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { drums: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_drums=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?drums=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_drums=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 frame 以外的任何值都當作 lookahead。

With auto, oav-p5 asks for Web MIDI as soon as it loads, so a plugged-in controller plays the sketch without anyone pressing anything. The browser remembers your answer per site. With click, it asks only when the 🎹 panel is first opened. With off, it never asks by itself, and the on-screen controller and a phone still play the sketch. OAVp5.connectHardware() asks whatever the option says, and OAVp5.hardware tells you the state: 'off' until it has been asked. On strudel.cc (or a page where Strudel's own functions are present) the default is click, because Strudel's midin() asks for MIDI itself. Setting hardware yourself wins. Safari and iPad have no Web MIDI at all: when oav-p5 asks (or you call OAVp5.connectHardware()), the state there becomes 'unavailable'. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { hardware: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_hardware=… on the page address, then ?hardware=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_hardware=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only auto and click ask. Any other value acts like off.

設成 auto 的時候，oav-p5 一載入就去要 Web MIDI，所以接上去的控制器不用誰按什麼就能彈草圖。瀏覽器會依網站記住你的答案。設成 click，只有第一次打開 🎹 面板時才去要。設成 off，它自己永遠不會去要，螢幕上的控制器和手機還是能彈草圖。 不管這個選項怎麼設，OAVp5.connectHardware() 都會去要，OAVp5.hardware 告訴你現在的狀態：還沒要過之前是 'off'。 在 strudel.cc（或頁面上本來就有 Strudel 自己的函式）預設是 click，因為 Strudel 的 midin() 會自己去要 MIDI。你自己設了 hardware 就以你的為準。 Safari 和 iPad 根本沒有 Web MIDI：oav-p5 去要的時候（或你呼叫 OAVp5.connectHardware()），那裡的狀態就會變成 'unavailable'。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { hardware: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_hardware=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?hardware=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_hardware=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 auto 和 click 會去要。其他的值效果跟 off 一樣。

When something goes wrong, a small card beside the 🎹 says what happened, why, and what to press, in the browser's language, once per page. hints: 'off' takes the cards off the page: the console still says the same thing and OAVp5.hints still lists what was said. Use it for a finished piece that goes on a wall or into a recording. It also hides the corner oscilloscope of scope(), which is part of the same on-page help. scope=off hides only that. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { hints: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_hints=… on the page address, then ?hints=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_hints=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns the cards off. Any other value, including the text false, leaves them on.

出問題的時候，🎹 旁邊會跳出一張小卡片，用瀏覽器的語言說明發生了什麼、為什麼、要按什麼，每個頁面只說一次。hints: 'off' 讓卡片從頁面上消失：console 還是說一樣的話，OAVp5.hints 也還是列出說過的內容。做好的作品要放在展場牆上或錄影的時候用。 它也會把 scope() 的角落示波器藏起來，因為那是同一套網頁上的輔助。scope=off 只藏它。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { hints: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_hints=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?hints=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_hints=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把卡片關掉。其他任何值，包括文字 false，都讓卡片保持開著。

Every oav-p5 page with the same room (another tab, another computer) gets what this page's programs play into the virtual MIDI output (notes, controllers and the clock), over the phone relay, and plays it at the moment it sounds here. On the other side, OAVp5.last.source is 'link'. Nothing it receives is sent on, so two pages cannot loop. The room is also the phones' room, so one QR code plays every linked page. OAVp5.link.info tells you the room, whether it is connected and how many other pages were heard. The 🎹 grows a 🔗: green when another page is there, yellow while connecting or alone, red when the relay is gone. linkdelay adds a buffer. A network connection to the relay (relay, wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay unless you set another). Without it the 🔗 is red and nothing is shared. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { link: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_link=… on the page address, then ?link=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_link=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only letters, digits, _ and - are kept, and only the first 32 characters.

房間相同的 oav-p5 頁面（另一個分頁、另一台電腦），會透過手機中繼收到這個頁面的程式送進虛擬 MIDI 輸出的東西（音符、控制器和時鐘），並在這裡聽到的那一刻播出來。收到的那一邊，OAVp5.last.source 是 'link'。收到的東西不會再往外送，所以兩個頁面不會互相繞圈。房間也是手機用的房間，所以一個 QR code 就能彈每一個連起來的頁面。 OAVp5.link.info 告訴你房間、有沒有連上、聽到幾個其他頁面。🎹 會多一個 🔗：另一個頁面在的時候是綠色，連線中或只有自己是黃色，中繼斷線是紅色。linkdelay 可以多加一段緩衝。 要能連上中繼（relay，沒另外設的話是 wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay）。連不上的話 🔗 是紅色，什麼都不會分享。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { link: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_link=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?link=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_link=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只留下字母、數字、_ 和 -，而且只取前 32 個字元。

Only matters together with link: without a room nothing is received. Each note arriving from another page is played at the moment it sounded there, which already allows for the trip. linkdelay adds this much on top, so a note that took longer than usual is still on time. The price is that everything from the other page arrives that much later. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { linkdelay: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_linkdelay=… on the page address, then ?linkdelay=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_linkdelay=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Held between 0 and 2000. Anything that is not a number is 0.

只有跟 link 一起用才有意義：沒有房間就不會收到任何東西。從另一個頁面來的每個音符，會在它在那邊響起的那一刻播出，這已經把路上花的時間算進去了。linkdelay 在那之上再多加這麼多，所以走得比平常久的音符也還是準時。代價是另一個頁面來的所有東西都晚這麼多才到。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { linkdelay: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_linkdelay=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?linkdelay=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_linkdelay=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 會被限制在 0 到 2000 之間。不是數字的值就是 0。

With auto, the first time a sketch reads micLevel, bass, mid, treble or beat, oav-p5 asks the browser for the microphone. With click, reading them does nothing: the microphone starts only when someone presses 🎤 in the 🎹 panel or the sketch calls startMic(), so the permission prompt arrives when you choose. With off, nothing opens the microphone, not even startMic(), which resolves false. off is a promise to the page: a gallery piece that must never listen can say so. click is for pieces where a permission prompt out of nowhere would be rude, or where the sound only matters after an intro. The values of the microphone stay 0 while it is off. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { mic: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_mic=… on the page address, then ?mic=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_mic=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything else means auto.

設成 auto，草圖第一次讀 micLevel、bass、mid、treble 或 beat 的時候，oav-p5 就會向瀏覽器要麥克風。設成 click，讀它們不會有任何作用：只有有人在 🎹 面板按 🎤、或草圖呼叫 startMic() 時麥克風才會開，這樣權限的詢問會在你決定的時候才跳出來。設成 off，什麼都不能開麥克風，連 startMic() 也不行，它會 resolve 成 false。 off 是對頁面的一個承諾：一件絕對不能收音的展場作品可以這樣宣告。click 適合不該憑空跳出權限詢問的作品，或是聲音要等片頭之後才有意義的作品。麥克風關著的時候，它的所有值都是 0。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { mic: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_mic=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?mic=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_mic=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 其他的值都當作 auto。

On OpenProcessing, OPC.slider('radius', 10) declares a variable with a slider. With opc on, oav-p5 then wires the controller to the OPC variables in order: knob 1 to the first slider, knob 2 to the second, the faders after the knobs, pad 1 to the first toggle or button. OPC's own panel moves with the knob. OAVp5.wiring() lists who drives what. off leaves OPC's variables to their own sliders. A control the sketch reads itself (knob1 in draw()) is the sketch's anyway: the slider at that place stops following it. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { opc: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_opc=… on the page address, then ?opc=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_opc=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns it off.

在 OpenProcessing 上，OPC.slider('radius', 10) 宣告一個有滑桿的變數。opc 開著的時候，oav-p5 會依序把控制器接到 OPC 的變數：旋鈕 1 接第一個滑桿，旋鈕 2 接第二個，推桿接在旋鈕之後，打擊墊 1 接第一個開關或按鈕。OPC 自己的面板會跟著旋鈕動。OAVp5.wiring() 會列出誰推動什麼。 off 讓 OPC 的變數只聽自己的滑桿。草圖自己有讀的控制（draw() 裡的 knob1）本來就歸草圖：那個位置的滑桿不再跟著它動。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { opc: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_opc=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?opc=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_opc=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把它關掉。

closed shows just the small 🎹 button, and pressing it opens the panel: the on-screen controller, the buttons for 🎤, 🔊, 🥁, ⏺, 📷, 📱 and 🩺. open opens the panel as soon as the page loads, for a workshop where everyone needs the on-screen controller at once. off removes the 🎹 button altogether, for a piece in an exhibition: there is no button and OAVp5.panel.open() does nothing. The cards that explain a problem still appear in the corner, unless hints is off too. With off everything the panel does is still there as code: startMic(), startSound(), startRecording() and the options keep working, and the console still says what goes wrong. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { panel: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_panel=… on the page address, then ?panel=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_panel=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Any value except open and off means closed.

closed 只顯示小小的 🎹 按鈕，按下去才打開面板：螢幕上的控制器，加上 🎤、🔊、🥁、⏺、📷、📱、🩺 這些按鈕。open 在頁面一載入就打開面板，適合工作坊，每個人一開始就需要螢幕上的控制器。off 把 🎹 按鈕整個拿掉，適合展場裡的作品：沒有按鈕，OAVp5.panel.open() 也什麼都不做。說明問題的卡片還是會出現在角落，除非 hints 也設成 off。 設成 off 之後，面板能做的事還是都能用程式做：startMic()、startSound()、startRecording() 和各個選項照常運作，出問題時 console 也還是會說。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { panel: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_panel=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?panel=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_panel=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 open 和 off 以外的任何值都當作 closed。

The on-screen controller of the 🎹 panel draws this device, and knob1, fader1 and pad1 mean the first knob, fader and pad printed on it. A sketch written with the LPD8 in mind, for instance, can ask for it with profile: 'akai-lpd8' so that whoever has no LPD8 still gets one on screen. The picker inside the panel changes it by hand. If you do not set it, the panel starts as the MiniLab 3 and then follows a real controller as soon as one that OAV has a profile for is plugged in. If you do set it, that choice stays. An id that does not exist is reported in the console with the list of known ids, and the panel shows no controller. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { profile: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_profile=… on the page address, then ?profile=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_profile=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Any id that @openav/midi has a profile for: arturia-minilab3, akai-lpd8, korg-nanokontrol2, generic-keys49 and the rest, and the controllers imported from QLC+ such as behringer-bcf2000, whose file is fetched when it is needed. When you set nothing, the panel follows the controller that is plugged in.

🎹 面板上的螢幕控制器會畫出這一台設備，knob1、fader1、pad1 指的就是它上面印的第一顆旋鈕、第一支推桿、第一個墊子。例如照著 LPD8 寫的草圖，可以用 profile: 'akai-lpd8' 指定它，沒有 LPD8 的人螢幕上也有一台。面板裡的選單可以手動換。 你不設的話，面板一開始是 MiniLab 3，一旦插上 OAV 有設定檔的真控制器，就改成跟著它。你設了的話，就維持你的選擇。不存在的 id 會在 console 回報，並列出已知的 id，面板也不會顯示控制器。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { profile: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_profile=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?profile=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_profile=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 @openav/midi 有設定檔的任何 id：arturia-minilab3、akai-lpd8、korg-nanokontrol2、generic-keys49 等等，也包括從 QLC+ 匯入的控制器，例如 behringer-bcf2000，需要時才抓它的檔案。你不設的話，面板跟著插上去的那一台控制器。

How many frames a second the recorder takes from the canvas, for startRecording() and the ⏺ button. 30 suits most places Instagram and YouTube accept. 60 is smoother for fast motion and makes a bigger file. One take can ask for its own rate: startRecording({ fps: 60 }). It is read back as OAVp5.options.recfps and as OAVp5.record.fps. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { recfps: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_recfps=… on the page address, then ?recfps=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_recfps=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Rounded to a whole number and held between 1 and 60. Anything that is not a number means 30.

錄影時每秒從畫布取幾格，給 startRecording() 和 ⏺ 按鈕用。30 適合 Instagram 和 YouTube 接受的大多數場合。60 對快速的動作比較順，檔案也比較大。單一次錄影也可以自己指定：startRecording({ fps: 60 })。 它可以用 OAVp5.options.recfps 和 OAVp5.record.fps 讀回來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { recfps: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_recfps=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?recfps=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_recfps=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 會四捨五入成整數，並限制在 1 到 60 之間。不是數字的值就當作 30。

A long take fills the tab's memory, so every recording stops by itself at this length, saves what it has and shows a card saying so. Raise it for a long piece, record in parts, or give one take its own length: startRecording(10) stops after ten seconds, and a number above the limit is cut down to the limit. It is read back as OAVp5.options.reclimit and as OAVp5.record.limit. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_reclimit=… on the page address, then ?reclimit=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_reclimit=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). At least 1. Anything that is not a number means 300 (five minutes).

太長的影片會把分頁的記憶體吃光，所以每次錄影都會在這個長度自己停下來，存下已經錄到的，並跳出一張卡片說明。長的作品就把它調高，或是分段錄，也可以替單次錄影指定長度：startRecording(10) 十秒後停下，超過上限的數字會被砍到上限。 它可以用 OAVp5.options.reclimit 和 OAVp5.record.limit 讀回來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_reclimit=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?reclimit=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_reclimit=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 至少是 1。不是數字的值就當作 300（五分鐘）。

With on, ⏺ and 📷 are in the 🎹 panel and startRecording() records the canvas together with the sound the sketch makes, the microphone included when it is on. nomic keeps the microphone out of the recording. With it in and no headphones, the speakers are recorded a second time through the microphone, so leave it out when you play sound out loud. off takes ⏺ and 📷 away and makes startRecording() do nothing. off is a promise to the page, like mic=off: a piece that must not be captured can say so. One take can still choose its own: startRecording({ mic: false }). Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { record: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_record=… on the page address, then ?record=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_record=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Anything else means on.

設成 on，⏺ 和 📷 都在 🎹 面板裡，startRecording() 會把畫布和草圖發出的聲音一起錄下來，麥克風開著的話也包含在內。nomic 讓麥克風不進錄影。麥克風收進去又沒戴耳機的話，喇叭的聲音會透過麥克風被錄第二次，所以大聲放聲音的時候把它關掉。off 把 ⏺ 和 📷 拿掉，讓 startRecording() 什麼都不做。 off 跟 mic=off 一樣是對頁面的承諾：一件不能被錄下來的作品可以這樣宣告。單次錄影還是可以自己決定：startRecording({ mic: false })。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { record: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_record=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?record=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_record=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 其他的值都當作 on。

The 📱 button shows a QR code that sends a phone to the remote page, and the phone's MIDI tab plays your sketch through this relay. link rooms use it too. The default is the project's public relay. To keep your traffic on your own machine, run the relay from a checkout of the repository with node packages/relay/server.js and point relay at ws://localhost:7458/relay. Nothing connects to it at load. It is used when you open the 📱 card (OAVp5.phone()) or set link. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { relay: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_relay=… on the page address, then ?relay=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_relay=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Used as given.

📱 按鈕會顯示一個 QR code，讓手機打開遙控頁面，手機的 MIDI 分頁就是透過這個中繼來彈你的草圖。link 的房間也用它。預設是專案的公開中繼。想讓資料只留在自己的機器上，就從儲存庫的副本執行 node packages/relay/server.js，再把 relay 指到 ws://localhost:7458/relay。 載入的時候不會連它。要打開 📱 卡片（OAVp5.phone()）或設了 link 才會用到。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { relay: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_relay=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?relay=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_relay=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 照你給的使用。

The phone's page is where the on-screen controller on the phone lives. The QR code and the link under it are this address plus the relay, the room and the MIDI tab. Change it when you host the remote page yourself, for example on a local network where the phone cannot reach the public site. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { remote: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_remote=… on the page address, then ?remote=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_remote=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Used as given, with ?relay=…&room=…&tab=midi added.

手機上的控制器就在那個頁面裡。QR code 和它下面的連結，是這個位址再加上中繼、房間和 MIDI 分頁。自己架遙控頁面的時候才需要改它，例如手機連不到公開網站的區域網路。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { remote: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_remote=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?remote=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_remote=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 照你給的使用，後面接上 ?relay=…&room=…&tab=midi。

A phone and a page meet in a room on the relay. Left empty, oav-p5 picks a name like p5-k3x9a the first time and keeps it in this browser (localStorage), so the same QR code keeps working on reload. If link is set, its room is used. Set room yourself when you want a name people can type or remember, such as one per class. A phone needs only the room name to join, so pick a name people cannot guess if that matters. OAVp5.phone() returns the room in use. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { room: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_room=… on the page address, then ?room=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_room=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Left empty, a name like p5-k3x9a is made up and kept in this browser. Only letters, digits, _ and - are kept, and only the first 32 characters. If nothing is left, the room is default.

手機和頁面在 relay 上的一個房間碰面。留空的話，oav-p5 第一次會挑一個像 p5-k3x9a 的名字，存在這個瀏覽器裡（localStorage），所以重新整理之後同一個 QR code 還是有用。設了 link 的話，就用它的房間。想要一個大家打得出來、記得住的名字，例如一班一個，就自己設 room。 手機只需要房間名稱就能加入，所以如果這很重要，就取一個別人猜不到的名字。OAVp5.phone() 會回傳現在用的房間。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { room: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_room=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?room=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_room=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 留空的話，會自己取一個像 p5-k3x9a 的名字，存在這個瀏覽器裡。只留下字母、數字、_ 和 -，而且只取前 32 個字元。如果什麼都沒剩下，房間就叫 default。

With off, scope() draws nothing in the corner and only returns its value, so a sketch can leave its scope() calls in and hide the plot for a show. drawTrail(), which draws on the canvas, is not affected. If the plot does not show up, check hints too: hints=off hides it as well. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { scope: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_scope=… on the page address, then ?scope=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_scope=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns it off.

設成 off，scope() 不會在角落畫任何東西，只回傳它的值，所以演出的時候草圖可以把 scope() 留在程式裡，只是把圖藏起來。畫在畫布上的 drawTrail() 不受影響。 圖沒有出現的話，也要檢查 hints：hints=off 也會把它藏起來。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { scope: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_scope=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?scope=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_scope=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把它關掉。

With on, a sketch that calls navigator.requestMIDIAccess() itself (WebMidi.js does) gets the real ports and one more input called "OAV Virtual MIDI", which carries whatever the on-screen controller and the phone play. It also works in Safari and on iPad, where there is no Web MIDI: the sketch gets the virtual port alone, so a WebMidi.js sketch still runs there. Programs can play into its output as well (Strudel's .midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')). off leaves the browser's own requestMIDIAccess alone. Use it when a page already has its own MIDI handling that must not see an extra port. Order matters: oav-p5 has to load before the code that asks for MIDI, which is why the loader line goes first. A page that opened MIDI earlier keeps the browser's own answer, and 🩺 says so. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { shim: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_shim=… on the page address, then ?shim=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_shim=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only off turns it off.

設成 on，自己呼叫 navigator.requestMIDIAccess() 的草圖（WebMidi.js 就是）會拿到真的連接埠，再多一個叫 "OAV Virtual MIDI" 的輸入，螢幕控制器和手機彈的東西都從它進來。在沒有 Web MIDI 的 Safari 和 iPad 上也能用：草圖只拿到虛擬連接埠，所以 WebMidi.js 的草圖在那裡還是能跑。其他程式也可以把東西送進它的輸出（Strudel 的 .midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')）。 off 不動瀏覽器自己的 requestMIDIAccess。頁面本來就有自己的 MIDI 處理、不能多出一個連接埠的時候用。 順序很重要：oav-p5 要比要 MIDI 的程式先載入，這就是為什麼載入那一行要放在最前面。更早就開了 MIDI 的頁面會維持瀏覽器自己的答案，🩺 也會這麼說。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { shim: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_shim=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?shim=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_shim=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 off 會把它關掉。

With click, nothing makes a sound until the sketch calls startSound() or someone presses 🔊 in the 🎹 panel. With an instrument id, every key, pad, the on-screen controller and a phone are heard from the first click on the page, with no code at all, so any MIDI sketch becomes playable by adding the option to the page address: ?oav_sound=piano. off is a promise to the page: nothing sounds, startSound() resolves false and the 🔊 button is hidden. Browsers let a page play sound only after a click, and a MIDI key is not a click, so the first sound waits for one: a card says "sound is ready but silent" until then. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { sound: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_sound=… on the page address, then ?sound=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_sound=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). An instrument id such as piano, organ, strings, harp or music-box. on and auto start the default instrument (the piano). An id that does not exist plays the default synth (synth/pad) and the console lists the ids that exist.

設成 click，要等草圖呼叫 startSound()，或有人在 🎹 面板按 🔊，才會有聲音。給一個樂器 id，每個琴鍵、打擊墊、螢幕控制器和手機，從頁面上的第一次點擊開始就都聽得到，一行程式都不用寫，所以任何 MIDI 草圖只要在網址加上 ?oav_sound=piano 就能彈。off 是對頁面的承諾：什麼都不發聲，startSound() 會 resolve 成 false，🔊 按鈕也會被藏起來。 瀏覽器要網頁被點過一下才讓它出聲，而 MIDI 的琴鍵不算點擊，所以第一個聲音要等一次點擊：在那之前會有一張卡片說「聲音準備好了，還沒響」。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { sound: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_sound=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?sound=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_sound=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 樂器 id，像是 piano、organ、strings、harp 或 music-box。on 和 auto 會啟動預設的樂器（鋼琴）。不存在的 id 會播預設的合成器（synth/pad），console 會列出存在的 id。

Strudel is a live-coding editor, not a sketch, so a few things change when oav-p5 sees it: the names Strudel owns (note, velocity, beat) are left alone and one card says what to read instead, MIDI is asked for by Strudel's own midin() rather than at load (hardware becomes click), the 🎹 panel becomes the compact box, and the 🎹 sits above Strudel's side-panel buttons. oav-p5 only looks at the address and at the names on the page: nothing of Strudel is called. on forces this behaviour on any page, off forces the plain one even on strudel.cc. Settings you give yourself (hardware, compact) still win over what Strudel mode would choose. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { strudel: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_strudel=… on the page address, then ?strudel=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_strudel=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). auto means on strudel.cc, or on a page where Strudel's own functions (note() and s() with stack() or samples()) are already there. Anything else means auto.

Strudel 是即時編碼編輯器，不是草圖，所以 oav-p5 看到它的時候有幾件事會改變：Strudel 自己擁有的名稱（note、velocity、beat）不去動，並用一張卡片說明要改讀什麼，MIDI 交給 Strudel 自己的 midin() 去要，不是載入的時候（hardware 變成 click），🎹 面板變成 compact 的小方塊，🎹 放在 Strudel 側邊按鈕的上面。oav-p5 只看網址和頁面上有哪些名稱：不會呼叫 Strudel 的任何東西。 on 讓任何頁面都用這種做法，off 讓 strudel.cc 上也用一般的做法。你自己給的設定（hardware、compact）還是比 Strudel 模式的選擇優先。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { strudel: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_strudel=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?strudel=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_strudel=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 auto 的意思是在 strudel.cc 上，或頁面上本來就有 Strudel 自己的函式（note() 和 s()，加上 stack() 或 samples()）。其他的值都當作 auto。

In oav-p5 it is off. With on, when the 🎹 panel builds the on-screen controller, @openav/midi sends one anonymous hit per page load to the project's Google Analytics, so the project can see where its controllers end up. The @openav/midi README (section Telemetry) lists exactly what it sends: the kind of embed, the profile, the page's origin (never the path, query or title) and the version. Nothing anyone plays is sent and no cookie is set. According to that README nothing is sent from localhost, local network addresses, file:// or openaudiovisual.com itself, or when the browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { telemetry: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_telemetry=… on the page address, then ?telemetry=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_telemetry=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Only on turns it on.

在 oav-p5 裡預設是關的。設成 on，🎹 面板建立螢幕控制器的時候，@openav/midi 會把每次頁面載入的一筆匿名紀錄送到專案的 Google Analytics，讓專案知道它的控制器用在哪些地方。@openav/midi 的 README（Telemetry 那一節）列出它確切送了什麼：嵌入的種類、設定檔、頁面的來源網域（絕不含路徑、查詢字串或標題）和版本。沒有任何人彈的東西會被送出，也不會設定 cookie。 依照那份 README，從 localhost、區域網路位址、file:// 或 openaudiovisual.com 本身都不會送，瀏覽器送出「不要追蹤」或 Global Privacy Control 的時候也不會送。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { telemetry: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_telemetry=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?telemetry=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_telemetry=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 只有 on 會打開它。

Without it a recording is oav-20261015-183012.mp4. With title: 'my-piece' it is oav-my-piece-20261015-183012.mp4, so takes from several pieces sort themselves. One take can have its own name: startRecording({ name: 'take-2' }) replaces it. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { title: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_title=… on the page address, then ?title=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_title=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). Spaces and the characters a file name cannot hold become -, and only the first 40 characters are used.
