沒有它的話，錄影檔名是 oav-20261015-183012.mp4。設了 title: 'my-piece'，就是 oav-my-piece-20261015-183012.mp4，好幾件作品的錄影就會自己排好。單次錄影也可以有自己的名字：startRecording({ name: 'take-2' }) 會取代它。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { title: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_title=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?title=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_title=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 空白和檔名不能用的字元會變成 -，而且只取前 40 個字元。

Sound (startSound(), the sound option, the 🔊 button) uses Tone.js 15, which oav-p5 loads the first time sound is wanted. By default it comes from jsDelivr. Point tone at your own copy when the page is behind a school firewall or an ad blocker that stops the CDN, or when you serve everything yourself. If it cannot be loaded, a card says which host was unreachable and what to try. Set it before oav-p5 loads. window.OAV_P5 = { tone: … }; above the loader line wins, then ?oav_tone=… on the page address, then ?tone=… on the script's own URL. Values in window.OAV_P5 are turned into text, so write 'off', not false. On OpenProcessing the page address takes ?sketch_oav_tone=… (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch). The address of Tone.js version 15 as an ES module. Left empty, it is https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm, and OAVp5.options.tone reads ''.

聲音（startSound()、sound 選項、🔊 按鈕）用的是 Tone.js 15，oav-p5 在第一次需要聲音的時候才載入它。預設從 jsDelivr 來。頁面在學校防火牆或擋廣告的外掛後面、CDN 被擋住，或是你自己架所有東西的時候，把 tone 指到你自己的那一份。載不到的時候，會有一張卡片說是哪個主機連不上，以及可以怎麼試。 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 window.OAV_P5 = { tone: … }; 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 ?oav_tone=…，最後是 script 自己網址上的 ?tone=…。寫在 window.OAV_P5 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 'off'，不要寫 false。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 ?sketch_oav_tone=…（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。 Tone.js 第 15 版的 ES module 位址。留空的話用 https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm，OAVp5.options.tone 讀回來是 ''。

It is there as soon as oav-p5 has loaded, in setup() and draw() alike. The plain names of the p5 style (knob1, note, micLevel) are the easy way in. OAVp5 is the way in when you want more: the raw MIDI state (OAVp5.note, OAVp5.cc, OAVp5.bend, OAVp5.held, OAVp5.last), subscriptions (OAVp5.on()), a way to send bytes (OAVp5.input()), the microphone's numbers (OAVp5.mic), the external clock (OAVp5.clock), the link (OAVp5.link), the values over time (OAVp5.chop) and the check-up (OAVp5.check()). Three names, one object. OAVp5 is always there. oavMidi is always there too. midi is there unless the page already had a midi of its own, in which case it is left alone and the console says to read OAVp5 instead. OAVp5.options holds the loading options as oav-p5 read them: OAVp5.options.mic, and so on for each of the loading options (for example mic). Only the loader line. If it has not loaded, OAVp5 is not defined, and a sketch that reads it stops with "OAVp5 is not defined". midi and oavMidi are the same object under other names.

只要 oav-p5 載入了，它就在那裡，setup() 和 draw() 裡都一樣。p5 風格的簡單名稱（knob1、note、micLevel）是輕鬆的入口。想要更多的時候就用 OAVp5：原始的 MIDI 狀態（OAVp5.note、OAVp5.cc、OAVp5.bend、OAVp5.held、OAVp5.last）、訂閱（OAVp5.on()）、自己送位元組進去的方法（OAVp5.input()）、麥克風的數字（OAVp5.mic）、外部時鐘（OAVp5.clock）、連結（OAVp5.link）、數值隨時間變化（OAVp5.chop），還有體檢（OAVp5.check()）。 三個名字，同一個物件。OAVp5 一定在，oavMidi 也一定在。midi 則是頁面本來沒有自己的 midi 時才有，如果頁面已經有了，就不去動它，console 會說要改讀 OAVp5。OAVp5.options 放的是 oav-p5 讀到的載入選項：OAVp5.options.mic，其他每個載入選項（例如 mic）也一樣。 只需要載入那一行。如果它沒載入，OAVp5 就沒有定義，讀它的草圖會停在「OAVp5 is not defined」。 midi 和 oavMidi 是同一個物件的其他名字。

The same thing the 🩺 button in the panel does. When something does not work for a student, OAVp5.check() in the console (or 🩺) gives a card that says what this browser did: whether the page is in an iframe, whether the microphone is on or blocked, whether Web MIDI exists and which devices it found, the last message, the sound and drum state, whether MP4 recording works, what the controller is wired to, which of the sketch's own names stepped in the way, and which cards have appeared. It has a copy button and a link to the site's full device check. It is a snapshot taken when you call it, not a live view. Calling it again replaces the card. opts { show: false } skips the card on the page and only returns the report (the text still goes to the console). Left out, the card is shown. The report: { version, time, page, browser, microphone, midi, sound, drums, wiring, own, hints, external, recording, text }. text is the whole card as plain lines, the other fields are the same facts as data (microphone.state, midi.hardware, midi.devices …).

跟面板裡的 🩺 按鈕做的事一樣。學生那邊有東西不能用的時候，在 console 打 OAVp5.check()（或按 🩺）就會得到一張卡片，說這個瀏覽器做了什麼：頁面是不是在 iframe 裡、麥克風開著還是被擋、有沒有 Web MIDI、找到哪些設備、最後一則訊息、聲音和鼓機的狀態、能不能錄 MP4、控制器接到哪些變數、草圖自己的哪些名稱擋住了路，還有出現過哪些卡片。卡片上有複製按鈕，也有連到網站完整裝置檢查的連結。 它是呼叫那一刻的快照，不是即時的畫面。再呼叫一次會取代那張卡片。 opts { show: false } 不顯示頁面上的卡片，只回傳報告（文字還是會印到 console）。不寫的話就顯示卡片。 報告：{ version, time, page, browser, microphone, midi, sound, drums, wiring, own, hints, external, recording, text }。text 是整張卡片的純文字，其他欄位是同樣的資訊做成的資料（microphone.state、midi.hardware、midi.devices …）。

Some programs keep the time and everyone else follows: Strudel (midicmd("clock96, /8")), a DAW over a virtual cable, a drum machine on a MIDI cable. They send 24 clock messages per beat, plus start, continue, stop and song position. oav-p5 counts them: OAVp5.clock.info says whether a clock is running, OAVp5.clock.bpm its tempo and OAVp5.clock.phase how far through the bar and the beat it is now. When a clock is moving, drumPhase, beatPhase, drumBar, drumStep and drumBpm read it, and a drum machine that is up follows it. ?oav_clock=off turns all of that off. Clock messages are not delivered to midiMessage(): they belong to the clock. The first clock message loads the counting code (@openav/midi's MidiClock) from next to oav-p5.js, which takes a few frames. Until then the members read none, null and null. This is advanced: most sketches only read drumPhase and let it follow a clock.

有些程式負責打拍子，其他人跟著走：Strudel（midicmd("clock96, /8")）、透過虛擬線連過來的 DAW、用 MIDI 線接的鼓機。它們每拍送 24 個時鐘訊息，加上 start、continue、stop 和 song position。oav-p5 把它們數起來：OAVp5.clock.info 說有沒有時鐘在跑，OAVp5.clock.bpm 是它的速度，OAVp5.clock.phase 是現在走到小節和拍子的哪裡。 時鐘在動的時候，drumPhase、beatPhase、drumBar、drumStep、drumBpm 讀的就是它，已經在跑的鼓機也會跟著它。?oav_clock=off 會把這些全部關掉。時鐘訊息不會交給 midiMessage()：它們屬於時鐘。 第一個時鐘訊息會從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入負責計算的程式（@openav/midi 的 MidiClock），要幾個畫面。在那之前，這些成員讀到的是 none、null、null。 這是進階用法：大多數草圖只讀 drumPhase，讓它自己去跟著時鐘。

The raw number, not rounded. Use it for anything that should run at the clock's tempo: OAVp5.clock.bpm / 60 is beats a second. If the drum machine follows the clock, drumBpm shows it rounded to a tenth. Fitted over the last 24 clock ticks, so it settles within a moment and does not jump with one late tick. null before two ticks have arrived or when clock=off.
原始的數字，沒有四捨五入。任何要跟著時鐘速度走的東西都可以用它：OAVp5.clock.bpm / 60 就是每秒幾拍。鼓機如果跟著時鐘，drumBpm 會顯示四捨五入到小數一位的值。 用最近 24 個時鐘 tick 擬合出來的，所以一下子就會穩定，不會因為一個晚到的 tick 就跳動。兩個 tick 到齊之前，或設了 clock=off，都是 null。

state is 'none' until a clock message has come, 'running' while the clock is going, 'stopped' after a MIDI stop (the position holds and clocks may still arrive), and 'lost' when no clock message has arrived for 0.6 seconds. bpm is the tempo fitted over the last 24 ticks, rounded to two decimals, or null before two ticks. running is true while the transport runs, which a stream of clocks with no start message counts as too (implicit is true then). following is true when the drums read this clock: it is running, has a tempo and clock=off is not set. source says where the messages came from: 'hardware', 'screen', 'phone', 'virtual-out' (a program playing into OAV Virtual MIDI) or 'link'. clocks, dupes, starts, stops and continues count what arrived; a start sent three times with one timestamp counts once and adds to dupes. A new object each time you read it: { state, bpm, running, following, source, implicit, clocks, dupes, starts, stops, continues }. Before any clock message it is { state: 'none', bpm: null, running: false, following: false, source: null, clocks: 0 }.

state 在收到任何時鐘訊息之前是 'none'，時鐘在走的時候是 'running'，MIDI stop 之後是 'stopped'（位置停住，時鐘訊息可能還在來），超過 0.6 秒沒收到時鐘訊息就是 'lost'。bpm 是用最近 24 個 tick 擬合出來的速度，四捨五入到小數兩位，兩個 tick 之前是 null。running 在播放中是 true，只有時鐘、沒有 start 訊息的串流也算（那時 implicit 是 true）。 following 在鼓機讀這個時鐘的時候是 true：它在跑、有速度、而且沒有設 clock=off。source 說訊息從哪裡來：'hardware'、'screen'、'phone'、'virtual-out'（某個程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI）或 'link'。clocks、dupes、starts、stops、continues 數的是收到了什麼：用同一個時間戳送三次的 start 只算一次，其餘加進 dupes。 每次讀都是一個新的物件：{ state, bpm, running, following, source, implicit, clocks, dupes, starts, stops, continues }。在任何時鐘訊息之前是 { state: 'none', bpm: null, running: false, following: false, source: null, clocks: 0 }。

A bar is four beats. bar and beat count up from 0 and fall back to 0 at the next downbeat, the same way drumPhase and beatPhase do. After a stop the position holds. A clock with no start message gets its downbeat from the first tick after a silence of half a second, so a phase is there anyway. A new object each time you read it: pos is the number of bars since the start (0 is the downbeat of bar 1), bar and beat are 0..1 through the current bar and beat, bpm the tempo and running whether the transport is moving. null until a tempo is known.

一個小節是四拍。bar 和 beat 從 0 往上數，到下一個第一拍就回到 0，跟 drumPhase、beatPhase 一樣。stop 之後位置會停住。沒有 start 訊息的時鐘，以沉默半秒之後的第一個 tick 當第一拍，所以還是有相位可以用。 每次讀都是一個新的物件：pos 是從 start 起算經過幾個小節（0 是第 1 小節的第一拍），bar 和 beat 是目前小節和拍子走了 0 到 1 的多少，bpm 是速度，running 是播放有沒有在動。知道速度之前是 null。

This is the diagnostic behind the 🩺 check-up. When drum hits feel late or early, look here first: the handbook puts a Bluetooth speaker at 0.15 to 0.25 seconds of latency, and ?oav_drumlatency=200 sets it by hand. late, skipped, warning and why are further notes the check-up reads. A new object on every read. clock is 'lookahead' (hits are handed to the audio clock ahead of time, the default) or 'frame' (moved by the frames, the drums option). heartbeat is 'worker' (a Web Worker wakes it every 25 ms), 'interval' (the fallback), 'frame' with the frame clock, or 'none' before the machine exists. lookahead is the seconds scheduled ahead and extended is true when a slow draw() made it look further ahead. latency is the seconds the callbacks wait for the output of the speakers, audio whether the kit's audio clock is running, and preDraw the p5 hook that delivers the callbacks right before draw().

這是 🩺 檢查報告背後的診斷資料。打擊感覺太晚或太早的時候，先看這裡：說明文件寫藍牙喇叭的 latency 大約是 0.15 到 0.25 秒，?oav_drumlatency=200 可以手動設定。late、skipped、warning、why 是檢查報告會讀的其他備註。 每次讀都是一個新的物件。clock 是 'lookahead'（打擊事先交給音訊時鐘排好，預設）或 'frame'（跟著畫面走，載入選項 drums）。heartbeat 是 'worker'（Web Worker 每 25 毫秒叫醒它）、'interval'（備用的做法）、用畫面時鐘的時候是 'frame'，鼓機還沒有的時候是 'none'。lookahead 是提前排程的秒數，extended 為 true 表示 draw() 太慢，讓它看得更遠。latency 是 callback 為了等喇叭輸出而延後的秒數，audio 是鼓組的音訊時鐘有沒有在跑，preDraw 是在 draw() 前面送 callback 的 p5 掛鉤。

It is what mountDrums() of @openav/drums returns, with seq (the sequencer), engine (the kit), play(on), setPattern(p), setBpm(bpm), phase(), now(), info() and the rhythm functions. OAVp5.drums.machine.play(false) stops the sound and the counting but leaves the grid up: OAVp5.drums.state then says 'stopped'. It is an advanced handle; the names on this page cover what a sketch normally needs. It is null until startDrums() (or 🥁) has loaded the machine. Check for null before you use it. Set once, when startDrums() has loaded the machine. null before that and after a failed load.

就是 @openav/drums 的 mountDrums() 回傳的東西，有 seq（序列器）、engine（鼓組）、play(on)、setPattern(p)、setBpm(bpm)、phase()、now()、info() 和節奏相關的函式。OAVp5.drums.machine.play(false) 會讓鼓機停止發聲和計數，但格子還留在畫面上：OAVp5.drums.state 這時是 'stopped'。它是進階的把手，這一頁的名稱已經涵蓋草圖平常需要的一切。 在 startDrums()（或 🥁）把鼓機載入之前都是 null，使用之前先檢查。 startDrums() 把鼓機載入之後設定一次。在那之前，或載入失敗之後，都是 null。

Each situation is said once per page. The list holds them all, including the ones the page did not show because hints=off is set, so it is the place to look when a sketch does something odd and nothing is on screen: console.log(OAVp5.hints). A card that went away because the situation ended (the microphone came on) stays in the list. Starts empty and only grows. Each item is { id, kind, what, why, next }: id names the situation ('micDenied', 'chopOut:lag'), kind is 'error', 'warn' or 'info', and what, why, next are the three lines of the card in the browser's language.

每種狀況在一個頁面只說一次。這個清單把它們全都記著，包括因為設了 hints=off 而沒有顯示在頁面上的，所以草圖行為怪怪的、螢幕上又什麼都沒有的時候，就看這裡：console.log(OAVp5.hints)。 因為狀況結束（麥克風開起來了）而收掉的卡片，還是會留在清單裡。 一開始是空的，只會變長。每一項是 { id, kind, what, why, next }：id 是這個狀況的名字（'micDenied'、'chopOut:lag'），kind 是 'error'、'warn' 或 'info'，what、why、next 是卡片上的三行字，用瀏覽器的語言寫。

A link joins oav-p5 pages that share a room: what one page's programs play into OAV Virtual MIDI (notes, controllers and the clock) is heard by every other page in the room, at the moment it sounds there. You switch it on with ?oav_link=my-room, and OAVp5.link.info is where you look at how it is going. There is nothing else to call: the link is made and closed by the option. This is advanced. It needs a network connection to the relay (relay).
連結把共用同一個房間的 oav-p5 頁面連在一起：一個頁面的程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI 的東西（音符、控制器和時鐘），房間裡其他每個頁面都會在它在那邊響起的那一刻聽到。用 ?oav_link=my-room 打開它，OAVp5.link.info 是看它進行得如何的地方。沒有別的東西要呼叫：連結的建立和結束都由那個選項決定。 這是進階用法。它需要連得上中繼（relay）。

Read it in draw() for a status line, or look at the 🔗 on the 🎹, which turns green when another page is there, yellow while connecting or alone, and red when the relay is gone. The 🩺 check-up prints the same facts. A new object is made on every read. null without a link room. With one: { room, state, peers, rtt, trip, late, sent, received, … }. state is 'connecting', 'open' or 'closed' (the relay is gone and it retries). peers is how many other pages were heard in the last 6 seconds. rtt is the shortest round trip to the relay in the last 30 seconds and trip the one-way trip estimated from it, both in milliseconds. late counts notes that arrived after the moment they should have sounded and were played at once. sent and received count messages. The object also has diff, lead, msgs, dupes and id, which explain the clock alignment (packages/relay/link.js).

在 draw() 裡讀它來做狀態列，或是看 🎹 上的 🔗：另一個頁面在的時候是綠色，連線中或只有自己是黃色，中繼不見是紅色。🩺 體檢也印出同樣的資訊。每次讀都會產生一個新的物件。 沒有 link 房間的時候是 null。有的話是 { room, state, peers, rtt, trip, late, sent, received, … }。state 是 'connecting'、'open' 或 'closed'（中繼不見了，正在重試）。peers 是最近 6 秒內聽到幾個其他頁面。rtt 是最近 30 秒到中繼最短的一趟來回，trip 是由它估出來的單程時間，單位都是毫秒。late 數的是比該響的時間晚到、被立刻播出的音符。sent 和 received 數訊息。物件裡還有 diff、lead、msgs、dupes 和 id，它們說明時鐘怎麼對齊（packages/relay/link.js）。

OAVp5.sound.shell is the Sound instance of @openav/sound, OAVp5.sound.engine is the Tone.js engine it plays through (noteOn, noteOff, sustain, releaseAll, setInstrument) and OAVp5.sound.module is the whole module, for example OAVp5.sound.module.listInstruments(), which lists every instrument id. They are advanced handles: the sketch-level names (startSound(), soundIsOn) cover everything a sketch normally needs. Call startSound() first and wait until OAVp5.sound.state is no longer 'loading', or check for null before you use them. Set once, when startSound() has loaded @openav/sound (the engine and the shell at the same moment, the module a little before). null before that, and after a failed load.

OAVp5.sound.shell 是 @openav/sound 的 Sound 實例，OAVp5.sound.engine 是它用來發聲的 Tone.js 引擎（noteOn、noteOff、sustain、releaseAll、setInstrument），OAVp5.sound.module 是整個模組，例如 OAVp5.sound.module.listInstruments() 會列出所有樂器代號。它們是進階的把手：草圖層級的名稱（startSound()、soundIsOn）已經涵蓋草圖平常需要的一切。 先呼叫 startSound()，等 OAVp5.sound.state 離開 'loading' 之後再用，也可以在使用之前先檢查它是不是 null。 startSound() 載入 @openav/sound 之後設定一次（引擎和外殼同時，模組稍微早一點）。在那之前，或載入失敗之後，都是 null。

Useful in a bug report or to check which build a page got: openaudiovisual.com/p5/oav-p5.js is always the latest, while a jsDelivr address with a tag is frozen. The same number is on the first line of the 🩺 check-up. If the file loads twice (the loader line and the OpenProcessing library list), the first one wins and the second does nothing. Set when oav-p5 loads and never changes.
回報問題或確認頁面拿到哪個版本時有用：openaudiovisual.com/p5/oav-p5.js 永遠是最新版，帶版本標籤的 jsDelivr 網址則是固定的。同一個數字也在 🩺 體檢的第一行。 如果這個檔案載入了兩次（載入那一行和 OpenProcessing 的函式庫清單各一次），先載入的那一個生效，第二個什麼都不做。 oav-p5 載入時設定，之後不會變。

Only method: 'hardware' changes anything but the log. A virtual or simulated run leaves numbers and marks alone and logs its corrections as mismatch, so nobody can turn a control true without a real unit. raw The profile as shipped. It is not changed. session The run. meta { date, by, method, firmware, os, browser, port, tool, note }. See VERIFY_METHODS. { profile, problems }: the new profile, and what validateProfile() says about it.

只有 method: 'hardware' 會改動紀錄以外的東西。virtual 或 simulated 不動數字和標記，修正也只記成 mismatch，沒有實機就不可能把控制項變成 true。 raw 原本的設定檔，不會被改動。 session 這次驗證。 meta { date, by, method, firmware, os, browser, port, tool, note }。方式見 VERIFY_METHODS。 { profile, problems }：新的設定檔，以及 validateProfile() 對它的意見。

Use it when you build a pitch-bend message by hand: { type: 'pitchbend', ch: 1, value: BEND_CENTER } is a wheel at rest. Spring-loaded wheels in a profile (spring) go back to this value when released. A constant. A pitch-bend value equal to it means "not bent" and becomes 0 in bendToUnit().
手動組彎音訊息時用得到：{ type: 'pitchbend', ch: 1, value: BEND_CENTER } 就是休息中的彎音輪。設定檔裡帶彈簧的彎音輪（spring）放開後會回到這個值。 常數。彎音輪的 value 等於它就表示「沒有彎」，在 bendToUnit() 裡會變成 0。

MIDI centres pitch bend at 8192, so there are 8192 steps below the centre and 8191 above. Below the centre it divides by 8192 and above by 8191, so the bottom reaches exactly −1, the top exactly +1 and the rest position exactly 0. This is the number published as midi/bend and midi/ch//bend. v A pitch-bend value, 0..16383 (what parseMessage() puts in value). −1 at 0, 0 at 8192, +1 at 16383.

MIDI 把彎音輪的中心定在 8192，所以中心以下有 8192 級，以上有 8191 級。它在中心以下除以 8192，以上除以 8191，因此最低剛好是 −1，最高剛好是 +1，休息位置剛好是 0。發佈成 midi/bend 和 midi/ch//bend 的就是這個數字。 v 彎音輪的數值，0..16383（parseMessage() 放在 value 裡的那個）。 0 時是 −1，8192 時是 0，16383 時是 +1。

What each sends: knob and fader a CC (0..1); encoder a CC that is either relative (position plus a /delta signal) or absolute; pad a note (velocity while held, with a /hit pulse) or a CC; button a note or CC, momentary or toggle; keys a range of notes; wheel and strip a CC or pitch bend, optionally bipolar and spring-loaded. A plain array. A control's type must be one of these or validateProfile() reports it.

各自送什麼：knob 和 fader 送 CC（0..1）。encoder 送 CC，可以是相對（位置加上 /delta 訊號）或絕對。pad 送音符（按著時是力度，並有 /hit 脈衝）或 CC。button 送音符或 CC，可以是瞬間或切換。keys 是一段音域的音符。wheel 和 strip 送 CC 或彎音，可以是雙向，也可以帶彈簧。 一個普通陣列。控制項的 type 必須是其中之一，否則 validateProfile() 會回報。

This is rule 1 of the project (continuous control goes through params): a world does not read midi/lpd8/k1 in update(), it declares a param and lets a route drive it. An id the profile does not have throws profile akai-lpd8 has no control "x", so a typo is loud. profile The device's profile (raw or normalized): used to check the ids and to know which controls are bipolar. bindings { controlId: target }, where target is a param name or a route object ({ target, inMin, inMax, … }). A pad written as { target: 'burst', on: 'hit' } listens to the /hit pulse instead of its velocity. short The signal namespace. The default is the profile's short; give another when you run the device under a different one. extra Every other key of the third argument ({ inMin: 0, inMax: 0.5 }) is copied onto each route as a default; a key in the route object itself wins. [{ source, target, … }], ready for mapper.addRoute(route). A bipolar control (a pitch wheel) gets inMin: -1, inMax: 1. Any other key in the third argument is copied onto every route.

這是專案的第一條規則（連續控制要經過參數）：世界不在 update() 裡讀 midi/lpd8/k1，而是宣告一個參數，由路由來推動它。設定檔沒有的 id 會丟出 profile akai-lpd8 has no control "x"，打錯字一定看得見。 profile 那台機器的設定檔（原始或整理過的都行）：用來檢查 id，並判斷哪些控制項是雙向的。 bindings { 控制項 id: target }，target 是參數名稱，或路由物件（{ target, inMin, inMax, … }）。打擊墊寫成 { target: 'burst', on: 'hit' } 時，聽的是 /hit 脈衝而不是力度。 short 訊號的命名空間，預設是設定檔的 short。同一台機器用了別的命名空間時才需要改。 extra 第三個參數裡其他的鍵（例如 { inMin: 0, inMax: 0.5 }）會當成預設值複製到每一條路由上，路由物件自己有的鍵優先。 [{ source, target, … }]，可以直接用 mapper.addRoute(route)。雙向的控制項（彎音輪）會自動加上 inMin: -1, inMax: 1。第三個參數裡的其他鍵，會複製到每一條路由上。

A 2018 sketch that calls navigator.requestMIDIAccess() (or WebMidi.js) and waits for a keyboard shows nothing on a laptop without one, and on an iPad has no Web MIDI at all. Hand it this access instead and the on-screen controller becomes a real-looking MIDI input: the sketch's own unmodified code receives midimessage events with the same bytes a keyboard sends. The virtual OUTPUT is a real-looking port too: a program that plays out to it (Strudel's .midi('OAV Virtual MIDI'), a WebMidi.js sketch) calls send(bytes, timestamp), and onOutput hears both. Real ports can be merged in with addReal(realAccess): they come FIRST in inputs, the virtual one last, so a sketch that only listens to inputs[0] takes the hardware when it is there and the virtual controller when it is not. Real ports pass through untouched, so nothing is delivered twice. access.inputs and access.outputs are Maps, as in Web MIDI. input.listening counts the listeners a program put on the port, and requests counts how often virtualRequestMIDIAccess() handed the access out. name The name of the virtual port, as the sketch sees it. manufacturer The manufacturer the virtual ports report. id The port id prefix: the ports are -in and -out. sysex What access.sysexEnabled reports. onOutput (bytes, timestamp) => … called when a program sends to the virtual OUTPUT. timestamp is when the bytes should sound (performance.now() milliseconds), or undefined for "now". onClear Called when the program calls output.clear() (Web…

2018 年寫的草圖呼叫 navigator.requestMIDIAccess()（或 WebMidi.js）然後等鍵盤，在沒有鍵盤的筆電上什麼都不會出現，在 iPad 上更是完全沒有 Web MIDI。改成交給它這個 access，螢幕上的控制器就變成一個看起來像真的 MIDI 輸入：草圖原封不動的程式碼，會收到跟鍵盤送出的位元組一模一樣的 midimessage 事件。 虛擬「輸出」也長得像真的埠：對它輸出的程式（Strudel 的 .midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')、WebMidi.js 草圖）會呼叫 send(bytes, timestamp)，onOutput 會同時收到位元組和時間戳。可以用 addReal(realAccess) 併入真實的埠：它們排在 inputs 的「前面」，虛擬的排最後，所以只聽 inputs[0] 的草圖，有硬體時用硬體，沒有時用虛擬控制器。真實的埠原封不動地穿過，所以不會重複送達。 跟 Web MIDI 一樣，access.inputs 和 access.outputs 都是 Map。input.listening 是程式在這個埠上掛了幾個監聽，requests 是 virtualRequestMIDIAccess() 把這個 access 交出去幾次。 name 虛擬埠的名稱，也就是草圖看到的名字。 manufacturer 虛擬埠回報的 manufacturer。 id 埠 id 的前綴：埠的 id 是 -in 和 -out。 sysex access.sysexEnabled 回報的值。 onOutput 程式送到虛擬「輸出」時呼叫的 (bytes, timestamp) => …。timestamp 是這些位元組該發聲的時間（performance.now() 毫秒），undefined 表示「現在」。 onClear 程式呼叫 output.clear() 時被呼叫（Web MIDI 的意思是：丟掉還在排隊的）。 { access, input, output, emit(bytes), addReal(realAccess), real, requests, dispose() }。把 access 交給程式。emit() 把位元組彈進虛擬輸入。

parseEmbedOptions() fills profile with it. createController() and ControllerCanvas have the same id as their own default. A constant. without a profile attribute and the iframe embed without ?profile= show this device.
parseEmbedOptions() 會用它填入 profile。createController() 和 ControllerCanvas 自己的預設值也是同一個 id。 常數。沒有 profile 屬性的 ，和沒有 ?profile= 的 iframe 嵌入，都會顯示這台機器。

The formats are Note On ch1 n60 v100 (two spaces after "On"), Note Off ch1 n60, CC ch1 #74=64, Bend ch1 0.50 (the bend as −1..1 with two decimals), Pressure ch1 50, Poly AT ch1 n60 33 and Program ch1 5. The Midi engine writes one of these to its log for each message it parses (clock is left out). Easily confused with describeMessage() and describeDetail(), which write the shorter lines the readout shows (CC 70 = 53). This one takes an event and is meant for logs. ev An event from parseMessage(). The line. null gives ?, and a type without a format (clock, sysex) gives its type name.

格式是 Note On ch1 n60 v100（On 後面兩個空格）、Note Off ch1 n60、CC ch1 #74=64、Bend ch1 0.50（彎音換成 −1..1，兩位小數）、Pressure ch1 50、Poly AT ch1 n60 33、Program ch1 5。Midi 引擎解析的每則訊息（時鐘除外），都會把這樣的一行寫進它的記錄。 容易跟 describeMessage()、describeDetail() 搞混：那兩個寫的是 讀數列用的較短文字（CC 70 = 53）。這一個吃事件物件，是給記錄用的。 ev parseMessage() 回傳的事件。 那一行文字。給 null 回傳 ?，沒有格式的類型（clock、sysex）則回傳類型名稱。
It is part of the MIDI 1.0 specification, not of any one device. Read the reply with parseDeviceInquiry(). The bytes, ready to send. Sending it needs SysEx permission.
它屬於 MIDI 1.0 規格，不是哪一台機器專有。回覆用 parseDeviceInquiry() 讀。 位元組，可以直接送。送出需要 SysEx 權限。

A virtual cable or a DAW can send your message straight back on an input, and the engine would treat it as a performer. sent(bytes) records a message and isEcho(bytes) asks whether an arriving one is that message returning. Each sent message cancels at most ONE echo, so two real identical messages are not both eaten. A note-on with velocity 0 counts as a note-off, in both directions, because a DAW may rewrite one as the other. System messages (clock and the like) are never recorded. Midi has one (midi.echo, with the echoWindow option) and drops the echoes it finds, counted in midi.echoDropped. window Milliseconds an echo may take to come back. 0 turns the guard off. max How many sent messages to remember. Only the newest max are kept.

虛擬線路或 DAW 可能把你送出的訊息原樣從輸入送回來，引擎會把它當成演奏者。sent(bytes) 記下一則訊息，isEcho(bytes) 問「剛到的這則是不是那一則回來了」。每則送出的訊息最多只抵銷「一個」回音，所以兩則真正相同的訊息不會被一起吃掉。 力度 0 的 note-on 當成 note-off，雙向都算，因為 DAW 可能把其中一種改寫成另一種。系統訊息（時鐘之類）不會被記錄。Midi 內建一個（midi.echo，由 echoWindow 選項設定），並把找到的回音丟掉，數量記在 midi.echoDropped。 window 回音可以晚多久回來（毫秒）。0 表示關閉。 max 要記住幾則送出的訊息，只留最新的 max 則。

encodeMessage({ type: 'noteon', ch: 10, note: 36, vel: 127 }) is [0x99, 36, 127]. The channel is held to 1..16 and every data byte is rounded and held to 0..127, so a bad value cannot produce an invalid message. A missing vel is 100 for noteon and 0 for noteoff. A pitchbend value (0..16383) is split into two 7-bit bytes, low byte first, as MIDI requires. The package uses this for the on-screen controller and for LED feedback. ev An event: type is noteon, noteoff, polyat, cc, program, chanat or pitchbend, with the fields parseMessage() uses for that type. ch defaults to 1. The bytes, ready for output.send(). null for a type it cannot make (clock, sysex, anything unknown).

encodeMessage({ type: 'noteon', ch: 10, note: 36, vel: 127 }) 得到 [0x99, 36, 127]。頻道會限制在 1..16，每個資料位元組都會四捨五入並限制在 0..127，所以錯誤的數值做不出不合法的訊息。沒給 vel 的話，noteon 是 100，noteoff 是 0。 pitchbend 的 value（0..16383）會照 MIDI 規定拆成兩個 7 位元的位元組，低位在前。套件用它來做螢幕上的控制器和 LED 回饋。 ev 事件物件：type 是 noteon、noteoff、polyat、cc、program、chanat 或 pitchbend，欄位跟 parseMessage() 對該類型用的一樣。ch 預設是 1。 位元組陣列，可以直接給 output.send()。做不出來的類型（clock、sysex、不認得的）回傳 null。

It lets anything that only hears a Signals bus (a recorded take playing back, the on-screen piano, a phone) drive a controller model as if the bytes had arrived. Values come back on the 0..127 scale they were published from (value × 127, rounded), so the round trip through genericSignals() is exact. A note signal with a value above 0 is a noteon (velocity at least 1), and 0 is a noteoff. The on-screen piano publishes channel 0, which is read as channel. A hardware message is published under both families, so a listener that wants each message once should use followMidiSignals() instead of calling this on every name. name A signal name. Only the generic names starting with midi/ are understood. value The signal's value: a number 0..1 (−1..1 for bend), or the { note, vel, velocity, ch } payload of midi/note/on and midi/note/off. channel The channel to use for the legacy names that carry none (midi/cc/, midi/bend). family is 'channel' or 'legacy', and ev is the event. null for a device name (midi/minilab3/…), midi/virtual and anything else.

有了它，只聽得到 Signals 匯流排的東西（正在回放的錄音、螢幕上的鋼琴、手機），也能像收到原始位元組一樣去推動控制器模型。數值會還原成當初發佈時的 0..127 尺度（值 × 127 再四捨五入），所以跟 genericSignals() 來回轉換不會失真。 音符訊號的值大於 0 是 noteon（力度至少 1），等於 0 是 noteoff。螢幕上的鋼琴發佈的頻道是 0，會被當成 channel 參數。硬體的一則訊息會用兩組名稱各發佈一次，所以想「每則訊息只處理一次」的話，請用 followMidiSignals()，不要對每個名稱都呼叫這個函式。 name 訊號名稱。只認得 midi/ 開頭的通用名稱。 value 訊號的值：0..1 的數字（彎音是 −1..1），或 midi/note/on、midi/note/off 那個 { note, vel, velocity, ch } 內容。 channel 沒有頻道資訊的短名稱（midi/cc/、midi/bend）要用哪個頻道。 family 是 'channel' 或 'legacy'，ev 是事件。裝置名稱（midi/minilab3/…）、midi/virtual 和其他名稱都回傳 null。

A profile has three levels of certainty. verified: true means a person moved this control on a real unit and the message matched, and validateProfile() refuses it without a hardware entry in verifications. No verified field means the number comes from a cited source and nobody has checked it on a unit yet. verified: false means it is our best reading, and a note says why. c One control of a profile. 'hardware' for verified: true, 'unconfirmed' for verified: false, 'source' when the field is absent.

設定檔的確定程度分三級。verified: true 表示有人在實機上動過這個控制項，訊息也對得上，沒有 verifications 裡的實機紀錄，validateProfile() 會拒絕它。沒有 verified 欄位，表示數字來自註明的出處，還沒有人在實機上確認。verified: false 表示這是我們最好的判讀，note 會寫原因。 c 設定檔裡的一個控制項。 verified: true 回傳 'hardware'，verified: false 回傳 'unconfirmed'，沒有這個欄位回傳 'source'。

This is how the midi-out attribute, the hardware attribute's port name and createController()'s setOutput(query) read what you typed. ports Ports with a name (an array, such as midi.outputs). query A name, a part of a name ('IAC', 'loopMIDI'), or '/^mini/'. Flags after the closing slash are used; without flags the regex is case-insensitive. The first matching port. A broken regex finds nothing instead of throwing.

midi-out 屬性、hardware 屬性裡的埠名，以及 createController() 的 setOutput(query)，都是用它來理解你打的字。 ports 有 name 的埠（陣列，例如 midi.outputs）。 query 名稱、名稱的一部分（'IAC'、'loopMIDI'），或 '/^mini/'。結尾斜線後面的旗標會被採用，沒寫旗標的話正規表示式不分大小寫。 第一個符合的埠。壞掉的正規表示式只會找不到，不會丟出錯誤。

Use it when you hold your own list, for example the profiles a picker offers (controller.controllers.profiles), and want the same id-or-short lookup the element uses. ref A profile id or short name. profiles The list to search (required here, unlike profileById(), which uses the shipped ones). The profile in the list.
手上有自己的清單時用，例如選單提供的設定檔（controller.controllers.profiles），而你想用跟元素相同的「id 或短名稱」查法。 ref 設定檔的 id 或 short 短名稱。 profiles 要搜尋的清單（這裡一定要給，不像 profileById() 固定用內建的）。 清單裡的那份設定檔。
The inverse of parseHex(). Use it for logs and for showing someone the exact message before it is sent. bytes The bytes. For example 'F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7'. Nothing in, an empty string out.
是 parseHex() 的反向。用在紀錄檔，或在送出之前把訊息原樣給人看。 bytes 位元組。 例如 'F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7'。沒有輸入就回傳空字串。

Two families, both published for every hardware port and every virtual controller. The short ones are what most worlds read: a noteon becomes the pulse midi/note/on with { note, vel (0..1), velocity (1..127), ch, device }, a noteoff becomes midi/note/off with { note, ch, device }, a cc becomes midi/cc/ (0..1), and a pitchbend becomes midi/bend (−1..1). The per-channel ones are for two devices that share a CC number, or a work that cares about the channel: midi/ch//note/ (velocity 0..1 while held, 0 on release), midi/ch//cc/, midi/ch//bend, midi/ch//pressure (channel aftertouch) and midi/ch//poly/ (polyphonic aftertouch). Pressure and poly exist only in this family. program, clock and the other system messages produce nothing. There is deliberately no midi/cc//: under prefix subscriptions it would collide with "CC 1 on any channel". ev An event from parseMessage(). null gives an empty list. device Written into the device field of the midi/note/on and midi/note/off pulses (the port slug). legacy Include the short names that ignore the channel (midi/note/on, midi/cc/, midi/bend). channel Include the per-channel names (midi/ch//…). One item per signal. Hand the list to publish().

兩組名稱，每個硬體連接埠和每個虛擬控制器都會發佈。短名稱是大多數世界讀的：noteon 變成脈衝 midi/note/on，內容是 { note, vel（0..1）, velocity（1..127）, ch, device }。noteoff 變成 midi/note/off，內容是 { note, ch, device }。cc 變成 midi/cc/（0..1），pitchbend 變成 midi/bend（−1..1）。 分頻道的那組給「兩台機器共用同一個 CC 編號」或「作品在意頻道」的時候用：midi/ch//note/（按著時是力度 0..1，放開是 0）、midi/ch//cc/、midi/ch//bend、midi/ch//pressure（頻道觸後）、midi/ch//poly/（複音觸後）。壓力和 poly 只存在於這一組。program、clock 和其他系統訊息不會產生訊號。 刻意沒有 midi/cc// 這種名稱：用前綴訂閱時，它會跟「任何頻道的 CC 1」搞混。 ev parseMessage() 回傳的事件。給 null 會得到空陣列。 device 寫進 midi/note/on、midi/note/off 脈衝的 device 欄位（連接埠的 slug）。 legacy 是否包含不分頻道的短名稱（midi/note/on、midi/cc/、midi/bend）。 channel 是否包含分頻道的名稱（midi/ch//…）。 每個訊號一項。把整個陣列交給 publish() 即可。

The groups follow the TouchDesigner tool's out CHOPs (out_knob, out_slider, out_pad …). A control gets its type as group unless the profile gives another. MidiController has a method of the same name that returns the current values instead of the ids. p A normalized profile, so every control has its group filled in. An object of arrays of control ids.
分組方式跟 TouchDesigner 工具的輸出 CHOP（out_knob、out_slider、out_pad …）一致。控制項沒特別指定的話，就用它的類型當分組。MidiController 有個同名的方法，回傳的是目前的數值，不是 id。 p 整理過的設定檔，這樣每個控制項才有 group。 由控制項 id 陣列組成的物件。

Their data is Apache-2.0, from QLC+ (see NOTICE), their layouts are generated (face.auto), and every control is verified: false. and oav-p5's ?profile= work with these ids. When one is plugged in, MidiControllers fetches its file and shows it, after the shipped profiles have had their say. A plain array, written by tools/import-qlc.mjs. These controllers are not in PROFILES, so a page that shows one does not fetch them all. Each row has kind and match, so matchProfile() can name the one a port wants before any file is loaded.

這些資料是 Apache-2.0，來自 QLC+（見 NOTICE），版面是自動產生的（face.auto），每個控制項都是 verified: false。 和 oav-p5 的 ?profile= 都能用這些 id。插上其中一台時，MidiControllers 會在內建設定檔都沒認領之後抓它的檔案並顯示。 一個普通陣列，由 tools/import-qlc.mjs 產生。這些控制器不在 PROFILES 裡，顯示一台的頁面不會全部抓下來。每一列都有 kind 和 match，還沒載入檔案，matchProfile() 就能判斷連接埠要的是哪一台。

This is how MidiController decides which control a message belongs to. Use it to build your own router. Each value is a list because a message can move more than one control. p A normalized profile (each control needs its ch). The keys are cc::, note::, polyat::, pitchbend:, chanat:, program:. A keys control gets one entry per note of its range.
MidiController 就是用它判斷一則訊息屬於哪個控制項。要自己做路由時可以拿來用。每個值都是清單，因為一則訊息可能推動不只一個控制項。 p 整理過的設定檔（每個控制項都要有 ch）。 鍵的格式是 cc::、note::、polyat::、pitchbend:、chanat:、program:。琴鍵控制項的音域裡每個音都有一筆。

A port that was unplugged can still be an object in your hands. Sending to it gets nowhere, and the engine's try/catch swallows the error, so nothing on screen says why. The output rules (pickOutput(), reselectOutput()) therefore skip every port that is not live. p A port shaped like a MIDIOutput: it only needs a state. false for null and for a disconnected port.
被拔掉的埠，在你手上仍然是個物件。對它送資料到不了任何地方，引擎的 try/catch 又會把錯誤吞掉，畫面上看不出原因。所以輸出的挑選規則（pickOutput()、reselectOutput()）會跳過所有不存活的埠。 p 長得像 MIDIOutput 的埠，只需要有 state。 給 null 或已斷線的埠回傳 false。

It is the test resolveProfile() uses to decide between looking an id up and fetching a file. A bare name that happens to end in .json also counts as a URL. ref What the page or attribute gave. Anything that is not a string is false. true when the string starts with http:, https:, blob: or data:, starts with /, ./ or ../, or ends in .json (optionally followed by ?… or #…).
resolveProfile() 就是用它決定要「查 id」還是「抓檔案」。剛好以 .json 結尾的單純名稱也會被當成網址。 ref 頁面或屬性給的內容。不是字串一律是 false。 字串以 http:、https:、blob:、data: 開頭，或以 /、./、../ 開頭，或以 .json 結尾（後面可接 ?… 或 #…）時為 true。

Colours are scaled to what the message takes: Novation's run 0..127 and AKAI's 0..255, and you always pass 0..255. This only builds bytes. To send them, see setLedColor() on createController(). p A profile. control One of its controls. color { r, g, b }, each 0..255, or { color }, a palette value. The bytes, or null when the control has no ledIndex or the profile has no such message.

顏色會換算成訊息要的範圍：Novation 是 0..127，AKAI 是 0..255，你一律傳 0..255。這個函式只組位元組，要送出請看 createController() 的 setLedColor()。 p 設定檔。 control 它的一個控制項。 color { r, g, b }，每個 0..255，或 { color }，色票值。 位元組，控制項沒有 ledIndex 或設定檔沒有這種訊息時回傳 null。

A phone's MIDI tab publishes the device's signals itself (the controller lives there), so this side only does three things. When you select another device it tells the phones with relay.config('midi', { profile }). When a knob, fader, encoder, wheel, strip or toggle button on THIS machine moves from hardware or the screen, it queues relay.feedback('midi//', value) so the phone's knobs follow. When a phone plays (midi/virtual) it mirrors that on this screen, state and view only, because the phone already published the signals. This is what @openav/remote's show-side host and the lab's midi module call. You need it only when you wire phones into a page yourself. relay A relay client with config(name, value) and feedback(signalName, value) (the show runner's RelayClient). signals The bus the phones' midi/virtual messages arrive on. controllers The manager whose controllers are linked. flush() sends the queued feedback to the relay (call it at a steady pace, for example once per frame). dispose() stops listening.

手機的 MIDI 分頁自己會發佈機器的訊號（控制器就住在那裡），所以這一端只做三件事。你用 select 換了機器，就用 relay.config('midi', { profile }) 告訴手機。這台電腦上的旋鈕、推桿、編碼器、彎音輪、觸控條或切換按鈕被硬體或螢幕動了，就把 relay.feedback('midi//', value) 排進佇列，讓手機上的旋鈕跟著動。手機彈了（midi/virtual），就鏡射在這個螢幕上，只更新狀態和畫面，因為手機已經發佈過訊號了。 @openav/remote 在演出端的主機，和實驗室的 midi 模組，用的就是它。只有在你自己把手機接進頁面時才需要。 relay 中繼客戶端，要有 config(name, value) 和 feedback(signalName, value)（演出執行器的 RelayClient）。 signals 手機的 midi/virtual 訊息抵達的匯流排。 controllers 要連起來的控制器所屬的管理器。 flush() 把佇列中的回饋送給中繼（以穩定的節奏呼叫，例如每個畫面一次）。dispose() 停止監聽。

It is resolveProfile() with the shipped profiles and the page's base URL filled in. calls it to read your file. A bad file says why instead of drawing nothing. ref An id ('akai-lpd8'), a short name ('lpd8'), a URL or path to a profile JSON, or a profile object. o Options passed on to resolveProfile(): fetch, base, and profiles (default: every shipped profile). base defaults to the page's document.baseURI, so a relative path is read from the page. The raw profile. Rejects with every problem listed when a file or object is invalid, or with unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …) when an id does not exist.

它就是 resolveProfile()，只是已經幫你帶入內建設定檔和頁面的基底網址。 就是呼叫它來讀你的檔案。檔案有問題時會說明原因，而不是什麼都不畫。 ref id（'akai-lpd8'）、短名稱（'lpd8'）、設定檔 JSON 的網址或路徑，或是設定檔物件。 o 轉交給 resolveProfile() 的選項：fetch、base，以及 profiles（預設是所有內建設定檔）。base 預設是頁面的 document.baseURI，所以相對路徑會以頁面為準。 原始的設定檔。檔案或物件不合法時 reject，並列出所有問題。id 不存在則 reject 為 unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)。

Only device profiles are considered (a generic layout never matches by name). A profile matches when one of its match.ports regular expressions (case-insensitive) hits the name. The score starts at 1, gains 1 when a match.prefer pattern also hits, and loses 2 when a match.avoid pattern hits. The highest positive score wins, so a port a device only exposes for something else (Minilab3 DIN THRU, Minilab3 MCU/HUI) does not match. This is how MidiControllers turns a plugged-in device into the right on-screen controller. When a device exposes several ports, pickPort() chooses which one to listen to. portName The name of a MIDI input port. profiles The profiles to search, usually PROFILES. The best match, or null when no device profile fits.

只考慮 device 設定檔（通用版面永遠不會靠名稱配對）。設定檔的某個 match.ports 正規表示式（不分大小寫）對得上名稱，就算符合。分數從 1 開始，match.prefer 也對上就加 1，match.avoid 對上就扣 2。取最高的正分，所以機器為了別的用途開出來的埠（Minilab3 DIN THRU、Minilab3 MCU/HUI）不會被配對。 MidiControllers 就是靠它把接上的機器變成正確的螢幕控制器。一台機器開出好幾個埠時，由 pickPort() 決定聽哪一個。 portName MIDI 輸入埠的名稱。 profiles 要搜尋的設定檔，通常是 PROFILES。 最佳的符合者。沒有任何 device 設定檔符合時回傳 null。

Create it, then await midi.enable(). It resolves true once the browser has given access and false when there is no Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) or the permission was refused; the reason is written to the log (onMessage). Nothing is listened to or sent before that. In: every message from every listened input goes to the callbacks you added with listen(fn) (raw bytes, including clock), then is parsed and published as genericSignals() names. With two or more inputs it also publishes midi//note/on, midi//note/off, midi//cc/ and midi//bend, so devices do not collide. The slug comes from the port name (Minilab3 MIDI becomes minilab3-midi), so a device that drops and reconnects keeps its identity. Clock messages are not logged and publish nothing. Out: send(bytes), noteOn(), noteOff() and cc() go to midi.out, the chosen output port, and are remembered for echo filtering. If that port is unplugged the engine moves to the next best live port (your choice by name, then prefer, then the first), moves back when your choice returns, and never lets an unrelated device steal the output. Every switch writes one line to the log and one console.warn, and calls the onOutput subscribers. Hooks you can assign: onCC(cc, value01, ch), onNote(note, velocity01, on, ch), onMessage({ dir, text }) (the log), onSend(bytes) (sees everything sent, for a meter) and onDeviceChange(devices). Fields: enabled, inputs, outputs, out, access, echoDropped. Call await midi.enable() first. Browsers with Web MIDI…

建立之後，await midi.enable()。瀏覽器給了存取權就回傳 true，沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad）或權限被拒絕就回傳 false，原因會寫進記錄（onMessage）。在那之前不會聽也不會送任何東西。 輸入：每個被聆聽的輸入埠送來的每一則訊息，會先交給你用 listen(fn) 加的函式（原始位元組，包含時鐘），再被解析並發佈成 genericSignals() 的名稱。有兩個以上輸入埠時，另外會發佈 midi//note/on、midi//note/off、midi//cc/ 和 midi//bend，讓不同機器不會互相打架。slug 由埠名產生（Minilab3 MIDI 變成 minilab3-midi），所以機器斷線再接回來，身分不變。時鐘訊息不寫記錄，也不發佈訊號。 輸出：send(bytes)、noteOn()、noteOff()、cc() 都會送到 midi.out（選定的輸出埠），並記下來做回音過濾。那個埠被拔掉時，引擎會換到下一個最好的存活埠（先你用名稱指定的，再 prefer，最後第一個），你指定的埠回來就換回去，而且不相干的新裝置不會搶走輸出。每次切換都會寫一行記錄、一個 console.warn，並通知 onOutput 的訂閱者。 可以指定的掛鉤：onCC(cc, value01, ch)、onNote(note, velocity01, on, ch)、onMessage({ dir, text })（記錄）、onSend(bytes)（看得到所有送出的訊息，做音量表用）、onDeviceChange(devices)。欄位有：enabled、inputs、outputs、out、access、echoDropped。 要先呼叫 await midi.enable()。有 Web MIDI 的瀏覽器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox）會在這個時候向訪客要權限，所以可以的話請在點擊裡呼叫。Safari 和 iPad 沒有 Web MIDI，enable() 會回傳 false。 createShow() 會替你建立一個並啟用它。createController() 和 在同一個頁面上共用一個引擎，所以一頁放五個控制器也只會要一次 MIDI。 引擎只送 MIDI 資料，自己不發聲。想聽到音符，另一端要有合成器（接在 IAC 匯流排上的 DAW、硬體合成器），或是用 @openav/sound。 signals 把每則輸入訊息發佈成 midi/… 訊號（見 genericSignals()）。不給的話，引擎仍然會呼叫 listen() 的函式和 on… 掛鉤。 filterOut 永遠不聽的輸入埠「名稱」，寫成正規表示式（字串會當成它的內容，不分大小寫）。預設 'IAC' 是 macOS 上你用來送進 Ableton 或 TouchDesigner 的匯流排，這樣你送出去的東西不會又從輸入回來。給 null 就是全部都聽。 requestAccess MIDIAccess 從哪裡來，會以 requestAccess({ sysex: false }) 呼叫，要回傳 promise。預設是 navigator.requestMIDIAccess。測試、轉接層，或是替舊草圖包裝了 Web MIDI 的環境，可以傳自己的函式，並把「真的」那個交到這裡。 echoWindow 毫秒。輸入的訊息如果跟這個時間內剛「送出」的某一則完全相同，就視為自己的回音而丟掉（計入…

The one idea: the on-screen controller and the hardware speak the SAME language, MIDI bytes. setValue(), press() and the other virtual hands encode the exact message the real control would send and feed it through ingest(), the same door the hardware uses. So a virtual knob and a real one can never drift apart, and what your work receives is identical whichever hand moved it. Pass the bytes of a real device to ingest(bytes, { source: 'hw' }). The source of a message decides what is published, so every event is published exactly once. 'hw': the device lives here, and Midi already published the generic midi/… names, so only midi//… is added. 'ui': a virtual hand, so it publishes midi//…, the generic names, and midi/virtual (the raw bytes, for Web MIDI shims). 'mirror': someone else published it (a phone, feedback), so only the state and the views move. Signals per control (values are normalised, raw keeps the MIDI number): midi// (0..1, −1..1 for a bipolar wheel) and /raw; an encoder's /delta; a pad's /hit pulse { vel, velocity, note, ch } and /pressure; a keys control's /on and /off pulses and midi//n while a key is held; and midi//last, a pulse saying what was touched last. profileSignals() lists them for a profile. Each control keeps a state { value, raw, held, pressure, pos } in controller.state (read it with get(id)). controller.keys maps each held key's note to its velocity. controller.profile is the working copy (learning changes it), controller.base the normalized…

核心想法：螢幕上的控制器和硬體說的是「同一種語言」，MIDI 位元組。setValue()、press() 等虛擬的手，會編出真實控制項會送的那則訊息，再從 ingest() 送進去，也就是硬體走的同一個入口。所以虛擬旋鈕和真的旋鈕不會漂開，作品收到的東西也一樣，不論是哪隻手動的。真實機器的位元組請用 ingest(bytes, { source: 'hw' }) 餵進去。 訊息的 source 決定發佈什麼，讓每個事件只發佈一次。'hw'：機器就在這裡，Midi 已經發佈過通用的 midi/… 名稱，所以只多發佈 midi//…。'ui'：虛擬的手，所以會發佈 midi//…、通用名稱，以及 midi/virtual（原始位元組，給 Web MIDI 轉接用）。'mirror'：別人已經發佈過了（手機、回饋），所以只更新狀態和畫面。 每個控制項的訊號（數值已正規化，raw 保留 MIDI 的號碼）：midi//（0..1，雙向彎音輪是 −1..1）和 /raw。旋鈕有 /delta，打擊墊有 /hit 脈衝 { vel, velocity, note, ch } 和 /pressure，琴鍵控制項有 /on、/off 脈衝，按著某個鍵時有 midi//n，另外還有 midi//last，這個脈衝說明最後碰了哪個控制項。profileSignals() 能列出某份設定檔的全部名稱。 每個控制項的狀態是 { value, raw, held, pressure, pos }，存在 controller.state（用 get(id) 讀）。controller.keys 把每個按著的琴鍵音符對應到力度。controller.profile 是正在使用的副本（學習會改動它），controller.base 是還沒學習之前整理過的設定檔，controller.lastEvent 是最後一則訊息和它的文字，controller.learning 與 controller.learned 記錄學習模式。 在演出裡不要在 update() 讀 midi/lpd8/k1，要用 controllerRoutes() 把它接到參數上。你很少需要自己建立 MidiController：MidiControllers 會替每份設定檔建立一個，createController() 則把這一切包起來。 profile 原始或整理過的設定檔（見 PROFILES）。會被複製一份，之後改動原物件不會有影響。 signals 把控制器的訊號發佈到這裡。 sink 每個訊號改成呼叫 (name, value, { pulse, min, max }) => …，不走 signals（例如中繼、手機）。兩個都給的話以 sink 為準。 short 覆寫訊號的命名空間，這樣兩台同型號的控制器就能用不同名稱發佈。 onLed 控制項狀態改變時，用「讓硬體上 LED 亮起或變暗的 MIDI」呼叫 (bytes) => …。

There is one MidiController per profile, created the first time it is asked for (get(id)), so a virtual MiniLab and a real MiniLab are the SAME object: whichever hand moves it, the work receives the same midi/minilab3/… signals. current is the controller the panel shows. With a midi attached it matches every input port to a profile by name (matchProfile(), one port per device through pickPort()), switches current to the first device it recognises, sends the LED colours to its output port, and routes each port's messages to that profile's controller. A port nobody recognises can be given to a profile by hand with assign(slug, profileId); that choice is remembered per port name. It remembers in storage under openav.midi.map. (learned mappings, restored when the controller is created) and openav.midi.assign (manual port assignments). profiles The profiles to manage, usually PROFILES. Required: the first one is shown when initial is not given. signals Passed to every MidiController it creates. sink Passed on to every controller, as in MidiController. midi An enabled (or about-to-be-enabled) Midi to follow. Leave it out for no hardware, and call attach(midi) later. initial The profile id shown before any hardware arrives. storage Where learned mappings and manual port assignments are remembered: anything with getItem and setItem. The default is localStorage when the page has it, otherwise nothing is remembered. imported Rows to recognise a port by when no profile claims it. Pass…

每份設定檔只有一個 MidiController，第一次被要求時才建立（get(id)），所以虛擬的 MiniLab 和真的 MiniLab 是「同一個物件」：不論哪隻手在動，作品收到的都是同樣的 midi/minilab3/… 訊號。current 是面板正在顯示的那個控制器。 接上 midi 之後，它會用名稱把每個輸入埠對到設定檔（matchProfile()，一台機器只取一個埠，由 pickPort() 決定），把 current 切到第一台認得的機器，把 LED 顏色送到它的輸出埠，並把每個埠的訊息導向該設定檔的控制器。沒有人認得的埠，可以用 assign(slug, profileId) 手動指定給某份設定檔，這個選擇會依埠名記起來。 它會把資料記在 storage 的 openav.midi.map.（學到的對應，建立控制器時還原）和 openav.midi.assign（手動指定的埠）。 profiles 要管理的設定檔，通常是 PROFILES。必填，沒給 initial 時會先顯示第一個。 signals 交給它建立的每個 MidiController。 sink 交給每個控制器，用法同 MidiController。 midi 要跟隨的 Midi（已啟用或即將啟用）。不給就是沒有硬體，之後再呼叫 attach(midi)。 initial 硬體出現之前先顯示的設定檔 id。 storage 用來記住學到的對應和手動指定的埠：任何有 getItem、setItem 的東西。預設是頁面有的話就用 localStorage，沒有的話就不記。 imported 沒有設定檔認領連接埠時，用來辨認的清單。傳 [] 就關掉。 loadImported 這種設定檔怎麼取得：(id) => Promise。預設是抓它的 JSON。

A word on a button decides first: play, cue, sync and loop go where they say. The rest take the next job in line. profile A profile. [{ control, group, key, led? }]. Controls with no job are left out, and so are keys and pitch bend.
按鈕上的字優先：play、cue、sync、loop 就照字面。其他的依序分配。 profile 設定檔。 [{ control, group, key, led? }]。沒有分到工作的控制項不列，琴鍵和 pitch bend 也不列。

It throws invalid MIDI profile "": followed by every problem when the profile is not valid. Otherwise it fills in: channel (1), learn (true for a generic layout), stack (true), sources and match (empty lists), and per control label (its id), group (its type), ch (the profile's channel), an encoder's relative (offset64), a button's mode (momentary) and a pitch-bend wheel's bipolar and spring (both true). Sections get label, flow (row) and spans, and portrait is built from the sections, top to bottom, with each section's height as its weight when you did not write one. MidiController, ControllerCanvas and the view all work on the normalized form, which is what controller.profile gives you. raw A raw profile. It must pass validateProfile(). A new profile object.

設定檔不合法時，它會丟出 invalid MIDI profile "":，後面接上每一個問題。合法的話會補上：channel（1）、learn（通用版面為 true）、stack（true）、sources 和 match（空清單），每個控制項的 label（用它的 id）、group（用它的類型）、ch（設定檔的頻道）、旋鈕的 relative（offset64）、按鈕的 mode（momentary）、彎音輪的 bipolar 和 spring（都是 true）。區塊會補上 label、flow（row）和 spans，沒寫 portrait 的話，會由各區塊從上到下排出來，高度當作權重。 MidiController、ControllerCanvas 和畫面元件用的都是整理後的版本，也就是 controller.profile 給你的那份。 raw 原始設定檔，必須通過 validateProfile()。 一個新的設定檔物件。

A verification record stores the firmware it was checked on, and this reads it from the unit. How the version bytes map to the number printed in a manual differs by maker, so version keeps the raw bytes beside text. data The bytes of one SysEx message. { manufacturer, family, model, version, text }: byte arrays, and text, the version bytes joined with dots.
驗證紀錄要存當時的韌體版本，這個函式從機器讀出來。版本位元組怎麼對應到說明書上的數字，各家不一樣，所以 version 保留原始位元組，text 放在旁邊。 data 一則 SysEx 訊息的位元組。 { manufacturer, family, model, version, text }：位元組陣列，text 是用點連起來的版本位元組。

It throws on anything that is not a hex byte, so a typo stops here instead of reaching a device. text Hex bytes separated by spaces or commas. 0x in front and h behind are allowed, so a line pasted from a manual works. The bytes.
遇到不是十六進位位元組的東西會丟出錯誤，打錯字會在這裡停下來，不會送到機器上。 text 用空白或逗號分開的十六進位位元組。前面有 0x、後面有 h 都可以，所以從說明書貼來的一行也能用。 位元組陣列。

parseMessage([0x90, 60, 100]) is { type: 'noteon', ch: 1, note: 60, vel: 100 }. Channels are numbered 1 to 16, the way they are printed on a device (the status byte stores 0 to 15), and data bytes are cut to 0..127. Every other function in this package that handles MIDI speaks these event objects. The type is noteon and noteoff (note, vel), polyat (polyphonic aftertouch: note, value), cc (cc, value), program (value), chanat (channel pressure: value) or pitchbend (value 0..16383, centre 8192). System messages come back as clock, start, continue, stop, sysex (with data, the whole message) or system (with the status byte). A note-on with velocity 0 comes back as noteoff, because that is how many devices say "released". Bytes that start with a data byte give null: the browser has already resolved running status before it hands you the message. It is pure: no DOM, no Web MIDI, no state. encodeMessage() is its inverse, and describe() turns the result into a line of text. data The bytes of ONE message, the way Web MIDI hands them over (event.data): a status byte first, then up to two data bytes. The event, or null when the input is empty, starts with a data byte (below 0x80) or is a channel status it has no case for.

parseMessage([0x90, 60, 100]) 會得到 { type: 'noteon', ch: 1, note: 60, vel: 100 }。頻道編號是 1 到 16，跟機器上印的一樣（狀態位元組裡存的是 0 到 15），資料位元組會被限制在 0..127。這個套件裡其他處理 MIDI 的函式，講的都是這種事件物件。 type 可能是 noteon、noteoff（有 note、vel）、polyat（複音觸後：note、value）、cc（cc、value）、program（value）、chanat（頻道壓力：value）、pitchbend（value 為 0..16383，中心是 8192）。系統訊息則是 clock、start、continue、stop、sysex（附 data，整則訊息）或 system（附 status 位元組）。 力度為 0 的 note-on 會回傳成 noteoff，因為很多機器就是這樣表示「放開」。位元組開頭是資料位元組時回傳 null：瀏覽器在把訊息交給你之前，已經處理過 running status。 它是純函式：沒有 DOM、沒有 Web MIDI、沒有狀態。encodeMessage() 是它的反向，describe() 則把結果變成一行文字。 data 「一則」訊息的位元組，格式跟 Web MIDI 給你的一樣（event.data）：先是狀態位元組，後面最多兩個資料位元組。 事件物件。輸入是空的、以資料位元組（小於 0x80）開頭，或是它沒處理的頻道狀態時，回傳 null。

The order is: 1) the port named preferred, 2) the first port that matches each entry of prefer, in order, 3) the first port. Only live ports (see isLive()) are considered, so a disconnected port is never picked. It is a pure function over plain objects, so you can test the rules without any hardware. The Midi engine applies them through reselectOutput(). outputs The candidate ports (objects with a name and a state). preferred The port you asked for: tried by exact name, then as a substring. prefer Fallback order. The first entry that matches a live port wins (a string is a substring). The chosen port, or null when no port is live.

順序是：1）名稱符合 preferred 的埠，2）依序比對 prefer 每一項，取第一個符合的埠，3）第一個埠。只考慮存活的埠（見 isLive()），所以斷線的埠不會被選到。 它是處理普通物件的純函式，所以不用任何硬體就能測這些規則。Midi 引擎是透過 reselectOutput() 來套用它們。 outputs 候選的埠（有 name 和 state 的物件）。 preferred 你指定的埠：先比對完整名稱，再比對子字串。 prefer 備用順序。第一個對得上存活埠的項目勝出（字串以子字串比對）。 選到的埠。沒有任何存活的埠時回傳 null。

A port scores 1 when its name matches one of the profile's match.ports (otherwise it is out), plus 1 for a prefer match and minus 2 for an avoid match. Only positive scores count and the highest wins. It is the second half of device detection after matchProfile(). ports Candidate ports: objects with a name. profile The device's profile (its match.ports, prefer and avoid). The best port, or null when none of them fits the profile.

埠名符合設定檔的某個 match.ports 得 1 分（不符合就出局），符合 prefer 加 1 分，符合 avoid 扣 2 分。只算正分，最高分勝出。它是 matchProfile() 之後裝置偵測的第二步。 ports 候選的埠：有 name 的物件。 profile 那台機器的設定檔（用它的 match.ports、prefer、avoid）。 最合適的埠。沒有任何一個符合設定檔時回傳 null。

Only profiles from PROFILES are searched. A profile you loaded from a URL is not in there: use resolveProfile(), which also accepts ids. It does not normalize or validate: pass the result to normalizeProfile() when you need the filled-in form. id A profile id or its short name (the part in midi//…). The raw profile from PROFILES, the same object each time, or null.
只會在 PROFILES 裡找。從網址載入的設定檔不在裡面，請用 resolveProfile()，它也收 id。它不會整理也不會驗證，需要填好預設值的版本時，請把結果交給 normalizeProfile()。 id 設定檔的 id 或 short 短名稱（midi//… 裡的那一段）。 PROFILES 裡的原始設定檔，每次回傳同一個物件，找不到則是 null。

A profile describes one controller as data: what it looks like (the faceplate sections), every control on it (type and the exact MIDI message it sends), LED feedback where the device accepts it, how to recognise its port name, and the document each number came from. Each one is a JSON file in packages/midi/profiles/; the full field list is in the package README and the controllers page shows them all. A device profile cites its sources and is matched to ports by name, so plugging the device in picks it automatically. A generic layout (generic-8k8p, generic-keys49 …) never auto-matches: you assign a device to it and it learns the controls in the order you move them. Pick one with profileById() (by id or by the short name), and hand it to createController(), MidiController or MidiControllers. Do not edit these objects in place: copy first (structuredClone), as withChannel() does. A control marked verified: false (with a note saying why) has a message that comes from the manual or a guess and has not been confirmed on a real unit. The faceplate shows a small orange ? on its label, and Learn rebinds it in one move. The order is the order a device picker shows. Each item is a raw profile (see normalizeProfile() for the filled-in form): id, short, name, kind ('device' or 'generic'), face, sections, controls and, for a device, match and sources.

設定檔把一台控制器寫成資料：長什麼樣子（面板的各個區塊）、上面每個控制項（類型，以及它送出的確切 MIDI 訊息）、機器有支援的 LED 回饋、怎麼認出它的埠名，以及每個數字的出處文件。每個設定檔是 packages/midi/profiles/ 裡的一個 JSON 檔，完整欄位在套件的 README 裡，控制器頁面則列出全部。 device 設定檔要註明資料來源，並且用名稱跟埠配對，所以接上機器就會自動選到它。generic（通用）版面（generic-8k8p、generic-keys49 …）永遠不會自動配對：你把某台機器指定給它，它會照你轉動的順序學習控制項。 用 profileById() 挑一個（用 id 或短名稱），再交給 createController()、MidiController 或 MidiControllers。不要直接修改這些物件，要先複製（structuredClone），withChannel() 就是這樣做的。 標著 verified: false 的控制項（並附上 note 說明原因），它的訊息來自說明書或推測，還沒有在真實的機器上確認過。面板上它的標籤旁會有一個橘色的 ?，用學習一下就能重新綁定。 順序就是裝置選單顯示的順序。每一項是原始設定檔（填好預設值的版本見 normalizeProfile()）：有 id、short、name、kind（'device' 或 'generic'）、face、sections、controls，真實機器還有 match 和 sources。

For each control: midi// and /raw; an encoder adds /delta; a pad adds /hit (and /pressure when it has aftertouch). A keys control has only /on, /off and one midi//n per key. These are the names a MidiController publishes, so a route from controllerRoutes() or a signals.on() can use them. p A profile (its short and controls are read). Signal names, starting with midi//last.

每個控制項有 midi// 和 /raw。旋鈕多一個 /delta，打擊墊多一個 /hit（有觸後的話再加 /pressure）。琴鍵控制項只有 /on、/off，以及每個琴鍵一個 midi//n。這些就是 MidiController 發佈的名稱，所以 controllerRoutes() 的路由或 signals.on() 都能用。 p 設定檔（會讀它的 short 和 controls）。 訊號名稱，第一個是 midi//last。

For a new continuous signal it defines the range from min and max (0 and 1 when missing) and source: 'midi'. A pulse is defined as kind: 'pulse'. Then it calls signals.pulse(name, value) or signals.set(name, value). The Midi engine and MidiController already do this for you. Call it yourself when you read MIDI some other way, for example from a WebSocket, and want the same names in your show. signals The registry from @openav/core. null makes the call do nothing. list Usually the result of genericSignals(). pulse: true fires a pulse, anything else sets a value.

遇到新的連續訊號，會用 min、max（沒寫就是 0 和 1）和 source: 'midi' 來宣告範圍。脈衝則宣告成 kind: 'pulse'。接著呼叫 signals.pulse(name, value) 或 signals.set(name, value)。 Midi 引擎和 MidiController 已經替你做了這件事。只有在你用別的方式讀 MIDI（例如從 WebSocket）、又想在作品裡得到同樣名稱的時候，才需要自己呼叫。 signals @openav/core 的登錄表。給 null 就什麼都不做。 list 通常是 genericSignals() 的結果。pulse: true 會觸發脈衝，其他的會設定數值。

These numbers come from midiprotocol.h in QLC+. CC 7 on channel 2 is 4103. msg In the message object, whose fields are a control's: cc, note, pitchbend, chanat or program. ch The MIDI channel, 1..16. cc The controller number, for cc. note The note number, for note. value The program, for program. omni In the options object: keep the MIDI channel in the number, for an input set to Omni. CC 0–127, notes 128–255, program change 384–511, channel aftertouch 512, pitch wheel 513, with the channel above bit 12.

這些編號來自 QLC+ 的 midiprotocol.h。頻道 2 的 CC 7 是 4103。 msg 放在訊息物件裡，欄位就是控制項的那些：cc、note、pitchbend、chanat、program。 ch MIDI 頻道，1..16。 cc 控制器編號，cc 用。 note 音符編號，note 用。 value 音色編號，program 用。 omni 放在選項物件裡：把 MIDI 頻道留在編號裡，給設成 Omni 的輸入用。 CC 0–127、音符 128–255、program change 384–511、頻道觸後 512、音高輪 513，頻道放在第 12 位元以上。

Use it to check or list the encodings, for example when you build a profile editor. validateProfile() reports an encoder whose relative is not in this list. A plain array. relativeDelta() and relativeValue() take one of these as mode, and a profile's relative field must be one of them (or false for an absolute encoder).
用來檢查或列出編碼方式，例如做設定檔編輯器的時候。validateProfile() 會回報 relative 不在這個清單裡的旋鈕。 一個普通陣列。relativeDelta() 和 relativeValue() 的 mode 要從裡面挑一個，設定檔的 relative 欄位也必須是其中之一（絕對值旋鈕寫 false）。

An endless encoder has no position, so it sends how far it moved, and devices disagree on how to write it. offset64: 64 is no move, 65 is +1, 63 is −1. offset16: 16 is no move, 17 is +1, 15 is −1. twos: 1..63 are +1..+63 and 127..65 are −1..−63 (two's complement). signbit: 1..63 are positive, 65..127 are −1..−63 (sign and magnitude). An unknown mode throws unknown relative mode "x". MidiController uses this for every encoder control whose profile says relative, and publishes the result as midi///delta. value The CC value, 0..127 (only the low 7 bits are read). mode How the device writes a turn: one of RELATIVE_MODES. A profile names it in the control's relative field. The signed step count, positive for clockwise.

無限旋鈕沒有位置，它送出的是「轉了多少」，而各家機器的寫法不一樣。offset64：64 是沒動，65 是 +1，63 是 −1。offset16：16 是沒動，17 是 +1，15 是 −1。twos：1..63 是 +1..+63，127..65 是 −1..−63（二的補數）。signbit：1..63 是正的，65..127 是 −1..−63（符號加大小）。 不認得的 mode 會丟出 unknown relative mode "x"。MidiController 對每個設定檔有寫 relative 的 encoder 控制項都用它，並把結果發佈成 midi///delta。 value CC 的值，0..127（只讀低 7 位元）。 mode 機器怎麼表示一次轉動：RELATIVE_MODES 其中之一。設定檔在控制項的 relative 欄位裡寫明。 有正負號的步數，順時針為正。

A virtual encoder sends the same encoding a hardware one does, so the on-screen controller and the real device look identical to everything downstream. relativeValue(-1) is 63 and relativeValue(3, 'twos') is 3. With offset16 the result is held at 0, so it can only go down to −16. An unknown mode throws unknown relative mode "x". delta Signed steps. Rounded and held to −63..63. mode One of RELATIVE_MODES. The CC value, 0..127.

虛擬的旋鈕送出跟實體旋鈕一樣的編碼，所以螢幕上的控制器和真實機器，在下游看起來完全一樣。relativeValue(-1) 是 63，relativeValue(3, 'twos') 是 3。offset16 的結果會停在 0，所以最多只能往下到 −16。 不認得的 mode 會丟出 unknown relative mode "x"。 delta 有正負號的步數，會四捨五入並限制在 −63..63。 mode RELATIVE_MODES 其中之一。 CC 的值，0..127。

It switches only when the current port is gone or disconnected (to the best live one, or to none), or when the port you named is back while a stand-in is in use (back to it). In every other case it stays: plugging in an unrelated device never steals the output. The text is plain ASCII, such as MIDI out: switched to "Synth" ("IAC Driver Bus 1" was unplugged). This is the rule behind the Midi engine's output hot-plug. It never touches Web MIDI, so a test can call it with plain objects. current The port in use now. outputs The ports there are now. preferred The port you chose by name (the one to go back to). prefer Fallback order, as in pickOutput(). next is the port to use. changed says whether it differs from current. reason is same, found, fallback, back or none. text is the line to log (an empty string when nothing changed).

只有兩種情況會換：目前的埠不見了或斷線（換到最好的存活埠，或是變成沒有），或是你指定的埠回來了而現在用的是替代品（換回去）。其他情況一律不動：插上不相干的新裝置，不會搶走輸出。說明文字是純 ASCII，例如 MIDI out: switched to "Synth" ("IAC Driver Bus 1" was unplugged)。 Midi 引擎處理輸出熱插拔，靠的就是這條規則。它完全不碰 Web MIDI，所以測試時用普通物件呼叫就行。 current 現在正在用的埠。 outputs 現在有的埠。 preferred 你用名稱選的埠（要回去的那一個）。 prefer 備用順序，跟 pickOutput() 一樣。 next 是該用的埠，changed 表示是否跟 current 不同，reason 是 same、found、fallback、back 或 none，text 是要記錄的一行（沒變時是空字串）。

A profile's short has a separate reserved list (cc, note, bend, ch, virtual, raw, clock) because those are the generic midi/… families. Both are checked by validateProfile(). A plain array. last is the signal midi//last, and the others are the suffixes a control's signals use (/raw, /delta, /hit, /on, /off, /pressure), so validateProfile() rejects them as control ids.

設定檔的 short 另有一份保留字清單（cc、note、bend、ch、virtual、raw、clock），因為它們是通用的 midi/… 家族名稱。兩份都由 validateProfile() 檢查。 一個普通陣列。last 是訊號 midi//last 的名字，其他的是控制項訊號會用的後綴（/raw、/delta、/hit、/on、/off、/pressure），所以 validateProfile() 不接受它們當控制項 id。

Errors are written for a person: no MIDI profile given, unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …), could not load MIDI profile (404) and invalid MIDI profile (): followed by the list from validateProfile(). ref A profile object (checked and returned), an id or short name (looked up in profiles), or a URL (fetched). A URL is a string starting with http:, https:, blob:, data:, /, ./ or ../, or ending in .json. profiles Where ids are looked up. The default is an empty list, so pass PROFILES (or use loadProfile(), which does). fetch Replaces fetch, for tests or special loading. It must return { ok, status?, json() }. base A base URL that a relative path is resolved against. The raw profile (not normalized).

錯誤訊息是寫給人看的：no MIDI profile given、unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)、could not load MIDI profile (404)，以及 invalid MIDI profile (): 後面接上 validateProfile() 的清單。 ref 設定檔物件（檢查後直接回傳）、id 或短名稱（在 profiles 裡查），或網址（會去抓）。網址指的是以 http:、https:、blob:、data:、/、./、../ 開頭，或以 .json 結尾的字串。 profiles 用來查 id 的清單。預設是空的，所以要傳入 PROFILES（或改用已經幫你傳好的 loadProfile()）。 fetch 取代 fetch，給測試或特殊的載入方式用。必須回傳 { ok, status?, json() }。 base 解析相對路徑用的基底網址。 原始的設定檔（沒有整理過）。

The score knows when a segment starts and when a cue passes. An outside program cannot read the score, but it can read MIDI: launch a clip on a note, jump a scene on a CC. Create a ScoreMidi, then call out.segment({ index, cause }) and out.cue({ name, n }) (createShow({ score: { …, midi: { channel: 15 } } }) does this for you). Markers go out only while the show plays (cause is play or release). A reset never sends, and seek and jump send only with scrub: true. Everything goes through the engine's own noteOn, noteOff and cc, so the MIDI OUT meter shows it and panic() can silence it. Off unless you create it. midi What to send through: a Midi (anything with noteOn, noteOff and cc). Required: without it the constructor throws. channel The MIDI channel, 1..16 (anything else throws). segment { note, cc, velocity }: segment number i sends note note + i and/or CC cc with value i. velocity defaults to 100, note to 36 (give note: null to send only the CC). false sends no segment markers. cue { note, notes, cc, velocity }: every cue sends note (or its own note from the map notes, by cue name) and/or CC cc with the cue's number as value. note defaults to 84 (give note: null to send only the CC). false sends no cue markers. length Seconds before a marker note's note-off. A marker note is a trigger, not a held note. scrub Also mark jumps the playhead made by hand (seek, jump). Off by default, so dragging the scrubber does not launch clips in the DAW. enabled Set to false (or later,…

樂譜知道每個段落什麼時候開始、cue 什麼時候經過。外部程式讀不到樂譜，但讀得到 MIDI：用某個音符啟動片段，用某個 CC 切換場景。建立一個 ScoreMidi，然後呼叫 out.segment({ index, cause }) 和 out.cue({ name, n })（createShow({ score: { …, midi: { channel: 15 } } }) 會替你做這件事）。 只有演出在播放時才送標記（cause 是 play 或 release）。reset 永遠不送，seek 和 jump 只有在 scrub: true 時才送。所有訊息都走引擎自己的 noteOn、noteOff、cc，所以 MIDI OUT 音量表看得到，panic() 也關得掉。你不建立它就不會送。 midi 要透過誰送出：一個 Midi（任何有 noteOn、noteOff、cc 的東西都行）。必填，沒給建構時會丟出錯誤。 channel MIDI 頻道，1..16（其他值會丟出錯誤）。 segment { note, cc, velocity }：第 i 段會送出音符 note + i 和（或）CC cc（值為 i）。velocity 預設 100，note 預設 36（只想送 CC 的話，給 note: null）。false 表示不送段落標記。 cue { note, notes, cc, velocity }：每個 cue 會送出 note（或在 notes 對照表裡依 cue 名稱查到的專屬音符）和（或）CC cc，值是 cue 的編號。note 預設 84（只想送 CC 的話，給 note: null）。false 表示不送 cue 標記。 length 標記音符送出後，隔幾秒才送 note-off。標記音符是觸發用的，不是按著的音。 scrub 手動拖動播放頭造成的跳轉（seek、jump）也要送標記。預設關閉，這樣拖動時間軸不會在 DAW 裡誤觸發片段。 enabled 設成 false（或之後改 out.enabled = false）就什麼都不送。 timer 排程 note-off 用的 (fn, ms) => …，預設是 setTimeout，測試時可以傳自己的。

Software that reads the file can act on the purpose without knowing the device: offer every mode message as a switch, or use a led message to light a pad. A plain array. purpose of an entry in sysex.messages must be one of these.
讀這個檔案的軟體不用認識機器，看用途就能動作：把每則 mode 訊息做成開關，或用 led 訊息點亮打擊墊。 一個普通陣列。sysex.messages 每一筆的 purpose 必須是其中之一。

A message's bytes is text: one hex byte or {name} per token. {name.msb} and {name.lsb} split a bigger value into two 7-bit halves. The function throws when an argument is missing or outside its min..max, because a wrong byte in SysEx can leave a unit in a mode nobody can find the way out of. This only builds bytes; it sends nothing and asks the browser for nothing. message An entry of the profile's sysex.messages; sysexMessage() finds one by id. args Argument name → value. A missing one takes its default. The whole message, from F0 to F7, ready for output.send().

訊息的 bytes 是文字，每一格是一個十六進位位元組或 {name}。{name.msb} 和 {name.lsb} 把比較大的值拆成兩個 7 位元。參數缺少或超出 min..max 時會丟出錯誤，因為 SysEx 錯一個位元組，機器可能進到一個找不到路出來的模式。 它只組位元組，不會送出，也不會向瀏覽器要權限。 message 設定檔 sysex.messages 裡的一筆，用 sysexMessage() 依 id 找。 args 參數名稱對應到值。沒給的用 default。 整則訊息，從 F0 到 F7，可以直接給 output.send()。

Each message says what it is for (purpose), what it does in words (label), which source its bytes came from (cite) and, when it changes the unit's state, which message undoes it (undo). p A profile. id The message id, such as programmer-mode. The entry of sysex.messages, or null when the profile has no such message.
每則訊息都寫了用途（purpose）、用文字說明它做什麼（label）、位元組的出處（cite），會改變機器狀態的訊息還寫了哪一則能還原（undo）。 p 設定檔。 id 訊息 id，例如 programmer-mode。 sysex.messages 裡的那一筆，沒有這則訊息就回傳 null。

A mapping binds controls to decks, which a profile knows nothing about, so mixxxBindings() hands out jobs in order: faders to deck volumes, knobs to EQ, pads to hot cues, buttons to play, cue and sync. Relative encoders go through the script, which also sends sysex.connect when Mixxx opens the device and each message's undo when it closes it. profile A profile. { xml, js, xmlName, jsName }: the two files and their names.

mapping 是把控制項綁到唱盤，這是設定檔不知道的事，所以 mixxxBindings() 依序分配工作：推桿給唱盤音量，旋鈕給 EQ，打擊墊給 hot cue，按鈕給 play、cue、sync。相對式旋鈕走腳本，腳本也會在 Mixxx 開啟機器時送 sysex.connect，關閉時送每則訊息的 undo。 profile 設定檔。 { xml, js, xmlName, jsName }：兩個檔案和它們的檔名。

A device whose controls sit on channel 1 gets plain numbers. Anything else is numbered for an input with its MIDI channel set to Omni, the way QLC+'s own APC40 file does, and the file says so in a comment. Keys become one Button per note. An LED on another note or CC cannot be written, because a .qxi lights a control through its own number. profile A profile. version In the options object: what goes in . The file.
控制項都在頻道 1 的機器用一般編號。其他情況的編號適用於 MIDI 頻道設成 Omni 的輸入，跟 QLC+ 自己的 APC40 檔案一樣，檔案開頭的註解會說明。琴鍵會變成每個音一個 Button。LED 在別的音或 CC 上時寫不進去，因為 .qxi 是用控制項自己的編號點燈。 profile 設定檔。 version 放在選項物件裡： 的內容。 檔案內容。

It does not hold u to −1..1, so clamp it first if it can overshoot. encodeMessage() clamps the final value into 0..16383 anyway, so a pitch-bend message built from an overshoot stays valid. u A position from −1 (fully down) to 1 (fully up). 0 is the centre. The rounded 14-bit value: unitToBend(0) is 8192, unitToBend(1) is 16383.
它不會把 u 限制在 −1..1，可能超出範圍的話請先自己限制。不過 encodeMessage() 最後會把數值限制在 0..16383，所以用超出範圍的數字組成的彎音訊息仍然是合法的。 u 位置，從 −1（最下）到 1（最上），0 是中心。 四捨五入後的 14 位元數值：unitToBend(0) 是 8192，unitToBend(1) 是 16383。

It reports all problems at once, not just the first. It checks: id and short are lower-case [a-z0-9_-] and short is not a reserved family name (cc, note, bend, ch, virtual, raw, clock), name and kind exist, a device cites at least one source, match regexes compile, face has a size, every control has a unique non-reserved id (see RESERVED_IDS), a known type and msg, numbers in range and no two controls listening to the same message, encoders name their relative mode, and the sections (and portrait, if given) show every control exactly once, inside the faceplate and within their grid. It also checks the palette, the sysex block (each message well formed and citing a source) and the verifications log, and it refuses verified: true without a hardware entry there that confirms it. This is the check behind normalizeProfile() (it throws with this list), resolveProfile() and the test that validates every shipped profile. Run it on your own file before you try it in a page. p A raw profile object (for example parsed from your JSON file). The problems, in plain words. [] is valid.

它會一次回報所有問題，不是只講第一個。檢查的項目有：id 和 short 是小寫的 [a-z0-9_-]，而且 short 不是保留的家族名稱（cc、note、bend、ch、virtual、raw、clock）。有 name 和 kind。device 至少註明一個來源。match 的正規表示式能編譯。face 有尺寸。每個控制項的 id 不重複也不是保留字（見 RESERVED_IDS），有認得的 type 和 msg，數字在範圍內，且沒有兩個控制項聽同一則訊息。旋鈕要寫明 relative 模式。sections（和有給的話 portrait）要讓每個控制項剛好出現一次，位在面板內，並且塞得進它的格子。也會檢查 palette、sysex（每則訊息格式正確並註明出處）和 verifications 紀錄，沒有實機紀錄支持的 verified: true 會被拒絕。 normalizeProfile()（用這份清單丟出錯誤）、resolveProfile()，以及驗證所有內建設定檔的測試，背後都是這個檢查。把自己的檔案放進網頁之前，先跑一次。 p 原始的設定檔物件（例如從你的 JSON 檔解析出來的）。 用白話寫的問題清單。[] 表示合法。

A profile keeps one entry per sitting in verifications, and each entry lists a result for every control checked. This function reads that log from the point of view of one control. Of two checks on the same day the later entry wins. p A profile. id A control id, or sysex: for a SysEx message. The sitting's date, by, method, firmware, os, browser and port, with this control's result (match, corrected, mismatch or absent) and, when there is one, was (the old message) and led.

設定檔的 verifications 一次驗證一筆，每筆列出每個驗過的控制項的結果。這個函式從單一控制項的角度讀這份紀錄。同一天驗了兩次，以後面那筆為準。 p 設定檔。 id 控制項 id，SysEx 訊息則寫 sysex:。 那次驗證的 date、by、method、firmware、os、browser、port，加上這個控制項的 result（match、corrected、mismatch、absent），有的話還有 was（舊訊息）和 led。

It is always in English, because the issue is read by whoever maintains the file. raw The profile as shipped. session The run. meta The same details as applyVerification(). max In the options object: cut the text at this length, so it fits in a link. The Markdown.
內容固定是英文，因為 issue 是給維護這個檔案的人看的。 raw 原本的設定檔。 session 這次驗證。 meta 跟 applyVerification() 一樣的資料。 max 放在選項物件裡：文字長度上限，才放得進網址。 Markdown 文字。

Controls are counted as entries of controls, so a keyboard is one control however many keys it has. checks is the number of entries in verifications. p A profile. { controls, hardware, source, unconfirmed, checks, latest }. latest is { date, by, method, firmware } or null.
這裡數的是 controls 裡的項目，所以一整排琴鍵算一個控制項。checks 是 verifications 的筆數。 p 設定檔。 { controls, hardware, source, unconfirmed, checks, latest }。latest 是 { date, by, method, firmware } 或 null。

hardware is a real unit. virtual is a virtual port such as the macOS IAC Driver or loopMIDI, and simulated is the page's own simulator. The last two show that the tool works, not that the device does, so they are logged but never confirm anything. A plain array. method in an entry of a profile's verifications must be one of these.
hardware 是實機。virtual 是虛擬埠，例如 macOS 的 IAC Driver 或 loopMIDI，simulated 是頁面自己的模擬。後兩種只能說明工具會動，不能說明機器是這樣，所以會留下紀錄，但不算確認。 一個普通陣列。設定檔 verifications 每一筆的 method 必須是其中之一。

match: the unit sent what the file said. corrected: it sent something else and the file now says that, with the old message kept in was. mismatch: it sent something else and the file was left as it is. absent: the control sent nothing, or this unit does not have it. Only the first two can back verified: true. A plain array. A value of results in a verifications entry is one of these, or an object with one of these as result.
match：機器送的跟檔案寫的一樣。corrected：送的不一樣，檔案已改成實際的值，舊訊息留在 was。mismatch：送的不一樣，檔案沒有改。absent：這個控制項什麼都沒送，或這台機器沒有它。只有前兩種能支持 verified: true。 一個普通陣列。verifications 裡 results 的值是其中之一，或是一個物件，result 是其中之一。

This is the logic behind the verification page; it has no DOM and no Web MIDI, so you can drive it from anything. current is the step to do now: { id, key, control, expected, index, total }. A keyboard takes two steps, its lowest and its highest key. Call feed(bytes) for every message, and settle() when the hand has stopped (the page does it after a short quiet). Note-offs, clock, aftertouch and the tail of a sweep that already matched are ignored. A message that differs waits for a person: accept() uses what the unit sent, reject() keeps the file and logs the difference, retry() forgets it. A message the file gives to another control is flagged with owner, because the likeliest story is the wrong control. profile The raw profile JSON. only In the options object: 'all', or 'unconfirmed' for only what the file marks verified: false.

這是驗證頁面背後的邏輯，沒有 DOM 也沒有 Web MIDI，什麼環境都能用。current 是現在這一步：{ id, key, control, expected, index, total }。琴鍵分兩步，最低音和最高音。 每則訊息都呼叫 feed(bytes)，手停下來時呼叫 settle()（頁面是在安靜一小段時間後呼叫）。note off、時鐘、觸後，以及已經對上之後那段轉動的尾巴都會被忽略。不同的訊息會等人決定：accept() 用機器送的，reject() 保留檔案並記下差異，retry() 當作沒發生。檔案裡屬於別的控制項的訊息會用 owner 標出來，因為最可能是動錯了。 profile 原始的設定檔 JSON。 only 放在選項物件裡：'all'，或 'unconfirmed' 只驗檔案標成 verified: false 的控制項。

If the real request answers within waitMs (1200 ms by default), its ports are there from the start. If it answers later they hot-plug in as statechange events. If it is refused or missing (Safari, iPad), the virtual input is still there. A permission prompt nobody answers cannot hang the sketch: it gets the access after waitMs anyway. real The original requestMIDIAccess, already bound (navigator.requestMIDIAccess.bind(navigator)), or null when there is none. The real request still happens, permission prompt and all. make (opts) => … returning the object of createVirtualMIDIAccess(). Required. Return the same one each time to share it. waitMs How long to wait for the real request before answering anyway. A function (opts?) => Promise to put where navigator.requestMIDIAccess was.

真實請求在 waitMs（預設 1200 毫秒）內回應的話，它的埠一開始就在。晚一點回應，就以 statechange 事件熱插拔進來。被拒絕或不存在（Safari、iPad）時，虛擬輸入還是在。沒有人回答的權限詢問不會卡死草圖：waitMs 一到它就會拿到 access。 real 原本的 requestMIDIAccess，要先綁好 this（navigator.requestMIDIAccess.bind(navigator)），沒有的話給 null。真實的請求仍然會進行，權限詢問也一樣。 make (opts) => …，回傳 createVirtualMIDIAccess() 的物件。必填。每次回傳同一個就能共用。 waitMs 最多等真實請求多久，時間到就先回覆。 一個函式 (opts?) => Promise，放到原本 navigator.requestMIDIAccess 的位置。

Explicit LED channels (led.ch) stay as they are, since LED feedback may use a different channel from the control. This is what the channel option of createController() and the channel attribute of call. profile A profile. ch The channel, 1..16. A falsy value (0, null) returns the same profile object untouched. A deep copy, validated, with channel and every control's ch set. The original is not changed.

明確寫出的 LED 頻道（led.ch）會維持原樣，因為 LED 回饋用的頻道可能跟控制項不同。createController() 的 channel 選項和 的 channel 屬性，呼叫的就是它。 profile 設定檔。 ch 頻道，1..16。給假值（0、null）就原封不動回傳同一個設定檔物件。 深層複製的副本，已通過驗證，channel 和每個控制項的 ch 都改好了。原本的不會被改動。

Colours are CSS colour strings. bg: null lets the video or page underneath show through, and accent: '#7ea6ff' makes the panel monochrome-with-one-colour, which suits a branded video. A frozen object (you cannot change it; pass theme instead). Keys: bg (the area around the device; null leaves what is underneath), body (the faceplate; null uses the profile's face.body), ink (big text), label (control labels), dim (faceplate and section lettering), idle (a pad at rest), button, cap (knob caps), well (fader slots and strip wells), screen, screenInk, screenDim, accent (one colour for everything that moves; null keeps each control's own), glow (0 flat to 1 like the on-screen controller) and the fonts font and mono.

顏色都是 CSS 顏色字串。bg: null 讓底下的影片或頁面透出來，accent: '#7ea6ff' 則讓整個面板只用一個顏色，很適合有品牌色的影片。 凍結的物件（不能修改，要用 theme 選項覆寫）。鍵有：bg（機器周圍的區域，null 表示保留底下原本的畫面）、body（面板，null 用設定檔的 face.body）、ink（大字）、label（控制項標籤）、dim（面板與區塊的文字）、idle（待機的打擊墊）、button、cap（旋鈕蓋）、well（推桿溝槽和觸控條底）、screen、screenInk、screenDim、accent（所有會動的東西用同一個顏色，null 保留各控制項自己的顏色）、glow（0 是平面，1 是跟螢幕控制器一樣的光暈），以及字型 font 和 mono。

Always there: profile (the profile id), id, type, label, value, raw, signal, message, bytes, source and time (performance.now(), rounded). value is 0..1 (−1..1 for a bipolar wheel); a pad is its velocity while held and 0 on release; a button is 0 or 1; for keys it is that note's velocity. raw is the MIDI number (0..127, pitch bend 0..16383). signal is the name the rest of open-audiovisual uses (midi/lpd8/k1; for a key midi/minilab3/n60). message is the parsed MIDI ({ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 70, value: 53 }) and bytes the raw bytes. source is 'ui' (a finger, a mouse, set()), 'hardware' (a real port, or bytes you ingest()) or 'mirror'. Sometimes there: note and velocity (note messages, velocity 0 for a release), delta (a relative encoder: the signed steps), held (a pad or button), and pressure (a pad, when it is above 0). The control, noteon and noteoff events carry it as their detail. mc The controller the change happened on. id The control id. st Its state after the change (mc.get(id)). info What onChange gave: { source, ev, note, bytes }. The payload, plain JSON that is safe to postMessage.

一定會有的欄位：profile（設定檔 id）、id、type、label、value、raw、signal、message、bytes、source、time（performance.now()，取整數）。value 是 0..1（雙向彎音輪是 −1..1），打擊墊在按著時是力度、放開是 0，按鈕是 0 或 1，琴鍵則是那個音的力度。raw 是 MIDI 的號碼（0..127，彎音是 0..16383）。signal 是 open-audiovisual 其他部分用的名稱（midi/lpd8/k1，琴鍵是 midi/minilab3/n60）。message 是解析後的 MIDI（{ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 70, value: 53 }），bytes 是原始位元組。source 是 'ui'（手指、滑鼠、set()）、'hardware'（真實的埠，或你 ingest() 的位元組）或 'mirror'。 有時才有的欄位：note 和 velocity（音符訊息，放開時 velocity 為 0）、delta（相對旋鈕：有正負號的步數）、held（打擊墊或按鈕）、pressure（打擊墊，大於 0 時才有）。control、noteon、noteoff 事件把它當作 detail。 mc 發生變化的控制器。 id 控制項 id。 st 變化之後的狀態（mc.get(id)）。 info onChange 給的內容：{ source, ev, note, bytes }。 事件內容，是可以安全 postMessage 的純 JSON。

The on-screen controller is DOM: perfect to play, impossible to record, because a page cannot capture its own DOM into a video. This draws the same faceplate, every section where it sits on the device and in the same colours, straight into a 2D context. It is vector and drawn at the output size, so a 4K frame is as sharp as a 1080 one, and it costs a few hundred path calls a frame. @openav/record's Compositor#setPanel takes one. Call panel.draw(ctx, { x, y, w, h }) every frame, or panel.renderTo(canvas) to fill a canvas of its own.
