What a video needs that a screen does not: a touch has to stay visible for a few frames (30 fps is 33 ms; a staccato note can be shorter), so released keys and pads fade out instead of switching off, the control a hand just moved glows, and the keyboard follows the device's octave buttons. panel.aspect is the faceplate's width ÷ height, for reserving an area of that shape. With neither signals nor controller the panel just stays at rest. It is a silent model: it publishes nothing back to the bus. panel.dispose() stops listening to the bus or controller (a controller you passed in is left as it was). profile Profile id, short name or object. An unknown id throws ControllerCanvas: unknown profile "x". signals Follow the generic MIDI names on this bus (midi/ch//…, midi/note/on|off, midi/cc/, midi/bend): live hardware, the on-screen controller, the QWERTY piano, phones and a recorded take playing back all move the panel. Each message counts once,…

螢幕上的控制器是 DOM：很適合彈，卻沒辦法錄，因為網頁不能把自己的 DOM 錄進影片。這個類別把同一個面板直接畫進 2D 畫布，每個區塊都在機器上原本的位置，用同樣的顏色。它是向量，直接以輸出的大小繪製，所以 4K 畫面跟 1080 一樣清楚，每個畫面約花幾百次路徑呼叫。@openav/record 的 Compositor#setPanel 就是接收它。 每個畫面呼叫 panel.draw(ctx, { x, y, w, h })，或用 panel.renderTo(canvas) 畫滿一張自己的畫布。影片需要而螢幕不需要的東西：一次觸碰要在畫面上留幾格（30 fps 是 33 毫秒，很短的斷音可能比這還短），所以放開的琴鍵和打擊墊會淡出而不是直接熄掉，剛被手動過的控制項會發光，鍵盤也會跟著機器的八度按鈕移動。panel.aspect 是面板的寬除以高，可用來預留相同形狀的區域。signals 和 controller 都沒給時，面板就只是靜止不動。 它是個安靜的模型：不會往匯流排發佈任何東西。panel.dispose() 會停止聽匯流排或控制器（你傳進來的控制器不會被動到）。 profile 設定檔 id、短名稱或物件。不認得的 id 會丟出 ControllerCanvas: unknown profile "x"。 signals 跟隨這條匯流排上的通用 MIDI 名稱（midi/ch//…、midi/note/on|off、midi/cc/、midi/bend）：實際的硬體、螢幕控制器、電腦鍵盤鋼琴、手機，以及正在回放的錄音，都會讓面板動起來。硬體的一則訊息雖然用兩個名稱發佈，也只會算一次。 controller 改為跟隨這個現有的控制器，不聽匯流排：正好就是那一台，連同它學到的對應。錄音回放不會傳到它。有給的話會忽略 signals。 mapping 要套用到面板自己的控制器上的學習結果：就是實機控制器的 exportMapping()。 theme CANVAS_THEME 的任何子集：顏色、glow、字型。 notes 把按著的音大大地寫在面板下面。'auto' 是區域有空間時才寫，true 會擠出空間，false 永遠不寫。 screen 機器自己的螢幕（MiniLab 3、KeyStep）顯示最後一次碰了什麼，跟實機一樣：Knob 3 · 87、C4 · 100。 padding 面板周圍的留白，以區域短邊的比例表示。 now 淡出效果用的時鐘（毫秒），預設是 performance.now()。傳給 draw() 的 now 要用同一個時鐘。

The faceplate keeps its own proportions, centred in the rect. The sections are laid out the way the on-screen controller's CSS grid does (row or column flow, spans), so the canvas drawing and the DOM agree. It is pure, so it is the part to test, and the part to use when you want to draw something of your own on top of a control. profile A normalized profile (MidiController#profile). rect The area, in pixels. padding Space around the faceplate, as a share of the rect's short side (0..1). notes Reserve a strip under the faceplate for the held notes: true always, false never, 'auto' when the rect has room. u is the pixel size of one face unit. face is { x, y, w, h }. notes is the strip or null. sections is a list with id, label, the box and its grid. controls is a Map from control id to { id, type, section, x, y, w, h }. deco lists the decorations (screen, logo, lettering) in pixels.

面板維持自己的比例，置中在矩形裡。區塊的排法跟螢幕控制器的 CSS grid 一致（橫向或直向排列、跨格），所以畫布上的繪製和 DOM 版本一致。它是純函式，適合拿來測試，也適合在你想在某個控制項上疊自己畫的東西時使用。 profile 整理過的設定檔（MidiController#profile）。 rect 區域，單位是像素。 padding 面板周圍的留白，以矩形短邊的比例表示（0..1）。 notes 在面板下面預留一條放按著的音的位置：true 一定有，false 一定沒有，'auto' 是矩形有空間時才有。 u 是一個面板單位的像素大小。face 是 { x, y, w, h }。notes 是那一條或 null。sections 是帶有 id、label、外框和 grid 的清單。controls 是從控制項 id 對到 { id, type, section, x, y, w, h } 的 Map。deco 列出以像素表示的裝飾（螢幕、標誌、文字）。

Events, with ctl.on(name, fn) (returns an unsubscribe function): control (every knob, pad, key or button change), noteon and noteoff (the same payload, for pads, keys and note buttons), connect and disconnect ({ port, profile }: a hardware port started or stopped driving it), status, profilechange ({ profile, name }) and '', which gets (name, detail) for all of them. The control payload is the one described under controlDetail(). ready and error exist only on the element. ctl.status is { hardware, input, output, outputState }. hardware is off, asking, waiting (listening, but the device is not plugged in), connected, unavailable (the browser has no Web MIDI) or denied (permission refused). outputState is off, asking, open, missing (no port matches), unavailable or denied. ctl.profileId, ctl.controller and ctl.profile say which device is on screen; ctl.controllers, ctl.view, ctl.midi and ctl.output are the objects underneath. What a hand plays on the screen leaves through the output port as real MIDI; moves of your real hardware are not forwarded (your software already hears the device), and input with the same name as the chosen output (the loopMIDI echo) is muted. connectHardware(), setOutput() and requestMidi() are the only calls that ask the browser for MIDI. Chrome, Edge and Firefox show a permission prompt, so call them from a click when you can. Without Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) the controller still plays and fires events, and status says unavailable. profile Profile id,…

事件用 ctl.on(name, fn) 訂閱（回傳取消訂閱的函式）：control（任何旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵、按鈕的變化）、noteon 和 noteoff（內容相同，給打擊墊、琴鍵和音符按鈕）、connect 和 disconnect（{ port, profile }：某個硬體埠開始或停止驅動它）、status、profilechange（{ profile, name }），以及 ''，所有事件都會以 (name, detail) 通知它。control 的內容見 controlDetail()。ready 和 error 只有 元素才有。 ctl.status 是 { hardware, input, output, outputState }。hardware 可能是 off、asking、waiting（在聽，但機器沒接上）、connected、unavailable（瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI）或 denied（權限被拒絕）。outputState 可能是 off、asking、open、missing（沒有符合的埠）、unavailable 或 denied。ctl.profileId、ctl.controller、ctl.profile 告訴你螢幕上是哪台機器，ctl.controllers、ctl.view、ctl.midi、ctl.output 則是底下的物件。 螢幕上的手彈出來的，會從輸出埠以真正的 MIDI 送出。真實硬體的動作不會被轉送（你的軟體本來就聽得到那台機器），名稱跟所選輸出埠相同的輸入（loopMIDI 的回音）會被靜音。 只有 connectHardware()、setOutput()、requestMidi() 會向瀏覽器要 MIDI。Chrome、Edge、Firefox 會跳出權限詢問，所以可以的話請在點擊裡呼叫。沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad）時，控制器仍然能彈、能觸發事件，status 會顯示 unavailable。 profile 設定檔 id、短名稱或物件。 profiles 選單或 follow 可以切換到的設定檔。預設是所有內建的。 signals 同時把 midi//… 發佈進演出。 sink 改由這個函式發佈（中繼），用法同 MidiController。 channel 把所有控制項移到這個 MIDI 頻道（你的機器設定在別的頻道時）。見 withChannel()。 follow 接上另一台認得的機器時，就改顯示那一台。 midi 改用這個引擎（演出的），不用頁面共用的。 requestAccess MIDIAccess 從哪裡來，用法同 Midi。給了它，控制器就會用自己的引擎。 filterOut Midi 的輸入埠過濾。任何不是預設 'IAC' 的值，也會讓控制器用自己的引擎。 storage 學到的對應存在哪裡，用法同 MidiControllers。預設是有 localStorage 就用它。 telemetry false 就不送匿名的頁面載入資料。 embedKind 這次嵌入屬於哪一種，供那筆資料用：'headless'（預設）、'element' 或 'iframe'。

Two shapes, chosen from the box it lives in. face: the device as it looks, sections where they sit on the real faceplate, scaled to fit (desktop, iPad, a phone held sideways). stack: the same controls re-gridded top to bottom for a tall box (a phone held upright), as the profile's portrait says. Nothing scrolls and nothing shrinks below a thumb. Square grid devices (Launchpad) stay face. mode fixes one; 'auto' follows the box. Every control repaints from the controller's state, so a finger here and a knob on the desk look the same, and a move from hardware gets a brief glow ring so you can see your hand arrive. Touch: drag a knob (right or up raises it), drag or click a fader or strip, strike a pad (higher on the pad is softer, lower is harder), hold a button, play the keys (multi-touch works). The mouse wheel turns knobs and faders. Keyboard: Tab reaches every control except the piano keys; the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End move knobs, faders and strips (Shift for fine steps); Space or Enter strikes pads and buttons, held while the key is held. Learn mode (setLearning(true)) turns every tap into "bind this control", and view.onLearnTap = (id) => … tells you which. A browser DOM and a container with a height. createController(…).mount(el) is the usual way to get one. container The element to fill. It needs a size: the view is 100% wide and tall, so give it a height. It can be inside a shadow root: the view's CSS goes into that root, not the page. controller The…

兩種形狀，依它所在的盒子大小決定。face：機器原本的樣子，各區塊在真實面板上的位置，縮放到剛好放進去（桌機、iPad、橫拿的手機）。stack：同樣的控制項，照設定檔的 portrait 重新由上到下排列，給高的盒子用（直拿的手機）。不會捲動，也不會縮到比手指小。方形格子的機器（Launchpad）一律維持 face。mode 可以固定其中一種，'auto' 則跟著盒子走。 每個控制項都從控制器的狀態重畫，所以螢幕上的手指和桌上的旋鈕看起來一樣，硬體動作則會有一圈短暫的光環，讓你看見自己的手「抵達」螢幕。操作：拖曳旋鈕（往右或往上是增加）、拖曳或點推桿與觸控條、敲打擊墊（敲在上半部較輕，下半部較重）、按住按鈕、彈琴鍵（支援多點觸控）。滑鼠滾輪可以轉旋鈕和推桿。 鍵盤：Tab 可以走到每個控制項（琴鍵除外），方向鍵、Page Up/Down、Home、End 移動旋鈕、推桿和觸控條（加 Shift 是微調），空白鍵或 Enter 敲打擊墊和按鈕，按著鍵就一直按著。學習模式（setLearning(true)）會讓每一次點擊都變成「綁定這個控制項」，view.onLearnTap = (id) => … 會告訴你是哪一個。 要有瀏覽器的 DOM，而且容器要有高度。平常用 createController(…).mount(el) 取得它。 container 要填滿的元素。它要有大小：畫面是 100% 寬、100% 高，所以要給高度。可以放在 shadow root 裡，畫面的 CSS 會放進那個 root，不會碰到頁面。 controller 要顯示並驅動的模型。 mode 'auto'、'face' 或 'stack'（見下）。 minTouch 控制項至少要有幾個像素大，face 才不會被換成 stack。

Four lines are enough: const ctl = createController('akai-lpd8'), ctl.mount(el) for the playable faceplate (optional, it works headless too), ctl.on('control', fn) to hear every knob, pad and key whether it came from the screen or the hardware, and ctl.connectHardware() to follow the real device. ctl.set(id, value) moves a control the way a hand would. Controllers on one page share one Midi engine, so the browser asks for MIDI permission once. Nothing asks until you call connectHardware(), setOutput() or requestMidi(). Pass signals to publish midi//… into a show. Like , it sends one anonymous hit per page load (which kind of embed and which device; nothing anyone plays) to the project's analytics, and nothing from localhost or the LAN. Turn it off with createController(profile, { telemetry: false }). The README's Telemetry section has the details. profile A profile id ('akai-lpd8'), a short name ('lpd8') or a profile object. For a URL, load it first with loadProfile(). An unknown id throws unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …). o Options, the same as the second argument of ControllerHost: profiles, signals, sink, channel, follow, midi, requestAccess, filterOut, storage, telemetry, embedKind. The controller. Its methods are listed under ControllerHost.

四行就夠：const ctl = createController('akai-lpd8')，ctl.mount(el) 畫出可以彈的面板（可有可無，沒有畫面也能用），ctl.on('control', fn) 聽每一個旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵，不論來自螢幕還是硬體，ctl.connectHardware() 跟隨真實的機器。ctl.set(id, value) 則像一隻手一樣去動某個控制項。 同一個頁面上的控制器共用一個 Midi 引擎，所以瀏覽器只會詢問一次 MIDI 權限。在你呼叫 connectHardware()、setOutput() 或 requestMidi() 之前，什麼都不會詢問。傳入 signals 就能把 midi//… 發佈進演出。 跟 一樣，每次載入頁面會對專案的分析送出一筆匿名資料（哪一種嵌入、哪一台機器，不含任何人彈的內容），從 localhost 或區域網路則不送。用 createController(profile, { telemetry: false }) 可以關掉。細節在 README 的 Telemetry 一節。 profile 設定檔 id（'akai-lpd8'）、短名稱（'lpd8'）或設定檔物件。要用網址的話，先用 loadProfile() 載入。不認得的 id 會丟出 unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)。 o 選項，跟 ControllerHost 的第二個參數一樣：profiles、signals、sink、channel、follow、midi、requestAccess、filterOut、storage、telemetry、embedKind。 控制器本身。它的方法列在 ControllerHost 底下。

A tag name can be registered only once per page, so use this when oav-controller clashes with another library, or when you want two differently-named copies. The default tag registers the exported OavController class itself; any other name registers a subclass of it. tag The new tag name. It must contain a hyphen, as every custom element does. The element class registered for that tag (an already-registered tag returns what is there). null when the page has no customElements.

一個標籤名稱在同一個頁面只能註冊一次，所以當 oav-controller 跟別的函式庫衝突，或你想要兩個不同名字的副本時，就用它。預設標籤註冊的是匯出的 OavController 類別本身，其他名稱註冊的是它的子類別。 tag 新的標籤名稱，必須包含連字號，所有自訂元素都是如此。 註冊在該標籤上的元素類別（標籤已經註冊過就回傳現有的）。頁面沒有 customElements 時回傳 null。

This is the text shows under the faceplate. Use it for your own log or caption. A payload without a message shows only the signal and the value. d A payload from controlDetail() (or a control event's detail). null gives an empty string. The signal name, the value (two decimals, or a whole number from 100 up), then ←, the message as describeMessage() writes it and the channel.
在面板下面顯示的就是這段文字。拿去做你自己的記錄或字幕也很方便。沒有 message 的內容只會顯示訊號和數值。 d controlDetail() 的內容（或 control 事件的 detail）。給 null 回傳空字串。 訊號名稱、數值（兩位小數，100 以上則是整數），接著是 ←、用 describeMessage() 寫的訊息，和頻道。

These are the shorter lines of the readout. describe() writes the longer log lines (CC ch1 #70=53). m An event from parseMessage(). null gives an empty string. CC 70 = 53, Note 36 · vel 90, Note 36 off, Bend 12288 (the raw 14-bit value), Pressure 50, Poly AT 36 = 12, Program 5; any other type gives its name.

這是 讀數列用的較短文字。describe() 寫的是較長的記錄文字（CC ch1 #70=53）。 m parseMessage() 的事件。給 null 回傳空字串。 CC 70 = 53、Note 36 · vel 90、Note 36 off、Bend 12288（原始的 14 位元數值）、Pressure 50、Poly AT 36 = 12、Program 5，其他類型則回傳類型名稱。

The iframe page copies every one of these from its URL onto the element. The extra parameters bg, pad, frame, origin and lang belong to the iframe page and are read by parseEmbedOptions(). What each attribute means is under OavController. A plain array, in this order. The element watches these (and lang) for changes.
iframe 頁面會把網址裡的這些參數逐一複製到元素上。另外的 bg、pad、frame、origin、lang 是 iframe 頁面專用的，由 parseEmbedOptions() 讀取。每個屬性的意思寫在 OavController 底下。 一個普通陣列，順序如上。元素會監看這些屬性（加上 lang）有沒有改變。

The iframe also posts a tenth type, values, as the answer to the get command; it is not an element event, so it is not in this list. The payloads are described under OavController and controlDetail(). A plain array, in this order. The element dispatches each as a CustomEvent that bubbles and is composed; the iframe page forwards each to window.parent with toParent().

iframe 還會送出第十種類型 values，那是對 get 指令的回答，不是元素事件，所以不在這份清單裡。各事件的內容寫在 OavController 和 controlDetail() 底下。 一個普通陣列，順序如上。元素把每一個都當成會冒泡、可穿過 shadow root 的 CustomEvent 觸發，iframe 頁面則用 toParent() 把每一個轉送給 window.parent。

A profile can opt out of stack (stack: false); square grid devices such as the Launchpad always stay face. See preferredAspect(). A plain array. parseEmbedOptions() turns any other layout value into 'auto', and the layout command of the iframe accepts only these.
設定檔可以不要 stack（stack: false），像 Launchpad 這種方形的格子機器永遠維持 face。見 preferredAspect()。 一個普通陣列。parseEmbedOptions() 會把其他的 layout 值變成 'auto'，iframe 的 layout 指令也只接受這三個。

A null means "keep the profile's own channels". A number makes withChannel() move every control there. v The attribute value, a number or a string. The channel, or null when it is missing, empty, not a whole number or outside 1..16.
null 代表「維持設定檔本來的頻道」。有數字的話，withChannel() 會把所有控制項移到那個頻道。 v 屬性的值，數字或字串。 頻道，沒寫、空字串、不是整數或不在 1..16 時是 null。

The iframe page puts the result into a CSS variable, so a value that could break out of CSS (red;}body{) is refused. It does not check that a name is a real colour: any 3 to 20 letters pass, and CSS ignores the ones it does not know. v The value from the query string. 'transparent'; '#' plus 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits (the # is optional in the input, so abc becomes #abc); or 3 to 20 letters, lower-cased ('RED' becomes 'red'); otherwise null.

iframe 頁面會把結果放進一個 CSS 變數，所以可能跳出 CSS 的值（red;}body{）會被拒絕。它不檢查名稱是不是真的顏色：任何 3 到 20 個字母都會通過，CSS 不認得的就會被忽略。 v 來自查詢字串的值。 'transparent'，或 '#' 加上 3、4、6 或 8 個十六進位數字（輸入裡的 # 可有可無，所以 abc 會變成 #abc），或 3 到 20 個英文字母（轉成小寫，'RED' 變成 'red'），其他是 null。

This is why and readout="true" both turn the readout on and readout="off" turns it off. Any other word counts as on, so readout="ask" is true. v The attribute value: null/undefined/false (absent) or a string. A bare attribute is the empty string. Absent is false; true is true; a string is true unless it is (case-insensitively, trimmed) false, 0, off or no.
所以 和 readout="true" 都會開啟讀數列，readout="off" 則會關掉。其他任何字都算開，所以 readout="ask" 也是 true。 v 屬性的值：null、undefined、false（沒寫）或字串。只寫屬性名稱時是空字串。 沒寫是 false，true 是 true，字串除了（不分大小寫、去掉空白後）false、0、off、no 之外都是 true。

Absent or false/0/off/no is off. ask is ask. on, true, yes, auto is on without a port. Any other text is on, and the text is the port name or /regex/ to look for (see findPort()): embedMode('IAC') is { mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }. v The attribute value. bare What a bare attribute (no value) means: 'on' for hardware (the default), 'ask' for midi-out, because there is no sensible default port to send to. mode is 'off', 'ask' or 'on'. port is a string only when the value names one.

沒寫或是 false/0/off/no 就是關閉。ask 就是 ask。on、true、yes、auto 是開啟但不指定埠。其他任何文字都是開啟，而那段文字就是要找的埠名或 /regex/（見 findPort()）：embedMode('IAC') 是 { mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }。 v 屬性的值。 bare 只寫屬性、沒有值時的意思：hardware 是 'on'（預設），midi-out 是 'ask'，因為送出去沒有合理的預設埠。 mode 是 'off'、'ask' 或 'on'。只有值裡有指定埠時，port 才是字串。

ControllerCanvas fades released keys (180 ms), pads (450 ms), the glow of a touched control (650 ms), the last-touch text under the faceplate (1600 ms) and on the device screen (3200 ms) with it. A video frame is 33 ms at 30 fps, so a staccato note that was 20 ms long would be gone before the next frame without a fade. now The current time in milliseconds. at When the touch happened, on the same clock. null or undefined gives 0. ms How long the fade lasts. Not above 0 gives 0. From 1 down to 0. The curve is the square of the remaining time, so it falls quickly at first.

ControllerCanvas 用它讓放開的琴鍵（180 毫秒）、打擊墊（450 毫秒）、被碰到的控制項光暈（650 毫秒）、面板下方的最後觸碰文字（1600 毫秒）和機器螢幕上的文字（3200 毫秒）淡出。30 fps 的影片一格是 33 毫秒，沒有淡出的話，20 毫秒長的斷音在下一格之前就消失了。 now 目前的時間（毫秒）。 at 觸碰發生的時間，用同一個時鐘。null 或 undefined 會得到 0。 ms 淡出持續多久。不大於 0 會得到 0。 從 1 降到 0。曲線是剩餘時間的平方，所以一開始掉得比較快。

Hardware and the on-screen controllers publish every message twice: the legacy name (midi/note/on) and then the per-channel one (midi/ch/1/note/60) in one call. The QWERTY piano and some takes publish only the legacy name. A per-channel name counts at once; a legacy name waits for a microtask and is dropped if its per-channel twin shows up first. So a relative encoder never turns twice, a legacy CC (which has no channel) never lands on the wrong channel, and order is kept. ControllerCanvas uses it. Use it yourself to turn a bus back into MIDI events, for example to drive your own visual from a recorded take. signals The bus. It needs onAny(cb). onEvent (ev) => … called with an event of parseMessage() for each message. channel The channel given to legacy CC and bend names, which carry none. defer (fn) => … that schedules the flush of legacy-only names. Default queueMicrotask; replaceable in tests. flush() delivers legacy-only messages that are still waiting. dispose() stops listening and drops them.

硬體和螢幕控制器對每則訊息都會發佈兩次：先是短名稱（midi/note/on），緊接著在同一次呼叫裡是分頻道的名稱（midi/ch/1/note/60）。電腦鍵盤鋼琴和某些錄音只發佈短名稱。分頻道的名稱會立刻算數，短名稱則等一個 microtask，如果它分頻道的孿生兄弟先到了就丟掉。所以相對旋鈕不會轉兩次，沒有頻道的短名稱 CC 也不會落到錯誤的頻道，順序也會保持。 ControllerCanvas 用的就是它。想把匯流排變回 MIDI 事件時可以自己用，例如用錄下的演奏去驅動你自己的畫面。 signals 匯流排，需要有 onAny(cb)。 onEvent 每則訊息都以 parseMessage() 的事件格式呼叫 (ev) => …。 channel 指定給短名稱 CC 和彎音用的頻道，因為它們本身沒有頻道資訊。 defer 排程「只有短名稱」那批訊息的 flush 用的 (fn) => …。預設是 queueMicrotask，測試時可以換掉。 flush() 送出還在等待的「只有短名稱」訊息。dispose() 停止監聽並丟掉它們。

What each does: set { id, value, note?, quiet? } moves a control, press { id, velocity?, note? } and release { id, note? } hold and let go, ingest { bytes } feeds MIDI (one message or a list), reset brings everything home, profile { profile } switches the device, layout { layout } changes the layout, and get asks for every value (the iframe answers with a values message). A plain array. fromParent() ignores a message whose type is not one of these.

各指令的作用：set { id, value, note?, quiet? } 移動控制項，press { id, velocity?, note? } 與 release { id, note? } 按住與放開，ingest { bytes } 餵入 MIDI（一則或一串），reset 讓所有東西回到原位，profile { profile } 切換機器，layout { layout } 改變版面，get 要求所有數值（iframe 會用一則 values 訊息回答）。 一個普通陣列。fromParent() 會忽略 type 不在這份清單裡的訊息。

Other scripts and extensions post to a page all the time, so always filter. Check event.origin too when the page cares who sent it: this function checks the shape, not the sender. data The event.data of a message event. null unless data is an object with source: 'openav' and a string type.
別的腳本和瀏覽器擴充功能隨時都在對頁面送訊息，所以一定要過濾。頁面在意是誰送的話，也要檢查 event.origin：這個函式檢查的是格式，不是寄件者。 data message 事件的 event.data。 除非 data 是帶有 source: 'openav' 和字串 type 的物件，否則回傳 null。

It is strict, because anything on the web can post to an iframe. The message needs target: 'openav' and a type from FRAME_COMMANDS. Control ids must be lower-case [a-z0-9_-]. value must be a finite number. note must be an integer 0..127 (else null). A press velocity is held to 0..1. ingest takes one message of 1 to 3 bytes whose first byte is a status byte (128 or more), or up to 256 such messages. profile takes an id or an https:// URL (not http://). layout must be in EMBED_LAYOUTS. data The event.data of a message event. A command such as { type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5, note: null, quiet: false }, or null.

它很嚴格，因為網路上任何東西都能對 iframe 送訊息。訊息必須有 target: 'openav'，type 要在 FRAME_COMMANDS 裡。控制項 id 必須是小寫的 [a-z0-9_-]。value 必須是有限的數字。note 必須是 0..127 的整數（否則是 null）。press 的力度會限制在 0..1。ingest 接受一則 1 到 3 個位元組、第一個位元組是狀態位元組（128 以上）的訊息，或最多 256 則這樣的訊息。profile 接受 id 或 https:// 網址（不接受 http://）。layout 必須在 EMBED_LAYOUTS 裡。 data message 事件的 event.data。 像 { type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5, note: null, quiet: false } 這樣的指令，或 null。

A range never starts on a black key: a black key with no white key before it is left out, the way the on-screen keyboard does. White keys share the width equally, so 48 to 72 is 15 white keys and 10 black ones. from The first MIDI note. to The last MIDI note. rect The area the keys fill. One item per key, the white keys first and then the black ones (the draw order, so the black keys end up on top).
音域不會從黑鍵開始：前面沒有白鍵的黑鍵會被省略，螢幕上的鍵盤也是這樣。白鍵平分寬度，所以 48 到 72 是 15 個白鍵加 10 個黑鍵。 from 第一個 MIDI 音符。 to 最後一個 MIDI 音符。 rect 琴鍵要填滿的區域。 每個琴鍵一項，先是白鍵再是黑鍵（也就是繪製順序，這樣黑鍵會疊在上面）。

A keyboard control catches notes outside its printed range, because the device's Oct+/Oct− buttons shift what the keys send. When one arrives, the drawing moves and stays there, as the device does. A 48 to 72 MiniLab with Oct+ pressed (a note of 76) shows 60 to 84. A range narrower than an octave just moves to reach the note. from The first note of the printed range. to The last note of the printed range. base The first note shown now. note A note that just went down. The new first note: base when the note fits, otherwise base moved by the fewest octaves that reach it, held to the MIDI range.

琴鍵控制項會接住超出印刷音域的音，因為機器的 Oct+/Oct− 按鈕會改變琴鍵送出的音。這種音到來時，畫面會移動並停在那裡，就像實機一樣。48 到 72 的 MiniLab 按下 Oct+（音符 76）後，畫面會顯示 60 到 84。窄於一個八度的音域，則是直接移動到夠到那個音為止。 from 印刷音域的第一個音。 to 印刷音域的最後一個音。 base 目前顯示的第一個音。 note 剛剛按下的音。 新的第一個音：音符放得進去就回傳 base，否則是把 base 移動剛好夠的最少八度，並限制在 MIDI 範圍內。

This is the on-screen keyboard's convention. Some software (Ableton Live, Yamaha) calls 60 "C3": the number is the same, only the octave label differs. In a p5 sketch, noteName() does the same and also writes flats when you ask. n A MIDI note number, 0..127. Sharps only ('C#4', never 'Db4'). 0 is 'C-1' and 127 is 'G9'.
這是螢幕鍵盤採用的寫法。有些軟體（Ableton Live、Yamaha）把 60 叫做「C3」：號碼是一樣的，只有八度的標示不同。在 p5 草圖裡，noteName() 做同樣的事，而且需要時可以寫成降記號。 n MIDI 音符號碼，0..127。 只用升記號（'C#4'，不會是 'Db4'）。0 是 'C-1'，127 是 'G9'。

The bar shows which device is on screen (the picker switches it), a chip saying whether a hardware port drives it, a port picker when hardware is attached, a Learn button (click a control, then move the one on the hardware; a second button resets the mapping), and a tiny monitor that prints the last message, so you see the hardware talking before you see what it moves. Plugging in a known device switches the picker and the faceplate. The labels on the toolbar (Learn, Reset, the hardware chip) are written in Chinese only, whatever the page language is. has an English and a Chinese toolbar; this panel is the one the lab and the phone tab use. parent The element to add the panel to. In full mode the panel is position: absolute; inset: 0, so give parent a position (relative) and a size. mcs The manager that holds the devices and the hardware. mode 'full' fills parent. 'dock' is a drawer fixed to the bottom of the window, 40% of the window height by default, with a grip to drag its height (remembered in localStorage). open Whether it starts open. A closed dock builds its view only when opened. id An element id for the panel. onToggle (open) => … called when the panel opens or closes. closeButton Show a ✕ button. The default is on in dock mode only. profiles Limit the device picker to these profile ids. contained Dock inside parent (absolute) instead of the window (fixed). el is the panel element, view the ControllerView (once it exists), isOpen a boolean. open(), close() and…

工具列顯示螢幕上是哪台機器（可以用選單切換）、一個說明有沒有硬體埠在驅動它的標籤、接了硬體時的埠選單、學習按鈕（點一個控制項，再動硬體上對應的那一個，另一個按鈕可以還原對應），以及一個小監看視窗印出最後一則訊息，讓你在看到它推動什麼之前，先看到硬體在說話。接上認得的機器時，選單和面板都會跟著切換。 工具列上的文字是中文（學習、還原、硬體 …），不隨頁面語言改變。 的工具列有英文和中文版，這個面板則是實驗室和手機分頁在用的那個。 parent 要加進面板的元素。full 模式的面板是 position: absolute; inset: 0，所以 parent 要設 position（relative）並有大小。 mcs 管理裝置與硬體的管理器。 mode 'full' 填滿 parent。'dock' 是固定在視窗底部的抽屜，預設佔視窗高度的 40%，有把手可以拖曳調整高度（記在 localStorage）。 open 一開始是否打開。關著的停靠面板要到打開時才建立畫面。 id 面板的元素 id。 onToggle 面板打開或關閉時呼叫 (open) => …。 closeButton 是否顯示 ✕ 按鈕。預設只有 dock 模式會顯示。 profiles 把機器選單限制在這些設定檔 id。 contained 停靠在 parent 裡面（absolute），不是停靠在視窗（fixed）。 el 是面板元素，view 是 ControllerView（建立之後才有），isOpen 是布林值。open()、close()、toggle() 回傳同一個物件，close() 還會放開按著的音。

Load @openav/midi/element (https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js) once and write . Importing the file registers the tag by itself. It is a shadow-DOM element, so the page's CSS cannot bend it and it cannot bend the page. It plays with a mouse, a finger, a pen and the keyboard, with or without Web MIDI: on Safari and iPad it still plays and fires events, and only the hardware and MIDI-out parts say they are unavailable. Attributes, each also a property of the same name (midi-out is el.midiOut): profile (an id, a short name or a URL to a profile JSON; default arturia-minilab3), layout (auto, face as it looks, stack re-gridded for a tall box), hardware (off by default; bare or on follows the real device, ask shows a button so the permission prompt waits for a click, or a port name or /regex/), midi-out (off by default; bare or ask lets the visitor pick, or a port name, substring or /regex/ such as IAC or loopMIDI), channel (1 to 16: move every control to that channel), picker, readout (the last message under the faceplate), learn (a Learn button), follow (show whatever known device is plugged in), theme (dark or light: the toolbar only, the device stays the device), telemetry (off sends no anonymous hit) and lang (the toolbar language: zh… is Chinese, anything else English; it reads the nearest lang on the page). Events are CustomEvents that bubble and cross the shadow root, so el.addEventListener('control', e => e.detail) works anywhere above it: ready {…

載入一次 @openav/midi/element（https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js），然後寫 。匯入這個檔案時會自動註冊標籤。它是 shadow DOM 元素，所以頁面的 CSS 影響不到它，它也不會影響頁面。滑鼠、手指、觸控筆和鍵盤都能彈，有沒有 Web MIDI 都行：在 Safari 和 iPad 上仍然能彈、能觸發事件，只有硬體和 MIDI 輸出的部分會說「不能用」。 屬性，每一個也是同名的屬性（property）（midi-out 對應 el.midiOut）：profile（id、短名稱，或指向設定檔 JSON 的網址，預設 arturia-minilab3）、layout（auto，face 是原本的樣子，stack 是為高的盒子重新排列）、hardware（預設關閉，只寫屬性或 on 是跟隨真實機器，ask 會顯示按鈕，讓權限詢問等到點擊才跳出，也可以寫埠名或 /regex/）、midi-out（預設關閉，只寫屬性或 ask 讓訪客自己挑，也可以寫埠名、子字串或 /regex/，例如 IAC、loopMIDI）、channel（1 到 16：把所有控制項移到那個頻道）、picker、readout（面板下面顯示最後一則訊息）、learn（學習按鈕）、follow（接上哪台認得的機器就顯示哪一台）、theme（dark 或 light：只影響工具列，機器還是機器的樣子）、telemetry（off 就不送匿名資料）和 lang（工具列語言：zh… 是中文，其他是英文，會讀頁面上最近的 lang）。 事件是會冒泡、也會穿過 shadow root 的 CustomEvent，所以在它上面任何一層用 el.addEventListener('control', e => e.detail) 都收得到：ready { profile, name, controls }、control（見 controlDetail()）、noteon、noteoff、connect、disconnect、status、profilechange 和 error { message }。EMBED_EVENTS 列出了它們。方法有：set()、get()、values()、reset()、press()、release()、ingest()、send()、on()、connectHardware()、disconnectHardware()、setOutput()、toggleLearn()。 它的寬度填滿容器，高度則跟著面板走（手機上會用比較高的直排），除非你自己設高度。CSS 變數：--oav-bg、--oav-fg、--oav-accent、--oav-line、--oav-font，以及 --oav-ratio（寬除以高）。可用的 part：::part(toolbar)、::part(body)、::part(readout)。 要等控制器建好：await el.ready（會以元素本身完成的 promise），或是監聽 ready 事件。在那之前，set()、press()、release()、ingest() 會回傳 null 並在主控台印出一次警告，get() 也回傳 null。除非用了 hardware、midi-out 或學習，否則它不會要 MIDI 權限。 只能放 iframe 的地方，同一個元素也放在…

Advanced: it is exported for pages that want to read or override the rules. You never need it to mount a panel. CSS for the .mcp… classes. mountMidiPanel() injects it by itself, once per document (a in the head).
進階用途：匯出給想讀或覆寫規則的頁面。掛上面板時完全用不到它。 .mcp… 那些 class 的 CSS。mountMidiPanel() 會自己注入，每個文件一次（放在 head 的 ）。

It is the one place that decides what the attributes and the iframe's query string mean, so the element and the iframe always agree. Defaults: profile is arturia-minilab3, layout auto, theme dark, hardware and midiOut off (so embedding never asks for MIDI permission), the booleans false, telemetry true, and channel, bg, frame, origin, lang are null. Rules worth knowing: an unknown layout becomes auto; theme is light or dark; midi-out may also be written midiout or midiOut, and alone it means ask; frame may also be written id and is cut to 64 characters; origin is kept only as https://host or http://host with no path (anything else, such as javascript:, becomes null), lang is cut to 16 characters, and bg goes through embedColor(). src Where the options live: an element (read with getAttribute), a URLSearchParams (the iframe page passes its own), a plain object { profile: 'lpd8' }, or a function (name) => value | null. { profile, layout, hardware, midiOut, channel, learn, picker, readout, follow, telemetry, theme, bg, frame, origin, lang }. hardware and midiOut are { mode, port } as in embedMode().

元素和 iframe 的查詢字串各代表什麼意思，都由它一個地方決定，所以兩邊一定一致。預設值：profile 是 arturia-minilab3，layout 是 auto，theme 是 dark，hardware 和 midiOut 是關閉（所以嵌入不會要 MIDI 權限），布林值都是 false，telemetry 是 true，channel、bg、frame、origin、lang 是 null。 值得知道的規則：不認得的 layout 變成 auto。theme 只有 light 或 dark。midi-out 也可以寫成 midiout 或 midiOut，單獨寫表示 ask。frame 也可以寫成 id，並且截成 64 個字元。origin 只接受沒有路徑的 https://host 或 http://host（其他的，像 javascript:，會變成 null）。lang 截成 16 個字元。bg 會經過 embedColor()。 src 選項放在哪裡：元素（用 getAttribute 讀）、URLSearchParams（iframe 頁面傳自己的）、普通物件 { profile: 'lpd8' }，或是函式 (name) => value | null。 { profile, layout, hardware, midiOut, channel, learn, picker, readout, follow, telemetry, theme, bg, frame, origin, lang }。hardware 和 midiOut 的格式是 embedMode() 那樣的 { mode, port }。

toParent() and toFrame() write it for you, and fromFrame() and fromParent() check it. A constant. A message from the iframe has source: 'openav', and a command to the iframe has target: 'openav'. Anything else is ignored on both sides.
toParent() 和 toFrame() 會替你寫入，fromFrame() 和 fromParent() 負責檢查。 常數。iframe 送出的訊息有 source: 'openav'，送進 iframe 的指令有 target: 'openav'。兩邊都會忽略其他任何訊息。
Messages from toParent() and toFrame() carry it as v: 1. A constant, so a page can tell when the format changes. fromFrame() gives v back (1 when a message lacks it).
toParent() 和 toFrame() 的訊息都會帶著 v: 1。 常數，讓頁面在格式改變時能分辨。fromFrame() 會把 v 還給你（訊息沒有時是 1）。

uses it to set its height, so a controller sizes itself from its width. In auto, the faceplate's own proportions are used while the smallest control stays at least minTouch pixels at that width; otherwise it becomes a stack, about 0.8 to 1.5 times as tall as it is wide depending on how many bands the profile's portrait has. Square grid devices (the Launchpad, stack: false) always keep their face. profile A normalized profile (face, sections, portrait, stack). width The box width in pixels. layout 'auto', 'face' or 'stack'. minTouch The smallest control size in pixels that still counts as finger-sized. mode is 'face' or 'stack', and aspect is the width ÷ height to give the box.

用它來決定自己的高度，所以控制器會依寬度自己決定大小。在 auto 下，只要在那個寬度時最小的控制項仍有至少 minTouch 像素，就用面板本身的比例，否則改成直排，高度大約是寬度的 0.8 到 1.5 倍，視設定檔 portrait 有幾條而定。方形格子的機器（Launchpad，stack: false）永遠維持 face。 profile 整理過的設定檔（face、sections、portrait、stack）。 width 盒子的寬度（像素）。 layout 'auto'、'face' 或 'stack'。 minTouch 還算夠手指按的最小控制項尺寸（像素）。 mode 是 'face' 或 'stack'，aspect 是要給盒子的寬高比。

reset() on ControllerHost uses it to bring every control home. An endless encoder has no real position, so only its drawn position goes to the middle and no MIDI is sent for it. c A control definition from a normalized profile. 0 for keys, pads, buttons and bipolar controls; otherwise the control's def, else 0.5 for an endless encoder and 0 for the rest.
ControllerHost 的 reset() 用它讓每個控制項回到原位。無限旋鈕沒有真正的位置，所以只有畫面上的位置會回到中間，而且不會送出 MIDI。 c 整理過的設定檔中的控制項定義。 琴鍵、打擊墊、按鈕和雙向控制項是 0。其他用控制項的 def，沒有的話無限旋鈕是 0.5，其餘是 0。

What value means depends on the type. Knob, fader, wheel, strip and encoder: 0..1 (−1..1 for a bipolar one). Pad and momentary button: above 0 presses (with that velocity, held to 1) and 0 releases. Toggle button: 0.5 or more is on. Keys: value is the velocity, above 0 presses that note and 0 releases it. This is what set() on ControllerHost and call. mc The controller. id The control id. An unknown id throws has no control "x" (controls: …). value The value (below). Anything that is not a finite number throws set("id"): value must be a number. note For a keys control: which note. The default is the first key of its range. source 'ui' (default) publishes and reaches MIDI out. 'mirror' moves only the faceplate (two-way binding). The bytes sent, or null when nothing changed (for example releasing a pad that is not held).

value 的意思依類型而定。旋鈕、推桿、彎音輪、觸控條、編碼器：0..1（雙向的是 −1..1）。打擊墊和瞬間按鈕：大於 0 是按下（用那個力度，上限 1），0 是放開。切換按鈕：0.5 以上是開。琴鍵：value 是力度，大於 0 按下那個 note，0 放開它。ControllerHost 和 的 set() 呼叫的就是它。 mc 控制器。 id 控制項 id。不存在的 id 會丟出 has no control "x" (controls: …)。 value 數值（見下）。不是有限數字的值會丟出 set("id"): value must be a number。 note 琴鍵控制項要給：哪個音。預設是音域的第一個鍵。 source 'ui'（預設）會發佈並送到 MIDI 輸出。'mirror' 只動面板（雙向綁定用）。 送出的位元組，沒有變化時（例如放開一個沒按著的打擊墊）回傳 null。

It does not check the command: the iframe does, with fromParent(), and ignores what it does not understand. Post to the frame's real origin, not , when you can. type The command: one of FRAME_COMMANDS. args The command's fields ({ id, value } for set). Copied through JSON. A message ready for iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, origin).
它不檢查指令內容：iframe 會用 fromParent() 檢查，不懂的就忽略。可以的話請送給 frame 真正的來源，不要用 。 type 指令：FRAME_COMMANDS 其中之一。 args 指令的欄位（set 是 { id, value }）。會經過 JSON 複製。 可以直接給 iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, origin) 的訊息。

The iframe page calls parent.postMessage(toParent(name, detail, { frame }), target) for every event, where target is the ?origin= parameter or . With ?origin=https://your.site the frame posts only to that origin and accepts commands only from it. type The event name (see EMBED_EVENTS), or values. detail The event payload. It is copied through JSON, so the message is always postMessage-safe (undefined becomes null). frame A name for this iframe (the ?frame= parameter), echoed in every message so a page with several frames can tell them apart. The message { source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }.

iframe 頁面對每個事件都呼叫 parent.postMessage(toParent(name, detail, { frame }), target)，target 是 ?origin= 參數，沒有就是 。加上 ?origin=https://your.site 之後，frame 只會送給那個來源，也只接受從它來的指令。 type 事件名稱（見 EMBED_EVENTS），或 values。 detail 事件內容。會經過 JSON 複製，所以訊息一定能安全地 postMessage（undefined 變成 null）。 frame 這個 iframe 的名字（?frame= 參數），每則訊息都會帶著，這樣頁面上有好幾個 frame 時才分得出來。 訊息物件 { source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }。

ControllerCanvas draws this text on the device's screen (MiniLab 3, KeyStep) so a video shows what the hardware's own screen would. It is pure, so it is easy to reuse for a caption or a log. c The control's definition (from the normalized profile). null gives an empty string. st Its state: { raw, value, held, pos }. note For a keys control, the note that was touched. The line. A control whose label is only a number is named after its type (Knob 1). A pad shows its velocity only while held, a button shows on or off, a relative encoder shows its position as a percentage, and a bipolar wheel shows a signed value.

ControllerCanvas 把這段文字畫在機器的螢幕上（MiniLab 3、KeyStep），讓影片裡看得到實機螢幕會顯示的內容。它是純函式，拿去當字幕或記錄也很方便。 c 控制項的定義（來自整理過的設定檔）。給 null 會回傳空字串。 st 它的狀態：{ raw, value, held, pos }。 note 琴鍵控制項要給：被碰到的音符。 那一行文字。標籤只是數字的控制項，會用類型來命名（Knob 1）。打擊墊只有按著時才顯示力度，按鈕顯示 on 或 off，相對旋鈕以百分比顯示位置，雙向彎音輪則顯示有正負號的值。
This is what values() returns on ControllerHost and , and what the iframe answers to the get command. mc The controller. One number per control id, in the profile's order.
ControllerHost 和 的 values() 回傳的就是它，iframe 對 get 指令的回答也是它。 mc 控制器。 每個控制項 id 一個數字，順序跟設定檔一致。

Advanced. You never need it to show a controller. It is exported for pages that build their own shadow DOM, a server-rendered preview or a theme that wants to read the rules. Colours use the CSS variables --oav-focus, --body, --c and --cap that the view sets per control. CSS for the .mcv… classes. The view injects it by itself, once per document, or once per shadow root when it lives inside one (a ).

進階用途。要顯示控制器的話完全用不到它。它是匯出給「自己建 shadow DOM 的頁面、伺服器端渲染的預覽、想讀規則的佈景」用的。顏色用的 CSS 變數有 --oav-focus、--body、--c 和 --cap，其中後三個由畫面針對每個控制項設定。 .mcv… 那些 class 的 CSS。畫面會自己注入，每個文件注入一次，放在 shadow root 裡時則是每個 root 一次（一個 ）。

new KeysPiano(el, { onNote }) builds the keys inside el. Whatever plays a key (a click or a touch on it, sweeping across the keys with the button held, the computer keyboard, or your own call to press()) ends up in onNote(note, vel01, on): on is true for a key going down and false for one coming up, and vel01 is 0..1 (0 on the way up). The black and white pattern follows the real pitch, so a piano can start on any note. A key that is already down ignores a second press(). The computer keyboard is off until you set piano.captureEnabled = true, and it is up to you to pass the page's keydown and keyup events to handleKeyDown(e) and handleKeyUp(e) (see PIANO_KEYMAP for which letter is which note). mountKeys() does all of that for you. handleKeyDown(e) returns true when the piano used the event, and then you should call e.preventDefault(). While capturing, every letter a–z counts as used, even those that play no note, so a stray letter cannot trigger a hotkey; digits, space and the arrows pass through. Held keys with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt are never used. container The element the keys are built in. It gets the class oav-keys and is emptied first. opts Options: base (lowest key, default 48), octaves (default 2), semitones (the number of keys, default octaves × 12 + 1), velocity (0..127 for the mouse and the computer keyboard, default 100), onNote(note, vel01, on), onOctave(base), fill (size the keys in percent of the container, so it can be any width), keyWidth (px per white key when…

new KeysPiano(el, { onNote }) 在 el 裡蓋出琴鍵。不管是誰彈了一個鍵（在上面點一下或觸碰、按著按鈕滑過琴鍵、電腦鍵盤，或你自己呼叫 press()），最後都會進到 onNote(note, vel01, on)：on 是 true 表示鍵按下去，false 表示放開，vel01 是 0..1（放開時是 0）。黑白鍵的排法照真正的音高走，所以鋼琴可以從任何一個音開始。已經按著的鍵再 press() 會被忽略。 電腦鍵盤一開始是關的，要自己設 piano.captureEnabled = true，並且由你把頁面的 keydown 和 keyup 事件交給 handleKeyDown(e) 和 handleKeyUp(e)（哪個字母是哪個音見 PIANO_KEYMAP）。mountKeys() 把這些全部替你做了。 鋼琴用掉這個事件的時候，handleKeyDown(e) 會回傳 true，那時你要呼叫 e.preventDefault()。在擷取鍵盤的時候，每個字母 a–z 都算被用掉，連不發音的也是，這樣打錯的字母不會觸發快捷鍵。數字、空白鍵、方向鍵會放行。有按著 Ctrl、Cmd、Alt 的組合鍵永遠不算。 container 要把琴鍵蓋在裡面的元素。它會得到 oav-keys 這個 class，並且先被清空。 opts 選項：base（最低的鍵，預設 48）、octaves（預設 2）、semitones（鍵的數量，預設 octaves × 12 + 1）、velocity（滑鼠和電腦鍵盤的力道，0..127，預設 100）、onNote(note, vel01, on)、onOctave(base)、fill（琴鍵用容器的百分比算大小，所以可以是任何寬度）、keyWidth（不 fill 的時候每個白鍵幾像素，預設 27）、minBase（24）和 maxBase（84），也就是八度鍵能移動 base 的範圍。

mountKeys() is the whole keyboard department in one line: a KeysPiano you can play with the mouse, a finger or the computer keyboard, and a SimPlayer that plays by itself. Above the piano are two checkboxes, both off to begin with: keyboard (the QWERTY keys play, Z and X move an octave, Shift plays harder) and simulate performance. Everything is published as the standard midi/note/on and midi/note/off, the same names a real MIDI keyboard uses, so a world, a sound engine or a chord detector cannot tell a QWERTY performance from hardware. Call keys.update(dt) once per frame, or the simulated performer does not move. A page with a DOM. The keyboard checkbox must be ticked before the computer keyboard plays, on purpose: while it is on, every letter key is taken by the piano, so hotkeys on letters stop working. A key listener goes on window until dispose(). In a p5 sketch you do not need this: the 🎹 panel of oav-p5 is a piano like this one, and notePressed() hears it. mountKeys() is for a page that has no oav-p5. container The element to put the piano in. It gets a small bar of checkboxes and the piano under it. dispose() empties it again. signals The Signals bus to publish into. Every key down is midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 0 } (vel 0..1) and every key up midi/note/off { note, ch: 0 }. Without a bus the piano still works and calls chord. chord Anything with noteOn(note, vel01) and noteOff(note), usually a chord detector from @openav/chord, to be fed every note directly. base…

mountKeys() 一行就把整個鍵盤部門裝好：一架可以用滑鼠、手指或電腦鍵盤彈的 KeysPiano，加上一個會自己彈的 SimPlayer。鋼琴上面有兩個勾選框，一開始都沒勾：keyboard（QWERTY 鍵能彈，Z 和 X 換八度，Shift 彈得比較重）和 simulate performance。 所有東西都發布成標準的 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off，跟真的 MIDI 鍵盤用同樣的名字，所以世界、聲音引擎或和弦偵測器分不出 QWERTY 演奏和硬體的差別。每個畫面要呼叫一次 keys.update(dt)，不然模擬演奏者不會動。 需要有 DOM 的頁面。要先勾「keyboard」電腦鍵盤才會彈，這是故意的：勾著的時候所有字母鍵都被鋼琴吃掉，字母的快捷鍵就不能用。window 上的按鍵監聽會一直在，直到 dispose()。 在 p5 草圖裡用不到這個：oav-p5 的 🎹 面板就是一架這樣的鋼琴，notePressed() 聽得到它。mountKeys() 是給沒有 oav-p5 的頁面用的。 container 要放鋼琴的元素。裡面會有一條小小的勾選列，和它底下的鋼琴。dispose() 會再把它清空。 signals 要發布訊號的 Signals 匯流排。每個按下去的鍵是 midi/note/on { note, vel, ch: 0 }（vel 是 0..1），每個放開的鍵是 midi/note/off { note, ch: 0 }。沒給匯流排的話鋼琴照樣能彈，也會呼叫 chord。 chord 任何有 noteOn(note, vel01) 和 noteOff(note) 的東西，通常是 @openav/chord 的和弦偵測器，每個音都會直接餵給它。 base 最低那個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼（48 是 C3）。模擬演奏者彈的是它高一個八度的地方。 octaves 鋼琴有幾個八度。鍵數是 octaves × 12 + 1，所以兩個八度會結束在一個 C。 sim 要不要顯示「simulate performance」勾選框。不管有沒有顯示，演奏者都在：用程式 keys.sim.toggle(true) 就能開始。 capture 要不要顯示「keyboard」勾選框，讓電腦鍵盤能彈這架鋼琴。給 false 就沒有勾選框，captureBox 是 null。你還是可以自己設 keys.piano.captureEnabled = true。 { piano, sim, update(dt), dispose(), captureBox }：KeysPiano、SimPlayer、每個畫面要呼叫的函式（參數是距離上一次過了幾秒，它帶動演奏者）、把一切拆掉的函式，以及「keyboard」勾選框（或 null）。

The layout the music software calls the DAW standard: the A S D F G H J K L ; row is the white keys and the W E T Y U O P row above it is the black keys, placed where they sit on a piano. With a piano that starts on C (base 48, 60…) it reads C, C♯, D, D♯, E, F, F♯, G, G♯, A, A♯, B, C, C♯, D, D♯, E. The keys are lowercase letters; KeysPiano.handleKeyDown(e) lowercases the key first. Z and X are not in the map: they move the octave. { a: 0, w: 1, s: 2, e: 3, d: 4, f: 5, t: 6, g: 7, y: 8, h: 9, u: 10, j: 11, k: 12, o: 13, l: 14, p: 15, ';': 16 }: key to semitones above the piano's base.

這是音樂軟體稱為 DAW 標準的排法：A S D F G H J K L ; 這一排是白鍵，上面一排 W E T Y U O P 是黑鍵，位置就跟鋼琴上一樣。鋼琴從 C 開始（base 是 48、60…）的話，從左到右是 C、C♯、D、D♯、E、F、F♯、G、G♯、A、A♯、B、C、C♯、D、D♯、E。鍵是小寫字母。KeysPiano.handleKeyDown(e) 會先把鍵轉成小寫。Z 和 X 不在這張表裡：它們是換八度。 { a: 0, w: 1, s: 2, e: 3, d: 4, f: 5, t: 6, g: 7, y: 8, h: 9, u: 10, j: 11, k: 12, o: 13, l: 14, p: 15, ';': 16 }：鍵對應到比鋼琴的 base 高幾個半音。

It plays like someone noodling. Every gesture it picks at random: mostly a step up or down the scale, sometimes a leap, now and then a triad stacked in the scale, and real rests. Notes last 0.18 to 0.68 seconds (a triad twice as long), the next gesture comes 0.22 to 0.77 seconds later (a rest lasts 0.6 to 2 seconds), all at the default density of 1, and the notes are kept between 36 and 96. Because it presses and releases through your own two functions, whatever listens downstream cannot tell it from a person. It starts off. Call toggle(true) and then update(dt) once per frame with the seconds since the last frame; it does nothing while it is off. toggle(false) releases every note it is holding, so none sticks. The notes are random (it uses Math.random, there is no seed). press press(note, vel01): called when a note starts, with its MIDI number and a velocity between 0.45 and 0.85. Usually the press of a KeysPiano, so the keys light up. release release(note): called when the note ends. base The MIDI note the scale starts on. scale The notes it may play, as semitones above base. The default is a pentatonic scale, which sounds fine whatever happens. density How busy it is. The gaps between notes are divided by it, so 2 plays about twice as often.

它彈起來像有人隨手彈。每個動作都是隨機挑的：大多是在音階上往上或往下一步，有時跳一個音程，偶爾彈一個疊在音階上的三和弦，也有真正的休止。每個音持續 0.18 到 0.68 秒（三和弦長兩倍），下一個動作在 0.22 到 0.77 秒之後（休止 0.6 到 2 秒），這些都是 density 為預設的 1 時的數字，音符被限制在 36 到 96。因為它是透過你的兩個函式按下和放開，下游的東西分不出它跟真人的差別。 它一開始是關的。呼叫 toggle(true)，然後每個畫面用距離上一個畫面過了幾秒呼叫 update(dt)。關著的時候它什麼都不做。toggle(false) 會放開它按著的所有音，不會有音卡住。音是隨機的（用的是 Math.random，沒有 seed）。 press press(note, vel01)：一個音開始時呼叫，帶著 MIDI 號碼和 0.45 到 0.85 之間的力道。通常是 KeysPiano 的 press，這樣琴鍵會亮。 release release(note)：這個音結束時呼叫。 base 音階從哪個 MIDI 音符開始。 scale 它可以彈的音，用比 base 高幾個半音來表示。預設是五聲音階，怎麼彈都不會難聽。 density 多忙。音和音之間的間隔會除以它，所以 2 大約是兩倍密。

The sensor gives joints, not rotations, but LeapJS sketches read a rotation basis for every bone, so V6Converter uses this to fill in bases. You only need it if you write your own converter. prev The joint at the base of the bone, [x, y, z] in millimetres. next The joint at the tip end of the bone. palmNormal The palm normal; -palmNormal becomes the "back of the hand" axis (y). left true for a left hand: the x axis is negated, so the determinant is negative, which is how LeapJS tells left from right. Three rows [x, y, z], each a unit vector rounded to 3 decimals. z runs from the tip back to the base (LeapJS's Bone.direction() is -z).

感測器給的是關節，不是旋轉，但 LeapJS 的草圖會對每根骨頭讀一個旋轉基底，所以 V6Converter 用它來填 bases。只有自己寫轉換器的時候才會需要它。 prev 骨頭根部的關節 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐。 next 骨頭前端的關節。 palmNormal 掌心法線，-palmNormal 會成為「手背」那一軸（y）。 left 左手就傳 true：x 軸會反向，行列式變成負的，LeapJS 就是靠這個分辨左右手。 三列 [x, y, z]，各是四捨五入到小數三位的單位向量。z 從前端指回根部（LeapJS 的 Bone.direction() 是 -z）。

The default of startBridge({ port }) and of --port. The environment variable LEAP_BRIDGE_PORT changes it for the command line. This is the port of the Leap bridge; the out-bridge has its own (DEFAULT_PORT of @openav/out, 6450).
startBridge({ port }) 和 --port 的預設值。環境變數 LEAP_BRIDGE_PORT 可以改命令列用的值。這是 Leap 橋接程式的連接埠。輸出橋接有自己的（@openav/out 的 DEFAULT_PORT，6450）。

Port 6437 is the port the original Leap service used, so old leap.js sketches find the bridge without changing anything. …/raw on the same port serves the raw lines instead. In a show, ?leap=ws://host:port/v6.json in the page address points a page at another bridge, and ?leap=sim starts the simulator.
6437 是原本的 Leap 服務用的連接埠，所以舊的 leap.js 草圖不用改任何東西就找得到橋接程式。同一個連接埠的 …/raw 提供的是原始行格式。在演出裡，網址加上 ?leap=ws://host:port/v6.json 可以讓頁面改連別的橋接程式，?leap=sim 則會啟動模擬器。

LeapJS (protocol 5 and up) turns it into deviceAttached, deviceStreaming and streamingStarted. The bridge sends one on connect and on every status change. LeapInput maps it to its status: no service is 'no-service', a service without a device is 'no-device', and a streaming device is 'tracking'. device The device id, or null for no device. service Whether the tracking service is running. LeapJS ignores this; LeapInput uses it to tell "no tracking service" from "no device". { event: { type: 'deviceEvent', state: { attached, streaming, id, type: 'Peripheral', service } } }; id is 'none' without a device.

LeapJS（通訊協定 5 以上）會把它轉成 deviceAttached、deviceStreaming 和 streamingStarted。橋接程式在連線時，以及每次狀態改變時都會送一則。LeapInput 把它對應成自己的狀態：沒有服務是 'no-service'，有服務沒裝置是 'no-device'，裝置在串流就是 'tracking'。 device 裝置 id，沒有裝置就是 null。 service 追蹤服務有沒有在跑。LeapJS 會忽略它。LeapInput 用它區分「沒有追蹤服務」和「沒有裝置」。 { event: { type: 'deviceEvent', state: { attached, streaming, id, type: 'Peripheral', service } } }，沒有裝置時 id 是 'none'。
hand.fingers[0] is the thumb and hand.fingers[4] the pinky, so FINGERS[i] names hand.fingers[i]. The fingertip signals are leap/hand///x|y|z with these names, for example leap/hand/right/index/y.
hand.fingers[0] 是拇指，hand.fingers[4] 是小指，所以 FINGERS[i] 就是 hand.fingers[i] 的名字。指尖訊號是 leap/hand///x|y|z，用的就是這些名字，例如 leap/hand/right/index/y。

A flat hand, palm down, fingers away from you, is { pitch: 0, yaw: 0, roll: 0 }. The three angles are the leap/hand//pitch|yaw|roll signals, which LeapInput computes with this function from each hand. When the fingers point straight up there is no yaw or roll to measure, and the function answers π (3.14) for them. Expect that at the top of a gesture, and do not map those two signals when the hand is vertical. direction The direction the fingers point, [x, y, z] (a unit vector). normal The palm normal [x, y, z], pointing out of the palm (down when the palm faces the sensor). { pitch, yaw, roll }, each −π..π: pitch is the fingers tipping up, yaw turning toward +x (the right), roll the palm turning over.

手平放、掌心朝下、手指朝向遠離你的方向，就是 { pitch: 0, yaw: 0, roll: 0 }。這三個角度就是 leap/hand//pitch|yaw|roll 這幾個訊號，LeapInput 對每隻手都是用這個函式算出來的。 手指正對著天花板的時候，沒有 yaw 或 roll 可量，函式會回答 π（3.14）。手勢做到最高的時候會遇到，手垂直時請不要去映射那兩個訊號。 direction 手指指的方向 [x, y, z]（單位向量）。 normal 掌心法線 [x, y, z]，從手掌往外指（掌心朝向感測器時是向下）。 { pitch, yaw, roll }，各自在 −π..π：pitch 是手指往上翹，yaw 是轉向 +x（右邊），roll 是手掌翻轉。

It only lists the pairs; you choose how to draw them. LeapInput.skeleton() calls it for you. Use it directly when you draw with p5, three.js or your own projection. hand A hand from handsOf() or leap.hands. An array of [pointA, pointB] pairs, each point [x, y, z] in millimetres. A hand with five 5-joint fingers, a wrist and an elbow gives 25.
它只列出成對的點，怎麼畫由你決定。LeapInput.skeleton() 會替你呼叫它。用 p5、three.js 或自己的投影來畫的時候，就直接用它。 hand 來自 handsOf() 或 leap.hands 的一隻手。 [pointA, pointB] 成對的陣列，每個點是 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐。一隻有五根各 5 個關節的手指、手腕和手肘的手，會得到 25 條。

A pinch strength hovers around any single threshold while the fingers are "almost touching", and one threshold then fires start, end, start, end sixty times a second. So every gesture is a trigger with two thresholds: it starts above on and only ends below off. The defaults are a pinch starting above 0.86 and ending below 0.5, a both-hands pinch entering when both hands are above 0.8 and leaving when either drops below 0.5, and a grab (fist) above 0.8 and below 0.5. A hand that disappears ends all of its gestures. LeapInput already runs one (leap.gestures) and turns its events into the leap/…/pinch-start pulses. Use HandGestures on its own when you have hands from somewhere else. thresholds Overrides for the defaults in THRESHOLDS: { pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }. Keys you leave out keep their defaults.

手指「快要碰到」的時候，捏合力度會在任何單一門檻附近晃來晃去，只有一個門檻的話，就會每秒六十次地開始、結束、開始、結束。所以每個手勢都有兩個門檻：高過 on 才開始，低於 off 才結束。預設值是：捏合高於 0.86 開始、低於 0.5 結束。雙手捏合在兩隻手都高於 0.8 時進入，任何一隻低於 0.5 就離開。握拳高於 0.8 開始、低於 0.5 結束。手消失的時候，它所有的手勢都會結束。 LeapInput 已經內建一個（leap.gestures），並把它的事件變成 leap/…/pinch-start 這些脈衝。你的手資料如果是從別的地方來，才需要單獨使用 HandGestures。 thresholds 覆寫 THRESHOLDS 的預設值：{ pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }。沒寫的鍵維持預設。

This is the hand shape worlds draw from (leap.hands). A raw frame carries the fingers inline; a v6 frame carries them as pointables joined to their hand by handId, and handsOf() does that join. Both give the same hand, so code written against leap.hands does not care which URL the bridge was reached on. msg A parsed message: a raw frame (t: 'f') or a v6 frame (with hands and pointables). The hands, each { id, side: 'left' | 'right', confidence, pinch, grab, palm, velocity, normal, direction, width, fingers, extended, elbow, wrist, timeVisible }. Positions are in millimetres; fingers is 5 arrays of joints (the last is the tip), extended 5 booleans.

這就是世界用來畫手的形狀（leap.hands）。原始影格把手指放在手的裡面。v6 影格把手指放成 pointables，用 handId 接到它們的手，handsOf() 負責做這個合併。兩者給出同一隻手，所以針對 leap.hands 寫的程式不在乎橋接程式是從哪個網址連的。 msg 一則解析好的訊息：原始影格（t: 'f'）或 v6 影格（有 hands 和 pointables）。 手的陣列，每隻是 { id, side: 'left' | 'right', confidence, pinch, grab, palm, velocity, normal, direction, width, fingers, extended, elbow, wrist, timeVisible }。位置單位是公釐。fingers 是 5 個關節陣列（最後一個是指尖），extended 是 5 個布林值。

The gap between on and off is what stops a value that hovers near one threshold from flickering. Each call to update() returns 'start' (it just became active), 'end' (it just stopped) or null (nothing changed). A missing or NaN value while active counts as an end, so a lost sensor lets go. active tells you whether it is on now. on The level the value must rise above to start. off The level the value must fall below to end. It must be lower than on, or the constructor throws "Hysteresis: off must be below on".

on 和 off 之間的空隙，就是讓在某個門檻附近徘徊的數值不會閃爍的原因。每次呼叫 update() 會回傳 'start'（剛變成啟動）、'end'（剛停止）或 null（沒有變化）。啟動中遇到缺值或 NaN 會當作結束，所以感測器掉了就會放開。active 告訴你它現在是不是開著。 on 數值要高過它才會開始。 off 數值要低於它才會結束。必須比 on 低，否則建構函式會丟出 "Hysteresis: off must be below on"。

A frozen object: the centre sits 200 mm above the sensor, and the box measures 235.247 mm along x, 235.247 mm along y and 147.751 mm along z (the sensor's own axes: x across, y up, z toward the player). normalizePoint() maps it to 0..1, and the console panel draws it as an outline so you can see when a hand leaves it. Pass your own box to new LeapInput({ box }) to change where 0 and 1 are.
一個凍結的物件：中心在感測器上方 200 公釐，三個軸的尺寸是感測器自己的座標軸：x 是 235 公釐、y 是 235 公釐、z 是 148 公釐。normalizePoint() 把它對應到 0..1，主控台面板把它畫成外框，這樣你就看得到手什麼時候離開。要改 0 和 1 在哪裡，就傳自己的盒子給 new LeapInput({ box })。

Browsers cannot talk to the Leap Motion sensor directly, so a small program on the same machine, the bridge (startBridge(), ws://127.0.0.1:6437), reads it and serves the hands over a WebSocket. LeapInput connects to that bridge and does one job: it turns hands into normalised signals and never touches params or worlds. In a show, createShow({ modules: { leap: true } }) builds one and returns it as show.leap; the console's L1 panel shows which link is missing. It publishes, for each side (left, right): leap/hand//present (0 or 1), x, y, z (the palm in the interaction box, 0..1, y up, z toward the player), pinch and grab (0..1), roll, pitch, yaw (−π..π radians), speed (0..1, 1 = 1 m/s), and /x|y|z for the five fingertips. Shared: leap/status (0 no bridge, 1 bridge but no tracking service, 2 service but no device, 3 tracking), leap/hands (0..2) and leap/both/distance (palm to palm, 1 = 40 cm). The full list with its ranges is what leapSignals() returns. Gestures are pulses with a payload { side, x, y, z, strength }: leap/hand//pinch-start|pinch-end and grab-start|grab-end, and leap/both/pinch-start|pinch-end (payload { x, y, z, distance } at the midpoint). They use hysteresis, so a pinch hovering near the threshold fires once and not sixty times a second (see HandGestures). A hand that leaves the view lets go: its present, pinch, grab and speed go to 0 and its gestures end. For continuous control, map a signal to a param ({ source: 'leap/hand/right/y', target: 'energy' }) so…

瀏覽器沒辦法直接跟 Leap Motion 感測器溝通，所以同一台機器上有個小程式，也就是橋接程式（startBridge()，ws://127.0.0.1:6437），負責讀取它，再用 WebSocket 把手送出來。LeapInput 連到那個橋接程式，只做一件事：把手變成正規化的訊號，絕不碰參數或世界。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { leap: true } }) 會建好一個，用 show.leap 回傳。主控台的 L1 面板會告訴你哪一段連線不通。 每一邊（left、right）它會發布：leap/hand//present（0 或 1）、x、y、z（掌心在互動範圍盒裡的位置，0..1，y 向上，z 朝向玩家）、pinch 和 grab（0..1）、roll、pitch、yaw（−π..π 弧度）、speed（0..1，1 = 每秒 1 公尺），還有五個指尖的 /x|y|z。共用的有：leap/status（0 沒有橋接、1 有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、2 服務在但沒有裝置、3 追蹤中）、leap/hands（0..2）和 leap/both/distance（兩掌之間的距離，1 = 40 公分）。完整的清單和範圍就是 leapSignals() 的回傳值。 手勢是帶有 { side, x, y, z, strength } 的脈衝：leap/hand//pinch-start|pinch-end 和 grab-start|grab-end，以及 leap/both/pinch-start|pinch-end（內容是中點的 { x, y, z, distance }）。它們有遲滯，所以在門檻附近徘徊的捏合只會觸發一次，不會一秒鐘觸發六十次（見 HandGestures）。手離開畫面就會放開：它的 present、pinch、grab 和 speed 歸零，手勢也跟著結束。 連續控制請把訊號映射到參數（{ source: 'leap/hand/right/y', target: 'energy' }），這樣時間軸、旋鈕和手就可以互換。leap.hands（以公釐計的關節）只用來把手本身畫出來。 要接真的手：橋接程式必須在跑（node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs，或加 --mock 得到會動的假手），而且你要呼叫 connect()。第一個影格到達之前不會發布任何東西。沒有感測器也沒有橋接程式：用 ingest() 餵手給它，或呼叫 simulate() 把滑鼠變成手。 可以讀的欄位：status（'idle'、'connecting'、'bridge'、'no-service'、'no-device'、'tracking'、'simulated'、'closed'）、hands（陣列，每隻手有 id、side、palm、fingers（5 × 5 個關節）、pinch、grab、velocity、normal、direction ……，單位是公釐）、frame（最近收到的原始訊息）、frames、fps、device、serviceVersion、gestures 和 box。 模擬器在跑的時候，手由它掌管：橋接程式來的真實影格會被忽略，橋接程式的狀態會被記住，等模擬器停止再恢復。 訊號是正規化的（y = 1 代表向上）。leap.hands 和 LeapJS 的影格則保留感測器自己的公釐單位，+z 朝向玩家。 橋接程式怎麼溝通、各種格式和疑難排解表，都在套件的…

new LeapInput({ signals }) already declares all of these, so you rarely call this yourself. It is useful when you want the list: to build a signal picker, to check that a route's source exists, or to declare the signals before the sensor is connected. The names it returns are the vocabulary of the Signals reference for Leap. fingers Include the fingertip signals. false leaves out the 30 of them. The pairs [name, meta]: 63 with fingers, 33 without. Each meta has source: 'leap', and min and max (the roll, pitch and yaw ones in radians, −π..π) or kind: 'pulse'.

new LeapInput({ signals }) 已經把這些全部宣告好了，所以很少需要自己呼叫。想要這份清單的時候它就很有用：做訊號選單、檢查某條路由的來源存不存在、或在感測器還沒接上之前先宣告訊號。它回傳的名稱就是訊號參考裡 Leap 的那一批詞彙。 fingers 要不要包含指尖訊號。false 會少掉那 30 個。 [name, meta] 的成對清單：有指尖是 63 個，沒有是 33 個。每個 meta 都有 source: 'leap'，以及 min 和 max（roll、pitch、yaw 是弧度，−π..π），脈衝則是 kind: 'pulse'。

This is the bridge's --mock stream and the way to try Leap code without a sensor. The right hand pinches for about a second out of every 3, the left hand pinches once every 12 seconds, and at those moments (for example second 8) both are pinched, so the both-hands pinch fires too. The left fist comes and goes slowly. The output goes through exactly the same conversion and publishing as a real Leap Motion Controller. t Time in seconds. The result depends only on t, so it is the same every time. id The frame number written into the frame. hands How many hands: 2 (right and left), 1 (the right only) or 0. A frame in the raw line format: { t: 'f', id, fps: 60, hands: [hand, …] }, the right hand (side: 'R') first. Feed it to LeapInput.ingest() or handsOf().

這就是橋接程式 --mock 模式送出的串流，也是沒有感測器時試 Leap 程式的辦法。右手每 3 秒有大約 1 秒在捏合，左手每 12 秒捏合一次，兩者重疊的時刻（例如第 8 秒），兩隻手同時捏合，所以雙手捏合也會觸發。左手的拳頭則慢慢地出現又消失。輸出走的轉換與發布路徑，跟真正的 Leap Motion Controller 完全一樣。 t 時間，單位是秒。結果只跟 t 有關，所以每次都一樣。 id 寫進影格裡的影格編號。 hands 手的數量：2（右手和左手）、1（只有右手）或 0。 原始行格式的影格：{ t: 'f', id, fps: 60, hands: [hand, …] }，右手（side: 'R'）在前面。可以餵給 LeapInput.ingest() 或 handsOf()。

It places a plausible hand in space: palm, knuckles, fingers curled by grab, thumb and index meeting as pinch goes to 1, wrist and elbow. LeapInput.simulate() builds its hands from the mouse with it, and mockFrame() with the animated ones. Use it to put a hand exactly where a test needs it. id The hand's id. side 'R' for a right hand, 'L' for a left. palm The palm position [x, y, z] in millimetres (+x right, +y up, +z toward the player). pinch Thumb to index, 0..1. At 1 the two fingertips meet. grab How closed the fist is, 0..1. roll Radians; positive rolls toward the thumb side. yaw Radians; positive turns the fingers toward +x. pitch Radians; positive tips the fingers up. vel Palm velocity in millimetres per second. conf Tracking confidence, 0..1. width Palm width in millimetres. A hand in the raw line format: { id, side, conf, pinch, grab, palm, vel, n, dir, w, f, ext, arm }, where f is 5 fingers × 5 joints (thumb to pinky; the last joint of each is the tip). Wrap hands in { t: 'f', id, fps, hands: [...] } to make a frame.

它在空間裡放一隻合理的手：掌心、指節、隨 grab 彎起來的手指、pinch 到 1 時碰在一起的拇指和食指、手腕和手肘。LeapInput.simulate() 用它把滑鼠變成手，mockFrame() 用它做出會動的手。需要把手剛好放在某個位置來測試時，就用它。 id 這隻手的 id。 side 右手用 'R'，左手用 'L'。 palm 掌心位置 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐（+x 向右、+y 向上、+z 朝向玩家）。 pinch 拇指到食指，0..1。到 1 的時候兩個指尖碰在一起。 grab 拳頭握得多緊，0..1。 roll 弧度，正值是往拇指那一側翻。 yaw 弧度，正值是讓手指轉向 +x。 pitch 弧度，正值是讓手指往上翹。 vel 掌心速度，單位是公釐每秒。 conf 追蹤的信心程度，0..1。 width 手掌寬度，單位是公釐。 原始行格式的手：{ id, side, conf, pinch, grab, palm, vel, n, dir, w, f, ext, arm }，其中 f 是 5 根手指 × 5 個關節（從拇指到小指，每根的最後一個關節是指尖）。把手包進 { t: 'f', id, fps, hands: [...] } 就成了一個影格。

One status line says which link is the broken one, in order: no bridge, bridge but no tracking service, service but no device, tracking (with the number of hands and the frame rate). Under it, a small front view draws the interaction box (a hand outside it is visibly outside, its signals sitting clamped at the edge) and the hand skeletons. It redraws only on frames and status changes, so nothing runs while the sensor is idle. In a show you do not call it: the console's L1 · Input panel mounts it when you declare modules: { leap: true }. el Where to put the panel. leap The LeapInput to show. width The width of the drawing in CSS pixels; the height follows (about 0.62 of the width). simulate Show the "simulate" button (mouse and touch become hands). simTarget What the simulator listens on. Defaults to leap.simTarget, then the window. { el, render(), destroy() }: the panel's root element, a function that redraws it, and one that removes it and unsubscribes.

一行狀態列會告訴你是哪一段連線壞了，依序是：沒有橋接、有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、有服務但沒有裝置、追蹤中（附上手的數量和影格率）。下面是個小小的正視圖，畫出互動範圍盒（手在盒子外面一眼就看得出來，它的訊號會被夾在邊緣）和手的骨架。它只在有影格或狀態改變時重畫，感測器閒置時什麼都不會跑。 在演出裡不用自己呼叫：宣告 modules: { leap: true } 之後，主控台的 L1 · Input 面板會掛上它。 el 面板要放在哪個元素裡。 leap 要顯示的 LeapInput。 width 繪圖區的寬度（CSS 像素），高度跟著決定（約為寬度的 0.62 倍）。 simulate 要不要顯示「simulate」按鈕（滑鼠和觸控變成手）。 simTarget 模擬器監聽哪個目標。預設是 leap.simTarget，再不然是 window。 { el, render(), destroy() }：面板的根元素、重畫它的函式，以及移除它並取消訂閱的函式。

The classic box is centred 200 mm above the sensor and about 235 × 235 × 148 mm (INTERACTION_BOX). A palm at the centre reads [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]; a palm far outside it reads 0 or 1 on that axis, which is why the signals "sit clamped at the edge" when a hand leaves the box. Pass clamp = false when you want to know how far outside it is. p The point [x, y, z] in millimetres. box The box { center, size } in millimetres. clamp Hold each value to 0..1. false lets a point outside the box go beyond. [x, y, z], each (p − center) / size + 0.5: 0.5 is the centre of the box, x grows to the right, y upward, z toward the player.

經典的盒子中心在感測器上方 200 公釐，大小約 235 × 235 × 148 公釐（INTERACTION_BOX）。掌心在中心讀到 [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]，掌心遠在盒子外面，那個軸就讀到 0 或 1，這就是手離開盒子時訊號會「夾在邊緣」的原因。想知道超出多遠，就傳 clamp = false。 p 點 [x, y, z]，單位是公釐。 box 範圍盒 { center, size }，單位是公釐。 clamp 把每個值限制在 0..1。false 的話，盒子外面的點可以超出範圍。 [x, y, z]，每個都是 (p − center) / size + 0.5：0.5 是盒子的中心，x 往右增加、y 往上增加、z 朝向玩家。

Like boneBasis(), it exists so that the LeapJS frames V6Converter writes have a r that hand.rotationAngle() can use. Worlds that draw hands read leap.hands and handAngles() instead. direction The direction the fingers point. normal The palm normal. left true for a left hand: x is negated. Three rows [x, y, z] (x sideways, y the back of the hand, z toward the wrist), rounded to 3 decimals.

和 boneBasis() 一樣，它的存在是為了讓 V6Converter 寫出的 LeapJS 影格有 hand.rotationAngle() 能用的 r。要畫手的世界讀的是 leap.hands 和 handAngles()。 direction 手指指的方向。 normal 掌心法線。 left 左手傳 true：x 會反向。 三列 [x, y, z]（x 是橫向、y 是手背、z 朝向手腕），四捨五入到小數三位。
v6Header() never reports more than this, and the bridge answers /v7.json as version 6. It is the default of the version argument there.
v6Header() 不會回報比這更高的版本，橋接程式也把 /v7.json 當成版本 6 回應。它是那裡 version 參數的預設值。

The bridge uses it to decide whether a WebSocket upgrade is a LeapJS client at all: /v6.json yes, /raw is handled separately, anything else is refused with a 404. pathname The URL path, such as '/v6.json'. The number in /v.json, or null. It does not clip to 6: /v7.json gives 7 (the bridge then answers it as version 6).
橋接程式用它判斷一個 WebSocket 升級請求是不是 LeapJS 的用戶端：/v6.json 是，/raw 另外處理，其他的一律回 404 拒絕。 pathname 網址的路徑，例如 '/v6.json'。 /v.json 裡的數字，或 null。它不會截到 6：/v7.json 得到 7（橋接程式再以版本 6 回應）。

Handy for tests and for looking at what a legacy sketch would receive. For a stream, keep one V6Converter instead, so that timeVisible and tipVelocity can accumulate. raw A raw frame { t: 'f', id, fps, hands }. tUs The time in microseconds. Defaults to now. opts Options for the V6Converter: { box, smoothing }. The v6 frame. Every field the LeapJS Frame, Hand, Pointable, Finger and Bone constructors read is there.

用在測試，以及查看舊版草圖會收到什麼的時候很方便。處理一條串流的話，請改為保留一個 V6Converter，timeVisible 和 tipVelocity 才能累積。 raw 原始影格 { t: 'f', id, fps, hands }。 tUs 時間，單位是微秒。預設是現在。 opts 給 V6Converter 的選項：{ box, smoothing }。 v6 影格。LeapJS 的 Frame、Hand、Pointable、Finger 和 Bone 建構函式會讀的每個欄位都有。

startBridge({ port: 7457 }) throws "port 7457 belongs to The Last Input" immediately, so the bridge can never take the port the monitor listens on (node packages/monitor/server.js). The out-bridge refuses the same one.
startBridge({ port: 7457 }) 會立刻丟出 "port 7457 belongs to The Last Input"，所以橋接程式絕不會占走後台監看監聽的連接埠（node packages/monitor/server.js）。輸出橋接也一樣拒絕這一個。

This is what node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs runs (add --mock for made-up hands, --port, --hz, --bin, --quiet). It serves ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json (the LeapJS protocol, which every 2014 to 2021 browser sketch speaks), ws://…/raw (the raw lines), the same lines as server-sent events on GET /raw and /hands, and GET /health (source, service, device, fps, hands, clients). Any page origin may read it, as the original Leap service allowed. Call it from your own Node program when you want the bridge inside it, for example in a test. startBridge() throws at once for port 7457 (it belongs to The Last Input and the monitor) and for a non-loopback host; a port already in use rejects the returned promise with a message that suggests curl http://127.0.0.1:6437/health. Node 22 or later, and for real hands the Ultraleap Hand Tracking service plus Xcode's clang to build the reader on first start. With mock: true neither is needed. port The port to listen on, DEFAULT_PORT unless you say otherwise. 0 picks any free one. The ports in RESERVED_PORTS (7457) are refused. host The address to bind. Only loopback (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost) is allowed: hand data never leaves the machine. mock true serves two animated made-up hands (mockFrame()) instead of reading a sensor. hz The most frames per second sent to each client (held to 1..120). A slow client skips frames; it never queues them. bin The path to the leap-stream reader program. By default the bridge compiles its C reader on…

node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs 執行的就是它（加 --mock 得到假手，另有 --port、--hz、--bin、--quiet）。它提供 ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json（LeapJS 通訊協定，2014 到 2021 年所有的瀏覽器草圖講的都是它）、ws://…/raw（原始行）、GET /raw 和 /hands 上以 server-sent events 送的同樣內容，以及 GET /health（來源、服務、裝置、fps、手、用戶端）。任何頁面來源都可以讀取，跟原本的 Leap 服務一樣。 想把橋接程式放進你自己的 Node 程式裡（例如測試）時，就自己呼叫它。連接埠是 7457（那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的）或 host 不是 loopback，startBridge() 會立刻丟出錯誤。連接埠已被占用，回傳的 promise 會被拒絕，訊息會建議你執行 curl http://127.0.0.1:6437/health。 Node 22 以上，要接真的手，還需要 Ultraleap Hand Tracking 服務，以及第一次啟動時用來編譯讀取程式的 Xcode clang。mock: true 的話兩者都不需要。 port 要監聽的連接埠，沒特別指定就是 DEFAULT_PORT。0 表示隨便挑一個空的。RESERVED_PORTS 裡的連接埠（7457）會被拒絕。 host 要綁定的位址。只允許 loopback（127.0.0.1、::1、localhost）：手的資料絕不會離開這台機器。 mock true 的話，送出兩隻會動的假手（mockFrame()），不讀感測器。 hz 每個用戶端每秒最多收到幾個影格（限制在 1..120）。慢的用戶端會跳過影格，不會排隊。 bin leap-stream 讀取程式的路徑。預設是橋接程式第一次啟動時編譯它的 C 讀取程式（需要 Xcode 命令列工具）並快取起來。 log 每一件值得知道的事（用戶端進出、狀態改變）都會以一行文字呼叫它。 開始監聽之後才完成，結果是 { port, state, health(), close() }：實際的連接埠（port: 0 時有用）、即時狀態、回傳 /health 物件的函式，以及停止一切並回傳 Promise 的函式。

A frozen object { off: 0, bridge: 1, service: 2, tracking: 3 }: 0 no bridge, 1 the bridge is there but the tracking service is not, 2 the service is there but no device, 3 tracking. Use it to read the signal without magic numbers: signals.get('leap/status') === STATUS.tracking. Note it is the number published as leap/status; leap.status is a different thing, a string ('tracking', 'no-device' …), and the simulator counts as 3. The code in LeapInput writes the numbers itself and does not read this object, so STATUS is a convenience for your own code. The strings map as: tracking and simulated to 3, no-device to 2, bridge and no-service to 1, the rest to 0.

一個凍結的物件 { off: 0, bridge: 1, service: 2, tracking: 3 }：0 沒有橋接、1 有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、2 有服務但沒有裝置、3 追蹤中。讀訊號時可以不用神祕數字：signals.get('leap/status') === STATUS.tracking。注意，發布成 leap/status 的是這個數字。leap.status 是另一回事，它是字串（'tracking'、'no-device' ……），而模擬器算 3。 LeapInput 裡的程式是自己寫入數字，並不讀這個物件，所以 STATUS 只是方便你自己的程式用。字串的對應是：tracking 和 simulated 是 3，no-device 是 2，bridge 和 no-service 是 1，其餘是 0。

A frozen object { pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }. The numbers come from The Last Input, tuned on a Leap Motion Controller 2, so one bridge means one feel. Change them per input with new LeapInput({ thresholds: { pinch: { on: 0.9, off: 0.6 } } }) or new HandGestures(...); you cannot change this object itself.

一個凍結的物件 { pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }。數字來自 The Last Input，在 Leap Motion Controller 2 上調過，這樣一個橋接程式就是一種手感。要改的話，在每個輸入上設定：new LeapInput({ thresholds: { pinch: { on: 0.9, off: 0.6 } } }) 或 new HandGestures(...)，這個物件本身改不了。

Every browser sketch written for the old Leap service (LeapJS, 2014 to 2021) speaks the v6 protocol, so the bridge serves it on /v6.json. This class does the conversion: one converter per stream. It is stateful where the protocol is: a hand's timeVisible grows while it stays in view and starts over when it leaves, stabilized… positions are a light low-pass, and tipVelocity is a finite difference between two frames. LeapC gives joints, not bone rotations, so the bone bases are rebuilt from the joints and the palm normal (boneBasis()). Gestures are not synthesised: gestures is always []. box The interaction box written into every frame's interactionBox. smoothing 0..1: how strongly stabilizedPalmPosition and stabilizedTipPosition lag behind (0 follows exactly, close to 1 barely moves).

所有為舊版 Leap 服務寫的瀏覽器草圖（LeapJS，2014 到 2021 年）講的都是 v6 通訊協定，所以橋接程式在 /v6.json 提供這個格式。這個類別負責轉換：一條串流用一個轉換器。它在通訊協定要求有狀態的地方才有狀態：手在畫面裡時 timeVisible 會增加，離開再回來就重新開始，stabilized… 位置是輕微的低通濾波，tipVelocity 是兩個影格之間的差分。 LeapC 給的是關節，不是骨頭的旋轉，所以骨頭的基底是從關節和掌心法線重建的（boneBasis()）。手勢不會被合成：gestures 永遠是 []。 box 寫進每個影格 interactionBox 的互動範圍盒。 smoothing 0..1：stabilizedPalmPosition 和 stabilizedTipPosition 落後的程度（0 完全跟隨，接近 1 幾乎不動）。

The bridge sends this (plus bridge: 'open-audiovisual') as soon as a client connects to /v6.json, and LeapInput turns it into the status 'bridge'. Ask for 7 and you get 6. serviceVersion The tracking service version to report, such as '5.20.0'. version The protocol version the client asked for. Held to 1..6. { serviceVersion: String, version: Number }.

用戶端一連到 /v6.json，橋接程式就會送出這則訊息（外加 bridge: 'open-audiovisual'），LeapInput 收到後會把狀態變成 'bridge'。要求 7 會得到 6。 serviceVersion 要回報的追蹤服務版本，例如 '5.20.0'。 version 用戶端要求的通訊協定版本。限制在 1..6。 物件 { serviceVersion: String, version: Number }。

The hand tracker: up to two hands, 21 landmarks each, run on the device with MediaPipe Tasks Vision (1.2.3). It downloads nothing until enable(), and no video leaves the machine. In a show, createShow({ modules: { hands: true } }) builds one (show.hands) and the L1 panel gets a 🖐 hands button. Per side (left, right) under hand//: present (0 or 1), x and y (the palm; y flipped so 1 is raised), tip/x and tip/y (the index fingertip), thumb/index, thumb/middle, thumb/ring and thumb/pinky (thumb tip to each fingertip, 0 = touching, 1 = wide open), openness (0 = fist, 1 = all fingers out), angle (wrist to the base of the middle finger: 0.5 = fingers up, 0.75 = pointing to the viewer's right, 0.25 = left), speed (palm speed, 1 = 3 frame heights a second), pinched (0 or 1), gesture (0 none, 1 fist, 2 open, 3 point, 4 thumb-up, 5 thumb-down, 6 victory, 7 iloveyou) and gesture/ (0 or 1 for each of those names). Pulses: hand//pinch-start and pinch-end with { side, x, y, distance } at the fingertip, and hand//gesture/-start with { side, x, y, gesture, score }. Both hands: hand/both/present, hand/both/distance (palm centre to palm centre), hand/both/x and y (the midpoint) and hand/both/angle (the line from the left palm to the right one, 0.5 = level). Every distance is divided by the size of the hand (wrist to the base of the middle finger) and measured with x multiplied by the frame's aspect ratio, so neither moving toward the camera nor turning the hand sideways changes a pinch. A…

手部追蹤器：最多兩隻手，每隻 21 個關節點，在裝置上用 MediaPipe Tasks Vision（1.2.3）執行。在 enable() 之前不會下載任何東西，影像也不會離開這台機器。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { hands: true } }) 會建好一個（show.hands），L1 面板會多出一個 🖐 hands 按鈕。 每一側（left、right）在 hand// 底下：present（0 或 1）、x 和 y（手掌，y 翻轉過，1 是舉高）、tip/x 和 tip/y（食指指尖）、thumb/index、thumb/middle、thumb/ring、thumb/pinky（拇指指尖到各指尖，0 = 碰在一起，1 = 張到最開）、openness（0 = 握拳，1 = 手指全開）、angle（手腕到中指根部：0.5 = 手指朝上，0.75 = 指向觀看者的右邊，0.25 = 左邊）、speed（手掌速度，每秒 3 個畫面高 = 1）、pinched（0 或 1）、gesture（0 沒有、1 握拳、2 張開、3 指上、4 讚、5 倒讚、6 YA、7 I love you），以及 gesture/（上面每個名稱各一個 0 或 1）。脈衝：hand//pinch-start 和 pinch-end，帶著指尖的 { side, x, y, distance }，還有 hand//gesture/-start，帶著 { side, x, y, gesture, score }。兩隻手：hand/both/present、hand/both/distance（兩個手掌中心的距離）、hand/both/x 和 y（中點）、hand/both/angle（左手掌到右手掌的連線，0.5 = 水平）。 每個距離都除以手的大小（手腕到中指根部），而且 x 乘上畫面的長寬比，所以手往鏡頭靠近、手轉向側面，捏合的值都不會變。捏一下要其他三指張開才算，所以握拳不會被當成捏。每個狀態（捏住、一個手勢）都有兩個門檻，而且要維持 80 毫秒才算數，所以它開始一次、結束一次，不會一直閃。手離開畫面，它的捏合和手勢馬上結束。 連續的訊號接到參數，脈衝接到脈衝參數：{ source: 'hand/right/openness', target: 'bloom', smooth: 0.12 }、{ source: 'hand/right/gesture/victory-start', target: 'nextScene' }。距離要「捏緊時變大」就用 invert。最早的三個量 hand//pinch/index、pinch/middle 和 spread 完全維持原樣（除以 2.2 個手的大小、沒有修正長寬比，張開的手大約是 0.5），用它們做的演出感覺不會變。新作品請用 thumb/。 要呼叫 await hands.enable()：它會從 jsDelivr 載入 MediaPipe 函式庫、從 Google 的模型儲存空間載入手勢模型（gestures: false 時是手的模型，所以需要網路）、向瀏覽器要鏡頭（https 或 localhost，使用者也要允許），然後啟動迴圈。在那之前，訊號都停在起始值。feed() 不需要這些。 可以讀的欄位：hands（[{ handed: 'left' | 'right', lm }]，lm 是 21 個關節點 { x, y, z }，在鏡頭影像裡，y…

This is the body tracker: one person, 33 landmarks (the BlazePose set), run by MediaPipe Tasks Vision on the device. No video leaves the machine, and nothing is downloaded until you call enable(). For fine finger control use HandTracker instead. In a show, createShow({ modules: { pose: true } }) builds one and the console's L1 panel gets a 🕺 body button that calls enable(); it is show.pose. Signals, all normalised, with y flipped so that 1 means raised and 0 means the bottom of the frame (performance meaning beats pixel meaning): pose/present (0 or 1: someone is visible), pose/hand/left/x and /y, pose/hand/right/x and /y (wrist positions, 0..1), pose/hand/left/v and pose/hand/right/v (wrist speed, 0..1, clamped), pose/hands/spread (distance between the wrists, 0..1), pose/height (nose height, 0..1: crouching to standing) and pose/lean (shoulder-line tilt, −1..1). When nobody is in view only pose/present goes to 0; the others keep their last values. Map these to params ({ source: 'pose/hand/right/y', target: 'energy', smooth: 0.1 }) so a raised hand does what a knob would. The detection runs on every animation frame while running. Call await pose.enable(): it loads the MediaPipe library from jsDelivr and the model from Google's model storage (so it needs the network), asks the browser for the camera (the page needs https or localhost, and the user must allow it), and starts the loop. Until then every signal sits at its starting value. Fields to read: landmarks (the latest…

這是身體追蹤器：一個人、33 個關節點（BlazePose 那一套），在裝置上由 MediaPipe Tasks Vision 執行。影像不會離開這台機器，在你呼叫 enable() 之前也不會下載任何東西。要精細控制手指的話，改用 HandTracker。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { pose: true } }) 會建好一個，主控台的 L1 面板會多出一個 🕺 body 按鈕來呼叫 enable()，它就是 show.pose。 訊號全都是正規化的，y 翻轉過，所以 1 是舉高、0 是畫面底部（演出的意義比像素的意義重要）：pose/present（0 或 1：看得到人）、pose/hand/left/x 和 /y、pose/hand/right/x 和 /y（手腕位置，0..1）、pose/hand/left/v 和 pose/hand/right/v（手腕速度，0..1，超過會被夾住）、pose/hands/spread（兩個手腕的距離，0..1）、pose/height（鼻子的高度，0..1：蹲下到站直）和 pose/lean（肩線的傾斜，−1..1）。畫面裡沒人的時候，只有 pose/present 會變成 0，其他的維持最後的值。 把它們映射到參數（{ source: 'pose/hand/right/y', target: 'energy', smooth: 0.1 }），舉起的手就能做旋鈕做的事。偵測在 running 期間每個動畫畫面都會跑。 要呼叫 await pose.enable()：它會從 jsDelivr 載入 MediaPipe 函式庫、從 Google 的模型儲存空間載入模型（所以需要網路）、向瀏覽器要鏡頭（網頁要在 https 或 localhost 底下，使用者也要允許），然後啟動迴圈。在那之前，所有訊號都停在起始值。 可以讀的欄位：landmarks（最新的 33 個原始點 { x, y, z, visibility }，x、y 是鏡頭影像裡的 0..1，y 向下、沒有左右翻轉，看不到人就是 null）、running、mirror、video。 關節點編號（BlazePose）：鼻子 0、肩膀 11 和 12、手腕 15 和 16、髖部 23 和 24。 模型是 MediaPipe 的「lite」姿態偵測器，跑在 GPU 上，一次只追蹤一個姿態。畫面裡有兩個人的話，只會追蹤其中一個。 signals 要發布進去的 Signals 登錄表。沒有的話，追蹤器照樣會跑、也會更新 landmarks，只是不發布任何訊號。 mirror 把鏡頭當成鏡子：x 會左右翻轉，所以往觀看者的右邊移動，x 就變大。對表演者很自然。false 則保留鏡頭本身的左右。

This is not a music-theory library. It is a performance semantics layer: raw notes in, one analysed event per gesture out, with features that are made to drive a work. A single note is a seed, a chord a colony, a consonant chord a flourish, a dissonant one decay; rename them for your own piece. In a show, createShow({ modules: { chord: true } }) builds one ({ chord: { window: 120 } } tunes it) and connects it to midi/note/on and midi/note/off, so a MIDI keyboard, the on-screen piano and phones all feed it. Each closed gesture publishes chord/consonance (−1..1), chord/count (0..10), chord/root (the lowest note) and the pulse chord/event, whose payload is the whole analysis: { notes, count, root, vel, pcs, consonance, isConsonant, isDissonant, isTriad, thirdsFraction, dissonanceLevel, chordType }. chordType is one of single, major, minor, sus2, sus4, dim, aug, maj7, min7, dom7, halfdim7, maj9, min9, dom9, six, min6, cluster (a very dissonant pile) or chord (anything else). Inversions resolve to the root-position name. consonance is the average of an interval weight for every pair of notes (an octave or fifth is high, a semitone or tritone is negative). isConsonant is consonance > 0.25 and isDissonant is consonance < −0.15, both only for two notes or more. dissonanceLevel is 0 for none, 1 for mild (a storm warning: foreshadow it) and 2 for severe (three or more notes that are a true cluster: commit to the decay). isTriad is true for major, minor, sus2, sus4, dim and aug, and…

它管的是演出語意，不是樂理：原始的音進去，每個手勢出來一個分析過的事件，特徵都是為了驅動作品而設計的。單一個音是種子，和弦是一群生物，協和的和弦是繁盛，不協和的和弦是衰敗。你可以替自己的作品換掉這些名字。在演出裡，createShow({ modules: { chord: true } }) 會建好一個（{ chord: { window: 120 } } 可以調整）並接上 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off，所以 MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的鋼琴和手機都能餵它。 每個收尾的手勢會發布 chord/consonance（−1..1）、chord/count（0..10）、chord/root（最低音）和脈衝 chord/event，脈衝的內容就是整份分析：{ notes, count, root, vel, pcs, consonance, isConsonant, isDissonant, isTriad, thirdsFraction, dissonanceLevel, chordType }。chordType 是 single、major、minor、sus2、sus4、dim、aug、maj7、min7、dom7、halfdim7、maj9、min9、dom9、six、min6、cluster（非常不協和的一堆音）或 chord（其他任何和弦）之一。轉位會被還原成原位和弦的名稱。 consonance 是每一對音的音程權重的平均（八度或五度很高，半音或三全音是負的）。isConsonant 是 consonance > 0.25，isDissonant 是 consonance < −0.15，都只在兩個音以上才成立。dissonanceLevel 0 是沒有，1 是輕微（風暴警報：預告它），2 是嚴重（三個音以上的真正音叢：直接進入衰敗）。isTriad 在 major、minor、sus2、sus4、dim、aug 時為真，thirdsFraction 是相鄰兩個音剛好相差 3 或 4 個半音的比例，這樣就分得出「真正疊起來的三度」和「幾個協和的音」。 用 noteOn(note, vel)（和 noteOff(note)）餵它，或讓 createShow 從 midi/note/on|off 餵。要等到最後一個 noteOn 之後 window 毫秒才會發布，所以結果是非同步的。analyze() 是例外：它立刻回傳，也不需要任何前置動作。 呼叫 analyze() 時音要由低到高：root 就是第一個音，偵測器會替你排序，但直接呼叫就不會。 像 [60, 62] 這樣的大二度，類型會是 cluster（沒有範本符合，而且協和度低於 −0.3），不過它的 dissonanceLevel 只有 1。要到 2 至少得有三個音。 手勢窗口不知道還按著的音：已經按著的一個音，不會跟你後來彈的兩個音湊成一個和弦。 window 最後一個 noteOn 之後等幾毫秒，就把這個手勢收尾並分析。彼此相隔不到這個時間按下的音，算同一個和弦。 onChord 每次一個手勢收尾，就以分析結果物件呼叫一次。 signals 要把 chord/ 發布進去的 Signals 登錄表。訊號在建立偵測器時就宣告好了。

A browser cannot send UDP, so OscOut posts batches of messages to a ~100-line Node program, packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js, which sends them on as OSC packets. Start it with node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js 7456 192.168.1.50 3456 (HTTP port, target host, UDP port; the defaults are 7456 127.0.0.1 3456). Then send(address, args) as often as you like and flush() once per frame: only the latest message per address survives a frame, because a position stream does not need its in-between values. Numbers go out as OSC floats (what Spat, Reaper and TouchDesigner expect), and anything else as a string. createShow() does not create an OscOut: make one, call enable(), flush it from onFrame, and if you like hand it to the worlds as show.stage.io.osc and to the Layers panel as show.app.osc (which then shows the OSC rate). The bridge must be running, and you must await osc.enable() first: it probes GET /health and answers false if nobody is there. Until it succeeds flush() just throws the queue away. On a public https page, Chrome asks permission before the page may reach 127.0.0.1. Fields and hooks: enabled, udp (the target the bridge reported), onStatus = (ok, info) => {} and onMsg = (address, args) => {} (high frequency: use sparingly). If the bridge disappears, the first failed flush calls onStatus(false, 'bridge lost'), and after more than 30 failed flushes in a row enabled turns false by itself, with no further message. Call enable() again to resume. The messages of a…
