瀏覽器沒辦法送 UDP，所以 OscOut 把一批一批的訊息用 POST 送給一支大約一百行的 Node 程式 packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js，由它再當成 OSC 封包送出去。用 node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js 7456 192.168.1.50 3456 啟動它（HTTP 連接埠、目標主機、UDP 連接埠，預設是 7456 127.0.0.1 3456）。然後想送多少次都可以 send(address, args)，每個畫面 flush() 一次：每個畫面裡，每個位址只有最後一則訊息會送出去，因為位置的串流不需要中間的值。 數字會當成 OSC 浮點數送出（Spat、Reaper 和 TouchDesigner 期待的格式），其他東西一律當成字串。createShow() 不會建立 OscOut：你自己建一個、呼叫 enable()，在 onFrame 裡 flush，想要的話再用 show.stage.io.osc 交給世界，用 show.app.osc 交給 Layers 面板（面板就會顯示 OSC 的訊息率）。 橋接程式必須在跑，而且你要先 await osc.enable()：它會探測 GET /health，沒有人在就回答 false。在成功之前，flush() 只會把佇列丟掉。在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 會在頁面連到 127.0.0.1 之前先詢問權限。 欄位與掛鉤：enabled、udp（橋接程式回報的目的地）、onStatus = (ok, info) => {} 和 onMsg = (address, args) => {}（頻率很高，請節制使用）。 橋接程式消失的話，第一次失敗的 flush 會呼叫 onStatus(false, 'bridge lost')，連續失敗超過 30 次之後，enabled 會自己變成 false，不再有任何訊息。想恢復就再呼叫一次 enable()。失敗那次 flush 的訊息會遺失。 每個數字都會當成 32 位元浮點數送出，整數也一樣（橋接程式檔案開頭的註解提到整數，但它的程式碼只會寫浮點數）。接收端如果需要整數，請在那邊轉換。 url OSC 橋接程式的位址（它的 HTTP 連接埠，不是 UDP 的目的地）。

The default of startBridge({ port }) and of --port; the environment variable OUT_BRIDGE_PORT changes it for the command line. It is the out-bridge's port: the Leap bridge has its own (DEFAULT_PORT of @openav/leap, 6437).
startBridge({ port }) 和 --port 的預設值。環境變數 OUT_BRIDGE_PORT 可以改命令列用的值。這是輸出橋接程式的連接埠：Leap 橋接程式有自己的（@openav/leap 的 DEFAULT_PORT，6437）。

It is the default of timeoutMs in the bridge config (the minimum allowed is 20). OutClient re-sends held values every third of whatever the bridge reports, so a still slider is not mistaken for a dead page. Lower it for hardware that must stop quickly, but keep it above the slowest frame your page may have.
這是橋接設定裡 timeoutMs 的預設值（允許的最小值是 20）。OutClient 每隔橋接程式回報的時間的三分之一就重送目前的值，所以停著不動的滑桿不會被誤認為當掉的頁面。需要硬體很快停下來的話可以調低它，但要比你的頁面可能出現的最慢畫面更長。

The match of a channel rule and the keys of safe in the bridge config are globs, and this is how both are read. Remember that also crosses slashes: light/ fits light/0/r, and alone fits every channel. glob The pattern. matches any run of characters, slashes included. Everything else, including ., ? and +, matches itself. An anchored expression: globToRegExp('light/') is /^light\/.$/.
橋接設定裡，頻道規則的 match 和 safe 的鍵都是萬用字元，兩者都是用它來解讀。請記得 也能跨過斜線：light/ 符合 light/0/r，只寫 就符合每一個頻道。 glob 樣式。 符合任何一串字元，包含斜線。其他一切，包括 .、? 和 +，都只符合它自己。 一個固定頭尾的正規表示式：globToRegExp('light/') 是 /^light\/.$/。

A thin helper around fs.readFileSync and JSON.parse. A missing file or invalid JSON throws one error that names the file (its text is written in Chinese in the code). The command line uses it for --config out.json; in your own program you may just as well pass an object to startBridge({ config }). file The path of the JSON file, such as out.json (copy packages/out/bridge/out.example.json to start). The parsed config, unchecked: startBridge() is what validates it.

包著 fs.readFileSync 和 JSON.parse 的薄薄一層。找不到檔案或 JSON 不合法，會丟出一個指出檔名的錯誤（訊息在程式碼裡是用中文寫的）。命令列的 --config out.json 就是用它。在你自己的程式裡，直接把物件傳給 startBridge({ config }) 也一樣。 file JSON 檔的路徑，例如 out.json（可以從複製 packages/out/bridge/out.example.json 開始）。 解析後的設定，沒有檢查：驗證它的是 startBridge()。

Port 6450 is the bridge's DEFAULT_PORT and /out is the only WebSocket path it serves. In the lab, ?out=ws://host:port/out points a page at another bridge, ?out=sim records values without one and ?out=0 turns it off.
6450 是橋接程式的 DEFAULT_PORT，/out 是它唯一提供的 WebSocket 路徑。在實驗室裡，?out=ws://host:port/out 可以讓頁面改連別的橋接程式，?out=sim 只記錄不連線，?out=0 則是關掉。

Hardware needs a number, and a page has a number: out.set('light/0/r', 0.8). The channel name is yours (a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /, up to 128 characters) and the bridge (startBridge()) decides from its config where that channel goes: a WLED strip, a serial motor board, an OSC address. Values are plain numbers; the convention is 0..1. Several set() calls on one channel inside one frame leave as one value, the last. In a lab work lab.out is this class. It keeps the connection alive on its own: it reconnects with a growing delay (250 ms doubling up to 5 s), resends everything it knows after a reconnect (a restarted bridge has forgotten it all), and while the socket is open it re-sends the held values every timeoutMs / 3 of the bridge's watchdog, so a slider that stands still is not mistaken for a frozen page. If the page really freezes, that heartbeat stops and the bridge puts the hardware on its safe values. Call connect() (the bridge must be running: node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json), or simulate() for no hardware at all. set() before the socket is open is not lost: it waits in last and goes out on open. Fields to read: status ('closed', 'connecting', 'open', 'sim'), last ({ channel: last value given to set() }, also in simulate mode), sent (values actually put on the wire: less than the number of set() calls because of coalescing), bridge (the bridge's last status message) and beatMs (how often the held values are re-sent while the socket is open: a third…

硬體需要的是數字，而頁面有數字：out.set('light/0/r', 0.8)。頻道名稱由你決定（a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /，最長 128 個字元），這個頻道要送去哪裡，由橋接程式（startBridge()）依它的設定決定：WLED 燈條、序列埠馬達板、OSC 位址。值就是普通的數字，慣例是 0..1。同一個畫面裡對同一個頻道呼叫好幾次 set()，只會送出最後一個值。在實驗室的作品裡，lab.out 就是這個類別。 它自己會維持連線：用愈來愈長的間隔重連（250 毫秒起，加倍到 5 秒），重連之後把它知道的值全部重送一遍（重新啟動的橋接程式什麼都忘了），而且在 socket 開著的時候，每隔橋接程式的看門狗時間的三分之一就重送一次目前的值，所以停著不動的滑桿不會被誤認為當掉的頁面。如果頁面真的凍結，這個心跳就會停，橋接程式就讓硬體回到安全值。 要呼叫 connect()（橋接程式必須在跑：node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json），或呼叫 simulate() 完全不接硬體。在 socket 開啟之前呼叫 set() 不會遺失：它會先放在 last，等開啟之後送出。 可以讀的欄位：status（'closed'、'connecting'、'open'、'sim'）、last（{ 頻道: 最後給 set() 的值 }，模擬模式下也有）、sent（真正送上線路的值：因為合併，會比 set() 呼叫次數少），bridge（橋接程式最近的狀態訊息），以及 beatMs（socket 開著時多久重送一次保持的值：收到橋接程式的狀態之後是它 timeoutMs 的三分之一，之前是 500 的三分之一）。 在線路上，單一個值是 { "type": "set", "ch", "v" }，多個值是 { "type": "batch", "items": [{ "ch", "v" }, …] }，前面先有一則 { "type": "hello", "id" }。 在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 會在頁面連到 127.0.0.1 之前詢問權限，被拒絕的話，狀態會一直停在 'connecting'。 url 橋接程式的 WebSocket 位址。預設是 OUT_DEFAULT_URL，也就是 ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out。 id 這個頁面的名字（作品的 id），會在 "hello" 訊息裡送給橋接程式，並顯示在它的紀錄裡。 WebSocket 要用的 WebSocket 建構函式。預設是全域的那個（Node 22 也有）。傳你自己的，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。 schedule 一個在下一個畫面執行一次回呼的函式。預設是 requestAnimationFrame（分頁被藏起來或沒有 requestAnimationFrame 時，改用 16 毫秒的計時器）。 maxBackoffMs 重新連線之間最長的等待時間，單位是毫秒。 minBackoffMs 重新連線之間第一次的等待時間。每次加倍，直到 maxBackoffMs。
startBridge({ port: 7457 }) throws at once, so the bridge can never take the port the monitor listens on. The Leap bridge refuses the same one (RESERVED_PORTS of @openav/leap).
startBridge({ port: 7457 }) 會立刻丟出錯誤，所以橋接程式絕不會占走後台監看監聽的連接埠。Leap 橋接程式也拒絕同一個（@openav/leap 的 RESERVED_PORTS）。

This is what node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json runs (also --port, --no-watchdog, --quiet; the environment variable OUT_BRIDGE_PORT). It serves ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out, which understands { type: 'hello', id }, { type: 'set', ch, v }, { type: 'batch', items } and { type: 'status' }, and answers with { type: 'status', … }; GET /health reports the sinks, the channel count, the clients and the time since the last value. Channel names are a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . / up to 128 characters, values must be finite numbers, and there is room for 4096 channels. The config routes channels: channels is a list of { match, sink, … } and the first rule whose match glob fits the channel name takes it ( means anything, slashes included); a channel no rule fits is counted and dropped. The sinks are log (stdout), udp-json (UDP, {"ch","v"}), osc (UDP, address "/" + channel, one float32), ddp (WLED over UDP 4048: light//r|g|b, 0..1, pixel index from 0, up to 10000 pixels) and serial (a device path, ch value lines or JSON, latest value only), and for DMX artnet, sacn and enttec (below). safe maps a channel glob to its safe value, or to "hold" for none (the first glob that fits wins), timeoutMs (default 500, at least 20) is the watchdog time, and allowOrigins lists the page origins that may connect (without it any page on this machine can). Three sinks carry DMX lighting, on channels named dmx// (address 1–512, value 0..1 to a byte 0–255): artnet (ArtDmx over UDP 6454, unicast to…

node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json 執行的就是它（另有 --port、--no-watchdog、--quiet，以及環境變數 OUT_BRIDGE_PORT）。它提供 ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out，聽得懂 { type: 'hello', id }、{ type: 'set', ch, v }、{ type: 'batch', items } 和 { type: 'status' }，並以 { type: 'status', … } 回應。GET /health 回報輸出、頻道數、用戶端和距離上一個值的時間。頻道名稱是 a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /，最長 128 個字元，值必須是有限數，最多容納 4096 個頻道。 設定檔負責把頻道導向各處：channels 是 { match, sink, … } 的清單，第一條 match 萬用字元符合頻道名稱的規則就接手它（ 代表任何東西，包含斜線）。沒有規則符合的頻道會被計數然後丟掉。輸出（sink）有 log（標準輸出）、udp-json（UDP，{"ch","v"}）、osc（UDP，位址是 "/" + 頻道，一個 float32）、ddp（用 UDP 4048 控制 WLED：light//r|g|b，0..1，像素索引從 0 開始，最多 10000 個像素）和 serial（裝置路徑，ch value 的行或 JSON，只送最新的值）。DMX 另有 artnet、sacn 和 enttec（見下一段）。safe 把頻道萬用字元對應到它的安全值，或對應到 "hold" 表示沒有安全值（第一個符合的萬用字元優先），timeoutMs（預設 500，至少 20）是看門狗的時間，allowOrigins 列出允許連線的頁面來源（沒寫的話，這台機器上的任何頁面都能連）。 有三個輸出負責 DMX 燈光，頻道名稱是 dmx//（位址 1–512，值 0..1 換成 0–255 的位元組）：artnet（ArtDmx，UDP 6454，單播給 host 也就是節點，"broadcast": true 要刻意才開，因為 Art-Net 4 規定 ArtDmx 不廣播）、sacn（E1.31，UDP 5568，送到每個 universe 的多播群組 239.255..，或單播給 host，可設 priority、source，橋接程式每次執行用同一個 CID），以及 enttec（把一個 universe 用 Enttec DMX USB Pro 的資料框寫到序列埠 path）。每個都替每個 universe 留一個 512 位元組的緩衝區，有變化時固定每秒 40 格，沒變時每秒補送一次。dmx/1/… 送出去是 Art-Net 的 Port-Address 1，也是 sACN 的 universe 1。頁面這一側用 dmxTransport('bridge') 送這些頻道。三個輸出都讓每個頻道在任何一秒內最多閃 3 次（變亮滿刻度 10% 以上，如果是這一秒的第四次就要等，變暗和安全值永遠直接通過），預設開著：在那條路線寫 "flashGuard": false 會關掉，{ "maxFlashHz": 3, "exempt": ["dmx/1/49-52"] } 可以改上限、讓某些頻道不受管。橋接程式不知道 patch，所以單位是一個頻道，比頁面那一道以每台燈算的粗：平順移動時，16 位元 pan 或…

For a monitor or a test receiver: an ArtPoll, another opcode, a packet cut short or a length that does not fit gives null, so a receiver can call it on everything that arrives on port 6454. bytes A UDP payload (a Node Buffer works: it is a Uint8Array). { universe, sequence, physical, version, data }, data a copy of the channel values.
給監看程式或測試用的接收端：ArtPoll、其他 opcode、被截斷的封包或長度對不上的，都回傳 null，所以接收端可以對 6454 埠收到的每個封包都呼叫它。 bytes 一個 UDP 的內容（Node 的 Buffer 也可以，它就是 Uint8Array）。 { universe, sequence, physical, version, data }，data 是通道值的複本。
For tests and for a simulated interface: it checks both delimiters, the label and that the length fits the frame. bytes One frame, from 0x7E to 0xE7. { startCode, data }, data the channels.
給測試和模擬的介面用：會檢查頭尾兩個分隔字元、label，以及長度跟資料框相符。 bytes 一個資料框，從 0x7E 到 0xE7。 { startCode, data }，data 是各通道的值。

It checks the identifier, the three vectors and that every layer's length matches the packet, so synchronization and discovery packets, and anything cut short, give null. A start code other than 0 is returned as startCode for the caller to decide. bytes A UDP payload. { universe, priority, sequence, source, cid, preview, terminated, startCode, data }, data a copy of the slot values.

它會檢查識別碼、三個 vector，以及每一層的長度跟封包相符，所以同步封包、探索封包和被截斷的封包都回傳 null。起始碼不是 0 的，放在 startCode 交給呼叫端決定。 bytes 一個 UDP 的內容。 { universe, priority, sequence, source, cid, preview, terminated, startCode, data }，data 是每格值的複本。

render(t, { beat, bpm }) returns the bytes of every universe at t seconds; state(t) returns the same moment as properties per fixture, plus capped, the effects and chases the flash cap slowed down. The same t always gives the same bytes: nothing reads a clock, nothing random is drawn (a flicker is seeded), nothing adds up frame by frame. So a look can be tested with no light, a recording can be rendered frame by frame, and scrubbing back shows what was. beat is a beat position (from @openav/drums or MIDI clock); without it, beats are t · bpm / 60. Give bpm with beat: the flash cap turns a rate per beat into flashes per second with the tempo, so render(t, { beat }) alone throws. The layers, bottom to top: base(...scenes), the look that is just on; cues, cue(name, { scene, fadeIn, fadeOut, curve }) and go(name, at), where the times belong to the cue you go to, as on a lighting desk (it rises over its fadeIn while what was on falls over its fadeOut, and a shorter fadeOut makes a dip); chase(name, { steps, every, unit, fade, start }), scenes in turn every n beats or seconds; effect(name, { target, property, wave, rate, unit, depth, phase, spread, width, seed }) with waves sine, saw, square, chase, flicker and rainbow, each fixture of the target behind the one before by spread; then set(target, props), live values from a fader or the microphone; then submaster(target, level), a fader over a group that scales its dimmer; then the patch's limits, engine.master, engine.blackout. A…

render(t, { beat, bpm }) 回傳 t 秒時每個 universe 的位元組，state(t) 回傳同一個時刻、每台燈的屬性，再加上 capped，也就是這一刻被閃爍上限放慢的 effect 和 chase。同一個 t 永遠得到同樣的位元組：不讀時鐘、不抽亂數（閃爍有種子）、不會一格一格累加。所以沒有燈也能測一個畫面，錄影可以逐格算，往回拉也看得到當時的樣子。beat 是拍子位置（來自 @openav/drums 或 MIDI clock），沒給的話拍子就是 t · bpm / 60。給 beat 的時候也要給 bpm：閃爍上限要靠拍速把「每拍幾次」換成「每秒幾次」，所以只給 render(t, { beat }) 會丟出錯誤。 由下往上的圖層：base(...scenes)，一直開著的基本畫面，cue，用 cue(name, { scene, fadeIn, fadeOut, curve }) 定義、go(name, at) 觸發，時間算在你要去的那個 cue 上，跟燈光控台一樣（它照自己的 fadeIn 亮起，原本的照它的 fadeOut 暗下，fadeOut 比較短就會先暗一下），chase(name, { steps, every, unit, fade, start })，每隔幾拍或幾秒輪到下一個 scene，effect(name, { target, property, wave, rate, unit, depth, phase, spread, width, seed })，波形有 sine、saw、square、chase、flicker、rainbow，目標裡每台燈依 spread 比前一台晚一點，接著 set(target, props)，推桿或麥克風的即時值，再來是 submaster(target, level)，一支管一個群組的推桿，把它的 dimmer 等比例調暗，最後是 patch 的上下限、engine.master、engine.blackout。目標可以是燈的 id、群組、'' 或清單。dmxParams() 把這些控制點變成參數。 安全機制預設就開著，而且以每台燈來算：要緊的是一台燈實際發出來的光。首先，每一個作用在 dimmer 或顏色上的 effect，以及每一個改變位置以外任何東西的 chase，各自被限制在每秒最多閃 maxFlashHz 次：以秒為單位的速度直接夾住，以拍為單位的速度一次減半直到符合，這樣還是踩在拍子上，chase 則把每一步的長度加倍，隨機閃爍每秒最多換那麼多次值。接著對每一台燈，把會讓它閃的東西的頻率加起來，總和超過上限，就只在這台燈上把這些來源放慢（以秒為單位的照同一個比例，以拍為單位的對半降，chase 的每一步加倍），state(t).slowed 會說是哪台燈、總和從多少降到多少，以及那台燈上的每個來源。結果仍然只取決於時間。即時值（set()、submaster()、麥克風推的參數）在這裡不會被放慢：每個 dmxTransport() 裡的頻閃保護管住每台燈實際發出的光。profile 寫了 Hz 的 strobe 通道也遵守上限（見 Patch）。作用在 dimmer 上的 effect 只會讓燈比底下的畫面暗，不會更亮。control 通道（重置、燈泡開關、內建程式）不能寫在 scene 或 set() 裡，只有 control(id, key, byte) 能寫，總控和 blackout 都不會動到它。blackout 時…

The framework's first rule: continuous control goes through params. The engine never reads a signal; this gives it params, so whatever drives a param drives the lights: a fader in the console, a MIDI knob through the mapper ({ source: 'midi/cc/7', target: 'dmx/master' }), the timeline's automation, the microphone (audio/rms to dmx/pars/dimmer), a phone. Spread params into a world's own and call apply(state, t) in its update(): it hands over only what changed. The keys: dmx/master (engine.master); dmx/blackout (a step param, 0 or 1); dmx//dimmer, a submaster (engine.submaster()) that scales what every layer made, so cues, chases and effects keep running under it; dmx//hue and /saturation, the group's colour, kept in a base scene of its own (rig.scene) under cues, chases and effects, so a rainbow effect mixes over it; dmx//rate and /depth, through engine.tune(), so a knob that changes the speed never makes the wave jump; dmx//run. A group gets hue and saturation only when its fixtures have colour channels. The defaults are what the engine says when you call it: the master, each effect's rate and depth, whether a chase runs. Declaring them changes nothing until something moves one, except a group's colour, which starts at the hue and saturation you pass (a warm amber by default). An unknown effect, chase or group throws. t is the time you render with: a new rate takes over from there. The flash cap (3 Hz by default) holds effects, chases and strobe channels. A value that…

框架的第一條規則：連續的控制走參數。引擎自己從來不讀訊號，這支函式替它開出參數，所以任何能推參數的東西都能推燈：控台的推桿、經過 mapping 的 MIDI 旋鈕（{ source: 'midi/cc/7', target: 'dmx/master' }）、時間軸的自動化、麥克風（audio/rms 接到 dmx/pars/dimmer）、手機。把 params 展開放進 world 自己的參數裡，在它的 update() 呼叫 apply(state, t)：它只交出有變的部分。 鍵名：dmx/master（engine.master）。dmx/blackout（階梯參數，0 或 1）。dmx//dimmer，一支群組推桿（engine.submaster()），把每一層算出的結果等比例調暗，所以底下的 cue、chase、effect 照樣在跑。dmx//hue 和 /saturation，群組的顏色，放在它自己的一個基礎 scene（rig.scene）裡，墊在 cue、chase、effect 底下，所以 rainbow effect 會混在它上面。dmx//rate 和 /depth，經過 engine.tune()，所以轉旋鈕改速度，波形不會跳。dmx//run。群組裡的燈有顏色通道，才會有色相和飽和度。 預設值是呼叫當下引擎的狀態：總控、每個 effect 的速度和深度、chase 有沒有在跑。宣告這些參數不會改變任何東西，直到有人動了其中一個，只有群組的顏色例外，它從你給的 hue 和 saturation 開始（預設是溫暖的琥珀色）。不存在的 effect、chase 或群組會丟出錯誤。t 是你算燈用的時間：新的速度從那一刻接手。 閃爍上限（預設 3 Hz）管的是 effect、chase 和 strobe 通道。從麥克風或大鼓經參數進來的值是即時值，照原樣送出：替它的路線加上 smooth（0.1 秒以上），讓推動它的東西維持在每秒閃三次以內，或讓聲音去推一個受上限管的東西。 engine 那個 DmxEngine。先定義好 effect 和 chase：預設值是從它讀的。 prefix 每個鍵名的開頭（英文字母、數字、-、_）。 groups 群組（或燈）的名稱，或 { group: { hue, saturation, dimmer } }，順便給起始值。 effects effect 的名稱，或 { effect: { max } }：它的速度參數最高到多少（預設 4，或目前速度的兩倍）。 chases chase 的名稱。 group 參數的 group：控台和手機控制面板依它分組。 { params, apply(state, t, { beat, bpm }), scene, keys }：放進 world 的 params 的宣告、它的 update() 要呼叫的函式、它管理的顏色 scene 的名稱，以及每個鍵各自推的是什麼。

Call send(engine.render(t)) every frame. Each transport keeps a copy of what it delivered and sends only the difference. sim records it: changed lists the channels of the last send, bytes(1) is universe 1. bridge calls client.set('dmx//', byte / 255) once per changed channel, and the bridge's artnet, sacn or enttec sink turns them back into bytes, 40 frames a second while they change and once a second while they do not. A universe is the number you patched on: dmx/1/… leaves as Art-Net Port-Address 1 and as sACN universe 1. serial writes Enttec DMX USB Pro frames (label 6, all 512 channels of one universe) straight from the page, with no bridge: at most one every 25 ms, only when something changed (and once a second otherwise), and when a frame is still on its way the newest one goes next. connect() asks the browser which port, so it must be called from a click, and nothing calls it for you. Without Web Serial (Chrome or Edge on a computer, on https or localhost) the status is 'unsupported' and connect() rejects with the reason. Every frame goes through a flash guard first, on every kind (a FlashGuard when you give { patch }). It reads each fixture's brightness from the bytes (intensity times its brightest colour channel) and counts a flash as WCAG 2.3.1 does, a pair of opposing changes of 10% of full scale or more. No fixture may brighten that much more than maxFlashHz times in any second: the next rise waits, the light staying where it was, until the second has room.…

每一格呼叫 send(engine.render(t))。每種傳送端都會留一份它送出過的內容，只送有變的部分。sim 把它記下來：changed 列出上一次送出改變的通道，bytes(1) 就是 universe 1。bridge 對每個有變的通道呼叫一次 client.set('dmx//', byte / 255)，橋接程式的 artnet、sacn 或 enttec 輸出再把它們換回位元組，有變化時每秒 40 格，沒變時每秒補送一次。universe 就是你 patch 時用的號碼：dmx/1/… 送出去是 Art-Net 的 Port-Address 1，也是 sACN 的 universe 1。 serial 直接從頁面寫出 Enttec DMX USB Pro 的資料框（label 6，一個 universe 的全部 512 個通道），不用橋接程式：最多每 25 毫秒一格，只有內容改變時才送（沒變就每秒補送一次），前一格還在送的時候，接下來送的是最新的那一格。connect() 會請瀏覽器問你要用哪個連接埠，所以必須在點擊裡呼叫，也不會有人替你呼叫。瀏覽器沒有 Web Serial（要電腦上的 Chrome 或 Edge，網址是 https 或 localhost）時，狀態是 'unsupported'，connect() 會帶著原因失敗。 每一格都先經過頻閃保護，每一種傳送端都一樣（給了 { patch } 就是一個 FlashGuard）。它從位元組讀出每台燈的亮度（調光乘上最亮的顏色通道），照 WCAG 2.3.1 的方式算一次閃：亮度往相反方向變化兩次，每次至少滿刻度的 10%。任何一秒內，一台燈變亮這麼多的次數不能超過 maxFlashHz 次：下一次變亮要等，燈停在原處，直到這一秒有空位。變暗永遠直接通過，所以 blackout 立刻就到。只有被壓住的燈的調光會變，pan、tilt 和其他每一個通道，以及沒被壓住的每台燈，都原封不動送出。引擎擋不到的它都擋得住：麥克風或大鼓推 dimmer、兩個引擎、任何即時值。沒有 patch 時，它只能一個通道一個通道地看（flashGuard.unit 是 'channel'），平順移動中的搖頭燈 pan 細調位元組也會被壓住。給 { flashGuard: false } 就沒有保護，關掉的這段時間 mountDmxMonitor() 會一直顯示 FLASH GUARD OFF。 頁面離開時兩者不一樣。走橋接程式時，頁面一停止說話，它的通道就會被放到橋接程式設定的 safe 值（設成 "hold" 的通道停在原處）。用 Web Serial 接的 Enttec Pro 會自己一直重送最後一格：要讓燈暗下來，先設 engine.blackout = true，再 send() 一次，然後 close()，它會等最新的那一格送出去，才放開連接埠。Enttec Open DMX 或沒有處理器的 FTDI 線（電腦得自己掌握 DMX break 的時序）不支援。 sim 什麼都不用。bridge：輸出橋接程式要開著，並且有一條 dmx/ 的規則（node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json）。serial：Chrome 或 Edge、一次點擊，以及插好的介面。 kind 'sim'、'bridge' 或 'serial'。 options 每一種都可以給：{ patch, flashGuard = true,…

Field by field from "Art-Net 4 Specification", ArtDmx packet definition: Art-Net\0, the opcode low byte first, protocol version 0 and 14, sequence, physical, SubUni (low byte of the Port-Address), Net (top 7 bits), the length high byte first, the data. A browser cannot send UDP: the out-bridge's artnet sink sends it (startBridge()). The spec asks for ArtDmx to be unicast to the nodes that subscribe to the universe, never broadcast. Art-Net™ Designed by and Copyright Artistic Licence. data Channel values 0–255, channel 1 first. An odd count gets one 0 added, as the length must be even. universe The 15-bit Port-Address, 0–32767: Net (7 bits), Sub-Net (4) and Universe (4) in one number. "Universe 1" as people say it is Port-Address 1 (Net 0, Sub-Net 0, Universe 1), the default; 0 still works but the spec deprecates it. sequence 0 turns sequencing off; a sender counts 1–255 so a node can put packets back in order. physical The input port the data came from (for merging at the node). 18 header bytes and the data.

照《Art-Net 4 Specification》的 ArtDmx packet definition 一欄一欄寫：Art-Net\0、opcode（低位元組在前）、協定版本 0 和 14、序號、physical、SubUni（Port-Address 的低位元組）、Net（最高 7 位元）、長度（高位元組在前）、資料。瀏覽器不能送 UDP，要交給輸出橋接程式的 artnet 輸出送（startBridge()）。 規格要求 ArtDmx 用單播送給訂閱這個 universe 的節點，不能廣播。Art-Net™ Designed by and Copyright Artistic Licence。 data 通道值 0–255，從第 1 通道開始。個數是奇數時補一個 0，因為長度必須是偶數。 universe 15 位元的 Port-Address，0–32767：Net（7 位元）、Sub-Net（4）、Universe（4）合成一個數字。大家口中的「universe 1」就是 Port-Address 1（Net 0、Sub-Net 0、Universe 1），也是預設值。0 還能用，但規格不建議。 sequence 0 代表不用序號。送出端從 1 數到 255，節點才能把封包排回正確順序。 physical 資料來自哪個輸入埠（給節點合併用）。 18 個表頭位元組加上資料。

From ENTTEC's "DMX USB Pro – API", message 8, "Output Only Send DMX Packet Request (Label=6)": the data is the start code followed by the channels, 25 to 513 bytes, and its size also sets how many channels the widget sends, so send the same count every time. The length is written low byte first. In Chrome and Edge, Web Serial can write this frame to the interface directly, with no bridge (dmxTransport('serial')); the out-bridge's enttec sink writes it from Node. data Channel values 0–255, at most 512. Fewer than 24 are padded with zeros to 24. The frame: 5 bytes before the channels, 1 after.

依照 ENTTEC《DMX USB Pro – API》第 8 則訊息「Output Only Send DMX Packet Request (Label=6)」：資料是起始碼加上通道，25 到 513 個位元組，它的長度也決定介面送出幾個通道，所以每次都送一樣多。長度是低位元組在前。在 Chrome 和 Edge 裡，Web Serial 可以直接把這個資料框寫進介面，不用橋接程式（dmxTransport('serial')），輸出橋接程式的 enttec 輸出則是從 Node 寫。 data 通道值 0–255，最多 512 個。不到 24 個會補 0 補到 24 個。 整個資料框：通道前面 5 個位元組，後面 1 個。

A receiver either listens on the multicast group of the universe (sacnAddress()) or gets the packet unicast. Each layer's flags and length field is 0x7 and the length from that field to the end of the packet: for 512 slots 0x726E, 0x7258 and 0x720B. data Slot values 0–255, slot 1 first (start code 0 is added). universe The universe, 1–63999. cid The sender's 16-byte CID (a UUID that stays the same for one sender). Required. source The source name a receiver shows, UTF-8, cut at a character to 63 bytes. priority 0–200: a receiver takes the highest priority it hears for a universe. sequence 0–255, counted up by the sender. preview Options bit 7: data meant for a visualiser, not for lights. terminated Options bit 6: this source stops sending this universe. 126 header bytes and the slots (638 bytes for a full universe).

接收端可以加入這個 universe 的多播群組（sacnAddress()），也可以用單播收。每一層的 flags & length 欄位是 0x7 加上從這個欄位到封包結尾的長度：512 格時分別是 0x726E、0x7258、0x720B。 data 每格的值 0–255，從第 1 格開始（起始碼 0 會自動加上）。 universe universe，1–63999。 cid 送出端 16 位元組的 CID（同一個送出端固定不變的 UUID）。一定要給。 source 接收端會顯示的來源名稱，UTF-8，超過 63 位元組時在完整的字之後截斷。 priority 0–200：接收端對同一個 universe 會採用聽到的最高優先權。 sequence 0–255，由送出端遞增。 preview 選項第 7 位元：資料是給視覺化程式看的，不是給燈的。 terminated 選項第 6 位元：這個來源不再送這個 universe。 126 個表頭位元組加上每格的值（完整的 universe 是 638 bytes）。
Patch.add() takes the id itself, so this is for reading a profile, or for copying one to change it. id Such as 'generic-rgbw'. The profile as data (the parsed JSON).
Patch.add() 可以直接吃 id，所以這是用來讀 profile，或複製一份來改的。 id 例如 'generic-rgbw'。 profile 的資料（解析好的 JSON）。

None describes one real fixture: each is a common channel order written by hand, MIT, "verified": false. Read your light's manual; where its order or ranges differ, copy the file (@openav/dmx/fixtures/generic-rgbw.json), change it, and pass it to Patch as a profile of your own. Their strobe channels say which values are open and which strobe, but not how fast: a generic file cannot know. Under the 3 Hz flash cap the engine therefore keeps them open, and the one-colour strobe works as a plain flood until the cap is raised on purpose. Seven open-audiovisual/fixture@1 profiles, in this order: generic-dimmer, generic-rgb, generic-rgbw, generic-rgba, generic-rgbaw-uv, generic-strobe, generic-moving-head.

沒有一份對應到某一台真的燈：每一份都是手寫的常見通道順序，MIT 授權，"verified": false。請讀你那台燈的說明書，順序或數值範圍不一樣的地方，就複製檔案（@openav/dmx/fixtures/generic-rgbw.json）修改，再當成你自己的 profile 交給 Patch。 它們的 strobe 通道寫了哪些值是 open、哪些是 strobe，但沒寫閃多快，通用的檔案不可能知道。所以在每秒 3 次的上限之下，引擎會讓它們停在 open，單色頻閃燈在你刻意調高上限之前，就只是一盞白光泛光燈。 七份 open-audiovisual/fixture@1 profile，順序是 generic-dimmer、generic-rgb、generic-rgbw、generic-rgba、generic-rgbaw-uv、generic-strobe、generic-moving-head。

apply(universes, t) takes what render() returns (or a Map, { id: bytes }, [[id, bytes]]) and the time in seconds, and returns [[universe, bytes]] to send. Call it once per frame, in time order, on a clock that runs at real speed (wall time, never a timeline that can be scrubbed). It keeps a memory of when each light last turned and rose, which is why it is not inside the engine: the engine stays a pure function of time. A fixture's brightness is its intensity (the average of its intensity channels, 1 with none) times its brightest colour channel (1 with none; CMY flags as the light that passes them), read the way the fixture reads the bytes, 16 bits where the mode has the fine byte. A flash is a pair of opposing changes of 10% of full scale or more (WCAG 2.3.1), measured from the last turning point, so a slow wave counts once it has moved that far. Only rises are rationed: the fixture whose next rise would be one too many stays at the level it last had, steady, until the second has room. Falls always pass, so a blackout is never held back and nothing is ever sent brighter than asked. What it changes: only a held fixture, and only its intensity bytes (coarse and fine), scaled down; a fixture with no intensity channel has its colour bytes scaled together, so the hue stays. Pan, tilt, zoom, gobo, strobe and control channels, channels no fixture owns, and every fixture not held come back as the very same arrays. held lists the fixtures held in the last apply(); status(t) is {…

apply(universes, t) 接收 render() 的結果（或 Map、{ id: bytes }、[[id, bytes]]）和以秒為單位的時間，回傳要送出的 [[universe, bytes]]。每一格呼叫一次，照時間順序，用照真實速度走的時鐘（真實時間，不能是會被拉來拉去的時間軸）。它記得每台燈上一次在哪裡轉折、什麼時候變亮，所以它不在引擎裡面：引擎要保持只取決於時間。 一台燈的亮度是它的調光（調光通道的平均，沒有調光通道就是 1）乘上最亮的顏色通道（沒有顏色通道就是 1，CMY 顏色片就看透過來的光），讀法跟燈具讀位元組一樣，模式有細調位元組的就用 16 位元。一次閃是亮度往相反方向變化兩次，每次至少滿刻度的 10%（WCAG 2.3.1），從上一個轉折點量起，所以慢慢變的波形移動到這麼多時也算。只有變亮有限額：下一次變亮會超過的燈穩穩停在上一次送出的亮度，等這一秒有空位。變暗永遠直接通過，所以 blackout 從不會被擋，送出的光也從不會比要求的亮。 它會改的：只有被壓住的燈，而且只有它的調光位元組（粗調和細調）等比例調低，沒有調光通道的燈就把顏色位元組一起調低，色相不變。pan、tilt、zoom、gobo、strobe、control 通道、不屬於任何燈的通道，以及沒被壓住的每台燈，回傳的都是原本那個陣列。held 列出上一次 apply() 壓住的燈，status(t) 是 { on, unit: 'fixture', maxFlashHz, held, rises }，reset() 忘掉每台燈的紀錄。 這道保護和引擎的上限都看不到很多台燈一起閃（它一台一台地算，二十台 par 各自 3 Hz、彼此錯開，整個場地就閃得快很多）、投影或螢幕上的畫面，以及亮度不變、只有顏色來回換（飽和的紅和藍交替）。pan、tilt 快速移動不算閃，也不會被壓住。 patch 要讀、要管的那個 Patch。之後才加進去的燈也會被管。 maxFlashHz 一台燈在任何一秒內最多可以閃幾次。不是整數的話取整數部分（2.5：任何一秒 2 次），小於 1 就是每 1 / maxFlashHz 秒一次，Infinity 就是不限制。

You rarely need it: Patch.add() loads a profile itself. Use it to see how many channels a mode takes before you choose start addresses. The error it throws lists every problem, and carries them as error.problems. profile A parsed fixture profile, or one this function already returned (it comes back unchanged). { format, id, manufacturer, name, kind, license, verified, modes: [{ id, name, footprint, slots: [{ key, offset, type, color, default, ranges, fine, coarse, fineOffset }] }], profile }, frozen.

通常用不到：Patch.add() 自己會載入 profile。想在決定起始位址之前先知道一個模式佔幾個通道，就用它。丟出的錯誤會列出所有問題，也放在 error.problems 裡。 profile 解析好的燈具 profile，或這個函式之前回傳的結果（原樣回傳）。 { format, id, manufacturer, name, kind, license, verified, modes: [{ id, name, footprint, slots: [{ key, offset, type, color, default, ranges, fine, coarse, fineOffset }] }], profile }，已凍結。

It reads everything back from the bytes, the way a fixture would. A swatch is what its colour channels mix to (red, green, blue, white, amber, UV and the rest; colour flags as their complement) times its dimmer channel; a fixture with no dimmer channel shows its colour bytes as they are. A profile that is one channel off shows the wrong colour here too, so this is how to check a patch with no light in the room. Hover a swatch for its address and values. The grid is 32 by 16 cells, address 1 at the top left. Each cell's bar is its value (the number is printed when it is not 0), tinted with the colour it drives or its fixture's colour, and a yellow edge marks where each fixture starts. Point at a cell to read universe/address = value and which fixture and channel it is. With several universes, tabs pick one. Pass the transport and the header shows its kind and status (sim · no hardware, out-bridge · open) and what its flash guard is doing (flash guard · 3 Hz per fixture, or holding par3, with an amber ring on each fixture held back). A transport made with { flashGuard: false } gets a red FLASH GUARD OFF and a red edge around the whole monitor, for as long as it lives. A serial transport gets a Connect button, the click Web Serial needs. Dark console theme, no dependencies; its styles are added to the page once, as #oav-dmx-css. A moving head's mark is a top view: its angle is pan across the head's whole range, its length is tilt. A page (it builds DOM) and the patch. It shows…

它所有東西都從位元組讀回來，跟燈具讀的方式一樣。色塊是它的顏色通道混出來的顏色（紅、綠、藍、白、琥珀、UV 等等，CMY 顏色片就用補色）乘上調光通道，沒有調光通道的燈直接顯示顏色位元組。profile 差一個通道，這裡的顏色也會跟著錯，所以房間裡沒有燈的時候，就靠它檢查 patch。滑鼠停在色塊上，會看到它的位址和數值。 通道表是 32 乘 16 格，位址 1 在左上角。每格的長條是它的值（不是 0 時會印出數字），顏色是它推的那種光或它所屬燈具的顏色，每台燈的第一個通道左邊有一條黃線。滑鼠指著一格，就會讀到 universe/位址 = 值，以及它是哪台燈的哪個通道。有好幾個 universe 時，用分頁切換。 傳入 transport，標題列就會顯示它的種類和狀態（sim · no hardware、out-bridge · open），以及它的頻閃保護在做什麼（flash guard · 3 Hz per fixture，或 holding par3，被壓住的每台燈外面有一圈琥珀色的框）。用 { flashGuard: false } 建立的傳送端，會有紅色的 FLASH GUARD OFF，整個監看器外框也變紅，只要它還在就一直顯示。serial 的傳送端會有一個 Connect 按鈕，就是 Web Serial 需要的那次點擊。深色控台風格、沒有任何相依套件，樣式只會加進頁面一次，叫 #oav-dmx-css。搖頭燈的記號是從上往下看：角度是 pan（對應燈的整個轉動範圍），長度是 tilt。 一個頁面（它會建立 DOM）和 patch。第一次 update() 之前，全部顯示 0。 el 要放在哪裡（它會把自己加進去）。版面由你安排。 patch 那個 Patch：要畫的燈，以及通道要用誰的名字標示。 transport 一個 dmxTransport() 的結果：它的種類、狀態和頻閃保護顯示在標題列，serial 的會多一個 Connect 按鈕，update() 不帶參數時顯示它實際送出的內容。 engine 那個 DmxEngine：被它每台燈的閃爍上限放慢的燈，會標上「slow」（滑鼠停上去看放慢了多少）。 universe 通道表一開始顯示哪個 universe（預設是 patch 裡的第一個）。 title 標題列上的名字。 { el, update(universes), select(universe), look(id), dispose() }：每一格呼叫 update()，不帶參數就顯示傳送端實際送出的內容，或帶 engine.render(t)（只有位元組或標記變了才重畫），select() 換到另一個 universe，look(id) 是一台燈在它最後拿到的位元組裡的樣子（{ color, mixed, dimmer, pan, tilt, strobe }），dispose() 把它從頁面上拿掉。

add({ id, profile, mode, universe = 1, address, name, groups, limits }) places one fixture: profile is a profile or the id of one, mode one of its modes (the first by default), address its start address. It throws for an unknown profile or mode, an address that is not 1–512, a footprint that runs past 512 (it says the last start address that fits), an id used twice, and a group named like a fixture. Two fixtures on the same addresses are allowed, because doubling two identical pars is common; check() lists them. A work asks for properties, never channel numbers: dimmer, color: [r, g, b], pan, tilt, strobe, zoom, each 0..1, and any other channel by its key in the profile (uv, gobo). render(states, { master, blackout, maxFlashHz, controls }) turns { id: properties } into Universes: colour goes through rgbToChannels(); dimmer drives every intensity channel of the fixture, and a fixture with no dimmer channel gets the dimmer multiplied into its colour; pan and tilt with a fine channel are written as 16 bits; a fixture with no state gets its channel defaults (a moving head waits at the middle, dark). The last layers live here, in this order: the fixture's limits ({ dimmer: [0, 0.8], tilt: [0.1, 0.9] }), then the grand master, then blackout, then the flash cap on the strobe channel. Blackout darkens intensity and colour and leaves pan, tilt, zoom and control channels alone. Every strobe channel whose profile gives Hz is held at or under maxFlashHz (3 by default); one whose…

add({ id, profile, mode, universe = 1, address, name, groups, limits }) 放一台燈：profile 是一份 profile 或它的 id，mode 是它的其中一個模式（預設第一個），address 是起始位址。profile 或模式不存在、位址不在 1–512、佔用的通道超過 512（錯誤訊息會說最後一個放得下的起始位址）、id 重複、群組名稱跟燈的 id 一樣，都會丟出錯誤。兩台燈用同一段位址是允許的，因為把兩台一樣的 par 設成同一個位址很常見，check() 會把它們列出來。 作品只要屬性，不要通道號碼：dimmer、color: [r, g, b]、pan、tilt、strobe、zoom，每個 0..1，其他通道用 profile 裡的鍵名（uv、gobo）。render(states, { master, blackout, maxFlashHz, controls }) 把 { id: 屬性 } 換成 Universes：顏色經過 rgbToChannels()，dimmer 會推這台燈的每一個調光通道，沒有調光通道的燈，dimmer 會乘進顏色裡，有 fine 通道的 pan、tilt 寫成 16 位元，沒有給狀態的燈用各通道的預設值（搖頭燈停在正中間、不亮）。 最後幾層在這裡處理，順序是：每台燈的 limits（{ dimmer: [0, 0.8], tilt: [0.1, 0.9] }），接著總控（grand master），接著 blackout，最後是 strobe 通道的閃爍上限。blackout 會讓亮度和顏色歸零，pan、tilt、zoom 和 control 通道維持原樣。profile 有寫 Hz 的每一個 strobe 通道，都會被限制在 maxFlashHz（預設 3）以下，沒寫 Hz 的就停在 open 的值，因為沒有人說得出它會閃多快。用鍵名設定的第二個調光或 strobe 通道，一樣套用上下限、總控、blackout 和閃爍上限。control 通道（重置、燈泡開關、內建程式）只能透過 controls: { id: { key: byte } } 寫入。 profiles 你自己的燈具 profile，add() 和 fromJSON() 會先用 id 在這裡找，找不到才找內建的 FIXTURES。

The rule, in order, each step taking its share out of what is left: white = min(r, g, b), taken out of r, g and b (a fixture with only warm or cold white uses that); amber = min(r, 2·g), read as (1, ½, 0), taken out of red and half as much green; red, green and blue get what is left. With no red, green or blue but cyan, magenta and yellow, it is subtractive: cyan = 1 − r, and so on. A fixture with one kind of emitter (a white par) gets the brightest of r, g, b. UV, lime and indigo have no place in RGB and stay 0. Why white first: on an RGBW par the white LED is the brightest and cleanest, and pastels made from red, green and blue alone look thin and tinted. Full extraction means (1, 1, 1) is the white LED alone. Patch calls this for you when a scene says color: [r, g, b]. rgb [r, g, b], each 0..1 (clamped). colors The colour names of the fixture's channels, such as ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'white']. One 0..1 value per name in colors.

規則依序如下，每一步都從剩下的量裡取：白光 = min(r, g, b)，從 r、g、b 扣掉（只有暖白或冷白的燈就放在那裡）。琥珀色 = min(r, 2·g)，把琥珀當成 (1, ½, 0)，從紅色扣掉、綠色扣一半。剩下的給紅、綠、藍。沒有紅綠藍、只有青、洋紅、黃的燈用減色法：青 = 1 − r，以此類推。只有一種光源的燈（例如白光 par）取 r、g、b 裡最亮的那個。UV、萊姆綠和靛色在 RGB 裡沒有位置，維持 0。 為什麼先取白光：RGBW par 上的白光 LED 最亮也最乾淨，只用紅綠藍混出來的淡色會顯得單薄又偏色。完全取出白光的意思是 (1, 1, 1) 只會點亮白光 LED。scene 寫 color: [r, g, b] 的時候，Patch 會替你呼叫它。 rgb [r, g, b]，每個 0..1（超出會被夾住）。 colors 燈具顏色通道的名稱，例如 ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'white']。 colors 裡每個名稱各一個 0..1 的值。

Send the packet from encodeSacn() to this address on port 5568 and every receiver that listens to the universe gets it, with no setup on the network beyond multicast working. universe The universe, 1–63999. An IPv4 address such as 239.255.0.1.
把 encodeSacn() 的封包送到這個位址的 5568 埠，所有在聽這個 universe 的接收端都會收到，網路只要支援多播就好，不用另外設定。 universe universe，1–63999。 一個 IPv4 位址，例如 239.255.0.1。

data is the 512 bytes themselves (slot 1 is data[0]), ready to hand to encodeArtDmx(), encodeSacn() or encodeEnttecDmx(). get(address) and set(address, value) use 1-based addresses. A wrong address (0, 513, 1.5) or a value outside 0–255 throws a RangeError instead of being clamped: a light patched one channel off still lights, only not the one you meant, so the mistake should stop you early. id The universe number, 0–63999: the one you patch on and send to. Universe 1 goes out as Art-Net Port-Address 1 and as sACN universe 1 (sACN has no 0; Art-Net's 0 is deprecated).

data 就是那 512 個位元組（第 1 格是 data[0]），可以直接交給 encodeArtDmx()、encodeSacn() 或 encodeEnttecDmx()。get(address) 和 set(address, value) 的位址從 1 開始。 位址錯了（0、513、1.5）或值不在 0–255 之間，會丟出 RangeError，不會自動夾到範圍內：位址差一格的燈還是會亮，只是亮的不是你要的那一台，所以錯誤要早一點擋下來。 id universe 的編號，0–63999，就是你 patch 和送出時用的那個號碼。universe 1 送出去是 Art-Net 的 Port-Address 1，也是 sACN 的 universe 1（sACN 沒有 0，Art-Net 的 0 規格不建議再用）。

get(id) gives the Universe with that number, creating it if needed. bytes(id) gives a copy of its 512 bytes, and 512 zeros for a universe nothing was patched on, so a sender can always send. ids() lists the numbers in use, lowest first.
get(id) 給你那個編號的 Universe，沒有就建立。bytes(id) 給它那 512 個位元組的複本，沒有任何燈的 universe 就給 512 個 0，所以送出端永遠有東西可以送。ids() 由小到大列出用到的編號。

A profile names its channels (channels: { red: { type: 'color', color: 'red' }, … }) and, per mode, the order the fixture reads them from its start address (modes: [{ id: '4ch', channels: ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'white'] }]). Channel types: intensity, color (red, green, blue, white, warmWhite, coldWhite, amber, uv, cyan, magenta, yellow, lime, indigo), pan, tilt, strobe, zoom, focus, gobo, colorWheel, speed, control and generic. A 16-bit channel is two entries: the coarse one, and { fineOf: 'pan' } for its low byte. It checks what a JSON Schema cannot: every mode names channels that exist, once each; a fine channel comes with its coarse one in the same mode; a strobe's ranges go up without overlapping and only a strobe range has hz; and "verified": true has a verification with method: "hardware", which only a person with the fixture in front of them can make. The schema is @openav/dmx/fixtures/fixture.schema.json. profile A parsed fixture profile (the JSON of one fixture). One sentence per problem, each starting with the profile's id.

一份 profile 寫出它的通道（channels: { red: { type: 'color', color: 'red' }, … }），以及每個模式下燈具從起始位址開始讀這些通道的順序（modes: [{ id: '4ch', channels: ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'white'] }]）。通道類型有：intensity、color（red、green、blue、white、warmWhite、coldWhite、amber、uv、cyan、magenta、yellow、lime、indigo）、pan、tilt、strobe、zoom、focus、gobo、colorWheel、speed、control 和 generic。16 位元的通道寫成兩筆：粗調那一筆，再加一筆 { fineOf: 'pan' } 當它的低位元組。 它檢查 JSON Schema 檢查不到的事：每個模式寫的通道都存在，而且只出現一次，fine 通道跟它的粗調通道在同一個模式裡，strobe 的 ranges 由小到大、不重疊，只有 strobe 區段可以寫 hz，寫了 "verified": true 就要有一筆 method: "hardware" 的驗證紀錄，那只有燈就在眼前的人才能留。Schema 在 @openav/dmx/fixtures/fixture.schema.json。 profile 解析好的燈具 profile（一台燈的 JSON）。 每個問題一句話，開頭是 profile 的 id。

A projector that is not square to the wall throws a trapezoid. Moving each corner of the picture to where the screen's corner really is undoes it, and four points decide exactly one projective transform. Hand the result to toMatrix3d() and the browser bends a whole element with it, on the GPU. A quad that is not convex (a corner pushed inside, two edges crossed), whose corners lie on one line or enclose no area, is refused with the reason: no projector throws it, and the matrix for it would turn the picture inside out. corners Four points [[x, y] × 4]: where the top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left corners go. They must make a convex quad. width The rectangle's width (the element's, in px). height The rectangle's height. Nine numbers, row by row: [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i] maps (x, y) to ((a·x + b·y + c) / w, (d·x + e·y + f) / w) with w = g·x + h·y + i.

投影機沒有正對牆面，投出來就是梯形。把畫面的每個角移到螢幕真正的角上，就能抵消它，而四個點剛好決定一個投影轉換。把結果交給 toMatrix3d()，瀏覽器就用 GPU 把整個元素照著彎過去。 不是凸的四邊形（一個角被推進去、兩條邊交叉）、三個角在同一條線上，或圍不出面積的，會被拒絕並說明原因：沒有投影機投得出這種形狀，而它的矩陣會把畫面整個翻過來。 corners 四個點 [[x, y] × 4]：左上、右上、右下、左下四個角要去的位置。它們必須圍成一個凸四邊形。 width 矩形的寬（元素的寬，單位 px）。 height 矩形的高。 九個數字，一列一列：[a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i] 把 (x, y) 變成 ((a·x + b·y + c) / w, (d·x + e·y + f) / w)，其中 w = g·x + h·y + i。

Rule 1 says what is performed goes through params, so each output's blackout and brightness must exist before any window opens: the timeline can fade the projector, a MIDI fader learned onto output/front/brightness works at once, and a saved mapping finds its target. createOutputs adds them at load; open(name), from a click, opens the window with what was declared for that name. exportLayout() gives every output's corners, flips, turn, border and soft edge as one open-audiovisual/output@1 document, and importLayout(doc) checks a file, saves it and applies it to open windows. On a clean page of one of these outputs (?output=left), what the code declares for left applies where the address says nothing. show What createShow() returned. outputs One entry per output: { name, crop, fit } (a name alone also works). With align, the align layout's outputs. aspect The stage's shape on this page, 16 / 9 or 32 / 9 for two projectors side by side: the world's layer is boxed to it, centred, black around. null leaves the stage as it is. With align, the align layout's art canvas. panel The "L4 · Output" panel: true puts it in the console, an element puts it there, false leaves it out. via For mode 'page' across browsers or machines: true is this server's /relay, or a ws:// address. storage Where the corners are saved. align What @openav/align's outputsFromAlign(layout) returned: the outputs and the aspect come from the align layout, and importLayout() also takes an align calibration (its…

規則一說：被演奏的東西都經過參數，所以每個輸出的黑場和亮度必須在任何視窗打開之前就存在：時間軸才能把投影機淡出，learn 到 output/front/brightness 的 MIDI 推桿馬上就能用，存下來的對應也找得到目標。createOutputs 在載入時就把它們加進去，在點擊時呼叫 open(name)，就照那個名字宣告的設定開視窗。 exportLayout() 把每個輸出的四個角、翻轉、旋轉、黑邊和柔邊寫成一份 open-audiovisual/output@1 文件，importLayout(doc) 先檢查檔案，再存下來，套用到開著的視窗。在其中一個輸出的乾淨頁面上（?output=left），網址沒說的部分，就用程式碼替 left 宣告的設定。 show createShow() 回傳的東西。 outputs 每個輸出一筆：{ name, crop, fit }（只寫名字也可以）。有 align 時用對位佈局的輸出。 aspect 舞台在這個頁面上的形狀，16 / 9，或兩台投影機並排時的 32 / 9：世界那一層會被框成這個形狀，置中，四周黑色。null 不改舞台。有 align 時用對位佈局的作品畫布。 panel 「L4 · Output」面板：true 放在控台裡，給一個元素就放在那裡，false 不要。 via 跨瀏覽器或跨機器使用 'page' 模式時：true 是這台伺服器的 /relay，或一個 ws:// 位址。 storage 四個角存在哪裡。 align @openav/align 的 outputsFromAlign(layout) 回傳的東西：輸出和比例都從對位佈局來，importLayout() 也收對位校正檔（每路輸出的四個角）。 所有輸出，也放在 show.outputs：{ names, open(name, o), close(name), get(name), edit(name, on), pattern(name, on), url(name, o), exportLayout(), importLayout(doc), keys(name) }。

Place the source at source inside an element at clip with overflow: hidden, and only the crop shows. A crop is normalized, so it holds whatever size the stage is drawn at. Where two crops meet there is no blend: edge blending is not part of this package. crop The region, { x, y, w, h } from 0 to 1 of the source (or [x, y, w, h]). null is all of it. source The source's size, { w, h } in px. box The box's size, { w, h } in px. fit The whole region with bars, the box filled and the rest cut, or the region pulled to the box's shape. { clip, source }, each { left, top, width, height } in the box's px: the part of the box the picture covers, and where the whole source sits (it may reach far outside the box).

把來源放在 source 的位置，外面包一個在 clip 位置、overflow: hidden 的元素，就只看得到裁切的那一塊。裁切是正規化的數值，所以舞台用什麼大小畫都適用。兩塊裁切接起來的地方沒有融合：邊緣融合（edge blending）不在這個套件裡。 crop 那一塊，來源的 0 到 1，{ x, y, w, h }（或 [x, y, w, h]）。null 是整個來源。 source 來源的大小，{ w, h }，單位 px。 box 框的大小，{ w, h }，單位 px。 fit 整塊放進去留黑邊、填滿框把多的切掉，或把那一塊拉成框的形狀。 { clip, source }，兩者都是框的 px 座標 { left, top, width, height }：畫面蓋住框的哪一部分，以及整個來源放在哪裡（可能遠遠超出框）。

Call it from a click: a browser opens a window only after a gesture, and when it refuses, openOutput throws. Drag the window onto the projector and press F in it, or let it find the screens: with the Window Management API and its permission it lists them and goes fullscreen on the one you click. The permission is only ever asked from a click in the output window. In the window: E edits the corners (drag the four handles, or pick one with 1 to 4 and move it with the arrows, Shift for 10 px), G shows a test pattern bent the same way, B toggles the blackout param, F goes fullscreen, H and V flip, O turns 90°, [ and ] add a black border, R puts the corners back. Every change is saved for that output name, so a venue's setup survives a reload. Mode 'mirror' shows exactly what the stage shows, at the size the stage's canvas has on this page, about a frame later, and only while this page stays open. Mode 'page' renders the world again at the window's own size, on any machine, but shares only the clock and the held values: a world that reacts to a note or integrates dt draws something else there. A DOM or SVG world has no canvas to mirror: the window says so, and mode 'page' works for it. source What createShow() returned (its world's canvas is mirrored), a canvas, or an element with a canvas inside (the largest one is taken). name The output's name, 1 to 32 letters, digits, - or _. It names its params (output//blackout, output//brightness), its saved corners and its window. crop…

要在點擊時呼叫：瀏覽器只在使用者有動作之後才開視窗，被擋下時 openOutput 會丟出錯誤。把視窗拖到投影機上，在視窗裡按 F，或讓它找螢幕：瀏覽器有 Window Management API 而且允許時，它會列出每個螢幕，點哪個就在哪個全螢幕。權限只會在輸出視窗裡點擊時才詢問。 在視窗裡：E 編輯四個角（拖四個把手，或用 1 到 4 選一個，再用方向鍵移動，按住 Shift 一次 10 px），G 顯示跟著彎的測試圖，B 切換黑場參數，F 全螢幕，H 和 V 翻轉，O 轉 90°，[ 和 ] 加黑邊，R 把四個角放回去。每個改動都依輸出名字存下來，所以場地的設定重新整理後還在。 'mirror' 模式顯示的跟舞台完全一樣，大小是舞台畫布在這個頁面上的大小，大約晚一幀，而且只有這個頁面開著時才有畫面。'page' 模式在視窗自己的大小重新算一次世界，任何一台機器都行，但只共用時鐘和被握住的值：對音符起反應、或把 dt 累加起來的世界，在那裡會畫出不一樣的東西。 DOM 或 SVG 的世界沒有畫布可以鏡像：視窗會說明，改用 'page' 模式就行。 source createShow() 回傳的東西（鏡像它的世界的畫布）、一個畫布，或裡面有畫布的元素（取最大的那個）。 name 輸出的名字，1 到 32 個字母、數字、- 或 _。它決定這個輸出的參數名（output//blackout、output//brightness）、存下來的四個角，以及視窗。 crop 這個輸出顯示舞台的哪一塊，{ x, y, w, h }，0 到 1。null 是整個舞台。 fit 裁切的畫面怎麼放進視窗：完整放進去留黑邊、塞滿並切掉多的，或拉成視窗的形狀。 mode 'mirror'：視窗用 captureStream() 顯示舞台的畫布，只算一次，畫面完全一樣。'page'：視窗是這個頁面的乾淨網址，跟著這個頁面的時鐘和被握住的值。 params 來源不是演出時：一個 Params，這個輸出的黑場和亮度會加進去。 timeline 來源不是演出時：一個 Timeline，黑場和亮度跟著它的自動化。 features 開視窗時 window.open() 的 features。 aspect 'page' 模式：舞台的形狀，寫進網址讓那個頁面照著畫。 via 'page' 模式：null 是 BroadcastChannel（同一個瀏覽器、同一台機器），true 是這台伺服器的 /relay，ws:// 位址是別台的中繼。 channel 'page' 模式：那個頁面跟隨的同步頻道。 storage 四個角存在哪裡，鍵是 oav-output:。 這個輸出：{ name, mode, window, closed, edit(on), pattern(on), room, set(partial), reset(), close() }。room 是場地對它做的事（四個角、翻轉、旋轉、黑邊、柔邊）。

The file is the room, the code is the show: a layout file holds what the venue did to each output (four corners as 0..1 of the window, flipX, flipY, rotate 0/90/180/270, overscan up to 0.45, soft up to 0.5), never what it shows. A file with another format is refused.
檔案記的是場地，程式碼記的是演出：設定檔只存場地對每個輸出做了什麼（四個角，是視窗的 0 到 1、flipX、flipY、rotate 0/90/180/270、overscan 最多 0.45、soft 最多 0.5），從來不存它顯示什麼。格式不同的檔案會被拒絕。

Rule 1: the projector's blackout is not a button wired to one window, it is a param, so the console's slider, a MIDI fader, the timeline's automation and a phone all reach it the same way. Brightness is a black veil over the picture (1 - brightness of it), not the projector's lamp. createOutputs() and openOutput() add these for you. names One output's name, or several. Two entries per output, each with key, label, min, max, def (blackout also step: 1) and group: 'output'.

規則一：投影機的黑場不是接在某個視窗上的按鈕，而是一個參數，所以控台的滑桿、MIDI 推桿、時間軸的自動化和手機，都用同一種方式推它。亮度是蓋在畫面上的一層黑紗（蓋 1 - brightness），不是投影機的燈泡。createOutputs() 和 openOutput() 會替你加好。 names 一個輸出的名字，或好幾個。 每個輸出兩筆，都有 key、label、min、max、def（blackout 另有 step: 1），以及 group: 'output'。

Any page built with createShow() becomes a clean output when its address has ?output: no console, no piano, no overlays, the stage alone on black with the corners this browser saved for that name. &follow= makes it follow the show page's clock (&via=relay across browsers or machines), &play starts the timeline where nobody can press Space (OBS, TouchDesigner). search location.search, or a URLSearchParams. The output's name (main when empty), its crop, the stage's shape, the fit, the channel to follow, the relay (true or an address) and whether to play at once. A bad value is dropped with a warning.

任何用 createShow() 做的頁面，網址加上 ?output 就變成乾淨的輸出：沒有控台、沒有鋼琴、沒有疊在上面的東西，只有黑底上的舞台，加上這個瀏覽器替那個名字存下的四個角。&follow= 讓它跟著演出頁面的時鐘（跨瀏覽器或跨機器時加 &via=relay），&play 讓時間軸在沒人能按空白鍵的地方（OBS、TouchDesigner）一載入就播放。 search location.search，或一個 URLSearchParams。 輸出的名字（空的就是 main）、裁切、舞台形狀、fit、要跟隨的頻道、中繼（true 或一個位址），以及要不要一載入就播放。不合格的值會被丟掉並警告。

What it writes, outputQuery() reads back the same. The rig's outputs.url(name) fills in the crop and shape declared for that output. base The show page's address (location.href). Its other keys are kept, the output's are replaced. name The output's name. crop The region of the stage, { x, y, w, h }. aspect The stage's shape, 16 / 9 or '16:9'. fit contain, cover or stretch. follow The sync channel of the show page to follow. via true for this server's /relay, or a ws:// address. play Start the timeline on load. The address, short: ?output=left&crop=0,0,0.5,1&play.

它寫出來的，outputQuery() 讀回去一模一樣。outputs.url(name) 會替你填好那個輸出宣告的裁切和形狀。 base 演出頁面的網址（location.href）。其他的查詢參數保留，輸出相關的會被換掉。 name 輸出的名字。 crop 舞台的哪一塊，{ x, y, w, h }。 aspect 舞台的形狀，16 / 9 或 '16:9'。 fit contain、cover 或 stretch。 follow 要跟隨的演出頁面的同步頻道。 via true 是這台伺服器的 /relay，或一個 ws:// 位址。 play 一載入就讓時間軸開始播放。 網址，寫成短的樣子：?output=left&crop=0,0,0.5,1&play。

A file from the venue is fixed in one go: an unknown key, a corner outside -0.5 to 1.5, a quad that is not convex, a turn of 45° and a bad name are all listed in the one error, each with its place (outputs.front.rotate). Missing keys take the defaults (the picture fills the window). An @openav/align calibration (open-audiovisual/align-calibration@1) is refused with a message that says how to bring it in: its corners are desktop pixels of an align layout, so it converts only with that layout, through outputsFromAlign(). doc The file's text, or the object it holds. { format, outputs }, every output with all six keys: corners, flipX, flipY, rotate, overscan, soft.

從場地帶回來的檔案可以一次改好：不認得的鍵、超出 -0.5 到 1.5 的角、不是凸的四邊形、轉 45° 和不合格的名字，全都列在同一個錯誤裡，每一項都標出位置（outputs.front.rotate）。沒寫的鍵用預設值（畫面填滿視窗）。 @openav/align 的校正檔（open-audiovisual/align-calibration@1）會被拒絕，訊息會說怎麼匯入：它的角是對位佈局的桌面像素，所以只能透過 outputsFromAlign() 配合那份佈局轉換。 doc 檔案的文字，或它裝的物件。 { format, outputs }，每個輸出都有六個鍵：corners、flipX、flipY、rotate、overscan、soft。

CSS lists a 4×4 matrix column by column; the homography's third row becomes the perspective column, and z passes through. The element's box must be the rectangle the homography was made for, and its transform-origin 0 0. H Nine numbers row by row, what cornerPin() returns. matrix3d(…) with 16 numbers in fixed notation (no exponent).
CSS 的 4×4 矩陣是一行一行（column）列出來的。單應矩陣的第三列變成透視的那一行，z 原封不動。元素的大小必須是當初算單應矩陣用的那個矩形，transform-origin 要是 0 0。 H 一列一列的九個數字，也就是 cornerPin() 回傳的東西。 有 16 個數字的 matrix3d(…)，用一般小數寫法（沒有指數）。

Nine numbers, row by row: [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i] takes (x, y) to ((a·x + b·y + c) / w, (d·x + e·y + f) / w) with w = g·x + h·y + i. M Nine numbers, row by row. array The point [x, y]. The point it lands on, [x', y'].
九個數字，一列一列：[a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i] 把 (x, y) 變成 ((a·x + b·y + c) / w, (d·x + e·y + f) / w)，其中 w = g·x + h·y + i。 M 九個數字，一列一列。 array 點 [x, y]。 落點 [x', y']。

What ClockSync adds for each pong. t0 When the ping left, this device's ms. server The relay's clock in the pong, ms. t1 When the pong came back, this device's ms. rtt = t1 − t0, offset = server − (t0 + t1) / 2, at = t1.
ClockSync 每收到一個回應就加進去的東西。 t0 ping 出發的時間，這台裝置的毫秒。 server 回應裡中繼的時鐘，毫秒。 t1 回應回來的時間，這台裝置的毫秒。 來回 rtt = t1 − t0、偏移 offset = server − (t0 + t1) / 2、時間 at = t1。

add(t0, server, t1) files one ping: it left at t0 (this clock), the relay read its clock as server, the pong came back at t1. If the trips out and back took as long as each other, the relay read its clock at the midpoint, so the offset is server − (t0 + t1) / 2, and the error is at most half the round trip. A phone busy drawing answers late and a crowded wifi queues, but neither ever makes a trip shorter than it was, so the shortest one is trusted. now() is the shared clock in ms, offset the relay's clock minus this one, rtt the round trip of the trusted sample (the offset is good to half of it), ready true after the first pong, local() this device's own clock. It is not @openav/sync. Sync makes a follower page chase a leader's timeline frame by frame; ClockSync only agrees on what time it is, and each screen computes its own frame from it. now This device's clock in ms. The default never jumps when the system clock is set. window Only samples this recent count, ms: clocks drift apart by a few ms a minute. keep At most this many samples.

add(t0, server, t1) 記下一次 ping：它在 t0（這邊的時鐘）出發，中繼讀到自己的時鐘是 server，回應在 t1 回來。如果去和回花的時間一樣，中繼就是在中點讀時鐘，所以偏移是 server − (t0 + t1) / 2，誤差最多是來回的一半。忙著畫圖的手機會晚回答、擠的 wifi 會排隊，但它們都不會讓一趟變得比實際更短，所以信任最短的那次。 now() 是共同的時鐘（毫秒），offset 是中繼的時鐘減掉這邊的，rtt 是被信任那個樣本的來回時間（偏移準到它的一半），ready 在第一個回應之後是 true，local() 是這台裝置自己的時鐘。 它不是 @openav/sync。sync 讓從屬頁面一幀一幀追著主控端的時間軸，ClockSync 只是對齊現在幾點，每台螢幕再各自用它算自己的畫面。 now 這台裝置的時鐘，毫秒。預設值在系統時間被調整時不會跳。 window 只算這麼近的樣本，毫秒：時鐘每分鐘會互相漂開幾毫秒。 keep 最多留這麼多個樣本。

unknown lists ids of no screen in the roster, or of a cell that screen does not have. duplicate lists a cell seen twice (a reflection, or two screens showing one number): both copies are dropped, since either may be the wrong one. found What the detector found: [{ id, corners: [[x, y] × 4] }] in photo pixels, OpenCV's corner order. roster The screens and their numbers: [{ id, index, w, h }]. grid The grid options the screens drew with ({ short, fill }). { devices: [{ id, index, w, h, markers: [{ marker, cell, device, photo }] }], unknown, duplicate }, ready for solveLayout().

unknown 列出不屬於名單上任何螢幕的 id，或那台螢幕沒有的格子。duplicate 列出被看到兩次的格子（反光，或兩台螢幕顯示同一個編號）：兩個都丟掉，因為哪一個都可能是錯的。 found 偵測器找到的：[{ id, corners: [[x, y] × 4] }]，照片像素，OpenCV 的角順序。 roster 螢幕和它們的編號：[{ id, index, w, h }]。 grid 螢幕畫標記時用的格子選項（{ short, fill }）。 { devices: [{ id, index, w, h, markers: [{ marker, cell, device, photo }] }], unknown, duplicate }，可以直接交給 solveLayout()。
The reverse of markerId(). id A marker id from the detector. The screen's number and the cell, { device, cell }.
markerId() 的反向。 id 偵測器找到的標記 id。 螢幕編號和格子，{ device, cell }。
For a similarity it is the scale squared. M Nine numbers, row by row. 0 for a singular matrix.
相似轉換的行列式是縮放的平方。 M 九個數字，一列一列。 奇異矩陣是 0。

Sub-pixel corner refinement is on (CORNER_REFINE_SUBPIX): the corners are what the solver lives on. Every OpenCV object it makes is deleted before it returns. Why OpenCV.js: one pinned file loaded with a script tag, no build step; its ArUco detector also reads AprilTag families, so the marker family can change without changing library; and the next step, a screen posed in 3D, needs solvePnP, which is in the same file. cv What loadOpenCV() resolved with. src The photo, or grey pixels already ({ data, w, h }, as greyPixels() gives). maxSide A larger photo is scaled down first: a 48 MP photo is slow and buys nothing. params Extra fields for OpenCV's aruco_DetectorParameters. { found: [{ id, corners: [[x, y] × 4] }], rejected, ms, w, h }: corners in OpenCV's order (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left of the marker as drawn), in canvas convention (+ 0.5 on OpenCV's pixel centres), what correspondences() expects.

開了次像素角點精修（CORNER_REFINE_SUBPIX）：求解靠的就是這些角。它建的每個 OpenCV 物件在回傳之前都會刪掉。為什麼用 OpenCV.js：一個固定版本的檔案，用 script 標籤載入，不用建置。它的 ArUco 偵測器也讀 AprilTag 家族，換標記家族不必換函式庫。下一步（在 3D 空間擺放的螢幕）要的 solvePnP 也在同一個檔案裡。 cv loadOpenCV() 回傳的東西。 src 照片，或已經轉好的灰階像素（{ data, w, h }，greyPixels() 給的那種）。 maxSide 比這大的照片先縮小：4800 萬像素的照片很慢，也沒有比較好。 params OpenCV aruco_DetectorParameters 的額外欄位。 { found: [{ id, corners: [[x, y] × 4] }], rejected, ms, w, h }：角照 OpenCV 的順序（畫出來的標記的左上、右上、右下、左下），用畫布的慣例（OpenCV 的像素中心再加 0.5），正是 correspondences() 要的。

Five by five rather than four by four: with rotations counted, two of its markers differ in at least 5 bits (tests/tile.test.js recomputes it from the table), where two DICT_4X4_1000 markers can differ in 2, and a misread id puts four corners on the wrong screen.
用 5×5 而不是 4×4：算上旋轉，它的任兩個標記至少差 5 個位元（tests/tile.test.js 從表格重新算過），DICT_4X4_1000 的兩個標記卻可能只差 2 個，而讀錯一個 id 就會把四個角放到錯的螢幕上。

The only part of the markers that needs a browser. The bits come from dict.js, extracted from OpenCV, so the screens never load OpenCV: only the camera page does, to find them again. ctx A context that draws in device pixels. w The width in device pixels. h The height. index The screen's number, 0 to 19. grid Grid options ({ short, fill }), the same the camera page is told. label Small text in the bottom margin, where it cannot touch a marker. The grid it drew (markerGrid()).

標記裡唯一需要瀏覽器的部分。位元來自從 OpenCV 抽出來的 dict.js，所以螢幕從來不載 OpenCV：只有拍照頁載，用來把它們找回來。 ctx 用裝置像素畫的 context。 w 寬，裝置像素。 h 高。 index 螢幕的編號，0 到 19。 grid 格子選項（{ short, fill }），要跟拍照頁拿到的一樣。 label 下方空白的小字，碰不到任何標記的地方。 它畫的格子（markerGrid()）。
A trip is never shorter than it really was, so the shortest one is the closest to the truth. samples Samples from clockSample(); anything else is skipped. n is how many samples counted.
一趟從來不會比實際更短，所以最短的那趟最接近真相。 samples clockSample() 做出來的樣本，其他的會被略過。 n 是算進去的樣本數。

No iteration and no starting guess: the turn, scale and shift fall out of four sums. It is how each screen is first placed against the reference. src The points. dst Where they should go. { a, b, tx, ty, rms }. A similarity is four numbers { a, b, tx, ty }: x' = a·x − b·y + tx, y' = b·x + a·y + ty, a turn of atan2(b, a), a uniform scale of hypot(a, b) and a shift.

不用迭代、不用初始猜測：旋轉、縮放和位移從四個總和直接算出來。每台螢幕一開始就是這樣對著基準螢幕擺上去的。 src 點。 dst 它們應該去的位置。 { a, b, tx, ty, rms }。相似轉換是四個數字 { a, b, tx, ty }：x' = a·x − b·y + tx、y' = b·x + a·y + ty，旋轉 atan2(b, a)、等比縮放 hypot(a, b)，再加一個位移。

What detectMarkers() feeds OpenCV; it needs no OpenCV itself, so importing @openav/tile/detect for it loads nothing from the network. src The picture. maxSide The longest side kept, in pixels. ImageData is taken as it is. data is a Uint8Array of luma (0.30 R + 0.59 G + 0.11 B), scale what the picture was multiplied by.
detectMarkers() 餵給 OpenCV 的東西。它本身不需要 OpenCV，所以為了它引入 @openav/tile/detect 不會從網路載任何東西。 src 圖片。 maxSide 保留的最長邊，像素。ImageData 照原樣用。 data 是亮度的 Uint8Array（0.30 R + 0.59 G + 0.11 B），scale 是圖片被乘上的倍率。

Four across keeps a marker large enough to read on a phone lying among a laptop and a tablet in one photo. The camera page sends the grid it uses in tile/roster, so a tile and the camera page always agree.
短邊四個，讓一支手機跟筆電、平板一起入鏡時，標記還是大到讀得出來。拍照頁會在 tile/roster 裡送出它用的格子，所以螢幕和拍照頁永遠一致。
The camera page reads every signal of the room through it and keeps those that match as the list of screens.
拍照頁用它讀房間裡的每個訊號，符合的就留下來當作螢幕清單。

Its value is { v: 1, id, w, h, dpr, screen, css, fullscreen, wake }: the drawing area in device pixels (what the markers are drawn in and the layout measures), the screen in device pixels, the CSS size, and whether it is fullscreen and awake. It is re-sent every second, so a camera page that opens late still hears every screen. id The screen's id. The name, tile//hello.
它的值是 { v: 1, id, w, h, dpr, screen, css, fullscreen, wake }：繪圖區的裝置像素（標記畫在這裡，版面也量這個）、螢幕的裝置像素、CSS 尺寸，以及是否全螢幕、是否保持喚醒。每秒重送一次，所以晚開的拍照頁也聽得到每台螢幕。 id 螢幕的 id。 訊號名稱 tile//hello。

With more than four points it is the least-squares fit. Without the normalization (centre the points, scale their mean distance to √2) a 9 × 9 system built from pixel coordinates in the thousands is hopeless in double precision: every screen came out degenerate in the test that turns it off. @openav/output has cornerPin() for the one case of four corners of a rectangle onto a projector's quad (it throws on a quad that is not convex, for a CSS matrix3d); this one takes any number of measured points and never throws. src The points [[x, y], …]. dst Where they go, in the same order. normalize false skips Hartley's normalization: kept only so a test can show why it is there. H: Nine numbers, row by row: [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i] takes (x, y) to ((a·x + b·y + c) / w, (d·x + e·y + f) / w) with w = g·x + h·y + i. H[8] is 1. reason is too-few-points or degenerate (collinear or repeated points).

超過四個點時就是最小平方擬合。沒有正規化（把點移到中心、平均距離縮放到 √2）的話，用上千像素的座標組成的 9 × 9 方程組，在雙精度下根本解不了：在把它關掉的測試裡，每台螢幕都被判成退化。 @openav/output 有 cornerPin()，處理矩形四個角送到投影四邊形那一種情況（四邊形不是凸的會丟出錯誤，給 CSS matrix3d 用）。這一個接受任何數量的量測點，而且從不丟出錯誤。 src 點 [[x, y], …]。 dst 它們要去的位置，順序一樣。 normalize false 跳過 Hartley 正規化：留著只是為了讓測試證明它為什麼需要。 H：九個數字，一列一列：[a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i] 把 (x, y) 變成 ((a·x + b·y + c) / w, (d·x + e·y + f) / w)，其中 w = g·x + h·y + i。H[8] 是 1。reason 是 too-few-points 或 degenerate（點共線或重複）。
The reference screen's similarity before the canvas is moved to start at (0, 0). Copy it (I3.slice()) before changing it.
畫布移到從 (0, 0) 開始之前，基準螢幕的相似轉換。要改之前先複製（I3.slice()）。
A view's toDevice is the inverse of its toCanvas: canvas units back to the screen's pixels. M Nine numbers, row by row. Nine numbers.
view 的 toDevice 就是它的 toCanvas 的反矩陣：從畫布單位回到螢幕像素。 M 九個數字，一列一列。 九個數字。

A tile is a controller in a relay room and tells the room who it is once a second with the signal tile//hello: its id and its drawing area in device pixels (CSS size × devicePixelRatio). The camera page answers with standing config the relay replays to a screen that joins later: each screen's number, Markers or Play, the layout, and the show's seed and start. The page opens on a "Tap to join" card: that tap is the one gesture a browser accepts for fullscreen and the screen wake lock, so both are asked for inside it. Until a photo placed this screen, tile.view is soloView() of its own size, and the work draws as one screen on its own. When the screen changes size (a rotation, the address bar) it goes back to that until the next photo. tile.time() is the shared show clock in seconds: every screen reads the same number at the same moment, within half of its quickest round trip to the relay. A tiled world draws from it and from tile.seed, never from a sum of its own dt, so a screen that joined late or dropped a frame still draws the same instant. syncTimeline(timeline, dt), called before timeline.advance(dt) (createShow's onFrame is), puts the timeline on that clock too. A browser page, a relay (node serve.js serves one at /relay; a static host such as openaudiovisual.com has none) and the camera page packages/tile/?room= on a phone. Fullscreen and the wake lock wait for the tap; the wake lock exists only on https:// or localhost. iPhone Safari cannot make a page fullscreen:…

一台螢幕在中繼房間裡是 controller，每秒用 tile//hello 這個訊號告訴房間它是誰：它的 id 和繪圖區的裝置像素（CSS 尺寸 × devicePixelRatio）。拍照頁用常駐的設定回答，中繼會把這些設定重播給晚到的螢幕：每台螢幕的編號、標記或演出、版面，以及演出的種子和起點。 頁面一開始是一張「Tap to join」卡片：這一下是瀏覽器唯一接受用來全螢幕和螢幕喚醒鎖的動作，所以兩個都在這一下裡要。拍照定位之前，tile.view 是自己尺寸的 soloView()，作品就當一台單獨的螢幕畫。螢幕尺寸一變（旋轉、網址列），它就退回這樣，直到下一張照片。 tile.time() 是共同的演出時鐘，單位秒：每台螢幕在同一刻讀到同一個數字，誤差在它到中繼最快那次來回的一半以內。拼接的世界從它和 tile.seed 算畫面，從不累加自己的 dt，所以晚加入或掉了一格的螢幕，畫的還是同一瞬間。syncTimeline(timeline, dt) 在 timeline.advance(dt) 之前呼叫（createShow 的 onFrame 就是），讓時間軸也跟著這個時鐘。 要有瀏覽器頁面、一個中繼（node serve.js 在 /relay 提供一個，openaudiovisual.com 這種靜態主機沒有），以及在手機上開的拍照頁 packages/tile/?room=。全螢幕和喚醒鎖要等那一下點擊，喚醒鎖只在 https:// 或 localhost 才有。 iPhone 的 Safari 不能讓網頁全螢幕：把它加入主畫面，再從主畫面打開。螢幕常亮靠系統設定（自動鎖定：永不），喚醒鎖只是保險。 同一個瀏覽器的兩個分頁會共用一個 id（存在 localStorage）：在一台電腦上試的時候，加上 &id=a、&id=b。 room 中繼的房間。同一張桌子的每台螢幕和它的拍照頁用同一個名字（字母、數字、- 和 _，最多 32 個字）。 url 中繼的 ws:// 位址。null 是這台伺服器的 /relay（node serve.js 跑的那個），或網址裡的 ?relay=。 id 這台螢幕的 id：網址裡的 ?id=，不然就是存在 localStorage 的那個，所以重新整理後還在桌上原來的位置。 signals 演出的 Signals：tile/markers、tile/synced、tile/layout 會寫進去。頁面通常在 createShow() 之前就加入，所以之後用 tile.attach(show.signals) 也一樣。 container 加入卡片、標記圖層和狀態小標放在哪裡。 ui 「Tap to join」卡片、狀態小標和 ⛶ 按鈕。false 只留下標記圖層。 storage 最後一份版面和演出起點存在哪裡，鍵是 oav.tile.。 Link 中繼用戶端的類別，給要換掉 socket 的測試用。 這台螢幕：id、room、index（拍照頁給的編號）、view、layout、calibrated、mode、seed、synced、time()（共同的秒數）、now()（共同的毫秒）、size()、markers(on)、attach(signals)、syncTimeline(timeline, dt)、on(event, cb)、status()、close()、link、clock。
validateLayout() refuses any other.
validateLayout() 會拒絕其他版本。

About 10 MB (3 MB over the wire), cached by the browser after the first visit. The screens never load it: their marker bits are in dict.js. A failed load rejects and lets the next call try again. OpenCV.js's cv is an Emscripten module whose then calls back with the module itself, so a promise resolved with it unwraps it again, forever (one core at 100%, nothing settles). loadOpenCV waits for cv.Mat, drops that then, and only then resolves. A browser page and the network (jsDelivr), unless url points at a copy. url Where to load it from: the pinned file on jsDelivr, or your own copy of the same file. OpenCV's cv. The same promise on every call.

大約 10 MB（傳輸時壓縮成 3 MB），第一次之後瀏覽器會快取。螢幕從來不載它：它們的標記位元在 dict.js 裡。載入失敗時 reject，下一次呼叫會再試。 OpenCV.js 的 cv 是一個 Emscripten 模組，它的 then 會用模組自己回呼，所以用它 resolve 的 promise 會一直展開下去（一顆 CPU 100%，永遠不結束）。loadOpenCV 等 cv.Mat 出現，拿掉那個 then，才 resolve。 要有瀏覽器頁面和網路（jsDelivr），除非 url 指到一份副本。 url 從哪裡載：jsDelivr 上固定版本的檔案，或你自己放的同一個檔案。 OpenCV 的 cv。每次呼叫都是同一個 promise。
A marker is 7 × 7 modules: a black border around these 5 × 5. drawMarkers() paints them. id A marker id, 0 to 999. 1 is white.
一個標記是 7 × 7 個模組：黑框圍著這 5 × 5。drawMarkers() 用它畫。 id 標記 id，0 到 999。 1 是白色。

The table in dict.js was drawn out of OpenCV 4.12.0 with cv.generateImageMarker at one pixel per module, so it is what OpenCV's own detector expects to find. id A marker id, 0 to 999. 0 to 2²⁵ − 1; 1 is a white module.
dict.js 裡的表格是用 OpenCV 4.12.0 的 cv.generateImageMarker 以一個模組一像素畫出來再讀回來的，所以就是 OpenCV 自己的偵測器預期找到的樣子。 id 標記 id，0 到 999。 0 到 2²⁵ − 1，1 是白色的模組。

Many small markers rather than one big one: screens overlap, hands and phones cover corners, and a phone lies at any angle. Each marker carries its screen and cell number and four corners, so any four in view place the whole screen. The grid is the same function on both ends: the tile draws markerGrid(w, h) and the camera page computes it again from the w and h the tile reported. w The screen's width in device pixels. h Its height. short Markers across the short side. fill The share of a cell the marker takes; the rest is its white quiet zone. { cell, nx, ny, module, size, markers: [{ cell, corners: [[x, y] × 4] }] }: the cell size, the grid, a module's pixels, a marker's pixels, and each marker's corners in OpenCV's order (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left).

用很多小標記而不是一個大的：螢幕會疊在一起、手和手機會蓋住角落、手機可能用任何角度放。每個標記都帶著它的螢幕編號、格子編號和四個角，所以畫面裡任何四個就能定位整台螢幕。兩邊用的是同一個函式：螢幕畫 markerGrid(w, h)，拍照頁再用螢幕回報的 w、h 算一次。 w 螢幕的寬，裝置像素。 h 它的高。 short 短邊排幾個標記。 fill 標記佔一格的比例，剩下的是它周圍的白邊。 { cell, nx, ny, module, size, markers: [{ cell, corners: [[x, y] × 4] }] }：格子的大小、格子的排法、一個模組幾像素、一個標記幾像素，以及每個標記照 OpenCV 順序（左上、右上、右下、左下）排的四個角。

One dictionary, split into 20 screens of 50 markers: the id alone says whose corner it is. device The screen's number, 0 to 19 (the camera page hands them out). cell The cell, 0 to 49. A DICT_5X5_1000 id, 0 to 999.
一本字典分給 20 台螢幕、每台 50 個標記：光看 id 就知道是誰的角。 device 螢幕的編號，0 到 19（拍照頁發的）。 cell 格子，0 到 49。 DICT_5X5_1000 的 id，0 到 999。
A 21st screen gets the number of the screen the camera page heard from longest ago.
第 21 台螢幕會拿到拍照頁最久沒聽到的那台的編號。
A screen's homography in the photo is mul3(plane, similarityMatrix(similarity)): the table's perspective after the screen's place on the table. A Nine numbers. B Nine numbers. Nine numbers.
一台螢幕在照片裡的單應矩陣是 mul3(plane, similarityMatrix(similarity))：先放到桌上的位置，再加上桌面的透視。 A 九個數字。 B 九個數字。 九個數字。
What homography() applies to both point sets before it solves. Exported from @openav/tile/solve. pts The points. A 3 × 3 matrix, row by row.
homography() 在求解之前套用到兩組點上的東西。從 @openav/tile/solve 匯出。 pts 點。 3 × 3 矩陣，一列一列。

No other page or package of the framework refers to it (tests/tile.test.js checks): a work that uses tile loads OpenCV only on its camera page. A venue without the internet can serve its own copy of the same file and pass it to loadOpenCV(url).
框架的其他頁面和套件都沒有提到它（tests/tile.test.js 會檢查）：用 tile 的作品只在它的拍照頁載 OpenCV。沒有網路的場地可以自己放一份同樣的檔案，交給 loadOpenCV(url)。
Pinned, so the page runs the build the tests ran and dict.js was extracted from. The package and OpenCV are Apache-2.0 (see NOTICE).
版本寫死，所以頁面跑的就是測試跑過、dict.js 抽出來的那個版本。這個套件和 OpenCV 都是 Apache-2.0（見 NOTICE）。
Marker ids run index × 50 to index × 50 + 49.
標記 id 從 index × 50 到 index × 50 + 49。

A layout's rms for each screen is this, in photo pixels: how far its markers' corners land from where the layout says they are. M A 3 × 3 matrix. src The points. dst Where they should go. 0 for no points.
版面裡每台螢幕的 rms 就是這個，單位是照片像素：它的標記的角，離版面說的位置多遠。 M 3 × 3 矩陣。 src 點。 dst 它們應該去的位置。 沒有點時是 0。
A screen's turn on the table; y points down, so a positive angle turns clockwise as you look at it. a From { a, b }. b From { a, b }. −π to π.
螢幕在桌上轉了多少。y 朝下，所以正的角度看起來是順時針。 a 來自 { a, b }。 b 來自 { a, b }。 −π 到 π。

A similarity is four numbers { a, b, tx, ty }: x' = a·x − b·y + tx, y' = b·x + a·y + ty, a turn of atan2(b, a), a uniform scale of hypot(a, b) and a shift. a Scale × cos(turn). b Scale × sin(turn). tx Shift in x. ty Shift in y. Nine numbers, row by row: what a layout keeps as matrix3x3.
相似轉換是四個數字 { a, b, tx, ty }：x' = a·x − b·y + tx、y' = b·x + a·y + ty，旋轉 atan2(b, a)、等比縮放 hypot(a, b)，再加一個位移。 a 縮放 × cos(旋轉角)。 b 縮放 × sin(旋轉角)。 tx x 方向的位移。 ty y 方向的位移。 九個數字，一列一列：版面裡存成 matrix3x3 的就是它。
It does not check that the matrix is a similarity: it reads the four numbers. M Nine numbers, row by row. { a: M[0], b: M[3], tx: M[2], ty: M[5] }.
它不檢查矩陣是不是相似轉換，只讀那四個數字。 M 九個數字，一列一列。 四個數字 { a: M[0], b: M[3], tx: M[2], ty: M[5] }。

In the demo layout the phone's 0.4935 is the laptop's 227 ppi over the phone's 460. a From { a, b }. b From { a, b }. Canvas units per screen pixel in a layout; a phone's is about the laptop's ppi over its own.
在示範版面裡，手機的 0.4935 就是筆電的 227 ppi 除以手機的 460。 a 來自 { a, b }。 b 來自 { a, b }。 在版面裡是每個螢幕像素幾個畫布單位。手機的大約是筆電的 ppi 除以手機自己的。

A world written for tiles runs unchanged on one screen with it: the page of example 30 without ?room= is one screen with the console, on its own time. w The screen's width in device pixels. h Its height. id The id the view carries. The same shape as a tileView(), with an identity transform.
為拼接寫的世界，有了它就能原封不動地在一台螢幕上跑：範例 30 的頁面沒有 ?room= 時，就是有控台、用自己時間的一台螢幕。 w 螢幕的寬，裝置像素。 h 它的高。 id view 帶著的 id。 跟 tileView() 一樣的形狀，轉換是單位矩陣。

Every screen lies in one plane, the table, and its pixels are evenly spaced on it, so "screen pixels → table" is a similarity for every screen, whatever its pixel density. The camera adds one perspective, "table → photo", the same for all of them. So the homography of a screen, divided by the reference's, is a similarity: the perspective cancels, and a phone's 460 ppi against a laptop's 227 ppi ends up in the scale. The steps: a normalized DLT homography() per screen (a misread marker dropped once), each screen's similarity by a least-squares fit through the reference's inverse, then Levenberg–Marquardt on one plane and every similarity at once, so the perspective is measured by every marker on the table (it keeps a screen far from the reference right), and the canvas moved to start at (0, 0). Flat screens only: a laptop standing up does not lie in the table's plane. Each device has kind: 'planar' and pose: null; a kind: 'window' device with a pose is the room kept for a screen posed in 3D, which this version validates but cannot draw. devices [{ id, w, h, index, markers: [{ device, photo }] }]: each screen's size in device pixels and its markers' corners in its pixels and in the photo (correspondences() makes it). photo { w, h } of the photo, written into the layout. minMarkers A screen with fewer markers in view is reported (too-few-markers), not solved. reference The id of the screen whose pixels measure the canvas. Default: the one that covers the most of the photo.…

每台螢幕都躺在同一個平面（桌面）上，而且它的像素在上面是均勻排的，所以不管像素密度多少，「螢幕像素 → 桌面」對每台都是一個相似轉換。相機再加上一個透視「桌面 → 照片」，對所有螢幕都一樣。所以一台螢幕的單應矩陣除以基準螢幕的，就是一個相似轉換：透視互相抵消，手機的 460 ppi 對筆電的 227 ppi 就落在縮放裡。 步驟：每台螢幕用正規化 DLT 算 homography()（讀錯的標記丟一次），用基準螢幕的反矩陣做最小平方擬合得到每台的相似轉換，再用 Levenberg–Marquardt 一起精修一個平面和所有相似轉換，讓透視由桌上每個標記一起量（離基準很遠的螢幕才會準），最後把畫布移到從 (0, 0) 開始。 只能是平放的螢幕：立起來的筆電不在桌面那個平面上。每台裝置都是 kind: 'planar'、pose: null。帶著 pose 的 kind: 'window' 是留給在 3D 空間擺放的螢幕用的位置，這一版會檢查它，但還畫不了。 devices [{ id, w, h, index, markers: [{ device, photo }] }]：每台螢幕的裝置像素大小，以及它的標記在螢幕像素和照片裡的角（correspondences() 做得出來）。 photo 照片的 { w, h }，寫進版面。 minMarkers 露出的標記比這少的螢幕會被回報（too-few-markers），不會被解。 reference 用哪台螢幕的像素量畫布。預設：在照片裡佔最大面積的那台。 refine 把桌面的透視和每台螢幕的相似轉換一起精修。 rejectPx 角離這台螢幕的擬合比這遠（而且超過中位數 4 倍）的標記會被丟掉一次：讀錯的 id。 { ok, layout, report, reason }。report 每台螢幕一列：{ id, status, markers, rejected, rms }，status 是 ok、too-few-markers、degenerate 或 bad-device。layout 是 { version: 1, kind: 'planar', units: 'reference-px', reference, canvas: { w, h }, photo, plane: { matrix3x3 }, devices: [{ id, index, w, h, kind: 'planar', similarity, matrix3x3, rms, markers, pose: null }] }。

tile/roster is { grid, devices: [{ id, index, w, h }] }, each screen's number (its markers) and the grid they use; tile/mode is 'markers' or 'show'; tile/layout is the layout; tile/show is { seed, start }, the seed and the start on the shared clock. Config is replayed by the relay to every screen that joins later, so a reloaded screen gets all four at once.
tile/roster 是 { grid, devices: [{ id, index, w, h }] }，每台螢幕的編號（它的標記）和用的格子。tile/mode 是 'markers' 或 'show'。tile/layout 是版面。tile/show 是 { seed, start }，種子和在共同時鐘上的起點。中繼會把設定重播給每台晚到的螢幕，所以重新整理的螢幕一次就拿到這四個。

The marker layer follows the param, not the camera page directly, so the timeline, a mapped signal or the console can call for markers like for any other param (AGENTS.md rule 1). tileWorld() adds it to the world's params unless the world already has one with that key.
標記圖層跟著這個參數，而不是直接跟著拍照頁，所以時間軸、對應過來的訊號或控台都能像對其他參數一樣叫出標記（AGENTS.md 規則一）。tileWorld() 會把它加進世界的參數，除非世界已經有同一個鍵。

When the camera page presses Markers the signal tile/markers goes to 1 and the route takes tileMarkers; Play puts both back to 0. It follows the framework's rule for who holds a value: a slider moved by hand on one screen's console holds that screen until the camera page really changes mode, and the same mode said again does not take it back.
拍照頁按下「標記」時，訊號 tile/markers 變成 1，路由接手 tileMarkers。按「演出」兩個都回到 0。它照框架「誰握住數值」的規則走：在某台螢幕的控台上用手推過的滑桿，會握住那一台，直到拍照頁真的換了模式，同一個模式再說一次並不會把它搶回來。

The id names the screen in the room (tile//hello) and in the layout, so it must stay the same across a reload: that is how a screen that reloads finds its place again without a new photo. storage Where the id is kept, under oav.tile.id. Up to 24 letters, digits, - or _; a made-up one is t and five more.
id 是這台螢幕在房間裡（tile//hello）和版面裡的名字，所以重新整理之後必須一樣：重新整理的螢幕就是這樣不用重拍就找回自己的位置。 storage id 存在哪裡，鍵是 oav.tile.id。 最多 24 個字母、數字、- 或 _。編出來的是 t 加五個字。

The relay already answers every ping with its own time ({ type: 'pong', t, server }); TileLink keeps that server time instead of only the latency. Ten quick pings on connect find a short round trip early, then one every 2 s follows the drift. The relay itself is unchanged: a tile is a controller, the camera page a runner. clock The clock the pongs go into. onClock (clock) => {} after every pong that counted. o Everything a RelayClient takes: role, room, id, url, onStatus, onSignal, onConfig ….

中繼本來就會用自己的時間回答每一個 ping（{ type: 'pong', t, server }），TileLink 把那個 server 時間留下來，而不只是延遲。連上時快速 ping 十次，早點找到短的來回，之後每 2 秒一次追蹤漂移。中繼本身完全沒改：螢幕是 controller，拍照頁是 runner。 clock 回應要放進去的時鐘。 onClock 每個算數的回應之後呼叫 (clock) => {}。 o RelayClient 接受的所有選項：role、room、id、url、onStatus、onSignal、onConfig ⋯。

The canvas is measured in the pixels of the reference screen and includes the gaps and bezels between screens, so something that leaves one screen travels behind the bezel and comes out on the next one where it would really be, at the same physical size. scale is device pixels per canvas unit, angle how far the screen is turned (radians), bounds the part of the canvas it covers. A 2D canvas: view.apply2d(ctx, canvas.width / view.device.w) and draw in canvas units. p5: view.applyP5(sk) at the top of draw(). An element: transform: view.css(devicePixelRatio) with transform-origin: 0 0. view.visible(x, y, r) is a cheap test to skip what is not on this screen. It never throws. layout A layout from solveLayout(). id The screen's id in it. { ok: true, id, device: { w, h }, canvas: { w, h }, toCanvas, toDevice, scale, angle, polygon, bounds, point(x, y), fromDevice(x, y), matrix(pixelRatio), apply2d(ctx, pixelRatio), applyP5(sk), css(dpr), visible(x, y, r) }, or { ok: false, reason } when the screen is not in the layout or is of a kind this version cannot draw.

畫布用基準螢幕的像素來量，而且包含螢幕之間的空隙和邊框，所以離開一台螢幕的東西會在邊框後面走，從下一台它真正該出現的位置出來，實際大小也一樣。scale 是每個畫布單位多少裝置像素，angle 是螢幕轉了多少（弧度），bounds 是它蓋住畫布的哪一塊。 2D 畫布：view.apply2d(ctx, canvas.width / view.device.w)，之後用畫布單位畫。p5：在 draw() 最前面 view.applyP5(sk)。HTML 元素：transform: view.css(devicePixelRatio) 加上 transform-origin: 0 0。view.visible(x, y, r) 是個便宜的測試，用來跳過不在這台螢幕上的東西。它從不丟出錯誤。 layout solveLayout() 算出來的版面。 id 螢幕在版面裡的 id。 { ok: true, id, device: { w, h }, canvas: { w, h }, toCanvas, toDevice, scale, angle, polygon, bounds, point(x, y), fromDevice(x, y), matrix(pixelRatio), apply2d(ctx, pixelRatio), applyP5(sk), css(dpr), visible(x, y, r) }，或是螢幕不在版面裡、或是這一版還畫不了的種類時，{ ok: false, reason }。

Every frame the wrapper shows or hides the marker layer from state.tileMarkers, then calls the world. The world draws in canvas units through io.tile.view (view.apply2d(ctx, pixelRatio) or view.applyP5(sk)), and computes from io.tile.time() and io.tile.seed: that is the one place a tiled world reads a clock, and it is the shared one. world The world to wrap ({ name, params, init, update, render, dispose }). It is not changed. tile What joinTile() returned. A world: the same name and params plus tileMarkers; init(ctx) gets ctx.tile and update(dt, state, io) gets io.tile; inner is the world you gave.

每一幀，包裝先依 state.tileMarkers 顯示或隱藏標記圖層，再呼叫世界。世界透過 io.tile.view 用畫布單位畫（view.apply2d(ctx, pixelRatio) 或 view.applyP5(sk)），並從 io.tile.time() 和 io.tile.seed 算：這是拼接的世界唯一讀時鐘的地方，而且讀的是共同的那個。 world 要包的世界（{ name, params, init, update, render, dispose }）。它本身不會被改動。 tile joinTile() 回傳的東西。 一個世界：名字和參數一樣，多了 tileMarkers。init(ctx) 拿到 ctx.tile，update(dt, state, io) 拿到 io.tile。inner 是你給的那個世界。

It checks the version, the reference (one of the devices), the canvas, the plane, and for every device its id (once), whole pixels, a similarity with a scale whose matrix3x3 matches it, or for kind: 'window' a pose. A tile refuses a layout that does not pass and keeps the one it had. Not the same function as @openav/surface's validateLayout(), which checks a phone control-surface layout: import one under another name (import { validateLayout as validateTileLayout } from '@openav/tile') when a page needs both. @openav/output has its own file and its own check, parseOutputLayout(). L A layout, for example parsed from a layout.json file. { ok: boolean, errors: string[] }: ok when errors is empty.

它檢查版本、基準（必須是其中一台裝置）、畫布、平面，以及每台裝置的 id（不能重複）、整數像素、有縮放的相似轉換而且 matrix3x3 跟它一致，或是 kind: 'window' 時要有 pose。螢幕會拒絕沒通過的版面，保留原本那份。 跟 @openav/surface 的 validateLayout() 不是同一個函式，那個檢查的是手機控制面板的版面：頁面兩個都要用時，把其中一個換個名字引入（import { validateLayout as validateTileLayout } from '@openav/tile'）。@openav/output 有它自己的檔案和檢查，parseOutputLayout()。 L 一份版面，例如從 layout.json 讀進來的。 { ok: boolean, errors: string[] }：errors 是空的時候 ok。

A layout says it with "format". A file written for art-align, the module this package grew from, says "contract": "art-align/v1": validateLayout() accepts both keys and both names, so such a file loads unchanged. A mapping always says the new name in its format. The schema is packages/align/align.schema.json. It is open at the top level: a layout may carry keys of its own (a note, a title), which every function ignores. 'open-audiovisual/align@1'.

佈局用 "format" 寫出格式。給 art-align（這個套件的前身）寫的檔案是 "contract": "art-align/v1"：validateLayout() 兩個鍵、兩個名字都收，所以那種檔案不用改就讀得進來。映射的 format 一律寫新的名字。 結構描述在 packages/align/align.schema.json。最上層是開放的：佈局可以帶自己的鍵（附註、標題），每個函式都會略過。 字串 'open-audiovisual/align@1'。

tiles: a two-tone checkerboard per segment with cell names, its name, size and metres, diagonals, a centre cross and circle (the look of a vendor's chart). grid: a line every 100 art px and every 500 with the absolute art coordinate. edges: frames, corners, the middle of each side. crosshair: a cross, thirds, three circles (an ellipse means the proportions are wrong). bars: colour bars (BAR_VARIANTS). The list an align command accepts (normalizeAlignArgs()); a work without vendor images passes a narrower list. ['tiles', 'grid', 'edges', 'crosshair', 'bars', 'vendor']; vendor is last on purpose, a page cycling with the arrow keys can treat it apart.
