tiles：每段一組深淺棋盤，有格名、段名、尺寸和公尺、對角線、中心十字和圓（廠商對位圖的樣子）。grid：每 100 作品 px 一條線，每 500 一條粗線並寫上作品的絕對座標。edges：外框、四角、每邊的中點。crosshair：十字、三分線、三個圓（變成橢圓就是比例錯了）。bars：色條（BAR_VARIANTS）。 對位指令接受的清單（normalizeAlignArgs()）。沒有廠商圖的作品可以給一份比較短的清單。 ['tiles', 'grid', 'edges', 'crosshair', 'bars', 'vendor']。vendor 刻意放最後，用方向鍵輪播的頁面可以另外處理它。

A stack aligned is evenly brighter; misaligned it shows double edges (the cells pattern colours the two tiles differently so it shows). A band needs a blend on both sides, or it is twice as bright: blendWeight(). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. { stacks: [{ segment, tiles }], bands: [{ a, b, rect }] }, rect in art px.
疊投對準了是均勻加亮，沒對準會看到雙邊（逐格圖樣把兩塊塗成不同顏色，一看就知道）。熔接帶兩邊都要有熔接，不然會兩倍亮：見 blendWeight()。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 { stacks: [{ segment, tiles }], bands: [{ a, b, rect }] }，rect 是作品 px。

Scaled and turned feeds included: it is the inverse of desktopToArt(). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. ax Art px. ay Art px. [{ tile, output, x, y }, …], empty when the point is in no segment.
縮放和轉過的 feed 都算進去：它是 desktopToArt() 的反向。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 ax 作品 px。 ay 作品 px。 [{ tile, output, x, y }, …]，這一點不在任何段裡時是空陣列。

Every pattern drawn through it runs on as one continuous band: the right picture of the wall, before it is cut into outputs. drawSource() draws the patterns this way, so they can go through the same warp as the work. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. A mapping with view: 'art', its desktop the art canvas, its one output ART; a stacked segment appears once.
透過它畫的圖樣都是連續的一整條：切成輸出之前，牆的樣子。drawSource() 就是這樣畫圖樣的，所以圖樣能跟作品走同一條 warp。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 一份 view: 'art' 的映射，桌面就是作品畫布，唯一的輸出叫 ART，疊投的段只出現一次。

smpte: SMPTE-style bars in full-range RGB, with near-black steps of 0, 2 and 4 %: see 4 % and not 2 % and black is right. steps: grey in tens, then 1 % steps near black and near white (crushed blacks, clipped whites). ramp: one gradient across the whole art canvas, so it runs on across segments: two segments of different brightness or colour show a step on the wall. ['smpte', 'steps', 'ramp'].
smpte：全幅 RGB 的 SMPTE 類色條，近黑三格是 0、2、4%：看得到 4%、分不出 2%，黑位就對了。steps：每 10% 一階的灰，再加近黑和近白每格 1%（看黑有沒有被吃掉、白有沒有被削掉）。ramp：跨整張作品畫布的一條漸層，所以跨段是連續的：兩段亮度或色偏不同，牆上會看到一個斷層。 三個字串 ['smpte', 'steps', 'ramp']。
So a 1920 × 1200 projector takes 11 + 11 bits: with inverses and the white and black references, 46 frames (graySequence()). size Pixels along one axis. ceil(log2(size)), at least 1.
所以 1920 × 1200 的投影機要 11 + 11 個位元，加上反相和全白、全黑兩張基準，共 46 張（graySequence()）。 size 一個軸向的像素數。 ceil(log2(size))，至少 1。

The bands come from the segment's blend: { l, r, t, b, curve, gamma } (art px; curve cosine by default, linear or smoothstep). The weight is light, not a pixel value: a projector is sent weight (1 / gamma) (gamma 2.2 by default). This is the layout's blend, worked out from numbers. The calibration's feather (featherAt()) is the one set by eye in the venue. A brightness field measured by a camera is on the roadmap, not here. tile One of mapping.tiles. ax Art px. ay Art px. 0 outside the tile, 1 inside away from its bands, a ramp across each band.

帶子來自段的 blend: { l, r, t, b, curve, gamma }（作品 px，曲線預設 cosine，也可以是 linear 或 smoothstep）。權重是光量，不是像素值：送進投影機的是 weight (1 / gamma)（gamma 預設 2.2）。 這是佈局寫的熔接，從數字算出來。校正檔的羽化（featherAt()）是現場用眼睛調的那一種。用相機量出來的亮度場在路線圖上，這裡沒有。 tile mapping.tiles 其中一塊。 ax 作品 px。 ay 作品 px。 塊外是 0，塊內離帶子遠的地方是 1，帶子裡是一段斜坡。

GL's origin is bottom-left, so a tile's viewport is (dst.x, H − dst.y − dst.h, dst.w, dst.h); then everything is divided by the pixel ratio. Forgetting that division draws every tile twice as big over its neighbours: it is done here, once. A turned tile carries rotate: a viewport cannot turn it (createWarpRenderer() can). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. pixelRatio The renderer's pixel ratio (three's setViewport takes CSS pixels). buffer The canvas's drawing buffer, physical px { w, h }. { full, mismatch, tiles: [{ name, viewport, scissor, uvOffset, uvScale, rotate? }] }. mismatch is true when the buffer is not the desktop's size.

GL 的原點在左下，所以一塊的 viewport 是 (dst.x, H − dst.y − dst.h, dst.w, dst.h)，再全部除以 pixel ratio。忘了除，每一塊都會畫成兩倍大蓋到隔壁：這件事在這裡做一次就好。轉過的塊帶 rotate：viewport 轉不了（createWarpRenderer() 轉得了）。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 pixelRatio renderer 的 pixel ratio（three 的 setViewport 吃 CSS 像素）。 buffer 畫布的繪圖緩衝區，實體像素 { w, h }。 { full, mismatch, tiles: [{ name, viewport, scissor, uvOffset, uvScale, rotate? }] }。緩衝區跟桌面大小不同時 mismatch 為 true。

A calibration is { format, savedAt, variants: { : { zones: { : zone } } } }: one zone per tile (corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks) for each variant of the work's layout. A file written as "contract": "art-align-cal/v1" loads unchanged (normalizeCalibration()) and is written back with the new name. The schema is packages/align/align-calibration.schema.json. 'open-audiovisual/align-calibration@1'.

校正檔是 { format, savedAt, variants: { : { zones: { : 區 } } } }：作品佈局的每一種擺法、每一塊各一區（四角、網格、羽化、gamma、亮度、遮罩）。寫成 "contract": "art-align-cal/v1" 的檔案不用改就讀得進來（normalizeCalibration()），存回去時用新的名字。結構描述在 packages/align/align-calibration.schema.json。 字串 'open-audiovisual/align-calibration@1'。

A segment that is not a whole number of cells ends with part cells, named like the others. seg A segment { x, y, w, h } (art px). size Cell size, px. ax Art px. ay Art px. Row letters and column number.
段不是格子的整數倍時，最後一欄或一列是殘格，照樣命名。 seg 一段 { x, y, w, h }（作品 px）。 size 格子大小，px。 ax 作品 px。 ay 作品 px。 列字母加欄號。

Cells are named as on a vendor's chart: rows A, B, C … top to bottom, columns 1, 2, 3 … left to right, starting at each segment's top-left. The same name is what highlightCell() outlines. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. ax Art px. ay Art px. :. The segment always comes first: a segment may itself be called A1.
格名跟廠商對位圖一樣：列 A、B、C⋯ 由上往下，欄 1、2、3⋯ 由左往右，每段從自己的左上角算起。highlightCell() 框的也是這個名字。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 ax 作品 px。 ay 作品 px。 :。段名一定在前面：段本身也可能叫 A1。
The inverse of cellAt(): from a name said in the venue to where it is. seg A segment { x, y, w, h }. size Cell size, px. name A cell name, any case (c8). { x, y, w, h }, art px.
cellAt() 的反向：從現場報的格名找出它在哪裡。 seg 一段 { x, y, w, h }。 size 格子大小，px。 name 格名，大小寫都行（c8）。 { x, y, w, h }，作品 px。

A layout can set its own with cells: { size }, for the whole layout or one segment. w Segment width, px. h Segment height, px. Pixels: one of 240, 200, 192, 160, 150, 120, 100, 96, 80, 60, 50, 40, or round(h / 5).
佈局可以用 cells: { size } 自己指定，整份或單一段都行。 w 段寬，px。 h 段高，px。 像素：240、200、192、160、150、120、100、96、80、60、50、40 其中之一，或 round(h / 5)。

Channel separation is what lets one photo measure three projectors at once, and makes a camera bumped between shots impossible for those three. A colour camera still mixes the channels a little: the crosstalk matrix to correct that is part of the camera half (not built). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. channels The channels to hand out. One { : 'r' | 'g' | 'b' } per pass, in the layout's order of outputs.
通道分離讓一張照片同時量三台投影機，這三台之間「拍攝中間相機被碰到」這件事就不可能發生。彩色相機還是會讓通道互相滲一點：修正它的串擾矩陣屬於相機那一半（還沒做）。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 channels 要分配的通道。 每一輪一個 { : 'r' | 'g' | 'b' }，照佈局裡輸出的順序。

In the browser only (it makes a canvas). source The desktop frame. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. doc Where the new canvas is made (a test passes its own). A canvas of art.w × art.h, black where no tile reads.
只能在瀏覽器裡用（它要建立 canvas）。 source 桌面那一幀。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 doc 在哪裡建立新的 canvas（測試可以傳自己的）。 一張 art.w × art.h 的 canvas，沒有塊讀到的地方是黑的。

For a thumbnail or a recording of what the work looked like, from a capture of the outputs. A stacked segment is drawn twice with the same content. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. [[sx, sy, sw, sh, dx, dy, dw, dh], …]: from the desktop (dst) to the art canvas (src).
從輸出的擷取畫面做縮圖，或錄下作品的樣子時用。疊投的段會用同樣的內容畫兩次。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 [[sx, sy, sw, sh, dx, dy, dw, dh], …]：從桌面（dst）到作品畫布（src）。

A layout (open-audiovisual/align@1) is one JSON object: art (the canvas the work draws, the wall unrolled flat), segments (rectangles of it, the wall's pieces), outputs (rectangles of the desktop, one per signal), feeds (which segment goes into which output, and where). This one table is what makes the promise of the package hold: drawPattern() draws the test patterns tile by tile from it, vendorPlacements() places the vendor's images from it, and blitPlan(), createBlitter() and createWarpRenderer() put the work on the outputs from it. So a pattern that is right on the wall means the work is right on the wall. src is in art-canvas pixels, dst in desktop pixels (the physical pixels a fullscreen browser covers, origin top-left). scale is dst over src (both 1 at 1:1). A stacked segment (one segment into two outputs) has two tiles. layout The layout (open-audiovisual/align@1, or art-align/v1). { format, id, title, art, desktop, outputs, segments, tiles, vendor, warnings }, plus params and ident when the layout has them. A tile: { name, segment, output, src, dst, scale, visible, color, meters, cell, blend }, plus rotate, label, plan, masks when written.

一份佈局（open-audiovisual/align@1）是一個 JSON 物件：art（作品畫的畫布，牆攤平之後的樣子）、segments（畫布上的矩形，牆的一塊一塊）、outputs（桌面上的矩形，一路訊號一個）、feeds（哪一塊送進哪一路、貼在哪裡）。 整個套件的保證就靠這一張表：drawPattern() 照它一塊一塊畫校正圖樣，vendorPlacements() 照它擺廠商的圖，blitPlan()、createBlitter()、createWarpRenderer() 照它把作品送上輸出。所以圖樣在牆上對了，作品在牆上就對。 src 是作品畫布的像素，dst 是桌面的像素（全螢幕瀏覽器蓋住的實體像素，原點在左上）。scale 是 dst 除以 src（1:1 時兩個都是 1）。疊投的段（一段送進兩路）會有兩塊。 layout 佈局（open-audiovisual/align@1，或 art-align/v1）。 { format, id, title, art, desktop, outputs, segments, tiles, vendor, warnings }，佈局有寫時多 params 和 ident。一塊 tile：{ name, segment, output, src, dst, scale, visible, color, meters, cell, blend }，有寫時多 rotate、label、plan、masks。

It is on while document.body has the class align, which the work adds (its own key or button). Then every key belongs to it, caught in the capture phase: C corners, G mesh, E feather, K masks; Tab or a digit picks a zone, [ ] a handle; the arrows move 1 px (Shift ×10, Alt ×0.25); + − mesh density; Q turns the zone 90°; N adds a mask; , . brightness; P the next source; V the next variant; O hides the frames; Backspace puts a handle back; ⌘S saves, ⌘Z undoes, L lists the backups, X exports, I imports; A leaves. The panel speaks English, or Chinese with lang: 'zh' (by default it follows the page's lang). A corner that would fold the quad does not move, and says so. It edits the calibration; it does not draw the picture. The page draws it through the calibration (with createWarpRenderer()) on each onChange('cal'): example 31 does all of it on one screen. o canvas (the picture, object-fit: contain in its parent), region (the part of the desktop it shows), getMapping(), store (createCalStore()), state ({ mode, source, variant, zone }), cal (normalized), onChange(why) ('cal' or 'source': rebuild the warp), setMode(mode) ('play' to leave: the caller removes body.align), and optionally setVariant(v), replaceCalibration(cal) (a backup or an imported file: normalize it and call setCalibration), variants, sources, sourceNames, lang. { draw(), setCalibration(cal), setState(s), save(), ui }.

document.body 有 align 這個 class 時就開著，這個 class 由作品自己加（用它自己的鍵或按鈕）。開著的時候每個鍵都歸它，在 capture 階段攔下：C 四角、G 網格、E 羽化、K 遮罩。Tab 或數字選區，[ ] 換把手。方向鍵移 1 px（Shift ×10、Alt ×0.25）。+ − 網格密度，Q 整區轉 90°，N 新增遮罩，, . 調亮度，P 換畫面，V 換擺法，O 隱藏外框，Backspace 把手回原位。⌘S 存檔、⌘Z 復原、L 備份清單、X 匯出、I 匯入，A 離開。 面板說英文，lang: 'zh' 時說中文（預設跟著頁面的 lang）。會讓四邊形翻面的角不會動，並且會說明。 它改的是校正檔，不畫畫面。頁面在每次 onChange('cal') 時透過校正檔把畫面畫出來（用 createWarpRenderer()）：範例 31 在一個螢幕上把這些全部做完。 o canvas（畫面，在父元素裡 object-fit: contain）、region（它顯示的那一塊桌面）、getMapping()、store（createCalStore()）、state（{ mode, source, variant, zone }）、cal（正規化過的）、onChange(why)（'cal' 或 'source'：重建 warp）、setMode(mode)（'play' 表示離開：由呼叫端拿掉 body.align），以及選填的 setVariant(v)、replaceCalibration(cal)（備份或匯入的檔案：正規化之後呼叫 setCalibration）、variants、sources、sourceNames、lang。 一個物件 { draw(), setCalibration(cal), setState(s), save(), ui }。

The plain output: the work renders once into a render target the size of the art canvas, and this copies it with blitPlan()'s viewports and scissors. It asks the renderer for the canvas's size (not the window's) and divides by its pixel ratio. It cannot turn a tile (throws for a turned feed) nor apply a calibration: createWarpRenderer() does both. THREE The three.js module. renderer The renderer of the desktop canvas. onMismatch Called once when the canvas is not the desktop's size. blit(texture, mapping) → { mismatch }: clears the canvas and copies each tile from the texture (an art.w × art.h render target).

最基本的輸出：作品先畫進一張作品畫布大小的 render target，這個函式再用 blitPlan() 的 viewport 和 scissor 貼出去。畫布大小問 renderer 本人（不是視窗），並除以它的 pixel ratio。 它轉不了塊（遇到轉過的 feed 會丟錯），也套不了校正：這兩件事 createWarpRenderer() 都做得到。 THREE three.js 模組。 renderer 桌面畫布的 renderer。 onMismatch 畫布跟桌面大小不同時呼叫一次。 blit(texture, mapping) → { mismatch }：清空畫布，再把每一塊從貼圖（art.w × art.h 的 render target）貼過來。

The prefix is the address of your saved work: change it and the old calibration is not found. A page that used art-align's default (art-align) keeps its calibration: with the default prefix, load(), listBackups() and readBackup() read the old keys while the new ones are empty (never writing them), and the first save writes the new keys, the old backups included. exportTo() downloads the file and importFrom() opens a file picker (in a page, from a click). A browser page cannot start itself at boot nor pick a display: those need an app with a bridge. bridge An object an app's preload exposes: load, saveCalibration, saveState, listBackups, readBackup, exportCalibration, importCalibration, displays, nextDisplay, setAutostart. prefix The localStorage keys: /calibration, /state, /backups. storage Where to keep them (a test passes one in memory). { kind, load(), saveCalibration(cal), saveState(st), listBackups(), readBackup(name), exportTo(cal), importFrom(), displays(), nextDisplay(), setAutostart(on) }, every method a Promise. kind is 'browser' or 'electron'.

prefix 就是存檔的位址：改了它，舊的校正檔就找不到了。用過 art-align 預設值（art-align）的頁面，校正檔還在：用預設 prefix 時，新的鍵還是空的，load()、listBackups()、readBackup() 就讀舊的鍵（從不寫入），第一次存檔才寫進新的鍵，舊的備份也一起帶過去。 exportTo() 會下載檔案，importFrom() 會開檔案選擇器（在網頁裡要從點擊觸發）。瀏覽器頁面不能開機自動啟動，也不能選螢幕：那些要有 bridge 的 app。 bridge app 的 preload 提供的物件：load、saveCalibration、saveState、listBackups、readBackup、exportCalibration、importCalibration、displays、nextDisplay、setAutostart。 prefix localStorage 的鍵：/calibration、/state、/backups。 storage 存在哪裡（測試可以傳一個記憶體裡的）。 { kind, load(), saveCalibration(cal), saveState(st), listBackups(), readBackup(name), exportTo(cal), importFrom(), displays(), nextDisplay(), setAutostart(on) }，每個方法都回傳 Promise。kind 是 'browser' 或 'electron'。

Hand its texture to createWarpRenderer() instead of the work's: the pattern goes out through the calibration. The ident screen's still part is drawn once and kept; only the moving part is drawn again. THREE The three.js module. size The art canvas { w, h }. doc Where its canvas is made. lang The language of the words drawn. { canvas, texture, draw(mapping, source, t = 0) → texture, dispose() }; t (seconds) moves the ident screen's sweep and clock.

把它的貼圖交給 createWarpRenderer() 取代作品的貼圖：圖樣就透過校正檔送出去。認機畫面靜止的部分只畫一次存起來，只重畫會動的部分。 THREE three.js 模組。 size 作品畫布 { w, h }。 doc 在哪裡建立它的 canvas。 lang 畫出來的字用哪種語言。 { canvas, texture, draw(mapping, source, t = 0) → texture, dispose() }。t（秒）讓認機畫面的光帶和時鐘動起來。

build() again whenever the calibration changes (it is cheap: (n + 1)² vertices a tile); zones is normalizeCalibration(…).variants[variant].zones. draw() renders the texture through every mesh onto the region of the desktop this canvas shows, { x, y, w, h }: the whole desktop for one window across every output, or one output for one window per output. Uncalibrated, it puts every pixel where createBlitter() does, and it can turn a feed. The texture can be the work's render target or a pattern (createPatternTexture()): both go through the same warp. @openav/output's windows use a CSS homography and cannot show a mesh, a feather or a mask: this is the WebGL path for those (see the chapter, "Output, tile and align"). THREE The three.js module. { meshes, build(mapping, zones, n = 32), draw(renderer, texture, region), dispose() }.

校正一變就重新 build()（很便宜：一塊 (n + 1)² 個頂點）。zones 是 normalizeCalibration(…).variants[variant].zones。draw() 把貼圖透過每片網格畫到這張畫布負責的那一塊桌面 { x, y, w, h }：一個視窗橫跨所有輸出時是整個桌面，每路輸出一個視窗時是那一路。 沒校正過時，每個像素的位置跟 createBlitter() 一樣，而且它轉得了 feed。貼圖可以是作品的 render target，也可以是圖樣（createPatternTexture()）：兩者走同一條 warp。 @openav/output 的視窗用的是 CSS homography，顯示不了網格、羽化和遮罩：這是那些功能的 WebGL 路線（見手冊章節的「output、tile 與 align」）。 THREE three.js 模組。 一個物件 { meshes, build(mapping, zones, n = 32), draw(renderer, texture, region), dispose() }。

Only the arithmetic. Reading those bits out of photos (thresholding each camera pixel against the frame and its inverse) is the camera half, which is not built. bits 0/1 or false/true, one per frame of an axis, highest bit first. The projector coordinate.
只有數學那一步。從照片讀出這些位元（每個相機像素用那張圖和它的反相比出閾值）是相機那一半，還沒做。 bits 0/1 或 false/true，一軸的每張圖一個，最高位在前。 投影機座標。

A zone, in zone coordinates (u, v) from 0 to 1 over the tile's segment: the desktop position is the perspective of the four corners (segment top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, desktop px) plus the mesh's shift there (cols × rows points, desktop px, bilinear between). The brightness is gain × feather (1 / gamma), black inside masks ({ u, v, w, h }). The feather is a share of the zone on each side, 0 to 0.5. Uncalibrated is exactly the plain mapping: every point lands where the 1:1 or scaled copy puts it. tile One of mapping.tiles. { corners, mesh: { cols, rows, d }, feather: { l, r, t, b }, gamma, gain, masks }.

一區用區內座標 (u, v)，0 到 1，蓋住這塊的段：桌面位置是四個 corners（段的左上、右上、右下、左下，桌面 px）決定的透視，加上 mesh 在那裡的位移（cols × rows 個點，桌面 px，中間雙線性內插）。亮度是 gain × feather (1 / gamma)，masks（{ u, v, w, h }）裡面是黑的。羽化是每一邊佔這區的比例，0 到 0.5。 沒校正過就跟原本的映射一模一樣：每一點都落在 1:1 或縮放貼法放的位置。 tile mapping.tiles 其中一塊。 一區 { corners, mesh: { cols, rows, d }, feather: { l, r, t, b }, gamma, gain, masks }。

For "where is the point I am pointing at": a click on a preview, a cell name to say over the radio. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. x Desktop px. y Desktop px. { tile, segment, output, x, y, cell }, in the tile drawn last there. A turned feed is turned back.
回答「我指的這裡是哪裡」：在預覽上點一下，或者在對講機裡報一個格名。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 x 桌面 px。 y 桌面 px。 { tile, segment, output, x, y, cell }，取那裡最後畫的那一塊。轉過的 feed 會轉回來。

The second thing a layout drives: the image a hardware or splitter vendor sets their side up with, read from the same layout as the patterns and the output, so the three cannot disagree. The header says "pixel to pixel, no scaling" when every block is 1:1, and warns when one is scaled. Save it as a PNG at the output's full size (canvas.toBlob) and send that: a scaled copy is not a chart. ctx A context of the output's size (output.w × output.h). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. outputId Which output. opts title, note, date, version (the footer), logo (an image: placed in a corner that covers nothing, or left out), lang ('zh'). { tiles, cuts }, plus logo (its rectangle, or null when no corner was free) when a logo was given.

佈局驅動的第二件事：硬體或分割器廠商照著設定他們那一端的圖，跟圖樣和輸出讀同一份佈局，所以三者不可能對不上。每一塊都是 1:1 時頁頭寫「pixel to pixel，不縮放」，有縮放的塊時會警告。 用這路輸出的原尺寸存成 PNG（canvas.toBlob）再寄出去：縮小過的就不算對位圖了。 ctx 跟這路輸出一樣大（output.w × output.h）的 context。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 outputId 哪一路輸出。 opts title、note、date、version（頁尾）、logo（圖片：放在不壓到任何東西的角落，放不下就不畫）、lang（'zh'）。 { tiles, cuts }，有給 logo 時多一個 logo（它的矩形，沒有空角落時是 null）。

Gray-code frames measure which projector pixel lands where, so they are drawn in output pixels, on the desktop, not on the art canvas and not through the calibration's warp. With more than three projectors, run channelPlan()'s passes one after another. To shoot: camera on a tripod, fixed exposure, focus and white balance, the room dark, one photo per frame in the order of graySequence(). What would read those photos is not built. ctx Any 2D context: a canvas on the page, an OffscreenCanvas. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. frame One frame of graySequence(): { kind: 'white' | 'black' } or { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }. assign { : channel }; an output without one stays black. The default is the first pass only. view Desktop px → canvas px: scale k, then shift x, y. k: 0.25 draws a quarter-size preview.

格雷碼圖量的是「投影機的哪個像素落在哪裡」，所以畫在輸出像素、也就是桌面上，不畫在作品畫布上，也不經過校正的 warp。超過三台投影機時，把 channelPlan() 的每一輪依序跑完。 拍法：相機上腳架，曝光、對焦、白平衡都鎖定，場地關燈，照 graySequence() 的順序一張圖拍一張。讀這些照片的程式還沒做。 ctx 任何 2D context：頁面上的 canvas、OffscreenCanvas 都可以。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 frame graySequence() 的其中一張：{ kind: 'white' | 'black' } 或 { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }。 assign { : 通道 }，沒分到通道的輸出全黑。預設只有第一輪。 view 桌面 px → 畫布 px：先乘 k，再平移 x、y。k: 0.25 畫四分之一大小的預覽。

The first thing to show on arrival: which surface is which, which way is up, whether the corners join. For a still, a test or a chart; a live page draws the base once and the live part every frame (createPatternTexture() does). g An art-canvas context. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. t Seconds, for the sweep. o { per, now, lang }, as for the two parts.
到場第一個要放的畫面：哪一面是哪一面、哪邊朝上、牆角有沒有接起來。拿來截圖、測試或附在對位圖上。即時的頁面把底圖畫一次，會動的部分每格重畫（createPatternTexture() 就是這樣做的）。 g 作品畫布的 context。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 t 秒，給光帶用。 o { per, now, lang }，跟兩個部分一樣。

The surfaces come from the layout's ident.surfaces ({ id, x, y, w, h, meters, name, big, hue, edges: { left, right, top, bottom }, arrow }); without an ident block each segment is a surface named after itself. With metres, every surface of a room gets the same size of letters at any density, and the circle is a whole number of metres (an ellipse on the wall means the proportions are wrong). g An art-canvas context. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. lang The language of the words drawn.

面來自佈局的 ident.surfaces（{ id, x, y, w, h, meters, name, big, hue, edges: { left, right, top, bottom }, arrow }）。沒有 ident 區塊時，每一段就是一面，用段名命名。有寫公尺時，同一個房間的每一面不論密度都用同樣大小的字，圓的直徑是整數公尺（在牆上變成橢圓就是比例錯了）。 g 作品畫布的 context。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 lang 畫出來的字用哪種語言。

The band runs along the surfaces of ident.sweep one after another as one strip, so the order of the walls and every corner show at a glance; the clock shows whether a picture is late or frozen. 15 frames a second are plenty. g An art-canvas context, the base already drawn. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. t Seconds. per Seconds the band takes over one surface. now The clock's time.
光帶沿著 ident.sweep 的那幾面接成一條連續地走，牆的順序和每個牆角一眼就看得出來。時鐘看畫面有沒有延遲、有沒有凍住。每秒 15 格就夠了。 g 已經畫好底圖的作品畫布 context。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 t 秒。 per 光帶走過一面要幾秒。 now 時鐘顯示的時間。

On the wall the frame is that output's signal edge: a frame that is not where the wall's edge is, is a splitter or display setting, not the layout. ctx Any 2D context: a canvas on the page, an OffscreenCanvas. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. view Desktop px → canvas px: scale k, then shift x, y. k: 0.25 draws a quarter-size preview.
在牆上，這個框就是那一路訊號的邊界：框跟牆邊對不上時，問題在分割器或顯示設定，不在佈局。 ctx 任何 2D context：頁面上的 canvas、OffscreenCanvas 都可以。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 view 桌面 px → 畫布 px：先乘 k，再平移 x、y。k: 0.25 畫四分之一大小的預覽。

This is the first of the three things one layout drives, and the reason to trust the other two: every pattern takes the same tiles as the work, so a pattern that is right on the wall means the work is right. Line widths, circles and cells are in target pixels, so on an output whose processor scales a circle stays round. A preview: pass view: { k } with k the canvas width over the desktop width. Lines never get thinner than one canvas pixel. ctx Any 2D context: a canvas on the page, an OffscreenCanvas. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. pattern One of ALIGN_PATTERNS. 'vendor' draws nothing (a page places those images itself). opts view (desktop → canvas, as for withTile()), overlay (a see-through background over the work), clear (false: keep what is there), variant (the bars' kind), highlight ('Q2:B3'), outputs (also the outputs' frames), lang ('zh' for the words). { drawn }: the number of tiles drawn.

這是一份佈局驅動的三件事的第一件，也是相信另外兩件的理由：每種圖樣都走跟作品一樣的那些塊，所以圖樣在牆上對了，作品就對。線寬、圓和格子都以目標像素為單位，所以處理器有縮放的輸出上，圓還是圓的。 預覽：傳 view: { k }，k 是畫布寬除以桌面寬。線再細也不會小於一個畫布像素。 ctx 任何 2D context：頁面上的 canvas、OffscreenCanvas 都可以。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 pattern ALIGN_PATTERNS 其中之一。'vendor' 什麼都不畫（那些圖由頁面自己擺）。 opts view（桌面 → 畫布，同 withTile()）、overlay（疊在作品上的半透明底）、clear（false：保留原本的畫面）、variant（色條種類）、highlight（'Q2:B3'）、outputs（順便畫每路輸出的外框）、lang（'zh' 時字用中文）。 { drawn }：畫了幾塊。

Drawn on the art canvas (through artView()), so the picture goes through the same warp as the work: a pattern that is right on the wall means the work is right, one warp later. g A context of the art canvas's size (art.w × art.h). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. source One of PATTERN_SOURCES except live. lang The language of the words drawn.
畫在作品畫布上（透過 artView()），所以這張畫面跟作品走同一條 warp：圖樣在牆上對了，作品也對，多一層 warp 也一樣。 g 作品畫布大小（art.w × art.h）的 context。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 source PATTERN_SOURCES 其中之一，live 除外。 lang 畫出來的字用哪種語言。
What the cells pattern draws from: use it for a pattern of your own. seg A segment { x, y, w, h }. size Cell size, px. One object per cell; part cells are cut to the segment.
逐格圖樣就是用它畫的，自己做圖樣時也可以用。 seg 一段 { x, y, w, h }。 size 格子大小，px。 一格一個物件，殘格會裁到段內。

The same curve as a layout's cosine blend (blendWeight()), set by eye on site where two projectors overlap: grey 50 % shows the band best. f { l, r, t, b }: each edge's share of the zone, 0 to 0.5. u 0 to 1. v 0 to 1. The product of the four edges' ramps; the shader raises it to 1 / gamma.
跟佈局的餘弦熔接（blendWeight()）同一條曲線，在現場兩台投影機重疊的地方用眼睛調：灰 50% 最看得出帶子。 f { l, r, t, b }：每一邊佔這區的比例，0 到 0.5。 u 0 到 1。 v 0 到 1。 四邊斜坡的乘積，shader 再取 1 / gamma 次方。

A layout may list aliases, other names it answers to (an old address keeps working after a rename). layouts The layouts to look in. name What was asked, for example ?layout= in the address. The layout object itself (not a copy), or null.
佈局可以列出 aliases，也就是它也認的其他名字（改名之後舊網址照樣能用）。 layouts 要找的那一組佈局。 name 要找的名字，例如網址裡的 ?layout=。 佈局物件本身（不是複本），或 null。

For the screen of the person shooting: which frame is on now, so the photo can be named after it. frame One frame of graySequence(): { kind: 'white' | 'black' } or { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }. lang The language of the words drawn. The name.
給拍攝的人看：現在投的是哪一張，照片可以照它命名。 frame graySequence() 的其中一張：{ kind: 'white' | 'black' } 或 { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }。 lang 畫出來的字用哪種語言。 名字。

The truth a decoder is tested against: every coordinate's bits, frame by frame. frame One frame of graySequence(): { kind: 'white' | 'black' } or { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }. coord Projector px along the frame's axis. 0 or 1; a white frame is always 1, a black one 0, an inverse frame the opposite of its pair.
解碼器要對照的答案：每個座標在每一張圖上的位元。 frame graySequence() 的其中一張：{ kind: 'white' | 'black' } 或 { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }。 coord 沿這張圖軸向的投影機 px。 0 或 1。全白永遠是 1，全黑是 0，反相圖跟它那一張相反。
Used by decodeGrayBits() once the bits are read. g A Gray-coded integer. The number it codes.
讀到位元之後，decodeGrayBits() 用它解碼。 g 格雷碼的整數。 它代表的數字。

Why Gray code for structured light: a camera pixel on the border between two stripes can read one bit wrong, and in Gray code that is an error of one projector pixel, not half the picture. n An integer ≥ 0. n ^ (n >>> 1).
結構光為什麼用格雷碼：落在兩條條紋交界的相機像素可能讀錯一個位元，用格雷碼的話誤差只有一個投影機像素，不是半張畫面。 n ≥ 0 的整數。 等於 n ^ (n >>> 1)。

What drawGrayFrame() draws with, so even the finest frame of a 4K output is a few hundred rectangles. frame One frame of graySequence(): { kind: 'white' | 'black' } or { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }. size Projector px along the axis. Half-open ranges; the widest bit is one run, the finest size / 4.
drawGrayFrame() 就是用它畫的，所以 4K 輸出最細的那張也只有幾百個矩形。 frame graySequence() 的其中一張：{ kind: 'white' | 'black' } 或 { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }。 size 軸向的投影機 px。 半開區間。最寬的位元一段，最細的是 size / 4 段。

This, with drawGrayFrame(), is the automatic-alignment part that exists: the pattern generator for camera-in-the-loop alignment. Each projector draws in its own colour channel, so three run at once and one photo per frame measures all three. Capturing the camera, reading the bits out of the photos, the camera ↔ projector correspondence, solving a warp mesh from it and the blend brightness field are not built: they are the roadmap in the chapter. size The projectors' resolution { w, h } (several sizes: give the largest). inverse Each frame followed by its inverse: a per-pixel threshold that copes with uneven light. refs An all-white and an all-black frame first (exposure, and the room's own light). axes Which axes. Frames { kind: 'white' | 'black' } and { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }; bit 0 is the widest stripes.

這個加上 drawGrayFrame()，就是自動對位已經有的部分：相機閉環對位的圖樣產生器。每台投影機只畫在自己的色通道，所以三台同時投，每張一張照片就同時量完三台。相機取像、從照片讀出位元、相機與投影機的對應、從對應解出 warp 網格、熔接的亮度場，這些都還沒做：它們是手冊章節裡的路線圖。 size 投影機解析度 { w, h }（解析度不同時給最大的）。 inverse 每張後面接它的反相：逐像素的閾值，不怕光不均勻。 refs 最前面先投全白和全黑（曝光基準，以及場地本身的光）。 axes 哪幾個軸。 圖的清單：{ kind: 'white' | 'black' } 和 { kind: 'gray', axis, bit, nbits, inverse }，bit 0 是最寬的條紋。

For "it is this one": the operator names a cell, everyone on site sees which. A stacked segment gets it on both projectors. ctx Any 2D context: a canvas on the page, an OffscreenCanvas. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. id :. view Desktop px → canvas px: scale k, then shift x, y. k: 0.25 draws a quarter-size preview. Whether it drew anything.
用來說「就是這一格」：控台報一個格名，現場每個人都看得到是哪一格。疊投的段兩台投影機上都會標。 ctx 任何 2D context：頁面上的 canvas、OffscreenCanvas 都可以。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 id :。 view 桌面 px → 畫布 px：先乘 k，再平移 x、y。k: 0.25 畫四分之一大小的預覽。 有沒有畫。

Useful as the fallback when no layout is given: the test patterns and the align mode then work on a laptop screen as they do on a wall. w Width, whole pixels. h Height, whole pixels. id Its id. title Its title. A layout in open-audiovisual/align@1: segment ALL, output OUT, one feed.
沒給佈局時拿來當預設：校正圖樣和對位模式在筆電螢幕上，就跟在牆上一樣能用。 w 寬，整數像素。 h 高，整數像素。 id 它的 id。 title 它的標題。 一份 open-audiovisual/align@1 的佈局：段 ALL、輸出 OUT、一條 feed。

Its message starts [align] layout does not follow open-audiovisual/align@1: and lists each error on its own line, so a file from the venue is fixed in one go. scaleArt() throws it too, when a value would stop being a whole pixel. id The layout's id, for the message. errors The problems, as validateLayout() writes them.
訊息開頭是 [align] layout does not follow open-audiovisual/align@1:，每個錯誤一行，現場來的檔案一次就能改完。scaleArt() 在某個值不再是整數像素時也丟它。 id 佈局的 id，寫進訊息用。 errors 問題清單，跟 validateLayout() 寫的一樣。

on is true unless it is exactly false. The shape stays the same as the list of patterns grows, so an old control page and a new wall page still understand each other. Send it through a relay (@openav/relay) or any channel you have. a The arguments as they arrived (anything). patterns The patterns this work accepts. fallback What an unknown pattern becomes. { on, pattern }, plus variant and highlight only when they look right.
on 除非明確是 false，否則就是 true。圖樣清單變長，形狀也不會變，所以舊的控制頁和新的牆頁還是講得通。透過中繼（@openav/relay）或任何現成的通道送都可以。 a 收到的參數（什麼都可能）。 patterns 這件作品接受的圖樣。 fallback 不認得的圖樣換成什麼。 { on, pattern }，variant 和 highlight 看起來正確時才會有。

What the align mode edits and saves. A zone the file lacks (a tile added to the layout) is the default; a mask removed on site stays removed, because a saved zone wins over the layout's masks. cal A calibration from a file, a store or nowhere (null). mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. variant Which layout of the work this is: each variant keeps its own zones. { format: 'open-audiovisual/align-calibration@1', savedAt, variants }.

對位模式改的、存的就是它。檔案裡沒有的區（佈局新加的塊）用預設值。現場刪掉的遮罩會維持刪掉，因為存下來的區優先於佈局的遮罩。 cal 從檔案、存放處或什麼都沒有（null）來的校正檔。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 variant 這是作品的哪一種擺法：每種擺法各存各的區。 補完整的校正檔 { format: 'open-audiovisual/align-calibration@1', savedAt, variants }。

What it fills: a feed with no w/h is the segment's size (1:1, or turned for a 90° feed); a feed with no name is its segment's id, or segment@output when the segment goes into several outputs; a segment gets cell, its cell size (cellSizeFor() unless cells.size says); and desktop, when the layout has none, is the outputs' bounding box. computeMapping() calls it first. @openav/surface has a normalizeLayout() too, for phone control surfaces: a different function. layout The layout. A new object; the input is not touched. It also carries warnings from validateLayout().

補的東西：沒寫 w/h 的 feed 等於段的大小（1:1，轉 90° 的 feed 會對調）。沒有 name 的 feed 用段的 id，段送進好幾路時用 段@輸出。每段多一個 cell，也就是格子大小（除非 cells.size 有寫，否則用 cellSizeFor()）。佈局沒寫 desktop 時，用所有輸出的外框。computeMapping() 會先呼叫它。 @openav/surface 也有一個 normalizeLayout()，給手機控制面板用，是不同的函式。 layout 佈局。 一個新的物件，原物件不動。它也帶著 validateLayout() 的 warnings。

A file edited by hand, or from an older version, never breaks the output: what cannot be read takes the default. z A zone from a file (anything). tile One of mapping.tiles. A zone: mesh 2–9 points a side, feather 0–0.5 each, gamma 0.5–4, gain 0–1.5, mask values 0–1.
手改過或舊版的檔案永遠不會讓輸出壞掉：讀不懂的部分就用預設值。 z 檔案裡的一區（什麼都可能）。 tile mapping.tiles 其中一塊。 一區：網格每邊 2 到 9 個點，羽化各 0 到 0.5，gamma 0.5 到 4，亮度 0 到 1.5，遮罩數值 0 到 1。

Pass it to createOutputs(show, { align }): the outputs and the stage's shape come from the layout, and the desk's Import layout also takes the align mode's calibration file, its four corners per output. Each output that one tile fills becomes an output window showing that tile's part of the art canvas (crop, fit: 'stretch' so a scaled feed fills it as the layout says); an output with several tiles, or one a tile does not fill, is listed in skipped with the reason (a window shows one picture). What an output window cannot do, a mesh, a feather, masks and gain, stays in the calibration and is listed by lost(calibration): those need WebGL (createWarpRenderer()), and wiring that into the output window is the next step, not done. layout An align layout, or its mapping. variant Which variant of a calibration to read and write. { id, variant, aspect, outputs: [{ name, crop, fit }], skipped: [{ output, why }], toOutputLayout(calibration), fromOutputLayout(doc, base), lost(calibration) }.

把它交給 createOutputs(show, { align })：輸出和舞台形狀都從佈局來，控台的 Import layout 也收對位模式的校正檔，也就是每路輸出的四個角。被一塊填滿的輸出，各變成一個輸出視窗，顯示那一塊在作品畫布上的部分（crop，fit: 'stretch'，所以有縮放的 feed 會照佈局填滿）。有好幾塊的輸出，或沒有被一塊填滿的輸出，會列在 skipped 並寫出原因（一個視窗只顯示一張畫面）。 輸出視窗做不到的網格、羽化、遮罩和亮度會留在校正檔裡，lost(calibration) 會列出來：那些需要 WebGL（createWarpRenderer()），把它接進輸出視窗是下一步，還沒做。 layout 對位佈局，或它的映射。 variant 要讀寫校正檔的哪一種擺法。 一個物件 { id, variant, aspect, outputs: [{ name, crop, fit }], skipped: [{ output, why }], toOutputLayout(calibration), fromOutputLayout(doc, base), lost(calibration) }。

live is the work itself (the caller draws it); the rest drawSource() paints on the art canvas. White shows even brightness, grey 50 % the blend bands, black light leaks. ['live', 'ident', 'tiles', 'grid', 'edges', 'crosshair', 'bars:smpte', 'bars:steps', 'bars:ramp', 'white', 'gray50', 'black'].

live 是作品本身（由呼叫端畫），其他的由 drawSource() 畫在作品畫布上。全白看亮度均不均勻，灰 50% 看熔接帶，全黑看漏光。 十二個字串 ['live', 'ident', 'tiles', 'grid', 'edges', 'crosshair', 'bars:smpte', 'bars:steps', 'bars:ramp', 'white', 'gray50', 'black']。
The align mode refuses a drag or a nudge that would make it false. q [[x, y] × 4]: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. true when the quad can be used.
對位模式會拒絕會讓它變成 false 的拖曳或微調。 q [[x, y] × 4]：左上、右上、右下、左下。 可以用時為 true。

The way back: corners set in an output window (its E mode) become the starting point of an align calibration, to refine with a mesh and a feather. room One output's room, as in an open-audiovisual/output@1 file. tile The tile, which must fill its output. output That output. base The zone to keep everything but the corners from (the current calibration's, to merge). { zone, dropped, mirrored }: dropped lists overscan and soft when the room has them; mirrored is true after one flip (the quad then runs the other way: createWarpRenderer draws it, the align mode's corner editor refuses to move it).

反過來的路：在輸出視窗（它的 E 模式）調好的角，變成對位校正的起點，再用網格和羽化細調。 room 一路輸出的 room，跟 open-audiovisual/output@1 檔案裡的一樣。 tile 那一塊，必須填滿它的輸出。 output 那一路輸出。 base 除了角以外都沿用的區（要合併時給現在校正檔的那一區）。 { zone, dropped, mirrored }：room 有 overscan、soft 時 dropped 會列出來。翻轉一次之後 mirrored 為 true（四邊形變成反方向：createWarpRenderer 照畫，對位模式的角編輯器不肯移動它）。

The same direction as a feed's rotate in the layout: four turns bring it home. zone A zone: { corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks } (see defaultZone()). dir Quarter turns, clockwise; negative turns back. The same zone, changed.
方向跟佈局裡 feed 的 rotate 一樣：轉四次回到原位。 zone 一區：{ corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks }（見 defaultZone()）。 dir 轉幾個 90°，順時針，負的往回轉。 同一個區，已經改過。
Rows are letters and columns numbers, so C8 reads at once on a ladder: row C, column 8. i The row, from 0. One or more capital letters.
列用字母、欄用數字，所以爬在梯子上也能一眼讀出 C8：第 C 列、第 8 欄。 i 列號，從 0 起算。 一個或多個大寫字母。

A layout is written once at one density; a lighter version of the work (a laptop, a rehearsal) draws fewer pixels and is stretched onto the same outputs. Throws LayoutError when a value stops being a whole pixel. layout The layout as written. k The factor: 0.5 for a work that draws at half the pixels per metre. A new layout (the same object when k is 1). Each feed's place and size on its output is written out, so nothing moves on the wall.
佈局用一種密度寫一次。比較輕的作品版本（筆電、排練）畫比較少的像素，再拉伸到同樣的輸出上。某個值不再是整數像素時丟 LayoutError。 layout 原本寫好的佈局。 k 倍數：作品每公尺只畫一半像素時是 0.5。 一份新的佈局（k 是 1 時回傳原物件）。每條 feed 在輸出上的位置和大小會寫死，牆上什麼都不會動。

The four-corner part of a zone. @openav/output's cornerPin() is the same transform scaled to a box of width × height (and it refuses a quad that is not convex); @openav/tile's homography() fits one to any number of measured points. q [[x, y] × 4]: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, 1]: (u, v) → ((a·u + b·v + c) / w, (d·u + e·v + f) / w), w = g·u + h·v + 1.

一區的四角那部分。@openav/output 的 cornerPin() 是同一個變換，只是縮放到 width × height 的方框（而且不收非凸的四邊形）。@openav/tile 的 homography() 則是從任意多個量到的點擬合出一個。 q [[x, y] × 4]：左上、右上、右下、左下。 [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, 1]：(u, v) → ((a·u + b·v + c) / w, (d·u + e·v + f) / w)，w = g·u + h·v + 1。

A layout (open-audiovisual/align@1) is one JSON object: art (the canvas the work draws, the wall unrolled flat), segments (rectangles of it, the wall's pieces), outputs (rectangles of the desktop, one per signal), feeds (which segment goes into which output, and where). Errors: pixels that are not whole numbers, a segment outside the art canvas, two outputs that overlap on the desktop, a feed that names no segment or output or lands outside its output, two feeds with one name, a turn other than 0, 90, 180 or 270, a format it does not know. Warnings: a segment that goes into no output, two segments that overlap without a blend band (the overlap is twice as bright), and metres whose pixels per metre across and down differ by more than 2 % (on an LED wall, usually one number copied wrong). Run it on a new layout before anything goes on the wall; node tools/check-align-layout.mjs prints the same with the mapping it comes to. Not the same function as @openav/tile's validateLayout() (a layout.json of screens on a table) or @openav/surface's validateLayout() (a phone control surface): import it under another name when a page uses two (import { validateLayout as validateAlignLayout } from '@openav/align'). layout The layout, parsed from its JSON. { ok, errors, warnings }: ok is true when errors is empty. Each message names the place: segments[3] (Q4) lies outside the art canvas: ….

一份佈局（open-audiovisual/align@1）是一個 JSON 物件：art（作品畫的畫布，牆攤平之後的樣子）、segments（畫布上的矩形，牆的一塊一塊）、outputs（桌面上的矩形，一路訊號一個）、feeds（哪一塊送進哪一路、貼在哪裡）。 錯誤：px 不是整數、段超出作品畫布、兩路輸出在桌面上重疊、feed 指不到段或輸出或貼出那一路之外、兩條 feed 同名、旋轉不是 0、90、180、270、不認得的格式。提醒：沒有送進任何一路的段、兩段重疊卻沒有熔接帶（重疊處會兩倍亮），以及公尺換算的橫向與縱向每公尺像素差超過 2%（在 LED 牆上，多半是抄錯一個數字）。 新的佈局在上牆之前先跑一次。node tools/check-align-layout.mjs 會印出一樣的內容，再加上算出來的映射。 跟 @openav/tile 的 validateLayout()（桌上螢幕的 layout.json）、@openav/surface 的 validateLayout()（手機控制面板）都不是同一個函式：一個頁面用到兩個時，換個名字匯入（import { validateLayout as validateAlignLayout } from '@openav/align'）。 layout 解析過的佈局 JSON。 { ok, errors, warnings }：errors 是空的時候 ok 為 true。每則訊息都講得出位置：segments[3] (Q4) lies outside the art canvas: …。

One of the three things a layout drives: the vendor's own chart, laid over the outputs exactly where the layout says they are. If the vendor's chart and the cells pattern disagree, the layout is wrong, not the wall. The images belong to a project and stay out of a public repository. mapping What computeMapping(layout) returned. base A prefix for each file's address. vendor The images, [{ file, output }] or [{ file, rect }] (the layout's vendor by default). [{ file, url, output, rect, pct: { left, top, width, height } }]: pct is the share of the desktop, in %.

佈局驅動的三件事之一：廠商自己的對位圖，照佈局說的位置疊在輸出上。廠商的圖和逐格圖樣對不上時，錯的是佈局，不是牆。這些圖屬於案子本身，不放進公開的 repository。 mapping computeMapping(layout) 的回傳值。 base 每個檔案網址的前綴。 vendor 圖檔清單，[{ file, output }] 或 [{ file, rect }]（預設是佈局的 vendor）。 [{ file, url, output, rect, pct: { left, top, width, height } }]：pct 是佔桌面的百分比。

What the GL mesh, the handles and the outlines are all made of: one formula for where the picture goes. zone A zone: { corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks } (see defaultZone()). u 0 to 1, across the segment. v 0 to 1, down the segment. H The corners' matrix, when you have it already (many points). [x, y]; [NaN, NaN] for a degenerate quad.
GL 網格、把手、外框全都用它算：畫面要去哪裡，只有一條公式。 zone 一區：{ corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks }（見 defaultZone()）。 u 0 到 1，橫跨整段。 v 0 到 1，由上到下。 H 四角的矩陣，已經算好時傳進來（算很多點時）。 [x, y]，四邊形退化時是 [NaN, NaN]。

For a pattern of your own that must take the work's path. The clip is on whole canvas pixels, so two neighbouring tiles share one edge in a scaled preview, with no dark seam. ctx Any 2D context: a canvas on the page, an OffscreenCanvas. tile One of mapping.tiles. view Desktop px → canvas px, { k, x, y }. fn (env) => {}, drawing in art px; env.px is how many art px one canvas pixel is, env.lw(n) a line width never under one canvas pixel. What fn returns.

自己做的圖樣要走作品的路時用它。裁切對齊到整數畫布像素，所以縮小預覽時相鄰兩塊共用同一條邊，不會留一條暗縫。 ctx 任何 2D context：頁面上的 canvas、OffscreenCanvas 都可以。 tile mapping.tiles 其中一塊。 view 桌面 px → 畫布 px，{ k, x, y }。 fn (env) => {}，用作品 px 作畫。env.px 是一個畫布像素等於幾個作品 px，env.lw(n) 是不會小於一個畫布像素的線寬。 fn 的回傳值。

What createWarpRenderer() builds its meshes from; use it to draw a warp with another engine. zone A zone: { corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks } (see defaultZone()). n Cells a side. { pos: Float32Array (x, y), uv: Float32Array (u, v), index: Uint32Array }: (n + 1)² vertices, 2n² triangles.

createWarpRenderer() 用它建網格，換別的引擎畫 warp 時也可以用。 zone 一區：{ corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks }（見 defaultZone()）。 n 每邊幾格。 { pos: Float32Array (x, y), uv: Float32Array (u, v), index: Uint32Array }：(n + 1)² 個頂點、2n² 個三角形。

An output room pins one window: its corners are the window's physical corners, relabelled by rotate and flips. A zone pins one tile: its corners are the segment's, in desktop px, the feed's turn baked into their order. When the tile fills its output the two are the same transform, and this converts one into the other: the room gets the feed's turn as rotate, so a turned tile stays turned. Throws when the tile does not fill its output: a room is the whole window. zone A zone: { corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks } (see defaultZone()). tile The zone's tile, which must fill its output exactly (dst equal to the output). output That output, from the same mapping. { room, dropped }: room is { corners, flipX, flipY, rotate, overscan, soft } (corners 0..1 of the window); dropped lists mesh, feather, masks, gain when the zone has them.

output 的 room 釘住一個視窗：角是視窗的實體角，再依 rotate 和翻轉重新對應。對位的一區釘住一塊：角是段的角，桌面 px，feed 的旋轉已經算進角的順序裡。塊剛好填滿輸出時，兩者是同一個變換，這個函式把一個換成另一個：room 的 rotate 拿 feed 的旋轉，所以轉過的塊還是轉著的。 塊沒有填滿輸出時丟錯：room 就是整個視窗。 zone 一區：{ corners, mesh, feather, gamma, gain, masks }（見 defaultZone()）。 tile 這一區的塊，必須剛好填滿它的輸出（dst 等於輸出）。 output 那一路輸出，來自同一份映射。 { room, dropped }：room 是 { corners, flipX, flipY, rotate, overscan, soft }（corners 是視窗的 0 到 1）。區裡有 mesh、feather、masks、gain 時，dropped 會列出來。

Binding twelve params one by one with the learn chip means twelve clicks and twelve guesses about what to touch next. The wizard walks the list for you: start() arms learn for keys[0], wizard.current says which param it is waiting for ('Turn a knob for: hue (1/12)'), you move a control, it is bound and the next one is armed. At the end learn is disarmed. The console's 🎛 map knobs in order button is this class. It is pure logic on top of the mapper, with no screen of its own. Learn only ever adds routes, so running the wizard twice puts a second control on a param instead of losing the first. While it runs, it owns learn mode: call sync() every frame so that a click on some other learn chip cannot leave it waiting for nothing. Fields to read: active, done (the run reached the end), index, total, order, and added ([{ key, source }], what was bound in this run). While it runs the wizard wraps the mapper's onLearn and puts yours back when it ends, so your own onLearn keeps being called. mapper The Mapper to bind through. keys The param keys to bind, in order, or a function that returns them (it is called when start() runs). onChange Called with the wizard whenever what a banner would show changes: the current param, the position, finished or not.

用 learn 標籤一個一個綁十二個參數，就是點十二次，還要猜十二次下一個該碰哪裡。精靈替你走完整份清單：start() 替 keys[0] 備好 learn，wizard.current 告訴你它在等哪個參數（「Turn a knob for: hue (1/12)」），你動一個控制項，它就綁上去，然後備好下一個。全部結束後，learn 會解除。主控台的 🎛 map knobs in order 按鈕就是這個類別。 它是建在映射上面的純邏輯，沒有自己的畫面。learn 只會新增路由，所以跑兩次精靈，是替參數多加一個控制項，不會弄丟第一個。它在跑的時候擁有 learn 模式：請每個畫面呼叫 sync()，這樣有人點了別的 learn 標籤，也不會讓它空等。 可以讀的欄位：active、done（這一輪走到了最後）、index、total、order，以及 added（[{ key, source }]，這一輪綁了什麼）。 精靈在跑的時候會包住映射的 onLearn，結束時再還給你，所以你自己的 onLearn 照樣會被呼叫。 mapper 要透過它綁定的 Mapper。 keys 要綁定的參數 key，依序排列。也可以是回傳它們的函式（在 start() 執行時呼叫）。 onChange 只要橫幅會顯示的內容改變（目前的參數、位置、有沒有結束），就以這個精靈本身呼叫。

Fetches the address with credentials: 'omit', and importMap()s the text. Any failure (refused address, no fetch, the server answered 404, offline, a site that blocks cross-origin reads, a timeout, a file that is not a map) lands in the report and in mapper.report, where the console shows it, and the routes stay as they were. It is async, so createShow() does not wait for it and the show starts regardless. A map on another site must be served with CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: ); raw GitHub files and gists are. In a show you rarely call it: open the page with ?map=, or pass map: 'maps/a.json' to createShow(). mapper The Mapper to import into. value The address of the map file, checked by parseMapUrl() first. base The page address that relative addresses resolve against. fetchImpl The function that does the request. Replace it to test without a network. timeoutMs Give up after this many milliseconds. The report: what mapper.importMap() returned (source: 'url', address, added, skipped …), or { ok: false, source: 'url', address, error }. The same report is kept in mapper.report.

用 credentials: 'omit' 去抓這個網址，再把文字交給 importMap()。任何失敗（網址被拒絕、沒有 fetch、伺服器回 404、離線、擋住跨來源讀取的網站、逾時、檔案不是映射檔）都會寫進報告和 mapper.report，主控台會顯示出來，路由維持原樣。它是非同步的，所以 createShow() 不會等它，演出照常開始。 別的網站上的映射檔必須用 CORS 提供（Access-Control-Allow-Origin: ），raw GitHub 檔案和 gist 都可以。做演出的時候很少直接呼叫它：開頁面時加上 ?map=，或在 createShow() 傳 map: 'maps/a.json' 就行了。 mapper 要匯入的 Mapper。 value 映射檔的網址，會先經過 parseMapUrl() 檢查。 base 相對網址據以解析的頁面網址。 fetchImpl 真正發出請求的函式。換掉它，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。 timeoutMs 超過這麼多毫秒就放棄。 報告：mapper.importMap() 的回傳值（source: 'url'、address、added、skipped ……），或 { ok: false, source: 'url', address, error }。同一份報告也存在 mapper.report。

A map file is JSON with "format": "openav.map", a version, a world name and a list of routes. parseMap() refuses anything whose format is not this string, so you cannot import some other tool's JSON by accident. The one exception is a bare array (what mapper.toJSON() returns), which is read as version 0.
映射檔是 JSON，裡面有 "format": "openav.map"、version、world 名稱和一份 routes 清單。parseMap() 會拒絕 format 不是這個字串的東西，所以不會誤把別的工具的 JSON 匯進來。唯一的例外是單純的陣列（mapper.toJSON() 回傳的那種），會被當成版本 0 來讀。
The limit is compared with the length of the text (characters), before any parsing, so a huge file cannot freeze the page. A map with more than 500 routes is refused as well, whatever its size.
這個上限是拿文字的長度（字元數）來比，在任何解析之前就比，所以很大的檔案不會讓頁面卡住。路由超過 500 條的映射檔也會被拒絕，不管大小。

serializeMap() writes this number and parseMap() accepts any version from 1 up to it. A newer file gets the message "this build of OAV reads up to version 1. Update OAV or re-export it." A file with no valid version is refused too. Only a bare array of routes counts as version 0.
serializeMap() 寫入這個數字，parseMap() 接受從 1 到它之間的任何版本。更新的檔案會得到這句訊息：this build of OAV reads up to version 1. Update OAV or re-export it. 沒有合法 version 的檔案也會被拒絕。只有單純的路由陣列會被當成版本 0。

The mapper is the only component that connects signals to params, and everything it knows is a list of routes, plain objects. mapper.addRoute({ source: 'midi/cc/74', target: 'bloom' }) makes the param bloom follow the signal midi/cc/74. One signal may drive several params, one param may listen to several signals (the route that wrote last wins), and learn adds routes, it never replaces them. In a show, createShow() builds one, loads the saved routes (or adds the ones you declared in routes) and returns it as show.mapper. A route needs only source and target; addRoute() fills in the rest and returns the stored route: When a signal arrives, each enabled route with that source does five things in order: take the window ((value - inMin) / (inMax - inMin), clamped to 0..1), invert if asked, apply the curve, scale into outMin..outMax, and write. With smooth: 0 the param is overridden at once. With smooth > 0 the result becomes a target that update(dt) glides toward: after smooth seconds the param has covered about 63% of the way. If the target param is a pulse param, the route fires it instead: on every event of a pulse signal, or when a continuous source rises past 0.5. Three optional route fields decide who wins when a knob meets the timeline. mode: 'trim': the route's output is an offset added to the timeline's value, so the timeline keeps moving underneath and the knob only adjusts it; two trim routes on one param add up. mode: 'pickup': like the default, but the route writes…

映射是唯一把訊號接到參數的元件，它知道的一切就是一份路由清單，每條路由是個普通物件。mapper.addRoute({ source: 'midi/cc/74', target: 'bloom' }) 讓參數 bloom 跟著訊號 midi/cc/74 走。一個訊號可以驅動好幾個參數，一個參數也可以聽好幾個訊號（最後寫入的算數），learn 只會新增路由，不會取代。在演出裡，createShow() 會建好一個，載入存起來的路由（或加入你在 routes 宣告的），用 show.mapper 回傳。 一條路由只需要 source 和 target，其餘由 addRoute() 補上，並回傳存下來的路由： 訊號到來的時候，每一條啟用中、source 相符的路由會依序做五件事：取輸入窗（(value - inMin) / (inMax - inMin)，限制在 0..1）、需要的話反轉、套用曲線、縮放到 outMin..outMax、然後寫入。smooth: 0 時參數立刻被覆寫。smooth > 0 時，結果變成一個目標值，由 update(dt) 慢慢滑過去：經過 smooth 秒，參數走完大約 63% 的距離。如果目標是脈衝參數，路由改成觸發它：脈衝訊號每來一次就觸發，連續訊號則是往上越過 0.5 的那一刻觸發。 有三個選填的路由欄位，決定旋鈕碰上時間軸的時候誰說了算。mode: 'trim'：路由的輸出是一個偏移量，加在時間軸的值上面，所以時間軸在底下照樣往前走，旋鈕只是微調，同一個參數上的兩條 trim 路由會相加。mode: 'pickup'：跟預設一樣，但旋鈕要先碰到參數現在的值（離得不到路由輸出範圍的 2%，或兩次讀數之間越過了它），路由才開始寫入，所以參數不會跳。release: 4，任何模式都能用：訊號靜止 4 秒之後路由就放手，時間軸把參數接回去（smooth: 0 是當場放手，否則用大約三倍 smooth 的時間淡回去，trim 是把偏移淡到 0），之後要訊號真的動了才會再接管。mode 和 release 對脈衝參數不起作用。 Learn 是通用版的 MIDI-learn：呼叫 mapper.learn('bloom')，然後動一個東西。第一個移動超過其宣告範圍 5% 的訊號（旋鈕、手、手機傾斜），或第一個觸發的脈衝（按鍵、打擊墊），就會成為一條使用預設值的新路由的來源。再呼叫一次 learn('bloom') 就取消。因為任何脈衝都會立刻被綁定，learn 之前請先把鼓機停掉。 先建好訊號和參數，再建映射。平滑的路由（smooth > 0）只會在 update(dt) 裡寫入參數，trim 路由在那裡跟著時間軸走，release 也是在那裡計時，所以每個畫面都要呼叫 mapper.update(dt)（createShow() 會做）。trim 和 pickup 需要 base 才知道時間軸的值。 路由把參數寫成覆寫值，沒有 release 的話覆寫是黏住的：映射的訊號一動，時間軸就不再驅動那個參數，直到你呼叫 params.clearOverride(key)（控台上的 ✕）。trim 路由也是覆寫：它寫進去的是時間軸的值加上偏移。 平滑的路由只在滑行的時候寫入，滑到了就停筆。所以 clearOverride 之後，或你拖動滑桿之後，參數就留在你手上：映射會發現它寫的覆寫被別人改過（它留著自己上一筆寫入的 params.holder()…

Use it to validate a file before you import it, or to show what is inside one. It refuses, with a plain-language error, text that is not JSON, text longer than MAP_MAX_BYTES, an object whose format is not MAP_FORMAT, a missing or newer version, no routes list, and more than 500 routes. What it accepts is cleaned: a route without a string signal and param is dropped (and counted in dropped), unknown keys disappear, numbers must be finite, an unknown curve becomes 'linear', smooth is held to 0..60 seconds, and only invert: true inverts. A route is on unless it says enabled: false. input The JSON text of a map file, an already parsed map object, or a bare array of routes (version 0). { ok: true, version, world, routes, dropped } or { ok: false, error }. Each route is { signal, param, curve, inMin, inMax, outMin?, outMax?, smooth, invert, enabled }; dropped counts the entries that were not routes.

用它在匯入之前檢查檔案，或看看檔案裡有什麼。下列情形它會用白話的 error 拒絕：文字不是 JSON、文字比 MAP_MAX_BYTES 長、物件的 format 不是 MAP_FORMAT、version 缺少或比較新、沒有 routes 清單，以及超過 500 條路由。 接受的內容都會被整理過：沒有字串 signal 和 param 的路由會被丟掉（並算進 dropped），不認得的欄位會消失，數字必須有限，不認得的 curve 變成 'linear'，smooth 限制在 0 到 60 秒，只有 invert: true 才會反轉。路由除非寫了 enabled: false，否則是開著的。 input 映射檔的 JSON 文字、已經解析好的映射物件，或單純的路由陣列（版本 0）。 { ok: true, version, world, routes, dropped } 或 { ok: false, error }。每條路由是 { signal, param, curve, inMin, inMax, outMin?, outMax?, smooth, invert, enabled }。dropped 是不算路由而被丟掉的項目數。

A map file named in the page address is somebody else's data, so the rules are strict. Accepted: an address on the same origin as base (any scheme, so plain http://localhost works for a page served from there), or an absolute https: address. Refused: an empty address, one longer than 2048 characters, one that is not a URL, one carrying a user name or password, http: to another host, and data:, javascript:, file:, blob: and every other scheme. loadMapUrl() runs this check before it fetches anything. value The address as typed: absolute, or relative to base. base The page address that relative addresses resolve against, and that "same origin" is judged by. Usually location.href. { ok: true, url } with the resolved address, or { ok: false, error }.

網址列上指定的映射檔是別人的資料，所以規則很嚴。接受：跟 base 同源的網址（任何通訊協定，所以從 http://localhost 提供的頁面用 http://localhost 也行），或絕對的 https: 網址。拒絕：空網址、超過 2048 個字元、不是網址、帶有帳號或密碼、指向別的主機的 http:，以及 data:、javascript:、file:、blob: 和其他所有通訊協定。loadMapUrl() 在抓任何東西之前都會先跑這個檢查。 value 輸入的網址：絕對網址，或相對於 base 的網址。 base 相對網址據以解析、「同源」據以判斷的頁面網址。通常是 location.href。 { ok: true, url }（解析後的網址），或 { ok: false, error }。

Routes in a map file are named by signal and param, never by id, so the file can travel between worlds. mapper.exportMap() calls this for you; use serializeMap() directly when you build routes by hand or want a fixed date. Missing inMin/inMax become 0 and 1, missing curve is 'linear', and the output range is 0..1 unless the route has outMin/outMax. routes Routes in the mapper's own shape (what mapper.toJSON() returns: source, target, inMin, outMax …). world The world name written into the file. Importing into another world drops the output ranges. now The time written as exported (an ISO string). Pass a fixed date to get the same file twice. { format: 'openav.map', version: 1, world, exported, routes: [{ signal, param, curve, range: { in: [inMin, inMax], out: [outMin, outMax] }, smooth, invert }] }. A muted route also carries enabled: false.

映射檔裡的路由是用訊號和參數的名字來指，不用 id，所以檔案可以在不同世界之間搬運。mapper.exportMap() 會替你呼叫它。自己手寫路由、或想要固定日期時，才需要直接用 serializeMap()。沒寫的 inMin/inMax 會變成 0 和 1，沒寫的 curve 是 'linear'，沒有 outMin/outMax 的話輸出範圍是 0..1。 routes 映射本身格式的路由（mapper.toJSON() 回傳的那種：source、target、inMin、outMax ……）。 world 寫進檔案的世界名稱。匯入到別的世界時，輸出範圍會被丟掉。 now 寫成 exported 的時間（ISO 字串）。傳一個固定的日期，就能得到兩次相同的檔案。 { format: 'openav.map', version: 1, world, exported, routes: [{ signal, param, curve, range: { in: [inMin, inMax], out: [outMin, outMax] }, smooth, invert }] }。被靜音的路由會多一個 enabled: false。

new Bus() is a tiny publish and subscribe helper for your own code: subscribe to an event name with on(), fire it with emit(), and every callback gets the one payload you pass. Callbacks run in the order they subscribed, synchronously, inside emit(). It is not the thing shows talk through. Inputs and worlds talk through Signals (named values with a range) and Params; nothing else in the framework uses a Bus, and createShow() does not create one.
new Bus() 是給你自己的程式用的小型發布與訂閱工具：用 on() 訂閱一個事件名稱，用 emit() 觸發，每個函式都會收到你傳的那一個內容。函式依訂閱順序同步執行，都在 emit() 裡面跑完。 演出裡各部分溝通靠的不是它。輸入和世界是透過 Signals（有範圍的具名值）和 Params 溝通，框架裡沒有別的東西用到 Bus，createShow() 也不會建立一個。

new Loop((dt) => { … }).start() runs your function once per requestAnimationFrame, with dt in seconds. It is the one clock a show has: the timeline advances, mapped signals settle, the world draws and the backstage feed is sent from inside it, in the order the architecture page lists. createShow() builds and starts one for you and returns it as show.loop. Browsers freeze requestAnimationFrame in a hidden tab, but a performance must not stop because someone switched windows. So while the loop runs, a Web Worker beats every 33 ms; whenever no animation frame has arrived for 50 ms, the loop steps itself. A hidden tab therefore ticks at roughly 15 frames a second with a normal-sized dt, and show time stays real time. Where the page forbids workers (a strict content security policy) that fallback is simply absent. loop.fps is the frame rate, rounded, refreshed about every half second (the very first value comes from the first frame alone); it is 0 before the first frame. loop.running says whether it is going. Who supplies the time is a choice. new Loop(fn) uses the page: requestAnimationFrame, performance.now and the hidden-tab Worker. new Loop(fn, { clock, raf }) runs on your sources, such as a test's fake timer or a recorder's frame pump. new Loop(fn, { manual: true }) schedules nothing: you call loop.step(dt) and each call is one frame. That is how a show is recorded frame by frame, unit-tested, or run headless, without replacing the global requestAnimationFrame. In a show,…

new Loop((dt) => { … }).start() 每個 requestAnimationFrame 呼叫你的函式一次，dt 的單位是秒。這是一場演出唯一的時鐘：時間軸往前走、映射的訊號安頓下來、世界繪圖、後台資料送出，都在它裡面做，順序見架構頁。createShow() 會替你建好並啟動一個，用 show.loop 回傳。 瀏覽器會在分頁被藏起來的時候凍結 requestAnimationFrame，但演出不能因為有人切換視窗就停下來。所以迴圈在跑的時候，會有一個 Web Worker 每 33 毫秒跳一下。只要 50 毫秒內沒有收到動畫畫面，迴圈就自己往前走一步。被藏起來的分頁因此大約每秒 15 個畫面，dt 大小正常，演出時間仍是真實時間。如果頁面禁止 Worker（嚴格的內容安全政策），這個備援就不存在。 loop.fps 是四捨五入後的影格率，大約每半秒更新一次（第一個值只由第一個畫面算出來），在第一個畫面之前是 0。loop.running 告訴你它有沒有在跑。 時間由誰提供是可以選的。new Loop(fn) 用的是頁面的：requestAnimationFrame、performance.now，加上分頁被藏起來時的 Worker。new Loop(fn, { clock, raf }) 用你給的來源跑，例如測試的假計時器，或錄影程式的逐格推進。new Loop(fn, { manual: true }) 什麼都不排程：由你呼叫 loop.step(dt)，每呼叫一次就是一個畫面。逐格錄下一場演出、寫單元測試、或無頭執行，就是這樣做的，不必換掉全域的 requestAnimationFrame。在演出裡，createShow({ loop: 'manual' }) 或 { loop: { clock, raf } } 會把這些選項傳下來。 要呼叫 start()，在那之前什麼都不會跳。預設它需要瀏覽器（requestAnimationFrame、performance）。環境裡沒有 requestAnimationFrame 的時候，除非你傳了 { raf } 或 { manual: true }，否則 start() 會丟出錯誤。step(dt) 在哪裡都能用。 不要在世界裡讀真實時間，時間請從 dt（或時間軸）來，這樣 30 fps 和 144 fps 的演出才會做一樣的事。 onFrame 以 onFrame(dt, now) 呼叫：dt 是距離上一個畫面的秒數（自動的畫面不會超過 maxDt），now 是以毫秒計的時間，跟 clock 是同一個鐘（手動迴圈則是迴圈自己的時間，從 0 開始）。裡面丟出的錯誤會被接住、記成 [loop]，時鐘繼續跑。 maxDt 放在選項物件裡，下面幾個也是。自動的畫面交給你的 dt 最大值，單位是秒。卡頓（長時間的記憶體回收、被拖動的視窗）會被截成這個值，世界不用處理一秒鐘的跳動。step(dt) 不受這個限制。 clock 你自己的時鐘：一個回傳毫秒、而且不會倒退的函式。測試可以傳一個假的。 raf 你自己的排程器：raf(cb) 安排在下一個畫面呼叫一次 cb。cb 可以收到一個毫秒的時間戳，沒給的話就讀 clock()。 manual true 表示完全不排程：每個畫面都來自你自己呼叫的 loop.step(dt)。 heartbeat 分頁被藏起來時用的 Worker。預設是：用頁面自己的 requestAnimationFrame 就開著，給了自己的 raf 或…

A param is the way a world takes continuous control: { key: 'bloom', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }. The world never asks who set it. Every frame each param resolves to one number: the override if there is one, otherwise the base value (usually the Timeline's automation at the current time), otherwise def. resolve() does exactly that and hands the world a { key: value } object. An override is sticky. After params.override('bloom', 0.8) (what a slider, a MIDI knob or a mapped route does) the timeline stops moving bloom until clearOverride('bloom'). That matches the stage: when a person grabs a control, the score gives way. Overrides are clamped into min..max and snapped to step when they are written. Every override is written with who holds it, and holder(key) answers: null while nothing holds the param (the timeline plays it, or def), { kind: 'hand', label: 'hand', value } after a slider or override(), { kind: 'route', label: 'midi/cc/74', source, mode, value } after a Mapper route. The console colours each param by its holder. The record is new on every write, so a writer that kept the record of its own last write can tell that somebody else wrote since, even the same number: that is how the mapper stands down for a hand (Who holds a value). A param with pulse: true is a trigger, not a level: nobody reads a value from it. Fire it with firePulse(key) (a pad, a route from a pulse signal, a console button) and listen with onPulse(key, cb). In a show, createShow() builds one…

參數是世界取得連續控制的方式：{ key: 'bloom', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }。世界從來不問是誰設定的。每個畫面，每個參數都會解析成一個數字：有覆寫值（override）就用覆寫值，否則用基準值（通常是 Timeline 在目前時間的自動化曲線），再不然就用 def。resolve() 做的就是這件事，把 { key: value } 物件交給世界。 覆寫是黏住的。params.override('bloom', 0.8) 之後（滑桿、MIDI 旋鈕或映射的路由做的就是這個），時間軸就不再動 bloom，直到你呼叫 clearOverride('bloom')。這跟舞台上的情形一樣：有人抓住控制的時候，樂譜讓路。覆寫值在寫入的時候就會被夾進 min..max，並對齊 step。 每一個覆寫值在寫入時都會記下是誰握著它，holder(key) 回答這件事：沒有人握著的時候（時間軸在播，或用 def）是 null，滑桿或 override() 之後是 { kind: 'hand', label: 'hand', value }，Mapper 的路由寫的是 { kind: 'route', label: 'midi/cc/74', source, mode, value }。主控台依握著它的人替每個參數上色。這筆紀錄每寫一次就是新的一筆，所以留著自己上一筆紀錄的寫入者，看得出後來有別人寫過，就算寫的是同一個數字也一樣：映射就是這樣認出手來、讓給手的（誰握著一個值）。 pulse: true 的參數是觸發器，不是水準值：沒有人從它讀值。用 firePulse(key) 觸發它（打擊墊、脈衝訊號的路由、主控台的按鈕），用 onPulse(key, cb) 聽它。 在演出裡，createShow() 會建好一個 Params，用 add() 把每個世界的 schema 登記進去，再用 show.params 回傳。 step 用一般的浮點數運算對齊：step: 0.1 時，覆寫值 0.3 讀回來是 0.30000000000000004。在時間軸上，有 step 的參數還會停在每個關鍵影格，而不是做內插。 resolve() 不會夾基準值，只有覆寫值在寫入時會被夾住。自動化曲線請自己保持在 min..max 之內。 世界可以宣告的欄位（label、options、surface、group ……）列在寫一個世界。 schema 參數的宣告：{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group? }。key 一定要有。min、max、def 給出範圍，以及沒人設定時的值。這個陣列是直接拿來用，不會複製。

It adds to the document's head, the tag WordPress and Hugo leave. No request is made, no cookie is set and there is no id: the tag is for a person who views the source, and for searches and censuses of the public web. createShow() calls it for you, and createShow({ signature: false }) does not. Calling it again changes nothing: there is one tag per product. A generator tag another tool left stays where it is. Where there is no document (Node, a worker) it returns null. doc The document to mark. product Read from the second argument, an object: sign(document, { product, version }). Another product of the project, for a tag of its own beside the framework's. version In the same object: the version that goes after the product's name. The tag, new or already there. null without a document.

它在文件的 head 裡加上 ，WordPress 和 Hugo 留的也是這種標籤。不發出請求、不寫 cookie、沒有任何識別碼。這個標籤是給檢視原始碼的人看的，也讓公開網頁的搜尋與普查認得出來。createShow() 會替你呼叫，createShow({ signature: false }) 就不會。 再呼叫一次不會有變化：一個產品只有一個標籤。別的工具留下的 generator 標籤會留在原地。沒有文件的地方（Node、worker）會回傳 null。 doc 要標記的文件。 product 從第二個引數（一個物件）讀：sign(document, { product, version })。這個專案的另一個產品，會在框架的標籤旁邊多一個自己的標籤。 version 同一個物件裡：接在產品名稱後面的版本。 那個標籤，新加的或原本就有的。沒有文件時是 null。

new Signals() makes an empty registry. In a show you rarely build it yourself: createShow() creates one and returns it as show.signals. A signal is a name plus a value. Input packages publish with set() and pulse(); everything else reads with get() and norm(), or subscribes with on() and onAny(). There are two kinds. A continuous signal (the default) always holds a current value, usually between 0 and 1: a knob, the loudness of the room, the height of a wrist. A pulse signal (kind: 'pulse') is an event: its value is the payload of the last firing and it is null until the first one: a key struck, a kick heard, a pinch started. Read a level whenever you like; subscribe to an event with on(). Names are paths with the source first: midi/cc/74, audio/rms, pose/hand/right/y, breath/pressure. Declare a signal with its range before you publish it: signals.define('breath/pressure', { min: 0, max: 1 }). set() on a name nobody declared defines it on the spot as a continuous signal from 0 to 1, so declare first whenever your numbers are in degrees, MIDI notes or any other range. A knob, a raised hand and a chord are equal citizens here. Whoever reads a signal (the Mapper, a world that listens for events, the monitor) does not know and does not care what produced it. signals.meta is a Map of name → declaration and signals.values a Map of name → last value. Read them if you must; write through define() and set() so subscribers hear about it. A subscriber that throws is caught and logged…

new Signals() 會做出一個空的登錄表。做演出的時候通常不用自己建：createShow() 會建好一個，用 show.signals 回傳給你。一個訊號就是一個名字加一個值。輸入套件用 set() 和 pulse() 發布。其他東西用 get() 和 norm() 讀，或用 on() 和 onAny() 訂閱。 訊號分兩種。連續（continuous，預設）的訊號隨時都有一個目前的值，通常在 0 到 1 之間：旋鈕的位置、房間的音量、手腕的高度。脈衝（pulse，寫成 kind: 'pulse'）是事件：它的值是最近一次觸發帶的內容，在第一次觸發之前是 null：按下一個鍵、聽到一下大鼓、開始一次捏合。水準值想讀就讀。事件用 on() 訂閱。 名字是「來源在前」的路徑：midi/cc/74、audio/rms、pose/hand/right/y、breath/pressure。發布之前先用範圍宣告它：signals.define('breath/pressure', { min: 0, max: 1 })。對一個沒人宣告過的名字呼叫 set()，會當場把它宣告成 0 到 1 的連續訊號，所以你的數字如果是角度、MIDI 音符號碼或別的範圍，請先宣告。 旋鈕、舉起的手、一個和弦，在這裡地位相同。讀訊號的一方（Mapper、聽事件的世界、後台監看）不知道也不在乎是什麼產生它。 signals.meta 是「名字 → 宣告」的 Map，signals.values 是「名字 → 最近的值」的 Map。需要的話可以讀，要寫請透過 define() 和 set()，訂閱者才聽得到。 訂閱者丟出錯誤會被接住、記成 [signals] ，其他訂閱者照常執行，set() 也不會丟錯。 每個內建套件發布的訊號名稱，都列在訊號參考。

One version covers every package: package.json, this constant and the address …/open-audiovisual@v0.9.0/packages/openav.js carry the same number. A show started with createShow() also has it as window.openav.version, so you can ask a running page which framework it is on. oav-p5, the one line for p5.js, counts its own versions: OAVp5.version. Three numbers with dots, for example 0.9.0.

一個版本涵蓋所有套件：package.json、這個常數和網址 …/open-audiovisual@v0.9.0/packages/openav.js 帶的是同一個數字。用 createShow() 開演的頁面上也有 window.openav.version，所以可以問一個正在跑的頁面它用的是哪一版。 p5.js 的那一行 oav-p5 有自己的版本號：OAVp5.version。 用點隔開的三個數字，例如 0.9.0。

Every example is a world plus one createShow() call. It builds the Signals registry, the Params, the Stage with your world, the Timeline, the Mapper (with your routes), the inputs and outputs you declare in modules, the director's desk (mountConsole()), the backstage feed (MonitorFeed) and the frame Loop, starts the loop, and hands you every part. Nothing is hidden: show.signals, show.params, show.timeline, show.mapper, show.stage and the rest are the very objects the frame loop runs. When the framework grows a module, every show can have it just by declaring it. The modules keys: midi (on by default, false turns it off, { controllers: true } or { controllers: { profile, profiles, open } } docks an on-screen MIDI controller), keys (the on-screen piano, QWERTY and the simulated performer: on by default, false turns them off, { base, octaves, sim, capture } tunes them), drums (true or { engine, autoEnableEngine }), audio (any truthy value: the microphone analyser, started from the 🎤 button), chord (true or { window }: a ChordDetector wired to every played note), hands (true or { thresholds, gestures, mirror }: HandTracker), pose (true: PoseTracker), leap (true or { url, simulate, fingers, box }: LeapInput; ?leap=sim or ?leap=ws://… in the address overrides), remote (true or { room, … }: phones as controllers) and sound (true, an instrument id such as 'piano', or { instrument, remember, picker, engine }: instruments in the page, loaded only when declared). Parts that fetch…

每個範例都是一個世界加上一次 createShow() 呼叫。它建好 Signals 登錄表、Params、放著你的世界的 Stage、Timeline、Mapper（帶著你的 routes）、你在 modules 宣告的輸入與輸出、導演控台（mountConsole()）、後台資料（MonitorFeed）和影格 Loop，啟動迴圈，再把每個部分交給你。什麼都沒有藏起來：show.signals、show.params、show.timeline、show.mapper、show.stage 這些，就是影格迴圈實際在跑的那些物件。框架多了一個模組的時候，每場演出只要宣告就能用上。 modules 的鍵：midi（預設開啟，false 關掉，{ controllers: true } 或 { controllers: { profile, profiles, open } } 會在舞台上停靠一個螢幕上的 MIDI 控制器）、keys（螢幕鋼琴、電腦鍵盤和模擬演奏者：預設開啟，false 關掉，{ base, octaves, sim, capture } 可調整）、drums（true 或 { engine, autoEnableEngine }）、audio（任何真值：麥克風分析器，從 🎤 按鈕啟動）、chord（true 或 { window }：接上每個被彈奏的音的 ChordDetector）、hands（true 或 { thresholds, gestures, mirror }：HandTracker）、pose（true：PoseTracker）、leap（true 或 { url, simulate, fingers, box }：LeapInput，網址上的 ?leap=sim 或 ?leap=ws://… 可以覆寫）、remote（true 或 { room, … }：把手機當控制器）和 sound（true、像 'piano' 這樣的樂器 id，或 { instrument, remember, picker, engine }：頁面內的樂器，宣告了才會載入）。需要下載東西的部分都是延遲載入，所以沒宣告的演出不會付出任何代價。 頁面外殼只固定一次，所以每場演出都一樣。沒有 mount 的話，頁面的 body 會變成兩欄的格線：舞台，以及放著鋼琴和控台的 340 像素側邊面板（直立的手機則是舞台在上、面板在下：見 isStacked()）。每個畫面依這個順序做事： 要 await 它：它是非同步的，因為要等世界的 init()（和延遲載入的模組）完成。它需要一個頁面（document、location、localStorage），還要有能解析它所匯入的每個 @openav/ 套件的 import map 或打包工具（可以複製 examples/01-hello-particles/index.html 裡的那份）。瀏覽器要等點擊之後才會啟動聲音，所以聲音和麥克風要從控台的按鈕啟動。 映射每 3 秒把路由存在 profile 名稱底下，所以學來的或改過的路由，重新載入之後還在，而且會贏過你在程式裡改過的宣告（同一個 source → target 組合會保留存起來的曲線和平滑）。profile: false 讓路由每次載入都來自程式，但映射之後仍然會用世界的名字存檔。要從頭開始，執行 localStorage.removeItem('openav.map.')。 映射拿到的是 base: () =>…

The shell of createShow() has one layout rule: wide windows get the stage and a 340 px side panel next to each other, and an upright phone or small tablet gets the stage on top and the panel below it, scrolling. The rule is the media query STACK_QUERY, and isStacked() is the very same decision as a plain function, so a test (or your own layout code) can use it without a browser. A phone on its side is never taller than wide, so it stays in the wide layout. width The window width in pixels. height The window height in pixels. true when width width.

createShow() 的外殼只有一條版面規則：寬的視窗是舞台和 340 像素的側邊面板並排，直立的手機或小平板則是舞台在上、面板在下並可以捲動。規則就是媒體查詢 STACK_QUERY，而 isStacked() 是同一個判斷的純函式版本，所以測試（或你自己的版面程式）不用瀏覽器也能用。橫放的手機高度不會比寬度大，所以仍然是寬版面。 width 視窗寬度，單位是像素。 height 視窗高度，單位是像素。 width width 的時候是 true。

A string. createShow() adds it once as (unless one with that id is already there). It sets the page body to a grid of the stage and a 340 px side panel, with the classes .oav-stage, .oav-side, .oav-keys-slot, .oav-desk, .oav-hint and .oav-credit, and the stacked layout from STACK_QUERY. Read it to see what the shell does to your page, or add a of your own before calling createShow() to replace it entirely.

一個字串。createShow() 會把它用 加進頁面一次（除非已經有同 id 的）。它把頁面 body 設成舞台加上 340 像素側邊面板的格線，用到 .oav-stage、.oav-side、.oav-keys-slot、.oav-desk、.oav-hint 和 .oav-credit 這些 class，以及來自 STACK_QUERY 的堆疊版面。想知道外殼對你的頁面做了什麼就讀它。或在呼叫 createShow() 之前，自己先放一個 ，就能整個取代它。
Used inside STACK_QUERY and isStacked(), so the CSS rule and the function cannot drift apart. Above 820 pixels the stage and the 340 px panel always sit side by side.
用在 STACK_QUERY 和 isStacked() 裡面，所以 CSS 規則和函式不會彼此走樣。超過 820 像素，舞台和 340 像素的面板一律是並排的。
It is a string you can hand to matchMedia() to ask the browser the same question the shell's CSS asks: matchMedia(STACK_QUERY).matches. isStacked(width, height) is the same decision from numbers.
這是一個字串，可以交給 matchMedia()，問瀏覽器跟外殼的 CSS 同一個問題：matchMedia(STACK_QUERY).matches。isStacked(width, height) 是用數字做的同一個判斷。
The stage must stay the main thing on a phone, so it keeps 58% of the height and the console below it scrolls. stageHeight() turns this number into pixels.
在手機上，舞台必須仍然是主角，所以它保有 58% 的高度，下方的控台可以捲動。stageHeight() 把這個數字換算成像素。

When the shell stacks, the stage must stay the main thing, so it takes STAGE_SHARE percent of the window height (the CSS uses 58vh, and 58dvh where the browser has it) and the panel gets the rest. This is the same number as a function, for tests and your own layout code. height The window height in pixels. A number: Math.round(height 58 / 100).
外殼堆疊的時候，舞台必須仍然是主角，所以它佔視窗高度的 STAGE_SHARE 百分比（CSS 用 58vh，瀏覽器支援的話用 58dvh），面板拿剩下的。這是同一個數字的函式版本，給測試和你自己的版面程式用。 height 視窗高度，單位是像素。 一個數字：Math.round(height 58 / 100)。

A convenience for worlds that draw with the 2D canvas API; a world may use it or ignore it. The canvas is display: block and as big as the container. fit() sets its pixel size to the container size times the device pixel ratio (never more than 2) and scales the context so you keep drawing in CSS pixels. Call fit() at the top of render(): it only does work when the size changed, and it returns { w, h } to draw with. A ResizeObserver also calls it when the container is resized. Call dispose() in the world's dispose(): it stops the observer and removes the canvas. If the container has no height (an empty in normal flow is 0 pixels tall), the canvas is 0 × 0 and nothing shows. Give the container a size, or use it inside a Stage, whose layer fills the stage. container The element to put the canvas in (a world's container, usually). alpha Whether the canvas may be transparent. The default false is faster and gives an opaque canvas. { canvas, ctx, fit, dispose }: the , its 2D context, fit() and dispose(). fit() returns { w, h }, the container size in CSS pixels.

給用 2D 畫布 API 繪圖的世界的小幫手。世界可以用，也可以不用。畫布是 display: block，跟容器一樣大。fit() 把它的像素大小設成容器大小乘以裝置像素比（最多 2），並縮放 context，讓你繼續用 CSS 像素繪圖。在 render() 開頭呼叫 fit()：只有大小改變時它才會做事，而且會回傳畫圖要用的 { w, h }。容器改變大小時，ResizeObserver 也會呼叫它。 在世界的 dispose() 裡呼叫 dispose()：它會停掉觀察器並移除畫布。 如果容器沒有高度（一般排版流程裡的空 高度是 0 像素），畫布就是 0 × 0，什麼都看不到。請給容器一個大小，或是用在 Stage 裡，它的圖層會填滿舞台。 container 要放畫布的元素（通常是世界的 container）。 alpha 畫布可不可以是透明的。預設 false 比較快，畫布是不透明的。 { canvas, ctx, fit, dispose }：、它的 2D context、fit() 和 dispose()。fit() 回傳 { w, h }，也就是容器以 CSS 像素計的大小。

A world is any system with this shape, and every method is optional: The stage owns the lifecycle and the param aggregation and deliberately not a renderer: draw with a 2D canvas, p5, three.js, SVG, the DOM, whatever you like. The shell never knows the work: switching works means swapping the world and its data, and the shell stays. A world takes continuous control from state (the params) and may subscribe to signals for discrete events (a note struck, a chord resolved). If it reads signals.get('midi/cc/74') inside update(), it works with your controller today, but the timeline, a hand or another controller can no longer drive it. In a show, createShow() builds the stage from its world and worlds options and returns it as show.stage. Register your worlds, then await stage.activate(name) once; until a world is active, frame() returns null and does nothing. Then call stage.frame(dt, baseState) every frame (a show's loop does). Check the name before you activate: activate('nope') disposes the current world first and only then rejects, and the stage keeps pointing at the disposed world (active and activeName do not change), so the next frame() still calls its update() and render(). Fields to read: active (the active world object), activeName, worlds (a Map of name → world), container, layer (the element worlds are placed in) and io ({ signals, ...io }, what update receives; add handles later with stage.io.osc = osc). An exception in init() is not caught: activate() rejects.…

世界就是任何符合這個形狀的系統，每個方法都是選填的： 舞台負責生命週期和參數的彙整，而刻意不負責繪圖：用 2D 畫布、p5、three.js、SVG、DOM，隨你高興。外殼永遠不知道作品是什麼：換作品就是換掉世界和它的資料，外殼不動。 世界從 state（參數）取得連續控制，可以訂閱 signals 來接離散事件（按下一個音、一個和弦解決）。如果它在 update() 裡讀 signals.get('midi/cc/74')，今天用你的控制器是行的，但時間軸、手或別的控制器就再也驅動不了它。在演出裡，createShow() 依 world 和 worlds 選項建好舞台，用 show.stage 回傳。 先登記你的世界，再 await stage.activate(name) 一次。在有世界啟用之前，frame() 會回傳 null，什麼都不做。之後每個畫面呼叫 stage.frame(dt, baseState)（演出的迴圈會做）。 啟用之前請先確認名字：activate('nope') 會先讓目前的世界 dispose，之後才被拒絕，而舞台仍然指著那個已經 dispose 的世界（active 和 activeName 沒有改變），所以下一次 frame() 還是會呼叫它的 update() 和 render()。 可以讀的欄位：active（目前啟用的世界物件）、activeName、worlds（名字對應世界的 Map）、container、layer（世界被放進去的元素），以及 io（{ signals, ...io }，也就是 update 收到的東西，之後可以用 stage.io.osc = osc 補上把手）。 init() 裡的例外不會被接住：activate() 會被拒絕。update() 和 render() 裡的例外會被接住。世界必須在 dispose() 裡釋放它拿走的東西（GPU 物件、DOM、訂閱），因為世界是可以現場切換的。 container 世界要畫進去的元素。如果它原本是 static，會被改成 position: relative。舞台會在裡面加一個自己的圖層，所以你放在容器裡的覆蓋物（提示、開始按鈕）在切換世界的時候不會被清掉。 params 世界的 schema 要併進去、也是 frame() 要解析的 Params。 signals 交給每個世界的 Signals 登錄表，讓世界可以訂閱事件。 io 給世界的 update(dt, state, io) 用的額外輸出把手，例如 { midi, osc }。signals 一定在裡面。

The browser only joins pages of the same origin and the same browser profile, so the leader and the followers must be opened from the same address. Nothing else has to run: no server, no network. It is what createTransport() returns when there is no url. A message is sent as JSON text and parsed on arrival. A message that cannot be turned into JSON is lost without an error (the next frame is another); text that is not JSON is ignored on arrival. Plain fields: channel, open (true until close()), and bc, the BroadcastChannel itself. channel The channel name. oav-sync: is put in front, so it cannot collide with a channel the work uses itself. BroadcastChannel The BroadcastChannel class to use (for a test). Where there is none, the constructor throws and tells you to give a relay address instead.

瀏覽器只會連通同一個來源、同一個設定檔的頁面，所以主控端和從屬端要從同一個網址打開。不用另外跑任何東西：不用伺服器，也不用網路。沒有 url 的時候，createTransport() 回傳的就是它。 訊息以 JSON 文字送出，到達時再解析。轉不成 JSON 的訊息會直接不見，不會丟出錯誤（下一幀又是新的一則）。到達的文字不是 JSON 就忽略。 普通欄位：channel、open（close() 之前都是 true），以及 bc，也就是 BroadcastChannel 本身。 channel channel 的名稱。前面會加上 oav-sync:，所以不會撞到作品自己用的頻道。 BroadcastChannel 要用的 BroadcastChannel 類別（測試用）。環境裡沒有的話，建構函式會丟出錯誤，告訴你改給中繼的位址。

A wall of three outputs, a stage and a lobby, a rehearsal laptop beside the show laptop: one show, several pages. One page is the leader: it runs the timeline and says, every frame, where it is. The others are followers: their timelines do not walk by themselves, they chase the leader's T (a small rate change when close, a seek when far, its pause and hold copied, running on alone when it goes quiet: that half is timeline.follow()). Every page runs the same code; only role differs. In a show you do not call it: createShow({ sync: { role, channel } }) does, calls sync.frame() every frame, switches a follower's input modules off and sends the sync numbers to the backstage monitor. By hand, call sync.frame() once per frame right after timeline.advance(dt), on the leader (it sends the frame) and on a follower (it retries its hello). The messages are plain JSON, the same on both transports: seq counts the leader's frames. A follower drops a frame that is old or repeated, notices a gap, and says hello again to get a state, so a page that joins late or reloads lands on the show's present. A Timeline on every page, and the same channel on all of them. Without a url, the pages must be open in the same browser, from the same origin. With one, a room relay must be running (node serve.js hosts one at /relay). The pages share time, nothing else. A world that integrates dt (a feedback trail, a particle system) will not look the same on two pages at the same T unless what must match is…
