三顆輸出拼成的一面牆、舞台加大廳、排練的筆電放在演出筆電旁邊：一場演出，好幾個頁面。其中一個頁面是主控端（leader）：它跑時間軸，每一幀說出自己在哪。其餘是從屬端（follower）：它們的時間軸不自己往前走，而是追主控端的 T（差得少就微調 rate，差得多就 seek，主控端暫停或停在 hold 也跟著，主控端沒聲音了就自己走：這一半是 timeline.follow()）。每個頁面跑同一份程式，只有 role 不同。 在演出裡不用自己呼叫：createShow({ sync: { role, channel } }) 會替你呼叫，每個影格呼叫 sync.frame()，把從屬端會產生輸入的模組關掉，並把同步的數字送到後台監看。手工組裝的話，每個影格在 timeline.advance(dt) 之後呼叫一次 sync.frame()，主控端要呼叫（它送出這一幀），從屬端也要（它負責重試 hello）。 訊息是單純的 JSON，兩種傳輸送的都一樣： seq 是主控端送出的 frame 的編號。從屬端會丟掉舊的或重複的 frame，發現缺口就再說一次 hello 去要 state，所以中途加入或重新載入的頁面，會落在演出的現在。 每個頁面都要有一條 Timeline，而且用同一個 channel。沒有 url 的時候，頁面要開在同一個瀏覽器、同一個來源底下。有 url 的時候，要有一台房間中繼在跑（node serve.js 在 /relay 架了一個）。 頁面之間共用的只有時間。會積分 dt 的世界（殘影、粒子系統），在 T 相同的兩個頁面上不會長得一樣，除非要一致的東西都寫成 T 的函式，或放在 extra 裡一起送。 frame 帶的是主控端的 T，不是牆鐘的時刻。跨機器時，從屬端大約會落後一趟路程的時間，除非你設定 follow: { latency }。沒有選舉：要把從屬端升成主控端，就是在舊主控端不見之後，用 role: 'leader' 載入它。 role 'leader'：這個頁面跑演出，每一幀說出自己在哪。'follower'：這個頁面的時間軸去追主控端。其他值會丟出 TypeError。 channel 頁面碰頭用的名字：BroadcastChannel 的名稱，也是中繼的房間名。1 到 32 個字母、數字、- 或 _。自己傳 transport 的時候不需要。 url 不給：用 BroadcastChannel（同一台機器、同一個瀏覽器、同一個來源的頁面）。ws:// 或 wss:// 位址：那台機器上的房間中繼。true：這個頁面自己的 /relay。 id 這一端的 id。預設是 L- 或 F- 加上六個隨機字元。 timeline 這個頁面的 Timeline。必填。主控端讀它的 t、playing、holding 和 rate。在從屬端，會替你呼叫 timeline.follow()。 score 一份 Score，或任何有 cut 的物件。主控端會把 score.cut 隨每一幀送出，從屬端會拒絕 cut 跟自己不同的主控端。 transport 你自己的傳輸 { send(msg), onMessage(cb), onOpen(cb), open, close() }，給測試或別的通道用。沒給就由 createTransport() 照 channel 和 url 建一個。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒（預設 performance.now）。從屬端會把同一個時鐘交給 timeline.follow()。…

createSync() calls it when you do not pass a transport of your own. Both transports turn a message into JSON before sending, so undefined, a Date or a Map are lost the same way on both, and swapping one for the other does not change what the work sees. role Who this page is. Anything else throws a TypeError. channel The BroadcastChannel name and the relay room: 1 to 32 letters, digits, - or _. Anything else throws a TypeError. url Nothing: a BroadcastChannel. true: this page's own /relay. A string: that ws:// or wss:// relay. id The peer id the relay knows this page by. The default is L- or F- and six random characters. A BroadcastTransport does not use it. BroadcastChannel The BroadcastChannel class to use (for a test). The default is the page's own. Client The relay client class to use (for a test). The default is RelayClient. A transport: { send(msg), onMessage(cb), onOpen(cb), open, close() }.

你沒有自己傳 transport 的時候，createSync() 會呼叫它。兩種傳輸都把訊息轉成 JSON 再送，所以 undefined、Date、Map 在兩邊一樣不見，換傳輸不會改變作品看到的東西。 role 這個頁面的角色。其他值會丟出 TypeError。 channel BroadcastChannel 的名稱，也是中繼的房間名：1 到 32 個字母、數字、- 或 _。其他值會丟出 TypeError。 url 不給：用 BroadcastChannel。true：這個頁面自己的 /relay。字串：那個 ws:// 或 wss:// 中繼。 id 中繼用來認這個頁面的 id。預設是 L- 或 F- 加六個隨機字元。BroadcastTransport 用不到它。 BroadcastChannel 要用的 BroadcastChannel 類別（測試用）。預設是頁面自己的。 Client 要用的中繼用戶端類別（測試用）。預設是 RelayClient。 一個傳輸：{ send(msg), onMessage(cb), onOpen(cb), open, close() }。

It wraps a RelayClient and connects at once. The relay is the one phones use (attachRelay()); node serve.js on the leader's machine is the whole setup. It is what createTransport() returns when there is a url. On a page served over https the address must be wss://: the browser blocks ws:// there. A message that finds the socket closed is gone, not queued: the next frame is a few milliseconds behind it, and a follower that missed one asks for the state again. The client reconnects by itself, and onOpen tells you each time. A room relay the page can reach. The relay has no authentication: use a closed network and a channel name nobody will guess. A state over 256 KB needs attachRelay(server, { maxMessageChars, maxBytes }). Plain fields: room, role, id, and client, the RelayClient underneath. url The relay's address, such as ws://leader.local:8080/relay; role, room and id are added to its query for you. null uses this page's own /relay (or ?relay= in the page address). room The relay room. Pages in different rooms never hear each other. role The role to join as. The relay hands a leader's messages to the room's followers and a follower's to its leaders. id The peer id. A leader's state reply is addressed to it, so a follower must use the same id here and in SyncFollower. Client The relay client class to use (for a test).

它包著一個 RelayClient，建立的時候就連線。中繼就是手機用的那一個（attachRelay()），在主控端那台機器上跑 node serve.js 就是全部的設定。有 url 的時候，createTransport() 回傳的就是它。用 https 提供的頁面要用 wss:// 位址：瀏覽器在那裡會擋掉 ws://。 訊息送出時 socket 沒開就不見了，不會排隊：下一幀只晚幾毫秒，漏了一幀的從屬端會再要一次 state。用戶端會自己重連，每次連上 onOpen 都會通知你。 要有一台頁面連得到的房間中繼。中繼沒有身分驗證：請用封閉的網路，以及沒人猜得到的 channel 名。超過 256 KB 的 state 需要 attachRelay(server, { maxMessageChars, maxBytes })。 普通欄位：room、role、id，以及 client，也就是底下那個 RelayClient。 url 中繼的位址，例如 ws://leader.local:8080/relay，role、room 和 id 會替你加到查詢字串上。null 表示用這個頁面自己的 /relay（或頁面網址上的 ?relay=）。 room 中繼的房間。不同房間的頁面彼此聽不到。 role 加入房間用的角色。中繼會把主控端的訊息交給房間裡的從屬端，把從屬端的訊息交給主控端。 id 這一端的 id。主控端的 state 回覆用它點名，所以從屬端在這裡和在 SyncFollower 裡要用同一個 id。 Client 要用的中繼用戶端類別（測試用）。

Every message SyncLeader and SyncFollower send starts with v: SYNC_VERSION, and both ignore, without an error, a message whose v is different. Use it when you write a message by hand, for a test or for a transport of your own.
SyncLeader 和 SyncFollower 送出的每一則訊息都以 v: SYNC_VERSION 開頭，兩邊遇到 v 不一樣的訊息都會直接忽略，不會丟出錯誤。自己手寫訊息的時候（測試，或你自己的傳輸）可以用它。

createSync({ role: 'follower', … }) builds one, with its transport, and makes the timeline follow it. A SyncFollower is itself the source that timeline.follow() takes: latest() answers the last accepted frame and now is the clock that stamped it. Order is the leader's order: a frame whose seq is not above the last one is dropped, and a jump in seq is a gap. It keeps to the first leader it hears. It says hello when the transport is open, again on every reconnect, every helloEvery milliseconds until a state arrives, and after a gap, a takeover or a silence when resync is on. Call frame() every frame so that a lost hello is retried. To make a timeline follow it by hand: timeline.follow(follower, { now: follower.now }). Plain fields: role ('follower'), id, src (the leader it keeps to, or null), seq, haveState, refused, closed, attached, counts, and the options you passed. An accept hook that throws refuses the message (the reason reads the accept hook threw) and is logged once. The other hooks are caught and logged as [sync]. transport Where the messages come from: a BroadcastTransport, a RelayTransport or your own. Required. id This follower's id: the leader addresses its state reply to it. On a relay it must be the id the transport joined with. The default is F- and six random characters. now The clock in milliseconds that stamps at on every frame. It must be the clock timeline.follow() uses (createSync() wires that). timeline Used only by monitor() (it reads…

createSync({ role: 'follower', … }) 會連同傳輸一起建好一個，並讓時間軸去追它。SyncFollower 自己就是 timeline.follow() 收的那種來源：latest() 回答最後一則被接受的 frame，now 就是替它蓋時間的那個鐘。 順序以主控端的順序為準：seq 沒有比上一則大的 frame 會被丟掉，seq 跳號就是缺口。它守著第一個聽到的主控端。傳輸開著的時候它會說 hello，每次重連再說一次，拿到 state 之前每 helloEvery 毫秒說一次，resync 開著的話，漏幀、換主控端、沉默之後也會再說。 每個影格都要呼叫 frame()，這樣掉了的 hello 才會重試。要自己讓時間軸追它：timeline.follow(follower, { now: follower.now })。 普通欄位：role（'follower'）、id、src（它守著的主控端，沒有就是 null）、seq、haveState、refused、closed、attached、counts，以及你傳進來的選項。 accept 掛鉤丟出錯誤就等於拒絕這則訊息（理由是 the accept hook threw），而且只記一次。其他掛鉤的錯誤會被接住、記成 [sync]。 transport 訊息從哪裡來：BroadcastTransport、RelayTransport，或你自己的傳輸。必填。 id 這個從屬端的 id：主控端的 state 回覆用它點名。走中繼的時候，它要跟傳輸加入房間用的 id 一樣。預設是 F- 加六個隨機字元。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒，用來替每一則 frame 蓋上 at。它要跟 timeline.follow() 用的是同一個鐘（createSync() 會接好）。 timeline 只有 monitor()（它讀 timeline.followStatus()）和 close() 會用到。建構函式不會呼叫 timeline.follow()，那是 createSync() 做的。 info 隨每個 hello 送給主控端（版本、指紋之類）。主控端的 state(hello) 掛鉤可以用 hello.info 讀到。 accept 每一則 frame 和 state 都以 accept(msg) 呼叫。回傳 false，或一個說明理由的字串，就是拒絕這則訊息：不交給任何人，latest() 也不更新。 onFrame 每一則被接受的 frame 都以 onFrame(msg) 呼叫，各一次，照主控端的順序。主控端的資料在 msg.extra 裡。 onState 每一則被接受的 state 回覆都以 onState(msg) 呼叫（msg.extra 是主控端的 state 掛鉤回傳的東西）。 onGap 漏了 frame 的時候以 onGap({ from, to }) 呼叫：seq 編號 from 到 to 的那些沒有到。 resync 漏了幀、沉默一陣子之後，或換了主控端的時候：再說一次 hello，把 state 拿回來。 helloEvery 還沒有 state 的時候，frame() 每隔這麼多毫秒再說一次 hello。 takeoverAfter 原本的主控端安靜了這麼多毫秒，才接受另一個主控端。在那之前，另一個主控端的訊息會被忽略。 resyncAfter 安靜了這麼多毫秒之後的第一幀，算是「主控端回來了」，會去要 state。 aliveEvery…

createSync({ role: 'leader', … }) builds one for you with its transport. Call leader.frame() once per frame, after timeline.advance(dt): it sends { v, kind: 'frame', src, seq, T, playing, holding, rate, cut?, extra? }, and seq goes up by one for every frame sent. When a follower says hello, the leader notes it and answers with a state message addressed to that follower, so the follower lands on the show's present. An extra, state or onHello hook that throws is caught and logged as [sync]; the message still goes out, without its extra. A cut function that throws is caught too: the message goes out without a cut, and the error is logged once. Call frame() every frame: nothing is sent by itself. Plain fields: role ('leader'), id, timeline, transport, cut, extra, state, hz, now, onHello, seq, sent, hellos, closed. timeline The Timeline to report. Required. Its t, playing, holding and rate are read for every frame, and a seek makes the next frame go out at once. transport Where the messages go: a BroadcastTransport, a RelayTransport or your own. Required. id This leader's id, the src of its messages. The default is L- and six random characters. cut The version of the show (a score's cut id), or a function that returns it. Sent with every frame when it is not null, so a follower can refuse a leader that plays another version. extra Asked once for every frame sent. What it returns (unless undefined) travels in that frame's extra: the work's own data that must go with the clock.…

createSync({ role: 'leader', … }) 會替你連同傳輸一起建好一個。每個影格在 timeline.advance(dt) 之後呼叫一次 leader.frame()：它送出 { v, kind: 'frame', src, seq, T, playing, holding, rate, cut?, extra? }，每送一幀 seq 就加一。從屬端說 hello 的時候，主控端記下它，並回一則指名給它的 state 訊息，讓它落在演出的現在。 extra、state 或 onHello 掛鉤丟出錯誤會被接住、記成 [sync]，訊息照樣送出，只是沒有 extra。cut 函式丟出錯誤也會被接住：訊息照樣送出，只是沒有 cut，錯誤只記一次。 每個影格都要呼叫 frame()：它不會自己送。 普通欄位：role（'leader'）、id、timeline、transport、cut、extra、state、hz、now、onHello、seq、sent、hellos、closed。 timeline 要回報的 Timeline。必填。每一幀都讀它的 t、playing、holding 和 rate，它被 seek 之後，下一幀會馬上送出。 transport 訊息要送去哪裡：BroadcastTransport、RelayTransport，或你自己的傳輸。必填。 id 這個主控端的 id，也就是它訊息裡的 src。預設是 L- 加六個隨機字元。 cut 演出的版本（總譜的 cut id），或一個回傳它的函式。不是 null 的時候會隨每一幀送出，讓從屬端可以拒絕演別的版本的主控端。 extra 每送一幀問一次。它回傳的東西（undefined 除外）會放進那一幀的 extra：作品自己要跟著時鐘走的資料。框架不會讀它。 state 從屬端說 hello 的時候，以 state(hello) 問一次。它回傳的東西會放進 state 回覆的 extra，例如中途加入的頁面漏掉的所有東西。 hz 每秒最多送幾幀，0 表示每次 frame() 都送。playing、holding、rate 或 cut 改變的那一幀，以及 seek 之後的那一幀，一定馬上送。 now 時鐘，單位是毫秒，用在 hz 的節流，以及記下每個從屬端上次出聲的時間。 onHello 每收到一個 hello，就在送出 state 之前以 onHello(hello) 呼叫。 forgetAfter 毫秒。說過「還在」（here，每隔它自己的 aliveEvery）之後安靜了這麼久的從屬端，就不再算進 followers：重新整理過或關掉的頁面。0 是每個都一直算。0.10.0 的從屬端從來不說 here，照以前那樣算。

WebToe is the sister project: a web-native, node-based dataflow engine that speaks TouchDesigner. webtoeWorld() embeds its app in an iframe that fills the stage (with allow="camera; microphone"), and each frame it posts the resolved params into the iframe as { type: 'webtoe:ext', values }. Inside the patch, any parameter written as ext('name', fallback) follows the value called name, and uses fallback until one arrives. The contract stays pure: the world reads params and never inputs. Which knob, hand or timeline drives speed is the mapper's business, as for any world. To send less, the world posts only when at least one value differs from the last post. The page must be able to load the WebToe app in an iframe (the network, by default https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/), and the patch file must be reachable by the app. The world does its work when it is activated, so use it with createShow({ world }), or stage.register() and stage.activate(). The message goes to the iframe with the target origin , so any page the iframe happens to be showing receives the values. If you point app at a site you do not trust, it can read your params. name The world's name: what Stage registers it under and what you pass to stage.activate(). Give each patch its own. app The WebToe app to embed in the iframe. Change it to run your own copy of the app. project The address of a .webtoe.json patch file. It is handed to the app as ?project=, and the app fetches it, so the file's server must allow…

WebToe 是姊妹專案：一個網頁原生、以節點為基礎的資料流引擎，講的是 TouchDesigner 的語言。webtoeWorld() 把它的應用程式嵌進一個填滿舞台的 iframe（帶著 allow="camera; microphone"），每個畫面把解析後的參數用 { type: 'webtoe:ext', values } 送進 iframe。節點圖裡，任何寫成 ext('name', fallback) 的參數，都會跟著名為 name 的值走，在值抵達之前用 fallback。 約定維持純粹：世界讀的是參數，從不讀輸入。是哪個旋鈕、手或時間軸在驅動 speed，是映射的事，跟任何世界一樣。為了少送一點，世界只在至少有一個值跟上一次送出的不同時才會送。 頁面必須能把 WebToe 應用程式載進 iframe（要有網路，預設是 https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/），節點圖檔案也要讓應用程式抓得到。世界在被啟用的時候才開始做事，所以請搭配 createShow({ world })，或 stage.register() 加 stage.activate() 使用。 訊息是用目標來源 送給 iframe，所以 iframe 當時顯示的任何頁面都收得到這些值。如果你把 app 指向你不信任的網站，它就能讀到你的參數。 name 世界的名字：Stage 用它來登記，stage.activate() 也是傳它。每份節點圖請取自己的名字。 app 要嵌進 iframe 的 WebToe 應用程式。改它就能跑你自己那一份。 project .webtoe.json 節點圖檔案的網址。它會用 ?project= 交給應用程式，由應用程式去抓，所以檔案所在的伺服器必須允許應用程式的來源（CORS）。請寫成絕對網址，例如 new URL('./garden.webtoe.json', location.href).href。 params 世界的參數 schema：[{ key, min, max, def }, …]。這些 key 就是節點圖用 ext('name', fallback) 讀取的名稱。 extra extra(state, out)，每個畫面呼叫：把衍生的值加進 out（狀態的複本），節點圖也讀得到，例如 out.hueRad = state.hue Math.PI / 180。 一個世界 { name, params, init, update, render, dispose }，可以交給 createShow({ world }) 或 stage.register()。

A route written in a World file cannot know the id of a stranger's phone. The alias fixes that: every phone signal is also filed under phone/any/…, which always holds the value from whichever phone sent last, so { source: 'phone/any/tilt/x', target: 'hue' } can be written before anyone has joined. bindSignals() and localSensors() both file the alias for you. name A signal name. Only phone//… has an alias. alias The word that replaces the id. Leave it out for any. The alias name, or null when name is not a phone signal or already uses the alias.

寫在世界檔案裡的路由，不可能知道陌生人手機的 id。別名就是用來解決這件事：每個手機訊號也會歸一份到 phone/any/…，它永遠是最後送出數值的那支手機的值，所以 { source: 'phone/any/tilt/x', target: 'hue' } 在還沒有人加入之前就能寫好。bindSignals() 和 localSensors() 都會替你歸這份別名。 name 訊號名稱。只有 phone//… 有別名。 alias 用來取代 id 的字。不給就是 any。 別名。name 不是手機訊號、或本來就用別名的時候是 null。

This is the server half, in Node, with no dependencies (the WebSocket codec is in the package). node serve.js already does it for you at /relay. To use it in your own server: attachRelay(server) before or after server.listen(). Clients connect to ws://host/relay?role=controller|runner|monitor|leader|follower&room=&id=: a bad role becomes controller, a bad room name becomes default, and the id is cut to 64 characters. Who may talk to whom: a controller's signal and batch go to the runner and the monitors; a runner's go to the monitors only; a runner's feedback and config go to the controllers and monitors; a monitor says nothing. A leader's sync goes to the room's followers and a follower's to its leaders (with to: '', to that one peer only); nobody else may send one, and the hub does not read what is inside. A config is kept per key and replayed to controllers that join later, and the room forgets it when its runner leaves. Rooms never hear each other. By default a message over 262144 characters is ignored and a frame over 1 MiB closes the connection (maxMessageChars, maxBytes). There is no authentication: anyone who can reach the server and knows a room name can join as a controller. Use a closed network, or a room name nobody will guess. A Node program, imported from @openav/relay/server (a different entry point from @openav/relay, which is the browser side). Standalone: node packages/relay/server.js [port] (default 7458; /health answers with the room names;…

這是伺服器那一半，跑在 Node 裡，沒有任何相依套件（WebSocket 編解碼器就在套件裡）。node serve.js 已經在 /relay 替你做好了。要用在你自己的伺服器上：在 server.listen() 之前或之後呼叫 attachRelay(server) 都行。用戶端連到 ws://host/relay?role=controller|runner|monitor|leader|follower&room=&id=：身分不合格會變成 controller，房間名不合格會變成 default，id 會被截成 64 個字元。 誰能對誰說話：控制端的 signal 和 batch 送給演出端和監看端。演出端的只送給監看端。演出端的 feedback 和 config 送給控制端和監看端。監看端什麼都不能說。主控端的 sync 送給房間裡的從屬端，從屬端的送給主控端（帶著 to: '' 就只送給那一端），其他身分都不能送，hub 也不讀裡面的內容。config 依 key 留著，重播給之後才加入的控制端，演出端離開時房間就忘掉它。房間之間互相聽不到。預設超過 262144 個字元的訊息會被忽略，超過 1 MiB 的 frame 會讓連線關閉（maxMessageChars、maxBytes）。 沒有任何身分驗證：任何連得到伺服器、又知道房間名稱的人，都能以控制端身分加入。請用封閉的網路，或一個沒人猜得到的房間名稱。 一支 Node 程式，從 @openav/relay/server 匯入（它跟 @openav/relay 是不同的進入點，後者是瀏覽器端）。單獨執行：node packages/relay/server.js [port]（預設 7458，/health 會回傳房間名稱，用 RELAY_HOST=127.0.0.1 可以綁在 localhost，後面接反向代理）。 server Node 的 http.Server（或任何有同樣 upgrade 事件的東西，例如 https 伺服器）。中繼會聽它的 upgrade 事件。 path 用戶端要連的網址路徑。其他路徑一律拒絕。 log (line) => {}，用戶端加入時以 + controller ab12 @main 這樣的一行呼叫，離開時是 - controller ab12 @main。預設什麼都不說。 heartbeatMs 多久對每個用戶端 ping 一次，單位毫秒。到下一次 ping 還沒回應的用戶端會被移除，所以斷線的手機會在一到兩個週期內消失。 maxMessageChars hub 願意轉送的最長訊息，以字元計。更長的會被忽略。同步的主控端要送很大的 state 給中途加入的頁面時，把它（連同 maxBytes）調大。 maxBytes 解析器願意收的最大 WebSocket frame（或組合後的訊息），以位元組計（1 MiB）。更大的會讓那條連線關閉。 hub 是 RoomHub（hub.rooms 是房間的 Map，hub.counts(room) 回傳 { controllers, runners, monitors, leaders, followers }）。close() 把所有連線中的用戶端斷開，不會關掉你的伺服器。

Call it once on the show page, after making the runner's client: bindSignals(show, signals). It sets client.onSignal so that each signal that arrives goes through fileSignal(), and a phone signal is filed twice, under its own name (phone/ab12/tilt/x) and under the alias (phone/any/tilt/x). Routes written at author time use the alias. A callback that was already in client.onSignal keeps running after the filing, so you can still watch the raw messages. client The runner's client (any object with an onSignal field works). signals The registry to fill (from @openav/core). alias The word used in the copy, phone//…. null or an empty string turns the copy off. meta Replace signalMeta with your own declarations, as in fileSignal(). Call it to unbind: client.onSignal goes back to what it was before.

在演出頁面上，做好演出端的用戶端之後呼叫一次：bindSignals(show, signals)。它會設定 client.onSignal，讓每個收到的訊號都經過 fileSignal()，手機訊號會歸兩份：自己的名稱（phone/ab12/tilt/x）和別名（phone/any/tilt/x）。寫作品時寫的路由用的是別名。 client.onSignal 裡原本就有的回呼，會在歸檔之後繼續執行，所以你還是看得到原始訊息。 client 演出端的用戶端（任何有 onSignal 欄位的物件都行）。 signals 要填的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 alias 複本用的字，phone//…。null 或空字串表示不做複本。 meta 像 fileSignal() 一樣，用你自己的宣告取代 signalMeta。 呼叫它就解除綁定：client.onSignal 回到綁定之前的樣子。

The first call makes an id and stores it under key; later calls read it back. RelayClient uses it as its default id, so a phone keeps the same name across reloads and its signals stay phone//…. If localStorage is blocked (some private windows), nothing can be stored and every call makes a new id. key The localStorage key. The default is the one the lab uses, so /control and /remote on one phone count as one device. A short id of about five letters and digits, such as k3x9a. The same one on every call, in the same browser.

第一次呼叫會做一個 id 並存在 key 底下，之後的呼叫就把它讀回來。RelayClient 把它當作預設的 id，所以手機重新載入之後名字不變，訊號也一直是 phone//…。 如果 localStorage 被擋掉（有些無痕視窗），就存不下來，每次呼叫都會做一個新的 id。 key localStorage 的 key。預設是實驗室用的那一個，所以同一支手機上的 /control 和 /remote 算是同一個裝置。 大約五個字母和數字的短 id，例如 k3x9a。同一個瀏覽器裡，每次呼叫都一樣。

This is the receiving half of the wire format, and every receiver files a message the same way through it: bindSignals() for a show that has a relay, localSensors() for a show on a phone, and a host that runs its own socket. In order: if the registry has never heard the name, declare it with what signalMeta() says (a pulse is never mistaken for a knob, and meters get their range); fill in the missing velocity spelling with normalizeValue(); then signals.pulse(name, value) for a pulse or signals.set(name, value) for the rest. signals The registry to file it in (from @openav/core). name The signal name. It must be a non-empty string of at most 128 characters, or nothing is filed. value The payload. pulse True when the message was sent as an event. A name that signalMeta() knows to be a pulse (or was declared as one) is a pulse either way. meta Replace signalMeta with your own (name, { pulse }) => metadata | null, to declare names the relay does not know. source A label stored in the declared metadata (signals.meta.get(name).source), such as 'relay' or 'local'. true when it was filed, false for a bad name.

這是傳輸格式的接收那一半，每個接收端都靠它用同樣的方式歸檔訊息：有中繼的演出用 bindSignals()，跑在手機上的演出用 localSensors()，自己開 socket 的主機也一樣。順序是：註冊表沒聽過這個名稱的話，就照 signalMeta() 的說法宣告（脈衝不會被當成旋鈕，音量表也拿得到範圍），用 normalizeValue() 補上缺的力度寫法，然後脈衝就 signals.pulse(name, value)，其他就 signals.set(name, value)。 signals 要歸進去的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 name 訊號名稱。必須是非空字串，最長 128 個字元，否則什麼都不歸。 value 訊號的內容。 pulse 訊息是當作事件送來的話為 true。名稱若是 signalMeta() 認得的脈衝（或之前就宣告成脈衝），不管這一項是什麼，都當作脈衝。 meta 用你自己的 (name, { pulse }) => 資料 | null 取代 signalMeta，用來宣告中繼不認得的名稱。 source 存進宣告資料裡的標籤（signals.meta.get(name).source），例如 'relay' 或 'local'。 歸好了是 true，名稱不合格是 false。

@openav/midi publishes vel as 0..1, a hardware keyboard talks in velocity 1..127, and senders (an old phone page, a TouchOSC bridge, a sequencer) give one or the other. A sketch is written against one spelling, so the receiving end fills in the other: velocity becomes vel = velocity / 127, and vel becomes velocity = Math.round(vel 127). You rarely call it yourself: fileSignal() does it for every message it files. name The signal name. Only midi/note/on, midi/note/off and the same with a device in the middle (midi//note/on) are touched. value The payload. Only an object with vel or velocity is changed (a copy, never the original). The payload with both vel and velocity. If both were there already, the same object comes back untouched.

@openav/midi 發布的 vel 是 0..1，硬體鍵盤說的是 1..127 的 velocity，而送訊號的人（舊的手機頁面、TouchOSC 橋接、編曲軟體）只會給其中一種。草圖通常只照一種寫法寫，所以接收端把另一種補上：velocity 會變成 vel = velocity / 127，vel 會變成 velocity = Math.round(vel 127)。 通常不用自己呼叫：fileSignal() 歸檔每一則訊息時都會做這件事。 name 訊號名稱。只有 midi/note/on、midi/note/off，以及中間多一個裝置名的寫法（midi//note/on）會被處理。 value 訊號的內容。只有帶 vel 或 velocity 的物件會被改（改的是複本，不動原件）。 同時帶 vel 和 velocity 的內容。兩個本來就都有的話，原物件原樣傳回。

Make one client per page, give it a role and a room, and call connect(). A phone calls phone.set('phone/me/tilt/x', 0.3) for values that change continuously and phone.send('midi/note/on', { note: 60 }, true) for events. The show passes its client to bindSignals(), and every phone signal lands in its Signals. The relay itself is attachRelay() on a Node server. Continuous values are cheap on purpose: set() only stores the value (and does nothing if it is the same as the last), then every 1 / batchHz seconds the changed ones leave in one batch, and every resendMs all of them leave again. Events are the opposite: send() leaves at once and is never batched or repeated, because a note-on delivered twice is a bug. It looks after the connection itself. When the socket closes it reconnects after 0.5 s, then 1 s, 2 s, 4 s and every 5 s, until you call close(). A ping goes out every 2 s and the answer becomes latency in milliseconds. status is 'connecting', 'open' or 'closed', and peers is how many controllers, runners, monitors, leaders and followers the room has. A relay server for it to reach, such as node serve.js (it hosts one at /relay) or node packages/relay/server.js. Until the socket is open, set() keeps the latest values and sends them when it opens, but send(), config() and sync() messages are dropped, not queued. Public fields: role, room, id, url, batchHz, resendMs, the callbacks, status, latency (milliseconds, null until the first pong), peers and sent (how many messages…

每個頁面做一個用戶端，給它身分和房間，然後呼叫 connect()。手機用 phone.set('phone/me/tilt/x', 0.3) 送連續變化的數值，用 phone.send('midi/note/on', { note: 60 }, true) 送事件。演出端把自己的用戶端交給 bindSignals()，每個手機訊號就會進到它的 Signals。中繼本身是 Node 伺服器上的 attachRelay()。 連續的數值刻意做得很省：set() 只是把值存起來（跟上一次一樣就什麼都不做），之後每 1 / batchHz 秒，有變動的值打包成一則 batch 送出，每 resendMs 毫秒，全部的值再送一遍。事件則相反：send() 馬上送出，不打包也不重送，因為一個 note-on 收到兩次就是錯。 連線它自己照顧。socket 關掉之後，它會在 0.5 秒、1 秒、2 秒、4 秒，之後每 5 秒重連一次，直到你呼叫 close()。每 2 秒送一個 ping，回應的時間差就是 latency（毫秒）。status 是 'connecting'、'open' 或 'closed'，peers 是房間裡有幾個 controllers、runners、monitors、leaders、followers。 要有一台中繼伺服器可以連，例如 node serve.js（它在 /relay 架了一個）或 node packages/relay/server.js。socket 還沒打開之前，set() 會記住最新的值，打開時送出，但 send()、config()、sync() 的訊息會直接丟掉，不會排隊。 公開的欄位有 role、room、id、url、batchHz、resendMs、各個回呼、status、latency（毫秒，第一個 pong 回來之前是 null）、peers 和 sent（已經送出幾則訊息）。 重連之後，演出端要再送一次 config()：用戶端不會記得它。mountRemoteHost() 會替你做這件事。 role 這個頁面的身分。控制端（controller，也就是手機）把訊號送給演出端和監看端。演出端（runner，也就是演出本身）聽得到控制端，也能把 feedback 和 config 送回去。監看端（monitor）只聽不說。主控端（leader）和從屬端（follower）之間只交換 sync 訊息（好幾個頁面演同一場：createSync()）。伺服器遇到其他字一律當成 controller。 room 房間名稱。不同房間的頁面彼此聽不到。1 到 32 個字元，只能用 A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -，其他的伺服器會換成 default。 id 這個裝置的 id，也就是 phone//… 裡的 。預設是 deviceId()，存在 localStorage 裡。伺服器只留前 64 個字元。 url 完整的 WebSocket 位址，查詢字串要自己帶好：wss://host/relay?role=controller&room=main&id=ab12。它不會再補任何東西。不給的話，用頁面網址裡的 ?relay=ws://…，再沒有就用頁面自己的 /relay（https 頁面用 wss:），並自動補上 role、room、id。 batchHz 每秒把你 set() 的數值送出幾次，打包成一則 batch 訊息。 resendMs…

A Signals registry needs to know a name's range before a meter can scale it or a mapping can tell a knob from an event. fileSignal() calls this the first time it hears a name. What it knows: phone//tilt/ is −1..1, accel/ is −20..20 m/s², rot/ is −360..360 °/s, orient/ is 0..360 °, touch/count is 0..10, knock is a pulse, and every other phone/… name (touch, light) is 0..1. surface/… names are 0..1 (…/raw and …/delta are unscaled, {}). midi/note/on, midi/note/off, midi/virtual and the hit, on, off, last names of a controller are pulses, and midi/cc/ is 0..1. name A signal name such as phone/ab12/tilt/x, surface/main/hue or midi/note/on. pulse Pass { pulse: true } when the message was sent as an event: the answer is then always { kind: 'pulse' }. Metadata for signals.define(): { min, max, unit? }, { kind: 'pulse' }, or {} for raw values. null when the name is not one it knows.

Signals 要先知道一個名稱的範圍，音量表才能縮放、映射才分得出旋鈕和事件。fileSignal() 第一次聽到一個名稱就會呼叫它。它認得的有：phone//tilt/ 是 −1..1，accel/ 是 −20..20 m/s²，rot/ 是 −360..360 °/s，orient/ 是 0..360 °，touch/count 是 0..10，knock 是脈衝，其他的 phone/… 名稱（觸控、光線）是 0..1。surface/… 的名稱是 0..1（…/raw 和 …/delta 沒有縮放，回傳 {}）。midi/note/on、midi/note/off、midi/virtual，以及控制器的 hit、on、off、last 名稱是脈衝，midi/cc/ 是 0..1。 name 訊號名稱，例如 phone/ab12/tilt/x、surface/main/hue 或 midi/note/on。 pulse 訊息是當作事件送來的話，傳 { pulse: true }：答案一律是 { kind: 'pulse' }。 給 signals.define() 用的資料：{ min, max, unit? }、{ kind: 'pulse' }，原始值則是 {}。名稱不在它認得的範圍內時是 null。

The first finger down is slot 0 and publishes touch/x, touch/y, touch/down; the second is slot 1 and publishes touch/1/x, touch/1/y, touch/1/down, and so on. A slot is given back when its finger lifts, so the lowest free number is used next. x runs 0 at the left edge to 1 at the right, y runs 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom, both held inside the element and rounded to 4 decimals. touch/down is 1 or 0, and touch/count is the number of fingers down. It publishes touch/down 0 and touch/count 0 at once, so a receiver knows the pad is there before anyone touches it. It uses pointer events, so a mouse works too (one finger). The sense tab uses this on its touch pad, with io writing to a RelayClient under phone//. pad The element to listen on. Give it touch-action: none in CSS, or the browser may take a drag for a scroll and cancel the touch. io Where the values go, as for PhoneSensors: only set is used, and the names have no phone// in front. onMove (slot, x, y, down) => {}, when a finger touches and each time it moves. x and y are 0..1 and down is true. Use it to draw the finger. onEnd (slot) => {}, when a finger lifts or the touch is cancelled.

第一根按下去的手指是 slot 0，發布 touch/x、touch/y、touch/down。第二根是 slot 1，發布 touch/1/x、touch/1/y、touch/1/down，以此類推。手指離開就把 slot 還回去，下一根會用最小的空號。x 從左邊緣的 0 到右邊緣的 1，y 從上緣的 0 到下緣的 1，都限制在元素裡面，並四捨五入到小數點後 4 位。touch/down 是 1 或 0，touch/count 是按著的手指數。 它一接上去就先發布 touch/down 0 和 touch/count 0，所以接收端在還沒有人碰之前就知道觸控板存在。它用的是 pointer 事件，所以滑鼠也能用（算一根手指）。 感測 分頁的觸控板用的就是它，io 寫進 RelayClient，名稱加上 phone//。 pad 要監聽的元素。在 CSS 裡給它 touch-action: none，不然瀏覽器可能把拖曳當成捲動，把觸碰取消掉。 io 數值要送去哪裡，跟 PhoneSensors 一樣：只用到 set，名稱前面沒有 phone//。 onMove (slot, x, y, down) => {}，手指按下去和每次移動的時候呼叫。x、y 是 0..1，down 是 true。拿來畫手指的位置。 onEnd (slot) => {}，手指離開或觸碰被取消的時候呼叫。

A remote phone reaches the show through a relay. When the show page is open on the phone itself, there is no one to relay to, so this reads the sensors in place. The names and thresholds are the same as a remote phone's (phone/local/tilt/x is −1..1, phone/local/knock is a pulse), declared the same way by fileSignal(), and mirrored to phone/any/…, so a route written for "the latest phone", phone/any/tilt/x, works whether the phone is in your hand as a controller or is the show. Call .start() on the result from a tap (iOS asks for permission only inside a gesture, and only on https pages). Until then nothing is published. See PhoneSensors. signals The registry to fill (from @openav/core). prefix What goes in front of each sensor name. alias The word for the copy, phone//…. null turns the copy off. source Stored as the signals' source in signals.meta. hooks The hooks of PhoneSensors: onKnock, onSample, notify. Nothing is listening yet: call .start() from a tap.

遠端的手機要透過中繼才找得到演出。演出頁面就開在手機上的時候，沒有人需要轉送，所以直接在原地讀感測器。名稱和門檻跟遠端手機一樣（phone/local/tilt/x 是 −1..1，phone/local/knock 是脈衝），用 fileSignal() 一樣的方式宣告，並複製一份到 phone/any/…，所以替「最新的那支手機」寫的路由 phone/any/tilt/x，不論手機是拿在手上當控制端、還是它本身就是演出，都能用。 拿到結果之後，要在點擊時呼叫 .start()（iOS 只在手勢裡才會問權限，而且只限 https 頁面）。在那之前什麼都不會發布。見 PhoneSensors。 signals 要填的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 prefix 放在每個感測器名稱前面的字。 alias 複本用的字，phone//…。null 表示不做複本。 source 存成 signals.meta 裡這些訊號的 source。 hooks PhoneSensors 的 hooks：onKnock、onSample、notify。 還沒有開始聽：要在點擊時呼叫 .start()。

The URL is the phone page (packages/remote/ next to this file) with ?room= on it, and with ?relay=… as well when the show uses the public relay or a relay of your own, so the phone ends up in the same room on the same relay. On localhost it asks node serve.js for this machine's LAN address at /info and puts that in the URL, because a phone cannot open localhost. The QR code is drawn from the URL; if the URL is too long for the encoder, the code is left out and the URL stays. The status line reads relay ok · 2 phones · room demo when the connection is open (and adds · public relay on the public one), relay offline — is it node serve.js? when a local relay cannot be reached, and can't reach the relay (…) — retrying for a shared one. On a phone held upright the card starts folded, because the stage is small; tap it to open or fold it. The words on the card are in English. parent The element to add the card to. The card is position: absolute at its top left, so the parent should be positioned (position: relative) and big enough to show it. host The host from mountRemoteHost(). The card reads host.room, host.relayMode and host.relayUrl, and takes over host.onStatus to write the status line. The card's element, already in parent. Remove it with .remove().

網址是手機頁面（這個檔案旁邊的 packages/remote/），後面接 ?room=，演出用公開中繼或你自己的中繼的話還會接上 ?relay=…，這樣手機會進到同一個中繼的同一個房間。在 localhost 的時候，它會向 node serve.js 的 /info 詢問這台電腦的區域網路位址並填進網址，因為手機打不開 localhost。QR code 是依網址畫出來的，網址太長、編碼器放不下時，就只留網址、不畫 QR code。 連線打開的時候，狀態那行寫 relay ok · 2 phones · room demo（用公開中繼的話後面加 · public relay），本機的中繼連不上時寫 relay offline — is it node serve.js?，共用的中繼連不上則寫 can't reach the relay (…) — retrying。直拿的手機上，卡片一開始是收起來的，因為舞台很小，點一下可以展開或收起。 卡片上的字是英文。 parent 要把卡片加進去的元素。卡片是 position: absolute，貼在左上角，所以父元素最好有定位（position: relative），而且夠大，放得下它。 host mountRemoteHost() 回傳的 host。卡片會讀 host.room、host.relayMode、host.relayUrl，並接管 host.onStatus 來寫狀態那行字。 卡片的元素，已經放進 parent 裡了。要移除就呼叫 .remove()。

It is what a phone opens: lockViewport() so nothing scrolls or zooms, keepAwake() so the screen stays on, one RelayClient as a controller that every tab shares, and the tabs. Sense is a tilt ball, readouts, a multi-touch pad (attachTouchPad()) and the sensors (PhoneSensors) behind a start button. Keys is a piano that is one row in landscape and two stacked rows in portrait. Control is a Surface. MIDI is a virtual controller. The control tab's layout comes from, in order: surfaceUrl or ?surface=, metaUrl or ?meta=, whatever layout the show publishes over the relay (the config surface), and finally a small generic panel so the page is never blank. The signals are phone//… (sense), midi/note/on|off and midi/cc/64 (keys), and surface// (control). The app opens on ?tab=, else the tab used last in this browser, else sense. A page of its own (it takes over the whole screen) and a relay to reach: the same origin's /relay unless relayUrl or ?relay= says otherwise. Without a show in the room the header says it is waiting for the work to open. The words on the app's tabs and header are in Chinese. root Where to put the app. It fills the whole page (position: fixed), so pass document.body. opts { room, relayUrl, surfaceUrl, metaUrl }, each optional. room is the relay room (else ?room= in the address, else window.REMOTE.room, else default). relayUrl is a ws:// or wss:// relay (else ?relay=; only those two schemes are accepted, so a link cannot point the phone anywhere else). surfaceUrl…

它就是手機打開的那個東西：lockViewport() 讓畫面不能捲動也不能縮放，keepAwake() 讓螢幕不暗掉，一個所有分頁共用的、身分是控制端的 RelayClient，再加上幾個分頁。感測（sense）有一顆傾斜球、讀數、一塊多點觸控板（attachTouchPad()），以及藏在開始按鈕後面的感測器（PhoneSensors）。琴鍵（keys）是一台鋼琴，橫拿時一排，直拿時上下兩排。控制台（control）是一個 Surface。MIDI 是一台虛擬控制器。 控制台分頁的版面依序從這些地方找：surfaceUrl 或 ?surface=、metaUrl 或 ?meta=、演出透過中繼發布的版面（設定 surface），最後是一個小小的通用面板，頁面永遠不會空白。訊號是 phone//…（感測）、midi/note/on|off 和 midi/cc/64（琴鍵）、surface//（控制台）。app 一開始打開 ?tab= 指定的分頁，沒有就是這個瀏覽器上次用的分頁，再沒有就是感測。 一個專屬的頁面（它會佔滿整個螢幕），以及一個連得到的中繼：沒有 relayUrl 或 ?relay= 的話就是同源的 /relay。房間裡沒有演出的時候，狀態列會寫在等作品開啟。 app 的分頁和狀態列上的字是中文。 root 要把 app 放在哪裡。它會填滿整個頁面（position: fixed），所以傳 document.body。 opts { room, relayUrl, surfaceUrl, metaUrl }，每一項都可省略。room 是中繼房間（沒給就用網址的 ?room=，再沒有就用 window.REMOTE.room，再沒有就是 default）。relayUrl 是 ws:// 或 wss:// 的中繼（沒給就用 ?relay=。只收這兩種，所以一個連結不能把手機指到別的地方）。surfaceUrl 是控制台分頁用的版面 JSON，metaUrl 是帶 params 陣列的 JSON，控制台分頁會把它變成 autoSurface()。網址上也可以寫 ?tab=sense|keys|control|midi。 { relay, show(tab), surface, dispose() }：RelayClient、切換分頁的函式、控制台分頁的 Surface（getter，那個分頁還沒打開過就是 null），以及 dispose()：關掉中繼、解除視窗鎖定、放掉螢幕喚醒鎖、移除整個 app。

createShow({ modules: { remote: true } }) calls this for you, so the world never has to know about phones. Calling it yourself does five things: it makes a RelayClient as the room's runner; files every phone signal into signals with bindSignals() (so phone/any/… always holds the latest phone); builds the layout from surface, world.surface or autoSurface() of the params; adds the surface/… → param routes to the mapper; and, when you call host.frame(dt, state) every frame, sends the resolved param values back about feedbackHz times a second so the phones' faders follow the timeline. Making the host does not connect it: call host.connect() when you want the socket. On every (re)connection it publishes the layout as relay config surface, so a phone that joins later gets the right panel. host.layout, host.routes and host.bindings are there to look at straight away, and host.dispose() closes the socket. A relay for connect() to reach: node serve.js hosts one at /relay, a static site uses the public relay (see pickRelay()), or pass url. Building the host needs none of that. signals The registry that phone signals are filed in. params The world's params. Its schema is what the control surface is built from. mapper The mapper that gets the surface/… → param routes (a route it already has is not added twice). world The world: its params are used when params.schema is empty, its name becomes the layout's title, and its surface (a hand-written layout) is used instead of a generated…

createShow({ modules: { remote: true } }) 會替你呼叫它，所以世界完全不必知道手機的存在。自己呼叫的話，它做五件事：先做一個 RelayClient 當房間的演出端，再用 bindSignals() 把每個手機訊號歸進 signals（所以 phone/any/… 永遠是最新那支手機的值），然後用 surface、world.surface 或參數的 autoSurface() 建立版面，接著把 surface/… → param 路由加進映射器，最後，你每個畫面呼叫 host.frame(dt, state) 的話，它大約每秒 feedbackHz 次把算好的參數值送回去，讓手機上的推桿跟著時間軸動。 做出 host 並不會連線：要連的時候呼叫 host.connect()。每次（重新）連上時，它會把版面當成中繼設定 surface 發布出去，所以之後才加入的手機也拿得到正確的面板。host.layout、host.routes、host.bindings 一做出來就能看，host.dispose() 會把 socket 關掉。 要有中繼讓 connect() 連：node serve.js 在 /relay 架了一個，靜態網站用公開中繼（見 pickRelay()），或傳 url。單單做出 host 不需要這些。 signals 手機訊號要歸進去的註冊表。 params 世界的參數。控制面板就是依它的 schema 建立的。 mapper 會收到 surface/… → param 路由的映射器（它已經有的路由不會重複加）。 world 世界物件：params.schema 是空的時候用它的 params，它的 name 會變成版面的標題，它的 surface（手寫的版面）會取代自動產生的。 room 要加入的中繼房間。 auto 傳給 autoSurface() 的選項：pairs、meters、style、perPage、smooth、title。 surface 指定的版面。它比 world.surface 優先。 feedbackHz host.frame() 每秒把參數值送回手機幾次。 url 不用這個頁面自己的 /relay，改用的中繼，例如 wss://host/relay。role、room、id 會替你補上去。這時演出端的 id 是 show- 加四個隨機字元，所以同一個演出開兩個分頁也不會打架。沒給 url 的話就是 show。 mode pickRelay() 的決定。只有加入卡片上的字會依它而變，host 會把它報成 host.relayMode。 controllers @openav/midi 的螢幕 MIDI 控制器：這樣手機的 MIDI 分頁會顯示同一台裝置，兩邊畫面上彈的音也會互相顯示。 { relay, layout, routes, bindings, publish, room, relayUrl, relayMode, onStatus, frame(dt, state), connect(), dispose() }。connect() 會再回傳 host 本身。

This is the phone half of the sense tab, with no page in it: make one with an io, call start() from a tap, and signals flow. From the phone's own events it produces tilt/x and tilt/y (−1..1, which is ±45° from the resting pose, x to the right and y toward you, in screen axes, so a phone turned sideways still reports "tilt right is +x"), orient/alpha|beta|gamma (degrees), accel/x|y|z (m/s², gravity included), rot/alpha|beta|gamma (degrees per second), knock (a pulse { strength, delta, t }) and, if you turn the camera on, light (0..1). A knock is a jolt: when the acceleration vector changes by more than threshold (10 m/s² by default) between two motion samples, and at least 130 ms after the last knock, io.send('knock', { strength, delta, t }, true) fires. delta is the size of the change, and strength runs from 0.15 just over the threshold up to 1. The phone also vibrates for 10 ms where it can. Hold the phone how you want to play it and call calibrate() to make that pose the zero of the tilt. For the show page itself running on a phone, localSensors() wraps this class and files straight into a Signals. Call start() from a tap or click, not on page load. iOS asks for motion permission only inside a user gesture, and it only gives motion sensors to pages on https://; touch and keys work over plain http://. start() always resolves true: look at denied for a refusal. If no sensor data arrives within 2.5 s, hooks.notify says so (a desktop, or an iPhone page on http).…

這是 感測 分頁在手機這一半的邏輯，裡面不含頁面：給它一個 io，在使用者點一下時呼叫 start()，訊號就開始流動。它用手機自己的事件產生 tilt/x 和 tilt/y（−1..1，也就是離靜止姿勢 ±45°，x 向右、y 朝向你，用的是螢幕座標軸，所以手機橫著拿也還是「往右傾是 +x」）、orient/alpha|beta|gamma（度）、accel/x|y|z（m/s²，含重力）、rot/alpha|beta|gamma（每秒幾度）、knock（脈衝 { strength, delta, t }），打開鏡頭的話還有 light（0..1）。 敲擊就是猛地一震：兩筆動作樣本之間，加速度向量的變化超過 threshold（預設 10 m/s²），而且距離上次敲擊至少 130 毫秒，就會觸發 io.send('knock', { strength, delta, t }, true)。delta 是變化的大小，strength 從剛過門檻的 0.15 到 1。手機能震動的話也會震 10 毫秒。把手機拿成你想演奏的姿勢，呼叫 calibrate()，就把那個姿勢當成傾斜的零點。 演出頁面本身就跑在手機上的話，用 localSensors()，它包住這個類別，直接把訊號歸進 Signals。 要在點擊或觸碰時才呼叫 start()，不是載入頁面時。iOS 只在使用者手勢裡才會問動作權限，而且只把動作感測器開放給 https:// 的頁面，觸控和琴鍵在一般的 http:// 就能用。start() 一律回傳 true，被拒絕要看 denied。2.5 秒內沒有任何感測資料進來的話，hooks.notify 會說明（桌機，或 http 的 iPhone 頁面）。setCamera(true) 在 iOS 上同樣要手勢和 HTTPS。 公開的欄位有 io、hooks、started、gotSensor（收過任何感測資料就是 true）、denied（iOS 說不行，要到「設定」裡改才會變）、rest 和 deg（傾斜，單位度）、threshold（敲擊門檻，10）和 COOLDOWN（130 毫秒）。 io 訊號要送去哪裡。set 收連續的訊號，send 收敲擊（pulse 為 true）。名稱前面沒有 phone//，是 tilt/x、accel/z 這樣。後面可以接加了前綴的 RelayClient，或是 Signals。 hooks 選用的回呼。onKnock(strength) 在每次敲擊之後呼叫，onSample(name, value) 每個連續樣本都呼叫（拿來畫讀數），notify(message) 收一行問題說明，例如權限被拒絕。訊息是中文寫的。

Each item takes the first free spot found by scanning left to right, then top to bottom: what a person does laying out a controller. The grid grows downward as far as it must, so rows is a result, not a limit. resolvePage() uses it for widgets without a position and for the automatic reflow. An item with no w (or a w that is not a number) never finds a spot and the function never returns. Give every item a w and an h; DEFAULT_SIZE has the natural size of each widget type. items What to place, in order. Every item needs a numeric w and h in cells, at least 1. A w wider than the grid is cut to cols. cols How many columns the grid has. fixed Placements that are already decided. They come first in the result and the other items go around them. placements is a list of { id, x, y, w, h } (the fixed ones first), rows is how many rows they fill.

每個項目都從左到右、再從上到下找第一個空位放進去：就是人在排控制器時的做法。格線需要多長就往下長多長，所以 rows 是結果，不是上限。resolvePage() 用它來排沒有位置的元件，也用在自動重排。 沒有 w（或 w 不是數字）的項目永遠找不到位置，函式也就永遠不會結束。每個項目都要給 w 和 h。DEFAULT_SIZE 有每種元件類型的預設大小。 items 要擺的東西，依序排。每一項都要有數字的 w 和 h（單位是格，至少 1）。w 比格線寬的話會被截成 cols。 cols 格線有幾欄。 fixed 已經決定的位置。它們會排在結果的最前面，其他項目繞著它們擺。 placements 是 { id, x, y, w, h } 的清單（固定的排前面），rows 是它們佔了幾列。

This is how a world that declares what it can be performed with gets a phone panel for free: const { layout, routes, bindings } = autoSurface(world.params), then routes.forEach((r) => mapper.addRoute(r)) and new Surface(el, { layout, sink }). Each param becomes the widget widgetTypeFor() picks. Each group of params gets its own page (a param without a group goes on main), long groups continue on main2, main3 …, and a pair from pairs becomes one XY pad with two routes, …/x and …/y. Widget ids are the param keys (anything outside A–Z a–z 0–9 _ - becomes _), colours go round cyan, amber, magenta, lime, violet, coral, and a radio's options come from the param or are the numbers. A pulse param gets no binding, since there is no value to show. The routes already scale the normalized signal to the param's min and max. A world that comes with its own layout uses routesFromLayout() instead. params The param declarations: { key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group?, options?, surface? }. surface: { type, color, label } on a param overrides the choice. perPage How much fits on a page, counted in weights: a fader or a meter weighs 1, an XY pad 4, anything else 2. The default 8 is eight faders, four knobs or two XY pads. A page that scrolls is a page that fails, so a full page starts the next. style Faders or knobs for the continuous params. 'auto' picks faders up to six, knobs beyond. pairs Pairs of param keys to drive with one XY pad: [['cx', 'cy']]. The first key is x and the…

一個宣告了「可以拿什麼來演奏」的世界，就這樣免費得到手機面板：const { layout, routes, bindings } = autoSurface(world.params)，再 routes.forEach((r) => mapper.addRoute(r)) 和 new Surface(el, { layout, sink })。每個參數變成 widgetTypeFor() 挑的元件。每個 group 各有一頁（沒有 group 的參數放在 main），太長的群組接著放到 main2、main3 …，pairs 裡的一對會變成一塊有兩條路由（…/x 和 …/y）的 XY 板。 元件的 id 就是參數鍵（A–Z a–z 0–9 _ - 以外的字元會變成 _），顏色依序輪流用 cyan、amber、magenta、lime、violet、coral，radio 的 options 來自參數，沒有就用數字。脈衝參數沒有 binding，因為沒有值可以顯示。路由已經把正規化的訊號換算成參數的 min 和 max。自己帶版面的世界，改用 routesFromLayout()。 params 參數宣告：{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group?, options?, surface? }。參數上的 surface: { type, color, label } 可以蓋過自動的選擇。 perPage 一頁放得下多少，以權重計算：推桿或音量表算 1，XY 板算 4，其他都算 2。預設的 8 就是八支推桿、四個旋鈕或兩塊 XY 板。要捲動的頁面就是失敗的頁面，所以滿了就開下一頁。 style 連續參數用推桿還是旋鈕。'auto' 六個以內用推桿，超過就用旋鈕。 pairs 要用同一塊 XY 板驅動的參數鍵配對：[['cx', 'cy']]。第一個鍵是 x，第二個是 y。 meters 另外要顯示成唯讀音量表的參數鍵，放在一頁叫 Meters 的頁面。 smooth 連續路由的平滑秒數，用來遮住 30 Hz 網路造成的階梯感（拉鍊雜訊）。脈衝、開關和單選不會被平滑。 title 版面的標題。 layout 是給 Surface 用的版面 JSON。routes 是映射器路由的清單 { source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }，從 surface// 到各個參數。bindings 是給 feedbackFor() 用的 { param, name, page, widget, min, max, readonly? }。

Use it to decide whether to show a fullscreen button: if (canFullscreen()) button.hidden = false. It only checks that the function exists; whether a request succeeds is up to the browser, which wants it to come from a tap (toggleFullscreen()). true or false. false without a document.
用來決定要不要顯示全螢幕按鈕：if (canFullscreen()) button.hidden = false。它只檢查那個函式存不存在。要求會不會成功由瀏覽器決定，瀏覽器要求它必須來自一次點擊（toggleFullscreen()）。 true 或 false。沒有 document 的話是 false。

{ id: 'hue', type: 'knob', color: 'amber' } makes the widget's fill, its value readout and its pressed outline amber. A widget without a colour uses --oav-accent of THEME_VARS. autoSurface() hands out the first six in turn (white is left for you). A name that is not in the list gets no colour of its own and falls back to the accent; validateLayout() does not check it. ['cyan', 'amber', 'magenta', 'lime', 'violet', 'coral', 'white'].

{ id: 'hue', type: 'knob', color: 'amber' } 會讓元件的填色、數值讀數和按下時的描邊都變成琥珀色。沒有顏色的元件用 THEME_VARS 的 --oav-accent。autoSurface() 會輪流發前六個（white 留給你用）。不在清單裡的名稱沒有自己的顏色，會退回強調色。validateLayout() 不檢查它。 七個字串：['cyan', 'amber', 'magenta', 'lime', 'violet', 'coral', 'white']。

A widget without a w or h takes the size of its type, held to the number of columns of the grid. autoArrange() and resolvePage() use it, and so does autoSurface() when it counts how many widgets fit on a page. A type it does not know counts as 2×2. Fourteen keys, one per type: fader 1×4, knob 2×2, encoder 2×2, button 2×1, toggle 2×1, xy 4×4, bank 4×4, radio 4×1, pads 4×4, keyboard 8×4, number 2×1, text 4×1, label 2×1, meter 1×4 (width × height).

沒寫 w 或 h 的元件，會用它的類型的大小，並限制在格線的欄數以內。autoArrange() 和 resolvePage() 會用到它，autoSurface() 計算一頁放得下幾個元件的時候也是。不認得的類型當作 2×2。 十四個鍵，每種類型一個：fader 1×4、knob 2×2、encoder 2×2、button 2×1、toggle 2×1、xy 4×4、bank 4×4、radio 4×1、pads 4×4、keyboard 8×4、number 2×1、text 4×1、label 2×1、meter 1×4（寬 × 高）。

It is pure and cheap, so the show calls it about ten times a second and sends each result to the phones with relay.feedback(name, value); host.frame() of mountRemoteHost() does exactly that. On the phone, Surface's feedback() moves the widget, so a fader follows the timeline and other controllers. state The resolved param values, such as params.resolve(…): { hue: 90, size: 5.5 }. bindings The bindings that autoSurface() returned. One entry per binding that has a number in state: name is the widget's signal, value is the param scaled to 0..1 and held in range. A param that is missing, not a number, or with min equal to max is skipped.

它是純函式、成本很低，所以演出端大約每秒呼叫十次，並用 relay.feedback(name, value) 把每一項送給手機，mountRemoteHost() 的 host.frame() 做的就是這件事。在手機上，Surface 的 feedback() 會移動元件，所以推桿會跟著時間軸和其他控制器動。 state 算好的參數值，例如 params.resolve(…) 的結果：{ hue: 90, size: 5.5 }。 bindings autoSurface() 回傳的 bindings。 state 裡有數字的每個 binding 各一項：name 是元件的訊號，value 是縮放到 0..1 並限制在範圍內的參數值。缺少、不是數字、或 min 等於 max 的參數會跳過。

resolvePage() compares it with the orientation of the screen: a base grid of 8 by 4 is used as it is on a landscape screen and reflowed on a portrait one. g The grid. 'landscape' when g.cols >= g.rows, else 'portrait'.
resolvePage() 會拿它跟螢幕的方向比：8 乘 4 的基本格線在橫向螢幕上直接用，在直向螢幕上就重排。 g 格線。 g.cols >= g.rows 是 'landscape'，否則是 'portrait'。

It calls navigator.vibrate(ms) when that exists and swallows any error. Browsers without it, such as Safari on iPhone, simply do nothing, and Chrome only vibrates after the person has touched the page. Surface calls it for buttons, toggles and radios, and its haptics: false option turns that off. ms How long to vibrate, in milliseconds. A button press in the surface uses 10 to 14. enabled Pass false to do nothing: a page can offer a "haptics" switch and hand it here.

它在 navigator.vibrate(ms) 存在的時候呼叫它，並吞掉任何錯誤。沒有它的瀏覽器，例如 iPhone 上的 Safari，就單純什麼都不做，而 Chrome 要等使用者碰過頁面之後才會震動。Surface 會在按鈕、開關和單選時呼叫它，它的 haptics: false 選項可以把這個關掉。 ms 震動多久，單位毫秒。面板裡按一下按鈕用的是 10 到 14。 enabled 傳 false 就什麼都不做：頁面可以提供一個「觸覺回饋」開關，把它的值交給這裡。

Surface and mountRemote() call it for you, so you need it only when you build a widget by yourself, or when you want the variables (var(--oav-accent)) for your own elements. It adds one to the head, and does nothing if that already exists, or if there is no document. To change the look, set a variable after that: document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--oav-accent', '#ff5fb3').

Surface 和 mountRemote() 會替你呼叫它，所以只有自己建立 元件 的時候，或想在自己的元素上用這些變數（var(--oav-accent)）的時候才需要它。它會在 head 裡加一個 ，這個已經存在、或根本沒有 document 的話，就什麼都不做。要改外觀，在那之後設變數：document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--oav-accent', '#ff5fb3')。

A phone that is a controller dims and locks within a minute unless something holds the screen on. keepAwake() requests navigator.wakeLock.request('screen') right away if the page is visible. The operating system drops the lock whenever the page is hidden, so it asks again each time the page becomes visible. It is best effort and silent: a browser with no wake lock, or one that says no, just means the screen may still dim, and it never throws. A page that is visible, on https or localhost (the wake lock only exists on secure pages). mountRemote() calls it for you. release() stops asking and lets go of the lock.

當控制器用的手機，一分鐘內就會暗掉、鎖定，除非有東西讓螢幕保持亮著。如果頁面看得到，keepAwake() 馬上要求 navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')。頁面一被藏起來，作業系統就會放掉這把鎖，所以每次頁面再變成可見，它都會再要求一次。它是盡力而為、而且不出聲：瀏覽器沒有喚醒鎖、或回答不行的話，就只是螢幕可能還是會暗掉，它絕不會丟出錯誤。 頁面要看得到，而且在 https 或 localhost 底下（喚醒鎖只存在於安全的頁面）。mountRemote() 會替你呼叫它。 release() 停止再要求，並放掉喚醒鎖。

It sets to width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover (making the tag if there is none) and adds a style that gives html and body no margin, the full height, overflow: hidden, overscroll-behavior: none and touch-action: none. iOS ignores user-scalable=no, so it also cancels gesturestart and gesturechange (pinch zoom) and the default of every touchmove, except one that starts in an input or textarea, so a text box still works. This is for a page that is a control panel, such as mountRemote(), which calls it. Do not call it on a page that has to scroll. Without a document (in Node) it returns a function that does nothing. Call it to remove the stylesheet and the listeners. The viewport stays as it was set.

它把 設成 width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover（沒有這個標籤就先做一個），並加一段樣式，讓 html 和 body 沒有邊界、高度填滿、overflow: hidden、overscroll-behavior: none、touch-action: none。iOS 會忽略 user-scalable=no，所以它也取消 gesturestart 和 gesturechange（雙指縮放），以及每個 touchmove 的預設行為，只有從 input 或 textarea 開始的例外，所以文字框還是能用。 這是給整個頁面就是控制面板的情況用的，例如 mountRemote() 就會呼叫它。要捲動的頁面不要呼叫它。沒有 document（在 Node 裡）的話，它回傳一個什麼都不做的函式。 呼叫它會移除樣式表和監聽。viewport 的 維持設好的樣子，不會還原。

A page without an id becomes page1, page2 …; without a title it gets its id (or Page 1); without a grid it gets { cols: 8, rows: 6 }. A widget without an id becomes its type and its position in the list, fader1; an id already used on the page gets _ added until it is unique. Every other field is kept as it is. Surface normalizes the layout it is given, and so do signalNames() and the show side of the remote. The default grid has 6 rows. autoSurface() writes its own grids of 8 by 4, so this default only matters for layouts that leave the grid out. raw The layout JSON. undefined or an object without pages gives a layout with no pages. { version: 1, title, pages } with every page and widget complete.

沒有 id 的頁面會變成 page1、page2 …，沒有 title 就用它的 id（或 Page 1），沒有 grid 就是 { cols: 8, rows: 6 }。沒有 id 的元件會變成「類型加在清單中的位置」，像 fader1。在同一頁已經用過的 id 會一直加上 _ 直到不重複。其他欄位原樣保留。Surface 會把拿到的版面正規化，signalNames() 和遙控的演出端也一樣。 預設格線是 6 列。autoSurface() 自己寫的格線是 8 乘 4，所以這個預設值只對沒寫格線的版面有意義。 raw 版面 JSON。undefined 或沒有 pages 的物件，會得到沒有任何頁面的版面。 { version: 1, title, pages }，每個頁面和元件的欄位都補齊了。

Surface calls it with the size of its container, not the size of the screen, so a panel in a half-width pane can be portrait while the phone is landscape. Use gridOrientation() for the shape of a grid. w The width, in any unit. h The height, in the same unit. 'landscape' when w >= h, else 'portrait'.
Surface 傳給它的是容器的大小，不是螢幕的大小，所以放在半寬窗格裡的面板可以是直向，而手機本身是橫向。要判斷格線的形狀，用 gridOrientation()。 w 寬，什麼單位都可以。 h 高，單位跟寬一樣。 w >= h 是 'landscape'，否則是 'portrait'。

A piano is two and a half metres wide and a phone held upright is six centimetres, so shrinking the keys makes a toy. Instead the keyboard changes shape with its box. A wide box gets one row with as many octaves as fit at minKeyPx or wider. A tall box gets two rows, the upper one continuing the pitch range where the lower stops, within reach of a thumb. The rows end on E or B and the next one starts on the next white key, so no black key is left alone at the seam. Notes stop at 127. The keyboard widget of Surface calls this every time its box changes size. width The width of the box, in pixels. height The height of the box, in pixels. base The MIDI note of the lowest key. 48 is C3 (C4 is 60). minKeyPx The narrowest a white key may be, in pixels. At least 3 white keys are kept. maxWhites The most white keys in a row. Two stacked rows are limited to 14 each. stackBelow Stack into two rows when width ÷ height is below this. forceRows 1 or 2 to decide yourself; 0 lets the shape of the box decide. stacked is true for two rows, whites the white keys in a row, keyPx the width of a white key. rows is a list of { base, semitones, whites }, the top row first (the higher notes), the way two keyboards are read: base is the MIDI note of the first key and semitones how many notes the row spans.

一台鋼琴有兩公尺半寬，直拿的手機只有六公分，把琴鍵縮小只會變成玩具。所以改成讓鍵盤隨著框的形狀變形。很寬的框得到一排，放得下幾個八度就放幾個（白鍵不窄於 minKeyPx）。很高的框得到兩排，上排接著下排停下來的地方往高音延伸，拇指搆得到。每一排都結束在 E 或 B，下一排從下一個白鍵開始，所以接縫處不會留下孤單的黑鍵。音符最高到 127。Surface 的 keyboard 元件在框的大小改變時，每次都會呼叫它。 width 框的寬，單位像素。 height 框的高，單位像素。 base 最低音那個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼。48 是 C3（C4 是 60）。 minKeyPx 白鍵最窄可以多寬，單位像素。至少會保留 3 個白鍵。 maxWhites 一排最多幾個白鍵。上下兩排的話，每排最多 14 個。 stackBelow 寬 ÷ 高低於這個值就改成上下兩排。 forceRows 1 或 2 自己決定，0 由框的形狀決定。 stacked 為 true 就是兩排，whites 是每排的白鍵數，keyPx 是白鍵的寬度。rows 是 { base, semitones, whites } 的清單，上面那一排在最前面（音比較高），就像兩層鍵盤的讀法：base 是第一個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼，semitones 是那一排涵蓋幾個半音。

A phone gets turned, so a layout has to survive it. The rules, in order: 1. If the page has a portrait or landscape entry for this orientation, use its grid and its place ({ widgetId: { x, y, w, h } }); widgets it does not mention keep their own position, or are packed into free cells (source is 'explicit'). 2. Else, if the base grid has the right shape (more columns than rows is landscape) and every widget has an x and a y, use the base ('base'). 3. Else reflow: the same widgets in reading order, packed again into half the columns (portrait, at least 2) or twice as many (landscape, up to 16), with a lone last row stretched to the edge by stretchRows() ('reflow'). Rows are a count, not pixels, so the result always fills the screen and nothing scrolls. A widget without w and h takes the size of its type from DEFAULT_SIZE. Surface calls this for every page each time the orientation changes. page One page of a layout: { grid, widgets, portrait?, landscape? }. orientation Which way the screen is held. grid is { cols, rows }, placements a list of { id, x, y, w, h }, source is 'explicit', 'base' or 'reflow'.

手機會被轉來轉去，所以版面一定要撐得住。規則依序是：1. 頁面針對這個方向有 portrait 或 landscape 的項目，就用它的 grid 和 place（{ 元件 id: { x, y, w, h } }）。它沒提到的元件保留自己的位置，或被打包進空的格子（source 是 'explicit'）。2. 否則，基本格線的形狀對（欄數多於列數是橫向）、而且每個元件都有 x 和 y，就用基本格線（'base'）。3. 否則重排：同樣的元件依閱讀順序，重新打包進一半的欄數（直向，至少 2 欄）或兩倍的欄數（橫向，最多 16 欄），最後孤零零的一列由 stretchRows() 拉到邊緣（'reflow'）。 列數是個數，不是像素，所以結果永遠填滿螢幕，不會捲動。沒有 w 和 h 的元件，會用 DEFAULT_SIZE 裡它的類型的大小。每次方向改變，Surface 都會對每一頁呼叫它。 page 版面中的一頁：{ grid, widgets, portrait?, landscape? }。 orientation 螢幕怎麼拿。 grid 是 { cols, rows }，placements 是 { id, x, y, w, h } 的清單，source 是 'explicit'、'base' 或 'reflow'。

Give a widget a target and the layout file is enough to perform a world. target is a param key, or an array for the widgets with several signals: an xy sends x to the first and y to the second, a bank sends channel i to the i-th. Every other widget uses its first (or only) target. The routes already scale the 0..1 signal to the param's min and max. mountRemoteHost() uses this for a layout from world.surface or from its surface option. layout The layout JSON, whose widgets may have a target. params The param declarations. A target that is not among them is skipped without a warning. smooth Seconds of smoothing on continuous routes. A widget's own smooth wins. Pulse params and button, toggle and radio widgets are never smoothed. Routes in the same shape autoSurface() makes: { source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }, with curve taken from the widget (linear if it has none).

給元件一個 target，光靠版面檔案就能演奏一個世界。target 是參數鍵，訊號不只一個的元件可以給陣列：xy 把 x 送給第一個、y 送給第二個，bank 把第 i 個頻道送給第 i 個。其他元件都用第一個（或唯一的）target。路由已經把 0..1 的訊號換算成參數的 min 和 max。mountRemoteHost() 遇到來自 world.surface 或 surface 選項的版面，就是用它。 layout 版面 JSON，裡面的元件可以有 target。 params 參數宣告。target 不在裡面的話，會不吭一聲地跳過。 smooth 連續路由的平滑秒數。元件自己的 smooth 優先。脈衝參數，以及 button、toggle、radio 元件不會被平滑。 格式跟 autoSurface() 做出來的一樣的路由：{ source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }，curve 取自元件（沒有就是 linear）。

It follows the table in WIDGET_TYPES: an XY pad gives /x, /y, /down; a bank gives /1 to /count; pads give /hit and /0 to /; an encoder gives its name and /delta; a keyboard gives midi/note/on, midi/note/off, midi/cc/64 and midi/virtual; a label or a meter gives nothing. The …/raw names that a widget with a range also sends are not in the list. layout The layout JSON (it is normalized first). Unique names such as surface/main/hue, surface/main/pad/x, midi/note/on, in page and widget order.

它依照 WIDGET_TYPES 裡的表：XY 板給 /x、/y、/down，bank 給 /1 到 /count，pads 給 /hit 和 /0 到 /，encoder 給它自己的名稱和 /delta，keyboard 給 midi/note/on、midi/note/off、midi/cc/64 和 midi/virtual，label 和 meter 什麼都不給。有範圍的元件另外送的 …/raw 名稱不在清單裡。 layout 版面 JSON（會先正規化）。 不重複的名稱，像 surface/main/hue、surface/main/pad/x、midi/note/on，依頁面和元件的順序。

A name it has not met is declared first: { kind: 'pulse' } when info.pulse is set, otherwise { min: 0, max: 1 }. Then a pulse fires with signals.pulse() and anything else is signals.set(). So a route in the mapper, { source: 'surface/main/hue', target: 'hue' }, works whether the finger is on this page or on a phone. It does no scaling: the …/raw signal that a widget with a range sends is filed like any other name, with the range 0..1 it was declared with, so ignore those or give them their own declaration. signals The registry to write into (from @openav/core). A (name, value, info) => {} to pass as Surface's sink.

還沒見過的名稱會先宣告：info.pulse 有設的話是 { kind: 'pulse' }，不然是 { min: 0, max: 1 }。然後脈衝用 signals.pulse() 觸發，其他都是 signals.set()。所以映射器裡的路由 { source: 'surface/main/hue', target: 'hue' }，不論手指在這個頁面上還是在手機上，都能運作。 它不做任何縮放：有範圍的元件送出的 …/raw 訊號，會跟其他名稱一樣歸檔，宣告的範圍是 0..1，所以請忽略它們，或自己另外宣告。 signals 要寫進去的註冊表（來自 @openav/core）。 一個 (name, value, info) => {}，傳給 Surface 的 sink。

A row is stretched only when it is safe: its widgets are all the same height, side by side with no gaps from the left edge, and nothing else sits to their right. The extra columns are dealt out one at a time from left to right, so a short row of three in four columns gives the first widget two columns. A row that does not qualify is left alone, and nothing ever overlaps. resolvePage() calls it at the end of a reflow. Advanced. You rarely call it yourself. placements Placements, for example from autoArrange(). Not changed: copies come back. cols How many columns the grid has. The placements, with the short rows widened.

只有安全的時候才會拉長一列：它的元件高度都一樣、從左邊緣開始一個接一個沒有空隙、右邊也沒有別的東西。多出來的欄數從左到右一欄一欄分下去，所以四欄裡只有三個元件的短列，第一個元件會拿到兩欄。不符合條件的列就不動，也絕不會重疊。resolvePage() 在重排的最後會呼叫它。 進階用法。通常不用自己呼叫。 placements 位置清單，例如來自 autoArrange()。不會被改動，回傳的是複本。 cols 格線有幾欄。 位置清單，短的列已經加寬。

Pass new Surface(container, { layout, sink }) and a panel appears: faders, knobs, an XY pad, pads, a keyboard, whatever the layout names, each with its live number. Widgets are dumb on purpose. Fingers go in, named normalized signals come out of sink, and the surface never knows what the work is. Run it on the show page with signalSink(), or on a phone with a sink that sends to the relay: the same layout works for both. A world's params can grow the whole layout by themselves with autoSurface(). The grid always fills the container and nothing scrolls. When the container is turned, the page is laid out again for the new orientation by resolvePage(): a portrait or landscape variant in the layout if there is one, else the base grid, else the same widgets packed again into half or double the columns. Touching a widget outlines it in its colour, and a double-tap on a fader or knob returns it to its default. Runner to widget goes the other way: feedback(name, value) moves a fader to follow the timeline, or fills a meter. A widget under a finger ignores feedback while it is touched and for about half a second after, so it does not fight the hand (a button only while it is held). A browser page (it builds DOM) and a container with a size. The panel injects its look once with injectTheme(). Nothing else to start: it works on the first touch. On a phone page, lockViewport() stops the page from scrolling and zooming under the fingers. Public fields: layout (the normalized layout),…

呼叫 new Surface(container, { layout, sink })，面板就出現了：推桿、旋鈕、XY 板、打擊墊、琴鍵，版面裡寫什麼就有什麼，每個都顯示即時的數字。元件刻意做得很笨：手指進去，有名字的正規化訊號從 sink 出來，面板完全不知道作品是什麼。在演出頁面上搭配 signalSink() 用，或在手機上搭配送去中繼的 sink 用：同一份版面兩邊都行。世界的參數也能用 autoSurface() 自己長出整份版面。 格線一定填滿容器，不會有任何捲動。容器轉向的時候，頁面會由 resolvePage() 依新的方向重新排：版面裡有 portrait 或 landscape 的版本就用它，沒有就用基本格線，再不行就把同樣的元件重新擺進一半或兩倍的欄數。碰到元件時，它會用自己的顏色描邊，在推桿或旋鈕上連點兩下就回到預設值。 從演出端到元件是另一條路：feedback(name, value) 讓推桿跟著時間軸動，或把音量表填起來。手指碰著的元件，在被碰著的時候和放開後大約半秒內，會忽略 feedback，不跟手搶（按鈕則只有按住的時候）。 要有瀏覽器頁面（它會建立 DOM），而且容器要有大小。面板會用 injectTheme() 把它的外觀注入一次。不用另外啟動：第一次觸碰就能用。在手機頁面上，用 lockViewport() 讓頁面不會在手指底下捲動或縮放。 公開的欄位有 layout（正規化之後的版面）、root（面板的元素）、orientation、pageId、widgets（"page/id" 對應元件的 Map）、sink、haptics。 建構函式在檢查版面之前就把面板加進容器了，所以版面在那裡丟出錯誤的話，會留下一個空的面板。版面來自檔案或使用者的話，請先跑 validateLayout()。 container 面板要放的地方。面板是 position: absolute，會填滿它，所以容器要有定位（position: relative）和大小，不然面板就沒有大小。 layout 版面 JSON（見 validateLayout()）：頁面、格線、元件。版面有問題會丟出錯誤，列出每一個問題。 sink (name, value, info) => {}，每一次觸碰產生訊號都會呼叫。name 像 surface/main/hue，value 是正規化的 0..1（事件是 info.pulse，文字框則是字串）。元件的範圍不是 0..1 的時候，info.raw 帶著沒縮放的值，接著還會再呼叫一次，名稱是 …/raw。signalSink() 會寫進 Signals，手機上則傳一個呼叫 relay.set 的函式。 haptics 在按下按鈕、切換開關、選了單選項目、雙擊重設的時候讓手機震一下，瀏覽器做得到的話（Android Chrome）。false 就關掉。 tabs 版面有一頁以上的時候，顯示分頁列。false 就隱藏，改用 setPage() 切換。 orientation 強制指定方向。不給的話，它跟著容器的形狀走（寬大於高是橫向），容器改變它也會跟著改。 onPage (pageId) => {}，換頁的時候呼叫，一開始也會用第一頁呼叫一次。

The design is a set of rules rather than decoration, because a controller is used in the dark, fast and half-looking: dark cards on near-black, the only saturated thing on screen is a value, every touch target at least 44 px (--oav-touch-min), the number you are changing always visible, and a pressed widget outlines itself in its colour. Everything is a CSS variable, so a work re-skins the surface by overriding a few of them, never by editing widget code. injectTheme() writes these values into the page once. Override after that, on document.documentElement or in your own stylesheet, with a rule that comes later on :root. Property name to its default value: --oav-bg #0a0c11, --oav-surface #141922, --oav-surface-2 #1b2230, --oav-line #283044, --oav-text #e8ecf5, --oav-dim #8691a8, --oav-accent #7ea6ff, --oav-ok #3ddc84, --oav-warn #f5a524, --oav-bad #e5484d, --oav-radius 14px, --oav-gap 8px, --oav-touch-min 44px, --oav-font (the system font) and --oav-mono (a monospace font).

設計是一組規則，不是裝飾，因為控制器是在黑暗中、很快、只用眼角餘光看的：近黑底上的深色卡片、畫面上唯一飽和的東西是數值、每個觸碰目標至少 44 像素（--oav-touch-min）、正在調的數字一定看得到、被按住的元件用自己的顏色描邊。所有東西都是 CSS 變數，所以作品只要覆寫其中幾個就能換皮膚，不必改元件的程式碼。 injectTheme() 會把這些值寫進頁面一次。要覆寫的話，在那之後，對 document.documentElement 設，或在你自己的樣式表裡用排在後面的 :root 規則。 屬性名稱對應它的預設值：--oav-bg #0a0c11、--oav-surface #141922、--oav-surface-2 #1b2230、--oav-line #283044、--oav-text #e8ecf5、--oav-dim #8691a8、--oav-accent #7ea6ff、--oav-ok #3ddc84、--oav-warn #f5a524、--oav-bad #e5484d、--oav-radius 14px、--oav-gap 8px、--oav-touch-min 44px、--oav-font（系統字型）和 --oav-mono（等寬字型）。

It asks for the whole page (document.documentElement) with the browser's navigation bar hidden, and quietly does nothing on a browser without fullscreen (see canFullscreen()). The phone app puts it on a ⛶ button in the status bar. A user gesture: call it from a click or pointerdown handler. Called on page load it is refused by the browser.
它要求整個頁面（document.documentElement）進入全螢幕，並把瀏覽器的導覽列藏起來，瀏覽器沒有全螢幕功能（見 canFullscreen()）的話就安靜地什麼都不做。手機 app 把它放在狀態列的 ⛶ 按鈕上。 需要使用者手勢：在 click 或 pointerdown 的處理函式裡呼叫。在頁面載入時呼叫，瀏覽器會拒絕。

It looks for: no object, or no non-empty pages array (it stops there); a page without an id, with a duplicate id or an id outside A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -; a widget whose type is not in WIDGET_TYPES, without an id, with a duplicate id on its page or an id outside those characters (the id becomes part of a signal name); and a min equal to its max. It reports every problem it finds, not only the first. It does not look at positions, grids or targets: a widget that overlaps another, or a target that is not a param, is not a problem here. Surface's setLayout() runs it and throws with the list when it is not empty. layout The raw layout JSON. One sentence per problem, with where it is (pages[0].widgets[2]: unknown type "dial"). [] when the layout is fine.

它會檢查：不是物件、或沒有非空的 pages 陣列（到這裡就停），頁面沒有 id、id 重複、或 id 用了 A–Z a–z 0–9 _ - 以外的字元，元件的 type 不在 WIDGET_TYPES 裡、沒有 id、在同一頁 id 重複、或 id 用了那些以外的字元（id 會變成訊號名稱的一部分），還有 min 等於 max。它會報告找得到的每一個問題，不只是第一個。 它不看位置、格線或 target：元件互相重疊、或 target 不是任何參數，在這裡都不算問題。Surface 的 setLayout() 會跑它，清單不是空的就丟出錯誤。 layout 原始的版面 JSON。 每個問題一句話，附上位置（pages[0].widgets[2]: unknown type "dial"）。版面沒問題就是 []。

Most pages never touch it: Surface looks each spec.type up here. It is exported for code that wants a single widget without a whole panel. spec is the widget's entry of the layout ({ id, type, label, min, max, … }) and ctx is { page, out(name, value, info), haptic(ms) }, where out is where the widget's signals go and page is the page id used in their names. A widget's element is .el; put it in the page yourself. Adding your own key here does not make a new layout type: validateLayout() only accepts the names in WIDGET_TYPES. Advanced. The keyboard widget wraps KeysPiano from @openav/keys. An object with the same 14 keys as WIDGET_TYPES, each a class: new WIDGET_CLASSEStype.

大部分頁面用不到它：Surface 會在這裡查每個 spec.type。把它匯出來，是給只想要單一元件、不要整個面板的程式用的。spec 是元件在版面裡的那一項（{ id, type, label, min, max, … }），ctx 是 { page, out(name, value, info), haptic(ms) }，out 就是元件的訊號送去的地方，page 是用在訊號名稱裡的頁面 id。元件的元素是 .el，要自己把它放進頁面。 在這裡加你自己的鍵，並不會多出一種新的版面類型：validateLayout() 只接受 WIDGET_TYPES 裡的名稱。 進階用法。keyboard 元件包著 @openav/keys 的 KeysPiano。 一個物件，鍵跟 WIDGET_TYPES 一樣有 14 個，每個值是一個類別：new WIDGET_CLASSEStype。

Each widget publishes under surface//, normalized 0..1; when its range is not 0..1 the unscaled value also goes out as …/raw. What each type sends: Fields every widget accepts: id, type, label, min, max, def, step, unit, color (one of COLOR_NAMES) and, for hand-written layouts, target, the param key that routesFromLayout() turns into a route. Others by type: orient (v, h or auto) on a fader, spring: true on an XY pad, count and labels on a bank, options on a radio, rows, cols and labels on pads, pulse on a button. The keys of DEFAULT_SIZE, in that order. validateLayout() rejects any type that is not in it.

每個元件都發布在 surface// 底下，正規化成 0..1。範圍不是 0..1 的話，沒縮放的值也會以 …/raw 送出。各類型送出的東西： signalNames() 可以替你的版面列出這些名稱。 每個元件都接受的欄位：id、type、label、min、max、def、step、unit、color（COLOR_NAMES 其中之一），手寫版面還可以加 target，也就是 routesFromLayout() 要變成路由的參數鍵。各類型另有：推桿的 orient（v、h 或 auto）、XY 板的 spring: true、bank 的 count 和 labels、radio 的 options、pads 的 rows、cols 和 labels。 DEFAULT_SIZE 的鍵，順序也一樣。validateLayout() 會拒絕不在裡面的 type。

The rules, first match wins: a surface: { type } hint on the param; pulse is a button; step: 1 over a range of 1 (two values) is a toggle; step: 1 over a range of 2 to 6 (three to seven values) is a radio; style 'knob' or 'fader' as asked; otherwise a fader, or a knob when continuousCount is above 6. A missing min is 0 and a missing max is 1. autoSurface() calls it for every param. p A param: { key, min?, max?, step?, pulse?, surface? }. continuousCount How many continuous params the panel has in all. More than 6 turns faders into knobs. style Force faders or knobs for the continuous params. One of the names in WIDGET_TYPES.

規則依序比對，第一個符合的就用：參數上有 surface: { type } 提示就照它，pulse 是 button，step: 1 而範圍是 1（兩個值）是 toggle，step: 1 而範圍是 2 到 6（三到七個值）是 radio，style 要求 'knob' 或 'fader' 就照辦，其他是 fader，continuousCount 超過 6 時是 knob。沒寫 min 當 0，沒寫 max 當 1。autoSurface() 會對每個參數呼叫它。 p 一個參數：{ key, min?, max?, step?, pulse?, surface? }。 continuousCount 整個面板一共有幾個連續參數。超過 6 個，推桿就改成旋鈕。 style 連續參數強制用推桿或旋鈕。 WIDGET_TYPES 裡的其中一個名稱。

What each action does: They are only the defaults. A show that plays the computer keyboard as a piano wants its letters back, so mountConsole(el, app, { keys }) and createShow({ console: { keys } }) lay your own map over this one: see resolveKeys(). { play: 'Space', next: 'ArrowRight', prev: 'ArrowLeft', reset: 'R', perf: 'T', fullscreen: 'F', midi: 'M', cancel: 'Escape', curves: 'C' }. Frozen: it cannot be changed.

每個動作做什麼： 它們只是預設值。把電腦鍵盤當鋼琴彈的演出會想把字母鍵要回來，所以 mountConsole(el, app, { keys }) 和 createShow({ console: { keys } }) 會把你自己的對照表疊在這一份上面：見 resolveKeys()。 { play: 'Space', next: 'ArrowRight', prev: 'ArrowLeft', reset: 'R', perf: 'T', fullscreen: 'F', midi: 'M', cancel: 'Escape', curves: 'C' }。它是凍結的，不能改。

These are the only names a keys map may use: resolveKeys() throws for any other. The order matters once: when two actions are given the same key, the one that comes first here gets it. ['play', 'next', 'prev', 'reset', 'perf', 'fullscreen', 'midi', 'cancel', 'curves']: the keys of DEFAULT_KEYS.
keys 對照表只能用這些名字：其他名字會讓 resolveKeys() 丟出錯誤。順序只在一個地方有影響：兩個動作被設成同一個鍵的時候，在這裡排前面的那個拿到它。 ['play', 'next', 'prev', 'reset', 'perf', 'fullscreen', 'midi', 'cancel', 'curves']：也就是 DEFAULT_KEYS 的鍵。

A show that moves the shortcuts should not keep saying "press R". Build the hint from the keys in force: keyLabel(show.console.keys, 'reset') gives F6 once the show has moved reset there. The console's own buttons and the performance mode do the same. bindings What resolveKeys() returned, or desk.keys of a mounted console. action An action name from KEY_ACTIONS. The label of the action's first key, as it was written in the spec, with ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, ArrowUp, ArrowDown and Escape shown as →, ←, ↑, ↓ and Esc. '' when the action has no key or the name is unknown.

挪動了快速鍵的演出，不該還在說「按 R」。提示請從目前生效的按鍵組出來：演出把 reset 挪到 F6 之後，keyLabel(show.console.keys, 'reset') 會回答 F6。控台自己的按鈕和演出模式也是這樣做的。 bindings resolveKeys() 的回傳值，或已掛上的控台的 desk.keys。 action KEY_ACTIONS 裡的一個動作名稱。 這個動作第一個鍵的標籤，照你寫的樣子，其中 ArrowRight、ArrowLeft、ArrowUp、ArrowDown 和 Escape 會顯示成 →、←、↑、↓ 和 Esc。動作沒有鍵，或名稱不認得，就是 ''。

The desk reads the same objects the loop runs and owns nothing. From top to bottom it has the transport (play, previous and next scene, reset, the clock) and a scrubber with a block for every scene (with a tick for every cue, and a dashed end for a hold, when the scenes have them); with a score, the Director panel; the Layers overview (L1 input, L2 mapping, L3 world, L4 output); L1 · Input (MIDI devices, 🎤 mic, 🖐 hands, 🕺 body, leap); L2 · Mapping (the routes with a mute box and ✕, 🎛 map knobs in order, ⬇ export, ⬆ import, clear); L3 · Params (a slider per param with ✕ to clear the override and a learn chip; a yellow label means overridden); L4 · sound when there is a sound engine; and the Signals meters with the MIDI log. Every panel header collapses its section. Keyboard, on the whole window: Space play and pause (at a hold: release it), → and ← next and previous scene (→ at a hold releases it), R back to the start, T performance mode (a fullscreen teleprompter for the performer: scene title, note and acts, the clock, the next scene, a HOLD banner), F fullscreen, M the on-screen MIDI controller panel (when the show has one), C opens and closes the Curves panel, Esc stops the mapping wizard or leaves keyboard-piano capture. Typing in an input field, a held key and any combination with ⌘, Ctrl or Alt are ignored. While the on-screen piano captures the keyboard the letters (R, T, F, M, C) belong to the piano; Space, the arrows and Esc always work. These are the defaults…

控台讀的是迴圈實際在跑的那些物件，自己什麼都不擁有。由上到下依序是：播放控制（播放、上一個與下一個場景、重設、時鐘）和一條 scrubber（每個場景一個區塊，場景有 cue 的話每個 cue 一個刻度、有 hold 的話尾端是虛線）。有總譜的話，Director 面板。Layers 總覽（L1 輸入、L2 映射、L3 世界、L4 輸出）。L1 · Input（MIDI 裝置、🎤 mic、🖐 hands、🕺 body、leap）。L2 · Mapping（路由清單，附靜音框與 ✕，還有 🎛 map knobs in order、⬇ export、⬆ import、clear）。L3 · Params（每個參數一支推桿，附清除覆寫的 ✕ 和 learn 標籤，黃色標籤代表被覆寫）。有聲音引擎的話是 L4 · sound。最後是 Signals 音量表和 MIDI 紀錄。每個面板的標題都可以收合它的區塊。 鍵盤，作用在整個視窗：Space 播放與暫停（在 hold 上則是放行）、→ 和 ← 下一個與上一個場景（在 hold 上，→ 是放行）、R 回到起點、T 演出模式（給表演者看的全螢幕提詞器：場景標題、備註與 acts、時鐘、下一個場景、HOLD 橫幅）、F 全螢幕、M 螢幕上的 MIDI 控制器面板（演出有的話）、C 打開與收起 Curves 面板、Esc 停止映射精靈，或離開鍵盤鋼琴的捕捉。在輸入欄位裡打字、按住不放的鍵，以及任何帶 ⌘、Ctrl 或 Alt 的組合都會被忽略。螢幕鋼琴捕捉鍵盤的時候，字母鍵（R、T、F、M、C）屬於鋼琴，Space、方向鍵和 Esc 則永遠有效。這些是預設值（DEFAULT_KEYS）：opts.keys 可以把每個動作挪到別的鍵。 每個畫面在 stage.frame() 之後呼叫 desk.render(state)（演出的迴圈會做）：控台只在你叫它的時候才重畫。state 是解析後的參數，也就是 params.resolve(timeline.state())。 Curves 面板把每個參數在整場演出裡的自動化曲線畫出來，連同段落、播放頭和覆寫。它一開始是收起來的，打開之前不花任何成本。沒有任何參數有自動化曲線的演出，就沒有這個面板。 鍵盤處理是掛在 window 上的，所以同一頁有兩個控台的話，兩個都會回應按鍵。dispose() 會移除它。演出模式的提詞器是加在 document.body 底下，不是 root。 碰一下推桿（或被映射的控制），那個參數就離開時間軸的掌控，直到你按下它的 ✕：有人抓住控制項的時候，樂譜讓路。 root 要在裡面建出控台的元素。它會得到 oav-console 這個 class，控台的樣式也會一次加進 。 app 控台要讀取的物件：{ timeline, params, mapper, signals, stage } 一定要有，midi、controllers、keys、sound、audio、hands、pose、leap、chord、remote、drums、loop、osc、score、director 是選填的。缺少的部分，它的區塊就會隱藏。createShow() 傳的是 show.app。 opts { layers: false } 和 { signals: false } 會省略 Layers 和 Signals 面板。{ learnOrder: ['hue', 'size'] } 設定 🎛 map knobs in order…

A key is a string, and it matches either the character typed or the physical key. 'r' or 'R' is the character (Shift does not matter unless the spec says Shift+). 'KeyR' is the physical R key whatever the layout types there. 'Space', 'F6', 'Backquote', 'ArrowUp', 'Enter' are KeyboardEvent.code or key names, in any case. Modifiers go in front: 'Shift+T', 'Ctrl+R', 'Alt+…', 'Meta+…' (also Control, Option, Cmd, Command). When the spec has no Ctrl, Alt or Meta, those keys must not be held, so ⌘R and Ctrl+F stay with the browser. It throws an Error for an action name that is not in KEY_ACTIONS, for a keys that is not an object, and for a key that cannot be parsed (an empty string inside a list, an unknown modifier). mountConsole() and createShow() call it first, so a typo stops the show before anything is mounted. While the on-screen piano captures the keyboard, a letter key (a to z, and ;) without Ctrl, Alt or Meta does nothing wherever you put an action, Shift+T included. Keys such as F6 or Backquote keep working. keys { action: 'key' }, { action: ['key', 'key'] } or { action: false }, laid over DEFAULT_KEYS. false, null or '' switches that action off. Nothing (undefined or null) gives the defaults; false instead of the object switches every shortcut off. A frozen object with one entry per action of KEY_ACTIONS: a frozen array of { spec, key, shift, ctrl, alt, meta, typing, label }, empty for an action that is switched off. label is what a hint prints (→ for ArrowRight, Esc…

鍵寫成字串，可以比對打出來的字元，也可以比對實體按鍵。'r' 或 'R' 是字元（有沒有按 Shift 都算，除非寫法裡有 Shift+）。'KeyR' 是實體的 R 鍵，不管鍵盤配置在那個位置打出什麼字。'Space'、'F6'、'Backquote'、'ArrowUp'、'Enter' 是 KeyboardEvent.code 或按鍵名稱，大小寫不拘。修飾鍵寫在前面：'Shift+T'、'Ctrl+R'、'Alt+…'、'Meta+…'（也可以寫 Control、Option、Cmd、Command）。寫法裡沒有 Ctrl、Alt、Meta 的時候，這三個鍵不能被按著，所以 ⌘R 和 Ctrl+F 仍然歸瀏覽器。 動作名稱不在 KEY_ACTIONS 裡、keys 不是物件、鍵的寫法解析不了（清單裡有空字串、不認得的修飾鍵），它都會丟出 Error。mountConsole() 和 createShow() 一開始就會呼叫它，所以打錯字會在任何東西掛上去之前就把演出擋下來。 螢幕鋼琴捕捉鍵盤的時候，不帶 Ctrl、Alt、Meta 的字母鍵（a 到 z，以及 ;）不管你把哪個動作放上去都不作用，Shift+T 也一樣。F6、Backquote 這類鍵則照常有效。 keys { 動作: '鍵' }、{ 動作: ['鍵', '鍵'] } 或 { 動作: false }，疊在 DEFAULT_KEYS 上面。false、null 或 '' 會關掉那個動作。什麼都不給（undefined 或 null）就是預設值。整個參數給 false 則關掉所有快速鍵。 一個凍結的物件，KEY_ACTIONS 的每個動作各有一項：一個凍結的陣列，內容是 { spec, key, shift, ctrl, alt, meta, typing, label }，被關掉的動作是空陣列。label 是提示上要印的字（ArrowRight 印 →，Escape 印 Esc）。typing 為 true 表示螢幕鋼琴捕捉鍵盤的時候，這個鍵會被鋼琴拿走。

One bad value must not stop a whole snapshot from being sent, so every field is checked. A number that is not finite (NaN, Infinity) becomes null. A string is cut to 80 characters. Booleans and null pass, and undefined becomes null. Anything else (a function, a nested object, an array, a BigInt) is dropped. A { v, min, max, warn } value keeps v (by the same rules, null when it cannot be kept), min and max only when they are finite numbers, and warn only when it is exactly true. At most 64 fields are kept, in the object's own order, and a field name is cut to 48 characters. A getter that throws loses only its own field. snapshotOf() and MonitorFeed call it for you; call it yourself when you build a snapshot by hand. x { field: value }, or a function that returns it. A value is a number, a string, a boolean, null or undefined, or { v, min, max, warn }. A new plain object with the fields that were kept, or null when x is not an object (an array counts as not one), when the function throws, or when no field is left.

一個壞值不能讓整個快照送不出去，所以每個欄位都會檢查。不是有限的數字（NaN、Infinity）會變成 null。字串會截到 80 個字元。布林和 null 照樣通過，undefined 變成 null。其他的東西（函式、巢狀物件、陣列、BigInt）會被丟掉。{ v, min, max, warn } 這種值會留下 v（規則相同，留不住就是 null），min 和 max 只在是有限數字的時候才留，warn 只在剛好是 true 的時候才留。 最多留 64 個欄位，照物件自己的順序，欄位名稱會截到 48 個字元。會丟出錯誤的 getter 只會讓它自己那個欄位不見。snapshotOf() 和 MonitorFeed 會替你呼叫它。自己手工組快照的時候，可以自己呼叫。 x { 欄位: 值 }，或一個回傳它的函式。值可以是數字、字串、布林、null 或 undefined，也可以是 { v, min, max, warn }。 一個新的普通物件，裡面是留下來的欄位。x 不是物件（陣列也不算）、函式丟出錯誤，或沒有任何欄位留下來，就回傳 null。

It is the default url of MonitorFeed. Not on an https page: the browser blocks ws:// there (mixed content, logged as an error), and a page published over https (openaudiovisual.com, a tunnel) has no relay beside it. A show that runs one behind TLS passes { url: 'wss://…' } explicitly. loc Anything with protocol and hostname, like location. Pass a fake one to test. 'ws://:7457', or null when loc is missing or its protocol is https:.

它是 MonitorFeed 預設的 url。https 頁面上不用：瀏覽器在那裡會擋住 ws://（混合內容，會被記成錯誤），而且用 https 發布的頁面（openaudiovisual.com、通道）旁邊沒有中繼站。在 TLS 後面跑了一個中繼站的演出，要明確傳 { url: 'wss://…' }。 loc 任何有 protocol 和 hostname 的東西，像 location。測試的時候可以傳一個假的。 'ws://:7457'，loc 不存在、或它的 protocol 是 https: 的時候是 null。

A show without a backstage is a rehearsal. Run the relay on the machine that serves the show (node packages/monitor/server.js, port 7457, which also serves the backstage page at / and GET /health), and a stage manager's phone or laptop on the same network opens http://:7457/ to see the clock, the scene, the world, the frame rate, the overrides and every signal and param live, with a red "stage feed lost" banner when the stage stops sending for 4 seconds. The show page joins as ?role=stage; every other socket is a monitor. createShow() already creates and connects one, so you only build a MonitorFeed for a show you assembled by hand. It is made to cost nothing when left on: with no relay it reconnects with a growing delay (about 5 seconds, growing by 1.6 each time up to 30), though the browser logs each refused connection, and that message is expected. frame() throttles itself, so call it every frame with a snapshot (see snapshotOf()). A work can send numbers of its own (a simulation tick, a drift, a count of bad values), and the backstage shows them in a Work panel. There are three ways in, and a show that uses none sends not one byte more: feed.extra(fn), the extra field of snapshotOf(), and a monitor() method on the active world. A value is a number, a string, a boolean or null, or { v, min, max, warn }: with min and max the backstage draws a bar, and warn: true turns it red. cleanExtra() is the filter they all pass through. Call connect() once (a show does), then…
