沒有後台的演出只是排練。在提供演出頁面的那台機器上跑中繼站（node packages/monitor/server.js，連接埠 7457，它同時在 / 提供後台頁面，並有 GET /health），同一個網路上舞台監督的手機或筆電打開 http://:7457/，就能即時看到時鐘、場景、世界、影格率、覆寫，以及每個訊號和參數。舞台超過 4 秒沒有送資料，就會出現紅色的「stage feed lost」橫幅。演出頁面是以 ?role=stage 加入的，其他所有 socket 都是監看端。createShow() 已經會建好並連上一個，所以只有手工組裝的演出才需要自己建 MonitorFeed。 它的設計是一直開著也不花什麼成本：沒有中繼站的時候，它用愈來愈長的間隔重連（大約 5 秒，每次乘以 1.6，最長 30 秒），不過瀏覽器會把每次被拒絕的連線記下來，那個訊息是預期中的。frame() 自己會節流，所以每個畫面都可以用一份快照呼叫它（見 snapshotOf()）。 作品可以送自己的數字（模擬的 tick、漂移、壞值的次數），後台會把它們顯示在 Work 面板。送的方式有三種，都不用的演出一個位元組都不會多送：feed.extra(fn)、snapshotOf() 的 extra 欄位，以及目前世界上的 monitor() 方法。值可以是數字、字串、布林或 null，也可以是 { v, min, max, warn }：有 min 和 max 後台就畫量條，warn: true 會讓它變紅。它們全都會經過 cleanExtra() 這道過濾。 呼叫一次 connect()（演出會做），之後每個畫面呼叫 frame(snapshot)。connected 是 false 的時候，frame() 什麼都不做。頁面必須連得到中繼站：在 https 頁面上，瀏覽器會擋住 ws://（混合內容），所以請明確給一個 wss:// 位址。 可以讀、可以設的欄位：url（附上 ?role=stage，或是 null）、hz、connected、ws，以及掛鉤 onStatus = (ok) => {}。 在公開的 https 頁面上，手工組裝的演出如果連 ws://127.0.0.1:7457，會遇到 Chrome 的區域網路存取詢問（依套件 README，WebSocket 從 Chrome 147 開始）：按允許，或從 http://localhost 開啟頁面。 url 中繼站的位址，例如 'ws://192.168.1.20:7457'（?role=stage 會替你加上去）。預設值來自 defaultMonitorUrl()：頁面自己的主機加上 7457 連接埠，https 頁面則是 null。是 null 的時候，connect() 什麼都不做。 hz 每秒最多送出幾個快照。 extra 等於呼叫一次 feed.extra(fn)：一個回傳作品自己的數字 { 欄位: 值 } 的函式，顯示在後台的 Work 面板。

The data that MonitorFeed.frame() sends and the backstage page draws. Each part is optional and read with a safe fallback, so a hand-assembled show can pass only what it has. The snapshot is plain JSON, so you can also log it, store it for a rehearsal recording or show it in your own page. snapshot.extra is filled from two places: the extra you pass, and the active world's optional monitor() method (stage.active.monitor()), so a world can report its own health without any wiring. Where both use the same name, extra wins. With neither, or with nothing in them, the snapshot has no extra at all. timeline The Timeline: gives t, playing, holding, total, sceneIndex and scene. params The Params: gives the list of keys that are overridden. signals The Signals: every signal as { n, v, k } (name, value, kind). stage The Stage: gives the active world's name. loop The Loop: gives the frame rate. extra The work's own numbers, { field: value }, or a function that returns them (asked on every call). They land under snapshot.extra, after cleanExtra() has tidied them. state The resolved param values of this frame (what stage.frame() returns). {} when you pass nothing. { t, playing, holding, total, sceneIndex, scene, world, fps, state, overrides, signals }. scene is the current scene's title (or its id); holding is true while the show waits at a hold; signals is [{ n, v, k }] with numbers rounded to 3 decimals. A part you leave out gives zeros, empty strings and empty lists. There is an…

這是 MonitorFeed.frame() 送出、後台頁面用來畫畫面的資料。每個部分都是選填的、讀取時有安全的預設值，所以手工組裝的演出只要傳它有的部分就行。快照是單純的 JSON，所以你也可以把它記下來、存成排練的錄影，或顯示在自己的頁面上。 snapshot.extra 有兩個來源：你傳的 extra，以及目前世界上選填的 monitor() 方法（stage.active.monitor()），所以世界不用接任何線就能回報自己的健康狀況。兩邊用了同一個名字的時候，以 extra 為準。兩邊都沒有，或裡面什麼都沒有，快照就完全不帶 extra。 timeline Timeline：提供 t、playing、holding、total、sceneIndex 和 scene。 params Params：提供被覆寫的參數 key 清單。 signals Signals：每個訊號整理成 { n, v, k }（名字、值、類型）。 stage Stage：提供目前世界的名字。 loop Loop：提供影格率。 extra 作品自己的數字 { 欄位: 值 }，或一個回傳它們的函式（每次呼叫都問一次）。它們經過 cleanExtra() 整理之後，放在 snapshot.extra 底下。 state 這個畫面解析後的參數值（stage.frame() 的回傳值）。什麼都不傳的話是 {}。 { t, playing, holding, total, sceneIndex, scene, world, fps, state, overrides, signals }。scene 是目前場景的標題（沒有標題就用 id）。holding 在演出停在 hold 上等待的時候為 true。signals 是 [{ n, v, k }]，數字會四捨五入到小數三位。沒有給的部分，結果是 0、空字串和空清單。只有作品送了自己的數字，才會有 extra 欄位。

The order lets a page choose where its kernels come from without touching the code that uses them: pass urls for one page, set window.LAB.vendor for a whole host (the lab does, to serve the kernels itself), and the unpkg default is the last resort. Calling it yourself is useful to see where a page would look. kind Which kernel. opts urls: { smlib, manifold }, each a URL or a list of URLs. The URLs, first to try first, without repeats.
這個順序讓頁面可以決定核心從哪裡來，而不用動到使用它們的程式：單一頁面傳 urls，整個主機就設 window.LAB.vendor（實驗室就是這樣做，自己提供核心），unpkg 預設是最後的辦法。自己呼叫它，可以看出一個頁面會去哪些地方找。 kind 哪一個核心。 opts urls：{ smlib, manifold }，每一項是一個網址或一串網址。 網址清單，最先要試的排最前面，沒有重複。

Pure and synchronous, with no DOM. Duplicate vertices are merged first (within 1e-6 of the bounding-box diagonal), because without that every un-indexed mesh (three.js toNonIndexed(), an STL, any triangle soup) reads as open. In the report: triangles (after merging; a face that collapses is dropped), bbox as { min, max, size } in mm, volume in mm³ (always positive; a mesh wound inside out is measured the right way round), watertight (every edge used by exactly two faces, in opposite directions) with the counts openEdges, nonManifoldEdges and inconsistentEdges behind it, and grams: { PETG, PLA }, the weight of the volume as solid plastic (1.27 and 1.24 g/cm³). overhang is { angle, area, ratio }: the area (mm²) of faces that look down steeper than angle allows, and its share of the whole surface. Faces that rest on the lowest 0.2 mm (the bed) do not count. minWall is { value, min, median, samples } or null: rays are shot into the part from sampled faces, and value is the 5th percentile of the thicknesses found, which is how thin most of the wall is. min is the single thinnest sample, which on a part with holes drilled at an angle is a knife edge and says little about the wall, so it has its own milder note. warnings is a list of one sentence each, in Chinese: not watertight (with the three counts), overhang above overhangWarn, a wall thinner than minWall, a knife edge thinner than half of it, and a size beyond bed. An empty list means nothing to report. fab.check(x) is…

純函式、同步，不碰 DOM。重複的頂點會先合併（距離在包圍盒對角線的 1e-6 以內），因為不這樣做，每個沒有索引的網格（three.js 的 toNonIndexed()、STL、任何三角形湯）都會被看成有開口。報告裡有：triangles（合併之後的數量，塌掉的面會被丟掉）、bbox（{ min, max, size }，單位毫米）、volume（單位 mm³，一定是正的，繞法反了的網格也會用正確的方向去量）、watertight（每條邊剛好被兩個面用到、而且方向相反），背後是 openEdges、nonManifoldEdges、inconsistentEdges 三個計數，還有 grams：{ PETG, PLA }，把體積當成實心塑膠算出的重量（1.27 和 1.24 g/cm³）。 overhang 是 { angle, area, ratio }：朝下的程度超過 angle 容許範圍的面的面積（mm²），以及它佔整個表面的比例。貼在最低 0.2 毫米內（也就是貼在床上）的面不算。minWall 是 { value, min, median, samples } 或 null：從取樣的面朝零件裡面射線，value 是量到的厚度的第 5 百分位，也就是大部分壁有多薄。min 是單一最薄的樣本，在有斜著鑽孔的零件上，它會是刀口，對壁厚說不了什麼，所以另外有比較溫和的提示。 warnings 是一串警告，每項一句話：網格不水密（附三個計數）、懸空超過 overhangWarn、壁比 minWall 薄、刀口比它的一半還薄、尺寸超出 bed。清單是空的就表示沒有要回報的事。fab.check(x) 就是 checkMesh(meshOf(x), opts)。 grams 是實心零件的重量：它不知道填充率或外殼層數，所以切片列印出來的會比較輕。 input 網格 { vertices, triangles, units? }：vertices 是 x, y, z, x, y, z … 的 Float32Array 或 Float64Array，triangles 是每個面三個頂點編號的 Uint32Array，從外面看逆時針，Z 向上，單位毫米。要從別的東西得到網格，用 meshOf()。 opts angle（45）：懸空角度，單位度。minWall（1.2）：允許的最薄壁，單位毫米。bed（[320, 320, 325]）：列印床的大小，單位毫米。wallSamples（2000）：量壁厚時取樣的面數，少一點比較快。overhangWarn（0.15）：懸空面積佔多少比例才警告。weld（true）：先把重複的頂點合併，false 就跳過。 { units, triangles, bbox, volume, watertight, openEdges, nonManifoldEdges, inconsistentEdges, overhang, minWall, grams, warnings }。見說明。

The last entry of candidateUrls(). Versions are pinned, so the kernels a page gets do not change under it. To use another copy, pass urls to Fab or loadKernel() rather than changing this object. { smlib: 'https://unpkg.com/@classcad/smlibwasm@0.3.0/dist/index.js', manifold: 'https://unpkg.com/manifold-3d@3.5.4/manifold.js' }.

candidateUrls() 的最後一項。版本是釘死的，所以頁面拿到的核心不會在它底下悄悄改變。要用別的副本，請把 urls 傳給 Fab 或 loadKernel()，不要去改這個物件。 兩個網址：{ smlib: 'https://unpkg.com/@classcad/smlibwasm@0.3.0/dist/index.js', manifold: 'https://unpkg.com/manifold-3d@3.5.4/manifold.js' }。

stl, obj and glb come from the mesh: toStlBytes(), toObjText(), toGlbBytes(). step and dxf come straight from the smlibwasm kernel (toStep, toDxf) and are refused for anything that is not a kernel shape, because a mesh has no curved surfaces to write; an error says so. A kernel solid's glb uses the kernel's toGlb when it has one. The report is made on the way, so a file and its check always agree. x The shape: anything meshOf() accepts, and for step a smlibwasm Part, for dxf a smlibwasm Shape or Sketch. fmt 'stl', 'obj', 'step', 'dxf' or 'glb', in any case. 'stp' means step and 'gltf' means glb. Another word throws an Error that lists the formats. opts The options of meshOf() (scale, tessellator) and of checkMesh() (angle, minWall, bed …), and name, the object name of an OBJ file. kernel { smlib: () => Promise }, where to get the smlibwasm module for step, dxf, and the glb of a Part. fab.export() passes its own. bytes is a Uint8Array, mime is from MIME, ext is the extension without the dot ('step' even if you asked for 'stp'), and report is the checkMesh() report of the mesh (for step and dxf it can be null when the shape cannot be meshed, such as a 2D sketch).

stl、obj、glb 由網格產生：toStlBytes()、toObjText()、toGlbBytes()。step 和 dxf 直接來自 smlibwasm 核心（toStep、toDxf），不是核心形狀的東西會被拒絕，因為網格沒有曲面可以寫，錯誤訊息會這樣說。核心實體的 glb 在核心有 toGlb 的時候會用它。報告是順便做出來的，所以檔案和它的檢查結果一定一致。 x 形狀：meshOf() 接受的任何東西。step 要用 smlibwasm 的 Part，dxf 要用 smlibwasm 的 Shape 或 Sketch。 fmt 'stl'、'obj'、'step'、'dxf' 或 'glb'，大小寫都可以。'stp' 等於 step，'gltf' 等於 glb。其他的字會丟出列出可用格式的 Error。 opts meshOf() 的選項（scale、tessellator）、checkMesh() 的選項（angle、minWall、bed …），以及 name，也就是 OBJ 檔裡的物件名稱。 kernel { smlib: () => Promise }，step、dxf 和 Part 的 glb 要從哪裡拿 smlibwasm 模組。fab.export() 會傳它自己的。 bytes 是 Uint8Array，mime 來自 MIME，ext 是不含點的副檔名（就算你要的是 'stp' 也是 'step'），report 是這個網格的 checkMesh() 報告（step 和 dxf 在形狀切不成網格，例如 2D 草圖時，可能是 null）。

Make one Fab and hand it whatever you made: fab.check(x) returns a manufacturability report (is it closed, how much material, how much overhang, how thin is the thinnest wall, how many grams), and await fab.export(x, 'stl') returns the file as bytes. x can be a plain triangle mesh { vertices, triangles }, a three.js Mesh, Object3D or BufferGeometry (recognised by its shape, three.js is never imported), or a smlibwasm Part or Shape. meshOf() says exactly what is accepted. Formats: stl, obj and glb work for any input; step only for a smlibwasm Part, and dxf only for a smlibwasm Shape or Sketch, because a mesh has no curved-surface information. The CAD kernels are not bundled: the first time one is needed, fab.smlib() or fab.manifold() imports it from a URL (unpkg by default) and remembers it. fab.save() writes the file through fab.saver if you set one (the lab's dev server does), and otherwise as a browser download. Zero runtime dependencies: nothing is fetched until you ask for a kernel. Nothing for meshes and three.js objects. A smlibwasm Part has to be tessellated by the kernel: call await fab.smlib() once before the synchronous check(), or use checkAsync(), meshOfAsync() and export(), which load it for you. Loading needs a network, or urls / window.LAB.vendor pointing somewhere that has the kernel. Public fields: opts and saver (set it to async (bytes, info) => ({ file, … }); it starts as null). The file name for save() is name, else the id from context(), else fab. opts…

做一個 Fab，把你做出來的東西交給它：fab.check(x) 回傳製造性報告（封不封閉、用了多少材料、有多少懸空、最薄的壁多薄、幾公克），await fab.export(x, 'stl') 以位元組回傳檔案。x 可以是單純的三角形網格 { vertices, triangles }、three.js 的 Mesh、Object3D 或 BufferGeometry（靠形狀辨認，從不 import three.js），或 smlibwasm 的 Part 或 Shape。meshOf() 說明了到底接受什麼。 格式：stl、obj、glb 任何輸入都行。step 只能從 smlibwasm 的 Part 輸出，dxf 只能從 smlibwasm 的 Shape 或 Sketch 輸出，因為網格沒有曲面資訊。CAD 核心沒有打包在裡面：第一次需要時，fab.smlib() 或 fab.manifold() 才從網址（預設是 unpkg）import 進來，並且記住。 fab.save() 如果你設了 fab.saver（實驗室的開發伺服器就會設）就透過它寫檔，沒有的話就當成瀏覽器下載。沒有任何執行期相依套件：在你要求核心之前，不會抓任何東西。 網格和 three.js 物件不需要任何前置動作。smlibwasm 的 Part 要由核心來切成網格：在同步的 check() 之前先 await fab.smlib() 一次，或改用會自動載入的 checkAsync()、meshOfAsync() 和 export()。載入需要網路，或是 urls、window.LAB.vendor 指向有這個核心的地方。 公開的欄位有 opts 和 saver（設成 async (bytes, info) => ({ file, … })，一開始是 null）。save() 的檔名是 name，沒有的話是 context() 給的 id，再沒有就是 fab。 opts { scale, urls, importer, download, context }，每一項都可省略。scale 是 three.js 物件每個單位多少毫米（10 表示 three.js 的一個單位是 10 毫米）。urls 是 { smlib, manifold }，一個網址或一串網址，用來載入 CAD 核心。importer(url) 取代載入核心用的動態 import()。download(bytes, info) 取代 save() 退而求其次用的瀏覽器下載。context() 回傳 { id, params }，讓 save() 放進 info。

This is what meshOf() uses for a kernel's tessellation result, whichever way the kernel spells it. It throws an Error (in Chinese) when m is empty or has no positions. It does not check that the faces point outward or that the mesh is closed: that is checkMesh(). m An object with the points under positions, vertices, points or position, and the faces under indices, triangles, faces, index or triVerts. Points may be flat numbers, nested arrays ([[x, y, z], …]) or objects ({ x, y, z }). Without faces, every three points are one triangle. m.units is kept (default 'mm'). scale Multiplies every position, for example millimetres per unit. { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }.

meshOf() 處理核心的切網格結果時用的就是它，不管核心怎麼拼那些名稱。m 是空的、或沒有位置的話，會丟出 Error（中文訊息）。它不檢查面是不是朝外、網格有沒有封閉：那是 checkMesh() 的工作。 m 一個物件，點放在 positions、vertices、points 或 position 底下，面放在 indices、triangles、faces、index 或 triVerts 底下。點可以是攤平的數字、巢狀陣列（[[x, y, z], …]）或物件（{ x, y, z }）。沒有面的話，每三個點是一個三角形。m.units 會保留（預設 'mm'）。 scale 乘在每個位置上，例如每個單位多少毫米。 回傳 { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }。

It reads what toStlBytes() writes, or any binary STL: the normals and the two attribute bytes are skipped, and the result is a triangle soup. Give it to checkMesh(), which merges the vertices itself, or to weldMesh(). The text (ASCII) form of STL, which starts with solid, is not supported and would read as garbage. bytes The contents of a binary STL file. The face count is read from the header; the file's length is not checked against it. { vertices: Float32Array (9 per face), triangles: Uint32Array (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 …), units: 'mm' }.

它讀的是 toStlBytes() 寫出的東西，或任何二進位 STL：法線和兩個屬性位元組會跳過，結果是一堆三角形湯。把它交給會自己合併頂點的 checkMesh()，或交給 weldMesh()。以 solid 開頭的文字（ASCII）格式 STL 不支援，讀進來會是亂碼。 bytes 二進位 STL 檔的內容。面數從檔頭讀，不會拿檔案長度去對照。 { vertices: Float32Array（每個面 9 個）, triangles: Uint32Array（0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 …）, units: 'mm' }。

The kernels are not bundled, because open-audiovisual has no dependencies and no build step: the first time a page needs one, it is imported from a URL. The order is candidateUrls(): opts.urls[kind], then window.LAB.vendor[kind], then unpkg (DEFAULT_URLS). If every URL fails it rejects with an Error (in Chinese) that names each URL and why it failed. It does not remember anything: fab.smlib() and fab.manifold() keep the promise for you, so call those unless you want to manage it yourself. A network, or urls pointing at a place that serves the kernel (the lab uses window.LAB.vendor), or an importer that returns one. kind Which kernel: 'smlib' for smlibwasm (solid modelling, STEP and DXF) or 'manifold' for manifold-3d (fast mesh booleans). opts urls: { smlib, manifold }, a URL or a list of URLs for each kernel. importer: async (url) => module, to use instead of the dynamic import(). The smlibwasm module as it came, or the manifold-3d module with its WebAssembly started (setup() called).

核心沒有打包，因為 open-audiovisual 沒有相依套件、也沒有建置步驟：頁面第一次需要的時候，才從網址 import 進來。順序是 candidateUrls()：opts.urls[kind]，然後 window.LAB.vendor[kind]，最後是 unpkg（DEFAULT_URLS）。每個網址都失敗的話，它會用 Error（中文）reject，訊息列出每個網址和失敗原因。它自己什麼都不記：fab.smlib() 和 fab.manifold() 會替你留著 promise，除非你想自己管理，不然呼叫那兩個。 要有網路，或是 urls 指向有提供核心的地方（實驗室用的是 window.LAB.vendor），或是一個會回傳核心的 importer。 kind 哪一個核心：'smlib' 是 smlibwasm（實體建模、STEP 和 DXF），'manifold' 是 manifold-3d（快速的網格布林運算）。 opts urls：{ smlib, manifold }，每個核心一個網址或一串網址。importer：async (url) => module，用來取代動態的 import()。 smlibwasm 模組原樣，或已經把 WebAssembly 啟動（呼叫過 setup()）的 manifold-3d 模組。

Everything is recognised by its shape and nothing is imported, so three.js and smlibwasm are never loaded for you. A three.js object has its matrixWorld applied (a mirrored object keeps its faces facing outward), indexed or not, and Y up is turned into Z up as (x, y, z) → (x, −z, y), then everything is multiplied by scale. A missing input, or something it cannot read, throws an Error whose message (in Chinese) says what to do. It is synchronous, so it cannot wait for a kernel: a smlibwasm solid without opts.tessellator throws a message that tells you to load the kernel first, and a tessellate() that returns a promise throws too. Use meshOfAsync() for those. x The thing to convert. Accepted, tried in this order: a mesh { vertices, triangles } (returned as it is); a three.js Mesh, Object3D (every visible mesh below it) or BufferGeometry; anything with a tessellate() method; an object with positions / vertices / points and, optionally, indices / triangles / faces / index; a smlibwasm solid or shape (given opts.tessellator). opts scale: millimetres per unit for a three.js or mesh-like input (default 1). A mesh { vertices, triangles } is never scaled. tessellator(shape): a function that turns a smlibwasm shape into a mesh (the Fab class passes the kernel's once it is loaded). tessellate: an argument passed on to the shape's own tessellate(). { vertices, triangles, units }: counter-clockwise faces seen from outside, Z up, millimetres.

每種東西都靠形狀辨認，什麼都不 import，所以 three.js 和 smlibwasm 絕對不會被替你載入。three.js 物件會套用它的 matrixWorld（鏡射的物件仍會讓面朝外），有沒有索引都行，Y 向上會換成 Z 向上，換法是 (x, y, z) → (x, −z, y)，然後全部乘上 scale。沒有給輸入、或它讀不懂的東西，會丟出 Error，訊息（中文）會說明該怎麼辦。 它是同步的，所以不能等核心：沒有 opts.tessellator 的 smlibwasm 實體會丟出一則叫你先載入核心的訊息，tessellate() 回傳 promise 也會丟出錯誤。這些情況請用 meshOfAsync()。 x 要轉換的東西。接受的類型，依這個順序比對：網格 { vertices, triangles }（原樣傳回），three.js 的 Mesh、Object3D（底下每個看得見的網格）或 BufferGeometry，任何有 tessellate() 方法的東西，有 positions／vertices／points，以及可有可無的 indices／triangles／faces／index 的物件，smlibwasm 的實體或形狀（要給 opts.tessellator）。 opts scale：three.js 或像網格的輸入，每個單位多少毫米（預設 1）。{ vertices, triangles } 的網格不會被縮放。tessellator(shape)：把 smlibwasm 形狀變成網格的函式（Fab 類別在核心載入後會傳入核心的那個）。tessellate：傳給形狀自己的 tessellate() 的參數。 { vertices, triangles, units }：從外面看逆時針的面，Z 向上，單位毫米。

Use it where the conversion may have to wait: a shape whose tessellate() is asynchronous, or a smlibwasm Part when the kernel is not loaded yet. With opts.kernel.smlib it awaits the module and uses its tessellate(part); an error says so if the module has none. Everything else is passed on to meshOf(). fab.meshOfAsync() fills in kernel for you. x The thing to convert; see meshOf(). opts The options of meshOf(), and kernel: { smlib: () => Promise }, where to get the smlibwasm module from when a solid has to be tessellated and no tessellator was given. The same mesh meshOf() would give.

轉換可能得等的時候用它：tessellate() 是非同步的形狀，或核心還沒載入的 smlibwasm Part。有給 opts.kernel.smlib 的話，它會等模組載好，用它的 tessellate(part)。模組沒有這個函式的話會丟出說明的錯誤。其他東西都交給 meshOf()。fab.meshOfAsync() 會替你填好 kernel。 x 要轉換的東西，見 meshOf()。 opts meshOf() 的選項，另外有 kernel：{ smlib: () => Promise }，遇到實體要切、又沒給 tessellator 時，從哪裡拿 smlibwasm 模組。 跟 meshOf() 會給的一樣的網格。

For the type of a Blob or the Content-Type of an upload when you handle the bytes yourself: new Blob([bytes], { type: MIME.stl }). exportAs() already puts the right one in its result. { stl: 'model/stl', obj: 'model/obj', step: 'model/step', dxf: 'image/vnd.dxf', glb: 'model/gltf-binary' }. Its keys are the formats exportAs() accepts.

自己處理位元組的時候，拿來當 Blob 的 type 或上傳的 Content-Type：new Blob([bytes], { type: MIME.stl })。exportAs() 的結果裡已經附上正確的那一個。 { stl: 'model/stl', obj: 'model/obj', step: 'model/step', dxf: 'image/vnd.dxf', glb: 'model/gltf-binary' }。它的鍵就是 exportAs() 接受的格式。

Vertices are welded first with weldMesh(). The file has POSITION and indices only: no normals, no materials, no colours, so a viewer shades it flat or works the normals out itself. The positions stay in millimetres and Z up, and asset.extras says { units: 'mm', up: 'Z' }. glTF itself assumes Y up, so a viewer that does not read the extras shows the part lying on its side. await fab.export(part, 'glb') of a smlibwasm Part uses the kernel's own toGlb when it has one, and this function otherwise. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }, in millimetres. A glTF 2.0 binary: the glTF header, one JSON chunk, one binary chunk with 32-bit float positions and 32-bit indices. The length is a multiple of 4.

頂點會先用 weldMesh() 合併。檔案裡只有 POSITION 和索引：沒有法線、材質、顏色，所以檢視器會用平面著色，或自己算法線。位置維持毫米、Z 向上，asset.extras 寫著 { units: 'mm', up: 'Z' }。glTF 本身假設 Y 向上，所以不讀 extras 的檢視器會把零件顯示成躺在側面。 smlibwasm 的 Part 用 await fab.export(part, 'glb') 的話，核心有自己的 toGlb 就用它，沒有才用這個函式。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }，單位毫米。 glTF 2.0 二進位檔：glTF 檔頭、一個 JSON 區塊、一個放 32 位元浮點數位置和 32 位元索引的二進位區塊。長度是 4 的倍數。

Vertices are welded first with weldMesh(), so a triangle soup comes out with shared vertices and a small file. There are no normals, no texture coordinates and no materials. await fab.export(x, 'obj', { name }) is the same thing with the conversions done for you. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }, in millimetres. name The object name on the o line. Spaces become underscores. The text: a comment line, o , one v line per welded vertex (6 decimals at most) and one f line per face, vertex numbers counting from 1.

頂點會先用 weldMesh() 合併，所以三角形湯寫出來有共用的頂點，檔案也小。沒有法線、沒有貼圖座標、沒有材質。await fab.export(x, 'obj', { name }) 是同一件事，並且替你做了轉換。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }，單位毫米。 name o 那一行的物件名稱。空格會變成底線。 文字內容：一行註解、o 、每個合併後的頂點一行 v（最多 6 位小數）、每個面一行 f，頂點編號從 1 開始。

Every face becomes its own 50 bytes: STL has no shared vertices. The normal comes from the order of the corners (right-hand rule), so counter-clockwise faces seen from outside give outward normals. Positions are written as they are, as float32: nothing is converted to millimetres, so give it a mesh that is already in mm. await fab.export(x, 'stl') is the same thing with the conversions and the check done for you. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }, in millimetres. The file: an 80-byte header (the text open-audiovisual fab STL (mm)), the face count as a little-endian 32-bit integer, then per face the normal and three corners as 32-bit floats and two zero bytes.

每個面各自佔 50 位元組：STL 沒有共用頂點。法線是從角的順序（右手定則）算出來的，所以從外面看逆時針的面，法線就朝外。位置原樣寫成 float32，不會換算成毫米，所以請給它已經是毫米的網格。await fab.export(x, 'stl') 是同一件事，並且替你做了轉換和檢查。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }，單位毫米。 檔案內容：80 位元組的檔頭（文字 open-audiovisual fab STL (mm)）、面數（小端序的 32 位元整數），然後每個面是法線和三個角（32 位元浮點數）加上兩個零位元組。

A triangle soup, where every face has three vertices of its own (what an STL file or three.js toNonIndexed() gives), has no neighbours as far as topology goes: every edge looks open. Welding gives the faces shared vertices, so checkMesh() can see that they join. checkMesh(), toObjText() and toGlbBytes() call it themselves; toStlBytes() does not need it. mesh A mesh { vertices, triangles }. It is not changed. tolerance Vertices closer than this (in each of x, y and z) become one, in the mesh's units. Left out: 1e-6 times the diagonal of the bounding box. { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units } with each position once, and no face that has two corners on the same vertex.

三角形湯，也就是每個面都有自己的三個頂點（STL 檔或 three.js 的 toNonIndexed() 給的就是這樣），在拓撲上沒有鄰居：每條邊都看起來是開的。合併頂點讓面共用頂點，checkMesh() 才看得出它們是接在一起的。checkMesh()、toObjText() 和 toGlbBytes() 會自己呼叫它，toStlBytes() 用不到。 mesh 網格 { vertices, triangles }。不會被改動。 tolerance 距離（x、y、z 各自）小於這個值的頂點會變成一個，單位跟網格一樣。不給的話是包圍盒對角線的 1e-6 倍。 { vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }，每個位置只出現一次，也沒有任何一個面有兩個角落在同一個頂點上。

A spec says which parts a work uses and how they are wired: { board, parts: { id: { part, have? } }, wires: [['mcu.4', 'acc.SDA'], …] }. A pin is written part.pin, by its name or an alias (mcu.SDA is mcu.4 on a Feather HUZZAH). part is a key of the parts library, HW_PARTS. Wires that touch are one net: the board pin and every part on it. Hw.check(spec) returns { ok, board, nets, power: { rails, battery }, i2c, issues, warnings, notes }. Each issue is { level, code, text, at }: error (it will not work or it breaks something), warn (it may not work), note (worth knowing) or unknown (a datasheet value is missing, so the check cannot tell). It looks for: a 3.3 V signal into a part that needs more (a 5 V LED strip), a voltage above what a pin takes, a supply out of a part's range or one that is only there on the charger, ESP8266 boot pins (GPIO0, 2, 15) and the serial pins, one pin wired to two jobs, SDA and SCL swapped, two I²C devices at one address, current beyond a regulator or a wireless receiver, and how many hours the battery lasts. warnings is the error and warn sentences, notes the rest. Hw.diagram(spec) returns an SVG string: the board in the middle, power parts on the left, the rest on the right, power red, ground grey, I²C blue, data green, SPI purple, analog orange, and a wire the check complains about dashed. Hw.bom(spec) returns { have, buy, unknown, count }, the parts split by have: true, with sizes, connectors and the notes to read before buying. It has no…

一份規格寫作品用了哪些零件、怎麼接：{ board, parts: { id: { part, have? } }, wires: [['mcu.4', 'acc.SDA'], …] }。腳位寫成 零件.腳，用名字或別名都可以（在 Feather HUZZAH 上 mcu.SDA 就是 mcu.4）。part 是零件庫 HW_PARTS 的鍵。碰在一起的線是同一個網路，板子的腳和接在上面的每個零件都在裡面。 Hw.check(spec) 回傳 { ok, board, nets, power: { rails, battery }, i2c, issues, warnings, notes }。每個問題是 { level, code, text, at }：error（不會動或會燒壞東西）、warn（可能不會動）、note（值得知道）或 unknown（規格書少一個數字，判斷不了）。它會找：3.3 V 訊號接到需要更高電壓的零件（5 V 燈條）、超過腳位能吃的電壓、供電超出零件的範圍或只有放在充電座上才有電、ESP8266 的開機腳（GPIO0、2、15）和序列埠腳、一支腳接了兩種用途、SDA 和 SCL 接反、兩個 I²C 裝置同一個位址、電流超過穩壓器或無線充電接收器，以及電池能撐幾小時。warnings 是 error 和 warn 的句子，notes 是其他的。 Hw.diagram(spec) 回傳一段 SVG 字串：板子在中間，電源零件在左邊，其他在右邊，電源紅色、地線灰色、I²C 藍色、資料綠色、SPI 紫色、類比橘色，檢查有意見的線畫成虛線。Hw.bom(spec) 回傳 { have, buy, unknown, count }，依 have: true 把零件分開，附尺寸、接頭和買之前要先看的提醒。它沒有價格，也沒有購買連結。 檢查只會跟零件庫一樣準。規格書沒有說清楚的值是 null，列在零件的 tbd 裡，需要它的檢查會回報 unknown，不會當作通過。

An object keyed by part id: feather-huzzah-esp8266, arduino-leonardo, arduino-uno-r3, rc522, pir-hc-sr501, pot-10k, lis3dh-breakout, mpu6050-gy521, ws2812b, sk6812, neopixel-ring-12, neopixel-ring-16, lipo-1s, tp4056-usbc, microlipo-usbc and qi-receiver. A part has name, zh, kind, sources (the datasheets and maker pages it was read from), supply, logic, current or perLed, pins, i2c, size, connector, notes and tbd. Where two revisions of a datasheet disagree (the WS2812B input threshold is 0.7 × VDD in one and 2.7 V in the other), the stricter value is used and notes says so. A value nobody could confirm is null and named in tbd.

以零件 id 為鍵的物件：feather-huzzah-esp8266、arduino-leonardo、arduino-uno-r3、rc522、pir-hc-sr501、pot-10k、lis3dh-breakout、mpu6050-gy521、ws2812b、sk6812、neopixel-ring-12、neopixel-ring-16、lipo-1s、tp4056-usbc、microlipo-usbc 和 qi-receiver。每個零件有 name、zh、kind、sources（讀過的規格書和原廠頁面）、supply、logic、current 或 perLed、pins、i2c、size、connector、notes 和 tbd。 同一份規格書兩個版本說法不同時（WS2812B 的輸入門檻一版是 0.7 × VDD，另一版是 2.7 V），取比較嚴的，並在 notes 寫明。沒有人能確認的值是 null，寫在 tbd 裡。

It imports the one file the device lives in and nothing else: a profile JSON, a fixture JSON, the parts library or a hand-written record. The record of a profile, a fixture or a part is read off that file each time, so it always says what the file says. A MIDI controller hands over what @openav/midi already does with a profile. routes({ knob1: 'hue' }) is controllerRoutes: mapper routes from its named signals (midi//) to your params. addTo(controllers) puts the profile into a MidiControllers, yours or a show's, and returns its live MidiController: the unit is recognised by its port name when the manager gets its hardware engine and at each device change. A unit already plugged in when you call addTo() on a manager that has its engine is matched the next time a device comes or goes, so call it before attach(midi). A DMX fixture places itself in a Patch: patch(p, { address: 1, mode: '6ch' }) calls p.add() with the fixture's profile and returns the placed fixture. The id defaults to --, the universe to 1, the mode to the profile's first. A camera or an audio interface is found among the browser's media devices by its label. constraints(deviceId?) is pure: the recommended settings (a camera's size and frame rate as ideal values, an audio input with echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain off). find() calls enumerateDevices() and returns the matching device, or null. open() is the only call that asks for a permission: it opens the device by its id and returns the…

它只匯入這台設備所在的那一個檔案：一份 profile JSON、一份燈具 JSON、零件庫，或一份手寫紀錄。profile、燈具和零件的紀錄每次都從那個檔案讀出來，所以檔案寫什麼它就是什麼。 MIDI 控制器交出的是 @openav/midi 拿到 profile 本來就會做的事。routes({ knob1: 'hue' }) 就是 controllerRoutes：從它有名字的訊號（midi//）連到你的參數的路由。addTo(controllers) 把 profile 放進一個 MidiControllers（你的或演出的），回傳即時的 MidiController：管理器拿到硬體引擎時，以及每次裝置有變化時，都會依連接埠名稱認出實機。如果管理器已經有引擎，呼叫 addTo() 時已經插著的實機要等下一次有裝置插拔才會被認出，所以請在 attach(midi) 之前呼叫。 DMX 燈具會把自己放進一個 Patch：patch(p, { address: 1, mode: '6ch' }) 用這台燈的 profile 呼叫 p.add()，回傳放好的燈具。id 預設是 --，universe 預設 1，模式預設是 profile 的第一個。 鏡頭或音訊介面依名稱在瀏覽器的媒體裝置裡找到。constraints(deviceId?) 是純函式：建議的設定（鏡頭的尺寸與畫面更新率是理想值，音訊輸入關掉回音消除、降噪和自動增益）。find() 呼叫 enumerateDevices()，回傳符合的裝置或 null。open() 是唯一會要權限的呼叫：依 id 打開裝置，回傳串流，用完由你停止。 載入設備什麼都不用。open() 要：https 或 localhost 上的網頁、一次點擊和權限。addTo() 要接實機時需要 Web MIDI（Chrome 或 Edge）。 頁面拿到一次相機或麥克風權限之前，瀏覽器不給裝置名稱，所以那之前 find() 回傳 null。這時 open() 會先要一次權限、再找一次，如果瀏覽器先開的是別的鏡頭，就關掉它改開這一台。名稱看得到卻沒有符合的，它會丟出錯誤並列出找到的名稱，不要任何權限。 @openav/pose 會自己打開預設的鏡頭，所以找到的鏡頭目前還送不進姿態追蹤。它可以送進 @openav/record（comp.setCamera(stream)），也可以經 analyzer.input() 送進 @openav/audio。 id 設備的 id，跟 devices() 列出來的一樣（arturia-minilab3、generic-rgbw、logitech-mx-brio）。minilab3 這種 MIDI 短名不是 id，錯誤訊息會建議接近的 id。 options DMX 燈具：patch() 的預設值 { id, universe, address, mode, groups, name, limits }。鏡頭或音訊介面：mediaDevices 會取代 navigator.mediaDevices（測試用替身）。 一個物件：一定有 { id, kind, name, record }，record 是這台設備完整的 open-audiovisual/device@1 紀錄。接著依種類：midi-controller 有 profile、routes(bindings, options)、addTo(controllers)。dmx-fixture 有…

Use it to build a filter or to check a value before passing it as kind to devices(). A kind can have no device yet (projector, display): the format has room for them before the collection does. A frozen array: midi-controller, dmx-fixture, dmx-interface, led-controller, sensor, camera, audio-interface, projector, display, printer, part.

用來做篩選器，或在把值當作 kind 傳給 devices() 之前先檢查。某些種類可能還沒有設備（projector、display）：格式先替它們留了位置。 凍結的陣列：midi-controller、dmx-fixture、dmx-interface、led-controller、sensor、camera、audio-interface、projector、display、printer、part。

The collection holds every MIDI controller profile of @openav/midi (the hand-written ones and the ones imported from QLC+), every fixture of @openav/dmx, every part of @openav/hw, and hand-written records for devices that have no deeper format: cameras, audio interfaces, sensors, LED and DMX interfaces, printers. None of them is copied: a profile, a fixture or a part stays in its own file, and its row is read off that file when the package is built. Listing loads no profile: the rows come from one generated file, catalog.js, so a page can show and search the whole collection without fetching 56 JSON files. With no argument it returns everything, grouped by kind in the order of deviceKinds, then by name. verified is true only when the device was checked on a real unit. A MIDI profile counts as verified only when every one of its controls was; most of the collection is not, yet. kind Only devices of this kind (or these kinds), one of deviceKinds. Any other word throws. q Words to search for. Each word must appear in the name, an alias, the manufacturer or the id, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation, so minilab3 and MiniLab 3 find the same device. Results start with the names that equal the query, then the names that start with it. connection Only devices that plug in this way: usb, din-midi, trs-midi, ethernet, wifi, bluetooth, hdmi, displayport, sdi, dmx-xlr3, dmx-xlr5, audio-xlr or audio-jack. Only hand-written records list their connections so far: a MIDI profile, a…

設備大集合包含 @openav/midi 的每一份 MIDI 控制器 profile（手寫的，以及從 QLC+ 轉入的）、@openav/dmx 的每一台燈具、@openav/hw 的每一個零件，以及沒有更深一層格式的設備的手寫紀錄：鏡頭、音訊介面、感測器、LED 與 DMX 介面、印表機。沒有任何一份是複製的：profile、燈具和零件都留在自己的檔案裡，它的那一列是建置套件時從那個檔案讀出來的。 列清單不會載入任何 profile：每一列來自一個產生出來的檔案 catalog.js，所以網頁不用抓 56 個 JSON 檔就能顯示和搜尋整個集合。不給參數時回傳全部，依 deviceKinds 的順序按種類分組，再依名稱排序。 只有在真機上檢查過，verified 才是 true。MIDI profile 要每一個控制項都檢查過才算。目前集合裡大多數都還沒有。 kind 只要這一種（或這幾種）設備，值是 deviceKinds 其中之一。其他的字會丟出錯誤。 q 要搜尋的字。每個字都要出現在名稱、別名、製造商或 id 裡，不分大小寫、空格和標點，所以 minilab3 和 MiniLab 3 找到同一台。結果先列名稱等於查詢的，再列名稱以它開頭的。 connection 只要用這種方式連接的設備：usb、din-midi、trs-midi、ethernet、wifi、bluetooth、hdmi、displayport、sdi、dmx-xlr3、dmx-xlr5、audio-xlr 或 audio-jack。目前只有手寫紀錄寫了連接方式：MIDI profile、燈具和零件的檔案都沒寫怎麼接，所以這個篩選會把它們全部排除。 凍結的列 { id, kind, manufacturer, name, aliases, connections, protocols, verified, from, file }。from 是紀錄從哪裡讀來（midi-profile、dmx-fixture、hw-part 或 device-record），file 是那個檔案在 packages/ 裡的路徑。把 id 交給 device() 就拿到完整的紀錄和可以用的物件。

No input: send "arguments": {}. It reads the profiles in packages/midi/profiles/, the same ones the controller pages and use. Use it to find the id for read_profile, or to check that a controller is already covered before writing a new profile with scaffold_profile. { count, controllers } as JSON text. Each controller is { id, short, name, maker, kind, controls, unverified, url }: id such as arturia-minilab3, short the signal namespace (midi//…), kind 'device' or 'generic', controls the mix as { knob: 8, pad: 8, keys: 25 } (a keyboard counts one per key), unverified how many of those controls still carry "verified": false, url like https://openaudiovisual.com/controllers//.

不需要輸入：送 "arguments": {}。它讀的是 packages/midi/profiles/ 裡的設定檔，跟控制器頁面和 用的是同一批。用它找 read_profile 要的 id，或在用 scaffold_profile 寫新設定檔之前，先確認這台控制器是不是已經有了。 { count, controllers }，格式是 JSON 文字。每個控制器是 { id, short, name, maker, kind, controls, unverified, url }：id 像 arturia-minilab3，short 是訊號的命名空間（midi//…），kind 是 'device' 或 'generic'，controls 是組成，像 { knob: 8, pad: 8, keys: 25 }（鍵盤每個鍵算一個），unverified 是其中還帶著 "verified": false 的控制元件數，url 像 https://openaudiovisual.com/controllers//。

The first call an agent makes in an unfamiliar checkout: what works already exist, so it can pick a donor for scaffold_world. It takes no input: send "arguments": {}. The server running: node packages/mcp/server.js, which Claude Code starts from the .mcp.json of the repository (server name openav). Other clients need the same command and args in their MCP settings. An MCP client sends initialize once before the first call. Over stdio every message is one line of JSON: the request bodies on this page are spread over several lines to be read, and a client writes them on one line for you. [{ dir, title, summary }], one per folder in examples/, as JSON text. dir is like examples/01-hello-particles, title is the of its index.html, summary is the first line of its main.js that starts with // (the slashes taken off). A file that is missing gives an empty string.

代理進到陌生的檔案庫時的第一個呼叫：已經有哪些作品，這樣它才能替 scaffold_world 挑一個範本。它不需要任何輸入：送 "arguments": {}。 伺服器要在跑：node packages/mcp/server.js，Claude Code 會依儲存庫的 .mcp.json 啟動它（伺服器名稱 openav）。其他用戶端要在自己的 MCP 設定裡寫同樣的 command 和 args。MCP 用戶端在第一次呼叫之前會先送一次 initialize。透過 stdio 時每則訊息是一行 JSON：這一頁的請求內容為了好讀而分成好幾行，用戶端會替你把它們寫成一行。 [{ dir, title, summary }]，examples/ 底下每個資料夾一項，格式是 JSON 文字。dir 像 examples/01-hello-particles，title 是它的 index.html 的 ，summary 是它的 main.js 第一行以 // 開頭的內容（去掉斜線）。缺檔就給空字串。

Input: doc (required), one of architecture, writing-a-world, signals, show-control, score, dmx, output, tile, align, devices, roadmap, agents, readme, introduction, getting-started, concepts, inputs, mapping, controllers, remote, packages, agents-guide, troubleshooting, lab-integration. The tool's own description tells an agent to start with agents (the conventions and the two unbreakable rules), then writing-a-world. Most names are docs/.md. Two are not, and they are easy to mix up: agents is AGENTS.md at the root of the repository (the briefing), agents-guide is docs/agents.md (the handbook chapter), and readme is README.md. A name that is not in the list, or no doc at all, is an error with a plain Node message (The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined), not a list of the valid names. A client that follows the input schema cannot send one: the schema has the names as an enum. The Markdown of the file, as it is on disk, in one text item: not JSON. The whole file comes back, which can be tens of kilobytes.

輸入：doc（必填），下面其中之一：architecture、writing-a-world、signals、show-control、score、dmx、output、tile、align、devices、roadmap、agents、readme、introduction、getting-started、concepts、inputs、mapping、controllers、remote、packages、agents-guide、troubleshooting、lab-integration。工具自己的說明叫代理先讀 agents（慣例和兩條不能破的規則），再讀 writing-a-world。 大部分名稱就是 docs/.md。有兩個不是，而且很容易搞混：agents 是儲存庫根目錄的 AGENTS.md（簡介），agents-guide 是 docs/agents.md（手冊的章節），readme 則是 README.md。 不在清單裡的名稱、或根本沒給 doc，會得到一個 Node 的原始錯誤訊息（The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined），而不是合法名稱的清單。照著輸入 schema 的用戶端不會送出這種值：schema 裡的名稱是 enum。 檔案原樣的 Markdown，放在一個文字項目裡，不是 JSON。整份檔案都會回來，可能有好幾十 KB。

Input: id (required), a profile id or its short, for example arturia-minilab3 or minilab3. Where a control says verified: false, its number is a placeholder or a guess that no source has confirmed yet. An unknown id is an error that lists every id it knows. list_controllers shows what is there. { id, url, unverified, profile, mapping } as JSON text. profile is the JSON as shipped. mapping has one row per control: { control, type, message, signal, verified }, where message reads like CC 74, ch 1, note 36, ch 10 or notes 48–72 (25 keys), ch 1, and signal is midi// (for a keyboard midi///on · /off · n); a row may also carry led and note.

輸入：id（必填），設定檔的 id 或它的 short，例如 arturia-minilab3 或 minilab3。控制元件寫著 verified: false 的地方，它的號碼是還沒有任何來源證實的預留值或猜測。不認得的 id 會得到一個列出它所有已知 id 的錯誤。list_controllers 可以看有哪些。 { id, url, unverified, profile, mapping }，格式是 JSON 文字。profile 是原樣的 JSON。mapping 每個控制元件一列：{ control, type, message, signal, verified }，message 讀起來像 CC 74, ch 1、note 36, ch 10 或 notes 48–72 (25 keys), ch 1，signal 是 midi//（鍵盤是 midi///on · /off · n），有的列還會帶 led 和 note。

No input: send "arguments": {}. An agent calls it after every change to know whether the repository is still green. It runs node --test over every tests/.test.js of the checkout the server lives in, waits for it to finish and gives up after 60 seconds. At the time of writing, in the checkout this was written from, the whole suite takes about 50 seconds and prints about 3.6 MB of report, while the tool reads at most 1 MiB of it. Past that the child process is stopped, and the tool answers { ok: false, output } with only the failing lines found in that first megabyte, even if every test passes. Until that changes, do not read ok: false with an empty output as a failing test: run node --test tests/.test.js in a terminal. When the run finishes cleanly: { pass, fail, ok } (numbers from the report, and ok true only when fail is 0), as JSON text. Otherwise { ok: false, output }, where output holds the lines of the report that say not ok or give the totals.

不需要輸入：送 "arguments": {}。代理每改一次就呼叫它，確認儲存庫還是綠的。它對伺服器所在的那份檔案庫的每個 tests/.test.js 執行 node --test，等它跑完，60 秒就放棄。 寫這一條的時候，在寫它所用的那份檔案庫裡，整套測試大約要跑 50 秒，印出大約 3.6 MB 的報告，而工具最多只讀它的 1 MiB。超過之後，子行程會被停掉，工具回答 { ok: false, output }，裡面只有那第一個百萬位元組裡找到的失敗行，就算每個測試都通過也一樣。在這個狀況改變之前，不要把 ok: false 加上空的 output 當成有測試失敗：請在終端機裡直接跑 node --test tests/.test.js。 跑完順利的時候：{ pass, fail, ok }（數字取自報告，fail 是 0 時 ok 才是 true），格式是 JSON 文字。其他情況是 { ok: false, output }，output 裡是報告中寫著 not ok 或給出總數的那幾行。

Input, all required: maker (such as Arturia), model (such as MiniLab 3) and controls, a list of { type, count, from? } that describes the faceplate, for example [{"type":"knob","count":8},{"type":"pad","count":8},{"type":"keys","count":25,"from":48}]. type is one of knob, encoder, fader, pad, button, keys, wheel, strip; count is a whole number from 1 to 128; from is the lowest note of a keys section (default 48). The skeleton passes validateProfile() and it is deliberately honest: every control has "verified": false, the source list holds one TODO entry, and the numbers are placeholders. Knobs, faders and strips get consecutive CC numbers from 20, pads get notes from 36 (skipping a keys range), buttons get momentary CCs, encoders get relative CCs, the first wheel is a pitch bend and any further wheel falls back to a CC. The id comes from maker and model (acme-pad-pro-16), short is the model without hyphens, and match.ports is a pattern made of the model's words. Wrong input is an error with the reason: no maker or model, controls empty or not a list, an unknown type, a count outside 1..128, keys outside notes 0..127, or more controls than there are CC numbers (about 108) or pad notes. After that the agent sources every number from the maker's MIDI chart, runs validate_profile, and saves the file in packages/midi/profiles/; next_steps lists these. { profile, problems, unverified, next_steps } as JSON text, plus warnings when the id or short name collides with a shipped…

輸入全部必填：maker（例如 Arturia）、model（例如 MiniLab 3）和 controls，一串描述面板的 { type, count, from? }，例如 [{"type":"knob","count":8},{"type":"pad","count":8},{"type":"keys","count":25,"from":48}]。type 是 knob、encoder、fader、pad、button、keys、wheel、strip 之一，count 是 1 到 128 的整數，from 是 keys 區段最低的音符（預設 48）。 骨架會通過 validateProfile()，而且刻意很誠實：每個控制元件都是 "verified": false，來源清單裡只有一條 TODO，號碼都是預留值。旋鈕、推桿、觸控條從 20 開始依序拿 CC 號碼，打擊墊從 36 開始拿音符（會跳過 keys 的範圍），按鈕拿瞬間式的 CC，編碼器拿相對式的 CC，第一個滾輪是彈音，之後的滾輪改用 CC。id 由廠牌和型號組成（acme-pad-pro-16），short 是去掉連字號的型號，match.ports 是由型號各個字組成的規則。 輸入不對會得到說明原因的錯誤：沒有廠牌或型號、controls 是空的或不是清單、不認得的 type、count 不在 1..128、keys 超出音符 0..127，或控制元件多到 CC 號碼（約 108 個）或打擊墊音符不夠用。之後代理要從廠商的 MIDI 對照表查證每個號碼，跑 validate_profile，再把檔案存進 packages/midi/profiles/。next_steps 列出的就是這些。 { profile, problems, unverified, next_steps }，格式是 JSON 文字，id 或簡稱跟內建設定檔撞名的話還會有 warnings。profile 是骨架，problems 是 validateProfile() 對它的意見（是空的），unverified 是有多少控制元件是預留值（全部），next_steps 是把它變成正式設定檔要做的事。

Input: slug (required), a kebab-case name made of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as jellyfish-bloom; and donor (optional, default 01-hello-particles), the name of a folder in examples/ to copy. Good donors: 01-hello-particles (a minimal canvas), 02-chord-garden (driven by chords), 03-pose-field (the camera), 05-prebiotic-flake (p5 and sound). The new folder is examples/-, where the number is the highest one already in examples/ plus 1, with two digits (28). It copies every file of the donor folder (the donors have no sub-folders, and a sub-folder would stop the copy with an error), so the new example starts as a working copy. A slug with anything else in it, or an unknown donor, or a folder that already exists is an error (slug must be kebab-case, unknown donor: …, already exists: …). Send slug every time. It is marked required in the input schema, but the tool does not check that it is there: without it the folder is created with the name examples/-undefined. donor is used as a folder name without further checks, so give it a plain name from examples/. { created, next_steps } as JSON text: created is the new folder (examples/28-jellyfish-bloom), next_steps is three lines: edit the World in main.js, edit the and hint in index.html, then open it with node serve.js.

輸入：slug（必填），由小寫字母、數字和連字號組成的 kebab-case 名稱，例如 jellyfish-bloom，以及 donor（選填，預設 01-hello-particles），要複製的 examples/ 裡的資料夾名稱。好用的範本有：01-hello-particles（最小的畫布）、02-chord-garden（由和弦驅動）、03-pose-field（鏡頭）、05-prebiotic-flake（p5 加聲音）。新資料夾是 examples/-，編號是 examples/ 裡現有最大的編號加 1，兩位數（28）。 它複製範本資料夾裡的每個檔案（現有的範本都沒有子資料夾，遇到子資料夾複製會出錯而中斷），所以新範例一開始就是能跑的副本。slug 含有其他字元、donor 不存在、或資料夾已經存在，都會是錯誤（slug must be kebab-case、unknown donor: …、already exists: …）。 每次都要送 slug。輸入 schema 把它標成必填，但工具本身沒有檢查它在不在：沒給的話，資料夾會以 examples/-undefined 的名字建立。 donor 會直接當成資料夾名稱使用，沒有再檢查，所以請給 examples/ 裡的單純名稱。 { created, next_steps }，格式是 JSON 文字：created 是新資料夾（examples/28-jellyfish-bloom），next_steps 是三行：編輯 main.js 裡的世界、編輯 index.html 的 和提示文字、然後用 node serve.js 打開。

Input: profile (required), the profile as an object or as a JSON string. A string that is not valid JSON does not raise an error: the answer is { ok: false, problems: ['not valid JSON: …'], conflicts: [] }. The checks cover the id and short name (lower-case, and short must not be one of the reserved generic names), a name and a kind (device or generic), a source for every device profile, the port regular expressions, the faceplate size, every control (a known type and message, cc or note in 0..127, two controls never on the same message, an encoder's relative mode) and that every control is shown on the faceplate. The conflicts are what the validator cannot see by itself: id and short are taken by a shipped profile (the short becomes the signal namespace midi//…), and port means a regular expression in match.ports is identical to a shipped one or matches its name, so the framework could not tell the two devices apart when one is plugged in. A profile for a new device passes when ok is true; a clone of a shipped one comes back with all three kinds. { ok, problems, conflicts } as JSON text. problems is a list of sentences from validateProfile() (controls[0] (a): cc must be 0..127). conflicts is a list of { with, kind, detail }: with is the shipped profile, kind is 'id', 'short' or 'port'. ok is true only when both are empty.

輸入：profile（必填），可以是物件，也可以是 JSON 字串。不是合法 JSON 的字串不會引發錯誤：答案是 { ok: false, problems: ['not valid JSON: …'], conflicts: [] }。檢查的範圍有：id 和簡稱（小寫，而且 short 不能是保留的通用名稱）、名稱和種類（device 或 generic）、每份 device 設定檔都要有來源、連接埠的正規表示式、面板尺寸、每個控制元件（已知的類型和訊息、cc 或 note 在 0..127、兩個控制元件不能用同一則訊息、編碼器的相對模式），以及每個控制元件都有顯示在面板上。 衝突是驗證器自己看不到的事：id 和 short 已經被內建的設定檔用掉了（short 會變成訊號命名空間 midi//…），port 則是 match.ports 裡的某條正規表示式跟內建的一模一樣、或對得上它的名稱，這樣接上其中一台時，框架分不出兩台裝置。新裝置的設定檔在 ok 是 true 的時候就算通過。複製一份內建設定檔去驗證，會三種衝突全都得到。 { ok, problems, conflicts }，格式是 JSON 文字。problems 是 validateProfile() 給的一串句子（controls[0] (a): cc must be 0..127）。conflicts 是 { with, kind, detail } 的清單：with 是內建的那份設定檔，kind 是 'id'、'short' 或 'port'。兩個都是空的，ok 才是 true。

open-audiovisual (OAV) is a JavaScript framework for live audiovisual performance that runs in the browser. It is plain ES modules: no build step, no dependencies, no account. You clone the repository, run one file, and open a page. It handles the part every show rebuilds from scratch: MIDI plumbing, turning inputs into parameters, a timeline with scenes, a director's console, a performance mode for the performer, and a backstage page for the stage manager. You write the world, the piece itself. The pitch, a live instrument and the thirty-one example works are on the homepage.

Performers play the examples with a MIDI keyboard, a microphone, a camera, a phone, or the on-screen piano, and drive a show from the console. Coders write a world in about twenty lines and get inputs, mapping, timeline, console, sound and backstage from one createShow() call. AI agents read AGENTS.md, connect to the bundled MCP server, and write worlds inside a chassis that already works. See For AI agents.
textCopy Each layer has one job and a written contract (Architecture), so any layer can be replaced without touching the others. Two rules keep it that way; they are explained in Core concepts.

The core was extracted from The Last Input (Che-Yu Wu, 2026), a performance for piano and a living digital world at the IRCAM residency × C-LAB Taiwan Sound Lab in Taipei, played on a 49.4-channel speaker dome. The timeline, the chord semantics, many-to-many MIDI learn and OSC batching all ran a real fourteen-scene show before they were generalized here. The rule since then: the framework only grows features that a real show asked for. The mapping layer's ideas descend from libmapper's research on signal namespaces. The sister project WebToe is a node-based dataflow engine that imports TouchDesigner projects; WebToe is the engine, open-audiovisual is the show.

New here: Quick start, then Core concepts, then Writing a world. Building a show: Inputs, Mapping, Show control, Phones, relay & surfaces. Looking something up: Signals reference and Package reference. Something is wrong: Troubleshooting. Everything here is checked against the source in packages/. When this page and the code disagree, the code is right and this page is a bug: please open an issue.

Pick the one that matches what you already have. They get bigger as you go down. One line in a p5.js sketch. Any p5.js sketch (OpenProcessing, the p5 editor, your own page) can be played from a MIDI controller, from a controller drawn on screen, or from a phone, by adding one line at the top. Read p5.js in one line, and play the sketch that carries it: example 15. The same line also plays sound, runs a drum machine you can write as one line of rhythm, listens to the microphone and records a video; each has a ready-made sketch among the examples (16 to 26). One controller in a page. <oav-controller profile="akai-lpd8"> puts a controller you can play into any web page. Read MIDI controllers & embedding, and pick yours in the controller library. A whole show. A World plus one createShow() call assembles inputs, mapping, timeline, console, sound and backstage. Start from example 01 and keep reading below.

You need Node.js (any current version; CI runs the tests on Node 22) and a browser. There is nothing to install: no npm install, no bundler. bashCopy serve.js is a static file server with caching turned off (stale code on stage is a nightmare) that also hosts the phone relay at ws://<host>:8080/relay. Pass a port to use another one: node serve.js 3000. The same commands exist as npm scripts: commandwhat it runs npm startnode serve.js npm run monitornode packages/monitor/server.js, the backstage monitor on port 7457 npm run bridgenode packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js, the OSC → UDP bridge on port 7456 npm testnode --test tests/*.test.js Open http://localhost:8080/examples/01-hello-particles/. Every example runs without hardware.

A show of your own does not need this repository. Save show.html (open it, then save the page, or copy its source), serve the folder it is in, and open it: bashCopy The file is one page with one import: the World you edit, and a createShow() call. Everything else arrives from one address: jsCopy Import what you need from that one address. A second address is a second copy of the framework in the same page. The phone relay and the backstage monitor are the two things a static page does not bring: the phone uses the public relay unless you run serve.js, and the monitor is node packages/monitor/server.js from a clone. When the work is up, add it to Made with.

@v0.12.0 in the address is a version of the whole framework. That address never changes, so the show you rehearsed is the show you play. To move to a newer one, change the number yourself and rehearse again. addresswhat you get https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/frank890417/open-audiovisual@v0.12.0/packages/openav.jsexactly 0.12.0, for good https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/openav.jsthe newest, a few minutes after each release https://openaudiovisual.com/p5/oav-p5.jsthe one line for p5.js: the newest (its own versions) Until 1.0, a new minor version (0.9 to 0.10) may rename or remove something, and the changelog says so in the entry's first line; a patch version (0.9.0 to 0.9.1) only fixes. What we work hardest not to break: the World contract (name, params, init, update, render, dispose), the signal names in Signals, the controller profile format, and the names oav-p5 gives a sketch. window.openav.version says which version a running show is.

Not sure what your device can do? Open the device check. It looks at your browser, Web MIDI, microphone, camera and graphics, and says what to do about each. Nothing runs until you press a button, and nothing leaves your device. Web MIDI is the one that differs most between browsers (sources checked 2026-10-15): Chrome and Edge have it. Use them for a show. Since Chrome 124 any use of MIDI asks for permission, where before only system-exclusive access did (Chrome blog). Firefox has Web MIDI on desktop from version 108, after you install Firefox's site-permission add-on (Firefox 108 release notes). Safari on Mac, iPhone and iPad has no Web MIDI (caniuse). WebKit lists it as not implemented because of fingerprinting concerns (WebKit), and bug 107250 is still open and unassigned. Chrome on an iPhone or iPad is WebKit underneath, so it has none either. On a Mac there is a third-party Safari extension, Safari-WebMIDI; we have not tested it. Where the browser has no Web MIDI, there are three routes: Play on screen. Every controller in the library plays with a finger, and every event still fires. Use a phone as the controller. See Phones, relay & surfaces. A browser app for the iPad. MIDIWeb Browser is a third-party app for iOS 17.6 and later that gives pages Web MIDI. We have not tested it with open-audiovisual. On Windows 11 the built-in Windows MIDI Services (released 2026-02-17) give apps shared MIDI ports and a loopback, so loopMIDI is no longer needed to send MIDI from the browser to a DAW (Windows blog); see Play your DAW with it. Two more rules apply to every browser: Camera and microphone only work in a secure context: http://localhost or https://. Open the show on the machine that runs serve.js through localhost, not through its LAN address. Phones can join over plain http:// on the local network for touch, keys and the control surface. iOS only gives motion sensors and the camera to https:// pages (see Phones, relay & surfaces).

An example page has two parts: the stage on the left (the world renders there) and the side panel on the right. From the top, the side panel holds: The piano, with two checkboxes: keyboard turns on QWERTY playing, simulate performance starts a hands-free player. Transport: play/pause, previous/next scene, reset, the clock, the current scene, and a scrubber with one block per scene. Layers: what every layer is doing right now (events per second per input, active routes, world and FPS, what is leaving the browser). L1 · Input: MIDI devices (untick to mute one) and buttons for sources that need a click: 🎤 mic, 🖐 hands, 🕺 body. L2 · Mapping: every route, with a mute box and ✕ to remove it. L3 · Params: a slider per param, ✕ to clear an override, learn to map. L4 · Output — sound, when the show has sound: enable sound. Signals: a live meter for every signal. Each panel title collapses its panel. keyaction Spaceplay / pause the timeline ← →previous / next scene Rstop and rewind the timeline to 0:00 Tperformance mode (teleprompter) Ffullscreen Mshow/hide the on-screen MIDI controller (only in shows that set modules.midi.controllers)

On-screen piano: click or touch the keys; drag across them for a glissando. QWERTY: tick keyboard first (capture is off by default so letters do not steal the console's hotkeys). The keys A W S E D F T G Y H U J K O L P ; play 17 notes a semitone apart, starting at the piano's base note; Z/X shift an octave; hold Shift for a louder note. Simulate performance: a hands-free player noodles in a pentatonic scale with steps, leaps, triads and rests, so you can watch the mapping breathe. Drum machine (examples 03 and 06): a step sequencer whose signals have the same shape as the microphone's drum detection. On-screen MIDI controller (example 09): a picture of a known controller you can play with the mouse (the supported devices are listed on the controllers page); plug the real one in and the picture moves with your hands. All of these publish the same signals as real hardware, so nothing downstream can tell the difference.

A world is an object with params and four lifecycle functions. Hand it to createShow() and the rest of the show is assembled around it: jsCopy Play a note: the circle jumps and decays. Drag the size slider, or click learn next to it and turn a knob. That is the whole model: params for continuous control, signals for events.

Copy examples/01-hello-particles/ to examples/<nn>-<name>/ (the next free number). Its index.html already has an import map for every @openav/* package; the ?v= suffixes are cache stamps written by tools/stamp-version.mjs before a deploy. Write your world in main.js (Writing a world). Change the <title> in index.html. Add CDN script tags there if you use p5 or another renderer. Open http://localhost:8080/examples/<nn>-<name>/. An AI agent can do steps 1–2 with the MCP tool scaffold_world (For AI agents).

npm test passes (it covers the pure logic: chords, timeline, mapping, relay, surfaces, MIDI parsing and profiles, the site pages). The page loads with no console errors. One message is expected: if the backstage monitor is not running, the browser reports that ws://localhost:7457 refused the connection. The page retries quietly with a growing delay (up to 30 s). Run npm run monitor to make it go away. Press Space: the timeline plays and something changes over time. Tick keyboard and press A: the world reacts without any hardware. window.openav in the devtools console is the whole show (signals, params, mapper, timeline…), for poking at it by hand.
Six words carry the whole framework: signal, param, route, world, timeline, show. This chapter defines each one and the two rules that hold them together.

A signal is a named value that says what is happening: a knob's position, the loudness of the room, the height of a wrist, the consonance of the last chord. Every input package publishes signals into one registry (Signals from @openav/core) and does nothing else. Signals are the only currency of input. There are two kinds: kindholdsexampleread it with continuousa current value, usually 0..1midi/cc/74 = 0.42signals.get(name), signals.norm(name) pulsethe payload of the last eventmidi/note/on → { note: 60, vel: 0.8, … }signals.on(name, cb) Names are paths, source first: midi/cc/74, audio/band/low, pose/hand/right/y, phone/ab12/tilt/x, surface/main/hue. Ranges are normalized where that makes performance sense, and y axes are flipped so that 1 means raised, never raw pixels. A signal is declared with its range so that meters and learn can scale it: jsCopy set() on a name nobody declared defines it on the spot as continuous 0..1. If your values live elsewhere (degrees, MIDI note numbers), declare the range first. A knob, a raised hand and a chord's consonance are equal citizens in this registry. That equality is what lets you mix them: a hand can do whatever a knob does.

A param is a value the world listens to: hue, bloom, gravity. The world declares its params; each one is a line of schema: jsCopy Every frame each param resolves to one number: textCopy An override is sticky. Once a hand or a route has touched bloom, the timeline stops moving it until the override is cleared (✕ in the console, or params.clearOverride('bloom')). That matches the stage: when a human grabs a control, the score yields. A route can choose otherwise: mode: 'trim' adds the knob to the timeline's value, and release hands the param back when the knob stands still (Mapping). When a hand and a route both touch a param, the last deliberate change wins and a repetition is not a change: a source that sends the same reading again never undoes a hand (Who holds a value); params.holder(key) and the console say who holds it. The full field list is in Writing a world.

A route connects one signal to one param. Routes are plain data: jsCopy The mapper (@openav/mapping) holds the routes and applies them: it reads the signal, clamps it into a window (inMin..inMax), optionally inverts it, bends it with a curve, scales it into the param's range and, if asked, smooths it over time. One signal may drive several params and one param may listen to several signals. Learn binds the next signal that moves, which works for a knob and for a waving hand alike. Routes serialize to JSON, so a wiring is a file you can carry to the next venue. Details: Mapping.

A world is the piece: an object with a name, its params, and init / update / render / dispose. It reads resolved params every frame and may subscribe to signals for discrete events. It brings its own renderer: 2D canvas, p5, three.js, a WebToe patch, DOM, anything. The framework has no opinion. Details: Writing a world.

The timeline (@openav/timeline) is the score: keyframed automation per param, plus a list of scenes with titles and notes for the performer. It owns time; worlds never read the clock. Scenes may start before zero for a pre-show standby. Details: Show control.

A show is a world plus one createShow() call (@openav/show). It builds the signals registry, the params, the stage, the timeline, the mapper, the inputs you ask for, sound, the console, the backstage feed and the frame loop, and returns all of them. Every example is a world plus this call, so when the framework grows a module, every show can have it by declaring it. jsCopy

Two rules make the framework composable. They come in two forms: one says how the system is designed, the other says what that asks of anyone writing code for it. 1. Signals are the only currency of input. So: continuous control goes through params; discrete events may use signals. A world that reads signals.get('midi/cc/74') inside update() still works, today, with your controller. But it can no longer be driven by the timeline, by a dancer's wrist, by a phone, or by someone else's controller. You have welded the performance to one input. Declare a param instead and let a route connect midi/cc/74 → yourParam. The same world then works for everyone, and the console, the phone surface and learn all see the param. Events are different. "A note was struck", "a chord resolved", "a kick hit" are moments, not levels. Subscribing to them in init() is correct and encouraged; it is what makes a world react rather than just drift. 2. Worlds never know who is performing them. So: the shell never knows the work. A world reads params, and whether a value came from the timeline, a MIDI knob, a dancer or a slider is invisible to it. The same holds for the framework: never edit packages/* to make one example look right. A framework change has to make every work better. Switching works means swapping a world and its data; the shell stays.

open-audiovisual is a data-layer framework. Its entire value is that four layers and two spines stay cleanly separated, so any of them can be replaced without touching the others. This page states each layer's contract precisely.

One Loop (@openav/core) drives everything. This is the order createShow() runs each frame (packages/show/index.js): jsCopy Signals arrive between frames, whenever a device or a socket fires. An unsmoothed route writes its param immediately; a smoothed route sets a target that mapper.update(dt) glides toward. OSC output is not part of createShow(); if you use it, flush it from onFrame (Show control). dt is in seconds and clamped to 0.1 (new Loop(fn, { maxDt })), so a stall never makes a world explode. When the browser freezes requestAnimationFrame (the projection window went to the background), a Web Worker heartbeat keeps the loop ticking, about every 66 ms (~15 frames per second): the timeline, mapped signals and the backstage feed must not stop because someone switched windows. Who supplies the frames is a choice, and the page's own is only the default. new Loop(fn, { clock, raf }) takes the time and the frame requests from you (a test's fake timer, a recorder's frame pump), and new Loop(fn, { manual: true }) schedules nothing: each loop.step(dt) is one frame. createShow({ loop: 'manual' }) does that for the whole show (Driving the frames yourself). Param resolution order (the heart of the design): textCopy An override is sticky: once a knob touched bloom, the timeline no longer moves it until the override is cleared (✕ in the console). This matches performance reality — when a human grabs a control, the score yields. A route can choose otherwise: mode: 'trim' adds the knob to the timeline's value instead of replacing it, and release hands the param back when the knob stands still (Mapping).

Contract: input packages publish named, normalized signals into a Signals registry, and do nothing else. They never touch params or worlds. names are path-like: midi/cc/74, chord/consonance, pose/hand/right/y continuous signals declare {min, max} and always hold a current value pulse signals (kind: 'pulse') fire events; their payload is the event object anyone can subscribe: signals.on(name, cb) or signals.onAny(cb) Adding a new input modality (breath sensor, gamepad, stock ticker, weather API) means writing one class that calls signals.set() / signals.pulse(). Nothing downstream changes. That is the whole point. The inputs today: @openav/midi (hardware and on-screen controllers), keys, drums, audio (microphone), pose (camera body and hands), leap (Leap Motion / Ultraleap hands) and phones through remote and surface. Hardware a browser cannot open itself reaches it through a small local bridge that speaks a web protocol (leap runs one on ws://127.0.0.1:6437); the browser side is still one class that publishes signals. Analyzers sit between raw sources and mapping: @openav/chord subscribes to midi/note/on|off and publishes chord/*. It is still an input as far as the mapper is concerned; it just listens to other signals instead of a device.

Contract: the only component that connects signals to params. Routes are data: jsCopy many-to-many: one signal may drive several params; one param may listen to several signals (last writer wins). Learn adds, it never replaces. learn is generalized MIDI-learn: mapper.learn('bloom') binds the next signal that moves ≥5% of its range — a knob and a waving hand both qualify. routes serialize to JSON → mapping profiles are shareable files. Full reference: Mapping.

Contract: a World is { name, params, init, update(dt, state, io), render, dispose }. It reads state (resolved param values). It may subscribe to signals for discrete events (a note-on spawning a particle is an event, not a parameter), but continuous control must flow through params — otherwise your world stops being performable by the timeline or by other inputs. The Stage owns lifecycle and param aggregation and deliberately does not own a renderer. p5, three.js, 2D canvas, SVG, DOM — the framework has no opinion. Constitutional rule (inherited from The Last Input): the shell never knows the work. Switching works = swapping World + automation data. The shell stays. Full reference: Writing a world.

The output layer splits in two. Both branches hang off the same signals → mapping → params spine — sound is performable state, not a side effect. Video branch screen is the default output; performance mode (T) gives the performer a teleprompter while the audience sees the stage window fullscreen (F). recording (@openav/record): the work and the performer's camera composited into one canvas of an exact size (vertical 1080×1920 up to 4K) and recorded with the work's own sound by one MediaRecorder, so picture and sound share a clock. MIDI takes record the playing itself and replay it into the show. future: NDI gateway (see roadmap; groundwork lives in sister project WebToe). Audio branch MIDI out (external synths/DAWs): midi.send()/noteOn()/cc() — one throat, observable (onSend) so meters can watch everything, with a real panic(). In-browser synthesis: @openav/sound — a small pluggable engine contract (params, enable, noteOn, noteOff, set, dispose) with a Tone.js engine first (CDN, loaded only on enable) that plays instruments from a registry: a sampled grand piano, mallets, strings, organ, synth presets, one file per sound, picked from the console. Engine params register as sound/* — a knob, a hand, or the timeline plays the filter cutoff exactly the way it plays the visuals. The drum kit in @openav/drums is a second engine behind the same contract (pure WebAudio, no samples needed). OSC: browser → HTTP → osc-bridge.js → UDP (Spat, Reaper, TD, lights). Batched per frame; only the latest message per address survives a frame.

Pure logic, no DOM: params + automation keyframes + scenes → state(t). Scenes may start at negative t (pre-show standby). onSceneChange is the cue hook — fire sound, lights, prompts from it. A scene with hold: true stops playback at its end until the operator releases it. A show with structure adds the score to this spine (@openav/score): the show written as segment lengths, from which Score computes every start, end, cue and countdown, and Director runs the module that performs each segment (enter once, exit once, a crash switches off only that module). The timeline takes its scenes and total from the score, and the director plugs into it as a param layer: textCopy The score only decides when. What happens still reaches the world as params. Full reference: Score & Director. A timeline can also follow another's clock instead of walking by itself, which is how several pages perform one show: the leader runs, the followers chase its T over a BroadcastChannel or the room relay, and every param still resolves as a function of that T (Several pages, one show).

The performance page streams JSON snapshots (throttled, ~15 Hz) over WebSocket to a dependency-free relay (server.js, hand-rolled RFC 6455). Any phone or laptop on the LAN opens the backstage page and sees: clock, scene, world, FPS, overrides, every signal and param, and a "stage feed lost" alarm. The work can add its own health numbers to the feed (Backstage monitor). The monitor is a first-class citizen because a show without a backstage is a rehearsal.

Console (@openav/console): the director's desk in the side panel, laid out by layer (Layers → L1 → L2 → L3 → L4 → Signals), plus performance mode and a curve view of the whole show's automation. It reads the same objects the loop runs; it owns nothing. Phones (@openav/relay, @openav/surface, @openav/remote): phones and iPads join a room on a WebSocket relay and publish phone/* and surface/* signals. To the mapper they are one more input. See Phones, relay & surfaces.
A world is the only part of the framework you have to write. Everything else is assembly.
